/**
 * 数据层单例装配（手工依赖注入，不引第三方容器）。
 *
 * `currentSid` / `currentName` / `currentToken` 由根页面在登录/退出时维护；各仓库通过闭包读取，
 * 避免仓库持有会话对象。`currentToken` 只用于请求头（`X-Device-Id` 等），**不放日志、不落盘**。
 */
export class Services {
  static currentSid: string = '';
  static currentName: string = '';
  /** 班级 token（身份会话凭据）：只供请求头使用，禁止打印/持久化到日志或业务数据。 */
  static currentToken: string = '';

  static readonly api: HttpClient = new HttpClient();
  static readonly sessionStore: SessionStore = new SessionStore();
  static readonly auth: AuthRepository = new AuthRepository(Services.api);

  static readonly userdata: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(
    Services.api,
    new FileUserdataLocalStore(() => Services.currentSid),
    () => Services.currentSid);

  static readonly marks: MarksRepository = new MarksRepository(
    Services.api,
    () => Services.currentSid,
    new FileMarksLocalStore(() => Services.currentSid));

  static readonly members: ClassMembersRepository = new ClassMembersRepository(
    Services.api,
    new FileClassMemberCache(),
    () => Services.currentSid);

  static readonly league: ClassLeagueRepository = new ClassLeagueRepository(
    Services.api,
    () => Services.currentSid);

  static readonly fitRecs: FitRecsRepository = new FitRecsRepository(
    Services.api,
    () => Services.currentSid);

  static readonly homework: HomeworkRepository = new HomeworkRepository(Services.api);

  static readonly notices: NoticesRepository = new NoticesRepository(Services.api);

  static readonly power: PowerRepository = new PowerRepository(Services.api);

  static readonly vote: VoteRepository = new VoteRepository(Services.api);

  static readonly ppt: PptRepository = new PptRepository(Services.api);

  static readonly diag: DiagRepository = new DiagRepository(Services.api);

  static readonly timetable: TimetableRepository = new TimetableRepository(
    Services.api,
    () => JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(Services.userdata.currentSections(), 'tt')));

  static readonly login: TimetableLoginRepository = new TimetableLoginRepository(Services.api);

  /** 文件传输 / 临时云空间（ECS drop v2.2；token 只在 X-Device-Id 请求头）。 */
  static readonly cloudspace: CloudSpaceRepository = new CloudSpaceRepository(
    () => Services.currentToken);

  static readonly visits: VisitsReporter = new VisitsReporter(
    Services.api,
    new PreferencesVisitsStore(),
    () => Services.currentSid,
    () => Services.currentName);
}
/** 极简异步互斥（替代 Kotlin Mutex；ArkTS 无协程）。 */
export class AsyncLock {
  private tail: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

  async run<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const previous: Promise<void> = this.tail;
    let release: () => void = () => {
    };
    this.tail = new Promise<void>((resolve: () => void) => {
      release = resolve;
    });
    await previous;
    try {
      return await task();
    } finally {
      release();
    }
  }
}

/**
 * 统一日志封装。
 *
 * 红线：**不打印** token、学号、姓名、宿舍号等隐私字段；调用方传入的文本必须已脱敏。
 */
export class Log {
  static i(tag: string, message: string): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, PREFIX, '[%{public}s] %{public}s', tag, message);
  }

  static w(tag: string, message: string): void {
    hilog.warn(DOMAIN, PREFIX, '[%{public}s] %{public}s', tag, message);
  }

  static e(tag: string, message: string): void {
    hilog.error(DOMAIN, PREFIX, '[%{public}s] %{public}s', tag, message);
  }
}

import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Api } from '../net/Api';

/** 一条华为账号绑定记录。 */
export class BindItem {
  openId: string = '';
  device: string = '';
  createdAt: string = '';

  masked(): string {
    if (this.openId.length <= 8) {
      return '已绑定账号';
    }
    return this.openId.substring(0, 4) + '…' + this.openId.substring(this.openId.length - 4);
  }
}

export class HwLoginResult {
  session: Session | undefined = undefined;
  reason: string = '';
}

interface HwActionJson {
  ok?: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  count?: number;
}

interface HwLoginJson {
  ok?: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  token?: string;
  sid?: string;
  name?: string;
  role?: string;
  badge?: string;
  is_admin?: boolean;
}

interface HwBindRowJson {
  open_id?: string;
  device?: string;
  created_at?: string;
}

/** 华为账号 ↔ 学号绑定（RPC：hw_bind / hw_bindings / hw_unbind / hw_login）。 */
export class AccountBindingRepository {
  /** 绑定当前华为账号；成功返回空串，失败返回原因。 */
  static async bind(openId: string, device: string, api: Api = Services.api): Promise<string> {
    if (openId.length === 0) {
      return '没有拿到华为账号标识';
    }
    const body: string = JSON.stringify({ p_open_id: openId, p_device: device });
    const result: ApiResult = await api.post('rpc/hw_bind', body);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '绑定失败';
    }
    try {
      const obj: HwActionJson = JSON.parse(result.value) as HwActionJson;
      if (obj.ok !== true) {
        return obj.reason !== undefined && obj.reason.length > 0 ? obj.reason : '绑定失败';
      }
      return '';
    } catch (e) {
      return '绑定服务返回异常';
    }
  }

  /** 当前学号已绑定的华为账号列表。 */
  static async list(api: Api = Services.api): Promise<BindItem[]> {
    const result: ApiResult = await api.post('rpc/hw_bindings', '{}');
    const out: BindItem[] = [];
    if (!result.ok) {
      return out;
    }
    if (result.value.length === 0) {
      return out;
    }
    let parsed: Object;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(result.value);
    } catch (e) {
      return out;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return out;
    }
    const arr: Object[] = parsed as Object[];
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      const row: HwBindRowJson = arr[i] as HwBindRowJson;
      const item: BindItem = new BindItem();
      item.openId = row.open_id !== undefined ? row.open_id : '';
      item.device = row.device !== undefined ? row.device : '';
      item.createdAt = row.created_at !== undefined ? row.created_at : '';
      if (item.openId.length > 0) {
        out.push(item);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 解绑指定华为账号。 */
  static async unbind(openId: string, api: Api = Services.api): Promise<boolean> {
    const result: ApiResult = await api.post('rpc/hw_unbind',
      JSON.stringify({ p_open_id: openId }));
    if (!result.ok || result.value.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      const obj: HwActionJson = JSON.parse(result.value) as HwActionJson;
      return obj.ok === true;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** 用华为账号换班级会话；未绑定时 reason 说明原因。 */
  static async login(openId: string, api: Api = Services.api): Promise<HwLoginResult> {
    const out: HwLoginResult = new HwLoginResult();
    if (openId.length === 0) {
      out.reason = '没有拿到华为账号标识';
      return out;
    }
    const result: ApiResult = await api.post('rpc/hw_login',
      JSON.stringify({ p_open_id: openId }));
    if (!result.ok) {
      out.reason = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '登录失败';
      return out;
    }
    let obj: HwLoginJson;
    try {
      obj = JSON.parse(result.value) as HwLoginJson;
    } catch (e) {
      out.reason = '登录服务返回异常';
      return out;
    }
    if (obj.ok !== true) {
      out.reason = obj.reason !== undefined ? obj.reason : '登录失败';
      return out;
    }
    const session: Session = new Session(
      obj.sid !== undefined ? obj.sid : '',
      obj.name !== undefined ? obj.name : '',
      obj.token !== undefined ? obj.token : ''
    );
    session.role = obj.role !== undefined ? obj.role : '';
    session.badge = obj.badge !== undefined ? obj.badge : '';
    session.isAdmin = obj.is_admin === true;
    out.session = session;
    return out;
  }
}
import { authentication } from '@kit.AccountKit';
import { common } from '@kit.AbilityKit';

/**
 * 华为账号（Account Kit）：只取 openID（scope = openid）。
 *
 * 说明：授权接口在手机 / 平板 / PC / 手表（5.1.0+）可用；
 * 需要 AGC 已开通 Account Kit，并且应用证件与 client_id 配置正确。
 */
export class HuaweiAccount {
  /** 拉起华为账号授权并返回 openID；用户取消或失败时抛错。 */
  static async openId(context: common.Context): Promise<string> {
    const provider = new authentication.HuaweiIDProvider();
    const request = provider.createAuthorizationWithHuaweiIDRequest();
    request.scopes = ['openid'];
    const controller = new authentication.AuthenticationController(context);
    const response = await controller.executeRequest(request) as authentication.AuthorizationWithHuaweiIDResponse;
    const openId: string = response.data !== undefined && response.data.openID !== undefined ? response.data.openID : '';
    return openId;
  }

  /** 把 Account Kit 错误码翻成用户能懂的文案（不泄露内部细节）。 */
  static message(err: Object): string {
    const text: string = JSON.stringify(err);
    if (text.indexOf('1001502001') >= 0 || text.indexOf('1001500001') >= 0) {
      return '未登录华为账号，请先在系统设置登录';
    }
    if (text.indexOf('1001502012') >= 0) {
      return '已取消华为账号授权';
    }
    if (text.indexOf('1001502003') >= 0) {
      return '应用未开通华为账号服务';
    }
    return '华为账号登录失败，请稍后重试';
  }
}
import { HttpClient } from '../net/HttpClient';
import { ApiError, ApiErrorKind, ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Session } from '../session/Session';

const VERIFY_PATH: string = 'rpc/class_verify';
const SESSION_TTL_MS: number = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const STUDENT_ID_REGEX: RegExp = new RegExp('^\\d{10}$');

interface VerifyJson {
  ok?: boolean;
  token?: string;
  sid?: string;
  name?: string;
  role?: string;
  badge?: string;
  is_admin?: boolean;
  reason?: string;
}

interface VerifyRequest {
  p_sid: string;
  p_name: string;
}

/** 身份核验结果。 */
export class VerifyResult {
  ok: boolean;
  session: Session | undefined;
  code: string;
  message: string;

  constructor(ok: boolean, session: Session | undefined, code: string, message: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.session = session;
    this.code = code;
    this.message = message;
  }

  static success(session: Session): VerifyResult {
    return new VerifyResult(true, session, 'ok', '');
  }

  static failure(code: string, message: string): VerifyResult {
    return new VerifyResult(false, undefined, code, message);
  }
}

/**
 * 真实身份仓库：`POST rpc/class_verify`（唯一免班级 token 的接口）。
 *
 * 契约：请求 `{p_sid, p_name}`；响应兼容「对象」与「单元素数组」，成功必须带 `token`。
 * 成功后本地会话 `issuedAt=now`、`expiresAt=now+30d`（服务端 token 30 天）。
 */
export class AuthRepository {
  private api: HttpClient;
  private now: () => number;

  constructor(api: HttpClient, now: () => number = () => Date.now()) {
    this.api = api;
    this.now = now;
  }

  async verify(studentId: string, name: string): Promise<VerifyResult> {
    const sid: string = studentId.trim();
    const nm: string = name.trim();
    if (!STUDENT_ID_REGEX.test(sid)) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('invalid_input', '请输入 10 位学号');
    }
    if (nm.length === 0) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('invalid_input', '请输入姓名');
    }
    const body: VerifyRequest = { p_sid: sid, p_name: nm };
    let result: ApiResult = await this.api.post(VERIFY_PATH, JSON.stringify(body), '', false);
    // 云端 PostgREST schema cache 偶发未刷新时重试一次（线上曾出现 "Could not find the function ... in the schema cache"）。
    if (!result.ok && result.error !== undefined && this.isSchemaCacheError(result.error.message)) {
      await AuthRepository.delay(800);
      result = await this.api.post(VERIFY_PATH, JSON.stringify(body), '', false);
    }
    if (!result.ok) {
      return this.mapError(result.error, result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '请求失败');
    }
    return this.parse(result.value, sid, nm);
  }

  private isSchemaCacheError(message: string): boolean {
    const text: string = message.toLowerCase();
    return text.indexOf('schema cache') >= 0 || text.indexOf('could not find the function') >= 0
      || text.indexOf('pgrst202') >= 0;
  }

  private static delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve: () => void) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        resolve();
      }, ms);
    });
  }

  private parse(raw: string, fallbackSid: string, fallbackName: string): VerifyResult {
    let body: VerifyJson | undefined = undefined;
    try {
      const parsed: Object = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        const arr: Object[] = parsed as Object[];
        if (arr.length > 0) {
          body = arr[0] as VerifyJson;
        }
      } else {
        body = parsed as VerifyJson;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('parse_error', '身份服务返回了无法解析的内容');
    }
    if (body === undefined) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('parse_error', '身份服务返回结构异常');
    }
    const token: string = body.token !== undefined ? body.token : '';
    const reason: string = body.reason !== undefined ? body.reason : '';
    if (body.ok === false) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('invalid_credentials', reason.length > 0 ? reason : '姓名或学号不在班级名单中');
    }
    if (token.length === 0) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('token_missing', reason.length > 0 ? reason : '云端未返回身份凭证，请稍后重试');
    }
    const nowMs: number = this.now();
    const s: Session = new Session(
      body.sid !== undefined && body.sid.trim().length > 0 ? body.sid.trim() : fallbackSid,
      body.name !== undefined && body.name.trim().length > 0 ? body.name.trim() : fallbackName,
      token
    );
    s.role = body.role !== undefined ? body.role : '';
    s.badge = body.badge !== undefined ? body.badge : '';
    s.isAdmin = body.is_admin === true;
    s.issuedAt = nowMs;
    s.expiresAt = nowMs + SESSION_TTL_MS;
    return VerifyResult.success(s);
  }

  private mapError(error: ApiError | undefined, fallback: string): VerifyResult {
    if (error === undefined) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('unknown', '请求失败');
    }
    if (error.kind === ApiErrorKind.TokenInvalid) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('invalid_credentials', '姓名或学号不在班级名单中');
    }
    if (error.kind === ApiErrorKind.Http) {
      if (this.isSchemaCacheError(error.message)) {
        return VerifyResult.failure('server_error', '登录服务正在更新，请稍后重试');
      }
      if (error.status >= 400 && error.status < 500) {
        return VerifyResult.failure('invalid_credentials',
          error.message.length > 0 ? error.message : '姓名或学号不在班级名单中');
      }
      return VerifyResult.failure('server_error', fallback);
    }
    if (error.kind === ApiErrorKind.Network) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('network', '网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试');
    }
    if (error.kind === ApiErrorKind.Config) {
      return VerifyResult.failure('not_configured', '云端配置缺失');
    }
    return VerifyResult.failure('parse_error', fallback);
  }
}

/**
 * ECS drop 服务 API 客户端（契约 `web/drop/CONTRACT.md` v2.2）——**纯请求描述 + 响应解析**。
 *
 * 接口：
 * - `GET  /mine`                          是否有活动会话（不创建）
 * - `POST /open`                          惰性创建/复用本账号会话（同 sid 跨设备自动互见）
 * - `GET  /state?sessionId=&since=`       事件列表（`file` 事件带签名 downloadUrl；`filedel` 表示删除）
 * - `POST /upload/init`                   分片上传初始化（返回 uploadId/chunkSize）
 * - `POST /upload/chunk?uploadId=&index=` 原始字节分片（8MiB，`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`）
 * - `POST /upload/finish`                 拼接完成（返回 file 并追加 file 事件）
 * - `DELETE /file/<fileId>?sessionId=`    单文件删除（幂等）
 * - `POST /close`                         清空：删除会话与全部文件
 *
 * 鉴权：所有请求带 `X-Device-Id: <班级 token>`。**token 只出现在请求头**：
 * 不进 URL / 请求体 / 日志 / 错误文案 / 落盘。本文件不 import 网络/文件 API，hypium 可直接测。
 */
export class CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
  method: string = 'GET';
  /** 相对路径（以 `/` 开头），由 [CloudSpaceApi.url] 拼到基址。 */
  path: string = '';
  /** JSON 请求体文本（GET/DELETE 为空）。 */
  bodyText: string = '';
  /** 请求体类型：''（无）、'application/json'、'application/octet-stream'。 */
  contentType: string = '';
  /** 是否携带班级 token（`X-Device-Id`）。 */
  authenticated: boolean = true;
}

export class CloudSpaceApi {
  static readonly APPLICATION_JSON: string = 'application/json';
  static readonly OCTET_STREAM: string = 'application/octet-stream';

  /** 规范化基址（**结尾不带 `/`**）；`url("/state")` → `<base>/state`。 */
  baseUrl: string = CloudSpaceDefaults.BASE_URL;

  constructor(baseUrl: string = CloudSpaceDefaults.BASE_URL) {
    this.baseUrl = CloudSpaceApi.normalizeBase(baseUrl);
  }

  static normalizeBase(baseUrl: string): string {
    let base: string = baseUrl.trim();
    while (base.endsWith('/')) {
      base = base.substring(0, base.length - 1);
    }
    return base;
  }

  /** 拼接完整 URL；`path` 自带 query。 */
  url(path: string): string {
    if (path.length === 0) {
      return this.baseUrl;
    }
    return path.startsWith('/') ? this.baseUrl + path : this.baseUrl + '/' + path;
  }

  /**
   * 统一请求头：token 只在 `X-Device-Id`，其余为 JSON/缓存约定。
   * 空 token 不发该头（避免把空串当身份）。
   */
  headers(token: string, contentType: string = ''): Record<string, string> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    const trimmed: string = token.trim();
    if (trimmed.length > 0) {
      headers['X-Device-Id'] = trimmed;
    }
    headers['Accept'] = 'application/json';
    headers['Cache-Control'] = 'no-store';
    if (contentType.length > 0) {
      headers['Content-Type'] = contentType;
    }
    return headers;
  }

  // ---- 请求描述 -----------------------------------------------------------

  mineSpec(): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    return CloudSpaceApi.spec('GET', '/mine');
  }

  openSpec(): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = CloudSpaceApi.spec('POST', '/open');
    spec.bodyText = '{}';
    spec.contentType = CloudSpaceApi.APPLICATION_JSON;
    return spec;
  }

  stateSpec(sessionId: string, since: number): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const path: string = '/state?sessionId=' + encodeURIComponent(sessionId)
      + '&since=' + Math.max(0, Math.floor(since));
    return CloudSpaceApi.spec('GET', path);
  }

  initSpec(sessionId: string, name: string, size: number, mimeType: string, totalChunks: number): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = CloudSpaceApi.spec('POST', '/upload/init');
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['sessionId'] = sessionId;
    body['name'] = name;
    body['size'] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(size));
    body['mime'] = mimeType.length > 0 ? mimeType : CloudSpaceApi.OCTET_STREAM;
    body['totalChunks'] = Math.max(1, Math.floor(totalChunks));
    spec.bodyText = JsonBlob.encode(body);
    spec.contentType = CloudSpaceApi.APPLICATION_JSON;
    return spec;
  }

  chunkSpec(uploadId: string, index: number): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const path: string = '/upload/chunk?uploadId=' + encodeURIComponent(uploadId)
      + '&index=' + Math.max(0, Math.floor(index));
    const spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = CloudSpaceApi.spec('POST', path);
    spec.contentType = CloudSpaceApi.OCTET_STREAM;
    return spec;
  }

  finishSpec(sessionId: string, uploadId: string): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = CloudSpaceApi.spec('POST', '/upload/finish');
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['sessionId'] = sessionId;
    body['uploadId'] = uploadId;
    spec.bodyText = JsonBlob.encode(body);
    spec.contentType = CloudSpaceApi.APPLICATION_JSON;
    return spec;
  }

  deleteSpec(fileId: string, sessionId: string): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const path: string = '/file/' + encodeURIComponent(fileId) + '?sessionId=' + encodeURIComponent(sessionId);
    return CloudSpaceApi.spec('DELETE', path);
  }

  closeSpec(sessionId: string): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = CloudSpaceApi.spec('POST', '/close');
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['sessionId'] = sessionId;
    spec.bodyText = JsonBlob.encode(body);
    spec.contentType = CloudSpaceApi.APPLICATION_JSON;
    return spec;
  }

  // ---- 响应解释 -----------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * HTTP 状态 + 响应体 → 统一结果：
   * - 非 2xx：优先服务端 `{ok:false,reason}`；
   * - 2xx 但 `ok:false` → rejected；
   * - 非 JSON / 不符合契约 → parse。
   */
  static interpret(status: number, bodyText: string): CloudSpaceResult<Blob> {
    const parsed: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(bodyText);
    if (status < 200 || status >= 300) {
      const reason: string = parsed !== undefined
        ? JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'reason'), '') : '';
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<Blob>(CloudSpaceErrors.http(status, reason));
    }
    if (parsed === undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<Blob>(CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    if (JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'ok'), true) === false) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<Blob>(
        CloudSpaceErrors.rejected(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'reason'), '')));
    }
    return CloudSpaceResult.success<Blob>(parsed);
  }

  /** `/mine` / `/state` / `/open` 的 session 节点 → 会话；缺失/非法返回 undefined。 */
  static parseSessionNode(blob: Blob | undefined): CloudSpaceSession | undefined {
    if (blob === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const id: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'id'), '').trim();
    if (id.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return new CloudSpaceSession(
      id,
      JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'code'), ''),
      JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'createdAt'), 0),
      JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'expiresAt'), 0));
  }

  /** `/state` 响应 → 事件列表 + cursor。 */
  static parseState(blob: Blob): CloudSpaceState {
    const state: CloudSpaceState = new CloudSpaceState();
    state.session = CloudSpaceApi.parseSessionNode(JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'session')));
    const rawEvents: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'events'));
    let maxSeq: number = 0;
    if (rawEvents !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < rawEvents.length; i++) {
        const eventBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(rawEvents[i]);
        if (eventBlob === undefined) {
          continue;
        }
        const event: CloudSpaceEvent | undefined = CloudSpaceApi.parseEvent(eventBlob);
        if (event !== undefined) {
          state.events.push(event);
          if (event.seq > maxSeq) {
            maxSeq = event.seq;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const cursor: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'cursor'), -1);
    state.cursor = cursor >= 0 ? cursor : maxSeq;
    return state;
  }

  /** `/upload/init` 响应 → uploadId/chunkSize；uploadId 缺失返回 undefined。 */
  static parseInit(blob: Blob): CloudSpaceUploadInit | undefined {
    const uploadId: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'uploadId'), '').trim();
    if (uploadId.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const init: CloudSpaceUploadInit = new CloudSpaceUploadInit();
    init.uploadId = uploadId;
    const chunkSize: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'chunkSize'), 0);
    init.chunkSize = chunkSize > 0 ? Math.floor(chunkSize) : CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE;
    return init;
  }

  /** `/upload/finish` 响应 → 新文件；缺失返回 undefined。 */
  static parseFinishedFile(blob: Blob): CloudSpaceFile | undefined {
    return CloudSpaceApi.parseFileObject(JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'file')), 0);
  }

  /** `DELETE /file` 响应 → 是否真的删除了（幂等：不存在返回 false 也算成功）。 */
  static parseDeleted(blob: Blob): boolean {
    return JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'deleted'), false);
  }

  /** `/upload/chunk` 响应 → 服务端累计已收字节（仅诊断用）。 */
  static parseReceived(blob: Blob): number {
    return JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'received'), 0);
  }

  // ---- 解析小工具 ---------------------------------------------------------

  private static parseEvent(blob: Blob): CloudSpaceEvent | undefined {
    const kind: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'kind'), '');
    const seq: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'seq'), 0);
    const at: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'at'), 0);
    const payload: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'payload'));
    if (kind === 'file') {
      const file: CloudSpaceFile | undefined = CloudSpaceApi.parseFileObject(payload, at);
      if (file === undefined) {
        return undefined;
      }
      const event: CloudSpaceEvent = new CloudSpaceEvent();
      event.kind = 'file';
      event.seq = seq;
      event.file = file;
      return event;
    }
    if (kind === 'filedel') {
      if (payload === undefined) {
        return undefined;
      }
      let fileId: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(payload, 'fileId'), '');
      if (fileId.length === 0) {
        fileId = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(payload, 'id'), '');
      }
      if (fileId.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
      }
      const event: CloudSpaceEvent = new CloudSpaceEvent();
      event.kind = 'filedel';
      event.seq = seq;
      event.fileId = fileId;
      return event;
    }
    // text / cmd 事件与本页无关，忽略。
    return undefined;
  }

  /**
   * 文件对象解析：`/state` 的 file 事件 payload 用 `fileId`，
   * `/upload/finish` 响应用 `id`，两者都兼容。
   */
  private static parseFileObject(blob: Blob | undefined, uploadedAt: number): CloudSpaceFile | undefined {
    if (blob === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    let fileId: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'fileId'), '');
    if (fileId.length === 0) {
      fileId = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'id'), '');
    }
    if (fileId.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const downloadUrl: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'downloadUrl'), '');
    const expired: boolean = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'expired'), false)
      || downloadUrl.length === 0;
    let name: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'name'), '');
    if (name.length === 0) {
      name = '文件';
    }
    return new CloudSpaceFile(
      fileId,
      name,
      JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'size'), 0),
      JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'mime'), ''),
      expired ? '' : downloadUrl,
      expired,
      uploadedAt);
  }

  private static spec(method: string, path: string): CloudSpaceRequestSpec {
    const spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = new CloudSpaceRequestSpec();
    spec.method = method;
    spec.path = path;
    return spec;
  }
}
import { CloudSpaceDefaults, CloudSpaceEvent, CloudSpaceFile } from './CloudSpaceModels';

/**
 * 临时云空间的纯逻辑（无网络 / 无 ArkUI 依赖，hypium 直接覆盖）：
 * 分片规划、大小/时间/剩余 TTL 文案、上传百分比、文件名清洗与去重、文件类型、事件合并。
 *
 * 与安卓 `CloudSpaceLogic.kt`、小程序 `utils/cloudspace.js` 保持同一口径（可读性优先，不追求逐字节一致）。
 */
export class CloudSpaceChunk {
  index: number = 0;
  start: number = 0;
  endExclusive: number = 0;

  constructor(index: number, start: number, endExclusive: number) {
    this.index = index;
    this.start = start;
    this.endExclusive = endExclusive;
  }

  size(): number {
    return Math.max(0, this.endExclusive - this.start);
  }
}

export class CloudSpaceChunkPlan {
  totalChunks: number = 0;
  chunkSize: number = CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE;
  chunks: CloudSpaceChunk[] = [];
}

export class CloudSpaceMergedFiles {
  files: CloudSpaceFile[] = [];
  expiredIds: string[] = [];

  expiredCount(): number {
    return this.expiredIds.length;
  }
}

/** 文件类型（只用于列表图标）。 */
export enum CloudSpaceFileKind {
  IMAGE = 'image',
  VIDEO = 'video',
  AUDIO = 'audio',
  ARCHIVE = 'archive',
  PDF = 'pdf',
  DOCUMENT = 'document',
  OTHER = 'other'
}

export class CloudSpaceLogic {
  /** 分片规划：最后一片可小于 chunkSize；空文件按 1 个 0 字节分片（纯函数语义完整，业务层拒绝空文件）。 */
  static chunkPlan(sizeBytes: number, chunkSize: number = CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE): CloudSpaceChunkPlan {
    const size: number = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sizeBytes));
    const cs: number = chunkSize > 0 ? Math.floor(chunkSize) : CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE;
    const total: number = size === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(size / cs);
    const plan: CloudSpaceChunkPlan = new CloudSpaceChunkPlan();
    plan.totalChunks = total;
    plan.chunkSize = cs;
    for (let index = 0; index < total; index++) {
      const start: number = index * cs;
      const end: number = Math.min(start + cs, size);
      plan.chunks.push(new CloudSpaceChunk(index, start, end));
    }
    return plan;
  }

  // ---- 文案格式 -----------------------------------------------------------

  /** 文件大小：B / KB / MB（≥10MB 不带小数，其余 1 位小数）。 */
  static fmtSize(bytes: number): string {
    const n: number = Math.max(0, Math.floor(bytes));
    if (n === 0) {
      return '0 B';
    }
    if (n >= 1024 * 1024) {
      const mb: number = n / (1024 * 1024);
      return (n >= 10 * 1024 * 1024 ? mb.toFixed(0) : mb.toFixed(1)) + ' MB';
    }
    if (n >= 1024) {
      return (n / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
    }
    return n + ' B';
  }

  /** 本地时间 `MM-dd HH:mm`；非法时间返回空串。 */
  static fmtTime(epochMs: number): string {
    if (epochMs <= 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(epochMs);
    const month: string = d.getMonth() + 1 < 10 ? '0' + (d.getMonth() + 1) : '' + (d.getMonth() + 1);
    const day: string = d.getDate() < 10 ? '0' + d.getDate() : '' + d.getDate();
    const hh: string = d.getHours() < 10 ? '0' + d.getHours() : '' + d.getHours();
    const mm: string = d.getMinutes() < 10 ? '0' + d.getMinutes() : '' + d.getMinutes();
    return month + '-' + day + ' ' + hh + ':' + mm;
  }

  /** 剩余保留时间（自上传完成起 72h）：`剩 N 天 M 小时` / `剩 N 小时` / `已过期`。 */
  static ttlText(uploadedAt: number, now: number): string {
    if (uploadedAt <= 0) {
      return '已过期';
    }
    const left: number = uploadedAt + CloudSpaceDefaults.FILE_TTL_MS - now;
    if (left <= 0) {
      return '已过期';
    }
    const hours: number = Math.ceil(left / 3600000);
    if (hours >= 24) {
      const days: number = Math.floor(hours / 24);
      const rest: number = hours % 24;
      return rest > 0 ? '剩 ' + days + ' 天 ' + rest + ' 小时' : '剩 ' + days + ' 天';
    }
    return '剩 ' + hours + ' 小时';
  }

  /** 上传中百分比：0..99（100 由「完成」状态给出，避免提前显示 100%）。 */
  static uploadPercent(sentBytes: number, totalBytes: number): number {
    if (totalBytes <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    const sent: number = Math.min(Math.max(0, sentBytes), totalBytes);
    return Math.min(99, Math.floor((sent * 100) / totalBytes));
  }

  /** 已过期文件提示。 */
  static expiredHint(count: number): string {
    return count + ' 个文件已过期（上传超过 72 小时，已自动删除）';
  }

  /** 上传任务状态文案（无自定义 message 时的默认文案）。 */
  static uploadStateText(state: string, message: string): string {
    if (message.length > 0) {
      return message;
    }
    if (state === 'waiting') {
      return '准备上传…';
    }
    if (state === 'uploading') {
      return '上传中…';
    }
    if (state === 'done') {
      return '已上传';
    }
    if (state === 'failed') {
      return '上传失败';
    }
    return '已取消';
  }

  // ---- 文件名 -------------------------------------------------------------

  /** 文件名清洗：去路径分隔符/控制字符、限长（保留扩展名）；空名回退 `file`。 */
  static safeName(rawName: string): string {
    const raw: string = rawName === undefined ? '' : rawName;
    let cleaned: string = '';
    const illegal: string = '\\/:*?"<>|';
    for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
      const ch: string = raw.charAt(i);
      const code: number = raw.charCodeAt(i);
      if (illegal.indexOf(ch) >= 0 || code < 0x20) {
        cleaned += '_';
      } else {
        cleaned += ch;
      }
    }
    cleaned = cleaned.trim();
    // 去首尾 `.`（避免 `..`/隐藏文件）
    while (cleaned.startsWith('.')) {
      cleaned = cleaned.substring(1);
    }
    while (cleaned.endsWith('.')) {
      cleaned = cleaned.substring(0, cleaned.length - 1);
    }
    if (cleaned.length === 0) {
      cleaned = 'file';
    }
    if (cleaned.length <= 120) {
      return cleaned;
    }
    const dot: number = cleaned.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (dot > 0 && cleaned.length - dot <= 12) {
      const ext: string = cleaned.substring(dot);
      return cleaned.substring(0, 120 - ext.length) + ext;
    }
    return cleaned.substring(0, 120);
  }

  /** 同名文件去重：`名称 (1).ext`、`名称 (2).ext`…（目录内已存在时递增）。 */
  static uniqueName(existingNames: string[], desiredName: string): string {
    if (existingNames.indexOf(desiredName) < 0) {
      return desiredName;
    }
    const dot: number = desiredName.lastIndexOf('.');
    const base: string = dot > 0 ? desiredName.substring(0, dot) : desiredName;
    const ext: string = dot > 0 ? desiredName.substring(dot) : '';
    for (let index = 1; index <= 9999; index++) {
      const candidate: string = base + ' (' + index + ')' + ext;
      if (existingNames.indexOf(candidate) < 0) {
        return candidate;
      }
    }
    return desiredName;
  }

  /** 下载落盘名：`<fileId>_<安全名>`（fileId 保证同会话不重名；展示仍用原名）。 */
  static sandboxFileName(fileId: string, safeName: string): string {
    return fileId + '_' + safeName;
  }

  // ---- 文件类型 -----------------------------------------------------------

  /** 按 MIME 优先、扩展名兜底判断文件类型。 */
  static fileKind(mimeType: string, name: string): CloudSpaceFileKind {
    const mime: string = mimeType.trim().toLowerCase();
    const dot: number = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    const ext: string = dot >= 0 ? name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase().trim() : '';
    if (mime.startsWith('image/') || CloudSpaceLogic.inList(ext,
      ['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'bmp', 'heic', 'heif', 'svg'])) {
      return CloudSpaceFileKind.IMAGE;
    }
    if (mime.startsWith('video/') || CloudSpaceLogic.inList(ext,
      ['mp4', 'mov', 'm4v', 'mkv', 'webm', 'avi', '3gp', 'ts'])) {
      return CloudSpaceFileKind.VIDEO;
    }
    if (mime.startsWith('audio/') || CloudSpaceLogic.inList(ext, ['mp3', 'm4a', 'wav', 'aac', 'ogg', 'flac'])) {
      return CloudSpaceFileKind.AUDIO;
    }
    if (CloudSpaceLogic.inList(ext, ['zip', 'rar', '7z', 'tar', 'gz', 'bz2', 'xz'])) {
      return CloudSpaceFileKind.ARCHIVE;
    }
    if (mime === 'application/pdf' || ext === 'pdf') {
      return CloudSpaceFileKind.PDF;
    }
    if (CloudSpaceLogic.inList(ext, ['doc', 'docx', 'xls', 'xlsx', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'txt', 'md', 'csv'])) {
      return CloudSpaceFileKind.DOCUMENT;
    }
    return CloudSpaceFileKind.OTHER;
  }

  /** 文件类型单字字形（列表图标，避免依赖图标字体）。 */
  static fileKindGlyph(kind: CloudSpaceFileKind): string {    if (kind === CloudSpaceFileKind.IMAGE) {
      return '图';
    }
    if (kind === CloudSpaceFileKind.VIDEO) {
      return '视';
    }
    if (kind === CloudSpaceFileKind.AUDIO) {
      return '音';
    }
    if (kind === CloudSpaceFileKind.ARCHIVE) {
      return '档';
    }
    if (kind === CloudSpaceFileKind.PDF) {
      return 'PDF';
    }
    if (kind === CloudSpaceFileKind.DOCUMENT) {
      return '文';
    }
    return '件';
  }

  // ---- 事件合并 -----------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * 合并 `/state` 事件到当前列表（`since > 0` 的增量合并；`since = 0` 时调用方传空列表重建）。
   *
   * - `file` 事件：未过期 → 覆盖/加入列表（同 id 去重，刷新 downloadUrl）；已过期 → 从列表移除并计入过期数；
   * - `filedel` 事件：从列表移除，同时从过期集合移除（已手动删除的文件不算「已过期」）；
   * - 输出按上传时间倒序（新文件在前），同时间按 id 稳定排序。
   */
  static applyEvents(currentFiles: CloudSpaceFile[], currentExpiredIds: string[],
    events: CloudSpaceEvent[]): CloudSpaceMergedFiles {
    const byId: Map<string, CloudSpaceFile> = new Map<string, CloudSpaceFile>();
    for (let i = 0; i < currentFiles.length; i++) {
      byId.set(currentFiles[i].id, currentFiles[i]);
    }
    const expired: string[] = currentExpiredIds.slice(0);
    const sorted: CloudSpaceEvent[] = events.slice(0);
    sorted.sort((a: CloudSpaceEvent, b: CloudSpaceEvent) => a.seq - b.seq);
    for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      const event: CloudSpaceEvent = sorted[i];
      if (event.kind === 'file' && event.file !== undefined) {
        const file: CloudSpaceFile = event.file;
        if (file.expired) {
          byId.delete(file.id);
          if (expired.indexOf(file.id) < 0) {
            expired.push(file.id);
          }
        } else {
          byId.set(file.id, file);
          const index: number = expired.indexOf(file.id);
          if (index >= 0) {
            expired.splice(index, 1);
          }
        }
      } else if (event.kind === 'filedel') {
        byId.delete(event.fileId);
        const index: number = expired.indexOf(event.fileId);
        if (index >= 0) {
          expired.splice(index, 1);
        }
      }
    }
    const files: CloudSpaceFile[] = [];
    byId.forEach((file: CloudSpaceFile) => {
      files.push(file);
    });
    files.sort((a: CloudSpaceFile, b: CloudSpaceFile) => {
      if (a.uploadedAt !== b.uploadedAt) {
        return b.uploadedAt - a.uploadedAt;
      }
      return a.id < b.id ? -1 : (a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0);
    });
    const merged: CloudSpaceMergedFiles = new CloudSpaceMergedFiles();
    merged.files = files;
    merged.expiredIds = expired;
    return merged;
  }

  /** 按扩展名猜 MIME（filePicker 只给 URI/文件名，上传时兜底用）。 */
  static mimeOf(name: string): string {
    const dot: number = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    const ext: string = dot >= 0 ? name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
    if (ext === 'pdf') {
      return 'application/pdf';
    }
    if (ext === 'png') {
      return 'image/png';
    }
    if (ext === 'jpg' || ext === 'jpeg') {
      return 'image/jpeg';
    }
    if (ext === 'gif') {
      return 'image/gif';
    }
    if (ext === 'webp') {
      return 'image/webp';
    }
    if (ext === 'mp4') {
      return 'video/mp4';
    }
    if (ext === 'mov') {
      return 'video/quicktime';
    }
    if (ext === 'mp3') {
      return 'audio/mpeg';
    }
    if (ext === 'm4a') {
      return 'audio/mp4';
    }
    if (ext === 'wav') {
      return 'audio/wav';
    }
    if (ext === 'zip') {
      return 'application/zip';
    }
    if (ext === 'rar') {
      return 'application/vnd.rar';
    }
    if (ext === '7z') {
      return 'application/x-7z-compressed';
    }
    if (ext === 'doc') {
      return 'application/msword';
    }
    if (ext === 'docx') {
      return 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document';
    }
    if (ext === 'xls') {
      return 'application/vnd.ms-excel';
    }
    if (ext === 'xlsx') {
      return 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet';
    }
    if (ext === 'ppt') {
      return 'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint';
    }
    if (ext === 'pptx') {
      return 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation';
    }
    if (ext === 'txt' || ext === 'md' || ext === 'csv') {
      return 'text/plain';
    }
    return 'application/octet-stream';
  }

  private static inList(value: string, list: string[]): boolean {
    return list.indexOf(value) >= 0;
  }
}
/**
 * 临时云空间（与网页/小程序/安卓同一 ECS drop 服务，契约 `web/drop/CONTRACT.md` v2.2）的数据模型。
 *
 * 语义（三端一致）：
 * - 同账号（同班级 token）自动共享同一云空间，不需要房间码/链接/配对；
 * - 每个文件自「上传完成」起保留 72 小时（3 天），逐文件过期；会话空闲 72h 且无未过期文件时回收；
 * - 上传任意大小：8MiB 原始字节分片（init → chunk × N → finish）。
 *
 * 红线：班级 token 只在请求头 `X-Device-Id` 中出现，**不落盘、不打日志、不进错误文案**。
 */
export class CloudSpaceDefaults {
  /**
   * 开发/调试基址：HTTPS 域名（tool.furina.fun）备案前直连 ECS IP
   * （`network_config.json` 已对该 IP 放行明文 HTTP）。
   */
  static readonly BASE_URL: string = 'http://121.196.47.2/drop';

  /** 与服务端/网页/小程序/安卓一致的固定分片：8 MiB。 */
  static readonly CHUNK_SIZE: number = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

  /** 文件 TTL：自上传完成起 72 小时。 */
  static readonly FILE_TTL_MS: number = 72 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  /** 服务端单文件分片数上限（仅用于本地超限提示）。 */
  static readonly MAX_UPLOAD_CHUNKS: number = 65536;

  /** 服务端单会话文件数上限（仅计未过期文件）。 */
  static readonly MAX_FILES: number = 300;

  /** 列表静默轮询间隔（与网页/小程序一致：5s）。 */
  static readonly POLL_INTERVAL_MS: number = 5000;

  /** 下载签名 URL 有效期（服务端 30 分钟；仅文案提示，不参与校验）。 */
  static readonly DOWNLOAD_URL_TTL_MINUTES: number = 30;
}

/** 云空间会话（`/mine`、`/open`、`/state` 的 session 节点；`code` 为历史兼容字段，UI 不展示）。 */
export class CloudSpaceSession {
  id: string = '';
  code: string = '';
  createdAt: number = 0;
  expiresAt: number = 0;

  constructor(id: string = '', code: string = '', createdAt: number = 0, expiresAt: number = 0) {
    this.id = id;
    this.code = code;
    this.createdAt = createdAt;
    this.expiresAt = expiresAt;
  }
}

/**
 * 一个云空间文件（来自 `/state` 的 `file` 事件）。
 *
 * `downloadUrl` 由服务端**每次读取重新签发**（30 分钟有效），不要长期缓存：
 * 下载前先刷新一次列表，遇到 403「下载链接已过期」再刷新重试。
 */
export class CloudSpaceFile {
  id: string = '';
  name: string = '';
  sizeBytes: number = 0;
  mimeType: string = '';
  downloadUrl: string = '';
  expired: boolean = false;
  /** 上传完成时刻（文件 TTL 起算点；毫秒）。 */
  uploadedAt: number = 0;

  constructor(id: string = '', name: string = '', sizeBytes: number = 0, mimeType: string = '',
    downloadUrl: string = '', expired: boolean = false, uploadedAt: number = 0) {
    this.id = id;
    this.name = name;
    this.sizeBytes = sizeBytes;
    this.mimeType = mimeType;
    this.downloadUrl = downloadUrl;
    this.expired = expired;
    this.uploadedAt = uploadedAt;
  }
}

/** 列表页渲染用的只读快照（同一时刻的文件集合 + 统计）。 */
export class CloudSpaceSnapshot {
  session: CloudSpaceSession | undefined = undefined;
  files: CloudSpaceFile[] = [];
  /** 已过期（上传超过 72h，服务端已删）的文件事件数；只用于提示。 */
  expiredCount: number = 0;
  /** 已合并的最大事件 seq（增量轮询用）。 */
  cursor: number = 0;

  connected(): boolean {
    return this.session !== undefined;
  }

  count(): number {
    return this.files.length;
  }

  totalBytes(): number {
    let total: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.files.length; i++) {
      total += this.files[i].sizeBytes;
    }
    return total;
  }
}

/** `/state` 解析后的事件（本页只关心 file / filedel；text / cmd 直接忽略）。 */
export class CloudSpaceEvent {
  /** `file` / `filedel`。 */
  kind: string = '';
  seq: number = 0;
  file: CloudSpaceFile | undefined = undefined;
  fileId: string = '';
}

/** `/state` 一次响应（events 尚未合并进列表）。 */
export class CloudSpaceState {
  session: CloudSpaceSession | undefined = undefined;
  events: CloudSpaceEvent[] = [];
  cursor: number = 0;
}

/** `/upload/init` 响应。 */
export class CloudSpaceUploadInit {
  uploadId: string = '';
  chunkSize: number = CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE;
}

/** 上传状态。 */
export enum CloudSpaceUploadState {
  WAITING = 'waiting',
  UPLOADING = 'uploading',
  DONE = 'done',
  FAILED = 'failed',
  CANCELED = 'canceled'
}

/** 上传进度回调（只在内存中传递，不落盘）。 */
export class CloudSpaceUploadProgress {
  state: CloudSpaceUploadState = CloudSpaceUploadState.WAITING;
  sentBytes: number = 0;
  totalBytes: number = 0;
  message: string = '';

  constructor(state: CloudSpaceUploadState, sentBytes: number, totalBytes: number, message: string = '') {
    this.state = state;
    this.sentBytes = sentBytes;
    this.totalBytes = totalBytes;
    this.message = message;
  }
}

/** 页面「上传进度」卡的一行（本机内存状态，不进云端同步）。 */
export class CloudSpaceUploadTask {
  id: string = '';
  name: string = '';
  sizeBytes: number = 0;
  sentBytes: number = 0;
  state: CloudSpaceUploadState = CloudSpaceUploadState.WAITING;
  message: string = '';

  percent(): number {
    if (this.state === CloudSpaceUploadState.DONE) {
      return 100;
    }
    return Math.min(99, Math.floor((this.sentBytes * 100) / Math.max(1, this.sizeBytes)));
  }
}

/** 下载进度回调。 */
export class CloudSpaceDownloadProgress {
  receivedBytes: number = 0;
  totalBytes: number = 0;
}

/** 错误类别（中文文案可直接展示给用户）。 */
export enum CloudSpaceErrorKind {
  NETWORK = 'network',
  TOKEN_INVALID = 'token_invalid',
  HTTP = 'http',
  PARSE = 'parse',
  LOCAL = 'local'
}

/**
 * 云空间错误（任何错误文案都不包含班级 token / 学号；服务端 reason 本身也不含）。
 *
 * 映射口径（drop 服务契约 §1.3）：
 * - 网络不可用 → NETWORK（不重试写请求，页面提示重试）；
 * - 401 → TOKEN_INVALID（身份失效，建议回身份页重新验证）；
 * - 4xx/5xx → HTTP：优先用服务端 `{ok:false,reason:"中文"}` 的 reason，缺失时按状态码给默认中文；
 * - 2xx 但响应不是合法 JSON / 不符合契约 → PARSE；
 * - 本地前置条件（空文件、未连接等）→ LOCAL。
 */
export class CloudSpaceError {
  kind: CloudSpaceErrorKind = CloudSpaceErrorKind.LOCAL;
  status: number = 0;
  reason: string = '';

  constructor(kind: CloudSpaceErrorKind, status: number = 0, reason: string = '') {
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
    this.reason = reason;
  }

  displayMessage(): string {
    if (this.kind === CloudSpaceErrorKind.NETWORK) {
      return '云空间服务不可达，请检查网络后重试';
    }
    if (this.kind === CloudSpaceErrorKind.PARSE) {
      return '云空间服务响应异常，请稍后重试';
    }
    if (this.reason.length > 0) {
      return this.reason;
    }
    return CloudSpaceErrors.defaultReason(this.status);
  }
}

/** HTTP 状态码 / 服务端 reason → 中文错误的唯一映射入口（纯函数，可单测）。 */
export class CloudSpaceErrors {
  static network(): CloudSpaceError {
    return new CloudSpaceError(CloudSpaceErrorKind.NETWORK);
  }

  static http(status: number, serverReason: string = ''): CloudSpaceError {
    const reason: string = CloudSpaceErrors.sanitize(serverReason);
    if (status === 401) {
      return new CloudSpaceError(CloudSpaceErrorKind.TOKEN_INVALID, status, reason);
    }
    return new CloudSpaceError(CloudSpaceErrorKind.HTTP, status, reason);
  }

  /** HTTP 200 但业务返回 `ok:false`（服务端拒绝；reason 优先）。 */
  static rejected(serverReason: string = ''): CloudSpaceError {
    const reason: string = CloudSpaceErrors.sanitize(serverReason);
    return new CloudSpaceError(CloudSpaceErrorKind.HTTP, 200,
      reason.length > 0 ? reason : '云空间操作失败，请稍后重试');
  }

  static parse(): CloudSpaceError {
    return new CloudSpaceError(CloudSpaceErrorKind.PARSE);
  }

  static local(message: string): CloudSpaceError {
    return new CloudSpaceError(CloudSpaceErrorKind.LOCAL, 0, message);
  }

  static defaultReason(status: number): string {
    if (status === 400) {
      return '请求参数有误，请稍后重试';
    }
    if (status === 401) {
      return '身份已失效，请重新验证';
    }
    if (status === 403) {
      return '没有操作权限，或文件已过期';
    }
    if (status === 404) {
      return '云空间会话或文件不存在（可能已清空或过期）';
    }
    if (status === 405) {
      return '云空间服务暂不支持该操作';
    }
    if (status === 411) {
      return '上传数据不完整，请重试';
    }
    if (status === 413) {
      return '文件数量或大小超出服务限制';
    }
    if (status === 500) {
      return '云空间服务内部错误，请稍后重试';
    }
    if (status === 503) {
      return '身份服务暂不可用，请稍后重试';
    }
    if (status === 507) {
      return '服务器空间不足，请稍后再试';
    }
    return '服务错误（HTTP ' + status + '）';
  }

  /** 服务端 reason 一律是短中文句；防御性截断，避免异常文本撑破 UI。 */
  private static sanitize(reason: string): string {
    const text: string = reason.trim();
    if (text.length <= 120) {
      return text;
    }
    return text.substring(0, 119) + '…';
  }
}

/** 数据层统一返回：成功 / 失败；仓库公开方法不抛异常（取消除外）。 */
export class CloudSpaceResult<T> {
  ok: boolean = false;
  value: T | undefined = undefined;
  error: CloudSpaceError | undefined = undefined;

  static success<T>(value: T): CloudSpaceResult<T> {
    const result: CloudSpaceResult<T> = new CloudSpaceResult<T>();
    result.ok = true;
    result.value = value;
    return result;
  }

  static failure<T>(error: CloudSpaceError): CloudSpaceResult<T> {
    const result: CloudSpaceResult<T> = new CloudSpaceResult<T>();
    result.ok = false;
    result.error = error;
    return result;
  }
}
import { http } from '@kit.NetworkKit';
import { BusinessError } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';
import { fileIo as fs } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';
import { fileUri } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';
import { picker } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';
import { wantConstant, Want } from '@kit.AbilityKit';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';
import { Blob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { CloudSpaceApi, CloudSpaceRequestSpec } from './CloudSpaceApi';
import {
  CloudSpaceDefaults,
  CloudSpaceError,
  CloudSpaceErrors,
  CloudSpaceFile,
  CloudSpaceResult,
  CloudSpaceSession,
  CloudSpaceSnapshot,
  CloudSpaceUploadInit,
  CloudSpaceUploadProgress,
  CloudSpaceUploadState
} from './CloudSpaceModels';
import { CloudSpaceLogic } from './CloudSpaceLogic';

const TAG: string = 'CloudSpaceRepo';

/** 一次 HTTP 响应的原始结果（内部用）。 */
class RawResponse {
  status: number = 0;
  body: string = '';
}

/** 本机选中的待上传文件。 */
export class PickedFile {
  uri: string = '';
  name: string = '';
  sizeBytes: number = 0;
  mimeType: string = '';
}

/**
 * 临时云空间仓库：会话生命周期 + 列表事件合并 + 分片上传 + 删除/清空 + 下载。
 *
 * 设计要点（对齐网页/小程序/安卓）：
 * - 同账号跨设备自动共享：先 `GET /mine`，无会话再 `POST /open`（**不展示房间码/配对**）；
 * - 列表以 `/state` 为准：`since=0` 全量重建（force），否则按 cursor 增量合并（file/filedel）；
 * - 下载链接 30 分钟有效且每次 `/state` 重签：下载前强拉一次最新链接；
 * - 上传：`init → chunk × N（8MiB 原始字节）→ finish`，逐片回调进度；
 * - 所有公开方法不抛异常（网络/解析错误以 [CloudSpaceResult.Failure] 返回）；
 * - **班级 token 只出现在 `X-Device-Id` 请求头**，不落盘、不打日志、不进错误文案。
 */
export class CloudSpaceRepository {
  private api: CloudSpaceApi;
  private tokenProvider: () => string;
  private now: () => number;
  private chunkSize: number;

  private session: CloudSpaceSession | undefined = undefined;
  private files: CloudSpaceFile[] = [];
  private expiredIds: string[] = [];
  private cursor: number = 0;

  constructor(tokenProvider: () => string, baseUrl: string = CloudSpaceDefaults.BASE_URL,
    now: () => number = () => Date.now(), chunkSize: number = CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE) {
    this.api = new CloudSpaceApi(baseUrl);
    this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
    this.now = now;
    this.chunkSize = chunkSize;
  }

  /** 当前列表快照（只读）。 */
  snapshot(): CloudSpaceSnapshot {
    const snapshot: CloudSpaceSnapshot = new CloudSpaceSnapshot();
    snapshot.session = this.session;
    snapshot.files = this.files.slice(0);
    snapshot.expiredCount = this.expiredIds.length;
    snapshot.cursor = this.cursor;
    return snapshot;
  }

  /** 退出登录/切换账号时清空内存状态（不向服务端发请求）。 */
  reset(): void {
    this.session = undefined;
    this.files = [];
    this.expiredIds = [];
    this.cursor = 0;
  }

  // ---- 会话 + 列表 ---------------------------------------------------------

  /** 确保已连接本账号云空间：`/mine` → 无会话则 `/open` → 全量拉列表。 */
  async ensureSpace(): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSnapshot>> {
    if (this.session !== undefined) {
      return await this.refresh(true);
    }
    const sessionResult: CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSession> = await this.resolveSession();
    if (!sessionResult.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(
        sessionResult.error !== undefined ? sessionResult.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    this.session = sessionResult.value;
    this.files = [];
    this.expiredIds = [];
    this.cursor = 0;
    return await this.refresh(true);
  }

  /** 刷新列表：force = `since=0` 全量重建；false = 增量。失败时保留上一次列表。 */
  async refresh(force: boolean): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSnapshot>> {
    if (this.session === undefined) {
      return await this.ensureSpace();
    }
    const session: CloudSpaceSession = this.session;
    const since: number = force ? 0 : this.cursor;
    const spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = this.api.stateSpec(session.id, since);
    const result: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> = await this.request(spec);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(
        result.error !== undefined ? result.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    const state = CloudSpaceApi.parseState(result.value!);
    const merged = CloudSpaceLogic.applyEvents(force ? [] : this.files, force ? [] : this.expiredIds, state.events);
    this.session = state.session !== undefined ? state.session : session;
    this.files = merged.files;
    this.expiredIds = merged.expiredIds;
    this.cursor = force ? state.cursor : Math.max(this.cursor, state.cursor);
    return CloudSpaceResult.success<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(this.snapshot());
  }

  /** 下载前调用：强拉一次最新列表并返回该文件（带 30 分钟有效的签名下载链接）。 */
  async findFreshFile(fileId: string): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceFile>> {
    if (fileId.trim().length === 0) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('文件不存在或已被删除'));
    }
    const refreshed: CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSnapshot> = await this.refresh(true);
    if (!refreshed.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
        refreshed.error !== undefined ? refreshed.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    let found: CloudSpaceFile | undefined = undefined;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.files.length; i++) {
      if (this.files[i].id === fileId) {
        found = this.files[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    if (found === undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
        CloudSpaceErrors.local('文件已过期或已被删除（上传超过 72 小时）'));
    }
    if (found.expired || found.downloadUrl.length === 0) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
        CloudSpaceErrors.local('文件已过期（上传超过 72 小时，已自动删除）'));
    }
    return CloudSpaceResult.success<CloudSpaceFile>(found);
  }

  // ---- 上传 ---------------------------------------------------------------

  /** 打开文件选择器（任意类型，单选）；取消返回 undefined。 */
  async pickFile(): Promise<PickedFile | undefined> {
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      const options: picker.DocumentSelectOptions = new picker.DocumentSelectOptions();
      options.maxSelectNumber = 1;
      const viewPicker: picker.DocumentViewPicker = new picker.DocumentViewPicker(context);
      const uris: string[] = await viewPicker.select(options);
      if (uris.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
      }
      const uri: string = uris[0];
      const name: string = CloudSpaceRepository.baseName(uri);
      let size: number = 0;
      try {
        const file: fs.File = fs.openSync(uri, fs.OpenMode.READ_ONLY);
        size = fs.statSync(file.fd).size;
        fs.closeSync(file);
      } catch (e) {
        size = 0;
      }
      const picked: PickedFile = new PickedFile();
      picked.uri = uri;
      picked.name = CloudSpaceLogic.safeName(name);
      picked.sizeBytes = size;
      picked.mimeType = CloudSpaceLogic.mimeOf(picked.name);
      return picked;
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.w(TAG, '选择文件失败 code=' + err.code);
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  /**
   * 分片上传一个文件（任意大小；8MiB/片，逐片回调进度）。
   *
   * 失败语义：任何一片失败都立即停止（服务端残留分片由 24h 清理线程回收，重传同 index 可覆盖）。
   */
  async upload(picked: PickedFile,
    onProgress: (progress: CloudSpaceUploadProgress) => void): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceFile>> {
    const size: number = Math.floor(picked.sizeBytes);
    if (size <= 0) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('空文件无法上传（0 字节）'));
    }
    const plan = CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(size, this.chunkSize);
    if (plan.totalChunks > CloudSpaceDefaults.MAX_UPLOAD_CHUNKS) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
        CloudSpaceErrors.local('文件超过服务上限（约 512 GB），请压缩后重试'));
    }
    let session: CloudSpaceSession | undefined = this.session;
    if (session === undefined) {
      const resolved: CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSession> = await this.resolveSession();
      if (!resolved.ok) {
        return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
          resolved.error !== undefined ? resolved.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
      }
      session = resolved.value;
      this.session = session;
    }
    if (session === undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    const sessionId: string = session.id;
    const name: string = CloudSpaceLogic.safeName(picked.name);
    const mime: string = picked.mimeType.length > 0 ? picked.mimeType : 'application/octet-stream';
    onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.WAITING, 0, size));

    const initResult: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> =
      await this.request(this.api.initSpec(sessionId, name, size, mime, plan.totalChunks));
    if (!initResult.ok) {
      onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.FAILED, 0, size,
        initResult.error !== undefined ? initResult.error.displayMessage() : '上传初始化失败'));
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
        initResult.error !== undefined ? initResult.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    const init: CloudSpaceUploadInit | undefined = CloudSpaceApi.parseInit(initResult.value!);
    if (init === undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    if (init.chunkSize !== plan.chunkSize) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
        CloudSpaceErrors.local('云空间分片大小异常（' + init.chunkSize + ' B），请稍后重试'));
    }

    let file: fs.File | undefined = undefined;
    try {
      file = fs.openSync(picked.uri, fs.OpenMode.READ_ONLY);
    } catch (e) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('读取文件失败，请重新选择文件'));
    }
    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < plan.chunks.length; i++) {
        const chunk = plan.chunks[i];
        const length: number = chunk.size();
        if (length <= 0) {
          continue;
        }
        const buffer: ArrayBuffer = new ArrayBuffer(length);
        let read: number = 0;
        try {
          read = fs.readSync(file.fd, buffer, { offset: chunk.start, length: length });
        } catch (e) {
          onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.FAILED, chunk.start, size,
            '读取文件失败，请重新选择文件'));
          return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
            CloudSpaceErrors.local('读取文件失败，请重新选择文件'));
        }
        if (read !== length) {
          onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.FAILED, chunk.start, size,
            '文件读取不完整（可能已被移动或截断），请重新选择文件'));
          return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
            CloudSpaceErrors.local('文件读取不完整（可能已被移动或截断），请重新选择文件'));
        }
        onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.UPLOADING, chunk.start, size));
        const chunkSpec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = this.api.chunkSpec(init.uploadId, chunk.index);
        const chunkResult: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> =
          await this.request(chunkSpec, buffer);
        if (!chunkResult.ok) {
          onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.FAILED, chunk.start, size,
            chunkResult.error !== undefined ? chunkResult.error.displayMessage() : '分片上传失败'));
          return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
            chunkResult.error !== undefined ? chunkResult.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
        }
        onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.UPLOADING, chunk.endExclusive, size));
      }
      onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.UPLOADING, size, size, '正在完成…'));
      const finishResult: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> =
        await this.request(this.api.finishSpec(sessionId, init.uploadId));
      if (!finishResult.ok) {
        onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.FAILED, size, size,
          finishResult.error !== undefined ? finishResult.error.displayMessage() : '上传完成失败'));
        return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(
          finishResult.error !== undefined ? finishResult.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
      }
      const finished: CloudSpaceFile | undefined = CloudSpaceApi.parseFinishedFile(finishResult.value!);
      if (finished === undefined) {
        return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceFile>(CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
      }
      const stored: CloudSpaceFile = new CloudSpaceFile(finished.id, finished.name, finished.sizeBytes,
        finished.mimeType, finished.downloadUrl, false, this.now());
      const remaining: CloudSpaceFile[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.files.length; i++) {
        if (this.files[i].id !== stored.id) {
          remaining.push(this.files[i]);
        }
      }
      remaining.push(stored);
      remaining.sort((a: CloudSpaceFile, b: CloudSpaceFile) => b.uploadedAt - a.uploadedAt);
      this.files = remaining;
      onProgress(new CloudSpaceUploadProgress(CloudSpaceUploadState.DONE, size, size));
      return CloudSpaceResult.success<CloudSpaceFile>(stored);
    } finally {
      if (file !== undefined) {
        try {
          fs.closeSync(file);
        } catch (e) {
          // 忽略关闭失败
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- 删除 / 清空 ---------------------------------------------------------

  /** 删除单个文件（幂等；成功后从本地列表移除）。 */
  async delete(fileId: string): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSnapshot>> {
    if (fileId.trim().length === 0) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('文件不存在或已被删除'));
    }
    const session: CloudSpaceSession | undefined = this.session;
    if (session === undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('云空间未连接，请先刷新'));
    }
    const result: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> =
      await this.request(this.api.deleteSpec(fileId, session.id));
    if (!result.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(
        result.error !== undefined ? result.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    const remaining: CloudSpaceFile[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.files.length; i++) {
      if (this.files[i].id !== fileId) {
        remaining.push(this.files[i]);
      }
    }
    this.files = remaining;
    this.expiredIds = this.expiredIds.filter((id: string) => id !== fileId);
    return CloudSpaceResult.success<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(this.snapshot());
  }

  /** 清空云空间：`POST /close` 删除会话与全部文件，随后自动重开一个新空间。 */
  async clearSpace(): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSnapshot>> {
    const session: CloudSpaceSession | undefined = this.session;
    if (session === undefined) {
      return await this.ensureSpace();
    }
    const closed: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> =
      await this.request(this.api.closeSpec(session.id));
    if (!closed.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSnapshot>(
        closed.error !== undefined ? closed.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    this.reset();
    return await this.ensureSpace();
  }

  // ---- 下载 / 打开 ---------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * 下载文件到应用沙箱（`filesDir/cloudspace/<fileId>_<安全名>`），返回沙箱路径。
   * 下载前刷新签名链接；流式落盘（不整文件进内存），回调进度。
   */
  async download(file: CloudSpaceFile,
    onProgress: (received: number, total: number) => void): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<string>> {
    const fresh: CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceFile> = await this.findFreshFile(file.id);
    if (!fresh.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<string>(
        fresh.error !== undefined ? fresh.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    const target: CloudSpaceFile = fresh.value!;
    const dir: string = this.sandboxDir();
    if (dir.length === 0) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<string>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('下载目录不可用'));
    }
    try {
      if (!fs.accessSync(dir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(dir);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // 目录已存在时 accessSync 可能抛错，忽略
    }
    const safe: string = CloudSpaceLogic.safeName(target.name);
    const path: string = dir + '/' + CloudSpaceLogic.sandboxFileName(target.id, safe);
    const total: number = target.sizeBytes;
    let received: number = 0;
    let fileFd: fs.File | undefined = undefined;
    try {
      fileFd = fs.openSync(path, fs.OpenMode.CREATE | fs.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fs.OpenMode.TRUNC);
    } catch (e) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<string>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('无法创建下载文件'));
    }
    const request: http.HttpRequest = http.createHttp();
    try {
      request.on('dataReceive', (data: ArrayBuffer) => {
        try {
          fs.writeSync(fileFd!.fd, data);
          received += data.byteLength;
          onProgress(received, total);
        } catch (e) {
          Log.w(TAG, '写入下载文件失败');
        }
      });
      const options: http.HttpRequestOptions = {
        method: http.RequestMethod.GET,
        header: { 'Accept': '*/*', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' },
        connectTimeout: 30000,
        readTimeout: 120000,
        usingCache: false
      };
      const status: number = await request.requestInStream(target.downloadUrl, options);
      if (status < 200 || status >= 300) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync(path);
        } catch (e) {
          // 忽略
        }
        return CloudSpaceResult.failure<string>(CloudSpaceErrors.http(status));
      }
      onProgress(received, total > 0 ? total : received);
      return CloudSpaceResult.success<string>(path);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.w(TAG, '下载失败 code=' + err.code);
      try {
        fs.unlinkSync(path);
      } catch (ignored) {
        // 忽略
      }
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<string>(CloudSpaceErrors.network());
    } finally {
      try {
        request.off('dataReceive');
        request.destroy();
      } catch (e) {
        // 忽略
      }
      if (fileFd !== undefined) {
        try {
          fs.closeSync(fileFd);
        } catch (e) {
          // 忽略
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /** 用系统能力打开沙箱文件（文件选择器/文件管理器/系统匹配应用）；返回错误文案（成功为空串）。 */
  async openLocalFile(path: string, mimeType: string): Promise<string> {
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      return '应用上下文缺失，无法打开文件';
    }
    try {
      const uri: string = fileUri.getUriFromPath(path);
      const want: Want = {
        action: 'ohos.want.action.viewData',
        uri: uri,
        type: mimeType.length > 0 ? mimeType : 'application/octet-stream',
        flags: wantConstant.Flags.FLAG_AUTH_READ_URI_PERMISSION
      };
      await context.startAbility(want);
      return '';
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.w(TAG, '打开文件失败 code=' + err.code);
      return '没有可打开该文件的应用（已下载到应用沙箱）';
    }
  }

  // ---- 内部实现 -----------------------------------------------------------

  /** 解析本账号会话：`/mine` → 无会话则 `/open`。 */
  private async resolveSession(): Promise<CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSession>> {
    if (this.session !== undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.success<CloudSpaceSession>(this.session);
    }
    const mineResult: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> =
      await this.request(this.api.mineSpec());
    if (!mineResult.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSession>(
        mineResult.error !== undefined ? mineResult.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    const mineBlob = mineResult.value!;
    const existing: CloudSpaceSession | undefined =
      CloudSpaceApi.parseSessionNode(requireBlob(mineBlob, 'session'));
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.success<CloudSpaceSession>(existing);
    }
    const openResult: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> =
      await this.request(this.api.openSpec());
    if (!openResult.ok) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSession>(
        openResult.error !== undefined ? openResult.error : CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    const opened: CloudSpaceSession | undefined =
      CloudSpaceApi.parseSessionNode(requireBlob(openResult.value!, 'session'));
    if (opened === undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<CloudSpaceSession>(CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
    }
    return CloudSpaceResult.success<CloudSpaceSession>(opened);
  }

  /** 发起一次请求并解释响应；网络异常统一映射为 NETWORK。 */
  private async request(spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec, bodyData?: ArrayBuffer):
    Promise<CloudSpaceResult<Blob>> {
    if (this.tokenProvider().trim().length === 0) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<Blob>(CloudSpaceErrors.local('身份缺失，请重新登录后重试'));
    }
    const raw: RawResponse | undefined = await this.execute(spec, bodyData);
    if (raw === undefined) {
      return CloudSpaceResult.failure<Blob>(CloudSpaceErrors.network());
    }
    return CloudSpaceApi.interpret(raw.status, raw.body);
  }

  private async execute(spec: CloudSpaceRequestSpec, bodyData?: ArrayBuffer): Promise<RawResponse | undefined> {
    const token: string = this.tokenProvider();
    if (token.trim().length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const request: http.HttpRequest = http.createHttp();
    const options: http.HttpRequestOptions = {
      method: toMethod(spec.method),
      header: this.api.headers(token, spec.contentType),
      connectTimeout: 30000,
      readTimeout: 60000,
      expectDataType: http.HttpDataType.STRING,
      usingCache: false
    };
    if (bodyData !== undefined) {
      options.extraData = bodyData;
    } else if (spec.bodyText.length > 0) {
      options.extraData = spec.bodyText;
    }
    try {
      const response: http.HttpResponse = await request.request(this.api.url(spec.path), options);
      const raw: RawResponse = new RawResponse();
      raw.status = response.responseCode;
      raw.body = bodyToText(response.result);
      return raw;
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.w(TAG, '云空间请求失败 code=' + err.code);
      return undefined;
    } finally {
      try {
        request.destroy();
      } catch (e) {
        // 忽略
      }
    }
  }

  private sandboxDir(): string {
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      return '';
    }
    return context.filesDir + '/cloudspace';
  }

  private static baseName(uri: string): string {
    let text: string = uri;
    const q: number = text.indexOf('?');
    if (q >= 0) {
      text = text.substring(0, q);
    }
    const slash: number = Math.max(text.lastIndexOf('/'), text.lastIndexOf('\\'));
    let name: string = slash >= 0 ? text.substring(slash + 1) : text;
    try {
      name = decodeURIComponent(name);
    } catch (e) {
      // 保持原样
    }
    return name.length > 0 ? name : 'file';
  }
}

/** 取 Blob 中的子对象；不存在返回 undefined（避免 `!` 展开后类型不匹配）。 */
function requireBlob(blob: Blob, key: string): Blob | undefined {
  const value = blob[key];
  if (value === undefined || value === null || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return value as Blob;
}

function toMethod(method: string): http.RequestMethod {
  if (method === 'POST') {
    return http.RequestMethod.POST;
  }
  if (method === 'DELETE') {
    return http.RequestMethod.DELETE;
  }
  if (method === 'PUT') {
    return http.RequestMethod.PUT;
  }
  return http.RequestMethod.GET;
}

function bodyToText(result: string | Object | ArrayBuffer): string {
  if (typeof result === 'string') {
    return result;
  }
  if (result instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
    return '';
  }
  return JSON.stringify(result);
}
export enum DiagStatus {
  PASS = 'pass',
  WARN = 'warn',
  FAIL = 'fail',
  INFO = 'info'
}

export function diagStatusLabel(status: DiagStatus): string {
  if (status === DiagStatus.PASS) {
    return '正常';
  }
  if (status === DiagStatus.WARN) {
    return '注意';
  }
  if (status === DiagStatus.FAIL) {
    return '异常';
  }
  return '信息';
}

export function diagStatusColor(status: DiagStatus): string {
  if (status === DiagStatus.PASS) {
    return '#4E9082';
  }
  if (status === DiagStatus.WARN) {
    return '#B98F63';
  }
  if (status === DiagStatus.FAIL) {
    return '#B4543F';
  }
  return '#6E8CA8';
}

/** `service_health` 行。 */
export class ServiceHealthRow {
  id: string = '';
  name: string = '';
  kind: string = '';
  status: string = '';
  detail: string = '';
  meta: string = '';
  checkedAt: string = '';

  displayStatus(): DiagStatus {
    const value: string = this.status.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (value === 'ok' || value === 'up' || value === 'pass') {
      return DiagStatus.PASS;
    }
    if (value === 'warn') {
      return DiagStatus.WARN;
    }
    if (value === 'down' || value === 'fail' || value === 'error') {
      return DiagStatus.FAIL;
    }
    return DiagStatus.INFO;
  }
}

/** 本机设备检查项。 */
export class DiagCheck {
  id: string = '';
  label: string = '';
  status: DiagStatus = DiagStatus.INFO;
  value: string = '';
  hint: string = '';

  shouldReport(): boolean {
    return this.status === DiagStatus.WARN || this.status === DiagStatus.FAIL;
  }
}

export class DiagSummary {
  checks: DiagCheck[] = [];
  ranAt: number = 0;

  passCount(): number {
    return this.countOf(DiagStatus.PASS);
  }

  warnCount(): number {
    return this.countOf(DiagStatus.WARN);
  }

  failCount(): number {
    return this.countOf(DiagStatus.FAIL);
  }

  private countOf(status: DiagStatus): number {
    let count: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.checks.length; i++) {
      if (this.checks[i].status === status) {
        count += 1;
      }
    }
    return count;
  }

  overall(): DiagStatus {
    if (this.failCount() > 0) {
      return DiagStatus.FAIL;
    }
    if (this.warnCount() > 0) {
      return DiagStatus.WARN;
    }
    return DiagStatus.PASS;
  }
}

  ts: number = 0;
  related: string = '';
}

export class RepairTask {

  createdAt: number = 0;
}

import { DiagCheck, DiagStatus, ServiceHealthRow } from './DiagModels';

/** 上报节流（同指纹 10 分钟一次）。 */
export class DiagThrottle {
  static readonly WINDOW_MS: number = 10 * 60 * 1000;

  static canReport(lastAt: number, nowMillis: number): boolean {
    if (lastAt <= 0) {
      return true;
    }
    return nowMillis - lastAt >= DiagThrottle.WINDOW_MS;
  }

  /** 指纹：kind + 异常检查项 id（排序去重）。 */
  static fingerprint(checks: DiagCheck[]): string {
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
      const check: DiagCheck = checks[i];
      if (check.status === DiagStatus.WARN || check.status === DiagStatus.FAIL) {
        ids.push(check.id);
      }
    }
    ids.sort();
    const unique: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      if (unique.indexOf(ids[i]) < 0) {
        unique.push(ids[i]);
      }
    }
    return unique.join('+');
  }
}

/** `client_diag` 上报行（脱敏：只含检查 id/值/状态，不含账号、路径、URL）。 */
export class DiagReport {
  /** 把服务健康行转为可上报检查项（只保留注意/异常）。 */
  static fromHealth(rows: ServiceHealthRow[]): DiagCheck[] {
    const out: DiagCheck[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const row: ServiceHealthRow = rows[i];
      const status: DiagStatus = row.displayStatus();
      if (status !== DiagStatus.WARN && status !== DiagStatus.FAIL) {
        continue;
      }
      const check: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
      check.id = 'svc:' + row.id;
      check.label = row.name;
      check.status = status;
      check.value = row.detail;
      check.hint = row.meta;
      out.push(check);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 汇总本机检查 + 服务健康，生成本次上报行。 */
  static buildAll(checks: DiagCheck[], healthRows: ServiceHealthRow[], nowMillis: number): Blob | undefined {
    const merged: DiagCheck[] = checks.concat(DiagReport.fromHealth(healthRows));
    return DiagReport.build(merged, nowMillis);
  }

  static build(checks: DiagCheck[], nowMillis: number): Blob | undefined {
    const anomalies: DiagCheck[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
      if (checks[i].shouldReport()) {
        anomalies.push(checks[i]);
      }
    }
    if (anomalies.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const level: string = anomalies.some((check: DiagCheck) => check.status === DiagStatus.FAIL)
      ? 'error' : 'warn';
    const fingerprint: string = DiagThrottle.fingerprint(checks);
    const details: Blob = {};
    const labels: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < anomalies.length; i++) {
      labels.push(anomalies[i].label);
      const item: Blob = {};
      item['status'] = anomalies[i].status;
      item['value'] = anomalies[i].value;
      item['hint'] = anomalies[i].hint;
      details[anomalies[i].id] = item;
    }
    const row: Blob = {};
    row['kind'] = 'diag';
    row['level'] = level;
    row['ts'] = nowMillis;
    row['title'] = '设备自检异常：' + labels.join('、');
    row['fingerprint'] = fingerprint;
    const detail: Blob = {};
    detail['check'] = anomalies.length === 1 ? anomalies[0].id : 'multi';
    detail['items'] = details;
    row['detail'] = detail;
    return row;
  }
}
import { preferences } from '@kit.ArkData';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';

/** 上报节流时间戳持久化（preferences，键 `last_report`）。 */
export class DiagReportStore {
  private static async store(): Promise<preferences.Preferences | undefined> {
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    if (ctx === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      return await preferences.getPreferences(ctx, { name: 'class_tools_diag' });
    } catch (e) {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  static async lastReportAt(): Promise<number> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await DiagReportStore.store();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return 0;
    }
    try {
      return await store.get('last_report', 0) as number;
    } catch (e) {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  static async markReported(nowMillis: number): Promise<void> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await DiagReportStore.store();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await store.put('last_report', nowMillis);
      await store.flush();
    } catch (e) {
      // 忽略持久化失败，不阻塞上报
    }
  }
}

  DiagAnalysisResult,
  DiagHealthResult,
