  ServiceHealthRow
} from './DiagModels';

const HEALTH_PATH: string = 'service_health?select=id,name,kind,status,detail,meta,checked_at&order=id.asc';
const ANALYSIS_PATH: string = 'diag_analysis?select=*&order=ts.desc&limit=20';
const REPAIRS_PATH: string = 'repair_tasks?select=*&order=created_at.desc&limit=20';
const PROBE_PATH: string = 'service_health?select=id&limit=1';

/** 网关延迟测量结果。 */
export class GatewayProbe {
  ok: boolean = false;
  latencyMs: number = 0;
  message: string = '';
}

/** 诊断仓库（只读）：服务健康 / AI 分析 / 修复任务 / 网关延迟。 */
export class DiagRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private clock: () => number;

  constructor(api: Api, clock: () => number = () => Date.now()) {
    this.api = api;
    this.clock = clock;
  }

  async health(): Promise<DiagHealthResult> {
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.get(HEALTH_PATH, true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return new DiagHealthResult(false,
        result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '服务健康加载失败', []);
    }
    return new DiagHealthResult(true, '', DiagRepository.parseHealth(result.value));
  }

  async analyses(): Promise<DiagAnalysisResult> {
    const analysisResult: ApiResult = await this.api.get(ANALYSIS_PATH, true);
    if (!analysisResult.ok) {
      return new DiagAnalysisResult(false,
        analysisResult.error !== undefined ? analysisResult.error.displayMessage() : 'AI 分析加载失败', [], []);
    }
    const repairResult: ApiResult = await this.api.get(REPAIRS_PATH, true);
    const repairs: RepairTask[] = repairResult.ok ? DiagRepository.parseRepairs(repairResult.value) : [];
    return new DiagAnalysisResult(true, '', DiagRepository.parseAnalyses(analysisResult.value), repairs);
  }

  /** 上报设备自检异常（client_diag，RLS 按 token 归属）。 */
  async report(row: Blob): Promise<boolean> {
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post('client_diag', JSON.stringify(row), 'return=minimal', true);
    return result.ok;
  }

  /** 网关延迟（同一接口往返耗时）。 */
  async probe(): Promise<GatewayProbe> {
    const probe: GatewayProbe = new GatewayProbe();
    const started: number = this.clock();
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.get(PROBE_PATH, true);
    probe.latencyMs = Math.max(1, this.clock() - started);
    probe.ok = result.ok;
    if (!result.ok) {
      probe.message = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '网关不可达';
    }
    return probe;
  }

  static parseHealth(raw: string): ServiceHealthRow[] {
    const rows: Blob[] = rowsOf(raw);
    const out: ServiceHealthRow[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const row: ServiceHealthRow = new ServiceHealthRow();
      row.id = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'id'), '');
      if (row.id.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      row.name = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'name'), '');
      row.kind = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'kind'), '');
      row.status = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'status'), '');
      row.detail = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'detail'), '');
      row.meta = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'meta'), '');
      row.checkedAt = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'checked_at'), '');
      out.push(row);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static parseAnalyses(raw: string): DiagAnalysis[] {
    const rows: Blob[] = rowsOf(raw);
    const out: DiagAnalysis[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const item: DiagAnalysis = new DiagAnalysis();
      item.id = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'id'), '');
      item.severity = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'severity'), '');
      item.title = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'title'), '');
      item.status = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'status'), '');
      item.cause = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'cause'), '');
      item.fix = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'fix'), '');
      item.ts = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'ts'), 0);
      const related = JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'related');
      item.related = typeof related === 'string' ? related as string : '';
      out.push(item);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static parseRepairs(raw: string): RepairTask[] {
    const rows: Blob[] = rowsOf(raw);
    const out: RepairTask[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const task: RepairTask = new RepairTask();
      task.id = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'id'), '');
      task.action = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'action'), '');
      task.status = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'status'), '');
      task.error = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'error'), '');
      task.createdAt = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(rows[i], 'created_at'), 0);
      out.push(task);
    }
    return out;
  }
}

function rowsOf(raw: string): Blob[] {
  if (raw.trim().length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  let parsed: Object | null = null;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Object;
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
  const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
  if (array === undefined) {
    return [];
  }
  const out: Blob[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
    if (obj !== undefined) {
      out.push(obj);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
import { fileIo as fs, fileUri } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';
import { photoAccessHelper } from '@kit.MediaLibraryKit';
import { BusinessError } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';

const TAG: string = 'ImageSaver';

export class SaveResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message: string;
  /** 相册 uri（保存到相册成功时）。 */
  uri: string;
  /** 应用沙箱路径（总是有）。 */
  path: string;

  constructor(ok: boolean, message: string, uri: string, path: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.message = message;
    this.uri = uri;
    this.path = path;
  }
}

/**
 * 导出图片落盘：
 * 1. 先写应用沙箱 `filesDir/export/<文件名>`（一定成功，作为兜底）；
 * 2. 再走 `photoAccessHelper.showAssetsCreationDialog` 让用户确认保存到相册（无需 WRITE_IMAGEVIDEO 权限）。
 */
export class ImageSaver {
  static async writeToAppFile(data: ArrayBuffer, fileName: string): Promise<string> {
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    if (ctx === undefined) {
      return '';
    }
    try {
      const dir: string = ctx.filesDir + '/export';
      if (!fs.accessSync(dir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(dir, true);
      }
      const path: string = dir + '/' + fileName;
      const file = fs.openSync(path, fs.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fs.OpenMode.CREATE | fs.OpenMode.TRUNC);
      fs.writeSync(file.fd, data);
      fs.closeSync(file);
      return path;
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.e(TAG, '写入沙箱失败 code=' + err.code);
      return '';
    }
  }

  static async saveToGallery(path: string, fileName: string): Promise<SaveResult> {
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    if (ctx === undefined || path.length === 0) {
      return new SaveResult(false, '无应用上下文', '', path);
    }
    try {
      const helper = photoAccessHelper.getPhotoAccessHelper(ctx);
      const title: string = fileName.replace(new RegExp('\\.png$'), '');
      const srcUri: string = fileUri.getUriFromPath(path);
      const configs: photoAccessHelper.PhotoCreationConfig[] = [{
        title: title,
        fileNameExtension: 'png',
        photoType: photoAccessHelper.PhotoType.IMAGE
      }];
      const uris: string[] = await helper.showAssetsCreationDialog([srcUri], configs);
      if (uris.length === 0) {
        return new SaveResult(false, '已取消保存', '', path);
      }
      // 把沙箱内容写入相册资产
      const src = fs.openSync(path, fs.OpenMode.READ_ONLY);
      const size: number = fs.statSync(src.fd).size;
      const buffer: ArrayBuffer = new ArrayBuffer(size);
      fs.readSync(src.fd, buffer);
      fs.closeSync(src);

      const dst = fs.openSync(uris[0], fs.OpenMode.READ_WRITE);
      fs.writeSync(dst.fd, buffer);
      fs.closeSync(dst);
      return new SaveResult(true, '已保存到相册', uris[0], path);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.e(TAG, '保存相册失败 code=' + err.code + ' msg=' + err.message);
      return new SaveResult(false, '保存失败：' + err.message, '', path);
    }
  }
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiError, ApiErrorKind, ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { FitCodec } from '../../features/fit/FitCodec';
import { FitRecord } from '../../features/fit/FitModels';
import { AsyncLock } from '../../common/AsyncLock';

const FITRECS_PATH: string = 'fitrecs';
const UPSERT_PREFER: string = 'return=representation,resolution=merge-duplicates';
const DEFAULT_TTL_MS: number = 2 * 60 * 1000;

export class FitRecsResult {
  ok: boolean;
  records: FitRecord[];
  fromCache: boolean;
  message: string;

  constructor(ok: boolean, records: FitRecord[], fromCache: boolean, message: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.records = records;
    this.fromCache = fromCache;
    this.message = message;
  }
}

export class FitRecsWriteResult {
  ok: boolean;
  error: ApiError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, error: ApiError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.error = error;
  }
}

/**
 * 体测历史仓库（`fitrecs`，契约 ENDPOINTS E14/E15/E16）。
 *
 * - 读：`GET fitrecs?select=*&acc=eq.<sid>&arch=eq.false&order=ts.desc`，TTL 2min；
 * - 写：`POST fitrecs` + upsert（按 id）；取消不 DELETE，`PATCH fitrecs?id=eq.<id>` `{arch:true}` 软删；
 * - 最多保留 2 条（由调用方把 dropped 记录 archive）。
 */
export class FitRecsRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private sidProvider: () => string;
  private clock: () => number;
  private ttlMs: number;

  private lock: AsyncLock = new AsyncLock();
  private cache: FitRecord[] = [];
  private cachedAt: number = 0;
  private loaded: boolean = false;

  constructor(api: Api, sidProvider: () => string, clock: () => number = () => Date.now(),
    ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS) {
    this.api = api;
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
  }

  async refresh(force: boolean): Promise<FitRecsResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return new FitRecsResult(false, [], false, '请先完成身份验证');
    }
    const now: number = this.clock();
    if (!force && this.loaded && now - this.cachedAt < this.ttlMs) {
      return new FitRecsResult(true, this.cache, true, '');
    }
    const path: string = FITRECS_PATH + '?select=*&acc=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(sid)
      + '&arch=eq.false&order=ts.desc';
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.get(path, true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      if (this.loaded) {
        const message: string = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '历史加载失败';
        return new FitRecsResult(true, this.cache, true, message);
      }
      return new FitRecsResult(false, [], false,
        result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '历史加载失败');
    }
    const records: FitRecord[] = FitRecsRepository.parseRows(result.value);
    this.cache = records.slice(0, FitRecord.MAX_RECORDS);
    this.cachedAt = now;
    this.loaded = true;
    return new FitRecsResult(true, this.cache, false, '');
  }

  async save(record: FitRecord): Promise<FitRecsWriteResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return new FitRecsWriteResult(false, new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Config, 0, 'no_session', '请先完成身份验证'));
    }
    return await this.lock.run<FitRecsWriteResult>(async () => {
      const row: Blob = FitCodec.rowForUpload(record, sid);
      const rows: Object[] = [row];
      const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post(FITRECS_PATH, JSON.stringify(rows), UPSERT_PREFER, true);
      if (!result.ok) {
        return new FitRecsWriteResult(false, result.error);
      }
      return new FitRecsWriteResult(true, undefined);
    });
  }

  /** 软删（arch=true），不发 DELETE。 */
  async archive(id: string): Promise<FitRecsWriteResult> {
    if (id.trim().length === 0) {
      return new FitRecsWriteResult(true, undefined);
    }
    const path: string = FITRECS_PATH + '?id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(id);
    const body: Blob = { 'arch': true };
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.patch(path, JSON.stringify(body), '', true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return new FitRecsWriteResult(false, result.error);
    }
    return new FitRecsWriteResult(true, undefined);
  }

  /** 改名：fitrecs 行只有 data 列，重写 data.n（成绩/时间不变）。 */
  async rename(record: FitRecord, name: string): Promise<FitRecsWriteResult> {
    const trimmed: string = name.trim();
    if (record.id.trim().length === 0 || trimmed.length === 0) {
      return new FitRecsWriteResult(true, undefined);
    }
    const copy: FitRecord = new FitRecord();
    copy.id = record.id;
    copy.ts = record.ts;
    copy.name = trimmed;
    copy.sex = record.sex;
    copy.gradeBucket = record.gradeBucket;
    copy.fields = record.fields;
    copy.total = record.total;
    copy.grade = record.grade;
    copy.syncPending = record.syncPending;
    const path: string = FITRECS_PATH + '?id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(record.id);
    const body: Blob = { 'data': FitCodec.recordToData(copy), 'ts': record.ts };
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.patch(path, JSON.stringify(body), '', true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return new FitRecsWriteResult(false, result.error);
    }
    return new FitRecsWriteResult(true, undefined);
  }

  /** 本地镜像（不联网）。 */
  local(): FitRecord[] {
    return this.cache;
  }

  static parseRows(raw: string): FitRecord[] {
    if (raw.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    let parsed: Object | null = null;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Object;
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
    if (array === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    const out: FitRecord[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
      const row: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
      if (row === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const data: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(row, 'data'), '');
      const record: FitRecord | undefined = FitCodec.recordFromData(data);
      if (record !== undefined) {
        out.push(record);
      }
    }
    out.sort((a: FitRecord, b: FitRecord) => b.ts - a.ts);
    return out;
  }
}
import { JsonBlob, Blob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';

/** 隐藏项（仅自己不可见，跨端同步）：作业 hwHide / 通知 ntHide。 */
export class HideData {
  hwHide: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  ntHide: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
}

/** userdata.hide 段读写（保留未知字段，与网页 D.d.hwHide/ntHide 同结构）。 */
export class HidePrefs {
  static read(sections: Blob): HideData {
    const data: HideData = new HideData();
    const hide: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'hide'));
    if (hide === undefined) {
      return data;
    }
    HidePrefs.collect(JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(hide, 'hwHide')), data.hwHide);
    HidePrefs.collect(JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(hide, 'ntHide')), data.ntHide);
    return data;
  }

  private static collect(blob: Blob | undefined, target: Set<string>): void {
    if (blob === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(blob);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      if (JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(blob, keys[i]), false)
        || JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, keys[i]), '') === 'true') {
        target.add(keys[i]);
      }
    }
  }

  /** 写回：复制所有顶层键，仅替换 hide（保留 hide 内未知键）。 */
  static write(current: Blob, data: HideData): Blob {
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const hide: Blob = {};
    const oldHide: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(current, 'hide'));
    if (oldHide !== undefined) {
      const oldKeys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(oldHide);
      for (let i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
        if (oldKeys[i] !== 'hwHide' && oldKeys[i] !== 'ntHide') {
          hide[oldKeys[i]] = oldHide[oldKeys[i]];
        }
      }
    }
    hide['hwHide'] = HidePrefs.toBlob(data.hwHide);
    hide['ntHide'] = HidePrefs.toBlob(data.ntHide);
    next['hide'] = hide;
    return next;
  }

  private static toBlob(set: Set<string>): Blob {
    const out: Blob = {};
    set.forEach((id: string) => {
      out[id] = true;
    });
    return out;
  }

  static isHwHidden(sections: Blob, id: string): boolean {
    return HidePrefs.read(sections).hwHide.has(id);
  }

  static isNtHidden(sections: Blob, id: string): boolean {
    return HidePrefs.read(sections).ntHide.has(id);
  }
}
import { preferences } from '@kit.ArkData';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';

const TAG: string = 'HomeNtBadge';
const STORE: string = 'class_tools_home_badge';

/**
 * 工作台「新通知」角标（对齐小程序 newNtAt）：
 * 通知签名变化 → 记为“有新通知”；打开通知页 → 清零。
 * 首次使用（无历史签名）不提示，避免首次登录误报。
 */
export class HomeNtBadge {
  private static async store(): Promise<preferences.Preferences | undefined> {
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    if (ctx === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      return await preferences.getPreferences(ctx, { name: STORE });
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '打开角标存储失败');
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  private static sigKey(sid: string): string {
    return 'sig_' + (sid.length > 0 ? sid : 'anon');
  }

  private static newKey(sid: string): string {
    return 'new_' + (sid.length > 0 ? sid : 'anon');
  }

  /** 用最新签名更新状态，返回当前是否显示角标。 */
  static async update(sid: string, signature: string): Promise<boolean> {
    if (signature.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await HomeNtBadge.store();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      const prevSig: string = await store.get(HomeNtBadge.sigKey(sid), '') as string;
      let isNew: boolean = await store.get(HomeNtBadge.newKey(sid), false) as boolean;
      if (prevSig.length > 0 && prevSig !== signature) {
        isNew = true;
      }
      await store.put(HomeNtBadge.sigKey(sid), signature);
      await store.put(HomeNtBadge.newKey(sid), isNew);
      await store.flush();
      return isNew;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static async markOpened(sid: string): Promise<void> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await HomeNtBadge.store();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await store.put(HomeNtBadge.newKey(sid), false);
      await store.flush();
    } catch (e) {
      // 忽略
    }
  }
}
import { ToolCatalog } from '../tool/ToolCatalog';

/** 首页快捷编辑结果。 */
export class HomeToolsToggleResult {
  ids: string[];
  /** 是否发生变化。 */
  changed: boolean;
  /** 拒绝原因：'' = 接受；'full' = 已满 4 个。 */
  rejected: string;

  constructor(ids: string[], changed: boolean, rejected: string) {
    this.ids = ids;
    this.changed = changed;
    this.rejected = rejected;
  }
}

/**
 * 首页常用工具（`userdata.homeTools`，≤4，与网页/小程序/安卓同契约）。
 *
 * 纯函数：不做 IO，便于单测；顺序即用户选择顺序（web 端拖动排序语义一致）。
 */
export class HomeTools {
  static readonly MAX: number = 4;

  /** 只保留已知工具 id、去重并截断到 MAX（读云端脏数据时的兜底）。 */
  static normalize(ids: string[]): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      const id: string = ids[i].trim();
      if (id.length === 0 || out.indexOf(id) >= 0) {
        continue;
      }
      if (ToolCatalog.byId(id) === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      out.push(id);
    }
    return out.length > HomeTools.MAX ? out.slice(0, HomeTools.MAX) : out;
  }

  /** 点按加入/移出：已存在则移除；未满则追加；已满则拒绝。 */
  static toggle(current: string[], id: string): HomeToolsToggleResult {
    const ids: string[] = HomeTools.normalize(current);
    const index: number = ids.indexOf(id);
    if (index >= 0) {
      const next: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
        if (i !== index) {
          next.push(ids[i]);
        }
      }
      return new HomeToolsToggleResult(next, true, '');
    }
    if (ToolCatalog.byId(id) === undefined) {
      return new HomeToolsToggleResult(ids, false, 'unknown');
    }
    if (ids.length >= HomeTools.MAX) {
      return new HomeToolsToggleResult(ids, false, 'full');
    }
    ids.push(id);
    return new HomeToolsToggleResult(ids, true, '');
  }

  static remove(current: string[], id: string): string[] {
    const ids: string[] = HomeTools.normalize(current);
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      if (ids[i] !== id) {
        out.push(ids[i]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  static contains(current: string[], id: string): boolean {
    return current.indexOf(id) >= 0;
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../sync/JsonBlob';

/** 作业行（`public.homework`；`done` 列前端忽略，完成状态唯一真源是 marks kind='hw'）。 */
export class HomeworkRow {
  id: string = '';
  subject: string = '';
  content: string = '';
  due: string = '';
  date: string = '';
  time: string = '';
  author: string = '';
  owner: string = '';
  /** 附件 JSON 字符串（`[{n,t,s,d}]`），需二次解析且不把 base64 常驻内存。 */
  attachments: string = '';
  archived: boolean = false;
  ts: number = 0;
}

export enum HomeworkAttachmentKind {
  DATA_URI = 'data',
  URL = 'url',
  NONE = 'none'
}

/** 作业附件元信息（不含 base64 内容）。 */
export class HomeworkAttachmentMeta {
  index: number = 0;
  name: string = '';
  mime: string = '';
  sizeBytes: number = 0;
  kind: HomeworkAttachmentKind = HomeworkAttachmentKind.NONE;

  isImage(): boolean {
    return this.mime.indexOf('image/') === 0;
  }

  sizeText(): string {
    const bytes: number = this.sizeBytes;
    if (bytes <= 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    if (bytes < 1024) {
      return bytes + ' B';
    }
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) {
      return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
    }
    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
  }
}

export enum HomeworkDueState {
  NONE = 'none',
  HOURS_LEFT = 'hours_left',
  DAYS_LEFT = 'days_left',
  OVERDUE_HOURS = 'overdue_hours',
  OVERDUE_DAYS = 'overdue_days'
}

export enum HomeworkDueTone {
  NEUTRAL = 'neutral',
  SAFE = 'safe',
  WARN = 'warn',
  URGENT = 'urgent',
  OVERDUE = 'overdue'
}

export class HomeworkDue {
  atMillis: number = 0;
  label: string = '';
  state: HomeworkDueState = HomeworkDueState.NONE;
  tone: HomeworkDueTone = HomeworkDueTone.NEUTRAL;
  expired: boolean = false;
  /** 过期超过 3 天：只在内存过滤（不写云、不 DELETE）。 */
  prunable: boolean = false;
}

export class HomeworkItem {
  row: HomeworkRow = new HomeworkRow();
  done: boolean = false;
  due: HomeworkDue | undefined = undefined;
  attachments: HomeworkAttachmentMeta[] = [];

  id(): string {
    return this.row.id;
  }

  /** 标题：subject 优先，否则正文首行。 */
  title(): string {
    if (this.row.subject.trim().length > 0) {
      return this.row.subject.trim();
    }
    const lines: string[] = this.row.content.split('\n');
    return lines.length > 0 ? lines[0].trim() : '';
  }

  /** 正文摘要（去掉首行标题，压成一行）。 */
  bodyPreview(): string {
    const text: string = this.row.content.replace(new RegExp('\\s+', 'g'), ' ').trim();
    const title: string = this.title();
    if (title.length > 0 && text.indexOf(title) === 0) {
      return text.substring(title.length).trim();
    }
    return text;
  }
}

export enum HomeworkFilter {
  ALL = '全部',
  UNFINISHED = '未完成',
  DONE = '已完成'
}

const DAY_MS: number = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const PRUNE_AFTER_DAYS: number = 3;

/** 作业截止时间计算（纯函数，对齐网页 hwDue/dueInfo/hwExpired/pruneHW）。 */
export class HomeworkDueCalculator {
  /** 解析 `date`（YYYY-MM-DD）(+`time` HH:MM) → epoch ms；无法解析返回 undefined。 */
  static parseDue(date: string, time: string): number | undefined {
    const d: string = date.trim();
    const dateMatch: RegExpMatchArray | null = d.match(new RegExp('^(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})$'));
    if (dateMatch === null) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const year: number = Number(dateMatch[1]);
    const month: number = Number(dateMatch[2]);
    const day: number = Number(dateMatch[3]);
    let hour: number = 0;
    let minute: number = 0;
    const t: string = time.trim();
    if (t.length > 0) {
      const timeMatch: RegExpMatchArray | null = t.match(new RegExp('^(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})$'));
      if (timeMatch !== null) {
        hour = Number(timeMatch[1]);
        minute = Number(timeMatch[2]);
        if (hour > 23 || minute > 59) {
          hour = 0;
          minute = 0;
        }
      }
    }
    const stamp: number = new Date(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, 0).getTime();
    return Number.isFinite(stamp) ? stamp : undefined;
  }

  /** 截止信息；无日期返回 undefined。 */
  static evaluate(row: HomeworkRow, nowMillis: number): HomeworkDue | undefined {
    const dueAt: number | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue(row.date, row.time);
    if (dueAt === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const diff: number = dueAt - nowMillis;
    const due: HomeworkDue = new HomeworkDue();
    due.atMillis = dueAt;
    due.prunable = nowMillis > dueAt + PRUNE_AFTER_DAYS * DAY_MS;
    if (diff < 0) {
      const overdue: number = -diff;
      due.expired = true;
      due.tone = HomeworkDueTone.OVERDUE;
      if (overdue < DAY_MS) {
        const hours: number = Math.max(1, Math.floor(overdue / (60 * 60 * 1000)));
        due.state = HomeworkDueState.OVERDUE_HOURS;
        due.label = '已过期 ' + hours + ' 小时';
      } else {
        const days: number = Math.floor(overdue / DAY_MS);
        due.state = HomeworkDueState.OVERDUE_DAYS;
        due.label = '已过期 ' + days + ' 天';
      }
      return due;
    }
    if (diff < DAY_MS) {
      const hours: number = Math.max(1, Math.floor(diff / (60 * 60 * 1000)));
      due.state = HomeworkDueState.HOURS_LEFT;
      due.label = '还剩 ' + hours + ' 小时';
      due.tone = HomeworkDueTone.URGENT;
      return due;
    }
    const days: number = Math.floor(diff / DAY_MS);
    due.state = HomeworkDueState.DAYS_LEFT;
    due.label = '还剩 ' + days + ' 天';
    due.tone = days <= 3 ? HomeworkDueTone.WARN : HomeworkDueTone.SAFE;
    return due;
  }

  /** `MM-dd HH:mm` 展示。 */
  static dueText(dueAt: number): string {
    if (dueAt <= 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(dueAt);
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }
}

/** 附件解析（JSON 字符串 → 元信息列表；不保留 base64）。 */
export class HomeworkAttachments {
  static parse(raw: string): HomeworkAttachmentMeta[] {
    if (raw.trim().length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    let parsed: JsonValue | undefined = undefined;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as JsonValue;
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
    if (array === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    const out: HomeworkAttachmentMeta[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
      const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
      if (obj === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const name: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'n'), '').trim();
      const mime: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 't'), '');
      const data: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'd'), '');
      const explicitSize: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 's'), 0);
      const meta: HomeworkAttachmentMeta = new HomeworkAttachmentMeta();
      meta.index = i;
      meta.name = name.length > 0 ? name : '附件 ' + (i + 1);
      meta.mime = mime;
      meta.sizeBytes = explicitSize > 0 ? explicitSize : HomeworkAttachments.estimateDataUriBytes(data);
      if (data.toLowerCase().indexOf('data:') === 0) {
        meta.kind = HomeworkAttachmentKind.DATA_URI;
      } else if (data.toLowerCase().indexOf('http://') === 0 || data.toLowerCase().indexOf('https://') === 0) {
        meta.kind = HomeworkAttachmentKind.URL;
      } else {
        meta.kind = HomeworkAttachmentKind.NONE;
      }
      out.push(meta);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 取第 index 个附件的原始 data URI / URL（仅详情预览用）。 */
  static dataOf(raw: string, index: number): string {
    if (raw.trim().length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    let parsed: JsonValue | undefined = undefined;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as JsonValue;
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
    if (array === undefined || index < 0 || index >= array.length) {
      return '';
    }
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[index]);
    return JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'd'), '');
  }

  /** data URI 的近似解码体积（base64 4→3）。 */
  private static estimateDataUriBytes(data: string): number {
    if (data.toLowerCase().indexOf('data:') !== 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    const comma: number = data.indexOf(',');
    if (comma < 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    const base64Length: number = data.length - comma - 1;
    return Math.floor(base64Length * 3 / 4);
  }
}

export function pad2(value: number): string {
  return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { HomeworkRow } from './HomeworkModels';

const HOMEWORK_PATH: string = 'homework?select=*&order=ts.asc&archived=eq.false';
const DEFAULT_TTL_MS: number = 10 * 60 * 1000;

export class HomeworkResult {
  ok: boolean;
  rows: HomeworkRow[];
  fromCache: boolean;
  message: string;

  constructor(ok: boolean, rows: HomeworkRow[], fromCache: boolean, message: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.rows = rows;
    this.fromCache = fromCache;
    this.message = message;
  }
}

/**
 * 作业仓库（只读）：`GET homework?select=*&order=ts.asc&archived=eq.false`（TTL 10 分钟）。
 * 完成状态不在本表，由 `marks`（kind='hw'）提供。
 */
export class HomeworkRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private clock: () => number;
  private ttlMs: number;

  private cache: HomeworkRow[] = [];
  private cachedAt: number = 0;
  private loaded: boolean = false;

  constructor(api: Api, clock: () => number = () => Date.now(), ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS) {
    this.api = api;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
  }

  async load(force: boolean): Promise<HomeworkResult> {
    const now: number = this.clock();
    if (!force && this.loaded && now - this.cachedAt < this.ttlMs) {
      return new HomeworkResult(true, this.cache, true, '');
    }
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.get(HOMEWORK_PATH, true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      if (this.loaded) {
        return new HomeworkResult(true, this.cache, true,
          result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '作业加载失败');
      }
      return new HomeworkResult(false, [], false,
        result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '作业加载失败');
    }
    const rows: HomeworkRow[] = HomeworkRepository.parseRows(result.value);
    this.cache = rows;
    this.cachedAt = now;
    this.loaded = true;
    return new HomeworkResult(true, rows, false, '');
  }

  local(): HomeworkRow[] {
    return this.cache;
  }

  static parseRows(raw: string): HomeworkRow[] {
    if (raw.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    let parsed: Object | null = null;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Object;
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
    if (array === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    const out: HomeworkRow[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
      const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
      if (obj === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const id: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'id'), '').trim();
      if (id.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const row: HomeworkRow = new HomeworkRow();
      row.id = id;
      row.subject = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'subject'), '');
      row.content = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'content'), '');
      row.due = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'due'), '');
      row.date = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'date'), '');
      row.time = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'time'), '');
      row.author = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'author'), '');
      row.owner = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'owner'), '');
      row.attachments = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'attachments'), '');
      row.archived = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'archived'), false);
      row.ts = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'ts'), 0);
      out.push(row);
    }
    return out;
  }
}
import { asset } from '@kit.AssetStoreKit';
import { util } from '@kit.ArkTS';
import { JwCredentialLogic } from '../../features/jw/JwCredentialLogic';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';

const TAG: string = 'JwCredentialStore';

/**
 * 本机教务 / 统一身份认证密码的安全存储（HarmonyOS Asset Store）。
 *
 * - 系统加密、应用私有；仅在设备首次解锁后可读（`DEVICE_FIRST_UNLOCKED`）；
 * - 不参与云同步（`SYNC_TYPE=NEVER`），卸载即清除（`IS_PERSISTENT=false`）；
 * - 别名 = 学号指纹（不含学号明文）；密码**不写日志/不上传/不导出**。
 *
 * 存储失败（设备不支持/服务异常）时返回 false，页面回退「每次手动输入」，不阻塞其它功能。
 */
export class JwCredentialStore {
  /** 保存/更新密码（同别名覆盖）。 */
  static async save(sid: string, password: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const alias: string = JwCredentialLogic.aliasOf(sid);
    if (alias.length === 0 || password.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      const attrs: asset.AssetMap = new Map();
      attrs.set(asset.Tag.ALIAS, JwCredentialStore.encode(alias));
      attrs.set(asset.Tag.SECRET, JwCredentialStore.encode(password));
      attrs.set(asset.Tag.ACCESSIBILITY, asset.Accessibility.DEVICE_FIRST_UNLOCKED);
      attrs.set(asset.Tag.SYNC_TYPE, asset.SyncType.NEVER);
      attrs.set(asset.Tag.IS_PERSISTENT, false);
      attrs.set(asset.Tag.CONFLICT_RESOLUTION, asset.ConflictResolution.OVERWRITE);
      await asset.add(attrs);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '保存本机凭据失败');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** 读取密码；未保存/失败返回空串。 */
  static async load(sid: string): Promise<string> {
    const alias: string = JwCredentialLogic.aliasOf(sid);
    if (alias.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    try {
      const query: asset.AssetMap = new Map();
      query.set(asset.Tag.ALIAS, JwCredentialStore.encode(alias));
      query.set(asset.Tag.RETURN_TYPE, asset.ReturnType.ALL);
      const result: asset.AssetMap[] = await asset.query(query);
      if (result.length === 0) {
        return '';
      }
      const secret = result[0].get(asset.Tag.SECRET);
      if (secret === undefined || typeof secret === 'number' || typeof secret === 'boolean') {
        return '';
      }
      return JwCredentialStore.decode(secret as Uint8Array);
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '读取本机凭据失败');
      return '';
    }
  }

  /** 是否已保存（不读明文，只按别名查询）。 */
  static async has(sid: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const secret: string = await JwCredentialStore.load(sid);
    return secret.length > 0;
  }

  /** 清除本机密码。 */
  static async clear(sid: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const alias: string = JwCredentialLogic.aliasOf(sid);
    if (alias.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      const query: asset.AssetMap = new Map();
      query.set(asset.Tag.ALIAS, JwCredentialStore.encode(alias));
      await asset.remove(query);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '清除本机凭据失败');
      return false;
    }
  }

  private static encode(text: string): Uint8Array {
    return new util.TextEncoder().encodeInto(text);
  }

  private static decode(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    try {
      return new util.TextDecoder().decodeToString(bytes);
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';

/** marks 三种 kind（契约 §5）：作业完成 / 通知置顶 / 通知已处理。 */
export enum MarkKind {
  HW = 'hw',
  NT = 'nt',
  NT_DONE = 'ntdone'
}

export function markKindFromWire(wire: string): MarkKind | undefined {
  if (wire === 'hw') {
    return MarkKind.HW;
  }
  if (wire === 'nt') {
    return MarkKind.NT;
  }
  if (wire === 'ntdone') {
    return MarkKind.NT_DONE;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * `public.marks` 一行。
 *
 * `id = "<sid>|<kind>|<ref>"`；`seat` = 学号（服务端 RLS 校验本人）；取消只写 `val=false`，绝不 DELETE。
 * 注意：`value` 的 JSON 字段名是 **`val`**（SQL 保留字规避），不要改。
 */
export class MarkRow {
  id: string = '';
  seat: string = '';
  kind: string = '';
  ref: string = '';
  value: boolean = false;
  ts: number = 0;

  constructor(id: string = '', seat: string = '', kind: string = '', ref: string = '',
    value: boolean = false, ts: number = 0) {
    this.id = id;
    this.seat = seat;
    this.kind = kind;
    this.ref = ref;
    this.value = value;
    this.ts = ts;
  }

  static idOf(sid: string, kind: MarkKind, ref: string): string {
    return sid + '|' + kind + '|' + ref;
  }

  toJson(): Blob {
    const out: Blob = {
      'id': this.id,
      'seat': this.seat,
      'kind': this.kind,
      'ref': this.ref,
      'val': this.value,
      'ts': this.ts
    };
    return out;
  }

  static fromJson(obj: Blob): MarkRow | undefined {
    const id: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'id'), '');
    const ref: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'ref'), '');
    if (id.length === 0 || ref.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const row: MarkRow = new MarkRow(
      id,
      JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'seat'), ''),
      JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'kind'), ''),
      ref,
      JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'val'), false),
      JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'ts'), 0)
    );
    return row;
  }
}

/** 本机 marks 视图（只保留 true 的项，等价 web `HW.marks` / `NT.marks` / `NT.done`）。 */
export class MarksSnapshot {
  hwDone: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  ntPin: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  ntDone: Set<string> = new Set<string>();

  isDone(kind: MarkKind, ref: string): boolean {
    if (kind === MarkKind.HW) {
      return this.hwDone.has(ref);
    }
    if (kind === MarkKind.NT) {
      return this.ntPin.has(ref);
    }
    return this.ntDone.has(ref);
  }

  with(kind: MarkKind, ref: string, value: boolean): MarksSnapshot {
    const next: MarksSnapshot = new MarksSnapshot();
    next.hwDone = copySet(this.hwDone);
    next.ntPin = copySet(this.ntPin);
    next.ntDone = copySet(this.ntDone);
    const target: Set<string> = kind === MarkKind.HW ? next.hwDone : (kind === MarkKind.NT ? next.ntPin : next.ntDone);
    if (value) {
      target.add(ref);
    } else {
      target.delete(ref);
    }
    return next;
  }

  /** 整表覆盖（服务端下发）；只收 true，缺少即未做。 */
  replaceRows(rows: MarkRow[]): MarksSnapshot {
    let snapshot: MarksSnapshot = this;
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const row: MarkRow = rows[i];
      if (row.ref.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const kind: MarkKind | undefined = markKindFromWire(row.kind);
      if (kind === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      snapshot = snapshot.with(kind, row.ref, row.value);
    }
    return snapshot;
  }

  /** 待补发覆盖云端旧值（契约 §5 需求 16：刚点的状态不被回滚）。 */
  applyPending(rows: MarkRow[]): MarksSnapshot {
    let snapshot: MarksSnapshot = this;
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const row: MarkRow = rows[i];
      const kind: MarkKind | undefined = markKindFromWire(row.kind);
      if (kind === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      snapshot = snapshot.with(kind, row.ref, row.value);
    }
    return snapshot;
  }

  counts(): number {
    return this.hwDone.size + this.ntPin.size + this.ntDone.size;
  }
}

export function copySet(source: Set<string>): Set<string> {
  const out: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  source.forEach((value: string) => {
    out.add(value);
  });
  return out;
}

    return this.pending;

  }

/** 文件实现：`<filesDir>/marks/marks_<sid>.json`。 */
export class FileMarksLocalStore implements MarksLocalStore {
  private sidProvider: () => string;
  private directory: string = '';

  constructor(sidProvider: () => string, directory: string = '') {
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.directory = directory;
  }

  private dir(): string {
    if (this.directory.length > 0) {
      return this.directory;
    }
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    return ctx !== undefined ? ctx.filesDir + '/marks' : '';
  }

  private path(): string {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim().replace(new RegExp('[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', 'g'), '');
    const dir: string = this.dir();
    if (sid.length === 0 || dir.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    return dir + '/marks_' + sid + '.json';
  }

  private read(): MarksFileShape {
    const path: string = this.path();
    if (path.length === 0) {
      return {};
    }
    try {
      if (!fs.accessSync(path)) {
        return {};
      }
      const text: string = fs.readTextSync(path);
      return text.length > 0 ? JSON.parse(text) as MarksFileShape : {};
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '读取本机 marks 失败');
      return {};
    }
  }

  private write(shape: MarksFileShape): void {
    const path: string = this.path();
    const dir: string = this.dir();
    if (path.length === 0 || dir.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (!fs.accessSync(dir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(dir, true);
      }
      const file = fs.openSync(path, fs.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fs.OpenMode.CREATE | fs.OpenMode.TRUNC);
      fs.writeSync(file.fd, JSON.stringify(shape));
      fs.closeSync(file);
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '写入本机 marks 失败');
    }
  }

  private rowsOf(raw: Object[] | undefined): MarkRow[] {
    const out: MarkRow[] = [];
    if (raw === undefined) {
      return out;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
      const blob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(raw[i]);
      if (blob === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const row: MarkRow | undefined = MarkRow.fromJson(blob);
      if (row !== undefined) {
        out.push(row);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  async readCache(): Promise<MarkRow[]> {
    return this.rowsOf(this.read().cache);
  }

  async writeCache(rows: MarkRow[]): Promise<void> {
    const shape: MarksFileShape = this.read();
    const raw: Object[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      raw.push(rows[i].toJson());
    }
    shape.cache = raw;
    this.write(shape);
  }

  async readPending(): Promise<MarkRow[]> {
    return this.rowsOf(this.read().pending);
  }

  async writePending(rows: MarkRow[]): Promise<void> {
    const shape: MarksFileShape = this.read();
    const raw: Object[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      raw.push(rows[i].toJson());
    }
    shape.pending = raw;
    this.write(shape);
  }
}

export class MarksUpdateResult {
  ok: boolean;
  error: ApiError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, error: ApiError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static success(): MarksUpdateResult {
    return new MarksUpdateResult(true, undefined);
  }

  static failure(error: ApiError): MarksUpdateResult {
    return new MarksUpdateResult(false, error);
  }
}

export class MarksRefreshResult {
  ok: boolean;
  snapshot: MarksSnapshot;
  error: ApiError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, snapshot: MarksSnapshot, error: ApiError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.snapshot = snapshot;
    this.error = error;
  }
}

/**
 * marks 仓库（契约 §5）：marks 是「作业完成 / 通知置顶 / 通知已处理」的跨端唯一真源。
 *
 * - 读：`GET marks?select=*&seat=eq.<sid>`，TTL 2 分钟；
 * - 写：`POST marks` + upsert（取消 = `val:false`，**不做 DELETE**）；
 * - 失败入本机 pending，下次刷新/补发；拉回后 pending 覆盖云端旧值。
 */
export class MarksRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private local: MarksLocalStore;
  private sidProvider: () => string;
  private clock: () => number;
  private ttlMs: number;

  private lock: AsyncLock = new AsyncLock();
  private snapshot: MarksSnapshot = new MarksSnapshot();
  private cacheLoaded: boolean = false;
  private lastFetchAt: number = 0;

  constructor(api: Api, sidProvider: () => string, local: MarksLocalStore = new InMemoryMarksLocalStore(),
    clock: () => number = () => Date.now(), ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS) {
    this.api = api;
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.local = local;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
  }

  marks(): MarksSnapshot {
    return this.snapshot;
  }

  async refresh(force: boolean): Promise<MarksRefreshResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return new MarksRefreshResult(false, this.snapshot,
        new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Config, 0, 'no_session', '请先完成身份验证'));
    }
    return await this.lock.run<MarksRefreshResult>(async () => {
      await this.ensureCacheLoaded();
      if (!force && this.lastFetchAt > 0 && this.clock() - this.lastFetchAt < this.ttlMs) {
        return new MarksRefreshResult(true, this.snapshot, undefined);
      }
      const path: string = MARKS_PATH + '?select=*&seat=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(sid);
      const result: ApiResult = await this.api.get(path, true);
      if (!result.ok) {
        const err: ApiError = result.error !== undefined
          ? result.error
          : new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', '网络连接失败');
        return new MarksRefreshResult(false, this.snapshot, err);
      }
      const rows: MarkRow[] | undefined = parseRows(result.value);
      if (rows === undefined) {
        return new MarksRefreshResult(false, this.snapshot,
          new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Parse, 0, 'parse', 'marks 响应不是合法数组'));
      }
      await this.local.writeCache(rows);
      this.lastFetchAt = this.clock();
      const pending: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readPending();
      const next: MarksSnapshot = new MarksSnapshot().replaceRows(rows).applyPending(pending);
      this.snapshot = next;
      return new MarksRefreshResult(true, next, undefined);
    });
  }

  async setMark(kind: MarkKind, ref: string, value: boolean): Promise<MarksUpdateResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return MarksUpdateResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Config, 0, 'no_session', '请先完成身份验证'));
    }
    if (ref.trim().length === 0) {
      return MarksUpdateResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Config, 0, 'empty_ref', 'ref 为空'));
    }
    return await this.lock.run<MarksUpdateResult>(async () => {
      await this.ensureCacheLoaded();
      const row: MarkRow = new MarkRow(MarkRow.idOf(sid, kind, ref), sid, kind, ref, value, this.clock());
      // 先本地乐观更新（UI 立即生效；失败也有本机状态）
      this.snapshot = this.snapshot.with(kind, ref, value);
      const cache: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readCache();
      const kept: MarkRow[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < cache.length; i++) {
        if (cache[i].id !== row.id) {
          kept.push(cache[i]);
        }
      }
      kept.push(row);
      await this.local.writeCache(kept);

      const rows: Object[] = [row.toJson()];
      const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post(MARKS_PATH, JSON.stringify(rows), UPSERT_PREFER, true);
      if (!result.ok) {
        const pending: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readPending();
        const nextPending: MarkRow[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < pending.length; i++) {
          if (pending[i].id !== row.id) {
            nextPending.push(pending[i]);
          }
        }
        nextPending.push(row);
        await this.local.writePending(nextPending);
        const err: ApiError = result.error !== undefined
          ? result.error
          : new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', '网络连接失败');
        return MarksUpdateResult.failure(err);
      }
      const pending: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readPending();
      const nextPending: MarkRow[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < pending.length; i++) {
        if (pending[i].id !== row.id) {
          nextPending.push(pending[i]);
        }
      }
      await this.local.writePending(nextPending);
      return MarksUpdateResult.success();
    });
  }

  /** 补发本机失败写入；返回成功条数。 */
  async flushPending(): Promise<number> {
    return await this.lock.run<number>(async () => {
      const pending: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readPending();
      if (pending.length === 0) {
        return 0;
      }
      let success: number = 0;
      const remaining: MarkRow[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < pending.length; i++) {
        const row: MarkRow = pending[i];
        const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post(MARKS_PATH, JSON.stringify([row.toJson()]), UPSERT_PREFER, true);
        if (result.ok) {
          success += 1;
        } else {
          remaining.push(row);
        }
      }
      await this.local.writePending(remaining);
      if (success > 0) {
        this.lastFetchAt = 0;
      }
      return success;
    });
  }

  async pendingCount(): Promise<number> {
    const pending: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readPending();
    return pending.length;
  }

  private async ensureCacheLoaded(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.cacheLoaded) {
      return;
    }
    this.cacheLoaded = true;
    const cached: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readCache();
    if (cached.length > 0) {
      this.snapshot = new MarksSnapshot().replaceRows(cached);
    }
    const pending: MarkRow[] = await this.local.readPending();
    if (pending.length > 0) {
      this.snapshot = this.snapshot.applyPending(pending);
    }
  }
}

/** 解析 `GET marks` 数组；不是数组 → undefined（调用方按 Parse 错误处理）。 */
export function parseRows(raw: string): MarkRow[] | undefined {
  if (raw.length === 0) {
    return undefined;
  }
  let parsed: Object | null = null;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Object;
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
  if (array === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const rows: MarkRow[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
    const blob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
    if (blob === undefined) {
      continue;
    }
    const row: MarkRow | undefined = MarkRow.fromJson(blob);
    if (row !== undefined && row.ref.trim().length > 0) {
      rows.push(row);
    }
  }
  return rows;
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { LeagueMember } from './ClassMember';

const LEAGUE_PATH: string = 'rpc/class_league';
const DEFAULT_TTL_MS: number = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export class ClassLeagueResult {
  ok: boolean;
  members: LeagueMember[];
  fromCache: boolean;
  message: string;

  constructor(ok: boolean, members: LeagueMember[], fromCache: boolean, message: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.members = members;
    this.fromCache = fromCache;
    this.message = message;
  }

  static success(members: LeagueMember[], fromCache: boolean, message: string): ClassLeagueResult {
    return new ClassLeagueResult(true, members, fromCache, message);
  }

  static failure(message: string): ClassLeagueResult {
    return new ClassLeagueResult(false, [], false, message);
  }
}

/**
 * 团员名单仓库（名单三分类之「团员」）。
 *
 * 读取 `class_league` RPC（只读、**不返回学号**）；会话内缓存 TTL 6h；
 * 网络失败 → 有缓存返回缓存（fromCache=true + warning），否则 Failure；空名单视为有效空。
 */
export class ClassLeagueRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private sidProvider: () => string;
  private clock: () => number;
  private ttlMs: number;

  private cacheSid: string = '';
  private cache: LeagueMember[] = [];
  private loadedOnce: boolean = false;
  private lastFetchAt: number = 0;

  constructor(api: Api, sidProvider: () => string, clock: () => number = () => Date.now(),
    ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS) {
    this.api = api;
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
  }

  async load(force: boolean): Promise<ClassLeagueResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length > 0 && sid !== this.cacheSid) {
      this.cacheSid = sid;
      this.cache = [];
      this.loadedOnce = false;
      this.lastFetchAt = 0;
    }
    const now: number = this.clock();
    if (!force && this.loadedOnce && now - this.lastFetchAt < this.ttlMs) {
      return ClassLeagueResult.success(this.cache, true, '');
    }
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post(LEAGUE_PATH, '{}', '', true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      const message: string = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '团员名单加载失败';
      if (this.loadedOnce) {
        return ClassLeagueResult.success(this.cache, true, message);
      }
      return ClassLeagueResult.failure(message);
    }
    const members: LeagueMember[] | undefined = parseLeague(result.value);
    if (members === undefined) {
      if (this.loadedOnce) {
        return ClassLeagueResult.success(this.cache, true, '团员名单格式异常');
      }
      return ClassLeagueResult.failure('团员名单格式异常');
    }
    this.cache = members;
    this.loadedOnce = true;
    this.lastFetchAt = now;
    return ClassLeagueResult.success(members, false, '');
  }

  async cached(): Promise<LeagueMember[]> {
    return this.cache;
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    this.cacheSid = '';
    this.cache = [];
    this.loadedOnce = false;
    this.lastFetchAt = 0;
  }
}

/** 解析 `class_league` 响应：`{ok,seats:[{seat,name}]}`；结构异常 → undefined。 */
export function parseLeague(raw: string): LeagueMember[] | undefined {
  if (raw.length === 0) {
    return undefined;
  }
  let parsed: JsonValue | undefined = undefined;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as JsonValue;
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
  let body: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(parsed);
  if (body === undefined) {
    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
    if (array !== undefined && array.length > 0) {
      body = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[0]);
    }
  }
  if (body === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  if (JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'ok'), true) === false) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const seats: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(body, 'seats'));
  if (seats === undefined) {
    return [];
  }
  const out: LeagueMember[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < seats.length; i++) {
    const item: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(seats[i]);
    if (item === undefined) {
      continue;
    }
    const seat: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(item, 'seat'), 0);
    const name: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(item, 'name'), '').trim();
    if (seat <= 0 || name.length === 0) {
      continue;
    }
    out.push(new LeagueMember(Math.round(seat), name));
  }
  out.sort((a: LeagueMember, b: LeagueMember) => a.seat - b.seat);
  return out;
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';

/**
 * 班级名单一行（`POST rpc/class_members` → `[{seat,sid,name,role,badge,is_admin}]`）。
 *
 * 契约：ENDPOINTS.md E2；服务端已过滤 `is_test` 测试身份，班级名单约 70 人。
 * 隐私：`sid` 只用于云端内部键与个人数据归属，**页面不显示学号**。
 */
export class ClassMember {
  seat: number = 0;
  sid: string = '';
  name: string = '';
  role: string = '';
  badge: string = '';
  isAdmin: boolean = false;

  constructor(seat: number = 0, sid: string = '', name: string = '', role: string = '',
    badge: string = '', isAdmin: boolean = false) {
    this.seat = seat;
    this.sid = sid;
    this.name = name;
    this.role = role;
    this.badge = badge;
    this.isAdmin = isAdmin;
  }

  /** 是否班委：契约里「role 非空」即班委（badge=班委 是展示徽章）。 */
  isCommittee(): boolean {
    return this.role.trim().length > 0;
  }

  static fromJson(obj: Blob): ClassMember | undefined {
    const seat: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'seat'), 0);
    const name: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'name'), '').trim();
    if (seat <= 0 || name.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return new ClassMember(
      Math.round(seat),
      JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'sid'), '').trim(),
      name,
      JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'role'), '').trim(),
      JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'badge'), '').trim(),
      JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'is_admin'), false)
    );
  }

  toJson(): Blob {
    const out: Blob = {
      'seat': this.seat,
      'sid': this.sid,
      'name': this.name,
      'role': this.role,
      'badge': this.badge,
      'is_admin': this.isAdmin
    };
    return out;
  }
}

/** 团员名单模型（`POST rpc/class_league` → `{ok:true,count,seats:[{seat,name}]}`）。 */
export class LeagueMember {
  seat: number = 0;
  name: string = '';

  constructor(seat: number = 0, name: string = '') {
    this.seat = seat;
    this.name = name;
  }

  toJson(): Blob {
    const out: Blob = { 'seat': this.seat, 'name': this.name };
    return out;
  }
}

/** 名单展示条目（**不含学号**，满足隐私红线）。 */
export class MemberEntry {
  seat: number = 0;
  name: string = '';
  badge: string = '';

  constructor(seat: number = 0, name: string = '', badge: string = '') {
    this.seat = seat;
    this.name = name;
    this.badge = badge;
  }
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { ClassMember } from './ClassMember';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { fileIo as fs } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';

const TAG: string = 'MembersRepo';
const MEMBERS_PATH: string = 'rpc/class_members';
const DEFAULT_TTL_MS: number = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export class ClassMembersResult {
  ok: boolean;
  members: ClassMember[];
  /** true = 来自本机缓存（TTL 内或网络失败时的降级）。 */
  fromCache: boolean;
  message: string;

  constructor(ok: boolean, members: ClassMember[], fromCache: boolean, message: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.members = members;
    this.fromCache = fromCache;
    this.message = message;
  }

  static success(members: ClassMember[], fromCache: boolean): ClassMembersResult {
    return new ClassMembersResult(true, members, fromCache, '');
  }

  static failure(message: string): ClassMembersResult {
    return new ClassMembersResult(false, [], false, message);
  }
}

export class MemberCacheEntry {
  members: ClassMember[] = [];
  savedAt: number = 0;

  constructor(members: ClassMember[], savedAt: number) {
    this.members = members;
    this.savedAt = savedAt;
  }
}

/** 班级名单落盘缓存（按 sid 隔离）。 */
export interface ClassMemberCache {
  read(sid: string): Promise<MemberCacheEntry | undefined>;

  write(sid: string, members: ClassMember[], savedAt: number): Promise<void>;

  clear(sid: string): Promise<void>;
}

export class InMemoryClassMemberCache implements ClassMemberCache {
  private data: Map<string, MemberCacheEntry> = new Map<string, MemberCacheEntry>();

  async read(sid: string): Promise<MemberCacheEntry | undefined> {
    return this.data.get(sid);
  }

  async write(sid: string, members: ClassMember[], savedAt: number): Promise<void> {
    this.data.set(sid, new MemberCacheEntry(members, savedAt));
  }

  async clear(sid: string): Promise<void> {
    this.data.delete(sid);
  }
}

interface MemberCacheFile {
  savedAt?: number;
  members?: Object[];
}

export class FileClassMemberCache implements ClassMemberCache {
  private directory: string = '';

  constructor(directory: string = '') {
    this.directory = directory;
  }

  private dir(): string {
    if (this.directory.length > 0) {
      return this.directory;
    }
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    return ctx !== undefined ? ctx.filesDir + '/members' : '';
  }

  private pathFor(sid: string): string {
    const safe: string = sid.replace(new RegExp('[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', 'g'), '');
    const dir: string = this.dir();
    return dir.length > 0 && safe.length > 0 ? dir + '/members_' + safe + '.json' : '';
  }

  async read(sid: string): Promise<MemberCacheEntry | undefined> {
    const path: string = this.pathFor(sid);
    if (path.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      if (!fs.accessSync(path)) {
        return undefined;
      }
      const text: string = fs.readTextSync(path);
      if (text.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
      }
      const file: MemberCacheFile = JSON.parse(text) as MemberCacheFile;
      const raw: Object[] = file.members !== undefined ? file.members : [];
      const members: ClassMember[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
        const blob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(raw[i]);
        if (blob === undefined) {
          continue;
        }
        const member: ClassMember | undefined = ClassMember.fromJson(blob);
        if (member !== undefined) {
          members.push(member);
        }
      }
      const savedAt: number = file.savedAt !== undefined ? file.savedAt : 0;
      return new MemberCacheEntry(members, savedAt);
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '读取名单缓存失败');
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async write(sid: string, members: ClassMember[], savedAt: number): Promise<void> {
    const path: string = this.pathFor(sid);
    const dir: string = this.dir();
    if (path.length === 0 || dir.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (!fs.accessSync(dir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(dir, true);
      }
      const raw: Object[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
        raw.push(members[i].toJson());
      }
      const file: MemberCacheFile = { 'savedAt': savedAt, 'members': raw };
      const handle = fs.openSync(path, fs.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fs.OpenMode.CREATE | fs.OpenMode.TRUNC);
      fs.writeSync(handle.fd, JSON.stringify(file));
      fs.closeSync(handle);
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '写入名单缓存失败');
    }
  }

  async clear(sid: string): Promise<void> {
    const path: string = this.pathFor(sid);
    if (path.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (fs.accessSync(path)) {
        fs.unlinkSync(path);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '清除名单缓存失败');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * 班级名单仓库：`POST rpc/class_members`（body `{}`，带身份 token）。
 *
 * 缓存：内存 L1（按 sid 隔离）+ 落盘；TTL 6h。
 * 失败语义：网络失败/空数组 → **不覆盖旧缓存**，返回旧缓存并标记 fromCache。
 */
export class ClassMembersRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private cache: ClassMemberCache;
  private sidProvider: () => string;
  private clock: () => number;
  private ttlMs: number;

  private memorySid: string = '';
  private memoryMembers: ClassMember[] = [];
  private memorySavedAt: number = 0;

  constructor(api: Api, cache: ClassMemberCache, sidProvider: () => string,
    clock: () => number = () => Date.now(), ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS) {
    this.api = api;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
  }

  async load(force: boolean): Promise<ClassMembersResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return ClassMembersResult.failure('请先完成身份验证');
    }
    const now: number = this.clock();
    if (!force && this.memorySid === sid && this.memoryMembers.length > 0
      && now - this.memorySavedAt < this.ttlMs) {
      return ClassMembersResult.success(this.memoryMembers, true);
    }

    let cached: ClassMember[] = [];
    let cachedAt: number = 0;
    if (this.memorySid === sid && this.memoryMembers.length > 0) {
      cached = this.memoryMembers;
      cachedAt = this.memorySavedAt;
    } else {
      const entry: MemberCacheEntry | undefined = await this.cache.read(sid);
      if (entry !== undefined) {
        cached = entry.members;
        cachedAt = entry.savedAt;
        this.memorySid = sid;
        this.memoryMembers = cached;
        this.memorySavedAt = cachedAt;
      }
    }
    if (!force && cached.length > 0 && now - cachedAt < this.ttlMs) {
      return ClassMembersResult.success(cached, true);
    }

    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post(MEMBERS_PATH, '{}', '', true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      if (cached.length > 0) {
        return ClassMembersResult.success(cached, true);
      }
      const message: string = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '名单加载失败';
      return ClassMembersResult.failure(message);
    }
    const members: ClassMember[] = parseMembers(result.value);
    if (members.length === 0) {
      // 契约：空数组视为失败，保留旧缓存
      if (cached.length > 0) {
        return ClassMembersResult.success(cached, true);
      }
      return ClassMembersResult.failure('班级名单为空，请稍后重试');
    }
    this.memorySid = sid;
    this.memoryMembers = members;
    this.memorySavedAt = now;
    await this.cache.write(sid, members, now);
    return ClassMembersResult.success(members, false);
  }

  /** 只读本机内存/文件缓存，不发请求。 */
  async cached(): Promise<ClassMember[]> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    if (this.memorySid === sid && this.memoryMembers.length > 0) {
      return this.memoryMembers;
    }
    const entry: MemberCacheEntry | undefined = await this.cache.read(sid);
    if (entry === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    this.memorySid = sid;
    this.memoryMembers = entry.members;
    this.memorySavedAt = entry.savedAt;
    return entry.members;
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    this.memorySid = '';
    this.memoryMembers = [];
    this.memorySavedAt = 0;
    if (sid.length > 0) {
      await this.cache.clear(sid);
    }
  }
}

/** 解析 `class_members` 数组；坏行跳过。 */
export function parseMembers(raw: string): ClassMember[] {
  if (raw.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  let parsed: JsonValue | undefined = undefined;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as JsonValue;
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
  const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
  if (array === undefined) {
    return [];
  }
  const out: ClassMember[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
    const blob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
    if (blob === undefined) {
      continue;
    }
    const member: ClassMember | undefined = ClassMember.fromJson(blob);
    if (member !== undefined) {
      out.push(member);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
import { ClassMember, LeagueMember, MemberEntry } from './ClassMember';

/** 名单三分类（对齐网页/小程序「名单」工具三 tab：班委 / 团员 / 全班）。 */
export enum MemberCategory {
  COMMITTEE = '班委',
  LEAGUE = '团员',
  ALL = '全班'
}

/** 三分类计数（UI tab 徽标）。 */
export class MemberCategoryCounts {
  committee: number = 0;
  league: number = 0;
  all: number = 0;

  constructor(committee: number = 0, league: number = 0, all: number = 0) {
    this.committee = committee;
    this.league = league;
    this.all = all;
  }

  of(category: MemberCategory): number {
    if (category === MemberCategory.COMMITTEE) {
      return this.committee;
    }
    if (category === MemberCategory.LEAGUE) {
      return this.league;
    }
    return this.all;
  }
}

/** 名单分类纯逻辑（可单测；不联网、不含学号）。 */
export class MemberCategoryBuilder {
  /** 班委判定与服务端 `auth_is_committee()` 同口径：`role` 非空 **或** `badge` 含「班委」。 */
  static isCommittee(member: ClassMember): boolean {
    return member.role.trim().length > 0 || member.badge.indexOf('班委') >= 0;
  }

  /** 班委名单（按座号升序；badge 优先 role，均无则「班委」）。 */
  static committee(members: ClassMember[]): MemberEntry[] {
    const out: MemberEntry[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
      const member: ClassMember = members[i];
      if (!MemberCategoryBuilder.isCommittee(member)) {
        continue;
      }
      const name: string = member.name.trim();
      if (member.seat <= 0 || name.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const role: string = member.role.trim();
      const badge: string = role.length > 0 ? role
        : (member.badge.trim().length > 0 ? member.badge.trim() : '班委');
      out.push(new MemberEntry(member.seat, name, badge));
    }
    out.sort((a: MemberEntry, b: MemberEntry) => a.seat - b.seat);
    return out;
  }

  /** 团员名单（来自 ClassLeagueRepository，无 badge）。 */
  static league(members: LeagueMember[]): MemberEntry[] {
    const out: MemberEntry[] = [];
    const seen: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
      const member: LeagueMember = members[i];
      const name: string = member.name.trim();
      if (member.seat <= 0 || name.length === 0 || seen.has(member.seat)) {
        continue;
      }
      seen.add(member.seat);
      out.push(new MemberEntry(member.seat, name, ''));
    }
    out.sort((a: MemberEntry, b: MemberEntry) => a.seat - b.seat);
    return out;
  }

  /** 全班名单（座号升序；badge 用 role/badge，无则不显示）。 */
  static all(members: ClassMember[]): MemberEntry[] {
    const out: MemberEntry[] = [];
    const seen: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
      const member: ClassMember = members[i];
      const name: string = member.name.trim();
      if (member.seat <= 0 || name.length === 0 || seen.has(member.seat)) {
        continue;
      }
      seen.add(member.seat);
      const role: string = member.role.trim();
      const badge: string = role.length > 0 ? role : member.badge.trim();
      out.push(new MemberEntry(member.seat, name, badge));
    }
    out.sort((a: MemberEntry, b: MemberEntry) => a.seat - b.seat);
    return out;
  }

  /** 按分类取名单；数据不可用时返回空列表（由 UI 显示空态）。 */
  static entries(category: MemberCategory, classMembers: ClassMember[], leagueMembers: LeagueMember[]): MemberEntry[] {
    if (category === MemberCategory.COMMITTEE) {
      return MemberCategoryBuilder.committee(classMembers);
    }
    if (category === MemberCategory.LEAGUE) {
      return MemberCategoryBuilder.league(leagueMembers);
    }
    return MemberCategoryBuilder.all(classMembers);
  }

  /** 三分类计数（用于 tab 徽标）。 */
  static counts(classMembers: ClassMember[], leagueMembers: LeagueMember[]): MemberCategoryCounts {
    return new MemberCategoryCounts(
      MemberCategoryBuilder.committee(classMembers).length,
      MemberCategoryBuilder.league(leagueMembers).length,
      MemberCategoryBuilder.all(classMembers).length
    );
  }

  /** 姓名搜索（空格不敏感；空查询返回全部）。 */
  static search(entries: MemberEntry[], query: string): MemberEntry[] {
    const q: string = query.trim();
    if (q.length === 0) {
      return entries;
    }
    const out: MemberEntry[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
      if (entries[i].name.indexOf(q) >= 0) {
        out.push(entries[i]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 方便 UI：按分类 + 搜索过滤。 */
  static visibleEntries(category: MemberCategory, classMembers: ClassMember[], leagueMembers: LeagueMember[],
    query: string): MemberEntry[] {
    return MemberCategoryBuilder.search(
      MemberCategoryBuilder.entries(category, classMembers, leagueMembers), query);
  }
}
import { ApiResult } from './ApiResult';

/**
 * 数据层依赖的最小网络接口（便于单测注入假实现）。
 *
 * 真实实现：`HttpClient`（PostgREST 网关封装）。
 */
export interface Api {
  get(path: string, authenticated?: boolean): Promise<ApiResult>;

  post(path: string, body: string, prefer?: string, authenticated?: boolean): Promise<ApiResult>;

  patch(path: string, body: string, prefer?: string, authenticated?: boolean): Promise<ApiResult>;

  delete(path: string, authenticated?: boolean): Promise<ApiResult>;
}
/** 请求失败的分类，UI 据此给不同文案/行为。 */
export enum ApiErrorKind {
  Network = 'network',
  Http = 'http',
  TokenInvalid = 'token_invalid',
  Parse = 'parse',
  Config = 'config'
}

/** 统一的错误载体（不携带任何隐私字段）。 */
export class ApiError {
  kind: ApiErrorKind;
  status: number;
  code: string;
  message: string;

  constructor(kind: ApiErrorKind, status: number, code: string, message: string) {
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    this.message = message;
  }

  /** 可直接展示给用户的中文文案。 */
  displayMessage(): string {
    if (this.message.length > 0) {
      return this.message;
    }
    if (this.kind === ApiErrorKind.Network) {
      return '网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试';
    }
    if (this.kind === ApiErrorKind.TokenInvalid) {
      return '身份已失效，请重新输入学号与姓名';
    }
    if (this.kind === ApiErrorKind.Config) {
      return '云端配置缺失';
    }
    return '请求失败（' + this.status + '）';
  }
}

/** 值语义的请求结果：成功带原始响应文本，失败带 ApiError。 */
export class ApiResult {
  ok: boolean;
  value: string;
  error: ApiError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, value: string, error: ApiError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.value = value;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static success(value: string): ApiResult {
    return new ApiResult(true, value, undefined);
  }

  static failure(error: ApiError): ApiResult {
    return new ApiResult(false, '', error);
  }
}
import { http } from '@kit.NetworkKit';
import { BusinessError } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';
import { CloudConfig } from '../../config/CloudConfig';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';
import { Api } from './Api';
import { ApiError, ApiErrorKind, ApiResult } from './ApiResult';

const TAG: string = 'HttpClient';

export enum HttpMethod {
  GET = 'GET',
  POST = 'POST',
  PATCH = 'PATCH',
  DELETE = 'DELETE'
}

/** 一次请求的完整描述。 */
export class HttpRequestSpec {
  method: HttpMethod = HttpMethod.GET;
  path: string = '';
  body: string = '';
  prefer: string = '';
  authenticated: boolean = true;
  extraHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};
  retryOnNetworkFailure: boolean = false;
}

interface PostgrestErrorBody {
  code?: string;
  message?: string;
  details?: string;
  hint?: string;
}

/**
 * CloudBase PostgREST 网关客户端（契约：android-class-tools/docs/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md §1）。
 *
 * - 头：`Authorization: Bearer <publishableKey>`、`Content-Type/Accept`、`Cache-Control: no-store`，
 *   有身份时才加 `X-Class-Token`（**绝不发空 token**）。
 * - 超时：连接/读 10s。
 * - 重试：仅 GET 的网络层失败重试 1 次（~350ms）；写请求不重试（防重复写入）。
 * - 401/403 → TokenInvalid，并回调登出（清会话回身份页）。
 */
export class HttpClient implements Api {
  private tokenProvider: () => string = () => '';
  private onTokenInvalid: () => void = () => {};

  setTokenProvider(provider: () => string): void {
    this.tokenProvider = provider;
  }

  setTokenInvalidHandler(handler: () => void): void {
    this.onTokenInvalid = handler;
  }

  async get(path: string, authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    const spec: HttpRequestSpec = new HttpRequestSpec();
    spec.method = HttpMethod.GET;
    spec.path = path;
    spec.authenticated = authenticated;
    spec.retryOnNetworkFailure = true;
    return await this.request(spec);
  }

  async post(path: string, body: string, prefer: string = '', authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    const spec: HttpRequestSpec = new HttpRequestSpec();
    spec.method = HttpMethod.POST;
    spec.path = path;
    spec.body = body;
    spec.prefer = prefer;
    spec.authenticated = authenticated;
    return await this.request(spec);
  }

  async patch(path: string, body: string, prefer: string = '', authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    const spec: HttpRequestSpec = new HttpRequestSpec();
    spec.method = HttpMethod.PATCH;
    spec.path = path;
    spec.body = body;
    spec.prefer = prefer;
    spec.authenticated = authenticated;
    return await this.request(spec);
  }

  async delete(path: string, authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    const spec: HttpRequestSpec = new HttpRequestSpec();
    spec.method = HttpMethod.DELETE;
    spec.path = path;
    spec.authenticated = authenticated;
    spec.prefer = 'return=minimal';
    return await this.request(spec);
  }

  async request(spec: HttpRequestSpec): Promise<ApiResult> {
    const first: ApiResult = await this.execute(spec);
    if (!first.ok && spec.retryOnNetworkFailure && first.error !== undefined
      && first.error.kind === ApiErrorKind.Network) {
      Log.w(TAG, 'GET 网络失败，350ms 后重试一次');
      await delay(CloudConfig.GET_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
      return await this.execute(spec);
    }
    return first;
  }

  private buildHeaders(spec: HttpRequestSpec): Record<string, string> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + CloudConfig.PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
    headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    headers['Accept'] = 'application/json';
    headers['Cache-Control'] = 'no-store';
    if (spec.authenticated) {
      const token: string = this.tokenProvider();
      if (token.length > 0) {
        headers['X-Class-Token'] = token;
      }
    }
    if (spec.prefer.length > 0) {
      headers['Prefer'] = spec.prefer;
    }
    const extra: Record<string, string> = spec.extraHeaders;
    const keys: string[] = Object.keys(extra);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      const k: string = keys[i];
      headers[k] = extra[k];
    }
    return headers;
  }

  private async execute(spec: HttpRequestSpec): Promise<ApiResult> {
    if (!CloudConfig.isConfigured()) {
      return ApiResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Config, 0, 'not_configured', '云端配置缺失'));
    }
    const request: http.HttpRequest = http.createHttp();
    const options: http.HttpRequestOptions = {
      method: toNetMethod(spec.method),
      header: this.buildHeaders(spec),
      connectTimeout: CloudConfig.CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS,
      readTimeout: CloudConfig.READ_TIMEOUT_MS,
      expectDataType: http.HttpDataType.STRING,
      usingCache: false
    };
    if (spec.body.length > 0) {
      options.extraData = spec.body;
    }
    const url: string = CloudConfig.url(spec.path);
    try {
      const response: http.HttpResponse = await request.request(url, options);
      const status: number = response.responseCode;
      const text: string = bodyToText(response.result);
      if (status >= 200 && status < 300) {
        return ApiResult.success(text);
      }
      if (status === 401 || status === 403) {
        const err: ApiError = new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.TokenInvalid, status, 'unauthorized', '身份已失效');
        this.onTokenInvalid();
        return ApiResult.failure(err);
      }
      return ApiResult.failure(parseHttpError(status, text));
    } catch (e) {
      const be: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.w(TAG, '请求失败 code=' + be.code + ' msg=' + be.message);
      return ApiResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', '网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试'));
    } finally {
      request.destroy();
    }
  }
}

function toNetMethod(method: HttpMethod): http.RequestMethod {
  if (method === HttpMethod.POST) {
    return http.RequestMethod.POST;
  }
  if (method === HttpMethod.PATCH) {
    return http.RequestMethod.PATCH;
  }
  if (method === HttpMethod.DELETE) {
    return http.RequestMethod.DELETE;
  }
  return http.RequestMethod.GET;
}

function bodyToText(result: string | Object | ArrayBuffer): string {
  if (typeof result === 'string') {
    return result;
  }
  if (result instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
    return '';
  }
  return JSON.stringify(result);
}

function parseHttpError(status: number, text: string): ApiError {
  let message: string = '';
  let code: string = '';
  if (text.length > 0) {
    try {
      const parsed: PostgrestErrorBody = JSON.parse(text) as PostgrestErrorBody;
      message = parsed.message !== undefined ? parsed.message : '';
      code = parsed.code !== undefined ? parsed.code : '';
    } catch (e) {
      message = '';
    }
  }
  return new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Http, status, code, message);
}

export function delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve: () => void) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      resolve();
    }, ms);
  });
}

/** 轻量签名行：`GET notices?select=id,ts,hidden,edited_at`（约 2KB，先比签名再拉整表）。 */
export class NoticeSigRow {
  id: string = '';
  ts: number = 0;
  hidden: boolean = false;
  editedAt: number = 0;

  static signatureOf(rows: NoticeSigRow[]): string {
    let out: string = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      out += rows[i].id + '|' + rows[i].ts + '|' + (rows[i].hidden ? '1' : '0') + '|' + rows[i].editedAt + ';';
    }
    return out;
  }
}
