    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await ReminderStore.store();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await store.put(ReminderStore.prefix(sid) + '_advance', record.advance);
      await store.put(ReminderStore.prefix(sid) + '_ids', ReminderStore.encodeIds(record.ids));
      await store.flush();
    } catch (e) {
      Log.e(TAG, '保存提醒偏好失败');
    }
  }

  /** 序列化 hwId:reminderId;…（纯函数，便于单测）。 */
  static encodeIds(ids: Map<string, number>): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    ids.forEach((value: number, key: string) => {
      if (key.indexOf(';') < 0 && key.indexOf(':') < 0 && value >= 0) {
        parts.push(key + ':' + value);
      }
    });
    return parts.join(';');
  }

  static decodeIds(raw: string): Map<string, number> {
    const out: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
    if (raw.length === 0) {
      return out;
    }
    const parts: string[] = raw.split(';');
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      const pair: string[] = parts[i].split(':');
      if (pair.length === 2) {
        const id: number = Number(pair[1]);
        if (pair[0].length > 0 && Number.isFinite(id) && id >= 0) {
          out.set(pair[0], Math.round(id));
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  static prefsOf(record: ReminderRecord): ReminderPrefs {
    const prefs: ReminderPrefs = new ReminderPrefs();
    prefs.advanceMinutes = record.advance;
    prefs.enabled = true;
    return prefs;
  }
}
/**
 * 已通过班级身份核验的会话（字段对齐网页/小程序/安卓本机身份）。
 *
 * 隐私：`sid`/`name`/`token` 只在本机使用，**不写日志、不导出、不上报**。
 */
interface SessionJson {
  sid?: string;
  name?: string;
  token?: string;
  role?: string;
  badge?: string;
  isAdmin?: boolean;
  issuedAt?: number;
  expiresAt?: number;
}

export class Session {
  sid: string = '';
  name: string = '';
  token: string = '';
  role: string = '';
  badge: string = '';
  isAdmin: boolean = false;
  /** token 签发时间（毫秒）。 */
  issuedAt: number = 0;
  /** token 过期时间（毫秒，0 = 未知）。 */
  expiresAt: number = 0;

  constructor(sid: string = '', name: string = '', token: string = '') {
    this.sid = sid;
    this.name = name;
    this.token = token;
  }

  /** UI 展示用的脱敏学号。 */
  maskedSid(): string {
    if (this.sid.length <= 4) {
      return '***';
    }
    return this.sid.substring(0, 2) + '***' + this.sid.substring(this.sid.length - 2);
  }

  /** 与网页一致的 29 天本地判定：未过期且签发不满 29 天可直接进主界面。 */
  isLikelyValid(now: number): boolean {
    if (this.expiresAt > 0 && now > this.expiresAt) {
      return false;
    }
    if (this.issuedAt <= 0) {
      return true;
    }
    return now - this.issuedAt < 29 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  }

  toJson(): string {
    const d: SessionJson = {
      sid: this.sid,
      name: this.name,
      token: this.token,
      role: this.role,
      badge: this.badge,
      isAdmin: this.isAdmin,
      issuedAt: this.issuedAt,
      expiresAt: this.expiresAt
    };
    return JSON.stringify(d);
  }

  static fromJson(raw: string): Session | undefined {
    if (raw.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      const d: SessionJson = JSON.parse(raw) as SessionJson;
      const s: Session = new Session(
        d.sid !== undefined ? d.sid : '',
        d.name !== undefined ? d.name : '',
        d.token !== undefined ? d.token : ''
      );
      s.role = d.role !== undefined ? d.role : '';
      s.badge = d.badge !== undefined ? d.badge : '';
      s.isAdmin = d.isAdmin === true;
      s.issuedAt = d.issuedAt !== undefined ? d.issuedAt : 0;
      s.expiresAt = d.expiresAt !== undefined ? d.expiresAt : 0;
      if (s.token.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
      }
      return s;
    } catch (e) {
      return undefined;
    }
  }
}
import { preferences } from '@kit.ArkData';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';
import { Session } from './Session';

const STORE_NAME: string = 'class_tools_session';
const KEY_SESSION: string = 'session_v1';
const TAG: string = 'SessionStore';

/**
 * 会话持久化（HarmonyOS preferences，按应用沙箱存储）。
 *
 * 只存身份会话；班级名单/课表等缓存后续按 sid 分桶，退出登录时一并清除。
 */
export class SessionStore {
  private store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = undefined;

  private async ensure(): Promise<preferences.Preferences | undefined> {
    if (this.store !== undefined) {
      return this.store;
    }
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    if (ctx === undefined) {
      Log.e(TAG, 'context 未注入，无法打开 preferences');
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      this.store = await preferences.getPreferences(ctx, { name: STORE_NAME });
      return this.store;
    } catch (e) {
      Log.e(TAG, '打开 preferences 失败');
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async load(): Promise<Session | undefined> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await this.ensure();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      const raw: string = store.getSync(KEY_SESSION, '') as string;
      if (raw.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
      }
      return Session.fromJson(raw);
    } catch (e) {
      Log.e(TAG, '读取会话失败');
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async save(session: Session): Promise<void> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await this.ensure();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      store.putSync(KEY_SESSION, session.toJson());
      await store.flush();
    } catch (e) {
      Log.e(TAG, '写入会话失败');
    }
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await this.ensure();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      store.deleteSync(KEY_SESSION);
      await store.flush();
    } catch (e) {
      Log.e(TAG, '清除会话失败');
    }
  }
}
/**
 * JSON 树工具（ArkTS 没有 kotlinx.serialization 的 JsonElement，用 Record<string, JsonValue> 表达）。
 *
 * 约定：
 * - 合并/比较一律在 JSON 树上做（保序、保留未知字段），**不要**转成 data class——
 *   那会丢掉「未拥有 section 原样保留」和未知字段，导致跨端覆盖（契约 §4.4）。
 * - 比较是「结构相等」（对象键序无关、数组有序），与 kotlinx JsonObject.equals 语义一致。
 */
export type JsonValue = Object | null;
export type Blob = Record<string, JsonValue>;

export class JsonBlob {
  static parse(text: string): Blob | undefined {
    if (text.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      const value: JsonValue = JSON.parse(text) as JsonValue;
      return JsonBlob.asBlob(value);
    } catch (e) {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  static encode(blob: Blob): string {
    return JSON.stringify(blob);
  }

  static isNullish(value: JsonValue | undefined): boolean {
    return value === null || value === undefined;
  }

  static asBlob(value: JsonValue | undefined): Blob | undefined {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'object') {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return value as Blob;
  }

  static asArray(value: JsonValue | undefined): Object[] | undefined {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return value as Object[];
  }

  static asString(value: JsonValue | undefined, fallback: string): string {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      return fallback;
    }
    return value as string;
  }

  static asNumber(value: JsonValue | undefined, fallback: number): number {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'number') {
      return fallback;
    }
    const n: number = value as number;
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
  }

  static asBoolean(value: JsonValue | undefined, fallback: boolean): boolean {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'boolean') {
      return fallback;
    }
    return value as boolean;
  }

  /** 时间戳解析：只有有限且 >0 的数才有效（与 web/mp `num(v)=isFinite(v)&&v>0?v:0` 等价）。 */
  static numMs(value: JsonValue | undefined): number {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      return 0;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'number') {
      return 0;
    }
    const n: number = value as number;
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return n;
  }

  static clone(value: JsonValue | undefined): JsonValue | undefined {
    if (value === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as JsonValue;
  }

  static keys(blob: Blob): string[] {
    return Object.keys(blob);
  }

  static has(blob: Blob | undefined, key: string): boolean {
    if (blob === undefined) {
      return false;
    }
    return Object.keys(blob).indexOf(key) >= 0;
  }

  static get(blob: Blob | undefined, key: string): JsonValue | undefined {
    if (blob === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const keys: string[] = Object.keys(blob);
    if (keys.indexOf(key) < 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return blob[key];
  }

  /** 结构相等：对象键序无关、数组有序、null 等于 null/缺失。 */
  static deepEqual(a: JsonValue | undefined, b: JsonValue | undefined): boolean {
    if (a === undefined || a === null) {
      return b === undefined || b === null;
    }
    if (b === undefined || b === null) {
      return false;
    }
    if (typeof a !== typeof b) {
      return false;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(a)) {
      if (!Array.isArray(b)) {
        return false;
      }
      const aa: Object[] = a as Object[];
      const bb: Object[] = b as Object[];
      if (aa.length !== bb.length) {
        return false;
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < aa.length; i++) {
        if (!JsonBlob.deepEqual(aa[i], bb[i])) {
          return false;
        }
      }
      return true;
    }
    if (typeof a === 'object') {
      const ao: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(a);
      const bo: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(b);
      if (ao === undefined || bo === undefined) {
        return false;
      }
      const ak: string[] = Object.keys(ao);
      const bk: string[] = Object.keys(bo);
      if (ak.length !== bk.length) {
        return false;
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < ak.length; i++) {
        const k: string = ak[i];
        if (bk.indexOf(k) < 0) {
          return false;
        }
        if (!JsonBlob.deepEqual(ao[k], bo[k])) {
          return false;
        }
      }
      return true;
    }
    return a === b;
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from './JsonBlob';
import { UserdataV6 } from './UserdataV6';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';
import { fileIo as fs } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';

const TAG: string = 'UserdataLocalStore';
const STORE_FILE_VERSION: number = 1;

/** 落盘结构（一 sid 一文件；cache/current 直接存 JSON 文本，避免嵌套序列化边界问题）。 */
interface UserDataStoreFile {
  v?: number;
  cacheJson?: string;
  currentJson?: string;
  pendingKeys?: string[];
  pend?: boolean;
  lastPullAt?: number;
  holdUntil?: number;
  syncEnabled?: boolean;
}

/**
 * userdata 本机持久层（按 sid 隔离）。
 *
 * - `cache`  = 最近一次合并结果（脏检测基线）；
 * - `current`= 本机各 section 当前值（业务层写入）；
 * - `pend` + `pendingKeys` = 待补发标记；
 * - `lastPullAt` = 上次成功拉取时间（60s TTL）；`holdUntil` = 清除云端后的抑制期；`syncEnabled` = 云同步开关。
 */
export interface UserdataLocalStore {
  readCache(): Promise<Blob | undefined>;

  writeCache(blob: Blob): Promise<void>;

  readCurrent(): Promise<Blob>;

  writeCurrent(sections: Blob): Promise<void>;

  pend(): Promise<boolean>;

  setPend(value: boolean): Promise<void>;

  pendingKeys(): Promise<Set<string>>;

  markPending(keys: string[]): Promise<void>;

  clearPending(): Promise<void>;

  lastPullAt(): Promise<number>;

  setLastPullAt(at: number): Promise<void>;

  holdUntil(): Promise<number>;

  setHoldUntil(at: number): Promise<void>;

  syncEnabled(): Promise<boolean>;

  setSyncEnabled(enabled: boolean): Promise<void>;

  clear(): Promise<void>;
}

/** 内存实现：单测 / 预览用。 */
export class InMemoryUserdataLocalStore implements UserdataLocalStore {
  private cache: Blob | undefined = undefined;
  private current: Blob = {};
  private pendFlag: boolean = false;
  private pending: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  private lastPull: number = 0;
  private hold: number = 0;
  private enabled: boolean = true;

  async readCache(): Promise<Blob | undefined> {
    return this.cache;
  }

  async writeCache(blob: Blob): Promise<void> {
    this.cache = blob;
  }

  async readCurrent(): Promise<Blob> {
    return this.current;
  }

  async writeCurrent(sections: Blob): Promise<void> {
    this.current = sections;
  }

  async pend(): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.pendFlag;
  }

  async setPend(value: boolean): Promise<void> {
    this.pendFlag = value;
  }

  async pendingKeys(): Promise<Set<string>> {
    return this.pending;
  }

  async markPending(keys: string[]): Promise<void> {
    this.pendFlag = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      if (keys[i].length > 0) {
        this.pending.add(keys[i]);
      }
    }
  }

  async clearPending(): Promise<void> {
    this.pendFlag = false;
    this.pending = new Set<string>();
  }

  async lastPullAt(): Promise<number> {
    return this.lastPull;
  }

  async setLastPullAt(at: number): Promise<void> {
    this.lastPull = at;
  }

  async holdUntil(): Promise<number> {
    return this.hold;
  }

  async setHoldUntil(at: number): Promise<void> {
    this.hold = at;
  }

  async syncEnabled(): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.enabled;
  }

  async setSyncEnabled(enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    this.enabled = enabled;
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    this.cache = undefined;
    this.current = {};
    this.pendFlag = false;
    this.pending = new Set<string>();
    this.lastPull = 0;
    this.hold = 0;
  }
}

/**
 * 文件实现：`<filesDir>/userdata/userdata_<sid>.json`。
 *
 * 不用 preferences：blob 可能超过 preferences 的单值上限。文件很小（<几十 KB），同步读写可接受；
 * 写入失败静默（本机缓存语义：失败不影响业务，下一次再写）。
 */
export class FileUserdataLocalStore implements UserdataLocalStore {
  private directory: string = '';
  private sidProvider: () => string;

  constructor(sidProvider: () => string, directory: string = '') {
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.directory = directory;
  }

  private dir(): string {
    if (this.directory.length > 0) {
      return this.directory;
    }
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    if (ctx === undefined) {
      return '';
    }
    return ctx.filesDir + '/userdata';
  }

  private currentSid(): string {
    return this.sidProvider().trim();
  }

  private pathFor(sid: string): string {
    const safe: string = sid.replace(new RegExp('[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', 'g'), '');
    return this.dir() + '/userdata_' + safe + '.json';
  }

  private readFile(): UserDataStoreFile {
    const sid: string = this.currentSid();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return {};
    }
    const dir: string = this.dir();
    if (dir.length === 0) {
      return {};
    }
    const path: string = this.pathFor(sid);
    try {
      if (!fs.accessSync(path)) {
        return {};
      }
      const text: string = fs.readTextSync(path);
      if (text.length === 0) {
        return {};
      }
      return JSON.parse(text) as UserDataStoreFile;
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '读取本机 userdata 失败');
      return {};
    }
  }

  private writeFile(next: UserDataStoreFile): void {
    const sid: string = this.currentSid();
    const dir: string = this.dir();
    if (sid.length === 0 || dir.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (!fs.accessSync(dir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(dir, true);
      }
      next.v = STORE_FILE_VERSION;
      const file = fs.openSync(this.pathFor(sid),
        fs.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fs.OpenMode.CREATE | fs.OpenMode.TRUNC);
      fs.writeSync(file.fd, JSON.stringify(next));
      fs.closeSync(file);
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '写入本机 userdata 失败');
    }
  }

  async readCache(): Promise<Blob | undefined> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    if (file.cacheJson === undefined || file.cacheJson.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return UserdataV6.decode(file.cacheJson);
  }

  async writeCache(blob: Blob): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    file.cacheJson = UserdataV6.encode(blob);
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async readCurrent(): Promise<Blob> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    if (file.currentJson === undefined || file.currentJson.length === 0) {
      return {};
    }
    const parsed: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(file.currentJson);
    return parsed !== undefined ? parsed : {};
  }

  async writeCurrent(sections: Blob): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    file.currentJson = JsonBlob.encode(sections);
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async pend(): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.readFile().pend === true;
  }

  async setPend(value: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    file.pend = value;
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async pendingKeys(): Promise<Set<string>> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    const keys: string[] = file.pendingKeys !== undefined ? file.pendingKeys : [];
    const set: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      if (keys[i].length > 0) {
        set.add(keys[i]);
      }
    }
    return set;
  }

  async markPending(keys: string[]): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    const existing: string[] = file.pendingKeys !== undefined ? file.pendingKeys : [];
    const merged: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < existing.length; i++) {
      merged.push(existing[i]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      if (keys[i].length > 0 && merged.indexOf(keys[i]) < 0) {
        merged.push(keys[i]);
      }
    }
    file.pend = true;
    file.pendingKeys = merged;
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async clearPending(): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    file.pend = false;
    file.pendingKeys = [];
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async lastPullAt(): Promise<number> {
    const value: number | undefined = this.readFile().lastPullAt;
    return value !== undefined ? value : 0;
  }

  async setLastPullAt(at: number): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    file.lastPullAt = at;
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async holdUntil(): Promise<number> {
    const value: number | undefined = this.readFile().holdUntil;
    return value !== undefined ? value : 0;
  }

  async setHoldUntil(at: number): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    file.holdUntil = at;
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async syncEnabled(): Promise<boolean> {
    const value: boolean | undefined = this.readFile().syncEnabled;
    return value !== false;
  }

  async setSyncEnabled(enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const file: UserDataStoreFile = this.readFile();
    file.syncEnabled = enabled;
    this.writeFile(file);
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    const sid: string = this.currentSid();
    const dir: string = this.dir();
    if (sid.length === 0 || dir.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const path: string = this.pathFor(sid);
      if (fs.accessSync(path)) {
        fs.unlinkSync(path);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '清除本机 userdata 失败');
    }
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from './JsonBlob';
import { UserdataV6 } from './UserdataV6';

/**
 * userdata v6 合并算法（纯函数，与 `mp-class-tools-tests/_sync_fixtures/merge_ref.js` 逐字节等价）。
 *
 * 规则（契约 §4 / docs/api/USERDATA_V6.md §2/§6）：
 * - 逐 section 比较 `at`，`remote.at[k] >= local.at[k]` 时云端赢（相等云端赢 = 幂等收敛）；
 * - 值是否参与比较用「非 null」判定；
 * - 双方都无 → DEFAULTS[k] + at=0；
 * - 输出固定顺序 `v, at, <11 sections>, homeToolsAt`，且 `homeToolsAt = at.homeTools`；
 * - `v=5` 先归一为 v6 再合并。
 */
export class UserdataMerge {
  /** 与 merge_ref.js `mergeBlob()` 等价。 */
  static merge(remoteIn: Blob | undefined, localIn: Blob | undefined): Blob {
    let remote: Blob | undefined = remoteIn;
    if (remoteIn !== undefined && UserdataV6.numMs(JsonBlob.get(remoteIn, 'v')) === 5) {
      remote = UserdataMerge.normalizeV5(remoteIn);
    }

    const values: Blob = {};
    const atOut: Blob = {};

    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      const ra: number = UserdataV6.atValue(remote, key);
      const la: number = UserdataV6.atValue(localIn, key);
      const remoteValue: JsonValue | undefined = withoutNull(JsonBlob.get(remote, key));
      const localValue: JsonValue | undefined = withoutNull(JsonBlob.get(localIn, key));
      if (remoteValue !== undefined && (localValue === undefined || ra >= la)) {
        values[key] = remoteValue;
        atOut[key] = ra;
      } else if (localValue !== undefined) {
        values[key] = localValue;
        atOut[key] = la;
      } else {
        values[key] = UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
        atOut[key] = 0;
      }
    }

    const out: Blob = {};
    out['v'] = UserdataV6.VERSION;
    out['at'] = atOut;
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      out[key] = values[key];
    }
    out['homeToolsAt'] = UserdataV6.numMs(JsonBlob.get(atOut, 'homeTools'));
    return out;
  }

  /** 与 merge_ref.js `normalizeV5()` 等价。 */
  static normalizeV5(old: Blob): Blob {
    const at: Blob = {};
    at['homeTools'] = UserdataV6.numMs(JsonBlob.get(old, 'homeToolsAt'));
    at['fit'] = 0;

    const out: Blob = {};
    out['v'] = UserdataV6.VERSION;
    out['at'] = at;
    const homeTools: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(old, 'homeTools'));
    if (homeTools !== undefined) {
      out['homeTools'] = homeTools;
    }
    const fit: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(old, 'fit'));
    if (fit !== undefined) {
      out['fit'] = fit;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * 本机视图（push 的 local 输入），与 web `UD.localView` / mp `udSections()+udOwnedDirty` 等价。
   *
   * - 拥有的 section 取本机当前值；不拥有的从「最近合并基线」原样带上；
   * - 与基线不同 = 脏 → at = max(now, base.at+1, remote.at+1)；
   * - forceKeys 显式强制为脏；
   * - power.at 镜像 at.power；
   * - 输出固定顺序。
   */
  static localView(base: Blob | undefined, current: Blob, remote: Blob | undefined,
    forceKeys: Set<string>, now: number, ownedSections: Set<string>): Blob {
    const values: Blob = {};
    const atOut: Blob = {};

    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      const owned: boolean = ownedSections.has(key);
      const currentValue: JsonValue | undefined = withoutNull(JsonBlob.get(current, key));
      const baseValue: JsonValue | undefined = withoutNull(JsonBlob.get(base, key));

      let value: JsonValue = null;
      if (owned && currentValue !== undefined) {
        value = currentValue;
      } else if (!owned) {
        value = baseValue !== undefined ? baseValue : UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
      } else {
        value = UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
      }

      const ba: number = UserdataV6.atValue(base, key);
      const ra: number = UserdataV6.atValue(remote, key);
      // 无基线（base===undefined）时不算脏：先 pull 建基线，避免默认值覆盖云端（契约 §4.4-5）
      let dirty: boolean = owned && base !== undefined && (baseValue === undefined || !JsonBlob.deepEqual(baseValue, value));
      if (owned && forceKeys.has(key)) {
        dirty = true;
      }
      let la: number = ba;
      if (dirty) {
        la = Math.max(now, ba + 1, ra + 1);
      }

      values[key] = value;
      atOut[key] = la;
    }

    // power 值内 at 与 at.power 镜像（契约 §1.3）
    const power: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(values, 'power'));
    if (power !== undefined) {
      const mirrored: Blob = {};
      const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(power);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        mirrored[keys[i]] = power[keys[i]];
      }
      mirrored['at'] = UserdataV6.numMs(JsonBlob.get(atOut, 'power'));
      values['power'] = mirrored;
    }

    const out: Blob = {};
    out['v'] = UserdataV6.VERSION;
    out['at'] = atOut;
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      out[key] = values[key];
    }
    out['homeToolsAt'] = UserdataV6.numMs(JsonBlob.get(atOut, 'homeTools'));
    return out;
  }

  /** 脏 section：本机当前值与基线不同（含「基线缺该键」= 脏），只考虑 ownedSections。 */
  static dirtySections(base: Blob | undefined, current: Blob, ownedSections: Set<string>): Set<string> {
    const dirty: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    if (base === undefined) {
      return dirty;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      if (!ownedSections.has(key)) {
        continue;
      }
      const baseValue: JsonValue | undefined = withoutNull(JsonBlob.get(base, key));
      const currentRaw: JsonValue | undefined = withoutNull(JsonBlob.get(current, key));
      const currentValue: JsonValue = currentRaw !== undefined ? currentRaw : UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
      if (baseValue === undefined || !JsonBlob.deepEqual(baseValue, currentValue)) {
        dirty.add(key);
      }
    }
    return dirty;
  }

  /** 无基线时判断「哪些 section 与默认值不同」= 本机真实改动（跳过 prefs，避免默认偏好覆盖云端）。 */
  static changedKeysVsDefaults(current: Blob, ownedSections: Set<string>): Set<string> {
    const changed: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      if (!ownedSections.has(key) || key === 'prefs') {
        continue;
      }
      const raw: JsonValue | undefined = withoutNull(JsonBlob.get(current, key));
      const value: JsonValue = raw !== undefined ? raw : UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
      if (!JsonBlob.deepEqual(value, UserdataV6.defaultSection(key))) {
        changed.add(key);
      }
    }
    return changed;
  }
}

/** JSON 值是否参与比较：null 与缺失等价（契约用「非 null」判定）。 */
function withoutNull(value: JsonValue | undefined): JsonValue | undefined {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return value;
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiError, ApiErrorKind, ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from './JsonBlob';
import { UserdataV6 } from './UserdataV6';
import { UserdataMerge } from './UserdataMerge';
import { UserdataLocalStore } from './UserdataLocalStore';
import { WaterNormalizer } from './WaterNormalizer';
import { AsyncLock } from '../../common/AsyncLock';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';

const TAG: string = 'UserdataRepo';
const USERDATA_PATH: string = 'userdata';
const UPSERT_PREFER: string = 'return=representation,resolution=merge-duplicates';

/** 同步节奏常量（契约 §4.3：拉取 TTL 60s、推送防抖 1200ms、清除后抑制期 30 天）。 */
export class UserdataSyncConfig {
  ttlMs: number;
  debounceMs: number;
  holdMs: number;

  constructor(ttlMs: number = 60000, debounceMs: number = 1200, holdMs: number = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
    this.debounceMs = debounceMs;
    this.holdMs = holdMs;
  }
}

/** 拉取结果。`status`：success / disabled / failure。 */
export class UserdataPullResult {
  status: string;
  changed: boolean;
  pushed: boolean;
  fresh: boolean;
  migratedV5: boolean;
  error: ApiError | undefined;

  constructor(status: string, changed: boolean, pushed: boolean, fresh: boolean, migratedV5: boolean,
    error: ApiError | undefined) {
    this.status = status;
    this.changed = changed;
    this.pushed = pushed;
    this.fresh = fresh;
    this.migratedV5 = migratedV5;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static success(changed: boolean, pushed: boolean, fresh: boolean, migratedV5: boolean): UserdataPullResult {
    return new UserdataPullResult('success', changed, pushed, fresh, migratedV5, undefined);
  }

  static disabled(): UserdataPullResult {
    return new UserdataPullResult('disabled', false, false, false, false, undefined);
  }

  static failure(error: ApiError): UserdataPullResult {
    return new UserdataPullResult('failure', false, false, false, false, error);
  }

  ok(): boolean {
    return this.status === 'success';
  }
}

/** 推送结果。`status`：success / skipped / disabled / held / failure。 */
export class UserdataPushResult {
  status: string;
  pushed: boolean;
  error: ApiError | undefined;

  constructor(status: string, pushed: boolean, error: ApiError | undefined) {
    this.status = status;
    this.pushed = pushed;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static success(pushed: boolean): UserdataPushResult {
    return new UserdataPushResult('success', pushed, undefined);
  }

  static skipped(): UserdataPushResult {
    return new UserdataPushResult('skipped', false, undefined);
  }

  static disabled(): UserdataPushResult {
    return new UserdataPushResult('disabled', false, undefined);
  }

  static held(): UserdataPushResult {
    return new UserdataPushResult('held', false, undefined);
  }

  static failure(error: ApiError): UserdataPushResult {
    return new UserdataPushResult('failure', false, error);
  }

  ok(): boolean {
    return this.status === 'success';
  }
}

class RemoteFetch {
  ok: boolean;
  value: Blob | undefined;
  error: ApiError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, value: Blob | undefined, error: ApiError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.value = value;
    this.error = error;
  }
}

/**
 * userdata v6 双向同步仓库（契约：BACKEND_CONTRACT.md §4 + `USERDATA_V6.md`）。
 *
 * 关键规则（照抄契约，勿简化）：
 * - 脏 section 抢时间戳 `max(now, base.at+1, remote.at+1)`（[UserdataMerge.localView]）；
 * - 无基线不盲推：先 pull 建基线；用户先改动则 markPending 保证本地赢；
 * - push：GET→merge→POST upsert（`Prefer: return=representation,resolution=merge-duplicates`）；
 * - 失败保留 pend 待补发；云端 v5 → 合并后立即写回 v6（迁移幂等）。
 */
export class UserdataRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private local: UserdataLocalStore;
  private sidProvider: () => string;
  private clock: () => number;
  private config: UserdataSyncConfig;
  private owned: Set<string>;

  private lock: AsyncLock = new AsyncLock();
  private sections: Blob = {};
  private listener: ((sections: Blob) => void) | undefined = undefined;
  private debounceTimer: number = -1;
  private recovering: boolean = false;

  constructor(api: Api, local: UserdataLocalStore, sidProvider: () => string,
    clock: () => number = () => Date.now(),
    config: UserdataSyncConfig = new UserdataSyncConfig(),
    ownedSections: Set<string> = defaultOwnedSections()) {
    this.api = api;
    this.local = local;
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.config = config;
    this.owned = ownedSections;
  }

  /** 注册本机 section 变化监听（UI 刷新用）。 */
  onSectionsChanged(listener: (sections: Blob) => void): void {
    this.listener = listener;
  }

  currentSections(): Blob {
    return this.sections;
  }

  private sid(): string {
    return this.sidProvider().trim();
  }

  private emit(sections: Blob): void {
    this.sections = sections;
    if (this.listener !== undefined) {
      this.listener(sections);
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 本机变更

  /** 业务层保存本机 section 后调用：持久化 → 更新内存 → 脏检测 → 防抖推送。 */
  async updateCurrent(sections: Blob): Promise<void> {
    const normalized: Blob = UserdataV6.sectionsOf(sections);
    await this.local.writeCurrent(normalized);
    this.emit(normalized);
    await this.onLocalChanged();
  }

  /** 非阻塞通知（业务层已自行写盘时用）。 */
  touch(): void {
    this.onLocalChanged();
  }

  private async onLocalChanged(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.sid().length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    if (!(await this.local.syncEnabled())) {
      return;
    }
    const current: Blob = await this.normalizedCurrent();
    this.emit(current);
    const base: Blob | undefined = await this.local.readCache();

    if (base === undefined) {
      // 无基线：只把「与默认值不同的 section」记为待补发，并先 pull 一次建基线（防默认值覆盖云端）
      const changed: Set<string> = UserdataMerge.changedKeysVsDefaults(current, this.owned);
      if (changed.size === 0) {
        return;
      }
      await this.local.markPending(setToArray(changed));
      if (!this.recovering) {
        this.recovering = true;
        try {
          await this.pull(true);
        } finally {
          this.recovering = false;
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    const dirty: Set<string> = UserdataMerge.dirtySections(base, current, this.owned);
    if (dirty.size > 0) {
      this.schedulePush();
    }
  }

  private schedulePush(): void {
    if (this.debounceTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
    }
    this.debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.debounceTimer = -1;
      this.push(false, new Set<string>());
    }, this.config.debounceMs);
  }

  private async normalizedCurrent(): Promise<Blob> {
    const raw: Blob = await this.local.readCurrent();
    const out: Blob = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      if (!this.owned.has(key)) {
        continue;
      }
      const rawValue: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.get(raw, key);
      if (key === 'water') {
        out[key] = WaterNormalizer.normalize(rawValue);
      } else if (rawValue === null || rawValue === undefined) {
        out[key] = UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
      } else {
        out[key] = rawValue;
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 拉取

  async pull(force: boolean): Promise<UserdataPullResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sid();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return UserdataPullResult.disabled();
    }
    if (!(await this.local.syncEnabled())) {
      return UserdataPullResult.disabled();
    }
    const now: number = this.clock();
    if (!force && now - (await this.local.lastPullAt()) < this.config.ttlMs) {
      return UserdataPullResult.success(false, false, true, false);
    }

    const remoteFetch: RemoteFetch = await this.fetchRemote(sid);
    if (!remoteFetch.ok) {
      const err: ApiError = remoteFetch.error !== undefined
        ? remoteFetch.error
        : new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Parse, 0, 'parse', 'userdata 响应异常');
      return UserdataPullResult.failure(err);
    }
    const remote: Blob | undefined = remoteFetch.value;
    const wasV5: boolean = remote !== undefined && UserdataV6.numMs(JsonBlob.get(remote, 'v')) === 5;

    const base: Blob | undefined = await this.local.readCache();
    const current: Blob = await this.normalizedCurrent();
    let wasDirty: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    if (base !== undefined) {
      wasDirty = UserdataMerge.dirtySections(base, current, this.owned);
    }

    const pending: Set<string> = await this.local.pendingKeys();
    const pendFlag: boolean = await this.local.pend();
    const forceKeys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    if (pendFlag || pending.size > 0) {
      pending.forEach((key: string) => {
        forceKeys.add(key);
      });
      // 竞态加固：无基线但用户已产生改动时至少保住 power（契约 §4.3 web 同款兜底）
      if (base === undefined) {
        forceKeys.add('power');
      }
      forceKeys.delete('prefs');
    }

    const localView: Blob = UserdataMerge.localView(base, current, remote, forceKeys, now, this.owned);
    const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(remote, localView);
    const changed: boolean = this.sectionsDiffer(current, merged);

    await this.persistApplied(merged);
    await this.local.setLastPullAt(now);

    const afterCurrent: Blob = await this.normalizedCurrent();
    const dirtyAfter: Set<string> = UserdataMerge.dirtySections(merged, afterCurrent, this.owned);
    const shouldPush: boolean = wasV5 || wasDirty.size > 0 || dirtyAfter.size > 0 || pendFlag || pending.size > 0;
    if (shouldPush) {
      const pushResult: UserdataPushResult = await this.push(true, forceKeys);
      return UserdataPullResult.success(changed || wasV5, pushResult.ok() && pushResult.pushed, false, wasV5);
    }
    return UserdataPullResult.success(changed, false, false, false);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 推送

  async push(force: boolean, forceKeys: Set<string>): Promise<UserdataPushResult> {
    const sid: string = this.sid();
    if (sid.length === 0) {
      return UserdataPushResult.disabled();
    }
    if (!(await this.local.syncEnabled())) {
      return UserdataPushResult.disabled();
    }
    if (this.clock() < (await this.local.holdUntil())) {
      return UserdataPushResult.held();
    }
    return await this.lock.run<UserdataPushResult>(async () => {
      const base: Blob | undefined = await this.local.readCache();
      if (base === undefined && !force && forceKeys.size === 0) {
        return UserdataPushResult.skipped();
      }

      const remoteFetch: RemoteFetch = await this.fetchRemote(sid);
      if (!remoteFetch.ok) {
        await this.local.setPend(true);
        const err: ApiError = remoteFetch.error !== undefined
          ? remoteFetch.error
          : new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Parse, 0, 'parse', 'userdata 响应异常');
        return UserdataPushResult.failure(err);
      }
      const remote: Blob | undefined = remoteFetch.value;

      const now: number = this.clock();
      const current: Blob = await this.normalizedCurrent();
      const localView: Blob = UserdataMerge.localView(base, current, remote, forceKeys, now, this.owned);
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(remote, localView);
      const remoteNormalized: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(remote, undefined);
      const mustWrite: boolean = force || remote === undefined || !JsonBlob.deepEqual(merged, remoteNormalized);

      if (!mustWrite) {
        await this.persistApplied(merged);
        await this.local.clearPending();
        return UserdataPushResult.success(false);
      }

      const row: Blob = { 'id': sid, 'blob': UserdataV6.encode(merged), 'ts': now };
      const bodyRows: Object[] = [row];
      const body: string = JSON.stringify(bodyRows);
      const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post(USERDATA_PATH, body, UPSERT_PREFER, true);
      if (!result.ok) {
        const dirty: Set<string> = base !== undefined
          ? UserdataMerge.dirtySections(base, current, this.owned)
          : new Set<string>();
        await this.local.markPending(setToArray(forceKeys.size > 0 ? forceKeys : dirty));
        await this.local.setPend(true);
        const err: ApiError = result.error !== undefined
          ? result.error
          : new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', '网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试');
        Log.w(TAG, '推送 userdata 失败：' + err.kind);
        return UserdataPushResult.failure(err);
      }
      await this.persistApplied(merged);
      await this.local.clearPending();
      return UserdataPushResult.success(true);
    });
  }

  /** 立即冲刷待推送（页面隐藏/退出前）。 */
  async flush(): Promise<UserdataPushResult> {
    if (this.debounceTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
      this.debounceTimer = -1;
    }
    if (this.sid().length === 0) {
      return UserdataPushResult.disabled();
    }
    const base: Blob | undefined = await this.local.readCache();
    const current: Blob = await this.normalizedCurrent();
    const dirty: Set<string> = base !== undefined
      ? UserdataMerge.dirtySections(base, current, this.owned)
      : new Set<string>();
    const pendFlag: boolean = await this.local.pend();
    if (!pendFlag && dirty.size === 0) {
      return UserdataPushResult.skipped();
    }
    // web 同款特例：power 变更时强制带上 power（选完宿舍立刻退出也不丢）
    const forceKeys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    if (dirty.has('power')) {
      forceKeys.add('power');
    }
    return await this.push(true, forceKeys);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 开关 / 恢复

  async setSyncEnabled(enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    await this.local.setSyncEnabled(enabled);
    if (!enabled) {
      if (this.debounceTimer >= 0) {
        clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
        this.debounceTimer = -1;
      }
      return;
    }
    // 恢复：先补推待发，再拉一次（契约 §4.3）
    if (await this.local.pend()) {
      await this.push(true, new Set<string>());
    } else {
      await this.pull(true);
    }
  }

  async syncEnabled(): Promise<boolean> {
    return await this.local.syncEnabled();
  }

  /** 最近一次成功合并的基线 blob（调试/清除云端用）。 */
  async cachedBlob(): Promise<Blob | undefined> {
    return await this.local.readCache();
  }

  /** 退出登录/切换账号：清空本 sid 的本机数据桶（合规要求，与安卓一致）。 */
  async clearLocal(): Promise<void> {
    await this.local.clear();
    this.sections = {};
    if (this.debounceTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
      this.debounceTimer = -1;
    }
    if (this.listener !== undefined) {
      this.listener({});
    }
  }

  /** 从本机持久化的 current 恢复内存镜像（登录/启动时、pull 之前调用）。 */
  async hydrateFromLocal(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.sid().length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    if (JsonBlob.keys(this.sections).length > 0) {
      return;
    }
    const stored: Blob = await this.local.readCurrent();
    if (JsonBlob.keys(stored).length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.emit(UserdataV6.sectionsOf(stored));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 内部

  private async persistApplied(merged: Blob): Promise<void> {
    const sections: Blob = UserdataV6.sectionsOf(merged);
    await this.local.writeCache(merged);
    await this.local.writeCurrent(sections);
    this.emit(sections);
  }

  private async fetchRemote(sid: string): Promise<RemoteFetch> {
    const path: string = USERDATA_PATH + '?select=*&id=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(sid);
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.get(path, true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return new RemoteFetch(false, undefined, result.error);
    }
    const parsed: JsonValue | undefined = tryParse(result.value);
    if (parsed === undefined) {
      return new RemoteFetch(false, undefined,
        new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Parse, 0, 'parse', 'userdata 响应不是合法 JSON'));
    }
    const rows: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
    if (rows === undefined) {
      // 非数组（例如空响应）视为「云端无数据」，不覆盖本机
      return new RemoteFetch(true, undefined, undefined);
    }
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return new RemoteFetch(true, undefined, undefined);
    }
    const row: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(rows[0]);
    if (row === undefined) {
      return new RemoteFetch(true, undefined, undefined);
    }
    const blobText: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(row, 'blob'), '');
    const blob: Blob | undefined = UserdataV6.decode(blobText);
    return new RemoteFetch(true, blob, undefined);
  }

  private sectionsDiffer(current: Blob, merged: Blob): boolean {
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      if (!this.owned.has(key)) {
        continue;
      }
      const currentRaw: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.get(current, key);
      const currentValue: JsonValue = currentRaw !== null && currentRaw !== undefined
        ? currentRaw
        : UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
      if (!JsonBlob.deepEqual(currentValue, JsonBlob.get(merged, key))) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
}

function tryParse(text: string): JsonValue | undefined {
  if (text.length === 0) {
    return undefined;
  }
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text) as JsonValue;
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
}

export function setToArray(set: Set<string>): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  set.forEach((value: string) => {
    out.push(value);
  });
  return out;
}

export function defaultOwnedSections(): Set<string> {
  const set: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
    set.add(UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i]);
  }
  return set;
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from './JsonBlob';

/**
 * `userdata` v6 blob 结构与默认值（契约：BACKEND_CONTRACT.md §4 + mp `utils/privacy.js` DEFAULTS）。
 *
 * 顶层 14 键固定顺序：`v, at, homeTools, fit, draw, group, roster, hide, tt, prefs, nick, power, water, homeToolsAt`。
 * 11 个 section 的顺序即合并输出顺序，必须与 web `UD_KEYS` / mp `SECTION_KEYS` / `merge_ref.js` 完全一致。
 */
export class UserdataV6 {
  static readonly VERSION: number = 6;

  static readonly SECTION_KEYS: string[] = [
    'homeTools', 'fit', 'draw', 'group', 'roster', 'hide', 'tt', 'prefs', 'nick', 'power', 'water'
  ];

  static readonly TOP_LEVEL_KEYS: string[] = [
    'v', 'at', 'homeTools', 'fit', 'draw', 'group', 'roster', 'hide', 'tt', 'prefs', 'nick', 'power', 'water',
    'homeToolsAt'
  ];

  /** 某 section 的默认值（与 merge_ref.js DEFAULTS 逐字段一致）。 */
  static defaultSection(key: string): JsonValue {
    if (key === 'homeTools') {
      const arr: Object[] = [];
      return arr;
    }
    if (key === 'fit' || key === 'group') {
      const empty: Blob = {};
      return empty;
    }
    if (key === 'draw') {
      // 2026-11-12 抽签升级 v1：draw section 内新增 names 字段（空 = 未设置），不新增顶层键
      const draw: Blob = { 'names': '' };
      return draw;
    }
    if (key === 'roster') {
      const rosterSel: Object[] = [];
      const rollSel: Object[] = [];
      const rollSt: Blob = {};
      const roster: Blob = {
        'rosterSel': rosterSel,
        'rollSel': rollSel,
        'rollSt': rollSt,
        'rollNames': ''
      };
      return roster;
    }
    if (key === 'hide') {
      const hwHide: Blob = {};
      const ntHide: Blob = {};
      const hide: Blob = { 'hwHide': hwHide, 'ntHide': ntHide };
      return hide;
    }
    if (key === 'tt') {
      const tt: Blob = { 'ttView': '', 'ttUseMine': false, 'ttLocal': null, 'termStart': '' };
      return tt;
    }
    if (key === 'prefs') {
      const hwRemind: Blob = {};
      const prefs: Blob = { 'hwRemind': hwRemind, 'ntSub': false, 'ntSubAt': 0 };
      return prefs;
    }
    if (key === 'nick') {
      return '';
    }
    if (key === 'power') {
      const power: Blob = { 'sel': '', 'at': 0, 'low': 30 };
      return power;
    }
    if (key === 'water') {
      const rooms: Blob = {};
      const water: Blob = { 'rooms': rooms };
      return water;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** 空 v6 blob（等价 mp `privacy.emptyV6()`：清除云端副本/初始化基线用）。 */
  static empty(): Blob {
    const at: Blob = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      at[UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i]] = 0;
    }
    const out: Blob = {};
    out['v'] = UserdataV6.VERSION;
    out['at'] = at;
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      out[key] = UserdataV6.defaultSection(key);
    }
    out['homeToolsAt'] = 0;
    return out;
  }

  static emptyBlobText(): string {
    return JsonBlob.encode(UserdataV6.empty());
  }

  /** 坏 JSON / 非对象 → undefined（视为无云端数据，不覆盖本机）。 */
  static decode(text: string | undefined): Blob | undefined {
    if (text === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return JsonBlob.parse(text);
  }

  static encode(blob: Blob): string {
    return JsonBlob.encode(blob);
  }

  /** 只保留 11 个 section 的值（去掉 v/at/homeToolsAt）。 */
  static sectionsOf(blob: Blob | undefined): Blob {
    const out: Blob = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i];
      const value: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.get(blob, key);
      if (value !== undefined) {
        out[key] = value;
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  static atMap(blob: Blob | undefined): Blob {
    const at: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'at'));
    return at !== undefined ? at : {};
  }

  static atValue(blob: Blob | undefined, key: string): number {
    return JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(UserdataV6.atMap(blob), key));
  }

  static numMs(value: JsonValue | undefined): number {
    return JsonBlob.numMs(value);
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from './JsonBlob';

/**
 * `water` section 归一化（契约：`_water_contract.md` §7.1 + `USERDATA_V6.md` §1.3）。
 *
 * 结构：`{ "rooms": { "<roomverify>": { "p": 4|6, "recs": [ {"m":"YYYY-MM","r":<吨>,"ts":<ms>} ] } } }`
 * 规则：p 只允许 4/6；月份合法 `YYYY-MM`；读数有限且 ≥0、保留 2 位；按月唯一升序；≤120 条；坏房间丢弃。
 */
export class WaterNormalizer {
  static readonly MAX_RECORDS: number = 120;
  static readonly PERSONS_DEFAULT: number = 4;

  static normalize(section: JsonValue | undefined): Blob {
    const sectionBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(section);
    const roomsElement: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(sectionBlob, 'rooms'));
    const rooms: Blob = {};
    if (roomsElement !== undefined) {
      const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(roomsElement);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        const roomVerify: string = keys[i];
        if (roomVerify.trim().length === 0) {
          continue;
        }
        const room: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(roomsElement[roomVerify]);
        if (room === undefined) {
          continue;
        }
        const pRaw: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(room, 'p'), WaterNormalizer.PERSONS_DEFAULT);
        const persons: number = pRaw === 6 ? 6 : WaterNormalizer.PERSONS_DEFAULT;
        const recs: Object[] = WaterNormalizer.normalizeRecords(JsonBlob.get(room, 'recs'));
        const roomOut: Blob = { 'p': persons, 'recs': recs };
        rooms[roomVerify] = roomOut;
      }
    }
    const out: Blob = { 'rooms': rooms };
    return out;
  }

  /** 归一记录列表（同月后者覆盖；按月升序；最多 120 条保留最新月份）。 */
  static normalizeRecords(input: JsonValue | undefined): Object[] {
    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(input);
    if (array === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    const byMonth: Map<string, Blob> = new Map<string, Blob>();
    for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
      const record: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
      if (record === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const month: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(record, 'm'), '');
      if (!WaterNormalizer.isValidMonth(month)) {
        continue;
      }
      const reading: number = WaterNormalizer.readingOf(JsonBlob.get(record, 'r'));
      if (!Number.isFinite(reading) || reading < 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const ts: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(record, 'ts'), 0);
      const rounded: number = WaterNormalizer.round2(reading);
      // 与网页 `Math.round(r*100)/100` 的数字形态一致：整数读数输出 80 而不是 80.0
      const readingValue: JsonValue = WaterNormalizer.isInteger(rounded) ? Math.round(rounded) : rounded;
      const row: Blob = { 'm': month, 'r': readingValue, 'ts': ts };
      byMonth.set(month, row);
    }
    const months: string[] = [];
    byMonth.forEach((value: Blob, key: string) => {
      months.push(key);
    });
    months.sort();
    let selected: string[] = months;
    if (months.length > WaterNormalizer.MAX_RECORDS) {
      selected = months.slice(months.length - WaterNormalizer.MAX_RECORDS);
    }
    const out: Object[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < selected.length; i++) {
      const row: Blob | undefined = byMonth.get(selected[i]);
      if (row !== undefined) {
        out.push(row);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 读数保留 2 位小数（与网页 `Math.round(r*100)/100` 一致）。 */
  static round2(value: number): number {
    return Math.round(value * 100) / 100;
  }

  private static readingOf(value: JsonValue | undefined): number {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return Number.NaN;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      return value as number;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      const parsed: number = Number(value as string);
      return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : Number.NaN;
    }
    return Number.NaN;
  }

  private static isValidMonth(month: string): boolean {
    if (month.length !== 7) {
      return false;
    }
    if (month.charAt(4) !== '-') {
      return false;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      if (i === 4) {
        continue;
      }
      const c: number = month.charCodeAt(i);
      if (c < 48 || c > 57) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    const mm: number = Number(month.substring(5, 7));
    return mm >= 1 && mm <= 12;
  }

  private static isInteger(value: number): boolean {
    return Math.abs(value - Math.round(value)) < 1e-9;
  }
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { TtParser, TtSnapshot } from './TimetableModels';

const ENQUEUE_PATH: string = 'rpc/tt_login_enqueue';
const STATUS_PATH: string = 'rpc/tt_login_status';

export class TtLoginEnqueue {
  ok: boolean = false;
  jobId: string = '';
  reused: boolean = false;
  message: string = '';
}

export class TtLoginStatus {
  ok: boolean = false;
  status: string = '';
  finished: boolean = false;
  error: string = '';
  snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined = undefined;
  raw: Blob | undefined = undefined;
  message: string = '';
}

/**
 * 教务登录任务（契约 §1：enqueue/status 是客户端唯一入口；密码只出现在 enqueue 的 POST body 里，
 * 不落盘、不打印、不进入任何返回值）。登录成功后由调用方写 `userdata.tt.ttLocal`。
 */
export class TimetableLoginRepository {
  private api: Api;

  constructor(api: Api) {
    this.api = api;
  }

  async enqueue(password: string): Promise<TtLoginEnqueue> {
    const result: TtLoginEnqueue = new TtLoginEnqueue();
    if (password.length === 0) {
      result.message = '请输入教务密码';
      return result;
    }
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['p_pwd'] = password;
    body['p_platform'] = 'android';
    const response: ApiResult = await this.api.post(ENQUEUE_PATH, JSON.stringify(body), '', true);
    if (!response.ok) {
      result.message = response.error !== undefined ? response.error.displayMessage() : '登录任务提交失败';
      return result;
    }
    const parsed: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(response.value);
    if (parsed === undefined) {
      result.message = '响应无法解析';
      return result;
    }
    result.ok = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'ok'), false);
    result.jobId = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'job_id'), '');
    result.reused = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'reused'), false);
    if (!result.ok || result.jobId.length === 0) {
      result.message = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'reason'), '登录任务被拒绝');
    }
    return result;
  }

  async status(jobId: string): Promise<TtLoginStatus> {
    const result: TtLoginStatus = new TtLoginStatus();
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['p_id'] = jobId;
    const response: ApiResult = await this.api.post(STATUS_PATH, JSON.stringify(body), '', true);
    if (!response.ok) {
      result.message = response.error !== undefined ? response.error.displayMessage() : '状态查询失败';
      return result;
    }
    const raw: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(response.value);
    if (raw === undefined) {
      result.message = '响应无法解析';
      return result;
    }
    result.ok = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(raw, 'ok'), false);
    result.status = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(raw, 'status'), '');
    result.finished = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(raw, 'finished'), false);
    result.error = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(raw, 'error'), '');
    const tt: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(raw, 'result'));
    if (tt !== undefined) {
      result.snapshot = TtParser.parseSnapshot(JSON.stringify(tt));
      result.raw = tt;
    }
    if (!result.ok) {
      result.message = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(raw, 'reason'), '状态查询被拒绝');
    }
    return result;
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';

/** 一门课（day 0=周一；start/end 为节次 1..12）。 */
export class Course {
  name: string = '';
  teacher: string = '';
  room: string = '';
  day: number = 0;
  start: number = 1;
  end: number = 1;
  /** 周次表达式，如 "1-16,18"；空 = 全学期。 */
  weeks: string = '';
  /** all | odd | even（单双周）。 */
  parity: string = 'all';
}

/** 课表快照：`c` 课程数组 + `t` 开学日 + 可选 `meta`。 */
export class TtSnapshot {
  c: Course[] = [];
  t: string = '';
  termStartMeta: string = '';

  /** 开学日解析优先级：meta.termStart → t。 */
  termStart(): string {
    return this.termStartMeta.trim().length > 0 ? this.termStartMeta.trim() : this.t.trim();
  }
}

/** 节次时间表（12 节固定，与小程序 PERIODS 一致）。 */
export class TtPeriods {
  static readonly PERIODS: string[][] = [
    ['08:10', '08:55'],
    ['08:55', '09:40'],
    ['09:50', '10:30'],
    ['10:40', '11:25'],
    ['11:25', '12:10'],
    ['14:30', '15:15'],
    ['15:15', '16:00'],
    ['16:10', '16:55'],
    ['16:55', '17:40'],
    ['19:00', '19:45'],
    ['19:45', '20:30'],
    ['20:30', '21:20']
  ];

  static readonly DAY_LABELS: string[] = ['周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六', '周日'];

  static startText(period: number): string {
    return period >= 1 && period <= TtPeriods.PERIODS.length ? TtPeriods.PERIODS[period - 1][0] : '';
  }

  static endText(period: number): string {
    return period >= 1 && period <= TtPeriods.PERIODS.length ? TtPeriods.PERIODS[period - 1][1] : '';
  }
}

export enum SessionState {
  NEXT = 'next',
  ONGOING = 'ongoing',
  DONE = 'done'
}

export enum TodayState {
  NODATA = 'nodata',
  NONE = 'none',
  HAS = 'has',
  DONE = 'done'
}

/** 一次课程占用（今日课程/下一节/日视图）。 */
export class SessionInfo {
  name: string = '';
  room: string = '';
  start: number = 1;
  end: number = 1;
  startText: string = '';
  endText: string = '';
  span: string = '';
  startAt: number = 0;
  endAt: number = 0;
  state: SessionState = SessionState.NEXT;
  dayOffset: number = 0;
  dayText: string = '';
  dateText: string = '';
}

/** 课表页/工作台共用计算产物。 */
export class TtPlan {

  week: number | undefined = undefined;

  next: SessionInfo | undefined = undefined;
}

/** 解析课表快照（`body` 可能是对象或 JSON 字符串）。 */
export class TtParser {
  static parseSnapshot(body: string): TtSnapshot | undefined {
    if (body.trim().length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    let parsed: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(body);
    if (parsed === undefined) {
      // body 可能是「JSON 字符串里再套 JSON」
      const inner: string = body.trim();
      if (inner.indexOf('"c"') >= 0) {
        return undefined;
      }
      return undefined;
    }
    const snapshot: TtSnapshot = new TtSnapshot();
    snapshot.t = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 't'), '');
    const meta: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'meta'));
    if (meta !== undefined) {
      snapshot.termStartMeta = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(meta, 'termStart'), '');
    }
    const courses: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(parsed, 'c'));
    if (courses !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < courses.length; i++) {
        const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(courses[i]);
        if (obj === undefined) {
          continue;
        }
        const course: Course = new Course();
        course.name = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'name'), '');
        course.teacher = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'teacher'), '');
        course.room = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'room'), '');
        course.day = Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'day'), 0));
        course.start = Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'start'), 1));
        course.end = Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'end'), 1));
        course.weeks = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'weeks'), '');
        course.parity = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'parity'), 'all');
        if (course.day >= 0 && course.day <= 6 && course.start >= 1 && course.end >= course.start) {
          snapshot.c.push(course);
        }
      }
    }
    return snapshot;
  }

  /** `site_assets` 行的 body（jsonb 可能是对象，也可能是字符串）。 */
  static bodyOf(row: Blob): string {
    const body = JsonBlob.get(row, 'body');
    if (body === null || body === undefined) {
      return '';
    }
    if (typeof body === 'string') {
      return body as string;
    }
    return JSON.stringify(body);
  }
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { TtParser, TtSnapshot } from './TimetableModels';

const TT_PATH: string = 'site_assets?select=*&id=eq.tt';
const DEFAULT_TTL_MS: number = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export enum TtSource {
  PERSONAL = 'personal',
  PUBLIC = 'public',
  CACHE = 'cache'
}

export class TtResult {
  ok: boolean;
  snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined = undefined;
  fromCache: boolean = false;
  source: TtSource = TtSource.PUBLIC;
  message: string = '';

  constructor(ok: boolean, snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined, fromCache: boolean, source: TtSource, message: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.snapshot = snapshot;
    this.fromCache = fromCache;
    this.source = source;
    this.message = message;
  }
}

/**
 * 课表仓库（契约 ENDPOINTS E24）：
 *
 * 1. 个人课表优先：`userdata.tt.ttUseMine === true` 且 `ttLocal` 有课程 → 直接用（PERSONAL）；
 * 2. 否则读公共快照 `site_assets?id=eq.tt`（body 可能是 jsonb 对象或 JSON 字符串）；
 * 3. 6 小时 TTL；网络失败回落缓存。
 */
export class TimetableRepository {
  private api: Api;
  private clock: () => number;
  private ttlMs: number;
  private personalProvider: () => Blob | undefined;

  private cache: TtSnapshot | undefined = undefined;
  private cachedAt: number = 0;
  private loaded: boolean = false;

  constructor(api: Api, personalProvider: () => Blob | undefined = () => undefined,
    clock: () => number = () => Date.now(), ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MS) {
    this.api = api;
    this.personalProvider = personalProvider;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
  }

  async load(force: boolean): Promise<TtResult> {
    const now: number = this.clock();
    const personal: TtSnapshot | undefined = this.personalSnapshot();
    if (personal !== undefined && personal.c.length > 0) {
      return new TtResult(true, personal, true, TtSource.PERSONAL, '');
    }
    if (!force && this.loaded && now - this.cachedAt < this.ttlMs && this.cache !== undefined) {
      return new TtResult(true, this.cache, true, TtSource.CACHE, '');
    }
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.get(TT_PATH, true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      if (this.cache !== undefined) {
        return new TtResult(true, this.cache, true, TtSource.CACHE,
          result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '课表加载失败');
      }
      return new TtResult(false, undefined, false, TtSource.PUBLIC,
        result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '课表加载失败');
    }
    const snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined = TimetableRepository.parseSiteAsset(result.value);
    if (snapshot === undefined || snapshot.c.length === 0) {
      if (this.cache !== undefined) {
        return new TtResult(true, this.cache, true, TtSource.CACHE, '课表为空');
      }
      return new TtResult(false, undefined, false, TtSource.PUBLIC, '暂无课表数据');
    }
    this.cache = snapshot;
    this.cachedAt = now;
    this.loaded = true;
    return new TtResult(true, snapshot, false, TtSource.PUBLIC, '');
  }

  local(): TtSnapshot | undefined {
    return this.cache;
  }

  /** `site_assets` 响应（数组，取第一行 body）。 */
  static parseSiteAsset(raw: string): TtSnapshot | undefined {
    if (raw.trim().length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    let parsed: Object | null = null;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Object;
    } catch (e) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const rows: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(parsed);
    if (rows === undefined || rows.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const row: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(rows[0]);
    if (row === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const body: string = TtParser.bodyOf(row);
    return TtParser.parseSnapshot(body);
  }

  /** 个人课表（`userdata.tt` 的 ttUseMine + ttLocal）。 */
  private personalSnapshot(): TtSnapshot | undefined {
    const tt: Blob | undefined = this.personalProvider();
    if (tt === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (!JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(tt, 'ttUseMine'), false)) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const local = JsonBlob.get(tt, 'ttLocal');
    if (local === null || local === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const text: string = typeof local === 'string' ? local as string : JSON.stringify(local);
    return TtParser.parseSnapshot(text);
  }
}
import { Course, SessionInfo, SessionState, TodayState, TtPeriods, TtPlan, TtSnapshot } from './TimetableModels';

const DAY_MS: number = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * 课表日历纯函数（与小程序 `utils/ttplan.js` 同口径）。
 *
 * - 周次：`floor(days(today - termStart)/7) + 1`（开学当周为第 1 周；开学前 undefined）；
 * - 上课判定：`weeks` 空 = 全学期；非空需包含该周；再按 parity 过滤单双周；
 * - 下一节：今天起 14 天内按真实时间找最近一节。
 */
export class TtCalendar {
  /** 解析开学日（容忍前 10 位是 YYYY-MM-DD 的 ISO 字符串）。 */
  static parseTermStart(raw: string): Date | undefined {
    const text: string = raw.trim();
    if (text.length < 10) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const match: RegExpMatchArray | null = text.substring(0, 10).match(new RegExp('^(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})$'));
    if (match === null) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const year: number = Number(match[1]);
    const month: number = Number(match[2]);
    const day: number = Number(match[3]);
    if (month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > 31) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return new Date(year, month - 1, day, 0, 0, 0);
  }

  /** 解析周次表达式："1-16,18"（容忍中文逗号/顿号/空格；非法 token 忽略）。 */
  static parseWeeks(spec: string): Set<number> {
    const out: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
    const text: string = spec.trim();
    if (text.length === 0) {
      return out;
    }
    const tokens: string[] = text.split(new RegExp('[,，;；\\s]+'));
    for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
      const token: string = tokens[i].trim();
      if (token.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const dash: number = token.indexOf('-');
      if (dash > 0 && dash < token.length - 1) {
        const a: number = Number(token.substring(0, dash).trim());
        const b: number = Number(token.substring(dash + 1).trim());
        if (Number.isFinite(a) && Number.isFinite(b)) {
          const lo: number = Math.min(a, b);
          const hi: number = Math.max(a, b);
          for (let w = lo; w <= hi; w++) {
            if (w >= 1 && w <= 60) {
              out.add(w);
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        const w: number = Number(token);
        if (Number.isFinite(w) && w >= 1 && w <= 60) {
          out.add(w);
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 本地日期 → epoch day（避免时区偏移）。 */
  static epochDay(date: Date): number {
    return Math.floor(Date.UTC(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()) / DAY_MS);
  }

  /** 指定日期属于第几周（开学当周=1；开学前/开学日无效 → undefined）。 */
  static weekOf(termStart: Date | undefined, date: Date): number | undefined {
    if (termStart === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const diffDays: number = TtCalendar.epochDay(date) - TtCalendar.epochDay(termStart);
    const week: number = Math.floor(diffDays / 7) + 1;
    return week > 0 ? week : undefined;
  }

  /** 某门课在第 week 周是否上课（undefined 视为不按周过滤）。 */
  static isActive(course: Course, week: number | undefined): boolean {
    if (week === undefined) {
      return true;
    }
    const weeks: Set<number> = TtCalendar.parseWeeks(course.weeks);
    if (weeks.size > 0 && !weeks.has(week)) {
      return false;
    }
    if (course.parity === 'odd') {
      return week % 2 === 1;
    }
    if (course.parity === 'even') {
      return week % 2 === 0;
    }
    return true;
  }

  /** 星期索引：0=周一 … 6=周日。 */
  static dayIndex(date: Date): number {
    return (date.getDay() + 6) % 7;
  }

  /** 教室短标识：优先取房间号（如「自强楼(教室01105)」→ "01105"）。 */
  static roomShort(room: string): string {
    const s: string = room.trim();
    if (s.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    if (s.length <= 7) {
      return s;
    }
    const numberMatch: RegExpMatchArray | null = s.match(new RegExp('\\d{3,6}'));
    if (numberMatch !== null) {
      return numberMatch[0];
    }
    const rangeMatch: RegExpMatchArray | null = s.match(new RegExp('\\d+-\\d+'));
    if (rangeMatch !== null) {
      return rangeMatch[0];
    }
    return s.substring(0, 7) + '…';
  }

  /** 节次跨度文案：`1-2 节` / `3 节`。 */
  static spanText(start: number, end: number): string {
    return start === end ? start + ' 节' : start + '-' + end + ' 节';
  }

  /** 指定日期的课程（未过滤时间，供周视图渲染）。 */
  static coursesOn(courses: Course[], termStart: Date | undefined, date: Date): Course[] {
    const week: number | undefined = TtCalendar.weekOf(termStart, date);
    const dayIdx: number = TtCalendar.dayIndex(date);
    const out: Course[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < courses.length; i++) {
      const course: Course = courses[i];
      if (course.day !== dayIdx) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!TtCalendar.isActive(course, week)) {
        continue;
      }
      if (course.start < 1 || course.end > TtPeriods.PERIODS.length || course.end < course.start) {
        continue;
      }
      out.push(course);
    }
    out.sort((a: Course, b: Course) => a.start - b.start);
    return out;
  }

  /** 指定日期的全部课程占用（按开始时间排序）。 */
  static sessionsOn(courses: Course[], termStart: Date | undefined, date: Date, nowMillis: number): SessionInfo[] {
    const week: number | undefined = TtCalendar.weekOf(termStart, date);
    const dayIdx: number = TtCalendar.dayIndex(date);
    const out: SessionInfo[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < courses.length; i++) {
      const course: Course = courses[i];
      if (course.day !== dayIdx) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!TtCalendar.isActive(course, week)) {
        continue;
      }
      if (course.start < 1 || course.start > TtPeriods.PERIODS.length
        || course.end < 1 || course.end > TtPeriods.PERIODS.length) {
        continue;
      }
      const startText: string = TtPeriods.startText(course.start);
      const endText: string = TtPeriods.endText(course.end);
      const startAt: number = TtCalendar.at(date, startText);
      const endAt: number = TtCalendar.at(date, endText);
      if (startAt <= 0 || endAt <= 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const session: SessionInfo = new SessionInfo();
      session.name = course.name.trim().length > 0 ? course.name : '课程';
      session.room = TtCalendar.roomShort(course.room);
      session.start = course.start;
      session.end = course.end;
      session.startText = startText;
      session.endText = endText;
      session.span = TtCalendar.spanText(course.start, course.end);
      session.startAt = startAt;
      session.endAt = endAt;
      if (nowMillis >= endAt) {
        session.state = SessionState.DONE;
      } else if (nowMillis >= startAt) {
        session.state = SessionState.ONGOING;
      } else {
        session.state = SessionState.NEXT;
      }
      out.push(session);
    }
    out.sort((a: SessionInfo, b: SessionInfo) => a.startAt - b.startAt);
    return out;
  }

  /** 今天起 lookAheadDays 天内最近一节未结束的课。 */
  static nextSession(courses: Course[], termStart: Date | undefined, nowMillis: number,
    lookAheadDays: number): SessionInfo | undefined {
    const today: Date = new Date(nowMillis);
    for (let offset = 0; offset <= lookAheadDays; offset++) {
      const date: Date = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, 0, 0, 0);
      const sessions: SessionInfo[] = TtCalendar.sessionsOn(courses, termStart, date, nowMillis);
      for (let i = 0; i < sessions.length; i++) {
        const session: SessionInfo = sessions[i];
        if (session.startAt <= nowMillis) {
          continue;
        }
        session.dayOffset = offset;
        session.dayText = offset === 0 ? '今天' : (offset === 1 ? '明天' : TtPeriods.DAY_LABELS[TtCalendar.dayIndex(date)]);
        session.dateText = (date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + date.getDate();
        return session;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  /** 课表页计算产物（今日课程 + 今日状态 + 下一节 + 当前周）。 */
  static plan(snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined, nowMillis: number): TtPlan {
    const plan: TtPlan = new TtPlan();
    if (snapshot === undefined || snapshot.c.length === 0) {
      plan.hasData = false;
      plan.todayState = TodayState.NODATA;
      return plan;
    }
    plan.hasData = true;
    const termStart: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(snapshot.termStart());
    const today: Date = new Date(nowMillis);
    plan.week = TtCalendar.weekOf(termStart, today);
    plan.today = TtCalendar.sessionsOn(snapshot.c, termStart, today, nowMillis);
    plan.next = TtCalendar.nextSession(snapshot.c, termStart, nowMillis, 14);
    if (plan.today.length === 0) {
      plan.todayState = TodayState.NONE;
    } else {
      let hasOngoingOrNext: boolean = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < plan.today.length; i++) {
        if (plan.today[i].state !== SessionState.DONE) {
          hasOngoingOrNext = true;
        }
      }
      plan.todayState = hasOngoingOrNext ? TodayState.HAS : TodayState.DONE;
    }
    return plan;
  }

  /** 指定日期 + `HH:MM` → epoch ms。 */
  static at(date: Date, hhmm: string): number {
    const match: RegExpMatchArray | null = hhmm.match(new RegExp('^(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})$'));
    if (match === null) {
      return 0;
    }
    const hour: number = Number(match[1]);
    const minute: number = Number(match[2]);
    return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate(), hour, minute, 0).getTime();
  }

  /** 第 N 周的周一日期（用于周视图）。 */
  static mondayOfWeek(termStart: Date, week: number): Date {
    return new Date(termStart.getFullYear(), termStart.getMonth(), termStart.getDate() + (week - 1) * 7, 0, 0, 0);
  }
}

  id: string = '';
  name: string = '';
  /** 图标字形（单字，避免依赖图标字体/图片资源）。 */

  subtitle: string = '';
  accent: string = '';
  category: ToolCategory = ToolCategory.CLASS;
  features: string[] = [];

  constructor(id: string, name: string, glyph: string, subtitle: string, accent: string,
    category: ToolCategory, features: string[]) {
    this.id = id;
    this.name = name;
    this.glyph = glyph;
    this.subtitle = subtitle;
    this.accent = accent;
    this.category = category;
    this.features = features;
  }
}
