import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';
import { preferences } from '@kit.ArkData';

const TAG: string = 'Visits';
const STORE_NAME: string = 'class_tools_visits';
const KEY_DID: string = 'visit_did';

/** 访问上报本机状态（按 sid 记录最近已上报的 slot）。 */
export interface VisitsStore {
  getSlot(sid: string): Promise<string>;

  setSlot(sid: string, slot: string): Promise<void>;

  /** 本机设备指纹（8..64 位十六进制；仅用于去重，不含个人信息）。 */
  deviceId(): Promise<string>;
}

export class InMemoryVisitsStore implements VisitsStore {
  private slots: Map<string, string> = new Map<string, string>();
  private did: string = '';

  constructor(did: string = 'a1b2c3d4e5f60718') {
    this.did = did;
  }

  async getSlot(sid: string): Promise<string> {
    const value: string | undefined = this.slots.get(sid);
    return value !== undefined ? value : '';
  }

  async setSlot(sid: string, slot: string): Promise<void> {
    this.slots.set(sid, slot);
  }

  async deviceId(): Promise<string> {
    return this.did;
  }
}

/** preferences 实现（体积小；不落任何隐私字段）。 */
export class PreferencesVisitsStore implements VisitsStore {
  private store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = undefined;

  private async ensure(): Promise<preferences.Preferences | undefined> {
    if (this.store !== undefined) {
      return this.store;
    }
    const ctx = AppGlobal.context;
    if (ctx === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    try {
      this.store = await preferences.getPreferences(ctx, { name: STORE_NAME });
      return this.store;
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '打开 visits preferences 失败');
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async getSlot(sid: string): Promise<string> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await this.ensure();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return '';
    }
    try {
      return store.getSync('slot_' + sid, '') as string;
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }

  async setSlot(sid: string, slot: string): Promise<void> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await this.ensure();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      store.putSync('slot_' + sid, slot);
      await store.flush();
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '写入 visits slot 失败');
    }
  }

  async deviceId(): Promise<string> {
    const store: preferences.Preferences | undefined = await this.ensure();
    if (store === undefined) {
      return 'unknown0000000000';
    }
    try {
      const existing: string = store.getSync(KEY_DID, '') as string;
      if (existing.length >= 8) {
        return existing;
      }
      const generated: string = randomHex16();
      store.putSync(KEY_DID, generated);
      await store.flush();
      return generated;
    } catch (e) {
      return 'unknown0000000000';
    }
  }
}

/**
 * 访问上报（与网页 `visitLog()` 同口径）：
 * - `POST visits` **不带** `Prefer: return=representation`（returning 会被 RLS 拒绝）；
 * - `id = "<sid>|<slot>|<随机6位>"`、`slot = YYYY-MM-DD-HH`；
 * - 同一 sid 同一 slot 只报一次（本机记录），失败不记，下次重试。
 */
export class VisitsReporter {
  private api: Api;
  private store: VisitsStore;
  private sidProvider: () => string;
  private nameProvider: () => string;
  private clock: () => number;

  constructor(api: Api, store: VisitsStore, sidProvider: () => string, nameProvider: () => string,
    clock: () => number = () => Date.now()) {
    this.api = api;
    this.store = store;
    this.sidProvider = sidProvider;
    this.nameProvider = nameProvider;
    this.clock = clock;
  }

  async reportOnce(): Promise<boolean> {
    const sid: string = this.sidProvider().trim();
    if (sid.length === 0 || this.nameProvider().trim().length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    const slot: string = formatSlot(new Date(this.clock()));
    const last: string = await this.store.getSlot(sid);
    if (last === slot) {
      return false;
    }
    const did: string = await this.store.deviceId();
    const random: string = randomBase36(6);
    const row: Blob = {
      'id': sid + '|' + slot + '|' + random,
      'slot': slot,
      'sid': sid,
      'name': this.nameProvider().trim(),
      'did': did,
      'ts': this.clock()
    };
    const rows: Object[] = [row];
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post('visits', JSON.stringify(rows), '', true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return false;
    }
    await this.store.setSlot(sid, slot);
    return true;
  }
}

/** `YYYY-MM-DD-HH`（本地时区，与网页 `vsSlot` 一致）。 */
export function formatSlot(date: Date): string {
  const month: string = pad2(date.getMonth() + 1);
  const day: string = pad2(date.getDate());
  const hour: string = pad2(date.getHours());
  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + month + '-' + day + '-' + hour;
}

function pad2(value: number): string {
  return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
}

function randomHex16(): string {
  let out: string = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    out += Math.floor(Math.random() * 16).toString(16);
  }
  return out;
}

function randomBase36(length: number): string {
  const chars: string = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
  let out: string = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    out += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }
  return out;
}
import { photoAccessHelper } from '@kit.MediaLibraryKit';
import { image } from '@kit.ImageKit';
import { fileIo as fs } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';
import { util } from '@kit.ArkTS';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';

const TAG: string = 'VoteImage';
const MAX_CHARS: number = 150000;
const MAX_EDGE: number = 640;

/** 投票选项配图：相册选择 → 缩放到长边 ≤640 → JPEG → data URL（≤150000 字符）。 */
export class VoteImage {
  /** 返回 data URL；空串 = 取消/失败。 */
  static async pick(): Promise<string> {
    let uri: string = '';
    try {
      const picker: photoAccessHelper.PhotoViewPicker = new photoAccessHelper.PhotoViewPicker();
      const options: photoAccessHelper.PhotoSelectOptions = new photoAccessHelper.PhotoSelectOptions();
      options.maxSelectNumber = 1;
      options.MIMEType = photoAccessHelper.PhotoViewMIMETypes.IMAGE_TYPE;
      const result: photoAccessHelper.PhotoSelectResult = await picker.select(options);
      if (result.photoUris.length === 0) {
        return '';
      }
      uri = result.photoUris[0];
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '打开相册失败');
      return '';
    }
    let file: fs.File | undefined = undefined;
    try {
      file = fs.openSync(uri, fs.OpenMode.READ_ONLY);
      const source: image.ImageSource = image.createImageSource(file.fd);
      const info: image.ImageInfo = await source.getImageInfo();
      const width: number = info.size.width;
      const height: number = info.size.height;
      const scale: number = Math.min(1, MAX_EDGE / Math.max(width, height));
      const decode: image.DecodingOptions = {
        desiredSize: {
          width: Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale)),
          height: Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale))
        }
      };
      const pixelMap: image.PixelMap = await source.createPixelMap(decode);
      const packer: image.ImagePacker = image.createImagePacker();
      const helper: util.Base64Helper = new util.Base64Helper();
      const qualities: number[] = [72, 55, 40, 28];
      for (let i = 0; i < qualities.length; i++) {
        const pack: image.PackingOption = { format: 'image/jpeg', quality: qualities[i] };
        const buffer: ArrayBuffer = await packer.packToData(pixelMap, pack);
        const base64: string = helper.encodeToStringSync(new Uint8Array(buffer));
        if (base64.length <= MAX_CHARS) {
          await pixelMap.release();
          return 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + base64;
        }
      }
      await pixelMap.release();
      return '';
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w(TAG, '压缩图片失败');
      return '';
    } finally {
      if (file !== undefined) {
        try {
          fs.closeSync(file);
        } catch (e) {
          // 忽略
        }
      }
    }
  }

  static dataUrlOf(pollOptionImage: string): string {
    if (pollOptionImage.startsWith('data:image/')) {
      return pollOptionImage;
    }
    return '';
  }
}
import {
  Poll,
  PollAudience,
  PollDraft,
  PollMode,
  PollOption,
  PollResultVisibility,
  PollSettings,
  PollSummary,
  PollVoter,
  VoteLimits
} from './VoteModels';

const MINUTE: number = 60 * 1000;

/** 投票纯逻辑（与网页/安卓同口径）。 */
export class VoteLogic {
  /** 是否已结束（状态 closed 或已过截止）。 */
  static effectiveClosed(poll: PollSummary, nowMillis: number): boolean {
    if (poll.closed || poll.status.trim().toLowerCase() === 'closed') {
      return true;
    }
    return poll.deadline > 0 && nowMillis >= poll.deadline;
  }

  /** 结果是否可见。 */
  static resultsVisible(settings: PollSettings, closed: boolean, hasVoted: boolean): boolean {
    if (settings.resultVisibility === PollResultVisibility.ALWAYS) {
      return true;
    }
    if (settings.resultVisibility === PollResultVisibility.AFTER_CLOSE) {
      return closed;
    }
    return hasVoted;
  }

  static canChangeVote(settings: PollSettings, closed: boolean, hasVoted: boolean): boolean {
    return !closed && hasVoted && settings.allowChange;
  }

  /** 不能投票的原因（'' = 可以投）。 */
  static voteBlockReason(poll: PollSummary, settings: PollSettings, closed: boolean, hasVoted: boolean): string {
    if (closed) {
      return '投票已结束';
    }
    if (hasVoted) {
      return settings.allowChange ? '' : '不可改票';
    }
    return '';
  }

  /** 选项校验（'' = 合法）。 */
  static validateChoices(settings: PollSettings, choices: string[], optionIds: string[]): string {
    if (choices.length === 0) {
      return '请至少选择 1 项';
    }
    if (!settings.multi && choices.length > 1) {
      return '单选投票只能选 1 项';
    }
    if (settings.multi && choices.length > settings.maxChoices) {
      return '最多选 ' + settings.maxChoices + ' 项';
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < choices.length; i++) {
      if (optionIds.indexOf(choices[i]) < 0) {
        return '选项无效';
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  /** 截止倒计时（deadline=0 → 0）。 */
  static countdown(deadline: number, nowMillis: number): number {
    if (deadline <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return Math.max(0, deadline - nowMillis);
  }

  static formatRemaining(millis: number): string {
    if (millis <= 0) {
      return '已截止';
    }
    const minutes: number = Math.floor(millis / MINUTE);
    if (minutes < 60) {
      const seconds: number = Math.floor((millis % MINUTE) / 1000);
      return '剩 ' + (minutes < 10 ? '0' + minutes : '' + minutes) + ':'
        + (seconds < 10 ? '0' + seconds : '' + seconds);
    }
    const hours: number = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    if (hours < 24) {
      return '剩 ' + hours + ' 小时';
    }
    const days: number = Math.floor(hours / 24);
    return '剩 ' + days + ' 天';
  }

  static deadlineText(deadline: number): string {
    return deadline > 0 ? '截止 ' + VoteLogic.formatAt(deadline) : '不限时';
  }

  static quickDeadline(nowMillis: number, minutes: number): number {
    return nowMillis + minutes * MINUTE;
  }

  static formatAt(millis: number): string {
    if (millis <= 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(millis);
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  static percent(count: number, total: number): number {
    if (total <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return Math.round(count / total * 1000) / 10;
  }

  static formatPercent(value: number): string {
    return value.toFixed(1) + '%';
  }

  /** 进行中在前、已结束按截止/创建倒序；组内按创建时间倒序。 */
  static sortPolls(polls: PollSummary[], nowMillis: number): PollSummary[] {
    const open: PollSummary[] = [];
    const closed: PollSummary[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < polls.length; i++) {
      if (VoteLogic.effectiveClosed(polls[i], nowMillis)) {
        closed.push(polls[i]);
      } else {
        open.push(polls[i]);
      }
    }
    open.sort((a: PollSummary, b: PollSummary) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
    closed.sort((a: PollSummary, b: PollSummary) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
    const out: PollSummary[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < open.length; i++) {
      out.push(open[i]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < closed.length; i++) {
      out.push(closed[i]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static filterForTab(polls: PollSummary[], showClosed: boolean, nowMillis: number): PollSummary[] {
    const sorted: PollSummary[] = VoteLogic.sortPolls(polls, nowMillis);
    const out: PollSummary[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      const closed: boolean = VoteLogic.effectiveClosed(sorted[i], nowMillis);
      if (showClosed === closed) {
        out.push(sorted[i]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 草稿校验（返回中文错误；'' = 合法）。 */
  static validateDraft(draft: PollDraft, nowMillis: number): string {
    const title: string = draft.title.trim();
    if (title.length === 0) {
      return '请填写标题';
    }
    if (draft.id.length > 0 && !VoteLogic.isPollIdValid(draft.id)) {
      return '投票编号不合法';
    }
    if (title.length > VoteLimits.MAX_TITLE) {
      return '标题不能超过 ' + VoteLimits.MAX_TITLE + ' 字';
    }
    if (draft.description.trim().length > VoteLimits.MAX_DESCRIPTION) {
      return '说明不能超过 ' + VoteLimits.MAX_DESCRIPTION + ' 字';
    }
    const texts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < draft.options.length; i++) {
      const text: string = draft.options[i].text.trim();
      if (text.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      if (text.length > VoteLimits.MAX_OPTION_TEXT) {
        return '选项不能超过 ' + VoteLimits.MAX_OPTION_TEXT + ' 字';
      }
      texts.push(text);
    }
    if (texts.length < VoteLimits.MIN_OPTIONS) {
      return '至少需要 ' + VoteLimits.MIN_OPTIONS + ' 个选项';
    }
    if (texts.length > VoteLimits.MAX_OPTIONS) {
      return '最多 ' + VoteLimits.MAX_OPTIONS + ' 个选项';
    }
    let imageChars: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < draft.options.length; i++) {
      const img: string = draft.options[i].img;
      if (img.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!img.startsWith('data:image/')) {
        return '选项配图格式不支持';
      }
      if (img.length > 150000) {
        return '单张配图过大（≤150000 字符）';
      }
      imageChars += img.length;
    }
    if (imageChars > 1600000) {
      return '配图总大小超限（≤1.6MB）';
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < texts.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < texts.length; j++) {
        if (texts[i] === texts[j]) {
          return '选项不能重复';
        }
      }
    }
    if (draft.deadline > 0 && draft.deadline <= nowMillis) {
      return '截止时间需晚于现在';
    }
    return '';
  }

  /** 生成投票 id（`poll_<ts>_<rand>`）。 */
  /** 服务端编号规则：`^p[a-z0-9]{4,32}$`。 */
  static isPollIdValid(id: string): boolean {
    return new RegExp('^p[a-z0-9]{4,32}$').test(id.trim());
  }

  /** 指定成员座号归一：1..70、去重、升序。 */
  static normalizeSeats(seats: number[]): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < seats.length; i++) {
      const seat: number = Math.round(seats[i]);
      if (seat >= 1 && seat <= 70 && out.indexOf(seat) < 0) {
        out.push(seat);
      }
    }
    out.sort((a: number, b: number) => a - b);
    return out;
  }

  /** 可见范围校验：custom 至少 1 人（'' = 合法）。 */
  static validateAudience(audience: string, seats: number[]): string {
    if (audience === 'custom' && VoteLogic.normalizeSeats(seats).length === 0) {
      return '指定成员至少选 1 人';
    }
    return '';
  }

  /** 生成投票 id（`p` + base36(时间) + 随机后缀，≤33）。 */
  static newPollId(nowMillis: number): string {
    return ('p' + nowMillis.toString(36) + randomSuffix()).substring(0, 33);
  }

  static newOptionId(nowMillis: number, index: number): string {
    return ('o' + nowMillis.toString(36) + (index + 1) + randomSuffix()).substring(0, 24);
  }

  /** 只保留有文字的选项，并补 id。 */
  static normalizeOptions(options: PollOption[], nowMillis: number): PollOption[] {
    const out: PollOption[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
      const option: PollOption = options[i];
      if (option.text.trim().length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const copy: PollOption = new PollOption();
      copy.id = option.id.trim().length > 0 ? option.id : VoteLogic.newOptionId(nowMillis, i);
      copy.text = option.text.trim();
      copy.desc = option.desc.trim();
      copy.img = option.img;
      out.push(copy);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 结果行：选项 + 票数 + 百分比 + 投票人姓名。 */
  static optionRows(detail: PollDetailView): PollOptionRow[] {
    const total: number = detail.total > 0 ? detail.total : 0;
    const rows: PollOptionRow[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < detail.poll.options.length; i++) {
      const option: PollOption = detail.poll.options[i];
      const count: number = detail.counts.get(option.id) !== undefined
        ? detail.counts.get(option.id) as number : 0;
      const row: PollOptionRow = new PollOptionRow();
      row.option = option;
      row.count = count;
      row.percent = VoteLogic.percent(count, total);
      const names: string[] = [];
      for (let v = 0; v < detail.voters.length; v++) {
        const voter: PollVoter = detail.voters[v];
        if (voter.choices.indexOf(option.id) >= 0 && voter.name.length > 0) {
          names.push(voter.name);
        }
      }
      row.voterNames = names;
      rows.push(row);
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

/** 详情视图（避免 UI 直接依赖 data 层类型名过多）。 */
export class PollDetailView {
  poll: Poll = new Poll();
  total: number = 0;
  counts: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
  voters: PollVoter[] = [];
}

export class PollOptionRow {
  option: PollOption = new PollOption();
  count: number = 0;
  percent: number = 0;
  voterNames: string[] = [];
}

function pad2(value: number): string {
  return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
}

function randomSuffix(): string {
  const alphabet: string = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
  let out: string = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    out += alphabet.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * alphabet.length));
  }
  return out;
}
/** 投票上限（对齐 `web/vote/CONTRACT.md` §1）。 */
export class VoteLimits {
  static readonly MAX_TITLE: number = 80;
  static readonly MAX_DESCRIPTION: number = 500;
  static readonly MIN_OPTIONS: number = 2;
  static readonly MAX_OPTIONS: number = 20;
  static readonly MAX_OPTION_TEXT: number = 80;
  static readonly MAX_OPTION_DESC: number = 200;
  static readonly MAX_CHOICES: number = 20;
  static readonly MAX_LIST: number = 100;
  /** 快捷限时（分钟）。 */
  static readonly QUICK_MINUTES: number[] = [5, 10, 30, 60, 120];
}

export enum PollMode {
  QUICK = 'quick',
  LONG = 'long'
}

export function pollModeLabel(mode: string): string {
  return mode === PollMode.QUICK ? '限时' : '长时';
}

export enum PollResultVisibility {
  ALWAYS = 'always',
  AFTER_VOTE = 'afterVote',
  AFTER_CLOSE = 'afterClose'
}

export function visibilityLabel(value: string): string {
  if (value === PollResultVisibility.ALWAYS) {
    return '结果始终可见';
  }
  if (value === PollResultVisibility.AFTER_CLOSE) {
    return '截止后可见';
  }
  return '投票后可见';
}

export enum PollAudience {
  ALL = 'all',
  COMMITTEE = 'committee',
  LEAGUE = 'league',
  CUSTOM = 'custom'
}

export function audienceLabel(value: string): string {
  if (value === PollAudience.COMMITTEE) {
    return '班委可见';
  }
  if (value === PollAudience.LEAGUE) {
    return '团员可见';
  }
  if (value === PollAudience.CUSTOM) {
    return '指定成员';
  }
  return '全班可见';
}

/** 可见范围标签（all 不显示）。 */
export function audienceTag(value: string, count: number): string {
  if (value === PollAudience.COMMITTEE) {
    return '班委可见';
  }
  if (value === PollAudience.LEAGUE) {
    return '团员可见';
  }
  if (value === PollAudience.CUSTOM) {
    return count > 0 ? '指定 ' + count + ' 人' : '指定成员';
  }
  return '';
}

export class PollSettings {
  multi: boolean = false;
  maxChoices: number = 1;
  anonymous: boolean = true;
  allowChange: boolean = true;
  resultVisibility: string = PollResultVisibility.AFTER_VOTE;

  normalized(optionCount: number): PollSettings {
    const next: PollSettings = new PollSettings();
    next.multi = this.multi && optionCount >= 2;
    next.maxChoices = !next.multi ? 1
      : Math.min(VoteLimits.MAX_CHOICES, Math.max(2, Math.min(this.maxChoices, Math.max(2, optionCount))));
    next.anonymous = this.anonymous;
    next.allowChange = this.allowChange;
    next.resultVisibility = this.resultVisibility;
    return next;
  }

  /** 规则标签（不含可见范围）。 */
  tags(hasVoted: boolean, closed: boolean, resultsHidden: boolean): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];
    out.push(this.multi ? '多选' : '单选');
    if (this.multi) {
      out.push('最多 ' + this.maxChoices + ' 项');
    }
    out.push(this.anonymous ? '匿名' : '实名');
    if (this.allowChange && !closed) {
      out.push('可改票');
    }
    if (resultsHidden) {
      out.push(visibilityLabel(this.resultVisibility));
    }
    return out;
  }
}

export class PollOption {
  id: string = '';
  text: string = '';
  desc: string = '';
  img: string = '';
}

export class PollVoter {
  name: string = '';
  choices: string[] = [];
}

export class PollSummary {
  id: string = '';
  title: string = '';
  description: string = '';
  mode: string = PollMode.LONG;
  ownerName: string = '';
  settings: PollSettings = new PollSettings();
  deadline: number = 0;
  status: string = 'open';
  closedAt: number = 0;
  createdAt: number = 0;
  updatedAt: number = 0;
  audience: string = PollAudience.ALL;
  audienceCount: number = 0;
  closed: boolean = false;
  total: number = 0;
  counts: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
  hasVoted: boolean = false;
}

export class Poll extends PollSummary {
  options: PollOption[] = [];
  audienceSeats: number[] = [];
}

export class PollList {
  polls: PollSummary[] = [];
  serverNow: number = 0;
  hasMore: boolean = false;
}

export class PollDetail {
  poll: Poll = new Poll();
  serverNow: number = 0;
  closed: boolean = false;
  total: number = 0;
  counts: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
  hasVoted: boolean = false;
  myChoices: string[] = [];
  resultsHidden: boolean = false;
  mine: boolean = false;
  canManage: boolean = false;
  voters: PollVoter[] = [];
}

/** 发起投票草稿（UI 表单 → RPC body）。 */
export class PollDraft {
  id: string = '';
  title: string = '';
  description: string = '';
  mode: string = PollMode.LONG;
  options: PollOption[] = [];
  settings: PollSettings = new PollSettings();
  deadline: number = 0;
  audience: string = PollAudience.ALL;
  audienceSeats: number[] = [];
}

export class VoteResult {
  ok: boolean = false;
  message: string = '';
  pollId: string = '';

  constructor(ok: boolean, message: string, pollId: string) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.message = message;
    this.pollId = pollId;
  }
}

export class PollListResult {
  ok: boolean = false;
  message: string = '';
  list: PollList = new PollList();

  constructor(ok: boolean, message: string, list: PollList) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.message = message;
    this.list = list;
  }
}

export class PollDetailResult {
  ok: boolean = false;
  message: string = '';
  detail: PollDetail = new PollDetail();

  constructor(ok: boolean, message: string, detail: PollDetail) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.message = message;
    this.detail = detail;
  }
}
import { Api } from '../net/Api';
import { ApiResult } from '../net/ApiResult';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import {
  PollDetailResult,
  PollDraft,
  PollListResult,
  VoteResult
} from './VoteModels';
import { VoteRpc } from './VoteRpc';

/**
 * 投票仓库：所有请求 `POST {REST}/rpc/<name>`，body 具名参数；服务端统一 `{ok:...}`（HTTP 200）。
 *
 * - `poll_list` / `poll_detail` / `poll_submit` / `poll_create` / `poll_manage`；
 * - 任何响应都不含学号；指定成员范围用座号。
 */
export class VoteRepository {
  private api: Api;

  constructor(api: Api) {
    this.api = api;
  }

  async list(): Promise<PollListResult> {
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post('rpc/poll_list', VoteRpc.listBody(), '', true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return new PollListResult(false, result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '投票加载失败',
        VoteRpc.parseList(''));
    }
    const body: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(result.value);
    if (body === undefined) {
      return new PollListResult(false, '投票数据格式错误', VoteRpc.parseList(''));
    }
    if (!JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'ok'), false)) {
      return new PollListResult(false, errorOf(body), VoteRpc.parseList(result.value));
    }
    return new PollListResult(true, '', VoteRpc.parseList(result.value));
  }

  async detail(pollId: string): Promise<PollDetailResult> {
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post('rpc/poll_detail', VoteRpc.detailBody(pollId), '', true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return new PollDetailResult(false,
        result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '投票详情加载失败', VoteRpc.parseDetail(''));
    }
    const body: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(result.value);
    if (body === undefined) {
      return new PollDetailResult(false, '投票数据格式错误', VoteRpc.parseDetail(''));
    }
    if (!JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'ok'), false)) {
      return new PollDetailResult(false, errorOf(body), VoteRpc.parseDetail(result.value));
    }
    return new PollDetailResult(true, '', VoteRpc.parseDetail(result.value));
  }

  async submit(pollId: string, choices: string[]): Promise<VoteResult> {
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post('rpc/poll_submit',
      VoteRpc.submitBody(pollId, choices), '', true);
    return toVoteResult(result, pollId, '投票失败');
  }

  async create(draft: PollDraft): Promise<VoteResult> {
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post('rpc/poll_create', VoteRpc.createBody(draft), '', true);
    return toVoteResult(result, draft.id, '发起失败');
  }

  async manage(pollId: string, action: string, deadline: number, draft: PollDraft | undefined): Promise<VoteResult> {
    const result: ApiResult = await this.api.post('rpc/poll_manage',
      VoteRpc.manageBody(pollId, action, deadline, draft), '', true);
    return toVoteResult(result, pollId, '操作失败');
  }
}

function toVoteResult(result: ApiResult, pollId: string, fallback: string): VoteResult {
  if (!result.ok) {
    return new VoteResult(false,
      result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : fallback, pollId);
  }
  const body: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(result.value);
  if (body === undefined) {
    return new VoteResult(false, '响应格式错误', pollId);
  }
  if (!JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'ok'), false)) {
    return new VoteResult(false, errorOf(body), pollId);
  }
  const id: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'poll_id'), '');
  return new VoteResult(true, '', id.length > 0 ? id : pollId);
}

function errorOf(body: Blob): string {
  const error: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'error'), '');
  if (error.length > 0) {
    return error;
  }
  const msg: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'msg'), '');
  return msg.length > 0 ? msg : '操作失败';
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../sync/JsonBlob';
import {
  Poll,
  PollAudience,
  PollDetail,
  PollDraft,
  PollList,
  PollMode,
  PollOption,
  PollSettings,
  PollSummary,
  PollVoter,
  PollResultVisibility,
  VoteLimits
} from './VoteModels';

/** 投票 RPC body 构造 + 响应解析（纯函数）。 */
export class VoteRpc {
  static listBody(): string {
    return '{}';
  }

  static detailBody(pollId: string): string {
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['p_id'] = pollId;
    return JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  static submitBody(pollId: string, choices: string[]): string {
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['p_id'] = pollId;
    const unique: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < choices.length; i++) {
      if (unique.indexOf(choices[i]) < 0) {
        unique.push(choices[i]);
      }
    }
    body['p_choices'] = unique;
    return JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  static createBody(draft: PollDraft): string {
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['p_id'] = draft.id;
    body['p_title'] = draft.title.trim();
    body['p_description'] = draft.description.trim();
    body['p_mode'] = draft.mode;
    body['p_options'] = optionsJson(draft.options);
    body['p_settings'] = settingsJson(draft.settings, draft.options.length);
    body['p_deadline'] = draft.deadline;
    body['p_audience'] = draft.audience;
    if (draft.audience === PollAudience.CUSTOM && draft.audienceSeats.length > 0) {
      body['p_audience_seats'] = draft.audienceSeats;
    }
    return JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  static manageBody(pollId: string, action: string, deadline: number, draft: PollDraft | undefined): string {
    const body: Blob = {};
    body['p_id'] = pollId;
    body['p_action'] = action;
    if (action === 'extend') {
      body['p_deadline'] = deadline;
    } else if (action === 'edit' && draft !== undefined) {
      body['p_title'] = draft.title.trim();
      body['p_description'] = draft.description.trim();
      body['p_options'] = optionsJson(draft.options);
      body['p_settings'] = settingsJson(draft.settings, draft.options.length);
      body['p_deadline'] = draft.deadline;
      body['p_audience'] = draft.audience;
      if (draft.audience === PollAudience.CUSTOM) {
        body['p_audience_seats'] = draft.audienceSeats;
      }
    }
    return JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  static parseList(raw: string): PollList {
    const list: PollList = new PollList();
    const body: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(raw);
    if (body === undefined) {
      return list;
    }
    const polls: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(body, 'polls'));
    if (polls !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < polls.length && list.polls.length < VoteLimits.MAX_LIST; i++) {
        const summary: PollSummary | undefined = VoteRpc.parseSummary(JsonBlob.asBlob(polls[i]));
        if (summary !== undefined) {
          list.polls.push(summary);
        }
      }
    }
    list.serverNow = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(body, 'now'), 0);
    list.hasMore = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'has_more'), false);
    return list;
  }

  static parseDetail(raw: string): PollDetail {
    const detail: PollDetail = new PollDetail();
    const body: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(raw);
    if (body === undefined) {
      return detail;
    }
    detail.poll = VoteRpc.parsePoll(JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(body, 'poll')));
    detail.serverNow = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(body, 'now'), 0);
    detail.closed = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'closed'), false);
    detail.total = Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(body, 'total'), 0));
    detail.counts = VoteRpc.parseCounts(JsonBlob.get(body, 'counts'));
    detail.hasVoted = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'has_voted'), false);
    detail.myChoices = stringArray(JsonBlob.get(body, 'my_choices'));
    detail.resultsHidden = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'results_hidden'), false);
    detail.mine = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'mine'), false);
    detail.canManage = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(body, 'can_manage'), false);
    const voters: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(body, 'voters'));
    if (voters !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < voters.length; i++) {
        const voterBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(voters[i]);
        if (voterBlob === undefined) {
          continue;
        }
        const voter: PollVoter = new PollVoter();
        voter.name = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(voterBlob, 'name'), '');
        voter.choices = stringArray(JsonBlob.get(voterBlob, 'choices'));
        detail.voters.push(voter);
      }
    }
    return detail;
  }

  static parseSummary(obj: Blob | undefined): PollSummary | undefined {
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const id: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'id'), '').trim();
    if (id.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const summary: PollSummary = new PollSummary();
    summary.id = id;
    summary.title = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'title'), '');
    summary.description = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'description'), '');
    summary.mode = normalizeMode(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'mode'), ''));
    summary.ownerName = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'owner_name'), '');
    summary.settings = VoteRpc.parseSettings(JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'settings')));
    summary.deadline = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'deadline'), 0);
    summary.status = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'status'), 'open');
    summary.closedAt = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'closed_at'), 0);
    summary.createdAt = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'created_at'), 0);
    summary.updatedAt = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'updated_at'), 0);
    summary.audience = normalizeAudience(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'audience'), ''));
    summary.audienceCount = Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'audience_count'), 0));
    summary.closed = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'closed'), false);
    summary.total = Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'total'), 0));
    summary.counts = VoteRpc.parseCounts(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'counts'));
    summary.hasVoted = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'has_voted'), false);
    return summary;
  }

  static parsePoll(obj: Blob | undefined): Poll {
    const poll: Poll = new Poll();
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return poll;
    }
    const summary: PollSummary | undefined = VoteRpc.parseSummary(obj);
    if (summary !== undefined) {
      poll.id = summary.id;
      poll.title = summary.title;
      poll.description = summary.description;
      poll.mode = summary.mode;
      poll.ownerName = summary.ownerName;
      poll.settings = summary.settings;
      poll.deadline = summary.deadline;
      poll.status = summary.status;
      poll.closedAt = summary.closedAt;
      poll.createdAt = summary.createdAt;
      poll.updatedAt = summary.updatedAt;
      poll.audience = summary.audience;
      poll.audienceCount = summary.audienceCount;
      poll.closed = summary.closed;
      poll.total = summary.total;
      poll.counts = summary.counts;
      poll.hasVoted = summary.hasVoted;
    }
    const options: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'options'));
    if (options !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
        const optionBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(options[i]);
        if (optionBlob === undefined) {
          continue;
        }
        const option: PollOption = new PollOption();
        option.id = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(optionBlob, 'id'), '');
        if (option.id.length === 0) {
          continue;
        }
        option.text = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(optionBlob, 'text'), '');
        option.desc = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(optionBlob, 'desc'), '');
        option.img = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(optionBlob, 'img'), '');
        poll.options.push(option);
      }
    }
    const seats: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'audience_seats'));
    if (seats !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < seats.length; i++) {
        const seat: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(seats[i], -1);
        if (seat > 0) {
          poll.audienceSeats.push(Math.round(seat));
        }
      }
    }
    return poll;
  }

  static parseSettings(obj: Blob | undefined): PollSettings {
    const settings: PollSettings = new PollSettings();
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return settings;
    }
    settings.multi = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'multi'), false);
    settings.maxChoices = Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'maxChoices'), 1));
    settings.anonymous = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'anonymous'), true);
    settings.allowChange = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'allowChange'), true);
    const visibility: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'resultVisibility'), '');
    settings.resultVisibility = visibility.length > 0 ? visibility : PollResultVisibility.AFTER_VOTE;
    return settings;
  }

  static parseCounts(value: JsonValue | undefined): Map<string, number> {
    const counts: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(value);
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return counts;
    }
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(obj);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      counts.set(keys[i], Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, keys[i]), 0)));
    }
    return counts;
  }
}

function optionsJson(options: PollOption[]): Object[] {
  const out: Object[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
    const option: PollOption = options[i];
    const blob: Blob = {};
    blob['id'] = option.id;
    blob['text'] = option.text.trim();
    if (option.desc.trim().length > 0) {
      blob['desc'] = option.desc.trim();
    }
    if (option.img.length > 0) {
      blob['img'] = option.img;
    }
    out.push(blob);
  }
  return out;
}

function settingsJson(settings: PollSettings, optionCount: number): Blob {
  const normalized: PollSettings = settings.normalized(optionCount);
  const blob: Blob = {};
  blob['multi'] = normalized.multi;
  blob['maxChoices'] = normalized.maxChoices;
  blob['anonymous'] = normalized.anonymous;
  blob['allowChange'] = normalized.allowChange;
  blob['resultVisibility'] = normalized.resultVisibility;
  return blob;
}

function stringArray(value: JsonValue | undefined): string[] {
  const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(value);
  if (array === undefined) {
    return [];
  }
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
    const text: string = JsonBlob.asString(array[i], '');
    if (text.length > 0) {
      out.push(text);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function normalizeMode(raw: string): string {
  return raw.trim() === PollMode.QUICK ? PollMode.QUICK : PollMode.LONG;
}

function normalizeAudience(raw: string): string {
  const text: string = raw.trim();
  if (text === PollAudience.COMMITTEE || text === PollAudience.LEAGUE || text === PollAudience.CUSTOM) {
    return text;
  }
  return PollAudience.ALL;
}
import { AbilityConstant, UIAbility, Want } from '@kit.AbilityKit';
import { hilog } from '@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit';
import { window } from '@kit.ArkUI';
import { AppGlobal } from '../app/AppGlobal';
import { Services } from '../app/Services';

const DOMAIN: number = 0x1001;
const TAG: string = 'EntryAbility';

export default class EntryAbility extends UIAbility {
  onCreate(want: Want, launchParam: AbilityConstant.LaunchParam): void {
    // 数据层（preferences 等）依赖 UIAbilityContext，进程内只注入一次。
    AppGlobal.context = this.context;
    AppGlobal.ability = this;
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, '%{public}s', 'onCreate');
  }

  onDestroy(): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, '%{public}s', 'onDestroy');
  }

  onWindowStageCreate(windowStage: window.WindowStage): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, '%{public}s', 'onWindowStageCreate');
    windowStage.loadContent('pages/Index', (err) => {
      if (err.code) {
        hilog.error(DOMAIN, TAG, 'loadContent failed: %{public}s', JSON.stringify(err));
        return;
      }
      hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, '%{public}s', 'loadContent ok');
    });
  }

  onWindowStageDestroy(): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, '%{public}s', 'onWindowStageDestroy');
  }

  onForeground(): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, '%{public}s', 'onForeground');
  }

  onBackground(): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, TAG, '%{public}s', 'onBackground');
    // 页面隐藏：立即冲刷待推送的 userdata（失败由 pending 兜底）
    Services.userdata.flush();
  }

  /**
   * Ability 级返回键：工具页打开时先关闭工具页（不退出应用）。
   *
   * 页面级 `onBackPress` 在 Stack 覆盖层场景下不一定被调用，这里做兜底。
   */
  onBackPressed(): boolean {
    if (AppGlobal.openToolId.length > 0) {
      AppGlobal.openToolId = '';
      if (AppGlobal.onToolClosed !== undefined) {
        AppGlobal.onToolClosed();
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
}
import bundleManager from '@ohos.bundle.bundleManager';
import deviceInfo from '@ohos.deviceInfo';
import fs from '@ohos.file.fs';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { DiagCheck, DiagStatus, DiagSummary } from '../../data/diag/DiagModels';

const MB: number = 1024 * 1024;

/** 本机设备检查（纯本地 + 网关延迟；不包含任何隐私字段）。 */
export class DeviceChecks {
  /** 运行全部检查；`gatewayOk/latencyMs` 由调用方探测后传入。 */
  static async run(gatewayOk: boolean, latencyMs: number): Promise<DiagSummary> {
    const summary: DiagSummary = new DiagSummary();
    summary.ranAt = Date.now();

    const version: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
    version.id = 'app_version';
    version.label = '应用版本';
    version.status = DiagStatus.PASS;
    version.value = await DeviceChecks.versionName();
    summary.checks.push(version);

    const device: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
    device.id = 'device';
    device.label = '设备型号';
    device.status = DiagStatus.PASS;
    device.value = deviceInfo.productModel !== undefined && deviceInfo.productModel.length > 0
      ? deviceInfo.productModel : '未知';
    summary.checks.push(device);

    const os: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
    os.id = 'os';
    os.label = '系统版本';
    os.status = DiagStatus.PASS;
    os.value = (deviceInfo.osFullName !== undefined ? deviceInfo.osFullName : 'HarmonyOS')
      + ' / API ' + deviceInfo.sdkApiVersion;
    summary.checks.push(os);

    const storage: DiagCheck = await DeviceChecks.storageCheck();
    summary.checks.push(storage);

    const gateway: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
    gateway.id = 'gateway';
    gateway.label = '云端网关';
    gateway.value = gatewayOk ? latencyMs + ' ms' : '不可达';
    if (!gatewayOk) {
      gateway.status = DiagStatus.FAIL;
      gateway.hint = '网络不可用或网关异常';
    } else if (latencyMs > 2000) {
      gateway.status = DiagStatus.WARN;
      gateway.hint = '延迟偏高';
    } else {
      gateway.status = DiagStatus.PASS;
    }
    summary.checks.push(gateway);

    const session: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
    session.id = 'session';
    session.label = '身份会话';
    session.status = DiagStatus.PASS;
    session.value = '已登录';
    summary.checks.push(session);

    return summary;
  }

  private static async versionName(): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const info = await bundleManager.getBundleInfoForSelf(bundleManager.BundleFlag.GET_BUNDLE_INFO_DEFAULT);
      const name: string = info.versionName !== undefined ? info.versionName : '';
      return name.length > 0 ? name + ' (' + info.versionCode + ')' : '—';
    } catch (e) {
      return '—';
    }
  }

  private static async storageCheck(): Promise<DiagCheck> {
    const check: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
    check.id = 'storage';
    check.label = '应用目录';
    try {
      const context = AppGlobal.context;
      if (context === undefined) {
        check.status = DiagStatus.INFO;
        check.value = '未知';
        return check;
      }
      const writable: boolean = fs.accessSync(context.filesDir);
      check.value = writable ? '可读写' : '不可写';
      check.status = writable ? DiagStatus.PASS : DiagStatus.FAIL;
      if (!writable) {
        check.hint = '应用目录不可写';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      check.status = DiagStatus.INFO;
      check.value = '读取失败';
    }
    return check;
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { DrawConfig, DrawPoolSource, drawSortFromWire, DrawSortMode } from './DrawModels';

/**
 * `userdata` v6 `draw` section 编解码。
 *
 * 线格式（与网页/小程序一致，键序固定）：
 * `{"start":1,"end":70,"count":10,"dup":false,"excl":"","sort":"draw"}`
 * 读取对脏数据容错：数值越界 clamp、缺失字段回落默认值。
 */
export class DrawConfigCodec {
  /**
   * 写回 `userdata.draw`。
   *
   * `existing` 传入当前 section 时，**保留未知字段**（例如网页 2026-11-12 新增的 `names` 自定义名称文本），
   * 否则会把别的端的字段覆盖丢失（契约：不拥有/不认识的字段必须原样保留）。
   */
  static toJson(config: DrawConfig, existing?: Blob): Blob {
    const out: Blob = {
      'start': config.start,
      'end': config.end,
      'count': config.count,
      'dup': config.allowDuplicates,
      'excl': config.excludedText,
      'sort': config.sort
    };
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(existing);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        const key: string = keys[i];
        if (JsonBlob.get(out, key) === undefined) {
          out[key] = existing[key];
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 从 `userdata.draw`（可能缺失/脏数据）解析；失败一律回落默认值。 */
  static fromJson(section: JsonValue | undefined, fallback: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig()): DrawConfig {
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(section);
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return fallback.copy();
    }
    const config: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig();
    config.start = intField(obj, 'start', fallback.start, DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER, DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER);
    config.end = intField(obj, 'end', fallback.end, DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER, DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER);
    config.count = intField(obj, 'count', fallback.count, DrawConfig.MIN_COUNT, DrawConfig.MAX_COUNT);
    config.allowDuplicates = JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'dup'), fallback.allowDuplicates);
    config.excludedText = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'excl'), fallback.excludedText);
    config.sort = drawSortFromWire(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'sort'), fallback.sort));
    // 候选池来源不属于跨端契约（仅本机 UI 选择），读取时恒为 RANGE
    config.poolSource = DrawPoolSource.RANGE;
    return config;
  }

  static defaults(): DrawConfig {
    return new DrawConfig();
  }
}

function intField(obj: Blob, key: string, fallback: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  const raw: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.get(obj, key);
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) {
    return fallback;
  }
  let value: number = Number.NaN;
  if (typeof raw === 'number') {
    value = raw as number;
  } else if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    value = Number((raw as string).trim());
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return fallback;
  }
  const rounded: number = Math.round(value);
  if (rounded < min) {
    return min;
  }
  if (rounded > max) {
    return max;
  }
  return rounded;
}

export function drawSortWireOf(mode: DrawSortMode): string {
  return mode;
}
import { DrawConfig, DrawEntry, DrawError, DrawErrorCode, DrawRemoveLog, DrawResult, DrawSortMode } from './DrawModels';
import { DrawRandom, shuffled, shuffledInts } from './DrawRandom';
import { DrawValidation, DrawValidator } from './DrawValidator';

/** 抽签执行结果。 */
export class DrawOutcome {
  ok: boolean;
  result: DrawResult | undefined;
  error: DrawError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, result: DrawResult | undefined, error: DrawError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.result = result;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static success(result: DrawResult): DrawOutcome {
    return new DrawOutcome(true, result, undefined);
  }

  static failure(error: DrawError): DrawOutcome {
    return new DrawOutcome(false, undefined, error);
  }
}

/**
 * 抽签引擎（纯函数 + 注入随机源，可复现）。
 *
 * 算法对齐网页 doDraw()：
 * - 池 = 范围 − 排除号（名单来源再∩名单）；
 * - 不重复：Fisher-Yates 洗牌后取前 count 个；允许重复：count 次独立随机；
 * - 排序：按抽取顺序 / 从小到大 / 从大到小 / 随机重排；
 * - 剔除重抽：移除指定项后，从「池 − 当前结果」补抽一个（允许重复时从全池补），追加 log。
 */
export class DrawEngine {
  /** 候选号码 → 带姓名条目。 */
  static entriesFor(numbers: number[], nameOf: (n: number) => string): DrawEntry[] {
    const out: DrawEntry[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < numbers.length; i++) {
      const name: string = nameOf(numbers[i]).trim();
      out.push(new DrawEntry(numbers[i], name));
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 校验 + 抽签（首抽入口）。 */
  static draw(config: DrawConfig, rosterSeats: number[], nameOf: (n: number) => string,
    random: DrawRandom): DrawOutcome {
    const validation: DrawValidation = DrawValidator.validate(config, rosterSeats);
    if (!validation.ok) {
      const error: DrawError = validation.error !== undefined
        ? validation.error
        : new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.RANGE_INVALID, '参数不合法');
      return DrawOutcome.failure(error);
    }
    const candidates: DrawEntry[] = DrawEngine.entriesFor(validation.numbers, nameOf);
    return DrawEngine.drawFromCandidates(config, candidates, random);
  }

  /** 从已确定的候选池抽签（STEP2 预览后调用，保证候选与预览一致）。 */
  static drawFromCandidates(config: DrawConfig, candidates: DrawEntry[], random: DrawRandom): DrawOutcome {
    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return DrawOutcome.failure(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.POOL_EMPTY, '候选为空，请返回上一步调整参数'));
    }
    if (config.count < DrawConfig.MIN_COUNT || config.count > DrawConfig.MAX_COUNT) {
      return DrawOutcome.failure(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.COUNT_INVALID,
        '抽取个数需在 ' + DrawConfig.MIN_COUNT + '–' + DrawConfig.MAX_COUNT + ' 之间'));
    }
    if (!config.allowDuplicates && config.count > candidates.length) {
      return DrawOutcome.failure(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.COUNT_EXCEEDS_POOL,
        '最多可抽 ' + candidates.length + ' 个（可用池 ' + candidates.length + '）'));
    }
    const picked: DrawEntry[] = DrawEngine.pick(config, candidates, random);
    const ordered: DrawEntry[] = DrawEngine.sortEntries(picked, config.sort, random);
    const result: DrawResult = new DrawResult();
    result.entries = ordered;
    result.pool = candidates.slice(0);
    result.config = config.copy();
    result.log = [];
    return DrawOutcome.success(result);
  }

  /** 剔除指定下标并（可选）自动补抽；返回新结果（不可变）。 */
  static removeAndRedraw(result: DrawResult, index: number, autoRedraw: boolean,
    random: DrawRandom): DrawOutcome {
    if (index < 0 || index >= result.entries.length) {
      return DrawOutcome.failure(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_INDEX, '要剔除的项不存在'));
    }
    const removed: DrawEntry = result.entries[index];
    const remaining: DrawEntry[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < result.entries.length; i++) {
      if (i !== index) {
        remaining.push(result.entries[i]);
      }
    }
    const next: DrawResult = result.copy();
    next.log = result.log.slice(0);
    if (!autoRedraw) {
      next.entries = remaining;
      next.log.push(new DrawRemoveLog(removed, undefined));
      return DrawOutcome.success(next);
    }
    const used: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
    if (!result.config.allowDuplicates) {
      for (let i = 0; i < remaining.length; i++) {
        used.add(remaining[i].number);
      }
    }
    const available: DrawEntry[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < result.pool.length; i++) {
      if (!used.has(result.pool[i].number)) {
        available.push(result.pool[i]);
      }
    }
    let added: DrawEntry | undefined = undefined;
    if (available.length > 0) {
      added = available[random.nextInt(available.length)];
      remaining.push(added);
    }
    next.entries = remaining;
    next.log.push(new DrawRemoveLog(removed, added));
    return DrawOutcome.success(next);
  }

  /** 同参数重新抽一次（结果集合会变，保留原参数）。 */
  static reroll(result: DrawResult, random: DrawRandom): DrawOutcome {
    const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.drawFromCandidates(result.config, result.pool, random);
    if (outcome.ok && outcome.result !== undefined) {
      outcome.result.config = result.config.copy();
    }
    return outcome;
  }

  /** 对已有结果应用排序模式（返回新数组，不改变集合）。 */
  static sortEntries(entries: DrawEntry[], mode: DrawSortMode, random: DrawRandom): DrawEntry[] {
    if (mode === DrawSortMode.ASCENDING) {
      const list: DrawEntry[] = entries.slice(0);
      list.sort((a: DrawEntry, b: DrawEntry) => a.number - b.number);
      return list;
    }
    if (mode === DrawSortMode.DESCENDING) {
      const list: DrawEntry[] = entries.slice(0);
      list.sort((a: DrawEntry, b: DrawEntry) => b.number - a.number);
      return list;
    }
    if (mode === DrawSortMode.RANDOM) {
      return shuffled<DrawEntry>(entries, random);
    }
    return entries;
  }

  private static pick(config: DrawConfig, candidates: DrawEntry[], random: DrawRandom): DrawEntry[] {
    const out: DrawEntry[] = [];
    if (config.allowDuplicates) {
      for (let i = 0; i < config.count; i++) {
        out.push(candidates[random.nextInt(candidates.length)]);
      }
      return out;
    }
    const order: number[] = shuffledInts(candidates.length, random);
    for (let i = 0; i < config.count; i++) {
      out.push(candidates[order[i]]);
    }
    return out;
  }
}
/** 结果排序模式（wire 值必须与 userdata.draw.sort 对齐：draw|num|desc|rand）。 */
export enum DrawSortMode {
  DRAW_ORDER = 'draw',
  ASCENDING = 'num',
  DESCENDING = 'desc',
  RANDOM = 'rand'
}

export function drawSortFromWire(wire: string): DrawSortMode {
  if (wire === 'num') {
    return DrawSortMode.ASCENDING;
  }
  if (wire === 'desc') {
    return DrawSortMode.DESCENDING;
  }
  if (wire === 'rand') {
    return DrawSortMode.RANDOM;
  }
  return DrawSortMode.DRAW_ORDER;
}

export function drawSortLabel(mode: DrawSortMode): string {
  if (mode === DrawSortMode.ASCENDING) {
    return '从小到大';
  }
  if (mode === DrawSortMode.DESCENDING) {
    return '从大到小';
  }
  if (mode === DrawSortMode.RANDOM) {
    return '随机';
  }
  return '按抽取顺序';
}

/** 候选池来源：纯号码范围 / 班级名单（与范围取交集）。RANGE 以外不跨端持久化。 */
export enum DrawPoolSource {
  RANGE = 'range',
  ROSTER = 'roster'
}

/** 抽签参数（表单状态 + userdata.draw 同步的唯一真源）。 */
export class DrawConfig {
  static readonly DEFAULT_START: number = 1;
  static readonly DEFAULT_END: number = 70;
  static readonly DEFAULT_COUNT: number = 10;
  static readonly MIN_NUMBER: number = 1;
  static readonly MAX_NUMBER: number = 999;
  static readonly MIN_COUNT: number = 1;
  static readonly MAX_COUNT: number = 999;

  start: number = DrawConfig.DEFAULT_START;
  end: number = DrawConfig.DEFAULT_END;
  count: number = DrawConfig.DEFAULT_COUNT;
  allowDuplicates: boolean = false;
  /** 排除序号原始文本（支持 `3,7,10-12`），持久化时原样保存。 */
  excludedText: string = '';
  sort: DrawSortMode = DrawSortMode.DRAW_ORDER;
  poolSource: DrawPoolSource = DrawPoolSource.RANGE;

  copy(): DrawConfig {
    const next: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig();
    next.start = this.start;
    next.end = this.end;
    next.count = this.count;
    next.allowDuplicates = this.allowDuplicates;
    next.excludedText = this.excludedText;
    next.sort = this.sort;
    next.poolSource = this.poolSource;
    return next;
  }
}

/** 候选/结果条目：序号 + 可选姓名（名单来源时带姓名）。 */
export class DrawEntry {
  number: number = 0;
  name: string = '';

  constructor(number: number = 0, name: string = '') {
    this.number = number;
    this.name = name;
  }

  label(): string {
    return this.name.length > 0 ? this.number + ' ' + this.name : '' + this.number;
  }
}

/** 剔除重抽记录：被剔除的条目 + 补抽条目（未补抽为空）。 */
export class DrawRemoveLog {
  removed: DrawEntry;
  added: DrawEntry | undefined;

  constructor(removed: DrawEntry, added: DrawEntry | undefined) {
    this.removed = removed;
    this.added = added;
  }
}

/** 一次抽签的完整结果（含候选池与参数快照，便于结果单/导出/重抽）。 */
export class DrawResult {
  entries: DrawEntry[] = [];
  pool: DrawEntry[] = [];
  config: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig();
  log: DrawRemoveLog[] = [];

  copy(): DrawResult {
    const next: DrawResult = new DrawResult();
    next.entries = this.entries.slice(0);
    next.pool = this.pool.slice(0);
    next.config = this.config.copy();
    next.log = this.log.slice(0);
    return next;
  }
}

export enum DrawErrorCode {
  RANGE_INVALID = 'range_invalid',
  COUNT_INVALID = 'count_invalid',
  EXCLUSION_INVALID = 'exclusion_invalid',
  POOL_EMPTY = 'pool_empty',
  COUNT_EXCEEDS_POOL = 'count_exceeds_pool',
  ROSTER_REQUIRED = 'roster_required',
  INVALID_STEP = 'invalid_step',
  INVALID_INDEX = 'invalid_index'
}

export class DrawError {
  code: DrawErrorCode;
  message: string;

  constructor(code: DrawErrorCode, message: string) {
    this.code = code;
    this.message = message;
  }
}
/** 随机数引擎抽象（可注入 seed，保证单测可复现）。 */
export interface DrawRandom {
  /** 返回 `0..bound-1` 的随机整数；`bound <= 0` 时返回 0。 */
  nextInt(bound: number): number;
}

/** 可复现实现（mulberry32）：同 seed 同序列，与平台随机源解耦。 */
export class SeededDrawRandom implements DrawRandom {
  private state: number = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.state = (seed >>> 0);
  }

  nextInt(bound: number): number {
    if (bound <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    this.state = (this.state + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0;
    let t: number = this.state;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t = (t ^ (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61))) >>> 0;
    const unit: number = ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    return Math.floor(unit * bound);
  }
}

/** 默认引擎：时间种子（每次抽签不可复现，与网页行为一致）。 */
export function defaultDrawRandom(): DrawRandom {
  return new SeededDrawRandom(Date.now() % 2147483647);
}

/** Fisher-Yates 洗牌（与网页实现同算法）；返回新数组。 */
export function shuffledInts(size: number, random: DrawRandom): number[] {
  const list: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    list.push(i);
  }
  for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
    const j: number = random.nextInt(i + 1);
    const tmp: number = list[i];
    list[i] = list[j];
    list[j] = tmp;
  }
  return list;
}

/** 对任意数组做 Fisher-Yates 洗牌。 */
export function shuffled<T>(items: T[], random: DrawRandom): T[] {
  const list: T[] = items.slice(0);
  for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
    const j: number = random.nextInt(i + 1);
    const tmp: T = list[i];
    list[i] = list[j];
    list[j] = tmp;
  }
  return list;
}
import { DrawConfig, DrawError, DrawErrorCode, DrawPoolSource } from './DrawModels';

/** 排除序号解析结果。 */
export class ExcludedParse {
  numbers: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
  /** 无法解析的片段（最多保留前 3 个，避免提示过长）。 */
  invalidTokens: string[] = [];

  isValid(): boolean {
    return this.invalidTokens.length === 0;
  }
}

/** 参数校验结果：合法时给出候选号码（升序），非法时给出可展示错误。 */
export class DrawValidation {
  ok: boolean;
  numbers: number[];
  error: DrawError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, numbers: number[], error: DrawError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.numbers = numbers;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static valid(numbers: number[]): DrawValidation {
    return new DrawValidation(true, numbers, undefined);
  }

  static invalid(error: DrawError): DrawValidation {
    return new DrawValidation(false, [], error);
  }
}

/**
 * 抽签参数校验（纯函数）。
 *
 * 规则（与网页 doDraw() 对齐，个别处更严格）：
 * - 范围 1..999 且 start ≤ end；
 * - 个数 1..999；
 * - 排除序号支持 `3,7,10-12`（逗号/顿号/空白分隔，区间 `-`/`~`/`—`）；
 * - 候选池 = 范围 − 排除号；名单来源时再与名单座号取交集；
 * - 不重复时 个数 ≤ 池大小。
 */
export class DrawValidator {
  /** 解析排除序号文本；空文本 = 无排除。 */
  static parseExcluded(text: string): ExcludedParse {
    const result: ExcludedParse = new ExcludedParse();
    const tokens: string[] = text.split(new RegExp('[,，、;；\\s]+'));
    for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
      const token: string = tokens[i].trim();
      if (token.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const rangeMatch: RegExpMatchArray | null = token.match(new RegExp('^(\\d+)\\s*[-~—]\\s*(\\d+)$'));
      if (rangeMatch !== null) {
        const from: number = Number(rangeMatch[1]);
        const to: number = Number(rangeMatch[2]);
        if (!Number.isFinite(from) || !Number.isFinite(to) || from > to
          || from < DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER || to > DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER) {
          if (result.invalidTokens.length < 3) {
            result.invalidTokens.push(token);
          }
        } else {
          for (let n = from; n <= to; n++) {
            result.numbers.add(n);
          }
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (new RegExp('^\\d+$').test(token)) {
        const n: number = Number(token);
        if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER || n > DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER) {
          if (result.invalidTokens.length < 3) {
            result.invalidTokens.push(token);
          }
        } else {
          result.numbers.add(n);
        }
      } else if (result.invalidTokens.length < 3) {
        result.invalidTokens.push(token);
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  /** 校验并给出候选号码（升序）。`rosterSeats` 为空表示未提供班级名单。 */
  static validate(config: DrawConfig, rosterSeats: number[]): DrawValidation {
    if (config.start < DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER || config.start > DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER
      || config.end < DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER || config.end > DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER) {
      return DrawValidation.invalid(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.RANGE_INVALID,
        '范围需在 ' + DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER + '–' + DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER + ' 之间'));
    }
    if (config.start > config.end) {
      return DrawValidation.invalid(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.RANGE_INVALID, '起始值不能大于结束值'));
    }
    if (config.count < DrawConfig.MIN_COUNT || config.count > DrawConfig.MAX_COUNT) {
      return DrawValidation.invalid(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.COUNT_INVALID,
        '抽取个数需在 ' + DrawConfig.MIN_COUNT + '–' + DrawConfig.MAX_COUNT + ' 之间'));
    }
    const excluded: ExcludedParse = DrawValidator.parseExcluded(config.excludedText);
    if (!excluded.isValid()) {
      return DrawValidation.invalid(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.EXCLUSION_INVALID, '排除格式示例：3,7,10-12'));
    }

    let numbers: number[] = [];
    for (let n = config.start; n <= config.end; n++) {
      if (!excluded.numbers.has(n)) {
        numbers.push(n);
      }
    }
    if (config.poolSource === DrawPoolSource.ROSTER) {
      const seats: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
      for (let i = 0; i < rosterSeats.length; i++) {
        const seat: number = rosterSeats[i];
        if (seat >= DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER && seat <= DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER) {
          seats.add(seat);
        }
      }
      if (seats.size === 0) {
        return DrawValidation.invalid(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.ROSTER_REQUIRED, '名单为空，请先选择班级名单'));
      }
      const filtered: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < numbers.length; i++) {
        if (seats.has(numbers[i])) {
          filtered.push(numbers[i]);
        }
      }
      numbers = filtered;
    }
    if (numbers.length === 0) {
      return DrawValidation.invalid(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.POOL_EMPTY, '排除后没有可用序号，请调整范围或排除号'));
    }
    if (!config.allowDuplicates && config.count > numbers.length) {
      return DrawValidation.invalid(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.COUNT_EXCEEDS_POOL,
        '最多可抽 ' + numbers.length + ' 个（可用池 ' + numbers.length + '）'));
    }
    return DrawValidation.valid(numbers);
  }
}
import { DrawConfig, DrawEntry, DrawError, DrawErrorCode, DrawResult, DrawSortMode } from './DrawModels';
import { DrawEngine, DrawOutcome } from './DrawEngine';
import { DrawRandom } from './DrawRandom';
import { DrawValidation, DrawValidator } from './DrawValidator';

/** 三步工作流：STEP1 配置 → STEP2 候选预览 → STEP3 结果。 */
export enum DrawStep {
  CONFIG = 1,
  PREVIEW = 2,
  RESULT = 3
}

export function drawStepTitle(step: DrawStep): string {
  if (step === DrawStep.PREVIEW) {
    return '候选';
  }
  if (step === DrawStep.RESULT) {
    return '结果';
  }
  return '配置';
}

/** 工作流状态（UI 持有，由 DrawWorkflow 纯函数迁移）。 */
export class DrawWorkflowState {
  step: DrawStep = DrawStep.CONFIG;
  config: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig();
  /** STEP2 预览的候选池（含姓名映射快照）。 */
  candidates: DrawEntry[] = [];
  /** STEP3 结果；未抽签为 undefined。 */
  result: DrawResult | undefined = undefined;

  copy(): DrawWorkflowState {
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
    next.step = this.step;
    next.config = this.config.copy();
    next.candidates = this.candidates.slice(0);
    next.result = this.result !== undefined ? this.result.copy() : undefined;
    return next;
  }
}

/** 状态迁移结果：成功给新状态，失败给可展示错误（不抛异常）。 */
export class DrawTransition {
  ok: boolean;
  state: DrawWorkflowState | undefined;
  error: DrawError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, state: DrawWorkflowState | undefined, error: DrawError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.state = state;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static next(state: DrawWorkflowState): DrawTransition {
    return new DrawTransition(true, state, undefined);
  }

  static rejected(error: DrawError): DrawTransition {
    return new DrawTransition(false, undefined, error);
  }
}

/**
 * 抽签工作流状态机（纯函数，无副作用）。
 *
 * 约束：
 * - 参数只在 STEP1 修改；进入 STEP2 后固化候选池，保证「预览的候选 = 实际抽签池」；
 * - 返回：STEP3→STEP2→STEP1；STEP2→STEP1 丢弃候选；STEP3→STEP2 丢弃结果；
 * - 剔除/重抽/排序只允许在 STEP3；排序写回 config.sort（随 userdata.draw 同步）。
 */
export class DrawWorkflow {
  static updateConfig(state: DrawWorkflowState, config: DrawConfig): DrawWorkflowState {
    if (state.step !== DrawStep.CONFIG) {
      return state;
    }
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    next.config = config.copy();
    return next;
  }

  /** STEP1 → STEP2：校验参数并生成候选（失败行内报错，不进入下一步）。 */
  static toPreview(state: DrawWorkflowState, rosterSeats: number[],
    nameOf: (n: number) => string): DrawTransition {
    if (state.step !== DrawStep.CONFIG) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_STEP, '当前步骤不能重新生成候选'));
    }
    const validation: DrawValidation = DrawValidator.validate(state.config, rosterSeats);
    if (!validation.ok) {
      const error: DrawError = validation.error !== undefined
        ? validation.error
        : new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.RANGE_INVALID, '参数不合法');
      return DrawTransition.rejected(error);
    }
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    next.step = DrawStep.PREVIEW;
    next.candidates = DrawEngine.entriesFor(validation.numbers, nameOf);
    next.result = undefined;
    return DrawTransition.next(next);
  }

  /** STEP2 → STEP3：从固化的候选池抽签。 */
  static startDraw(state: DrawWorkflowState, random: DrawRandom): DrawTransition {
    if (state.step !== DrawStep.PREVIEW) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_STEP, '请先预览候选再开始抽签'));
    }
    const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.drawFromCandidates(state.config, state.candidates, random);
    if (!outcome.ok || outcome.result === undefined) {
      const error: DrawError = outcome.error !== undefined
        ? outcome.error
        : new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.POOL_EMPTY, '抽签失败');
      return DrawTransition.rejected(error);
    }
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    next.step = DrawStep.RESULT;
    next.result = outcome.result;
    return DrawTransition.next(next);
  }

  /** 返回上一步；STEP1 返回原状态（由调用方决定是否退出页面）。 */
  static back(state: DrawWorkflowState): DrawWorkflowState {
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    if (state.step === DrawStep.PREVIEW) {
      next.step = DrawStep.CONFIG;
      next.candidates = [];
    } else if (state.step === DrawStep.RESULT) {
      next.step = DrawStep.PREVIEW;
      next.result = undefined;
    }
    return next;
  }

  /** STEP3：剔除第 index 项并按 autoRedraw 决定是否补抽。 */
  static removeAndRedraw(state: DrawWorkflowState, index: number, autoRedraw: boolean,
    random: DrawRandom): DrawTransition {
    if (state.step !== DrawStep.RESULT) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_STEP, '只有结果页可以剔除重抽'));
    }
    if (state.result === undefined) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_INDEX, '还没有抽签结果'));
    }
    const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.removeAndRedraw(state.result, index, autoRedraw, random);
    if (!outcome.ok || outcome.result === undefined) {
      const error: DrawError = outcome.error !== undefined
        ? outcome.error
        : new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_INDEX, '剔除失败');
      return DrawTransition.rejected(error);
    }
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    next.result = outcome.result;
    return DrawTransition.next(next);
  }

  /** STEP3：切换排序模式（同步写回 config.sort）。 */
  static changeSort(state: DrawWorkflowState, mode: DrawSortMode, random: DrawRandom): DrawTransition {
    if (state.step !== DrawStep.RESULT) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_STEP, '只有结果页可以调整排序'));
    }
    if (state.result === undefined) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_INDEX, '还没有抽签结果'));
    }
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    next.config.sort = mode;
    const sorted: DrawEntry[] = DrawEngine.sortEntries(state.result.entries, mode, random);
    const result: DrawResult = state.result.copy();
    result.entries = sorted;
    result.config = next.config.copy();
    next.result = result;
    return DrawTransition.next(next);
  }

  /** STEP3：同参数重新抽一次（结果集合变化，log 清空）。 */
  static reroll(state: DrawWorkflowState, random: DrawRandom): DrawTransition {
    if (state.step !== DrawStep.RESULT) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_STEP, '只有结果页可以重新抽签'));
    }
    if (state.result === undefined) {
      return DrawTransition.rejected(new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.INVALID_INDEX, '还没有抽签结果'));
    }
    const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.reroll(state.result, random);
    if (!outcome.ok || outcome.result === undefined) {
      const error: DrawError = outcome.error !== undefined
        ? outcome.error
        : new DrawError(DrawErrorCode.POOL_EMPTY, '重抽失败');
      return DrawTransition.rejected(error);
    }
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    next.result = outcome.result;
    return DrawTransition.next(next);
  }

  /** 重置回 STEP1（保留参数，清空候选与结果）。 */
  static reset(state: DrawWorkflowState): DrawWorkflowState {
    const next: DrawWorkflowState = state.copy();
    next.step = DrawStep.CONFIG;
    next.candidates = [];
    next.result = undefined;
    return next;
  }
}

/**
