  generatedAt: number = 0;
}

/** 命名/编号工具（纯函数，时间与随机后缀可注入，便于单测）。 */
export class ExportNaming {
  static pad2(value: number): string {
    return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
  }

  /** `YYYYMMDD-HHMM`（本地时区，与网页一致）。 */
  static stamp(now: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(now);
    return '' + d.getFullYear() + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getDate())
      + '-' + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getHours()) + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  /** `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`（页脚展示）。 */
  static timeText(now: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(now);
    return '' + d.getFullYear() + '-' + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getDate())
      + ' ' + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + ExportNaming.pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  /** `DRAW-20261114-2230-ABC12` 形式的唯一编号。 */
  static recordId(prefix: string, now: number, suffix: string): string {
    return prefix + '-' + ExportNaming.stamp(now) + '-' + suffix.toUpperCase();
  }

  /** 文件名安全化（去掉 Windows/相册不允许的字符）。 */
  static safeName(raw: string): string {
    return raw.replace(new RegExp('[\\\\/:*?"<>|]', 'g'), '_');
  }

  static randomSuffix(): string {
    const chars: string = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let out: string = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      out += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    return out;
  }
}

/** 抽签导出数据工厂（纯函数）。 */
export class DrawExportFactory {
  static create(result: DrawResult, now: number, suffix: string): ExportCardSpec {
    const config = result.config;
    const stamp: string = ExportNaming.stamp(now);
    const spec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();
    spec.title = '随机抽签结果';
    spec.subtitle = '共 ' + result.entries.length + ' 个 · 范围 ' + config.start + '–' + config.end;
    spec.recordId = ExportNaming.recordId('DRAW', now, suffix);
    spec.fileName = ExportNaming.safeName('抽签结果_' + stamp
      + '_范围' + config.start + '-' + config.end
      + '_抽' + config.count + '个'
      + '_' + (config.allowDuplicates ? '允许重复' : '不重复')
      + '_' + drawSortLabel(config.sort) + '.png');
    spec.params = DrawExportFactory.configFields(result);
    spec.chipLabel = '抽签结果';
    spec.chips = DrawExportFactory.chips(result.entries);
    spec.noteLines = DrawExportFactory.removeLines(result);
    spec.footer = '生成时间 ' + ExportNaming.timeText(now);
    spec.generatedAt = now;
    return spec;
  }

  static chips(entries: DrawEntry[]): ExportChip[] {
    const out: ExportChip[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
      out.push(new ExportChip(entries[i].number, entries[i].name));
    }
    return out;
  }

  static removeLines(result: DrawResult): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < result.log.length; i++) {
      const removed: DrawEntry = result.log[i].removed;
      const added: DrawEntry | undefined = result.log[i].added;
      out.push('#' + (i + 1) + ' 剔除 ' + removed.label()
        + ' → 重抽 ' + (added !== undefined ? added.label() : '（未补抽）'));
    }
    return out;
  }

  static configFields(result: DrawResult): ExportParam[] {
    const config = result.config;
    const fields: ExportParam[] = [
      new ExportParam('范围', config.start + ' – ' + config.end),
      new ExportParam('抽取个数', '' + config.count),
      new ExportParam('允许重复', config.allowDuplicates ? '是' : '否'),
      new ExportParam('排除序号', config.excludedText.trim().length > 0 ? config.excludedText : '无'),
      new ExportParam('结果排序', drawSortLabel(config.sort)),
      new ExportParam('可用池', '共 ' + result.pool.length + ' 个')
    ];
    if (config.poolSource === DrawPoolSource.ROSTER) {
      fields.push(new ExportParam('候选来源', '班级名单'));
    }
    return fields;
  }
}

/** 分组导出数据工厂（纯函数）。 */
export class GroupExportFactory {
  static create(result: GroupResult, now: number, suffix: string): ExportCardSpec {
    const stamp: string = ExportNaming.stamp(now);
    const snapshot = result.snapshot;
    const spec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();
    spec.title = '随机分组结果';
    spec.subtitle = '共 ' + snapshot.total + ' 人 · ' + snapshot.groupCount + ' 组';
    spec.recordId = ExportNaming.recordId('GROUP', now, suffix);
    spec.fileName = ExportNaming.safeName('分组结果_' + stamp
      + '_' + snapshot.total + '人_' + snapshot.groupCount + '组'
      + '_' + (result.config.shuffle ? '打乱' : '原顺序') + '.png');
    spec.params = GroupExportFactory.configFields(result);
    spec.groupLabel = '分组结果';
    spec.groups = GroupExportFactory.groups(result);
    spec.footer = '生成时间 ' + ExportNaming.timeText(now);
    spec.generatedAt = now;
    return spec;
  }

  static groups(result: GroupResult): ExportChip[][] {
    const out: ExportChip[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < result.groups.length; i++) {
      const group: MemberGroup = result.groups[i];
      const chips: ExportChip[] = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < group.members.length; j++) {
        chips.push(new ExportChip(group.members[j].seat, group.members[j].name));
      }
      out.push(chips);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static configFields(result: GroupResult): ExportParam[] {
    const snapshot = result.snapshot;
    return [
      new ExportParam('成员来源', snapshot.sourceLabel),
      new ExportParam('分组方式', snapshot.modeLabel),
      new ExportParam('成员数', '' + snapshot.total),
      new ExportParam('组数', '' + snapshot.groupCount),
      new ExportParam('分配方式', snapshot.innerLabel)
    ];
  }
}

/** 体测导出数据工厂（纯函数）。 */
export class FitExportFactory {
  static create(calc: FitCalc, input: FitInput, now: number, suffix: string): ExportCardSpec {
    const stamp: string = ExportNaming.stamp(now);
    const spec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();
    spec.title = '体测评分结果';
    spec.subtitle = fitSexLabel(calc.sex) + ' · ' + fitGradeLabel(calc.gradeBucket)
      + ' · 总分 ' + calc.totalText + '（' + calc.grade + '）';
    spec.recordId = ExportNaming.recordId('FIT', now, suffix);
    spec.fileName = ExportNaming.safeName('体测评分_' + stamp + '_' + calc.totalText + '分_' + calc.grade + '.png');
    spec.params = FitExportFactory.configFields(calc, input);
    spec.linesLabel = '评分明细';
    spec.lines = FitExportFactory.lines(calc);
    spec.footer = '生成时间 ' + ExportNaming.timeText(now);
    spec.generatedAt = now;
    return spec;
  }

  static configFields(calc: FitCalc, input: FitInput): ExportParam[] {
    const params: ExportParam[] = [
      new ExportParam('性别', fitSexLabel(calc.sex)),
      new ExportParam('年级', fitGradeLabel(calc.gradeBucket)),
      new ExportParam('身高', input.h.trim().length > 0 ? input.h + ' cm' : '—'),
      new ExportParam('体重', input.w.trim().length > 0 ? input.w + ' kg' : '—'),
      new ExportParam('体重指数', calc.bmi !== undefined
        ? calc.bmi.toFixed(1) + (calc.bmiCategory.length > 0 ? '（' + calc.bmiCategory + '）' : '')
        : '—'),
      new ExportParam('标准分', calc.std.toFixed(1)),
      new ExportParam('附加分', calc.plus.toFixed(1)),
      new ExportParam('已测权重', calc.wtDone + ' / 100')
    ];
    return params;
  }

  static lines(calc: FitCalc): string[] {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < calc.rows.length; i++) {
      const row: FitRow = calc.rows[i];
      const scoreText: string = row.score !== undefined ? '' + row.score : '缺项';
      const plusText: string = row.plus > 0 ? '（加 ' + row.plus + '）' : '';
      lines.push(row.name + '  ' + row.value + ' ' + row.sub + ' · ' + row.weight + '% · '
        + scoreText + ' 分' + plusText);
    }
    lines.push('总分 ' + calc.totalText + ' · ' + calc.grade
      + (calc.miss > 0 ? ' · 缺 ' + calc.miss + ' 项' : ''));
    return lines;
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { FitFields, FitGrade, fitGradeFromWire, FitInput, FitRecord, FitSex, fitSexFromWire } from './FitModels';

/**
 * 体测数据编解码：
 * 1. `userdata.fit` section（11 键：sex/grade + 9 项成绩字符串）；
 * 2. `fitrecs.data` 行：`{id, ts, n, sex, gr, fields{h..durS}, total, grade}` 以 JSON **字符串** 存 `data` 列。
 */
export class FitCodec {
  /** 解析 `userdata.fit`（缺省 → 默认输入；未知字段忽略）。 */
  static inputFromJson(section: JsonValue | undefined): FitInput {
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(section);
    const input: FitInput = new FitInput();
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return input;
    }
    input.sex = fitSexFromWire(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'sex'), 'm'));
    input.grade = fitGradeFromWire(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'grade'), '12'));
    input.h = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'h'), '').trim();
    input.w = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'w'), '').trim();
    input.vc = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'vc'), '').trim();
    input.r50 = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'r50'), '').trim();
    input.sit = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'sit'), '').trim();
    input.jump = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'jump'), '').trim();
    input.pull = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'pull'), '').trim();
    input.durM = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'durM'), '').trim();
    input.durS = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'durS'), '').trim();
    return input;
  }

  /** 输出 `userdata.fit`：固定键序 `sex, grade, h, w, vc, r50, sit, jump, pull, durM, durS`，保留未知字段。 */
  static toJson(input: FitInput, existing?: Blob): Blob {
    const out: Blob = {
      'sex': input.sex,
      'grade': input.grade,
      'h': input.h,
      'w': input.w,
      'vc': input.vc,
      'r50': input.r50,
      'sit': input.sit,
      'jump': input.jump,
      'pull': input.pull,
      'durM': input.durM,
      'durS': input.durS
    };
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(existing);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        if (JsonBlob.get(out, keys[i]) === undefined) {
          out[keys[i]] = existing[keys[i]];
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 记录 → `fitrecs.data` JSON 字符串（字段名与契约一致；不含 syncPending）。 */
  static recordToData(record: FitRecord): string {
    const fields: Blob = {
      'h': record.fields.h,
      'w': record.fields.w,
      'vc': record.fields.vc,
      'r50': record.fields.r50,
      'sit': record.fields.sit,
      'jump': record.fields.jump,
      'pull': record.fields.pull,
      'durM': record.fields.durM,
      'durS': record.fields.durS
    };
    const data: Blob = {
      'id': record.id,
      'ts': record.ts,
      'n': record.name,
      'sex': record.sex,
      'gr': record.gradeBucket,
      'fields': fields,
      'total': record.total !== undefined ? record.total : null,
      'grade': record.grade
    };
    return JSON.stringify(data);
  }

  /** 解析 `fitrecs.data` 字符串 → FitRecord；坏 JSON/缺 id → undefined。 */
  static recordFromData(data: string): FitRecord | undefined {
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(data);
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const id: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'id'), '').trim();
    if (id.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const record: FitRecord = new FitRecord();
    record.id = id;
    record.ts = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'ts'), 0);
    record.name = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'n'), '');
    record.sex = fitSexFromWire(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'sex'), 'm'));
    record.gradeBucket = fitGradeFromWire(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'gr'), '12'));
    record.fields = FitCodec.fieldsFromJson(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'fields'));
    const total: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.get(obj, 'total');
    record.total = typeof total === 'number' ? total as number : undefined;
    record.grade = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'grade'), '');
    return record;
  }

  static fieldsFromJson(value: JsonValue | undefined): FitFields {
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(value);
    const fields: FitFields = new FitFields();
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return fields;
    }
    fields.h = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'h'), '');
    fields.w = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'w'), '');
    fields.vc = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'vc'), '');
    fields.r50 = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'r50'), '');
    fields.sit = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'sit'), '');
    fields.jump = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'jump'), '');
    fields.pull = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'pull'), '');
    fields.durM = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'durM'), '');
    fields.durS = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'durS'), '');
    return fields;
  }

  /** `fitrecs` 行（上传用）：`{id, acc, data, arch:false, ts}`。 */
  static rowForUpload(record: FitRecord, sid: string): Blob {
    const row: Blob = {
      'id': record.id,
      'acc': sid,
      'data': FitCodec.recordToData(record),
      'arch': false,
      'ts': record.ts
    };
    return row;
  }

  /** 记录里的性别/年级（便捷）。 */
  static sexOf(record: FitRecord): FitSex {
    return record.sexEnum();
  }

  static gradeOf(record: FitRecord): FitGrade {
    return record.gradeEnum();
  }
}
/** 性别。 */
export enum FitSex {
  MALE = 'm',
  FEMALE = 'f'
}

export function fitSexFromWire(wire: string): FitSex {
  return wire.trim() === 'f' ? FitSex.FEMALE : FitSex.MALE;
}

export function fitSexLabel(sex: FitSex): string {
  return sex === FitSex.FEMALE ? '女' : '男';
}

/** 年级档（大学组：大一/大二、大三/大四）。 */
export enum FitGrade {
  G12 = '12',
  G34 = '34'
}

export function fitGradeFromWire(wire: string): FitGrade {
  return wire.trim() === '34' ? FitGrade.G34 : FitGrade.G12;
}

export function fitGradeLabel(grade: FitGrade): string {
  return grade === FitGrade.G34 ? '大三 / 大四' : '大一 / 大二';
}

/** 表单字段元数据（UI 渲染 + 输入清洗；durM/durS 单独成对展示）。 */
export class FitFieldSpec {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  unit: string;
  /** 小数位（0 = 整数）。 */
  decimals: number;
  /** 是否允许负数（坐位体前屈）。 */
  allowNegative: boolean;

  constructor(key: string, label: string, unit: string, decimals: number, allowNegative: boolean = false) {
    this.key = key;
    this.label = label;
    this.unit = unit;
    this.decimals = decimals;
    this.allowNegative = allowNegative;
  }
}

/** 单项字段（身高~引体/仰卧；长跑拆 durM/durS）。 */
export const FIT_INPUT_FIELDS: FitFieldSpec[] = [
  new FitFieldSpec('h', '身高', 'cm', 1),
  new FitFieldSpec('w', '体重', 'kg', 1),
  new FitFieldSpec('vc', '肺活量', 'mL', 0),
  new FitFieldSpec('r50', '50 米跑', '秒', 2),
  new FitFieldSpec('sit', '坐位体前屈', 'cm', 1, true),
  new FitFieldSpec('jump', '立定跳远', 'cm', 0),
  new FitFieldSpec('pull', '引体 / 仰卧起坐', '次', 0)
];

/** 表单输入（与 `userdata.fit` 的 11 个键一一对应，值保留字符串以便原样回填）。 */
export class FitInput {
  /** `userdata.fit` 的固定 9 个成绩键（sex/grade 另有）。 */
  static readonly KEYS: string[] = ['h', 'w', 'vc', 'r50', 'sit', 'jump', 'pull', 'durM', 'durS'];

  sex: FitSex = FitSex.MALE;
  grade: FitGrade = FitGrade.G12;
  h: string = '';
  w: string = '';
  vc: string = '';
  r50: string = '';
  sit: string = '';
  jump: string = '';
  pull: string = '';
  durM: string = '';
  durS: string = '';

  valueOf(key: string): string {
    if (key === 'h') {
      return this.h;
    }
    if (key === 'w') {
      return this.w;
    }
    if (key === 'vc') {
      return this.vc;
    }
    if (key === 'r50') {
      return this.r50;
    }
    if (key === 'sit') {
      return this.sit;
    }
    if (key === 'jump') {
      return this.jump;
    }
    if (key === 'pull') {
      return this.pull;
    }
    if (key === 'durM') {
      return this.durM;
    }
    if (key === 'durS') {
      return this.durS;
    }
    return '';
  }

  withValue(key: string, value: string): FitInput {
    const next: FitInput = this.copy();
    if (key === 'h') {
      next.h = value;
    } else if (key === 'w') {
      next.w = value;
    } else if (key === 'vc') {
      next.vc = value;
    } else if (key === 'r50') {
      next.r50 = value;
    } else if (key === 'sit') {
      next.sit = value;
    } else if (key === 'jump') {
      next.jump = value;
    } else if (key === 'pull') {
      next.pull = value;
    } else if (key === 'durM') {
      next.durM = value;
    } else if (key === 'durS') {
      next.durS = value;
    }
    return next;
  }

  hasAny(): boolean {
    for (let i = 0; i < FitInput.KEYS.length; i++) {
      if (this.valueOf(FitInput.KEYS[i]).trim().length > 0) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  toFields(): FitFields {
    const fields: FitFields = new FitFields();
    fields.h = this.h;
    fields.w = this.w;
    fields.vc = this.vc;
    fields.r50 = this.r50;
    fields.sit = this.sit;
    fields.jump = this.jump;
    fields.pull = this.pull;
    fields.durM = this.durM;
    fields.durS = this.durS;
    return fields;
  }

  copy(): FitInput {
    const next: FitInput = new FitInput();
    next.sex = this.sex;
    next.grade = this.grade;
    next.h = this.h;
    next.w = this.w;
    next.vc = this.vc;
    next.r50 = this.r50;
    next.sit = this.sit;
    next.jump = this.jump;
    next.pull = this.pull;
    next.durM = this.durM;
    next.durS = this.durS;
    return next;
  }

  static fromFields(sex: FitSex, grade: FitGrade, fields: FitFields): FitInput {
    const input: FitInput = new FitInput();
    input.sex = sex;
    input.grade = grade;
    input.h = fields.h;
    input.w = fields.w;
    input.vc = fields.vc;
    input.r50 = fields.r50;
    input.sit = fields.sit;
    input.jump = fields.jump;
    input.pull = fields.pull;
    input.durM = fields.durM;
    input.durS = fields.durS;
    return input;
  }
}

/** 一项评分结果。 */
export class FitRow {
  name: string;
  /** 单位或备注（mL / 秒 / BMI · 正常…）。 */
  sub: string;
  /** 权重（百分比整数，总分 100）。 */
  weight: number;
  /** 原始输入展示（未填 `—`）。 */
  value: string;
  /** 等级分（undefined = 缺项或非法）。 */
  score: number | undefined;
  /** 加分（引体/仰卧/长跑）。 */
  plus: number;

  constructor(name: string, sub: string, weight: number, value: string, score: number | undefined,
    plus: number = 0) {
    this.name = name;
    this.sub = sub;
    this.weight = weight;
    this.value = value;
    this.score = score;
    this.plus = plus;
  }
}

/** 一次完整计算。 */
export class FitCalc {
  rows: FitRow[] = [];
  /** 标准分（Σ 单项分×权重/100，1 位小数）。 */
  std: number = 0;
  plus: number = 0;
  total: number = 0;
  totalText: string = '';
  /** 等级：优秀/良好/及格/不及格。 */
  grade: string = '';
  miss: number = 0;
  /** 已填项权重合计。 */
  wtDone: number = 0;
  sex: FitSex = FitSex.MALE;
  gradeBucket: FitGrade = FitGrade.G12;
  h: number | undefined = undefined;
  w: number | undefined = undefined;
  bmi: number | undefined = undefined;
  bmiCategory: string = '';
}

/** 历史记录里的成绩字段（9 项字符串，与 fitrecs.data.fields 一致）。 */
export class FitFields {
  h: string = '';
  w: string = '';
  vc: string = '';
  r50: string = '';
  sit: string = '';
  jump: string = '';
  pull: string = '';
  durM: string = '';
  durS: string = '';

  isEmpty(): boolean {
    return this.h.trim().length === 0 && this.w.trim().length === 0 && this.vc.trim().length === 0
      && this.r50.trim().length === 0 && this.sit.trim().length === 0 && this.jump.trim().length === 0
      && this.pull.trim().length === 0 && this.durM.trim().length === 0 && this.durS.trim().length === 0;
  }

  valueOf(key: string): string {
    if (key === 'h') {
      return this.h;
    }
    if (key === 'w') {
      return this.w;
    }
    if (key === 'vc') {
      return this.vc;
    }
    if (key === 'r50') {
      return this.r50;
    }
    if (key === 'sit') {
      return this.sit;
    }
    if (key === 'jump') {
      return this.jump;
    }
    if (key === 'pull') {
      return this.pull;
    }
    if (key === 'durM') {
      return this.durM;
    }
    if (key === 'durS') {
      return this.durS;
    }
    return '';
  }
}

/**
 * 一条体测历史记录（= `fitrecs.data` JSON 解析后的结构；本机/云端最多 2 条）。
 * 序列化字段：`id, ts, n, sex, gr, fields, total, grade`。
 */
export class FitRecord {
  static readonly MAX_RECORDS: number = 2;

  id: string = '';
  ts: number = 0;
  name: string = '';
  sex: string = 'm';
  gradeBucket: string = '12';
  fields: FitFields = new FitFields();
  total: number | undefined = undefined;
  grade: string = '';
  syncPending: boolean = false;

  sexEnum(): FitSex {
    return fitSexFromWire(this.sex);
  }

  gradeEnum(): FitGrade {
    return fitGradeFromWire(this.gradeBucket);
  }

  displayName(): string {
    return this.name.trim().length > 0 ? this.name : '体测 ' + this.timeText();
  }

  /** `MM-dd HH:mm`（本地时区）。 */
  timeText(): string {
    if (this.ts <= 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(this.ts);
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  totalText(): string {
    return this.total !== undefined ? this.total.toFixed(1) : '—';
  }

  /** 成绩明细（与小程序 recDetail 文案一致）。 */
  detailText(): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    const f: FitFields = this.fields;
    if (f.h.trim().length > 0) {
      parts.push('身高 ' + f.h + 'cm');
    }
    if (f.w.trim().length > 0) {
      parts.push('体重 ' + f.w + 'kg');
    }
    if (f.vc.trim().length > 0) {
      parts.push('肺活量 ' + f.vc + 'mL');
    }
    if (f.r50.trim().length > 0) {
      parts.push('50米 ' + f.r50 + 's');
    }
    if (f.sit.trim().length > 0) {
      parts.push('坐位 ' + f.sit + 'cm');
    }
    if (f.jump.trim().length > 0) {
      parts.push('跳远 ' + f.jump + 'cm');
    }
    if (f.pull.trim().length > 0) {
      parts.push((this.sexEnum() === FitSex.FEMALE ? '仰卧 ' : '引体 ') + f.pull + '次');
    }
    if (f.durM.trim().length > 0 || f.durS.trim().length > 0) {
      const m: string = f.durM.trim().length > 0 ? f.durM : '0';
      const s: string = pad2(Number(f.durS.trim().length > 0 ? f.durS : '0'));
      parts.push("长跑 " + m + "'" + s + '"');
    }
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(' · ') : '（无成绩明细）';
  }
}

/** 历史保存结果。 */
export class SavedHistory {
  records: FitRecord[] = [];
  dropped: FitRecord[] = [];
  merged: boolean = false;
  record: FitRecord | undefined = undefined;
}

/** 体测历史逻辑（纯函数，对齐小程序 saveRec/findMergeIndex）。 */
export class FitHistory {
  /** 旧记录的非空项是否都是新记录同项的子集（且旧记录至少有一项非空）。 */
  static isSubset(oldFields: FitFields, newFields: FitFields): boolean {
    let any: boolean = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < FitInput.KEYS.length; i++) {
      const key: string = FitInput.KEYS[i];
      const oldValue: string = oldFields.valueOf(key).trim();
      const newValue: string = newFields.valueOf(key).trim();
      if (oldValue.length > 0) {
        any = true;
        if (oldValue !== newValue) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    return any;
  }

  static findMergeIndex(records: FitRecord[], newFields: FitFields, sex: FitSex, grade: FitGrade): number {
    for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
      if (records[i].sexEnum() !== sex || records[i].gradeEnum() !== grade) {
        continue;
      }
      if (FitHistory.isSubset(records[i].fields, newFields)) {
        return i;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  /**
   * 保存一条记录：可合并则更新旧记录（移到最前）；否则新建；结果截断到 2 条（多出的进 dropped）。
   */
  static save(records: FitRecord[], input: FitInput, calc: FitCalc, id: string, now: number,
    name: string): SavedHistory {
    const fields: FitFields = input.toFields();
    const mergeAt: number = FitHistory.findMergeIndex(records, fields, input.sex, input.grade);
    const working: FitRecord[] = records.slice(0);
    const saved: SavedHistory = new SavedHistory();
    let mergedRecord: FitRecord;
    if (mergeAt >= 0) {
      const old: FitRecord = working[mergeAt];
      working.splice(mergeAt, 1);
      mergedRecord = old;
      mergedRecord.ts = now;
      if (old.name.trim().length === 0) {
        mergedRecord.name = name;
      }
      mergedRecord.sex = input.sex;
      mergedRecord.gradeBucket = input.grade;
      mergedRecord.fields = fields;
      mergedRecord.total = calc.total;
      mergedRecord.grade = calc.grade;
      mergedRecord.syncPending = true;
      saved.merged = true;
    } else {
      mergedRecord = new FitRecord();
      mergedRecord.id = id;
      mergedRecord.ts = now;
      mergedRecord.name = name;
      mergedRecord.sex = input.sex;
      mergedRecord.gradeBucket = input.grade;
      mergedRecord.fields = fields;
      mergedRecord.total = calc.total;
      mergedRecord.grade = calc.grade;
      mergedRecord.syncPending = true;
      saved.merged = false;
    }
    working.unshift(mergedRecord);
    saved.records = working.slice(0, FitRecord.MAX_RECORDS);
    saved.dropped = working.length > FitRecord.MAX_RECORDS ? working.slice(FitRecord.MAX_RECORDS) : [];
    saved.record = mergedRecord;
    return saved;
  }

  static deleteAt(records: FitRecord[], index: number): FitRecord[] {
    if (index < 0 || index >= records.length) {
      return records;
    }
    const out: FitRecord[] = records.slice(0);
    out.splice(index, 1);
    return out;
  }

  static renameAt(records: FitRecord[], index: number, newName: string): FitRecord[] {
    if (index < 0 || index >= records.length) {
      return records;
    }
    const name: string = newName.trim().substring(0, 24);
    if (name.length === 0) {
      return records;
    }
    const out: FitRecord[] = records.slice(0);
    out[index].name = name;
    return out;
  }

  static restoreAt(records: FitRecord[], index: number): FitInput | undefined {
    if (index < 0 || index >= records.length) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const record: FitRecord = records[index];
    return FitInput.fromFields(record.sexEnum(), record.gradeEnum(), record.fields);
  }
}

export function pad2(value: number): string {
  return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
}
import { FitCalc, FitFieldSpec, FitGrade, FitInput, FitRow, FitSex } from './FitModels';
import { FitPlusTable, FitScoreTable, FitTables } from './FitTables';

/**
 * 体测评分（纯函数，对齐 `mp-class-tools/utils/fit.js ftCalc()` / 网页 fit 实现）。
 *
 * 权重：BMI 15%、肺活量 15%、50m 20%、坐位体前屈 10%、立定跳远 10%、引体/仰卧 10%、长跑 20%（合计 100）；
 * 附加分 ≤20（引体/仰卧、1000/800m 加分表）；等级：≥90 优秀 / ≥80 良好 / ≥60 及格 / <60 不及格；
 * 未填项按缺项计（不计入标准分），并计入 miss。
 */
export class FitScoring {
  /** 数值文本解析：空/非法 → undefined（与 mp `ftNum` 一致）。 */
  static num(text: string): number | undefined {
    const s: string = text.trim();
    if (s.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const value: number = Number(s);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return value;
  }

  /** 长跑「分:秒」→ 秒（两者都空 → undefined；只有一个时另一个按 0）。 */
  static sec(minutesText: string, secondsText: string): number | undefined {
    const m: number | undefined = FitScoring.num(minutesText);
    const s: number | undefined = FitScoring.num(secondsText);
    if (m === undefined && s === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return (m !== undefined ? m : 0) * 60 + (s !== undefined ? s : 0);
  }

  /** 输入合法性：长跑只要求 >0 秒；其它按 FTRANGE；非法 → undefined（视为缺项）。 */
  static valid(key: string, value: number | undefined): number | undefined {
    if (value === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (key === 'dur') {
      return value > 0 ? value : undefined;
    }
    const range: number[] = FitTables.rangeOf(key);
    if (range.length !== 2) {
      return value;
    }
    return value >= range[0] && value <= range[1] ? value : undefined;
  }

  /** 单项得分：任一阈值命中即返回 SCORES[i]；都不命中 → 0。 */
  static scoreOf(table: FitScoreTable, value: number | undefined, sex: FitSex,
    grade: FitGrade): number | undefined {
    if (value === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const column: number[] = table.column(sex, grade);
    if (column.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < column.length; i++) {
      if (table.hi) {
        if (value >= column[i]) {
          return FitTables.SCORES[i];
        }
      } else if (value <= column[i]) {
        return FitTables.SCORES[i];
      }
    }
    return 0;
  }

  /** 附加分：gap 超过表中阈值则取对应加分（gap≤0 → 0）。 */
  static plusOf(table: FitPlusTable | undefined, gap: number): number {
    return table !== undefined ? table.plusFor(gap) : 0;
  }

  /** 秒 → `m'ss"`（与 mp `ftMS` 一致；undefined → `—`）。 */
  static ms(seconds: number | undefined): string {
    if (seconds === undefined) {
      return '—';
    }
    let m: number = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    let s: number = Math.round(seconds - m * 60);
    if (s >= 60) {
      m += 1;
      s -= 60;
    }
    return m + "'" + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s + '"';
  }

  /** 保留 1 位小数（四舍五入）。 */
  static round10(value: number): number {
    return Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
  }

  /** 主计算入口。 */
  static calc(input: FitInput): FitCalc {
    const sex: FitSex = input.sex;
    const grade: FitGrade = input.grade;
    const rows: FitRow[] = [];

    // 1) BMI（15%）
    const h: number | undefined = FitScoring.valid('h', FitScoring.num(input.h));
    const w: number | undefined = FitScoring.valid('w', FitScoring.num(input.w));
    let bmi: number | undefined = undefined;
    let bmiScore: number | undefined = undefined;
    let bmiCategory: string = '';
    if (h !== undefined && w !== undefined && h > 0 && w > 0) {
      const rawBmi: number = w / ((h / 100) * (h / 100));
      bmi = FitScoring.round10(rawBmi);
      const normalStart: number = FitTables.bmiNormalStart(sex);
      if (bmi < normalStart) {
        bmiScore = 80;
        bmiCategory = '低体重';
      } else if (bmi <= FitTables.BMI_NORMAL_END) {
        bmiScore = 100;
        bmiCategory = '正常';
      } else if (bmi <= FitTables.BMI_OBESE) {
        bmiScore = 80;
        bmiCategory = '超重';
      } else {
        bmiScore = 60;
        bmiCategory = '肥胖';
      }
    }
    const bmiRow: FitRow = new FitRow('体重指数', bmiCategory.length > 0 ? 'BMI · ' + bmiCategory : 'BMI',
      15, bmi !== undefined ? bmi.toFixed(1) : '—', bmiScore);
    rows.push(bmiRow);

    // 2) 肺活量（15%）/ 50m（20%）/ 坐位体前屈（10%）/ 立定跳远（10%）
    FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '肺活量', 'mL', 15, input.vc, FitScoring.num(input.vc), FitTables.VC,
      undefined, undefined, 'vc', sex, grade);
    FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '50 米跑', '秒', 20, input.r50, FitScoring.num(input.r50), FitTables.R50,
      undefined, undefined, 'r50', sex, grade);
    FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '坐位体前屈', 'cm', 10, input.sit, FitScoring.num(input.sit), FitTables.SIT,
      undefined, undefined, 'sit', sex, grade);
    FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '立定跳远', 'cm', 10, input.jump, FitScoring.num(input.jump), FitTables.JUMP,
      undefined, undefined, 'jump', sex, grade);

    // 3) 引体向上（男）/ 仰卧起坐（女）（10%，有加分）
    if (sex === FitSex.MALE) {
      const column: number[] = FitTables.PULL.column(sex, grade);
      FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '引体向上', '次', 10, input.pull, FitScoring.num(input.pull), FitTables.PULL,
        FitTables.PULL_PLUS, column[0], 'pull', sex, grade);
    } else {
      const column: number[] = FitTables.SUP.column(sex, grade);
      FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '1 分钟仰卧起坐', '次', 10, input.pull, FitScoring.num(input.pull), FitTables.SUP,
        FitTables.SUP_PLUS, column[0], 'pull', sex, grade);
    }

    // 4) 1000m（男）/ 800m（女）（20%，有加分）
    const durSeconds: number | undefined = FitScoring.valid('dur', FitScoring.sec(input.durM, input.durS));
    const hasDurInput: boolean = FitScoring.num(input.durM) !== undefined || FitScoring.num(input.durS) !== undefined;
    const durRaw: string = hasDurInput ? FitScoring.ms(FitScoring.sec(input.durM, input.durS)) : '';
    const durColumn: number[] = FitTables.DUR.column(sex, grade);
    if (sex === FitSex.MALE) {
      FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '1000 米跑', '分·秒', 20, durRaw, durSeconds, FitTables.DUR,
        FitTables.DUR_MALE_PLUS, durColumn[0], 'dur', sex, grade);
    } else {
      FitScoring.pushItem(rows, '800 米跑', '分·秒', 20, durRaw, durSeconds, FitTables.DUR,
        FitTables.DUR_FEMALE_PLUS, durColumn[0], 'dur', sex, grade);
    }

    // 汇总（由 finalize 统一按 rows 计算，避免重复累计）
    const calc: FitCalc = new FitCalc();
    calc.rows = rows;
    calc.sex = sex;
    calc.gradeBucket = grade;
    calc.h = h;
    calc.w = w;
    calc.bmi = bmi;
    calc.bmiCategory = bmiCategory.length > 0 ? bmiCategory : '';
    return FitScoring.finalize(calc);
  }

  /** BMI 行已单独累计；为保持与安卓一致，这里统一按 rows 重算并写回。 */
  private static finalize(calc: FitCalc): FitCalc {
    let std: number = 0;
    let plus: number = 0;
    let miss: number = 0;
    let wtDone: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < calc.rows.length; i++) {
      const row: FitRow = calc.rows[i];
      if (row.score === undefined) {
        miss += 1;
      } else {
        std += row.score * row.weight / 100;
        plus += row.plus;
        wtDone += row.weight;
      }
    }
    calc.std = FitScoring.round10(std);
    calc.plus = FitScoring.round10(plus);
    calc.total = FitScoring.round10(calc.std + calc.plus);
    calc.totalText = calc.total.toFixed(1);
    calc.miss = miss;
    calc.wtDone = wtDone;
    if (calc.total >= 90) {
      calc.grade = '优秀';
    } else if (calc.total >= 80) {
      calc.grade = '良好';
    } else if (calc.total >= 60) {
      calc.grade = '及格';
    } else {
      calc.grade = '不及格';
    }
    return calc;
  }

  /** 输入清洗：数字字段只保留数字/小数/负号（坐位体前屈允许负），按小数位截断。 */
  static sanitizeInput(text: string, spec: FitFieldSpec): string {
    let filtered: string = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      const ch: string = text.charAt(i);
      const code: number = text.charCodeAt(i);
      if (code >= 48 && code <= 57) {
        filtered += ch;
      } else if (ch === '.' && filtered.indexOf('.') < 0) {
        filtered += ch;
      } else if (ch === '-' && spec.allowNegative && filtered.length === 0) {
        filtered += ch;
      }
    }
    if (spec.decimals === 0) {
      const dot: number = filtered.indexOf('.');
      return dot >= 0 ? filtered.substring(0, dot) : filtered;
    }
    const dot: number = filtered.indexOf('.');
    if (dot < 0) {
      return filtered;
    }
    const decimals: string = filtered.substring(dot + 1);
    return filtered.substring(0, dot + 1) + decimals.substring(0, spec.decimals);
  }

  private static pushItem(rows: FitRow[], name: string, unit: string, weight: number, raw: string,
    value: number | undefined, table: FitScoreTable, plusTable: FitPlusTable | undefined,
    topThreshold: number | undefined, key: string, sex: FitSex, grade: FitGrade): void {
    const validValue: number | undefined = FitScoring.valid(key, value);
    const score: number | undefined = FitScoring.scoreOf(table, validValue, sex, grade);
    let plusPoint: number = 0;
    if (score !== undefined && plusTable !== undefined && topThreshold !== undefined && validValue !== undefined) {
      const gap: number = table.hi ? validValue - topThreshold : topThreshold - validValue;
      plusPoint = FitScoring.plusOf(plusTable, gap);
    }
    rows.push(new FitRow(name, unit, weight, raw.trim().length > 0 ? raw : '—', score, plusPoint));
  }
}
import { FitGrade, FitSex } from './FitModels';

/** 单项评分表：`hi=true` 越大越好（v>=阈值命中），否则越小越好（v<=阈值命中）。 */
export class FitScoreTable {
  hi: boolean;
  m12: number[];
  m34: number[];
  f12: number[];
  f34: number[];

  constructor(hi: boolean, m12: number[] = [], m34: number[] = [], f12: number[] = [], f34: number[] = []) {
    this.hi = hi;
    this.m12 = m12;
    this.m34 = m34;
    this.f12 = f12;
    this.f34 = f34;
  }

  column(sex: FitSex, grade: FitGrade): number[] {
    if (sex === FitSex.MALE) {
      return grade === FitGrade.G12 ? this.m12 : this.m34;
    }
    return grade === FitGrade.G12 ? this.f12 : this.f34;
  }
}

/** 加分表：`[超出量, 加分]`（从大到小）。 */
export class FitPlusTable {
  rows: number[][];

  constructor(rows: number[][]) {
    this.rows = rows;
  }

  plusFor(gap: number): number {
    if (gap <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < this.rows.length; i++) {
      if (gap >= this.rows[i][0]) {
        return this.rows[i][1];
      }
    }
    return 0;
  }
}

/**

  /** 1 分钟仰卧起坐（女）。 */

    [],
    [],
    [56, 54, 52, 49, 46, 44, 42, 40, 38, 36, 34, 32, 30, 28, 26, 24, 22, 20, 18, 16],
    [57, 55, 53, 50, 47, 45, 43, 41, 39, 37, 35, 33, 31, 29, 27, 25, 23, 21, 19, 17]);

  /** 1000 米（男）/ 800 米（女），单位：秒。 */
  static readonly DUR: FitScoreTable = new FitScoreTable(false,
    [197, 202, 207, 214, 222, 227, 232, 237, 242, 247, 252, 257, 262, 267, 272, 292, 312, 332, 352, 372],
    [195, 200, 205, 212, 220, 225, 230, 235, 240, 245, 250, 255, 260, 265, 270, 290, 310, 330, 350, 370],
    [198, 204, 210, 217, 224, 229, 234, 239, 244, 249, 254, 259, 264, 269, 274, 284, 294, 304, 314, 324],
    [196, 202, 208, 215, 222, 227, 232, 237, 242, 247, 252, 257, 262, 267, 272, 282, 292, 302, 312, 322]);

  static readonly PULL_PLUS: FitPlusTable = new FitPlusTable([
    [10, 10], [9, 9], [8, 8], [7, 7], [6, 6], [5, 5], [4, 4], [3, 3], [2, 2], [1, 1]
  ]);

  static readonly SUP_PLUS: FitPlusTable = new FitPlusTable([
    [13, 10], [12, 9], [11, 8], [10, 7], [9, 6], [8, 5], [7, 4], [6, 3], [4, 2], [2, 1]
  ]);

  static readonly DUR_MALE_PLUS: FitPlusTable = new FitPlusTable([
    [35, 10], [32, 9], [29, 8], [26, 7], [23, 6], [20, 5], [16, 4], [12, 3], [8, 2], [4, 1]
  ]);

  static readonly DUR_FEMALE_PLUS: FitPlusTable = new FitPlusTable([
    [50, 10], [45, 9], [40, 8], [35, 7], [30, 6], [25, 5], [20, 4], [15, 3], [10, 2], [5, 1]
  ]);

  /** BMI 正常区间下/上界（男 17.9–23.9，女 17.2–23.9）。 */
  static bmiNormalStart(sex: FitSex): number {
    return sex === FitSex.MALE ? 17.9 : 17.2;
  }

  static readonly BMI_NORMAL_END: number = 23.9;
  static readonly BMI_OBESE: number = 27.9;

  /** 输入合法区间（dur 单独规则：>0 秒即可）。 */
  static rangeOf(key: string): number[] {
    if (key === 'h') {
      return [100, 250];
    }
    if (key === 'w') {
      return [25, 200];
    }
    if (key === 'vc') {
      return [500, 8000];
    }
    if (key === 'r50') {
      return [3, 15];
    }
    if (key === 'sit') {
      return [-20, 40];
    }
    if (key === 'jump') {
      return [50, 350];
    }
    if (key === 'pull') {
      return [0, 100];
    }
    return [];
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { GroupConfig, GroupMode, groupModeFromWire, GroupSource, groupSourceFromWire } from './GroupModels';

/**
 * `userdata.group` section 编解码（契约 USERDATA_V6.md §1.2）：
 *
 * `{ "source": "prev", "mode": "groups", "n": 4, "shuffle": false, "sel": [1,3,5] }`
 *
 * 规则：source 兼容 `pick/paste/roster` → names；mode 兼容 `per/size` → pergroup；
 * `sel` 只保留 1..99 整数、去重升序；未知字段写入时原样保留。
 */
export class GroupConfigCodec {
  static fromJson(section: JsonValue | undefined): GroupConfig {
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(section);
    const config: GroupConfig = new GroupConfig();
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return config;
    }
    config.source = groupSourceFromWire(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'source'), ''));
    config.mode = groupModeFromWire(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'mode'), ''));
    const n: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'n'), GroupConfig.DEFAULT_N);
    config.n = Math.round(n);
    config.shuffle = GroupConfigCodec.readBool(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'shuffle'));
    config.selectedSeats = GroupConfigCodec.readSeats(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'sel'));
    return config;
  }

  /** 输出固定字段顺序（source/mode/n/shuffle/sel），保留未知字段（如以后新增的字段）。 */
  static toJson(config: GroupConfig, existing?: Blob): Blob {
    const seats: number[] = GroupConfigCodec.normalizeSeats(config.selectedSeats);
    const out: Blob = {
      'source': config.source,
      'mode': config.mode,
      'n': Math.round(config.n),
      'shuffle': config.shuffle,
      'sel': GroupConfigCodec.seatsToObjects(seats)
    };
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(existing);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        const key: string = keys[i];
        if (JsonBlob.get(out, key) === undefined) {
          out[key] = existing[key];
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  static empty(): Blob {
    return GroupConfigCodec.toJson(new GroupConfig());
  }

  static normalizeSeats(seats: number[]): number[] {
    const set: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
    for (let i = 0; i < seats.length; i++) {
      const seat: number = Math.round(seats[i]);
      if (seat >= 1 && seat <= 99) {
        set.add(seat);
      }
    }
    const out: number[] = [];
    set.forEach((seat: number) => {
      out.push(seat);
    });
    out.sort((a: number, b: number) => a - b);
    return out;
  }

  /** 兼容 true 与字符串 "true"（小程序旧数据把 bool 存成字符串）。 */
  private static readBool(value: JsonValue | undefined): boolean {
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
      return value as boolean;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      return (value as string).toLowerCase() === 'true';
    }
    return false;
  }

  private static readSeats(value: JsonValue | undefined): number[] {    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(value);
    if (array === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    const seats: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
      const raw: JsonValue | undefined = array[i];
      let seat: number = Number.NaN;
      if (typeof raw === 'number') {
        seat = raw as number;
      } else if (typeof raw === 'string') {
        seat = Number((raw as string).trim());
      }
      if (Number.isFinite(seat)) {
        seats.push(Math.round(seat));
      }
    }
    return GroupConfigCodec.normalizeSeats(seats);
  }

  private static seatsToObjects(seats: number[]): Object[] {
    const out: Object[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < seats.length; i++) {
      out.push(seats[i]);
    }
    return out;
  }
}
import {
  GroupConfig,
  GroupConfigSnapshot,
  GroupError,
  GroupErrorCode,
  GroupMember,
  GroupMode,
  GroupResult,
  GroupSource,
  GroupValidation,
  MemberGroup
} from './GroupModels';

/** 分组随机源（可注入 seed，便于单测复现）。 */
export interface GroupRandom {
  nextInt(bound: number): number;
}

/** 固定 seed 的随机源（mulberry32，与抽签同算法）。 */
export class SeededGroupRandom implements GroupRandom {
  private state: number = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.state = (seed >>> 0);
  }

  nextInt(bound: number): number {
    if (bound <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    this.state = (this.state + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0;
    let t: number = this.state;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t = (t ^ (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61))) >>> 0;
    const unit: number = ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    return Math.floor(unit * bound);
  }
}

export function defaultGroupRandom(): GroupRandom {
  return new SeededGroupRandom(Date.now() % 2147483647);
}

/**
 * 分组引擎（纯函数，与小程序 `doGroup()` 同算法）：
 * 1. 组数：`groups` 模式 = clamp(n, 2, 成员数)；`pergroup` 模式 = ceil(成员数 / n)；
 * 2. 可选打乱：Fisher-Yates；
 * 3. 轮流分配 `out[i % groups].push(member)` → 各组人数差 ≤1（均衡）；
 * 4. 生成参数快照（导出/摘要用）。
 */
export class GroupEngine {
  /** 计算实际组数（供 UI 预览「将分成 N 组」）。 */
  static groupCount(memberCount: number, config: GroupConfig): number {
    if (memberCount <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (config.mode === GroupMode.PER_GROUP) {
      const per: number = Math.min(Math.max(config.n, GroupConfig.MIN_PER_GROUP), GroupConfig.MAX_PER_GROUP);
      return Math.max(Math.ceil(memberCount / per), 1);
    }
    return Math.min(Math.max(config.n, GroupConfig.MIN_GROUPS), Math.max(GroupConfig.MIN_GROUPS, memberCount));
  }

  /** 执行分组。成员为空时返回空结果（调用方应先校验）。 */
  static group(members: GroupMember[], config: GroupConfig, random: GroupRandom): GroupResult {
    const list: GroupMember[] = config.shuffle ? GroupEngine.shuffle(members, random) : members.slice(0);
    const groups: number = GroupEngine.groupCount(list.length, config);
    const buckets: GroupMember[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < groups; i++) {
      buckets.push([]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (groups > 0) {
        buckets[i % groups].push(list[i]);
      }
    }
    const resultGroups: MemberGroup[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {
      resultGroups.push(new MemberGroup(i + 1, buckets[i]));
    }
    const result: GroupResult = new GroupResult();
    result.groups = resultGroups;
    result.config = config.copy();
    result.snapshot = GroupEngine.snapshotOf(config, resultGroups);
    return result;
  }

  /** Fisher-Yates（返回副本）。 */
  static shuffle(members: GroupMember[], random: GroupRandom): GroupMember[] {
    const list: GroupMember[] = members.slice(0);
    for (let i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j: number = Math.min(Math.max(random.nextInt(i + 1), 0), i);
      const tmp: GroupMember = list[i];
      list[i] = list[j];
      list[j] = tmp;
    }
    return list;
  }

  /** 参数快照（文案与 web/mp `cfg` 一致）。 */
  static snapshotOf(config: GroupConfig, groups: MemberGroup[]): GroupConfigSnapshot {
    let total: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
      total += groups[i].members.length;
    }
    const snapshot: GroupConfigSnapshot = new GroupConfigSnapshot();
    snapshot.total = total;
    snapshot.groupCount = groups.length;
    snapshot.sourceLabel = config.source === GroupSource.NAMES
      ? '班级名单（' + total + ' 人）'
      : '上一步抽签序号';
    snapshot.modeLabel = config.mode === GroupMode.PER_GROUP
      ? '按每组人数(' + config.n + ' 人)'
      : '按组数(' + groups.length + ' 组)';
    snapshot.innerLabel = config.shuffle ? '打乱后随机分配' : '按原顺序轮流分配';
    return snapshot;
  }

  /** 校验来源成员与参数（配置 → 结果前调用）。 */
  static validate(members: GroupMember[], config: GroupConfig): GroupValidation {
    if (members.length === 0) {
      if (config.source === GroupSource.NAMES && config.selectedSeats.length === 0) {
        return GroupValidation.invalid(new GroupError(GroupErrorCode.ROSTER_EMPTY, '请先选择班级名单'));
      }
      return GroupValidation.invalid(new GroupError(GroupErrorCode.NO_MEMBERS, '没有可分组的成员，请先抽签或选择名单'));
    }
    if (members.length < 2) {
      return GroupValidation.invalid(new GroupError(GroupErrorCode.MEMBERS_TOO_FEW, '成员不足 2 人，无法分组'));
    }
    if (config.mode === GroupMode.GROUPS) {
      const n: number = config.normalizedN(members.length);
      if (n < GroupConfig.MIN_GROUPS || n > members.length) {
        return GroupValidation.invalid(new GroupError(GroupErrorCode.COUNT_INVALID, '组数需在 2–' + members.length + ' 之间'));
      }
    } else if (config.n < GroupConfig.MIN_PER_GROUP || config.n > GroupConfig.MAX_PER_GROUP) {
      return GroupValidation.invalid(new GroupError(GroupErrorCode.COUNT_INVALID,
        '每组人数需在 ' + GroupConfig.MIN_PER_GROUP + '–' + GroupConfig.MAX_PER_GROUP + ' 之间'));
    }
    return GroupValidation.valid(members);
  }
}
/** 成员来源。 */
export enum GroupSource {
  /** 上一步抽签结果（带序号/可选姓名）。 */
  PREV = 'prev',
  /** 班级名单（按座号选择）。 */
  NAMES = 'names'
}

export function groupSourceFromWire(wire: string): GroupSource {
  const v: string = wire.trim();
  if (v === 'names' || v === 'pick' || v === 'paste' || v === 'roster') {
    return GroupSource.NAMES;
  }
  return GroupSource.PREV;
}

export function groupSourceLabel(source: GroupSource): string {
  return source === GroupSource.NAMES ? '班级名单' : '上一步抽签序号';
}

/** 分组方式。 */
export enum GroupMode {
  GROUPS = 'groups',
  PER_GROUP = 'pergroup'
}

export function groupModeFromWire(wire: string): GroupMode {
  const v: string = wire.trim();
  if (v === 'pergroup' || v === 'per' || v === 'size') {
    return GroupMode.PER_GROUP;
  }
  return GroupMode.GROUPS;
}

export function groupModeLabel(mode: GroupMode): string {
  return mode === GroupMode.PER_GROUP ? '按每组人数' : '按组数';
}

/** 一个可分组的学生：座号 + 可选姓名。 */
export class GroupMember {
  seat: number = 0;
  name: string = '';

  constructor(seat: number = 0, name: string = '') {
    this.seat = seat;
    this.name = name;
  }

  label(): string {
    return this.name.length > 0 ? this.seat + ' ' + this.name : '' + this.seat;
  }
}

/** 分组参数（表单状态 + userdata.group 持久化唯一真源）。 */
export class GroupConfig {
  static readonly DEFAULT_N: number = 4;
  static readonly MIN_GROUPS: number = 2;
  static readonly MIN_PER_GROUP: number = 1;
  static readonly MAX_PER_GROUP: number = 99;

  source: GroupSource = GroupSource.PREV;
  mode: GroupMode = GroupMode.GROUPS;
  /** 组数（GROUPS）或每组人数（PER_GROUP）。 */
  n: number = GroupConfig.DEFAULT_N;
  /** 是否打乱成员再分组（Fisher-Yates）。 */
  shuffle: boolean = false;
  /** 班级名单来源时已选座号（升序去重；blob 原样保存）。 */
  selectedSeats: number[] = [];

  copy(): GroupConfig {
    const next: GroupConfig = new GroupConfig();
    next.source = this.source;
    next.mode = this.mode;
    next.n = this.n;
    next.shuffle = this.shuffle;
    next.selectedSeats = this.selectedSeats.slice(0);
    return next;
  }

  /** 规范化 n：GROUPS 夹到 [2, 成员数]，PER_GROUP 夹到 [1, 99]。 */
  normalizedN(memberCount: number): number {
    if (this.mode === GroupMode.PER_GROUP) {
      return Math.min(Math.max(this.n, GroupConfig.MIN_PER_GROUP), GroupConfig.MAX_PER_GROUP);
    }
    const upper: number = Math.max(GroupConfig.MIN_GROUPS, memberCount);
    return Math.min(Math.max(this.n, GroupConfig.MIN_GROUPS), upper);
  }
}

/** 一组结果（index 从 1 开始）。 */
export class MemberGroup {
  index: number = 1;
  members: GroupMember[] = [];

  constructor(index: number = 1, members: GroupMember[] = []) {
    this.index = index;
    this.members = members;
  }

  size(): number {
    return this.members.length;
  }

  label(): string {
    return '第 ' + this.index + ' 组';
  }
}

/** 分组参数快照（导出卡参数区 + 结果页摘要）。 */
export class GroupConfigSnapshot {
  sourceLabel: string = '';
  modeLabel: string = '';
  total: number = 0;
  groupCount: number = 0;
  innerLabel: string = '';
}

/** 一次分组结果。 */
export class GroupResult {
  groups: MemberGroup[] = [];
  config: GroupConfig = new GroupConfig();
  snapshot: GroupConfigSnapshot = new GroupConfigSnapshot();

  totalMembers(): number {
    let sum: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.groups.length; i++) {
      sum += this.groups[i].members.length;
    }
    return sum;
  }
}

/** 分组向导步骤（配置 → 结果）。 */
export enum GroupStep {
  CONFIG = 1,
  RESULT = 2
}

/** 向导状态。 */
export class GroupWorkflowState {
  step: GroupStep = GroupStep.CONFIG;
  config: GroupConfig = new GroupConfig();
  result: GroupResult | undefined = undefined;

  copy(): GroupWorkflowState {
    const next: GroupWorkflowState = new GroupWorkflowState();
    next.step = this.step;
    next.config = this.config.copy();
    next.result = this.result;
    return next;
  }
}

export enum GroupErrorCode {
  NO_MEMBERS = 'no_members',
  MEMBERS_TOO_FEW = 'members_too_few',
  COUNT_INVALID = 'count_invalid',
  ROSTER_EMPTY = 'roster_empty',
  INVALID_STEP = 'invalid_step'
}

export class GroupError {
  code: GroupErrorCode;
  message: string;

  constructor(code: GroupErrorCode, message: string) {
    this.code = code;
    this.message = message;
  }
}

export class GroupValidation {
  ok: boolean;
  members: GroupMember[];
  error: GroupError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, members: GroupMember[], error: GroupError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.members = members;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static valid(members: GroupMember[]): GroupValidation {
    return new GroupValidation(true, members, undefined);
  }

  static invalid(error: GroupError): GroupValidation {
    return new GroupValidation(false, [], error);
  }
}

export class GroupTransition {
  ok: boolean;
  state: GroupWorkflowState | undefined;
  error: GroupError | undefined;

  constructor(ok: boolean, state: GroupWorkflowState | undefined, error: GroupError | undefined) {
    this.ok = ok;
    this.state = state;
    this.error = error;
  }

  static next(state: GroupWorkflowState): GroupTransition {
    return new GroupTransition(true, state, undefined);
  }

  static rejected(error: GroupError): GroupTransition {
    return new GroupTransition(false, undefined, error);
  }
}
import { HomeworkDueCalculator, HomeworkRow } from '../../data/homework/HomeworkModels';
import { NoticeCard } from '../notices/NoticeCards';
import { NoticeSection } from '../notices/NoticeRecurrence';
import { PowerStats } from '../../data/power/PowerModels';

/** 工作台卡片里的一条轮换项（作业 / 通知）。 */
export class HomeCardItem {
  title: string = '';
  sub: string = '';
}

/** 工作台数据整理（与小程序 pages/index 同口径的纯函数）。 */
export class HomeDigest {
  static hello(hour: number): string {
    if (hour < 6) {
      return '夜深了';
    }
    if (hour < 11) {
      return '早上好';
    }
    if (hour < 14) {
      return '中午好';
    }
    if (hour < 18) {
      return '下午好';
    }
    return '晚上好';
  }

  static pad2(value: number): string {
    return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
  }

  static dateText(now: Date): string {
    return now.getFullYear() + '-' + HomeDigest.pad2(now.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + HomeDigest.pad2(now.getDate());
  }

  static weekText(week: number | undefined): string {
    return week !== undefined && week > 0 ? '第 ' + week + ' 周' : '';
  }

  /** 待交作业：未完成、未隐藏（本端无 hide 数据）、截止升序（无截止排最后）。 */
  static hwOpen(rows: HomeworkRow[], isDone: (id: string) => boolean,
    isHidden: (id: string) => boolean = (id: string) => false): HomeworkRow[] {
    const out: HomeworkRow[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (!isDone(rows[i].id) && !isHidden(rows[i].id)) {
        out.push(rows[i]);
      }
    }
    out.sort((a: HomeworkRow, b: HomeworkRow) => {
      const x: number | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue(a.date, a.time);
      const y: number | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue(b.date, b.time);
      if (x === undefined && y === undefined) {
        return 0;
      }
      if (x === undefined) {
        return 1;
      }
      if (y === undefined) {
        return -1;
      }
      return x - y;
    });
    return out;
  }

  /** 作业轮换项（≤5 条，标题截断 18 字，副标题为截止信息）。 */
  static hwItems(rows: HomeworkRow[], max: number = 5): HomeCardItem[] {
    const out: HomeCardItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length && i < max; i++) {
      const row: HomeworkRow = rows[i];
      const item: HomeCardItem = new HomeCardItem();
      item.title = HomeDigest.shortTitle(row.subject.length > 0 ? row.subject : row.content);
      const due: number | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue(row.date, row.time);
      item.sub = due !== undefined ? '截止 ' + HomeworkDueCalculator.dueText(due) : '';
      out.push(item);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static shortTitle(text: string, max: number = 18): string {
    const trimmed: string = text.trim();
    if (trimmed.length <= max) {
      return trimmed;
    }
    return trimmed.substring(0, max) + '…';
  }

  /** 待处理通知卡（未处理、非定义卡），按 sortAt 排序。 */
  static ntOpen(cards: NoticeCard[], isDone: (key: string) => boolean): NoticeCard[] {
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = cards[i];
      if (card.definition || card.section === NoticeSection.MATERIAL || card.section === NoticeSection.EXPIRED) {
        continue;
      }
      if (isDone(card.key)) {
        continue;
      }
      out.push(card);
    }
    out.sort((a: NoticeCard, b: NoticeCard) => a.sortAt - b.sortAt);
    return out;
  }

  static ntPending(cards: NoticeCard[], isDone: (key: string) => boolean): number {
    return HomeDigest.ntOpen(cards, isDone).length;
  }

  static ntItems(cards: NoticeCard[], isDone: (key: string) => boolean, max: number = 5): HomeCardItem[] {
    const open: NoticeCard[] = HomeDigest.ntOpen(cards, isDone);
    const out: HomeCardItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < open.length && i < max; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = open[i];
      const item: HomeCardItem = new HomeCardItem();
      item.title = HomeDigest.shortTitle(card.title.length > 0 ? card.title : '班级通知');
      item.sub = card.occurrence ? card.label : (card.dueText.length > 0 ? card.dueText : card.timeText);
      out.push(item);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 电费状态：q < low 低电；low ≤ q < 2*low 偏低；其余充足；无数据 idle。 */
  static powerState(q: number, hasValue: boolean, low: number): string {
    if (!hasValue) {
      return 'idle';
    }
    const threshold: number = low > 0 ? low : 30;
    if (q < threshold) {
      return 'low';
    }
    if (q < threshold * 2) {
      return 'warn';
    }
    return 'ok';
  }

  static powerStateText(state: string): string {
    if (state === 'low') {
      return '低电';
    }
    if (state === 'warn') {
      return '偏低';
    }
    if (state === 'ok') {
      return '充足';
    }
    return '未选择';
  }

  static powerQText(q: number, hasValue: boolean): string {
    return PowerStats.fmtMain(q, hasValue);
  }

  /** 更新时间显示：`MM-dd HH:mm`；无值返回空串。 */
  static updText(updatedAt: string): string {
    if (updatedAt.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const parsed: number = Date.parse(updatedAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(parsed);
    return HomeDigest.pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + HomeDigest.pad2(d.getDate())
      + ' ' + HomeDigest.pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + HomeDigest.pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  static rotate(count: number, index: number): number {
    if (count <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return (index + 1) % count;
  }
}
/** 昵称规则（userdata.nick 字符串，跨端同步）。 */
export class NickLogic {
  static readonly MAX: number = 16;

  /** 去首尾空白、压缩连续空格、截断到 16 字符；空串 = 清除昵称。 */
  static normalize(raw: string): string {
    const trimmed: string = raw.trim();
    const parts: string[] = trimmed.split(' ');
    const words: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      if (parts[i].length > 0) {
        words.push(parts[i]);
      }
    }
    let text: string = words.join(' ');
    if (text.length > NickLogic.MAX) {
      text = text.substring(0, NickLogic.MAX);
    }
    return text;
  }

  static display(nick: string, fallback: string): string {
    const value: string = NickLogic.normalize(nick);
    return value.length > 0 ? value : fallback;
  }
}
/**
 * 本机教务密码的纯逻辑（不 import 安全存储，hypium 可直接测）。
 *
 * 为什么需要：教务登录需要「本机保存的教务密码」。
 * 存储实现见 `data/jw/JwCredentialStore.ets`（HarmonyOS Asset Store，应用私有 + 系统加密）。
 *
 * 红线：密码只在本机安全存储与内存中出现；**不参与 userdata 云同步、不上传、不写日志、不导出**；
 * 别名不含学号明文（FNV-1a 指纹），避免存储条目本身泄漏学号。
 */
export class JwCredentialLogic {
  /** 存储别名前缀（版本化，便于以后换存储实现时清理）。 */
  static readonly ALIAS_PREFIX: string = 'jw_pwd_v1_';

  /** 密码最大长度（与 CAS 输入框 maxlength 一致）。 */
  static readonly MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH: number = 32;

  /** 保存说明（界面唯一一句说明）。 */
  static readonly STORAGE_NOTE: string =
    '密码只保存在本机安全存储（应用私有、系统加密），用于教务登录自动填充；不上传、不参与云同步。';

  /** 别名：学号 FNV-1a 指纹（不含学号明文；同 sid 稳定，不同 sid 不同）。 */
  static aliasOf(sid: string): string {
    const text: string = sid.trim();
    let hash: number = 0x811C9DC5;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      hash = hash ^ text.charCodeAt(i);
      // FNV-1a 32 位乘法（用 16 位拆分避免浮点精度损失）
      hash = (hash + ((hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24))) >>> 0;
    }
    let hex: string = hash.toString(16);
    while (hex.length < 8) {
      hex = '0' + hex;
    }
    return JwCredentialLogic.ALIAS_PREFIX + hex;
  }

  /** 密码校验：合法返回空串，否则返回可直接展示的中文提示。 */
  static validatePassword(password: string): string {
    if (password.length === 0) {
      return '请输入教务密码';
    }
    if (password.length > JwCredentialLogic.MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
      return '密码过长（最多 ' + JwCredentialLogic.MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH + ' 位）';
    }
    return '';
  }

  /** 是否可自动填充：有学号 + 本机已保存密码。 */
  static canAutoFill(sid: string, hasSavedCredential: boolean): boolean {
    return sid.trim().length > 0 && hasSavedCredential;
  }

  /** 本机凭据状态文案。 */
  static savedStateText(hasSavedCredential: boolean): string {
    return hasSavedCredential ? '已保存到本机' : '本机未保存';
  }

  /** 保存按钮文案（已保存 → 更新）。 */
  static saveButtonText(hasSavedCredential: boolean): string {
    return hasSavedCredential ? '更新密码' : '保存密码';
  }

  /** 清除按钮是否可见（只有已保存时才给「清除」）。 */
  static showClearButton(hasSavedCredential: boolean): boolean {
    return hasSavedCredential;
  }

  /** 密码脱敏展示（仅用于调试/单测，UI 不展示密码本身）：固定 `••••••`。 */
  static masked(): string {
    return '••••••';
  }
}

/** 教务页文案（纯函数，可单测）。 */
export class JwLogic {
  /** 周次文案：`第 13 周` / `学期未开始` / `—`。 */
  static weekText(week: number | undefined, hasData: boolean): string {
    if (week !== undefined && week > 0) {
      return '第 ' + week + ' 周';
    }
    return hasData ? '学期未开始' : '—';
  }

  /** 下一节课文案：`周一 11-23 08:10 思想道德与法治`。 */
  static nextText(dayText: string, dateText: string, startText: string, name: string): string {
    if (name.length === 0) {
      return '暂无后续课程';
    }
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (dayText.length > 0) {
      parts.push(dayText);
    }
    if (dateText.length > 0) {
      parts.push(dateText);
    }
    if (startText.length > 0) {
      parts.push(startText);
    }
    parts.push(name);
    return parts.join(' ');
  }

  /** 今日课程汇总：`3 节 · 下一节 14:30 英语1`。 */
  static todayText(count: number, nextStart: string, nextName: string): string {
    if (count <= 0) {
      return '今天没有课';
    }
    if (nextName.length === 0) {
      return count + ' 节 · 今日已结束';
    }
    return count + ' 节 · 下一节 ' + nextStart + ' ' + nextName;
  }

  /** 入口说明（避免误导：不做账号密码登录）。 */
  static loginHint(): string {
    return '首次登录请在浏览器勾选「保存密码」，之后打开即自动填充';
  }
}
/**
 * 校园 2.5D 地图：H5 地址与降级逻辑（纯逻辑，可单测）。
 *
 * 数据源与安卓/网页同源：ECS H5 `map/campus_final_25d.html`（唯一数据源，不在原生侧重写 canvas）。
 * 顶栏要求：返回 / 刷新 / 浏览器降级；主文档加载失败时给出「重试 + 浏览器打开」。
 *
 * 备案完成、`tool.furina.fun` 恢复后，只需把 [ECS_BASE] 换成同源 https 地址（单点改动）。
 */
export class MapConfig {
  /** ECS 调试入口（备案前公网唯一入口）。 */
  static readonly ECS_BASE: string = 'http://121.196.47.2';

  /** H5 相对路径。 */
  static readonly PAGE_PATH: string = '/map/campus_final_25d.html';

  /** 嵌入参数（H5 据此隐藏站内导航，交给 App 顶栏）。 */
  static readonly EMBED_QUERY: string = 'embed=1';
}

/** 地图页加载状态。 */
export enum MapLoadState {
  LOADING = 'loading',
  READY = 'ready',
  FAILED = 'failed'
}

/** 地图页纯逻辑（URL / allowlist / 状态文案），不 import ArkUI。 */
export class MapLogic {
  /** 主页面 URL：`.../campus_final_25d.html?embed=1`。 */
  static pageUrl(): string {
    return MapConfig.ECS_BASE + MapConfig.PAGE_PATH + '?' + MapConfig.EMBED_QUERY;
  }

  /** 主文档 host（用于 Web 内部导航 allowlist）。 */
  static host(): string {
    return '121.196.47.2';
  }

  /** 仅允许 ECS 主机下的 http(s) 页面继续在 Web 内加载；其它交给系统浏览器。 */
  static isAllowedNavigation(url: string): boolean {
    const trimmed: string = url.trim();
    if (!trimmed.toLowerCase().startsWith('http://') && !trimmed.toLowerCase().startsWith('https://')) {
      return false;
    }
    const host: string = MapLogic.hostOf(trimmed);
    return host === MapLogic.host();
  }

  /** 解析 host（小写）；非法/缺失返回空串。 */
  static hostOf(url: string): string {
    const text: string = url.trim();
    const schemeIndex: number = text.indexOf('://');
    if (schemeIndex < 0) {
      return '';
    }
    let rest: string = text.substring(schemeIndex + 3);
    const stop: number = MapLogic.firstIndexAny(rest, ['/', '?', '#']);
    if (stop >= 0) {
      rest = rest.substring(0, stop);
    }
    // 去 userinfo（防御：https://user:pass@host/ 不当作合法源）
    const at: number = rest.lastIndexOf('@');
    if (at >= 0) {
      rest = rest.substring(at + 1);
    }
    const colon: number = rest.indexOf(':');
    if (colon >= 0) {
      rest = rest.substring(0, colon);
    }
    return rest.toLowerCase();
  }

  /** 状态文案：加载中/已就绪/失败。 */
  static stateText(state: MapLoadState): string {
    if (state === MapLoadState.LOADING) {
      return '正在加载校园地图…';
    }
    if (state === MapLoadState.FAILED) {
      return '地图加载失败，请检查网络后重试';
    }
    return '';
  }

  /** 主文档失败时是否展示错误条（含重试 + 浏览器打开）。 */
  static showErrorBar(state: MapLoadState): boolean {
    return state === MapLoadState.FAILED;
  }

  /** 顶栏「浏览器」按钮始终可用（任意设备都可降级到系统浏览器）。 */
  static canOpenInBrowser(): boolean {
    return true;
  }

  private static firstIndexAny(text: string, chars: string[]): number {
    let best: number = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
      const index: number = text.indexOf(chars[i]);
      if (index >= 0 && (best < 0 || index < best)) {
        best = index;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }
}
import { NoticeEntry } from '../../data/notices/NoticesRepository';
import { NoticeGroup, NoticeItemMeta, NoticeOccurrence, NoticeRecurrence, NoticeSegment } from '../../data/notices/NoticeModels';
import { NoticeRecurrenceLogic, NoticeSection } from './NoticeRecurrence';
import { NoticeStatus, NoticeStatusInfo } from './NoticeStatus';

/** 卡片里的「组成」小标签（图片 3 / 附件 1 …）。 */
export class NoticeComposeChip {
  n: number = 0;
  label: string = '';
}

/** 列表卡片（普通通知 / 长期期次 / 长期定义）。 */
export class NoticeCard {
  key: string = '';
  title: string = '';
  summary: string = '';
  label: string = '';
  timeText: string = '';
  dueText: string = '';
  occurrence: boolean = false;
  definition: boolean = false;
  section: string = NoticeSection.PRIMARY;
  sortAt: number = 0;
  entry: NoticeEntry | undefined = undefined;

  // ---- 展示层（与小程序 notice-card 对齐） ----
  cat: string = '通知';
  catCls: string = 'qt';
  statusLabel: string = '';
  statusCls: string = 'none';
  expired: boolean = false;
  source: string = '';
  sourceKind: string = 'doc';
  senderName: string = '';
  senderBadge: string = '';
  ocr: boolean = false;
  updated: boolean = false;
  hiddenLocal: boolean = false;
  recurring: boolean = false;
  recurLabel: string = '';
  nextText: string = '';
  nextCnText: string = '';
  pubTs: number = 0;
  whenAt: number = 0;
  canDone: boolean = true;
  canRemind: boolean = true;
  aiSummary: string = '';
  points: string[] = [];
  segments: NoticeSegment[] = [];
  items: NoticeItemMeta[] = [];
  quotes: NoticeItemMeta[] = [];
  compose: NoticeComposeChip[] = [];
  hasDetail: boolean = false;
  hasRaw: boolean = false;
  moreText: string = '';
  rawTitle: string = '';
  definitionGroup: NoticeGroup | undefined = undefined;
}

/** 顶部简报统计。 */
export class NoticeStats {
  pending: number = 0;
  urgent: number = 0;
  week: number = 0;
  longterm: number = 0;
  latestText: string = '—';
  expired: number = 0;
}

/** 卡片构建 + 分区（纯函数，可单测）。 */
export class NoticeCards {
  private static readonly CAT_PALETTE: string[] = ['jw', 'tw', 'ks', 'jf', 'hd', 'qt'];
  private static readonly COMPOSE_DEFS: string[] = ['text', 'img', 'file', 'form', 'link', 'mini', 'article', 'merged'];
  private static readonly COMPOSE_LABELS: string[] = ['原文', '图片', '附件', '收集表', '链接', '小程序', '公众号', '聊天记录'];
  private static readonly SEG_ORDER: string[] = ['时间', '地点', '对象', '内容', '报名', '截止', '要求', '联系方式', '补充'];

  static build(entries: NoticeEntry[], nowMillis: number): NoticeCard[] {
    const primary: NoticeCard[] = [];
    const material: NoticeCard[] = [];
    const expired: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
      const entry: NoticeEntry = entries[i];
      const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = entry.group;
      if (group !== undefined && NoticeRecurrenceLogic.isLongterm(group)) {
        const until: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurUntil(group);
        const ended: boolean = until > 0 && nowMillis > until;
        const occurrence: NoticeOccurrence | undefined = ended ? undefined
          : NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceOf(entry, nowMillis);
        if (occurrence !== undefined) {
          const card: NoticeCard = new NoticeCard();
          NoticeCards.fill(card, entry, nowMillis);
          card.key = occurrence.key;
          card.title = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(occurrence.title, nowMillis);
          card.label = occurrence.label;
          card.occurrence = true;
          card.section = NoticeSection.PRIMARY;
          card.sortAt = occurrence.nextMillis;
          card.whenAt = occurrence.nextMillis;
          card.statusLabel = NoticeStatus.occurrenceLabel(occurrence.nextMillis, nowMillis);
          card.statusCls = 'recurring';
          card.expired = false;
          card.canDone = true;
          card.canRemind = false;
          card.recurring = false;
          card.nextText = '';
          primary.push(card);
          continue;
        }
        const card: NoticeCard = new NoticeCard();
        NoticeCards.fill(card, entry, nowMillis);
        card.key = entry.id();
        card.title = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(entry.title(), nowMillis);
        card.definition = true;
        card.definitionGroup = group;
        card.section = ended ? NoticeSection.EXPIRED : NoticeSection.PRIMARY;
        card.sortAt = entry.row.ts;
        card.expired = ended;
        card.canDone = false;
        card.canRemind = false;
        card.recurring = !ended;
        card.recurLabel = NoticeCards.recurLabelOf(group);
        card.nextText = ended ? '' : NoticeStatus.dateTimeCnOf(card.whenAt, nowMillis);
        card.nextCnText = card.nextText.length > 0 ? '下次 ' + card.nextText : '';
        card.statusLabel = ended ? '长期安排已结束'
          : ('长期安排 · ' + NoticeCards.recurLabelOf(group));
        card.statusCls = ended ? 'expired' : 'recurring';
        card.label = card.statusLabel;
        if (ended) {
          expired.push(card);
        } else {
          primary.push(card);
        }
        continue;
      }
      const card: NoticeCard = new NoticeCard();
      NoticeCards.fill(card, entry, nowMillis);
      card.key = entry.id();
      card.title = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(entry.title(), nowMillis);
      card.timeText = entry.timeLabel();
      card.dueText = group !== undefined ? NoticeRecurrenceLogic.deadlineText(group) : '';
      card.section = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.sectionOf(entry, nowMillis);
      card.sortAt = entry.row.ts;
      if (card.section === NoticeSection.EXPIRED) {
        expired.push(card);
      } else if (card.section === NoticeSection.MATERIAL) {
        material.push(card);
      } else {
        primary.push(card);
      }
    }
    primary.sort((a: NoticeCard, b: NoticeCard) => {
      if (a.occurrence !== b.occurrence) {
        return a.occurrence ? -1 : 1;
      }
      if (a.occurrence && b.occurrence) {
        return a.sortAt - b.sortAt;
      }
      return 0;
    });
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < primary.length; i++) {
      out.push(primary[i]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < material.length; i++) {
      out.push(material[i]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < expired.length; i++) {
      out.push(expired[i]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 填充展示层公共字段。 */
  private static fill(card: NoticeCard, entry: NoticeEntry, nowMillis: number): void {
    const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = entry.group;
    card.entry = entry;
    card.summary = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(entry.summary(), nowMillis);
    card.cat = group !== undefined && group.cat.trim().length > 0 ? group.cat.trim() : '通知';
    card.catCls = NoticeCards.catClsOf(card.cat);
    card.source = group !== undefined ? group.source.trim() : '';
    card.sourceKind = NoticeCards.sourceKindOf(card.source);
    card.senderName = group !== undefined ? group.senderName.trim() : '';
    card.senderBadge = group !== undefined
      ? (group.senderRole.trim().length > 0 ? group.senderRole.trim() : group.senderBadge.trim())
      : '';
    card.ocr = group !== undefined && group.ocr;
    card.updated = (group !== undefined && group.updatedAt.trim().length > 0) || entry.row.editedAt > 0;
    card.aiSummary = group !== undefined ? NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(group.aiSummary.trim(), nowMillis) : '';
    card.points = [];
    if (group !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < group.aiPoints.length && i < 3; i++) {
        card.points.push(NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(group.aiPoints[i], nowMillis));
      }
    }
    card.segments = [];
    if (group !== undefined) {
      const compact: NoticeSegment[] = NoticeCards.compactSegments(group.aiSegments);
      for (let i = 0; i < compact.length; i++) {
        const seg: NoticeSegment = new NoticeSegment();
        seg.type = compact[i].type;
        seg.text = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(compact[i].text, nowMillis);
        card.segments.push(seg);
      }
    }
    const status: NoticeStatusInfo = NoticeStatus.ofEntry(entry, nowMillis);
    card.statusLabel = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(status.label, nowMillis);
    card.statusCls = status.cls;
    card.expired = status.expired;
    card.whenAt = status.whenAt;
    card.canDone = !status.expired && !(group !== undefined && NoticeRecurrenceLogic.isLongterm(group));
    card.canRemind = card.canDone;
    // 明细项与原文摘录
    const details: NoticeItemMeta[] = [];
    const quotes: NoticeItemMeta[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < entry.items.length; i++) {
      const item: NoticeItemMeta = entry.items[i];
      if (item.kind === 'text' || item.kind === 'follow') {
        if (quotes.length < 2) {
          const quote: NoticeItemMeta = new NoticeItemMeta();
          quote.kind = item.kind;
          quote.label = item.label;
          quote.fromName = item.fromName;
          quote.fromRole = item.fromRole;
          quote.timeText = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(item.timeText, nowMillis);
          quote.text = NoticeStatus.fmtDatesCn(item.text, nowMillis);
          quote.isFollow = item.isFollow;
          quotes.push(quote);
        }
      } else {
        details.push(item);
      }
    }
    card.items = details;
    card.quotes = card.aiSummary.length > 0 ? [] : quotes;
    card.compose = NoticeCards.composeOf(entry.items);
    card.hasRaw = quotes.length > 0 || (group === undefined && entry.row.body.trim().length > 0);
    card.rawTitle = entry.title();
    const more: string[] = [];
    if (details.length > 0) {
      more.push(details.length + ' 项详情');
    }
    let files: number = 0;
    let images: number = 0;
    let forms: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < details.length; i++) {
      if (details[i].kind === 'file') {
        files += 1;
      } else if (details[i].kind === 'img') {
        images += 1;
      } else if (details[i].kind === 'form') {
        forms += 1;
      }
    }
    if (files > 0) {
      more.push(files + ' 个附件');
    }
    if (images > 0) {
      more.push(images + ' 张图片');
    }
    if (forms > 0) {
      more.push(forms + ' 个收集表');
    }
    card.moreText = more.length > 0 ? more.join(' · ') : '';
    card.hasDetail = card.segments.length > 0 || details.length > 0 || quotes.length > 0;
    card.pubTs = NoticeCards.pubTsOf(entry, nowMillis);
    if (group !== undefined && NoticeRecurrenceLogic.isLongterm(group)) {
      card.recurring = !status.expired;
      card.recurLabel = NoticeCards.recurLabelOf(group);
      const next: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(group, nowMillis);
      card.nextText = next > 0 && !status.expired ? NoticeStatus.dateTimeCnOf(next, nowMillis) : '';
    }
    if (card.timeText.length === 0 && status.whenAt > 0) {
      card.timeText = NoticeStatus.shortTime(status.whenAt);
    }
  }

  static ofSection(cards: NoticeCard[], section: string): NoticeCard[] {
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      if (cards[i].section === section) {
        out.push(cards[i]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 未处理数（期次卡与普通卡都计入；长期定义不计）。 */
  static pendingCount(cards: NoticeCard[], doneKeys: string[]): number {
    let count: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      if (cards[i].definition) {
        continue;
      }
      if (doneKeys.indexOf(cards[i].key) < 0) {
        count += 1;
      }
    }
    return count;
  }

  /** 顶部 5 张数据卡 + 已过期数。 */
  static statsOf(cards: NoticeCard[], doneKeys: string[], nowMillis: number): NoticeStats {
    const stats: NoticeStats = new NoticeStats();
    let latest: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = cards[i];
      latest = Math.max(latest, card.pubTs);
      if (card.definition) {
        if (!card.expired) {
          stats.longterm += 1;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (card.section === NoticeSection.EXPIRED) {
        stats.expired += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (card.section === NoticeSection.MATERIAL) {
        continue;
      }
      if (doneKeys.indexOf(card.key) >= 0) {
        continue;
      }
      stats.pending += 1;
      if (card.whenAt > nowMillis) {
        const left: number = card.whenAt - nowMillis;
        if (left <= 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
          stats.urgent += 1;
        }
        if (left <= 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
          stats.week += 1;
        }
      }
    }
    stats.latestText = NoticeStatus.latestTextOf(latest, nowMillis);
    return stats;
  }

  /** 简报「最近截止」：待处理且有时间，升序取前 3。 */
  static briefNext(cards: NoticeCard[], doneKeys: string[], nowMillis: number, max: number = 3): NoticeCard[] {
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = cards[i];
      if (card.definition || card.section !== NoticeSection.PRIMARY) {
        continue;
      }
      if (doneKeys.indexOf(card.key) >= 0) {
        continue;
      }
      if (card.whenAt <= 0) {
        continue;
      }
      out.push(card);
    }
    out.sort((a: NoticeCard, b: NoticeCard) => a.whenAt - b.whenAt);
    return out.length > max ? out.slice(0, max) : out;
  }

  /** 分类 chips（未过期、非空）。 */
  static categories(cards: NoticeCard[]): string[] {
    const seen: Map<string, boolean> = new Map<string, boolean>();
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      const cat: string = cards[i].cat.trim();
      if (cat.length === 0 || cards[i].expired) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!seen.has(cat)) {
        seen.set(cat, true);
        out.push(cat);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 长期安排清单（进行中的定义卡）。 */
  static longtermCards(cards: NoticeCard[]): NoticeCard[] {
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      if (cards[i].definition && !cards[i].expired) {
        out.push(cards[i]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 已处理状态用：卡片是否可标记。 */
  static doneKey(card: NoticeCard): string {
    return card.key;
  }

  static catClsOf(cat: string): string {
    if (cat === '教务') {
      return 'jw';
    }
    if (cat === '团务') {
      return 'tw';
    }
    if (cat === '考试') {
      return 'ks';
    }
    if (cat === '缴费') {
      return 'jf';
    }
    if (cat === '活动') {
      return 'hd';
    }
    if (cat === '班级事务') {
      return 'qt';
    }
    let hash: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < cat.length; i++) {
      hash = (hash * 31 + cat.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
    }
    return NoticeCards.CAT_PALETTE[hash % NoticeCards.CAT_PALETTE.length];
  }

  static sourceKindOf(source: string): string {
    if (source.indexOf('QQ') >= 0) {
      return 'qq';
    }
    if (source.indexOf('微信') >= 0) {
      return 'wx';
    }
    return 'doc';
  }

  static recurLabelOf(group: NoticeGroup): string {
    const recur: NoticeRecurrence | undefined = group.recurrence;
    if (recur === undefined) {
      return '';
    }
    const raw: string = recur.label.trim();
    if (raw.length > 0) {
      return raw;
    }
    const time: string = recur.time.trim();
    if (recur.freq === 'daily') {
      return '每天 ' + time;
    }
    if (recur.freq === 'weekly') {
      return '每周' + weekCn(recur.weekday) + ' ' + time;
    }
    if (recur.freq === 'monthly_day') {
      return '每月 ' + recur.day + ' 日 ' + time;
    }
    const last: number = recur.weeks.length > 0 ? recur.weeks[recur.weeks.length - 1] : 3;
    return '每月前 ' + last + ' 周' + weekCn(recur.weekday) + ' ' + time;
  }

  static compactSegments(segments: NoticeSegment[]): NoticeSegment[] {
    const map: Map<string, string> = new Map<string, string>();
    for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
      const type: string = segments[i].type.trim();
      const text: string = segments[i].text.trim();
      if (type.length === 0 || text.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const existing: string | undefined = map.get(type);
      map.set(type, existing === undefined ? text : existing + '；' + text);
    }
    const out: NoticeSegment[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < NoticeCards.SEG_ORDER.length; i++) {
      const type: string = NoticeCards.SEG_ORDER[i];
      const text: string | undefined = map.get(type);
      if (text !== undefined) {
        const seg: NoticeSegment = new NoticeSegment();
        seg.type = type;
        seg.text = text;
