        out.push(seg);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  static segClsOf(type: string): string {
    if (type === '时间') {
      return 'time';
    }
    if (type === '地点') {
      return 'place';
    }
    if (type === '对象') {
      return 'who';
    }
    if (type === '报名') {
      return 'join';
    }
    if (type === '截止') {
      return 'due';
    }
    if (type === '要求') {
      return 'rule';
    }
    if (type === '联系方式') {
      return 'contact';
    }
    if (type === '补充') {
      return 'supp';
    }
    return 'info';
  }

  private static composeOf(items: NoticeItemMeta[]): NoticeComposeChip[] {
    const count: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      const kind: string = items[i].kind;
      const n: number | undefined = count.get(kind);
      count.set(kind, n === undefined ? 1 : n + 1);
    }
    const out: NoticeComposeChip[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < NoticeCards.COMPOSE_DEFS.length; i++) {
      const kind: string = NoticeCards.COMPOSE_DEFS[i];
      const n: number | undefined = count.get(kind);
      if (n !== undefined && n > 0) {
        const chip: NoticeComposeChip = new NoticeComposeChip();
        chip.n = n;
        chip.label = NoticeCards.COMPOSE_LABELS[i];
        out.push(chip);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  private static pubTsOf(entry: NoticeEntry, nowMillis: number): number {
    let best: number = entry.row.ts;
    if (entry.group !== undefined) {
      const updated: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(entry.group.updatedAt);
      if (updated > best) {
        best = updated;
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < entry.items.length; i++) {
      const t: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(entry.items[i].timeText);
      if (t > best && t <= nowMillis) {
        best = t;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }
}

function weekCn(weekday: number): string {
  const names: string[] = ['日', '一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六'];
  if (weekday < 0 || weekday > 6) {
    return '';
  }
  return names[weekday];
}
import { NoticeEntry } from '../../data/notices/NoticesRepository';
import { NoticeGroup, NoticeOccurrence, NoticeRecurrence } from '../../data/notices/NoticeModels';

/** 通知分区（对齐网页：主列表 / 资料 / 已过期）。 */
export enum NoticeSection {
  PRIMARY = '待处理',
  MATERIAL = '资料',
  EXPIRED = '已过期'
}

const OCCURRENCE_LEAD_MS: number = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const RECUR_FREQS: string[] = ['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly_day', 'monthly_weeks'];
const TIME_PATTERN: RegExp = new RegExp('^([01]?\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d$');

/** 长期安排/时间解析与分区（对齐网页 `recurNext` / 三区口径的简化实现）。 */
export class NoticeRecurrenceLogic {
  /** 宽松时间解析：ISO(含偏移/Z) → 本地日期时间 → `MM-dd HH:mm` → `MM-dd`。 */
  static parseTs(raw: string): number {
    const text: string = raw.trim();
    if (text.length === 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    const iso: number = Date.parse(text);
    if (Number.isFinite(iso)) {
      return iso;
    }
    const dateTime: RegExpMatchArray | null = text.match(
      new RegExp('^(\\d{4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,2})[ T](\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})(?::(\\d{2}))?$'));
    if (dateTime !== null) {
      const d: Date = new Date(Number(dateTime[1]), Number(dateTime[2]) - 1, Number(dateTime[3]),
        Number(dateTime[4]), Number(dateTime[5]), dateTime[6] !== undefined ? Number(dateTime[6]) : 0);
      return d.getTime();
    }
    const mdhm: RegExpMatchArray | null = text.match(new RegExp('^(\\d{1,2})-(\\d{1,2})[ T](\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})$'));
    if (mdhm !== null) {
      const year: number = new Date().getFullYear();
      return new Date(year, Number(mdhm[1]) - 1, Number(mdhm[2]), Number(mdhm[3]), Number(mdhm[4]), 0).getTime();
    }
    const md: RegExpMatchArray | null = text.match(new RegExp('^(\\d{1,2})-(\\d{1,2})$'));
    if (md !== null) {
      const year: number = new Date().getFullYear();
      return new Date(year, Number(md[1]) - 1, Number(md[2]), 0, 0, 0).getTime();
    }
    return 0;
  }

  /** 有效 recurrence：freq 合法且 time 为 HH:MM。 */
  static effectiveRecurrence(group: NoticeGroup | undefined): NoticeRecurrence | undefined {
    if (group === undefined || group.recurrence === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const recur: NoticeRecurrence = group.recurrence;
    if (RECUR_FREQS.indexOf(recur.freq.trim().toLowerCase()) < 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (!TIME_PATTERN.test(recur.time.trim())) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return recur;
  }

  static isLongterm(group: NoticeGroup | undefined): boolean {
    return NoticeRecurrenceLogic.effectiveRecurrence(group) !== undefined;
  }

  /** `until`：`YYYY-MM-DD` 含当天；其它按时间解析；空/非法 → 0。 */
  static recurUntil(group: NoticeGroup): number {
    const recur: NoticeRecurrence | undefined = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.effectiveRecurrence(group);
    if (recur === undefined || recur.until.trim().length === 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    const text: string = recur.until.trim();
    const dateOnly: RegExpMatchArray | null = text.match(new RegExp('^(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})$'));
    if (dateOnly !== null) {
      return new Date(Number(dateOnly[1]), Number(dateOnly[2]) - 1, Number(dateOnly[3]), 23, 59, 59, 999).getTime();
    }
    return NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(text);
  }

  /** 下一次发生时间（严格 > now）；无法计算 → 0。 */
  static recurNext(group: NoticeGroup, nowMillis: number): number {
    const recur: NoticeRecurrence | undefined = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.effectiveRecurrence(group);
    if (recur === undefined) {
      return 0;
    }
    const startAt: number = recur.startAt.trim().length > 0 ? NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(recur.startAt) : 0;
    const reference: number = Math.max(nowMillis, startAt > 0 ? startAt : nowMillis);
    const timeMatch: RegExpMatchArray | null = recur.time.trim().match(new RegExp('^(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})$'));
    const hour: number = timeMatch !== null ? Number(timeMatch[1]) : 0;
    const minute: number = timeMatch !== null ? Number(timeMatch[2]) : 0;
    const base: Date = new Date(reference);
    const at = (y: number, m: number, d: number): number => {
      return new Date(y, m, d, hour, minute, 0).getTime();
    };
    if (recur.freq.trim().toLowerCase() === 'daily') {
      let candidate: number = at(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth(), base.getDate());
      if (candidate <= reference) {
        candidate = at(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth(), base.getDate() + 1);
      }
      return candidate;
    }
    if (recur.freq.trim().toLowerCase() === 'weekly') {
      if (recur.weekday < 0 || recur.weekday > 6) {
        return 0;
      }
      const cursor: Date = new Date(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth(), base.getDate(), 0, 0, 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
        const candidate: number = at(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth(), cursor.getDate());
        if (cursor.getDay() === recur.weekday && candidate > reference) {
          return candidate;
        }
        cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() + 1);
      }
      return 0;
    }
    if (recur.freq.trim().toLowerCase() === 'monthly_day') {
      if (recur.day < 1 || recur.day > 28) {
        return 0;
      }
      let year: number = base.getFullYear();
      let month: number = base.getMonth();
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const candidate: number = at(year, month, recur.day);
        if (candidate > reference) {
          return candidate;
        }
        month += 1;
        if (month > 11) {
          month = 0;
          year += 1;
        }
      }
      return 0;
    }
    if (recur.freq.trim().toLowerCase() === 'monthly_weeks') {
      if (recur.weekday < 0 || recur.weekday > 6) {
        return 0;
      }
      const weeks: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < recur.weeks.length; i++) {
        if (recur.weeks[i] >= 1 && recur.weeks[i] <= 5) {
          weeks.push(recur.weeks[i]);
        }
      }
      if (weeks.length === 0) {
        weeks.push(1);
        weeks.push(2);
        weeks.push(3);
        weeks.push(4);
        weeks.push(5);
      }
      let monthStart: Date = new Date(base.getFullYear(), base.getMonth(), 1, 0, 0, 0);
      for (let m = 0; m < 4; m++) {
        const first: Date = firstWeekdayOfMonth(monthStart.getFullYear(), monthStart.getMonth(), recur.weekday);
        for (let w = 0; w < weeks.length; w++) {
          const candidateDate: Date = new Date(first.getFullYear(), first.getMonth(),
            first.getDate() + (weeks[w] - 1) * 7, hour, minute, 0);
          if (candidateDate.getMonth() !== monthStart.getMonth()) {
            continue;
          }
          const candidate: number = candidateDate.getTime();
          if (candidate > reference) {
            return candidate;
          }
        }
        monthStart = new Date(monthStart.getFullYear(), monthStart.getMonth() + 1, 1, 0, 0, 0);
      }
      return 0;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  /** 期次（仅 `[next-24h, next)` 窗口内返回）。 */
  static occurrenceOf(entry: NoticeEntry, nowMillis: number): NoticeOccurrence | undefined {
    const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = entry.group;
    if (group === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const until: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurUntil(group);
    if (until > 0 && nowMillis > until) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const next: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(group, nowMillis);
    if (next <= 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (until > 0 && next > until) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const windowStart: number = next - OCCURRENCE_LEAD_MS;
    if (nowMillis < windowStart || nowMillis >= next) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const occurrence: NoticeOccurrence = new NoticeOccurrence();
    occurrence.groupId = group.id.length > 0 ? group.id : entry.id();
    occurrence.title = group.title.length > 0 ? group.title : entry.title();
    occurrence.nextMillis = next;
    occurrence.windowStartMillis = windowStart;
    occurrence.key = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceKey(occurrence.groupId, next);
    occurrence.label = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceLabel(next, nowMillis);
    return occurrence;
  }

  static occurrenceKey(groupId: string, nextMillis: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(nextMillis);
    return groupId + '@occ:' + d.getFullYear() + pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad2(d.getDate());
  }

  static occurrenceLabel(nextMillis: number, nowMillis: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(nextMillis);
    const today: Date = new Date(nowMillis);
    const tomorrow: Date = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + 1);
    let dayText: string = '';
    if (d.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear() && d.getMonth() === today.getMonth()
      && d.getDate() === today.getDate()) {
      dayText = '今天';
    } else if (d.getFullYear() === tomorrow.getFullYear() && d.getMonth() === tomorrow.getMonth()
      && d.getDate() === tomorrow.getDate()) {
      dayText = '明天';
    } else {
      dayText = (d.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + d.getDate() + '日';
    }
    return '本次 ' + dayText + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  /** 长期安排下一场文案（用于定义卡）。 */
  static nextText(group: NoticeGroup, nowMillis: number): string {
    const next: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(group, nowMillis);
    if (next <= 0) {
      return '';
    }
    return '下次 ' + NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceLabel(next, nowMillis).substring(3);
  }

  /** 通知分区。 */
  static sectionOf(entry: NoticeEntry, nowMillis: number): NoticeSection {
    const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = entry.group;
    if (group !== undefined) {
      if (NoticeRecurrenceLogic.isLongterm(group)) {
        const until: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurUntil(group);
        if (until > 0 && nowMillis > until) {
          return NoticeSection.EXPIRED;
        }
        return NoticeSection.PRIMARY;
      }
      const anchors: number[] = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.timeAnchors(group);
      if (anchors.length === 0) {
        return NoticeSection.MATERIAL;
      }
      let latest: number = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < anchors.length; i++) {
        latest = Math.max(latest, anchors[i]);
      }
      return latest > 0 && latest < nowMillis ? NoticeSection.EXPIRED : NoticeSection.PRIMARY;
    }
    return NoticeSection.MATERIAL;
  }

  /** 时间锚点（截止/活动/报名截止/失效/过期）。 */
  static timeAnchors(group: NoticeGroup): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];
    const push = (raw: string): void => {
      if (raw.trim().length === 0) {
        return;
      }
      const ts: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(raw);
      if (ts > 0) {
        out.push(ts);
      }
    };
    push(group.deadline);
    push(group.eventAt);
    push(group.expireAt);
    return out;
  }

  /** 截止文案（`MM-dd HH:mm`，无可解析 → 原字符串）。 */
  static deadlineText(group: NoticeGroup): string {
    const raw: string = group.deadline.trim();
    if (raw.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const ts: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(raw);
    if (ts <= 0) {
      return raw;
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(ts);
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }
}

function firstWeekdayOfMonth(year: number, month: number, weekday: number): Date {
  const first: Date = new Date(year, month, 1, 0, 0, 0);
  const delta: number = (weekday - first.getDay() + 7) % 7;
  return new Date(year, month, 1 + delta, 0, 0, 0);
}

function pad2(value: number): string {
  return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
}
import { NoticeEntry } from '../../data/notices/NoticesRepository';
import { NoticeGroup, NoticeRecurrence } from '../../data/notices/NoticeModels';
import { NoticeRecurrenceLogic } from './NoticeRecurrence';

/** 状态胶囊（与小程序 `utils/notice.js statusOf` 同口径）。 */
export class NoticeStatusInfo {
  key: string = 'none';
  label: string = '无时间';
  cls: string = 'none';
  expired: boolean = false;
  /** 主显示时间（deadline / eventAt），无时间 → 0。 */
  whenAt: number = 0;
}

const WEEK_CN: string[] = ['周日', '周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六'];
const HOUR_MS: number = 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DAY_MS: number = 24 * HOUR_MS;

/** 通知状态机 + 时间文案（纯函数，可单测）。 */
export class NoticeStatus {
  static pad2(value: number): string {
    return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
  }

  /** 主显示时间：截止 → 活动时间；长期安排 → 状态胶囊不带日期。 */
  static whenAt(group: NoticeGroup | undefined): number {
    if (group === undefined) {
      return 0;
    }
    const deadline: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(group.deadline);
    if (deadline > 0) {
      return deadline;
    }
    return NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(group.eventAt);
  }

  /** `MM-DD HH:MM`。 */
  static shortTime(ts: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(ts);
    return NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getDate())
      + ' ' + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  /** 紧迫度文案：已过 / N 分钟后 / N 小时后 / N 天后 / MM-DD HH:MM。 */
  static fmtWhen(ts: number, now: number): string {
    const left: number = ts - now;
    if (left <= 0) {
      return NoticeStatus.shortTime(ts);
    }
    if (left < HOUR_MS) {
      return Math.max(1, Math.round(left / 60000)) + ' 分钟后';
    }
    if (left < DAY_MS) {
      return Math.max(1, Math.round(left / HOUR_MS)) + ' 小时后';
    }
    if (left < 7 * DAY_MS) {
      return Math.max(1, Math.round(left / DAY_MS)) + ' 天后';
    }
    return NoticeStatus.shortTime(ts);
  }

  /** 动作文案精简（≤6 字）。 */
  static conciseAction(action: string): string {
    const text: string = action.trim();
    if (text.length === 0) {
      return '截止';
    }
    if (text === '报送姓名截止') {
      return '报送截止';
    }
    if (text === '集合点名') {
      return '点名';
    }
    if (text === '活动开始') {
      return '开始';
    }
    if (text === '报名已截止') {
      return '报名截止';
    }
    return text.length > 6 ? text.substring(0, 6) : text;
  }

  private static bucketOf(ts: number, action: string, now: number): NoticeStatusInfo {
    const info: NoticeStatusInfo = new NoticeStatusInfo();
    info.label = NoticeStatus.fmtWhen(ts, now) + ' ' + NoticeStatus.conciseAction(action);
    info.whenAt = ts;
    const left: number = ts - now;
    if (left < HOUR_MS) {
      info.key = 'urgent';
      info.cls = 'urgent';
    } else if (left < DAY_MS) {
      info.key = 'today';
      info.cls = 'urgent';
    } else if (left < 3 * DAY_MS) {
      info.key = 'soon';
      info.cls = 'active';
    } else {
      info.key = 'active';
      info.cls = 'active';
    }
    info.expired = false;
    return info;
  }

  static statusOf(group: NoticeGroup | undefined, now: number): NoticeStatusInfo {
    if (group === undefined) {
      return new NoticeStatusInfo();
    }
    const recur: NoticeRecurrence | undefined = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.effectiveRecurrence(group);
    if (recur !== undefined) {
      const until: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurUntil(group);
      const next: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(group, now);
      const ended: boolean = (until > 0 && now > until) || (until > 0 && next > until);
      const info: NoticeStatusInfo = new NoticeStatusInfo();
      if (ended) {
        info.key = 'expired';
        info.cls = 'expired';
        info.expired = true;
        info.label = '长期安排已结束';
        return info;
      }
      info.key = 'recurring';
      info.cls = 'recurring';
      info.expired = false;
      info.whenAt = next;
      const label: string = recur.label.trim();
      info.label = label.length > 0 ? ('长期安排 · ' + label) : '长期安排';
      return info;
    }
    const deadline: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(group.deadline);
    if (deadline > 0) {
      const action: string = group.alert ? '截止' : '截止';
      if (now > deadline) {
        const info: NoticeStatusInfo = new NoticeStatusInfo();
        info.key = group.alert ? 'alert' : 'expired';
        info.cls = group.alert ? 'alert' : 'expired';
        info.expired = !group.alert;
        info.label = NoticeStatus.fmtWhen(deadline, now) + ' ' + NoticeStatus.conciseAction(action);
        info.whenAt = deadline;
        return info;
      }
      return NoticeStatus.bucketOf(deadline, action, now);
    }
    const eventAt: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(group.eventAt);
    if (eventAt > 0) {
      const end: number = Math.max(eventAt, NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs(group.expireAt));
      if (now > end) {
        const info: NoticeStatusInfo = new NoticeStatusInfo();
        info.key = 'expired';
        info.cls = 'expired';
        info.expired = true;
        info.label = NoticeStatus.fmtWhen(eventAt, now) + ' 开始';
        info.whenAt = eventAt;
        return info;
      }
      const info: NoticeStatusInfo = new NoticeStatusInfo();
      info.key = 'active';
      info.cls = 'active';
      info.expired = false;
      info.label = NoticeStatus.fmtWhen(eventAt, now) + ' 开始';
      info.whenAt = eventAt;
      return info;
    }
    const none: NoticeStatusInfo = new NoticeStatusInfo();
    none.whenAt = 0;
    return none;
  }

  /** 状态（含手动通知兜底：无 group 按「无时间」）。 */
  static ofEntry(entry: NoticeEntry, now: number): NoticeStatusInfo {
    const info: NoticeStatusInfo = NoticeStatus.statusOf(entry.group, now);
    if (entry.group === undefined && info.whenAt === 0 && entry.row.ts > 0) {
      info.label = '无时间';
    }
    return info;
  }

  /** `M月D日（周X）`（跨年补年份）。 */
  static dateCnOf(ts: number, now: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(ts);
    const n: Date = new Date(now);
    const yearPrefix: string = d.getFullYear() !== n.getFullYear() ? (d.getFullYear() + '年') : '';
    return yearPrefix + (d.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + d.getDate() + '日（' + WEEK_CN[d.getDay()] + '）';
  }

  /** `M月D日（周X）HH:MM`。 */
  static dateTimeCnOf(ts: number, now: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(ts);
    return NoticeStatus.dateCnOf(ts, now) + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  /** 文本里的日期 token → `M月D日（周X）`（已带括号不重复）。 */
  static fmtDatesCn(text: string, now: number): string {
    let src: string = text;
    if (src.length === 0) {
      return src;
    }
    const n: Date = new Date(now);
    const year: number = n.getFullYear();
    src = src.replace(new RegExp('(\\d{4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,2})', 'g'),
      (match: string, y: string, mo: string, da: string): string => {
        if (!validMd(Number(mo), Number(da))) {
          return match;
        }
        return NoticeStatus.dateCnOf(new Date(Number(y), Number(mo) - 1, Number(da)).getTime(), now);
      });
    src = src.replace(new RegExp('(\\d{1,2})月(\\d{1,2})日(?!\\s*[（(])', 'g'),
      (match: string, mo: string, da: string): string => {
        if (!validMd(Number(mo), Number(da))) {
          return match;
        }
        return NoticeStatus.dateCnOf(new Date(year, Number(mo) - 1, Number(da)).getTime(), now);
      });
    src = src.replace(new RegExp('(^|[^0-9:\\-])(\\d{1,2})-(\\d{1,2})(?![0-9\\-人个次名天周月年元度分条项张份间号栋楼届])', 'g'),
      (match: string, pre: string, mo: string, da: string): string => {
        if (!validMd(Number(mo), Number(da))) {
          return match;
        }
        return pre + NoticeStatus.dateCnOf(new Date(year, Number(mo) - 1, Number(da)).getTime(), now);
      });
    return src;
  }

  /** 发布时间相对文案：今天 12:49 / 昨天 12:49 / 11-12 12:49。 */
  static latestTextOf(ts: number, now: number): string {
    if (ts <= 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(ts);
    const n: Date = new Date(now);
    const sameDay: boolean = d.getFullYear() === n.getFullYear() && d.getMonth() === n.getMonth()
      && d.getDate() === n.getDate();
    const hm: string = NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getMinutes());
    if (sameDay) {
      return '今天 ' + hm;
    }
    const yesterday: Date = new Date(n.getFullYear(), n.getMonth(), n.getDate() - 1);
    if (d.getFullYear() === yesterday.getFullYear() && d.getMonth() === yesterday.getMonth()
      && d.getDate() === yesterday.getDate()) {
      return '昨天 ' + hm;
    }
    return NoticeStatus.shortTime(ts);
  }

  /** 原样文案（期次胶囊）。 */
  static occurrenceLabel(nextMillis: number, now: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(nextMillis);
    return '本次 ' + (d.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + d.getDate() + '日（' + WEEK_CN[d.getDay()] + '）'
      + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + NoticeStatus.pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }
}

function validMd(month: number, day: number): boolean {
  if (!(month >= 1 && month <= 12) || !(day >= 1 && day <= 31)) {
    return false;
  }
  const d: Date = new Date(2000, month - 1, day);
  return d.getMonth() === month - 1 && d.getDate() === day;
}
/** 演示上传的分片/ID 规则（纯函数，便于单测）。 */
export class PptUploadPlanner {
  static readonly CHUNK_SIZE: number = 512 * 1024;
  static readonly MAX_SIZE: number = 200 * 1024 * 1024;
  static readonly SUFFIXES: string[] = ['.ppt', '.pptx'];

  static isSupported(name: string): boolean {
    const lower: string = name.toLowerCase();
    for (let i = 0; i < PptUploadPlanner.SUFFIXES.length; i++) {
      if (lower.endsWith(PptUploadPlanner.SUFFIXES[i])) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  static chunkCount(size: number): number {
    if (size <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return Math.ceil(size / PptUploadPlanner.CHUNK_SIZE);
  }

  /** 第 index 片的 [offset, length]（最后一片可小）。 */
  static chunkRange(index: number, size: number): number[] {
    const offset: number = index * PptUploadPlanner.CHUNK_SIZE;
    const length: number = Math.max(0, Math.min(PptUploadPlanner.CHUNK_SIZE, size - offset));
    return [offset, length];
  }

  /** deck id：`d` + base36(ms) + 6 位小写字母数字（≤13 字符）。 */
  static deckId(nowMillis: number, seed: number): string {
    const alphabet: string = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
    let value: number = Math.abs(Math.floor(seed));
    let tail: string = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      tail += alphabet.charAt(value % alphabet.length);
      value = Math.floor(value / alphabet.length) + 7;
    }
    const ts: string = nowMillis.toString(36);
    const shortTs: string = ts.length > 6 ? ts.substring(ts.length - 6) : ts;
    return 'd' + shortTs + tail;
  }

  static titleOf(name: string, max: number = 80): string {
    const dot: number = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    const base: string = dot > 0 ? name.substring(0, dot) : name;
    return base.length > max ? base.substring(0, max) : base;
  }

  static extOf(name: string): string {
    const dot: number = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    return dot >= 0 ? name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  }

  static validate(name: string, size: number): string {
    if (!PptUploadPlanner.isSupported(name)) {
      return '只支持 .ppt / .pptx';
    }
    if (size <= 0) {
      return '文件为空或无法读取';
    }
    if (size > PptUploadPlanner.MAX_SIZE) {
      return '文件超过 200 MB';
    }
    return '';
  }
}
import { pushService } from '@kit.PushKit';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';
import { deviceInfo } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';

/**
 * 系统推送（Push Kit）：
 * - 仅当用户开启「消息推送」时申请 token，并写入本人 `userdata.push`（token/enabled/at）；
 * - tokenUpdate 时自动更新；
 * - 关闭时删除 token 并写 enabled=false。
 *
 * 注意：token 只存在本人 userdata 行；服务端下发需要能读取 token 的权限（见 docs/M69）。
 */
export class AppPush {
  private static listening: boolean = false;

  static enabled(): boolean {
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const push: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'push'));
    return push !== undefined && JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(push, 'enabled'), false);
  }

  static token(): string {
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const push: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'push'));
    return push === undefined ? '' : JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(push, 'token'), '');
  }

  /** 启动时：已开启则续订 token（失败静默，不阻塞主流程）。 */
  static async syncOnLaunch(): Promise<void> {
    if (!AppPush.enabled()) {
      return;
    }
    await AppPush.register();
  }

  /** 申请 token 并保存；返回是否成功。 */
  static async register(): Promise<boolean> {
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      return false;
    }
    const ability = AppGlobal.ability;
    try {
      const token: string = await pushService.getToken();
      if (token.length === 0) {
        return false;
      }
      await AppPush.save(token, true);
      await AppPush.syncTable(token);
      if (!AppPush.listening && ability !== undefined) {
        pushService.on('tokenUpdate', ability, (newToken: string) => {
          AppPush.save(newToken, true);
        });
        AppPush.listening = true;
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w('AppPush', 'getToken 失败');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** 关闭推送：删除 token 并落库。 */
  static async disable(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await pushService.deleteToken();
    } catch (e) {
      // 忽略：未开通/无 token 时也允许关闭
    }
    await AppPush.save('', false);
    await AppPush.clearTable();
  }

  /** 同步到班级共享表 push_tokens（provider=harmony），供发送端读取。 */
  private static async syncTable(token: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await Services.api.delete('push_tokens?provider=eq.harmony');
      const body: Blob = {};
      body['provider'] = 'harmony';
      body['token'] = token;
      body['device'] = deviceInfo.productModel;
      body['app_version'] = '1.0.5';
      await Services.api.post('push_tokens', JSON.stringify(body), 'return=minimal');
    } catch (e) {
      Log.w('AppPush', '写 push_tokens 失败');
    }
  }

  private static async clearTable(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await Services.api.delete('push_tokens?provider=eq.harmony');
    } catch (e) {
      // 忽略
    }
  }

  private static async save(token: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const push: Blob = {};
    const old: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(current, 'push'));
    if (old !== undefined) {
      const oldKeys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(old);
      for (let i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
        push[oldKeys[i]] = old[oldKeys[i]];
      }
    }
    push['token'] = token;
    push['enabled'] = enabled;
    push['at'] = Date.now();
    next['push'] = push;
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
    const pushKeys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    pushKeys.add('push');
    await Services.userdata.push(false, pushKeys);
  }
}
import { HomeworkDueCalculator, HomeworkRow } from '../../data/homework/HomeworkModels';

/** 提醒偏好（本机 + 可随账号同步；当前本机保存）。 */
export class ReminderPrefs {
  enabled: boolean = true;
  /** 提前分钟数。 */
  advanceMinutes: number = 30;
}

export class ReminderPlan {
  homeworkId: string = '';
  title: string = '';
  content: string = '';
  triggerAt: number = 0;
  dueAt: number = 0;
}

/** 作业截止提醒规划（纯函数）。 */
export class ReminderPlanner {
  static readonly ADVANCE_OPTIONS: number[] = [10, 30, 60, 120];

  static normalizeAdvance(value: number): number {
    for (let i = 0; i < ReminderPlanner.ADVANCE_OPTIONS.length; i++) {
      if (ReminderPlanner.ADVANCE_OPTIONS[i] === value) {
        return value;
      }
    }
    return 30;
  }

  /** 生成提醒计划：截止时间需在未来，触发时间 = 截止 - 提前分钟（若已过则 1 分钟后）。 */
  static plan(row: HomeworkRow, nowMillis: number, advanceMinutes: number): ReminderPlan | undefined {
    const dueAt: number | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue(row.date, row.time);
    if (dueAt === undefined || dueAt <= nowMillis) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const advance: number = ReminderPlanner.normalizeAdvance(advanceMinutes);
    const triggerAt: number = Math.max(nowMillis + 60 * 1000, dueAt - advance * 60 * 1000);
    const plan: ReminderPlan = new ReminderPlan();
    plan.homeworkId = row.id;
    plan.title = ReminderPlanner.titleOf(row);
    plan.content = '截止 ' + HomeworkDueCalculator.dueText(dueAt)
      + (advance >= 60 ? '（提前 ' + Math.round(advance / 60) + ' 小时）' : '（提前 ' + advance + ' 分钟）');
    plan.triggerAt = triggerAt;
    plan.dueAt = dueAt;
    return plan;
  }

  static titleOf(row: HomeworkRow): string {
    const subject: string = row.subject.trim();
    if (subject.length > 0) {
      return subject + ' 作业截止';
    }
    const firstLine: string = row.content.split('\n')[0].trim();
    return (firstLine.length > 0 ? firstLine : '作业') + ' 截止';
  }

  /** 是否临近（24h 内）/已过期，用于列表提醒标记。 */
  static urgency(dueAt: number | undefined, nowMillis: number): string {
    if (dueAt === undefined) {
      return '';
    }
    const diff: number = dueAt - nowMillis;
    if (diff < 0) {
      return '已过期';
    }
    if (diff <= 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
      return '今日到期';
    }
    return '';
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { ClassMember } from '../../data/member/ClassMember';

/** 点名状态（到 / 假；空 = 未点）。 */
export class RollStatus {
  static readonly DONE: string = '到';
  static readonly ABSENT: string = '假';
}

/** `userdata.roster` 里的点名相关字段（其余字段原样保留）。 */
export class RollState {
  rollSel: number[] = [];
  rollSt: Map<number, string> = new Map<number, string>();
  rollNames: string = '';
  rosterSel: number[] = [];
  groupSel: number[] = [];
}

/** 点名范围。 */
export enum RollScope {
  ALL = '全班',
  COMMITTEE = '班委',
  LEAGUE = '团员'
}

/** 一行点名记录（UI 用）。 */
export class RollRow {
  seat: number = 0;
  name: string = '';
  status: string = '';
  processed: boolean = false;
}

export class RollCounts {
  done: number = 0;
  absent: number = 0;
  pending: number = 0;
  total: number = 0;

  progress(): number {
    if (this.total <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return Math.round((this.done + this.absent) / this.total * 100);
  }
}

/** `userdata.roster` 点名字段读写（保留 rosterSel/groupSel 等其它字段）。 */
export class RollCodec {
  static read(sections: Blob): RollState {
    const state: RollState = new RollState();
    const roster: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'roster'));
    if (roster === undefined) {
      return state;
    }
    state.rollSel = seatsOf(JsonBlob.get(roster, 'rollSel'));
    state.rosterSel = seatsOf(JsonBlob.get(roster, 'rosterSel'));
    state.groupSel = seatsOf(JsonBlob.get(roster, 'groupSel'));
    state.rollNames = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(roster, 'rollNames'), '');
    const rollSt: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(roster, 'rollSt'));
    if (rollSt !== undefined) {
      const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(rollSt);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        const seat: number = Number(keys[i]);
        const value: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(rollSt, keys[i]), '');
        if (Number.isFinite(seat) && seat > 0 && (value === RollStatus.DONE || value === RollStatus.ABSENT)) {
          state.rollSt.set(Math.round(seat), value);
        }
      }
    }
    return state;
  }

  /** 写回：只改 roster 段的点名字段，其它 section/字段原样保留。 */
  static write(current: Blob, state: RollState): Blob {
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const roster: Blob = {};
    const existing: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(current, 'roster'));
    if (existing !== undefined) {
      const rosterKeys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(existing);
      for (let i = 0; i < rosterKeys.length; i++) {
        roster[rosterKeys[i]] = existing[rosterKeys[i]];
      }
    }
    roster['rollSel'] = state.rollSel.slice(0);
    roster['rollNames'] = state.rollNames;
    const rollSt: Blob = {};
    state.rollSt.forEach((value: string, seat: number) => {
      if (value === RollStatus.DONE || value === RollStatus.ABSENT) {
        rollSt['' + seat] = value;
      }
    });
    roster['rollSt'] = rollSt;
    next['roster'] = roster;
    return next;
  }
}

/** 点名纯逻辑。 */
export class RollLogic {
  /** 范围座号（未指定 = 不限）。 */
  static scopeSeats(members: ClassMember[], leagueSeats: number[], scope: RollScope): Set<number> {
    const seats: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
    if (scope === RollScope.ALL) {
      return seats;
    }
    if (scope === RollScope.COMMITTEE) {
      for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
        if (members[i].isCommittee() || members[i].badge.indexOf('班委') >= 0) {
          seats.add(members[i].seat);
        }
      }
      return seats;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < leagueSeats.length; i++) {
      seats.add(leagueSeats[i]);
    }
    return seats;
  }

  /** 自定义名单与范围求交（picked 为空 → 范围全量）。 */
  static intersect(scope: Set<number>, picked: number[]): Set<number> {
    const out: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
    if (picked.length === 0) {
      scope.forEach((seat: number) => {
        out.add(seat);
      });
      return out;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < picked.length; i++) {
      const seat: number = picked[i];
      if (scope.size === 0 || scope.has(seat)) {
        out.add(seat);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 生成点名行：未处理在前（按座号），已处理沉底。 */
  static rows(members: ClassMember[], statuses: Map<number, string>, scope: Set<number>): RollRow[] {
    const pending: RollRow[] = [];
    const processed: RollRow[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
      const member: ClassMember = members[i];
      if (scope.size > 0 && !scope.has(member.seat)) {
        continue;
      }
      const row: RollRow = new RollRow();
      row.seat = member.seat;
      row.name = member.name;
      const status: string | undefined = statuses.get(member.seat);
      row.status = status !== undefined ? status : '';
      row.processed = row.status.length > 0;
      if (row.processed) {
        processed.push(row);
      } else {
        pending.push(row);
      }
    }
    pending.sort((a: RollRow, b: RollRow) => a.seat - b.seat);
    processed.sort((a: RollRow, b: RollRow) => a.seat - b.seat);
    const out: RollRow[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < pending.length; i++) {
      out.push(pending[i]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < processed.length; i++) {
      out.push(processed[i]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static counts(rows: RollRow[]): RollCounts {
    const counts: RollCounts = new RollCounts();
    counts.total = rows.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (rows[i].status === RollStatus.DONE) {
        counts.done += 1;
      } else if (rows[i].status === RollStatus.ABSENT) {
        counts.absent += 1;
      } else {
        counts.pending += 1;
      }
    }
    return counts;
  }

  /** 切换状态：同状态再点一次 = 取消（返回新 Map）。 */
  static toggle(statuses: Map<number, string>, seat: number, status: string): Map<number, string> {
    const next: Map<number, string> = new Map<number, string>();
    statuses.forEach((value: string, key: number) => {
      next.set(key, value);
    });
    if (next.get(seat) === status) {
      next.delete(seat);
    } else {
      next.set(seat, status);
    }
    return next;
  }

  /** 清空指定范围的已点状态（空范围 = 全清）。 */
  static clear(statuses: Map<number, string>, scope: Set<number>): Map<number, string> {
    const next: Map<number, string> = new Map<number, string>();
    statuses.forEach((value: string, key: number) => {
      if (scope.size > 0 && !scope.has(key)) {
        next.set(key, value);
      }
    });
    return next;
  }

  /** 未到/请假名单（导出用）。 */
  static namesOf(rows: RollRow[], status: string): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (rows[i].status === status) {
        out.push(rows[i].name);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
}

function seatsOf(value: Object | null | undefined): number[] {
  const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(value);
  if (array === undefined) {
    return [];
  }
  const seats: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
    const seat: number = JsonBlob.asNumber(array[i], 0);
    if (Number.isFinite(seat) && seat > 0) {
      const rounded: number = Math.round(seat);
      if (seats.indexOf(rounded) < 0) {
        seats.push(rounded);
      }
    }
  }
  seats.sort((a: number, b: number) => a - b);
  return seats;
}
/** 手表端纯逻辑：倒计时、时间、离线判断（可单测）。 */
export class WatchLogic {
  /** 距上课还有几分钟；<=0 表示已开始。 */
  static minutesUntil(atMs: number, nowMs: number): number {
    return Math.floor((atMs - nowMs) / 60000);
  }

  /** 倒计时文案。 */
  static countdownText(atMs: number, nowMs: number): string {
    const min: number = WatchLogic.minutesUntil(atMs, nowMs);
    if (min > 60) {
      const h: number = Math.floor(min / 60);
      return '还有 ' + h + ' 小时 ' + (min % 60) + ' 分';
    }
    if (min > 0) {
      return '还有 ' + min + ' 分钟';
    }
    return '已开始';
  }

  /** HH:mm。 */
  static clock(ms: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(ms);
    const h: number = d.getHours();
    const m: number = d.getMinutes();
    return (h < 10 ? '0' + h : '' + h) + ':' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : '' + m);
  }

  /** 截止文案：今天/明天/日期 + HH:mm。 */
  static dueText(date: string, time: string, nowMs: number): string {
    if (date.length === 0) {
      return time.length > 0 ? time + ' 截止' : '';
    }
    const now: Date = new Date(nowMs);
    const today: string = WatchLogic.dateKey(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, now.getDate());
    const tomorrow: Date = new Date(now.getTime() + 24 * 3600 * 1000);
    const tmr: string = WatchLogic.dateKey(tomorrow.getFullYear(), tomorrow.getMonth() + 1, tomorrow.getDate());
    let day: string = date;
    if (date === today) {
      day = '今天';
    } else if (date === tmr) {
      day = '明天';
    }
    return day + ' ' + (time.length > 0 ? time : '') + ' 截止';
  }

  static dateKey(y: number, m: number, d: number): string {
    const mm: string = m < 10 ? '0' + m : '' + m;
    const dd: string = d < 10 ? '0' + d : '' + d;
    return y + '-' + mm + '-' + dd;
  }

  /** 超过 max 字符截断。 */
  static short(text: string, max: number): string {
    if (text.length <= max) {
      return text;
    }
    return text.substring(0, max - 1) + '…';
  }

  /** 所有数据源都失败且无缓存 → 离线。 */
  static offline(anyOk: boolean): boolean {
    return !anyOk;
  }
}
import {
  WaterCharge,
  WaterMonthStats,
  WaterRecord,
  WaterRoomState,
  WaterRules
} from './WaterModels';
import { WaterCodec } from './WaterCodec';
import { WaterMonth } from './WaterMonth';

/**
 * 水量计算（纯函数，契约 `_water_contract.md` §0/§7）：
 * - 本期用量 = 本次读数 − 该宿舍月份升序的上一条读数；
 * - 水费 = `max(0, 用量 − 2×人数) × 3.03`（2 位）；
 * - 折合扣电 = `水费 ÷ 0.58`（1 位）；
 * - 无上一条 → 首次记录（用量/水费/扣电均无，不伪造 0）。
 */
export class WaterCalculator {
  static freeWater(persons: number): number {
    return WaterRules.WATER_FREE_PER_PERSON * WaterCodec.normalizePersons(persons);
  }

  static freeElec(persons: number): number {
    return WaterRules.ELEC_FREE_PER_PERSON * WaterCodec.normalizePersons(persons);
  }

  /** 同宿舍、月份升序的上一条记录（不含 month 本身）。 */
  static previousRecord(room: WaterRoomState, month: string): WaterRecord | undefined {
    let found: WaterRecord | undefined = undefined;
    for (let i = 0; i < room.records.length; i++) {
      const record: WaterRecord = room.records[i];
      if (record.month < month && (found === undefined || record.month > found.month)) {
        found = record;
      }
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** 同宿舍的下一条记录（用于录入校验）。 */
  static nextRecord(room: WaterRoomState, month: string): WaterRecord | undefined {
    let found: WaterRecord | undefined = undefined;
    for (let i = 0; i < room.records.length; i++) {
      const record: WaterRecord = room.records[i];
      if (record.month > month && (found === undefined || record.month < found.month)) {
        found = record;
      }
    }
    return found;
  }

  static recordOf(room: WaterRoomState, month: string): WaterRecord | undefined {
    for (let i = 0; i < room.records.length; i++) {
      if (room.records[i].month === month) {
        return room.records[i];
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  /** 某条记录的用量/水费/折合扣电。 */
  static charge(room: WaterRoomState, record: WaterRecord, personsOverride: number): WaterCharge {
    const charge: WaterCharge = new WaterCharge();
    const persons: number = WaterCodec.normalizePersons(personsOverride);
    charge.free = WaterCalculator.freeWater(persons);
    const previous: WaterRecord | undefined = WaterCalculator.previousRecord(room, record.month);
    if (previous === undefined) {
      return charge;
    }
    charge.hasPrevious = true;
    charge.hasUsage = true;
    charge.usage = WaterCodec.round2(Math.max(0, record.reading - previous.reading));
    charge.excess = WaterCodec.round2(Math.max(0, charge.usage - charge.free));
    charge.fee = WaterCodec.round2(charge.excess * WaterRules.WATER_PRICE);
    charge.degree = WaterCodec.round1(charge.fee / WaterRules.ELEC_PRICE);
    charge.within = charge.excess <= 0.001;
    return charge;
  }

  /** 某个月份的统计卡数据。 */
  static stats(room: WaterRoomState, month: string, nowMillis: number): WaterMonthStats {
    const stats: WaterMonthStats = new WaterMonthStats();
    const safeMonth: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(month);
    stats.month = safeMonth !== undefined ? safeMonth : WaterMonth.current(nowMillis);
    stats.persons = WaterCodec.normalizePersons(room.persons);
    stats.record = WaterCalculator.recordOf(room, stats.month);
    stats.previous = WaterCalculator.previousRecord(room, stats.month);
    if (stats.record !== undefined) {
      stats.charge = WaterCalculator.charge(room, stats.record, stats.persons);
    } else {
      const charge: WaterCharge = new WaterCharge();
      charge.free = WaterCalculator.freeWater(stats.persons);
      charge.hasPrevious = stats.previous !== undefined;
      stats.charge = charge;
    }
    if (stats.charge.hasUsage) {
      const days: number = Math.max(1, WaterMonth.elapsedDays(stats.month, nowMillis));
      stats.dailyAverage = WaterCodec.round2(stats.charge.usage / days);
      stats.hasDailyAverage = true;
    }
    const previousMonth: string = WaterMonth.shift(stats.month, -1);
    const previousMonthRecord: WaterRecord | undefined = WaterCalculator.recordOf(room, previousMonth);
    if (previousMonthRecord !== undefined) {
      const previousCharge: WaterCharge = WaterCalculator.charge(room, previousMonthRecord, stats.persons);
      if (previousCharge.hasUsage) {
        stats.previousMonthUsage = previousCharge.usage;
        stats.hasPreviousMonthUsage = true;
      }
    }
    if (stats.charge.hasUsage && stats.hasPreviousMonthUsage) {
      stats.deltaVsPreviousMonth = WaterCodec.round2(stats.charge.usage - stats.previousMonthUsage);
      stats.hasDelta = true;
    }
    return stats;
  }

  static fmtReading(value: number, hasValue: boolean): string {
    return hasValue ? value.toFixed(2) : '—';
  }

  static fmtMoney(value: number, hasValue: boolean): string {
    return hasValue ? value.toFixed(2) : '—';
  }

  static fmtDegree(value: number, hasValue: boolean): string {
    return hasValue ? value.toFixed(1) : '—';
  }

  /** 规则卡文案（与网页一致）。 */
  static ruleLines(persons: number): string[][] {
    const safe: number = WaterCodec.normalizePersons(persons);
    const quota: number = WaterCalculator.freeWater(safe);
    const lines: string[][] = [
      ['水价', WaterRules.WATER_PRICE.toFixed(2) + ' 元/吨（无阶梯）'],
      ['免费水量', '2 吨/人/月 × ' + safe + ' 人 = ' + quota.toFixed(1) + ' 吨'],
      ['折合扣电', '水费 ÷ 0.58 元/度（1 吨 ≈ ' + WaterRules.tonToDegree().toFixed(2) + ' 度）'],
      ['学年划拨', WaterRules.CYCLE_MONTHS + ' 个月']
    ];
    return lines;
  }
}
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { WaterRecord, WaterRoomState, WaterRules, WaterState } from './WaterModels';

/**
 * `userdata.water` section 编解码（契约 `_water_contract.md` §2/§7）。
 *
 * 输出键序固定：`rooms` → `<roomverify>` → `p`、`recs` → `m`、`r`、`ts`。
 * 输入容错：人数非 4/6 → 4；月份非法/读数非有限负数丢弃；同月保留最后一条；按月升序；每间 ≤120 条。
 */
export class WaterCodec {
  private static readonly MONTH_PATTERN: RegExp = new RegExp('^\\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$');

  static fromJson(section: JsonValue | undefined): WaterState {
    const state: WaterState = new WaterState();
    const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(section);
    if (obj === undefined) {
      return state;
    }
    const rooms: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'rooms'));
    if (rooms === undefined) {
      return state;
    }
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(rooms);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      const key: string = keys[i].trim();
      if (key.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const roomBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(rooms, keys[i]));
      if (roomBlob === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const room: WaterRoomState = new WaterRoomState();
      room.persons = WaterCodec.normalizePersons(Math.round(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(roomBlob, 'p'),
        WaterRules.PERSONS_DEFAULT)));
      room.records = WaterCodec.normalizeRecords(JsonBlob.get(roomBlob, 'recs'));
      state.rooms.set(key, room);
    }
    return state;
  }

  static toJson(state: WaterState): Blob {
    const rooms: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = [];
    state.rooms.forEach((room: WaterRoomState, key: string) => {
      keys.push(key);
    });
    keys.sort();
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      const room: WaterRoomState | undefined = state.rooms.get(keys[i]);
      if (room === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const recs: Object[] = [];
      const records: WaterRecord[] = WaterCodec.normalizeRecords(recordsToJson(room.records));
      for (let j = 0; j < records.length; j++) {
        recs.push(recordToBlob(records[j]));
      }
      const roomBlob: Blob = {};
      roomBlob['p'] = WaterCodec.normalizePersons(room.persons);
      roomBlob['recs'] = recs;
      rooms[keys[i]] = roomBlob;
    }
    const out: Blob = {};
    out['rooms'] = rooms;
    return out;
  }

  static normalizePersons(persons: number): number {
    for (let i = 0; i < WaterRules.PERSONS_OPTIONS.length; i++) {
      if (WaterRules.PERSONS_OPTIONS[i] === persons) {
        return persons;
      }
    }
    return WaterRules.PERSONS_DEFAULT;
  }

  static normalizeMonth(month: string): string | undefined {
    const text: string = month.trim();
    return WaterCodec.MONTH_PATTERN.test(text) ? text : undefined;
  }

  /** 归一记录：合法月份+读数；同月后者覆盖；升序；≤120。 */
  static normalizeRecords(value: JsonValue | undefined): WaterRecord[] {
    const array: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(value);
    if (array === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    const byMonth: Map<string, WaterRecord> = new Map<string, WaterRecord>();
    for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
      const obj: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(array[i]);
      if (obj === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const month: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(
        JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'm'), ''));
      if (month === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const reading: number = readingOf(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'r'));
      if (!Number.isFinite(reading) || reading < 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const record: WaterRecord = new WaterRecord();
      record.month = month;
      record.reading = WaterCodec.round2(reading);
      record.ts = JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(obj, 'ts'), 0);
      byMonth.set(month, record);
    }
    const months: string[] = [];
    byMonth.forEach((record: WaterRecord, month: string) => {
      months.push(month);
    });
    months.sort();
    const start: number = months.length > WaterRules.MAX_RECORDS_PER_ROOM
      ? months.length - WaterRules.MAX_RECORDS_PER_ROOM : 0;
    const out: WaterRecord[] = [];
    for (let i = start; i < months.length; i++) {
      const record: WaterRecord | undefined = byMonth.get(months[i]);
      if (record !== undefined) {
        out.push(record);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  static round2(value: number): number {
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.round(value * 100) / 100 : 0;
  }

  static round1(value: number): number {
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.round(value * 10) / 10 : 0;
  }
}

function readingOf(value: JsonValue | undefined): number {
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    return value as number;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return Number(value as string);
  }
  return Number.NaN;
}

function recordToBlob(record: WaterRecord): Blob {
  const blob: Blob = {};
  blob['m'] = record.month;
  const rounded: number = WaterCodec.round2(record.reading);
  if (Math.abs(rounded - Math.round(rounded)) < 1e-9) {
    blob['r'] = Math.round(rounded);
  } else {
    blob['r'] = rounded;
  }
  blob['ts'] = record.ts;
  return blob;
}

function recordsToJson(records: WaterRecord[]): Object[] {
  const out: Object[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
    out.push(recordToBlob(records[i]));
  }
  return out;
}
/** 计费规则常量（网页/小程序同值；页面唯一来源）。 */
export class WaterRules {
  /** 电 0.58 元/度。 */
  static readonly ELEC_PRICE: number = 0.58;
  /** 水 3.03 元/吨（无阶梯、无加价）。 */
  static readonly WATER_PRICE: number = 3.03;
  /** 免费水量 2 吨/人/月。 */
  static readonly WATER_FREE_PER_PERSON: number = 2.0;
  /** 免费电量 5 度/人/月（展示用）。 */
  static readonly ELEC_FREE_PER_PERSON: number = 5.0;
  static readonly PERSONS_DEFAULT: number = 4;
  static readonly PERSONS_OPTIONS: number[] = [4, 6];
  static readonly MAX_RECORDS_PER_ROOM: number = 120;
  static readonly CYCLE_MONTHS: number = 10;

  /** 1 吨水折合扣电（≈5.2241 度）。 */
  static tonToDegree(): number {
    return WaterRules.WATER_PRICE / WaterRules.ELEC_PRICE;
  }
}

/** 一条抄表记录。 */
export class WaterRecord {
  month: string = '';
  reading: number = 0;
  ts: number = 0;
}

/** 一间宿舍的水量状态。 */
export class WaterRoomState {
  persons: number = WaterRules.PERSONS_DEFAULT;
  records: WaterRecord[] = [];

  latest(): WaterRecord | undefined {
    return this.records.length > 0 ? this.records[this.records.length - 1] : undefined;
  }
}

/** 整个 water section。 */
export class WaterState {
  rooms: Map<string, WaterRoomState> = new Map<string, WaterRoomState>();

  room(roomVerify: string): WaterRoomState | undefined {
    return this.rooms.get(roomVerify.trim());
  }

  roomOrDefault(roomVerify: string): WaterRoomState {
    const found: WaterRoomState | undefined = this.room(roomVerify);
    return found !== undefined ? found : new WaterRoomState();
  }

  recordOf(roomVerify: string, month: string): WaterRecord | undefined {
    const room: WaterRoomState | undefined = this.room(roomVerify);
    if (room === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < room.records.length; i++) {
      if (room.records[i].month === month) {
        return room.records[i];
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  /** 深拷贝（避免共享引用）。 */
  copy(): WaterState {
    const next: WaterState = new WaterState();
    this.rooms.forEach((room: WaterRoomState, key: string) => {
      const roomCopy: WaterRoomState = new WaterRoomState();
      roomCopy.persons = room.persons;
      for (let i = 0; i < room.records.length; i++) {
        roomCopy.records.push(cloneRecord(room.records[i]));
      }
      next.rooms.set(key, roomCopy);
    });
    return next;
  }
}

/** 一次抄表读数/水费计算。 */
export class WaterCharge {
  usage: number = 0;
  hasUsage: boolean = false;
  free: number = 0;
  excess: number = 0;
  fee: number = 0;
  degree: number = 0;
  within: boolean = false;
  hasPrevious: boolean = false;
}

/** 某个月份的统计。 */
export class WaterMonthStats {
  month: string = '';
  persons: number = WaterRules.PERSONS_DEFAULT;
  record: WaterRecord | undefined = undefined;
  previous: WaterRecord | undefined = undefined;
  charge: WaterCharge = new WaterCharge();
  dailyAverage: number = 0;
  hasDailyAverage: boolean = false;
  previousMonthUsage: number = 0;
  hasPreviousMonthUsage: boolean = false;
  deltaVsPreviousMonth: number = 0;
  hasDelta: boolean = false;
}

/** 抄表校验结果。 */
export class WaterRecordReview {
  valid: boolean = false;
  message: string = '';
  record: WaterRecord | undefined = undefined;
  replaceExisting: boolean = false;
}

export function cloneRecord(record: WaterRecord): WaterRecord {
  const copy: WaterRecord = new WaterRecord();
  copy.month = record.month;
  copy.reading = record.reading;
  copy.ts = record.ts;
  return copy;
}
import { WaterCodec } from './WaterCodec';

/** 月份工具（`YYYY-MM`，本地时区）。 */
export class WaterMonth {
  static current(nowMillis: number): string {
    const d: Date = new Date(nowMillis);
    return yearMonth(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + 1);
  }

  /** 月份平移（delta 可负）。 */
  static shift(month: string, delta: number): string {
    const safe: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(month);
    if (safe === undefined) {
      return month;
    }
    let year: number = Number(safe.substring(0, 4));
    let monthNum: number = Number(safe.substring(5, 7));
    const total: number = year * 12 + (monthNum - 1) + delta;
    year = Math.floor(total / 12);
    monthNum = total - year * 12 + 1;
    return yearMonth(year, monthNum);
  }

  /** 该月已过天数（当月=今天几号；过去月=整月；未来月=1）。 */
  static elapsedDays(month: string, nowMillis: number): number {
    const safe: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(month);
    if (safe === undefined) {
      return 1;
    }
    const current: string = WaterMonth.current(nowMillis);
    if (safe === current) {
      return Math.max(1, new Date(nowMillis).getDate());
    }
    if (safe < current) {
      return WaterMonth.daysInMonth(safe);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  static daysInMonth(month: string): number {
    const safe: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(month);
    if (safe === undefined) {
      return 30;
    }
    const year: number = Number(safe.substring(0, 4));
    const monthNum: number = Number(safe.substring(5, 7));
    return new Date(year, monthNum, 0).getDate();
  }

  static label(month: string): string {
    const safe: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(month);
    return safe !== undefined ? safe : month;
  }
}

function yearMonth(year: number, monthNum: number): string {
  const m: number = monthNum < 10 ? monthNum : monthNum;
  return '' + year + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' + m : '' + m);
}
import { WaterRecord, WaterRecordReview, WaterRoomState, WaterRules, WaterState } from './WaterModels';
import { WaterCodec } from './WaterCodec';
import { WaterCalculator } from './WaterCalculator';
import { WaterMonth } from './WaterMonth';

/**
 * 水量状态变更（纯函数）：
 * - 录入：月份合法、读数 ≥0、2 位小数；不得小于上一条、不得大于下一条；同月覆盖需确认；
 * - 删除：按月份；人数切换 4/6；清空单间；
 * - 所有变更返回新 WaterState（整段 LWW 写回 userdata.water）。
 */
export class WaterMutator {
  static review(room: WaterRoomState, monthRaw: string, readingRaw: string, nowMillis: number): WaterRecordReview {
    const review: WaterRecordReview = new WaterRecordReview();
    const month: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(monthRaw);
    if (month === undefined) {
      review.message = '月份格式应为 YYYY-MM';
      return review;
    }
    const text: string = readingRaw.trim().replace(new RegExp('\\s+', 'g'), '');
    const reading: number = Number(text);
    if (text.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(reading)) {
      review.message = '请输入水表读数（吨）';
      return review;
    }
    if (reading < 0) {
      review.message = '读数需为 ≥0 的数字';
      return review;
    }
    const rounded: number = WaterCodec.round2(reading);
    const previous: WaterRecord | undefined = WaterCalculator.previousRecord(room, month);
    if (previous !== undefined && rounded < previous.reading) {
      review.message = '读数不能小于上月（' + previous.month + '）的 ' + previous.reading.toFixed(2) + ' 吨';
      return review;
    }
    const next: WaterRecord | undefined = WaterCalculator.nextRecord(room, month);
    if (next !== undefined && rounded > next.reading) {
      review.message = '读数不能大于下一条记录（' + next.month + '）的 ' + next.reading.toFixed(2) + ' 吨';
      return review;
    }
    const existing: WaterRecord | undefined = WaterCalculator.recordOf(room, month);
    review.valid = true;
    review.replaceExisting = existing !== undefined;
    const record: WaterRecord = new WaterRecord();
    record.month = month;
    record.reading = rounded;
    record.ts = nowMillis;
    review.record = record;
    return review;
  }

  /** 写入/覆盖一条记录。 */
  static put(state: WaterState, roomVerify: string, record: WaterRecord): WaterState {
    const key: string = roomVerify.trim();
    const month: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(record.month);
    if (key.length === 0 || month === undefined) {
      return state;
    }
    const next: WaterState = state.copy();
    const room: WaterRoomState = next.rooms.has(key) ? next.rooms.get(key) as WaterRoomState : new WaterRoomState();
    const merged: Map<string, WaterRecord> = new Map<string, WaterRecord>();
    for (let i = 0; i < room.records.length; i++) {
      merged.set(room.records[i].month, room.records[i]);
    }
    const normalized: WaterRecord = new WaterRecord();
    normalized.month = month;
    normalized.reading = WaterCodec.round2(record.reading);
    normalized.ts = record.ts;
    merged.set(month, normalized);
    const months: string[] = [];
    merged.forEach((value: WaterRecord, keyMonth: string) => {
      months.push(keyMonth);
    });
    months.sort();
    const start: number = months.length > WaterRules.MAX_RECORDS_PER_ROOM
      ? months.length - WaterRules.MAX_RECORDS_PER_ROOM : 0;
    const records: WaterRecord[] = [];
    for (let i = start; i < months.length; i++) {
      const item: WaterRecord | undefined = merged.get(months[i]);
      if (item !== undefined) {
        records.push(item);
      }
    }
    room.records = records;
    next.rooms.set(key, room);
    return next;
  }

  /** 删除某月记录。 */
  static delete(state: WaterState, roomVerify: string, month: string): WaterState {
    const key: string = roomVerify.trim();
    const safeMonth: string | undefined = WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(month);
    const room: WaterRoomState | undefined = state.rooms.get(key);
    if (safeMonth === undefined || room === undefined) {
      return state;
    }
    const next: WaterState = state.copy();
    const nextRoom: WaterRoomState = next.rooms.get(key) as WaterRoomState;
    const records: WaterRecord[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < nextRoom.records.length; i++) {
      if (nextRoom.records[i].month !== safeMonth) {
        records.push(nextRoom.records[i]);
      }
    }
    if (records.length === nextRoom.records.length) {
      return state;
    }
    nextRoom.records = records;
    return next;
  }

  /** 切换 4/6 人间（影响免费额度与计费；历史记录不变）。 */
  static withPersons(state: WaterState, roomVerify: string, persons: number): WaterState {
    const key: string = roomVerify.trim();
    if (key.length === 0) {
      return state;
    }
    const safePersons: number = WaterCodec.normalizePersons(persons);
    const next: WaterState = state.copy();
    const room: WaterRoomState = next.rooms.has(key) ? next.rooms.get(key) as WaterRoomState : new WaterRoomState();
    room.persons = safePersons;
    next.rooms.set(key, room);
    return next;
  }

  /** 删除单间宿舍水量数据。 */
  static clearRoom(state: WaterState, roomVerify: string): WaterState {
    const key: string = roomVerify.trim();
    if (!state.rooms.has(key)) {
      return state;
    }
    const next: WaterState = state.copy();
    next.rooms.delete(key);
    return next;
  }

  /** 当前月份（供 UI 默认值）。 */
  static currentMonth(nowMillis: number): string {
    return WaterMonth.current(nowMillis);
  }
}
import { Services } from '../app/Services';
import { AppGlobal } from '../app/AppGlobal';
import { Session } from '../data/session/Session';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { UserdataPullResult } from '../data/sync/UserdataRepository';
import { Tokens } from '../ui/theme/Tokens';
import { Motion } from '../ui/theme/Motion';
import { BrandMark } from '../ui/components/BrandMark';
import { IdentityScreen } from '../ui/screens/IdentityScreen';
import { AppShell } from '../ui/shell/AppShell';
import { Device } from '../common/Device';
import { WatchShell } from '../ui/watch/WatchShell';
import { WatchLogin } from '../ui/watch/WatchLogin';
import { ToolScreen } from '../ui/tools/ToolScreen';
import { Log } from '../common/Log';
import { AppPush } from '../features/push/AppPush';

const TAG: string = 'Index';

/**
 * 应用根：启动 → 身份门禁 → 三 Tab 外壳 → 工具页。
 *
 * 门禁语义与网页/小程序/安卓一致：无有效会话一律先身份页，不允许绕过；
 * 任一数据请求 401/403 由 HttpClient 回调清会话回身份页。
 */
@Entry
@Component
struct Index {
  @State private phase: string = 'boot';
  @State private userName: string = '';
  @State private maskedSid: string = '';
  @State private roleLabel: string = '';
  @State private isAdmin: boolean = false;
  @State private openToolId: string = '';
  @State private authNotice: string = '';
  @State private wearable: boolean = Device.isWearable();
  @State private quickIds: string[] = [];
  @State private syncState: string = '未同步';

  private session: Session | undefined = undefined;

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    Services.api.setTokenProvider(() => this.session !== undefined ? this.session.token : '');
    Services.api.setTokenInvalidHandler(() => {
      this.handleTokenInvalid();
    });
    Services.userdata.onSectionsChanged((sections: Blob) => {
      this.applySections(sections);
    });
    AppGlobal.onToolClosed = () => {
      this.openToolId = '';
    };
    this.bootstrap();
  }

  private async bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
    const saved: Session | undefined = await Services.sessionStore.load();
    if (saved !== undefined && saved.isLikelyValid(Date.now())) {
      Log.i(TAG, '已恢复本机会话，直接进入');
      await this.enterApp(saved);
      return;
    }
    this.phase = 'auth';
  }

  private async enterApp(session: Session): Promise<void> {
    this.session = session;
    this.userName = session.name;
    this.maskedSid = session.maskedSid();
    this.isAdmin = session.isAdmin;
    this.roleLabel = session.isAdmin ? '管理员' : session.role;
    this.authNotice = '';
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.SLOW, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.phase = 'app';
    });

    Services.currentSid = session.sid;
    Services.currentName = session.name;
    Services.currentToken = session.token;
    AppPush.syncOnLaunch();
    // 先恢复本机偏好（离线/未同步时 UI 也看到上次设置），再后台拉云端
    await Services.userdata.hydrateFromLocal();
    this.applySections(Services.userdata.currentSections());
    this.syncNow();
    Services.visits.reportOnce();
  }

  private applySections(sections: Blob): void {
    const raw: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'homeTools'));
    const ids: string[] = [];
    if (raw !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
        const id: string = JsonBlob.asString(raw[i], '');
        if (id.length > 0) {
          ids.push(id);
        }
      }
    }
    this.quickIds = ids;
  }

  /** 首页快捷写回 userdata（经仓库做脏检测 + 防抖推送 + 跨端同步）。 */
  private async setHomeTools(ids: string[]): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const arr: Object[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      arr.push(ids[i]);
    }
    next['homeTools'] = arr;
    this.quickIds = ids;
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
  }

  private async syncNow(): Promise<void> {
    if (Services.currentSid.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.syncState = '同步中';
    const pull: UserdataPullResult = await Services.userdata.pull(false);
    if (!pull.ok()) {
      this.syncState = pull.status === 'disabled' ? '云同步已关闭' : '离线';
      return;
    }
    this.applySections(Services.userdata.currentSections());
    this.syncState = '已同步';
    // 顺带刷新 marks / 名单（失败不影响界面）
    Services.marks.refresh(false);
    Services.members.load(false);
    Services.league.load(false);
  }

  private handleTokenInvalid(): void {
    Log.w(TAG, '身份失效，清除会话并回到身份页');
    this.session = undefined;
    Services.currentSid = '';
    Services.currentName = '';
    Services.currentToken = '';
    Services.cloudspace.reset();
    Services.sessionStore.clear();
    AppGlobal.openToolId = '';
    this.openToolId = '';
    this.authNotice = '身份已失效，请重新输入学号与姓名';
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.phase = 'auth';
    });
  }

  private async logout(): Promise<void> {
    // 退出前尽力把本机改动推上去，再清空本机数据桶（合规：不留班级数据）
    await Services.userdata.flush();
    this.session = undefined;
    await Services.userdata.clearLocal();
    await Services.members.clear();
    await Services.league.clear();
    Services.currentSid = '';
    Services.currentName = '';
    Services.currentToken = '';
    Services.cloudspace.reset();
    await Services.sessionStore.clear();
    AppGlobal.openToolId = '';
    this.openToolId = '';
    this.userName = '';
    this.maskedSid = '';
    this.roleLabel = '';
    this.isAdmin = false;
    this.authNotice = '';
    this.quickIds = [];
    this.syncState = '未同步';
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.phase = 'auth';
    });
  }

  private openTool(id: string): void {
    if (this.wearable) {
      return;
    }
    AppGlobal.openToolId = id;
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Tokens.DUR_NORMAL, curve: Curve.FastOutSlowIn }, () => {
      this.openToolId = id;
    });
  }

  private closeTool(): void {
    AppGlobal.openToolId = '';
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Tokens.DUR_FAST, curve: Curve.FastOutSlowIn }, () => {
      this.openToolId = '';
    });
  }

  onBackPress(): boolean {
    if (this.openToolId.length > 0) {
      this.closeTool();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  build() {
    Stack() {
      if (this.phase === 'auth') {
        if (this.wearable) {
          WatchLogin({
            notice: this.authNotice,
            onSignedIn: (session: Session) => {
              this.enterApp(session);
            }
          })
        } else {
          IdentityScreen({
            notice: this.authNotice,
            onSignedIn: (session: Session) => {
              this.enterApp(session);
            }
          })
            .transition(TransitionEffect.OPACITY.combine(TransitionEffect.scale({ x: 0.99, y: 0.99 })))
        }
      } else if (this.phase === 'app') {
        if (this.wearable) {
          WatchShell({
            userName: this.userName,
            onLogout: () => {
              this.logout();
            }
          })
        } else {
          AppShell({
          userName: this.userName,
          maskedSid: this.maskedSid,
          roleLabel: this.roleLabel,
          isAdmin: this.isAdmin,
          quickIds: this.quickIds,
          syncState: this.syncState,
          onOpenTool: (id: string) => {
            this.openTool(id);
          },
          onSetHomeTools: (ids: string[]) => {
            this.setHomeTools(ids);
          },
          onSyncNow: () => {
            this.syncNow();
          },
          onLogout: () => {
            this.logout();
          }
        })
        }
      } else {
        Column({ space: 16 }) {
          BrandMark({ markSize: 34 })
          Text('班级工具站')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
      }

      if (this.openToolId.length > 0) {
        ToolScreen({
          toolId: this.openToolId,
          onClose: () => {
            this.closeTool();
          }
        })
          .transition(TransitionEffect.asymmetric(Motion.pageEnter(), Motion.pageExit()))
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
  }
}
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';

/** 品牌标记：三圆点几何（与网页 favicon / 小程序 / 安卓 BrandMark 一致）。 */
@Component
export struct BrandMark {
  @Prop markSize: number = 22;

  build() {
    Row({ space: this.markSize * 0.22 }) {
      Circle().width(this.markSize * 0.42).height(this.markSize * 0.42).fill(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
      Circle().width(this.markSize * 0.42).height(this.markSize * 0.42).fill(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
      Circle().width(this.markSize * 0.42).height(this.markSize * 0.42).fill(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
    }
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
  }
}
import { ExportCardSpec, ExportChip, ExportParam } from '../../features/export/ExportCard';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';

/**
 * 导出卡 v2 版式（ArkUI 组件实现；规格见 web/tools/tests/export_card_v2_spec.md）。
 *
 * 逻辑宽度 760，白卡 + 渐变底 + 参数配置区 + 结果胶囊 + 斜向平铺水印 + 页脚时间/编号。
 * 通过 `componentSnapshot` 截图为图片（PNG）。
 */
@Component
export struct ExportCardView {
  spec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();

  @State private cardHeight: number = 600;
  private wmCtx: CanvasRenderingContext2D = new CanvasRenderingContext2D(new RenderingContextSettings(true));

  private drawWatermark(): void {
    const width: number = 716;
    const height: number = this.cardHeight;
    if (height <= 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.wmCtx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    this.wmCtx.globalAlpha = 0.04;
    this.wmCtx.fillStyle = '#23302E';
    this.wmCtx.font = 'bold 15px sans-serif';
    for (let y = -40; y < height + 80; y += 140) {
      for (let x = -120; x < width + 120; x += 300) {
        this.wmCtx.save();
        this.wmCtx.translate(x, y);
        this.wmCtx.rotate(-20 * Math.PI / 180);
        this.wmCtx.fillText('班级工具站', 0, 0);
        this.wmCtx.restore();
      }
    }
  }

  @Builder
  blockTitle(text: string, topMargin: number) {
    Row({ space: 7 }) {
      Rect()
        .width(5)
        .height(5)
        .radius(1.5)
        .fill(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
      Text(text)
        .fontSize(12.5)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
    }
    .height(20)
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
    .margin({ top: topMargin })
  }

  @Builder
  brandRow() {
    Row({ space: 10 }) {
      Circle().width(6).height(6).fill(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
      Circle().width(6).height(6).fill(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
      Circle().width(6).height(6).fill(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
      Text('班级工具站')
        .fontSize(11)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .margin({ left: 2 })
    }
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
  }

  @Builder
  paramCell(param: ExportParam) {
    Row() {
      Text(param.label)
        .fontSize(12.5)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width(104)
      Text(param.value)
        .fontSize(14)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .maxLines(2)
    }
    .width('50%')
    .padding({ top: 4, bottom: 4 })
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Top)
  }

  @Builder
  chipView(chip: ExportChip) {
    Row({ space: 5 }) {
      Text('' + chip.n)
        .fontSize(13.5)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
      if (chip.nm.length > 0) {
        Text(chip.nm)
          .fontSize(12)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      }
    }
    .height(30)
    .padding({ left: 11, right: 11 })
    .backgroundColor('#FFFFFF')
    .border({ width: 1, color: '#E3E9E6' })
    .borderRadius(15)
    .margin({ right: 7, bottom: 7 })
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.TopStart }) {
        Canvas(this.wmCtx)
          .width(716)
          .height(this.cardHeight)
          .onReady(() => {
            this.drawWatermark();
          })
          .hitTestBehavior(HitTestMode.None)

        Column() {
          this.brandRow()

          Text(this.spec.title)
            .fontSize(30)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 14 })
            .maxLines(1)

          Text(this.spec.subtitle)
            .fontSize(13)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })

          Divider()
            .color('#E6E9E8')
            .strokeWidth(1)
            .margin({ top: 14, bottom: 16 })

          this.blockTitle('参数配置', 0)

          Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
            ForEach(this.spec.params, (param: ExportParam) => {
              this.paramCell(param)
            }, (param: ExportParam) => param.label)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding(14)
          .margin({ top: 8 })
          .backgroundColor('#F4F8F7')
          .border({ width: 1, color: '#E8EEEC' })
          .borderRadius(14)

          if (this.spec.chips.length > 0) {
            this.blockTitle(this.spec.chipLabel, 18)

            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
              ForEach(this.spec.chips, (chip: ExportChip) => {
                this.chipView(chip)
              }, (chip: ExportChip, index: number) => index + '_' + chip.n)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 8 })
          }

          if (this.spec.groups.length > 0) {
            this.blockTitle(this.spec.groupLabel, 18)

            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap, justifyContent: FlexAlign.SpaceBetween }) {
              ForEach(this.spec.groups, (group: ExportChip[], index: number) => {
                Column() {
                  Row() {
                    Text('第 ' + (index + 1) + ' 组')
                      .fontSize(12.5)
                      .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                      .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                    Blank()
                    Text(group.length + ' 人')
                      .fontSize(10.5)
                      .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                  }
                  .width('100%')

                  Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
                    ForEach(group, (chip: ExportChip, memberIndex: number) => {
                      Text(chip.nm.length > 0 ? chip.n + ' ' + chip.nm : '' + chip.n)
                        .fontSize(12)
                        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                        .margin({ right: 10, top: 6 })
                    }, (chip: ExportChip, memberIndex: number) => index + '_' + memberIndex + '_' + chip.n)
                  }
                  .width('100%')
                  .margin({ top: 2 })
                }
                .width('48.5%')
                .padding(12)
                .margin({ bottom: 12 })
                .backgroundColor('#FAFCFB')
                .border({ width: 1, color: '#E8EEEC' })
                .borderRadius(14)
              }, (group: ExportChip[], index: number) => 'group_' + index)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 8 })
          }

          if (this.spec.lines.length > 0) {
            this.blockTitle(this.spec.linesLabel, 18)

            Column() {
              ForEach(this.spec.lines, (line: string, index: number) => {
                Text(line)
                  .fontSize(12.5)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
                  .width('100%')
                  .margin({ top: 4 })
              }, (line: string, index: number) => 'line_' + index)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })
          }

          if (this.spec.noteLines.length > 0) {
            this.blockTitle(this.spec.noteLabel, 12)
            Column() {
              ForEach(this.spec.noteLines, (line: string) => {
                Text(line)
                  .fontSize(12)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
                  .width('100%')
                  .margin({ top: 3 })
              }, (line: string) => line)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4 })
          }

          Divider()
            .color('#E6E9E8')
            .strokeWidth(1)
            .margin({ top: 18, bottom: 12 })

          Row() {
            Column() {
              Text(this.spec.footer)
                .fontSize(11.5)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
              Text('编号 ' + this.spec.recordId)
                .fontSize(11)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                .margin({ top: 4 })
            }
            .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
            .layoutWeight(1)

            Row({ space: 8 }) {
              Circle().width(5).height(5).fill(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
              Circle().width(5).height(5).fill(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
              Circle().width(5).height(5).fill(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
              Text('班级工具站')
                .fontSize(11.5)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            }
            .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
          }
          .width('100%')
        }
        .padding(28)
        .width('100%')
        .onAreaChange((oldArea: Area, newArea: Area) => {
          const raw: Length = newArea.height;
          const height: number = typeof raw === 'number' ? raw : parseFloat(raw as string);
          if (height > 0 && Math.abs(height - this.cardHeight) > 0.5) {
            this.cardHeight = height;
            this.drawWatermark();
          }
        })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .backgroundColor('#FFFFFF')
      .borderRadius(22)
      .clip(true)
      .border({ width: 1, color: '#E6E9E8' })
    }
    .width(760)
    .padding(22)
    .backgroundColor('#F2F6F4')
    .id('exportCard')
  }
}

export struct PageHeader {

  };

  };

  build() {
