import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Motion } from '../theme/Motion';

/**
 * 工具卡：单字字形 + 名称 + 副标题（2 行）。
 *
 * 2026-11-15 视觉要求：描述最多两行、卡片最小高度 96vp，常见描述不被截断（与安卓 v4.55 口径一致）。
 */
@Component
export struct ToolTile {
  @Prop glyph: string = '';
  @Prop name: string = '';
  @Prop subtitle: string = '';
  @Prop accent: string = Tokens.MIST_TEAL;
  @Prop compact: boolean = false;
  onTap: () => void = () => {
  };

  private minHeight(): number {
    return this.compact ? 76 : 96;
  }

  build() {
    Row() {
      Text(this.glyph)
        .fontSize(this.compact ? 16 : 18)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(this.accent)
        .width(this.compact ? 34 : 40)
        .height(this.compact ? 34 : 40)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.tint(this.accent, 0.12))
        .borderRadius(12)

      Column() {
        Text(this.name)
          .fontSize(this.compact ? 14 : 15)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .maxLines(1)
        Text(this.subtitle)
          .fontSize(this.compact ? 11 : 12)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
          .maxLines(2)
          .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
          .lineHeight(this.compact ? 15 : 17)
          .margin({ top: 3 })
      }
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .margin({ left: 10 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .constraintSize({ minHeight: this.minHeight() })
    .padding(this.compact ? 10 : 12)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .stateStyles({
      normal: {
        .scale({ x: 1, y: 1 })
      },
      pressed: {
        .scale({ x: 0.97, y: 0.97 })
        .opacity(0.92)
      }
    })
    .animation({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() })
    .onClick(() => {
      this.onTap();
    })
    .accessibilityText(this.name + '，' + this.subtitle)
  }
}
import { ToolCatalog, ToolCategory, ToolDef } from '../../data/tool/ToolCatalog';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Breakpoints } from '../theme/Breakpoints';
import { SectionHeader } from '../components/SectionHeader';
import { ToolTile } from '../components/ToolTile';

/**
 * 全部工具：按分类分组；编辑态点按可加入/移出首页快捷（≤4）。
 *
 * 自适应（2026-11-15 平板/折叠屏断点）：容器宽 <600 → 2 列；600–899 → 3 列；≥900 → 4 列；
 * 内容最大宽度按 [Breakpoints.contentMaxWidth] 居中（手机/平板 880，大屏 960）。
 */
@Component
export struct AllScreen {
  @Prop editing: boolean = false;
  @Prop quickIds: string[] = [];
  @State private layoutWidth: number = 0;
  onToggleQuick: (id: string) => void = () => {
  };
  onToggleEdit: () => void = () => {
  };
  onOpenTool: (id: string) => void = () => {
  };

  private tileWidth(): string {
    return Breakpoints.gridItemWidthPercent(this.layoutWidth);
  }

  private columns(): number {
    return Breakpoints.gridColumns(this.layoutWidth);
  }

  private categories(): ToolCategory[] {
    return [ToolCategory.STUDY, ToolCategory.CLASS, ToolCategory.SYSTEM];
  }

  @Builder
  card(tool: ToolDef) {
    Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.TopEnd }) {
      ToolTile({
        glyph: tool.glyph,
        name: tool.name,
        subtitle: tool.subtitle,
        accent: tool.accent,
        onTap: () => {
          if (this.editing) {
            this.onToggleQuick(tool.id);
          } else {
            this.onOpenTool(tool.id);
          }
        }
      })
      if (this.editing && this.quickIds.indexOf(tool.id) >= 0) {
        Text('✓')
          .fontSize(12)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .width(22)
          .height(22)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .borderRadius(11)
          .margin({ top: -4, right: -4 })
      }
    }
  }

  build() {
    Scroll() {
      Column() {
        Row() {
          Text('全部工具')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_TITLE)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          Blank()
          Text(this.editing ? '完成' : '编辑首页')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
            .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            .padding({ left: 10, right: 4, top: 8, bottom: 8 })
            .onClick(() => {
              this.onToggleEdit();
            })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 20 })

        Text(this.editing
          ? '点工具加入或移出首页快捷（最多 4 个）'
          : ToolCatalog.ALL.length + ' 个工具 · ' + this.columns() + ' 列 · 与网页/小程序/安卓同一套云端契约')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(this.editing ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6, bottom: 20 })

        ForEach(this.categories(), (category: ToolCategory) => {
          Column() {
            SectionHeader({ title: category })
            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap, justifyContent: FlexAlign.SpaceBetween }) {
              ForEach(ToolCatalog.byCategory(category), (tool: ToolDef) => {
                Column() {
                  this.card(tool)
                }
                .width(this.tileWidth())
                .margin({ bottom: 10 })
              }, (tool: ToolDef) => tool.id)
            }
            .width('100%')
          }
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ bottom: 18 })
        }, (category: ToolCategory) => category)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .constraintSize({ maxWidth: Breakpoints.contentMaxWidth(this.layoutWidth) })
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, top: Tokens.BREATH_TOP, bottom: 24 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .align(Alignment.Top)
    .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
    .onAreaChange((oldArea: Area, newArea: Area) => {
      const next: number = Number(newArea.width);
      if (Math.abs(next - this.layoutWidth) > 1) {
        this.layoutWidth = next;
      }
    })
  }
}
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { MarkKind } from '../../data/marks/Marks';
import { HomeworkRow } from '../../data/homework/HomeworkModels';
import { HomeworkResult } from '../../data/homework/HomeworkRepository';
import { NoticeCards, NoticeCard } from '../../features/notices/NoticeCards';
import { NoticeEntry, NoticesResult } from '../../data/notices/NoticesRepository';
import { PowerPrefs } from '../../data/power/PowerPrefs';
import { PowerRooms, PowerRow } from '../../data/power/PowerModels';
import { PowerRowResult } from '../../data/power/PowerRepository';
import { SessionInfo, SessionState, TodayState, TtPlan } from '../../data/timetable/TimetableModels';
import { TtCalendar } from '../../data/timetable/TtCalendar';
import { TtResult } from '../../data/timetable/TimetableRepository';
import { ToolCatalog, ToolDef } from '../../data/tool/ToolCatalog';
import { HomeDigest, HomeCardItem } from '../../features/home/HomeDigest';
import { HomeNtBadge } from '../../data/home/HomeNtBadge';
import { HidePrefs } from '../../data/home/HidePrefs';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Motion } from '../theme/Motion';
import { Breakpoints } from '../theme/Breakpoints';
import { BrandMark } from '../components/BrandMark';

/**
 * 工作台（对齐小程序 pages/index）：
 * 问候（日期/周次/角色）→ 今日课程 → 宿舍电费 → 作业待交 → 通知待处理 → 常用工具。
 * 首页只读云端缓存（各仓库 TTL），不额外写数据；快捷工具在「全部」页勾选（≤4）。
 */
@Component
export struct HomeScreen {
  @Prop userName: string = '';
  @Prop maskedSid: string = '';
  @Prop roleLabel: string = '';
  @Prop quickIds: string[] = [];
  @Prop @Watch('onEpochChanged') epoch: number = 0;
  @Prop editing: boolean = false;
  onToggleEdit: () => void = () => {
  };
  onRemoveQuick: (id: string) => void = () => {
  };
  onAddQuick: () => void = () => {
  };
  onOpenTool: (id: string) => void = () => {
  };
  onOpenAll: () => void = () => {
  };
  onEditQuick: () => void = () => {
    this.onOpenAll();
  };

  @State private loading: boolean = true;
  @State private plan: TtPlan = new TtPlan();
  @State private ttLoaded: boolean = false;
  @State private hwOpen: number = 0;
  @State private hwItems: HomeCardItem[] = [];
  @State private ntPending: number = 0;
  @State private ntItems: HomeCardItem[] = [];
  @State private ntState: string = 'loading';
  @State private powerHas: boolean = false;
  @State private powerLabel: string = '';
  @State private powerQ: string = '—';
  @State private powerUnit: string = '度';
  @State private powerState: string = 'idle';
  @State private powerUpd: string = '';
  @State private hwIdx: number = 0;
  @State private ntIdx: number = 0;
  @State private hwFade: boolean = false;
  @State private ntFade: boolean = false;
  @State private refreshing: boolean = false;
  @State private ntNew: boolean = false;
  @State private shimmer: boolean = false;
  @State private floatY: number = 0;
  @State private layoutWidth: number = 0;
  private rotateTimer: number = -1;
  private shimmerTimer: number = -1;
  private floatTimer: number = -1;
  private fadeTimer: number = -1;
  private startedAt: number = 0;

  onEpochChanged(): void {
    this.load(false);
  }

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.startedAt = Date.now();
    this.load(false);
    this.rotateTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.rotateTick();
    }, 5000);
    this.shimmerTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: 700, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
        this.shimmer = !this.shimmer;
      });
    }, 700);
    this.floatTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: 1200, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
        this.floatY = this.floatY === 0 ? -2 : 0;
      });
    }, 2400);
  }

  aboutToDisappear(): void {
    if (this.rotateTimer >= 0) {
      clearInterval(this.rotateTimer);
      this.rotateTimer = -1;
    }
    if (this.fadeTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.fadeTimer);
      this.fadeTimer = -1;
    }
    if (this.shimmerTimer >= 0) {
      clearInterval(this.shimmerTimer);
      this.shimmerTimer = -1;
    }
    if (this.floatTimer >= 0) {
      clearInterval(this.floatTimer);
      this.floatTimer = -1;
    }
  }

  private quick(): ToolDef[] {
    const out: ToolDef[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.quickIds.length && out.length < 4; i++) {
      const tool: ToolDef | undefined = ToolCatalog.byId(this.quickIds[i]);
      if (tool !== undefined) {
        out.push(tool);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  private async load(force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const now: number = Date.now();
    try {
      const marks = await Services.marks.refresh(false);
      const snapshot = Services.marks.marks();
      // 课表
      const tt: TtResult = await Services.timetable.load(force);
      this.plan = TtCalendar.plan(tt.snapshot, now);
      this.ttLoaded = true;
      // 作业
      const hw: HomeworkResult = await Services.homework.load(force);
      const hidden = HidePrefs.read(Services.userdata.currentSections());
      const open: HomeworkRow[] = HomeDigest.hwOpen(hw.rows,
        (id: string) => snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.HW, id),
        (id: string) => hidden.hwHide.has(id));
      this.hwOpen = open.length;
      this.hwItems = HomeDigest.hwItems(open);
      // 通知
      const nt: NoticesResult = await Services.notices.load(force);
      const allCards: NoticeCard[] = NoticeCards.build(nt.entries, now);
      const cards: NoticeCard[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < allCards.length; i++) {
        const card: NoticeCard = allCards[i];
        const entryId: string = card.entry !== undefined ? card.entry.row.id : '';
        const groupId: string = card.key.indexOf('@occ:') > 0 ? card.key.substring(0, card.key.indexOf('@occ:')) : card.key;
        if (hidden.ntHide.has(entryId) || hidden.ntHide.has(groupId)) {
          continue;
        }
        cards.push(card);
      }
      this.ntPending = HomeDigest.ntPending(cards, (key: string) => snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.NT_DONE, key));
      this.ntItems = HomeDigest.ntItems(cards, (key: string) => snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.NT_DONE, key));
      this.ntState = nt.ok ? 'ok' : (Services.currentSid.length === 0 ? 'off' : 'error');
      this.ntNew = await HomeNtBadge.update(Services.currentSid, Services.notices.currentSignature());
      // 电费（未选择 → 0 请求）
      const prefs = PowerPrefs.read(Services.userdata.currentSections());
      if (prefs.sel.length > 0) {
        this.powerHas = true;
        this.powerLabel = PowerRooms.labelOf(prefs.sel);
        this.powerQ = '—';
        this.powerState = 'idle';
        const rowResult: PowerRowResult = await Services.power.loadRow(prefs.sel, false);
        const row: PowerRow | undefined = rowResult.row;
        if (row !== undefined) {
          this.powerQ = HomeDigest.powerQText(row.q, row.hasValue);
          this.powerUnit = row.unit.length > 0 ? row.unit : '度';
          this.powerState = HomeDigest.powerState(row.q, row.hasValue, prefs.low);
          this.powerUpd = HomeDigest.updText(row.updatedAt);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.ntState = 'error';
    }
    this.loading = false;
  }

  private rotateTick(): void {
    const hwCount: number = this.hwItems.length;
    const ntCount: number = this.ntItems.length;
    if (hwCount <= 1 && ntCount <= 1) {
      return;
    }
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: 260, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      if (hwCount > 1) {
        this.hwFade = true;
      }
      if (ntCount > 1) {
        this.ntFade = true;
      }
    });
    this.fadeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (hwCount > 1) {
        this.hwIdx = HomeDigest.rotate(hwCount, this.hwIdx);
      }
      if (ntCount > 1) {
        this.ntIdx = HomeDigest.rotate(ntCount, this.ntIdx);
      }
      this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: 320, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
        this.hwFade = false;
        this.ntFade = false;
      });
    }, 260);
  }

  private hwTitle(): string {
    return this.hwItems.length > 0 ? this.hwItems[Math.min(this.hwIdx, this.hwItems.length - 1)].title : '';
  }

  private hwSub(): string {
    return this.hwItems.length > 0 ? this.hwItems[Math.min(this.hwIdx, this.hwItems.length - 1)].sub : '';
  }

  private ntTitle(): string {
    return this.ntItems.length > 0 ? this.ntItems[Math.min(this.ntIdx, this.ntItems.length - 1)].title : '';
  }

  private ntSub(): string {
    return this.ntItems.length > 0 ? this.ntItems[Math.min(this.ntIdx, this.ntItems.length - 1)].sub : '';
  }

  private greeting(): string {
    return HomeDigest.hello(new Date().getHours());
  }

  private subLine(): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    parts.push(HomeDigest.dateText(new Date()));
    const week: string = HomeDigest.weekText(this.plan.week);
    if (week.length > 0) {
      parts.push(week);
    }
    if (this.roleLabel.length > 0) {
      parts.push(this.roleLabel);
    }
    return parts.join(' · ');
  }

  private sessionPill(state: string): string {
    return state === 'ongoing' ? '上课中' : '';
  }

  private powerPillColor(): string {
    if (this.powerState === 'low') {
      return Tokens.DANGER;
    }
    if (this.powerState === 'warn') {
      return Tokens.WARM_SAND;
    }
    if (this.powerState === 'ok') {
      return Tokens.MIST_TEAL;
    }
    return Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY;
  }

  private nextToday(): SessionInfo | undefined {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.plan.today.length; i++) {
      if (this.plan.today[i].state !== SessionState.DONE) {
        return this.plan.today[i];
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  /** Hero 里的一行课程摘要（不写长段落）。 */
  private todaySummary(): string {
    if (!this.plan.hasData) {
      return '课表未同步 · 打开课表拉取本周课程';
    }
    const next: SessionInfo | undefined = this.nextToday();
    let text: string = this.plan.today.length > 0
      ? '今日 ' + this.plan.today.length + ' 节' : '今天没课';
    if (next !== undefined) {
      text += ' · 下一节 ' + next.startText + ' ' + next.name;
    } else if (this.plan.next !== undefined) {
      text += ' · 下次 ' + this.plan.next.dayText + ' ' + this.plan.next.name;
    }
    return text;
  }

  /**
   * 工作台「今日」hero：中性深色（不铺大面积品牌绿，品牌绿只做小面积点缀）。
   * 内容：今日课程摘要 / 周次 / 问候 / 日期与角色。
   */
  @Builder
  heroCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('今日')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor('#DDF0EA')
          .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 3, bottom: 3 })
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.tint(Tokens.MIST_TEAL, 0.22))
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
        Blank()
        Text(HomeDigest.weekText(this.plan.week).length > 0
          ? HomeDigest.weekText(this.plan.week) : '课表未同步')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.HERO_SUB)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Text(this.greeting() + '，' + this.userName)
        .fontSize(24)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(Tokens.HERO_TEXT)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 12 })

      Text(this.subLine())
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.HERO_SUB)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 6 })

      Row() {
        Text(this.todaySummary())
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontColor(Tokens.HERO_TEXT)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .maxLines(2)
        Text('课表 ›')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor('#DDF0EA')
          .padding({ left: 8 })
          .onClick(() => {
            this.onOpenTool('tt');
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
      .padding({ top: 10 })
      .margin({ top: 10 })
      .border({ width: { top: 0.5 }, color: Tokens.HERO_DARK_SOFT })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(18)
    .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 20 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.HERO_DARK)
    .borderRadius(24)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
    .transition(Motion.listItem())
  }

  @Builder
  cardHeader(eyebrow: string, action: string, onAction: () => void) {
    Row() {
      Text(eyebrow)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .layoutWeight(1)
      if (action.length > 0) {
        Text(action)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
          .padding({ left: 8, top: 4, bottom: 4 })
          .onClick(() => {
            onAction();
          })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
  }

  private cardItems(kind: string): HomeCardItem[] {
    return kind === 'hw' ? this.hwItems : this.ntItems;
  }

  private cardIdx(kind: string): number {
    return kind === 'hw' ? this.hwIdx : this.ntIdx;
  }

  private cardFade(kind: string): boolean {
    return kind === 'hw' ? this.hwFade : this.ntFade;
  }

  private cardCount(kind: string): number {
    return kind === 'hw' ? this.hwOpen : this.ntPending;
  }

  @Builder
  taskCard(kind: string, icon: string, label: string, emptyText: string, onTap: () => void) {
    Row() {
      Text(icon)
        .fontSize(18)
        .width(40)
        .height(40)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.tint(Tokens.MIST_TEAL, 0.10))
        .borderRadius(12)
      Column() {
        Row() {
          Text(label)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          if (this.cardCount(kind) > 0) {
            Text('' + this.cardCount(kind))
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
              .padding({ left: 6, right: 6, top: 1, bottom: 1 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
              .borderRadius(8)
              .margin({ left: 8 })
          }
          if (kind === 'nt' && this.ntNew) {
            Text('新通知')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)

    }

    .stateStyles({
      pressed: {
        .scale({ x: 0.99, y: 0.99 })

import { VerifyResult } from '../../data/auth/AuthRepository';
import { Session } from '../../data/session/Session';
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { BrandMark } from '../components/BrandMark';

/** 身份页（唯一入口）：学号 + 姓名 → 云端班级 token。 */
@Component
export struct IdentityScreen {
  @Prop notice: string = '';
  onSignedIn: (session: Session) => void = () => {
  };

  @State private sid: string = '';
  @State private userName: string = '';
  @State private submitting: boolean = false;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';

  private canSubmit(): boolean {
    return !this.submitting && this.sid.length === 10 && this.userName.trim().length > 0;
  }

  private async submit(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canSubmit()) {
      return;
    }
    this.submitting = true;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    const result: VerifyResult = await Services.auth.verify(this.sid, this.userName);
    this.submitting = false;
    if (result.ok && result.session !== undefined) {
      await Services.sessionStore.save(result.session);
      this.onSignedIn(result.session);
      return;
    }
    this.errorMsg = result.message;
  }

  build() {
    Scroll() {
      Column() {
        Row() {
          BrandMark({ markSize: 28 })
          Blank()
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 28 })

        Text('班级工具站')
          .fontSize(30)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 22 })

        Text('学号 + 姓名，进入班级数据')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6 })

        Column() {
          Text('学号')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')

          TextInput({ placeholder: '10 位学号', text: this.sid })
            .type(InputType.Number)
            .maxLength(10)
            .height(48)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_INPUT)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
            .onChange((value: string) => {
              this.sid = value;
              this.errorMsg = '';
            })

          Text('姓名')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 16 })

          TextInput({ placeholder: '与班级名单逐字一致', text: this.userName })
            .maxLength(20)
            .height(48)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_INPUT)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
            .onChange((value: string) => {
              this.userName = value;
              this.errorMsg = '';
            })

          if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
            Text(this.errorMsg)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
              .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 12 })
          }

          Button(this.submitting ? '验证中…' : '进入班级')
            .width('100%')
            .height(48)
            .margin({ top: 20 })
            .backgroundColor(this.canSubmit() ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.tint(Tokens.MIST_TEAL, 0.45))
            .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
            .enabled(this.canSubmit())
            .onClick(() => {
              this.submit();
            })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding(18)
        .margin({ top: 26 })
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

        Text('仅本班成员可进入 · 数据来自班级云端')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .width('100%')
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .margin({ top: 18 })

        if (this.notice.length > 0) {
          Text(this.notice)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
            .width('100%')
            .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
            .margin({ top: 8 })
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .constraintSize({ maxWidth: 520 })
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 40 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .align(Alignment.Top)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
    .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
  }
}
import { CloudConfig } from '../../config/CloudConfig';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { common } from '@kit.AbilityKit';
import { HuaweiAccount } from '../../data/account/HuaweiAccount';
import { AccountBindingRepository, BindItem } from '../../data/account/AccountBindingRepository';
import { BrandMark } from '../components/BrandMark';
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { NickLogic } from '../../features/home/NickLogic';
import { AppPush } from '../../features/push/AppPush';

/** 我的：身份卡 + 设置项 + 退出登录。 */
@Component
export struct MeScreen {
  @Prop userName: string = '';
  @Prop maskedSid: string = '';
  @Prop roleLabel: string = '';
  @Prop isAdmin: boolean = false;
  @Prop syncState: string = '';
  onSyncNow: () => void = () => {
  };
  onLogout: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private nick: string = '';
  @State private nickEditing: boolean = false;
  @State private nickDraft: string = '';
  @State private nickNotice: string = '';
  @State private pushOn: boolean = false;
  @State private pushBusy: boolean = false;
  @State private pushNotice: string = '';
  @State private hwItems: BindItem[] = [];
  @State private hwBusy: boolean = false;
  @State private hwNotice: string = '';

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const value = sections['nick'];
    this.nick = value === undefined ? '' : String(value);
    this.pushOn = AppPush.enabled();
    this.loadBindings();
  }

  private async loadBindings(): Promise<void> {
    this.hwItems = await AccountBindingRepository.list();
  }

  private async bindHuawei(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.hwBusy) {
      return;
    }
    this.hwBusy = true;
    this.hwNotice = '';
    try {
      const context = this.getUIContext().getHostContext() as common.Context;
      const openId: string = await HuaweiAccount.openId(context);
      const err: string = await AccountBindingRepository.bind(openId, 'phone');
      this.hwNotice = err.length > 0 ? err : '已绑定当前华为账号';
      await this.loadBindings();
    } catch (e) {
      this.hwNotice = HuaweiAccount.message(e as Object);
    }
    this.hwBusy = false;
  }

  private async unbindHuawei(openId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (this.hwBusy) {
      return;
    }
    this.hwBusy = true;
    const ok: boolean = await AccountBindingRepository.unbind(openId);
    this.hwNotice = ok ? '已解绑' : '解绑失败';
    await this.loadBindings();
    this.hwBusy = false;
  }

  private async togglePush(next: boolean): Promise<void> {
    if (this.pushBusy) {
      return;
    }
    this.pushBusy = true;
    this.pushOn = next;
    if (next) {
      const ok: boolean = await AppPush.register();
      this.pushNotice = ok ? '已开启系统推送' : '推送开通失败，请确认已开通推送服务';
      if (!ok) {
        this.pushOn = false;
      }
    } else {
      await AppPush.disable();
      this.pushNotice = '已关闭系统推送';
    }
    this.pushBusy = false;
  }

  private async saveNick(): Promise<void> {
    const next: string = NickLogic.normalize(this.nickDraft);
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    sections['nick'] = next;
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(sections);
    const keys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    keys.add('nick');
    const result = await Services.userdata.push(false, keys);
    this.nick = next;
    this.nickEditing = false;
    this.nickNotice = result.ok() ? '昵称已保存并同步' : '已保存到本机，稍后自动同步';
  }

  @Builder
  row(title: string, value: string, danger: boolean) {
    Row() {
      Text(title)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .fontColor(danger ? Tokens.DANGER : Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        .layoutWeight(1)
      Text(value)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(52)
    .padding({ left: 16, right: 16 })
  }

  build() {
    Scroll() {
      Column() {
        Text('我的')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_TITLE)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 24, bottom: 18 })

        Column() {
          Row() {
            Text(this.userName.length > 0 ? this.userName.substring(0, 1) : '?')
              .fontSize(22)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
              .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
              .width(56)
              .height(56)
              .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.TINT_TEAL)
              .borderRadius(28)

            Column() {
              Row() {
                Text(this.userName)
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_HEADING)
                  .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                if (this.roleLabel.length > 0) {

                .onChange((value: string) => {
                  this.nickDraft = value;
                })
              Button('保存')
                .height(36)

                .fontColor('#FFFFFF')

              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)

import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Motion } from '../theme/Motion';
import { HomeTools, HomeToolsToggleResult } from '../../data/home/HomeTools';
import { HomeScreen } from '../screens/HomeScreen';
import { AllScreen } from '../screens/AllScreen';
import { MeScreen } from '../screens/MeScreen';

/** 应用外壳：工作台 / 全部 / 我的（底部自定义 tab + 液体指示条 + 页面滑动切换）。 */
@Component
export struct AppShell {
  @Prop userName: string = '';
  @Prop maskedSid: string = '';
  @Prop roleLabel: string = '';
  @Prop isAdmin: boolean = false;
  @Prop quickIds: string[] = [];
  @Prop syncState: string = '';
  onOpenTool: (id: string) => void = () => {
  };
  onSetHomeTools: (ids: string[]) => void = () => {
  };
  onSyncNow: () => void = () => {
  };
  onLogout: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private activeTab: number = 0;
  @State private editHome: boolean = false;
  @State private homeEpoch: number = 0;
  @State private barWidth: number = 0;
  @State private stretch: number = 0;
  private controller: TabsController = new TabsController();
  private stretchTimer: number = -1;

  private switchTab(index: number): void {
    if (index === this.activeTab) {
      return;
    }
    // 液体动效：先拉长指示条，再弹性吸附到目标 tab
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: 110, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.stretch = 1;
    });
    if (this.stretchTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.stretchTimer);
    }
    this.stretchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.stretchTimer = -1;
      this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.spring() }, () => {
        this.activeTab = index;
        this.stretch = 0;
      });
      if (index === 0) {
        this.homeEpoch += 1;
      }
    }, 90);
    this.controller.changeIndex(index);
  }

  private toggleQuick(id: string): void {
    const result: HomeToolsToggleResult = HomeTools.toggle(this.quickIds, id);
    if (result.rejected === 'full') {
      try {
        this.getUIContext().getPromptAction().showToast({ message: '首页最多 4 个' });
      } catch (e) {
        // toast 失败不影响主流程
      }
      return;
    }
    if (result.changed) {
      this.onSetHomeTools(result.ids);
    }
  }

  private itemWidth(): number {
    return this.barWidth > 0 ? this.barWidth / 3 : 0;
  }

  private indicatorX(): number {
    const itemW: number = this.itemWidth();
    if (itemW <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return itemW * this.activeTab + itemW / 2 - (24 + 16 * this.stretch) / 2;
  }

  @Builder
  tabItem(index: number, label: string) {
    Column() {
      Text(label)
        .fontSize(12)
        .fontWeight(this.activeTab === index ? FontWeight.Medium : FontWeight.Regular)
        .fontColor(this.activeTab === index ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .animation({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() })
    }
    .layoutWeight(1)
    .height('100%')
    .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
    .onClick(() => {
      this.switchTab(index);
    })
  }

  @Builder
  bottomBar() {
    Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.BottomStart }) {
      Row() {
        this.tabItem(0, '工作台')
        this.tabItem(1, '全部')
        this.tabItem(2, '我的')
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')

      Column()
        .width(24 + 16 * this.stretch)
        .height(3)
        .borderRadius(2)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        .offset({ x: this.indicatorX(), y: -10 })
        .opacity(this.barWidth > 0 ? 1 : 0)
        .animation({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.spring() })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(58)
    .constraintSize({ maxWidth: 960 })
    // 浅色底栏无黑影：纯浅色 + 顶部发丝线，显式零阴影（不叠系统对比度蒙层/投影）。
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BAR_LIGHT)
    .border({ width: { top: 0.5 }, color: Tokens.DIVIDER })
    .shadow({ radius: 0, color: '#00000000', offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 })
    .onAreaChange((oldArea: Area, newArea: Area) => {
      const width: number = Number(newArea.width);
      if (width > 0 && Math.abs(width - this.barWidth) > 1) {
        this.barWidth = width;
      }
    })
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      Tabs({ barPosition: BarPosition.End, index: this.activeTab, controller: this.controller }) {
        TabContent() {
          HomeScreen({
            userName: this.userName,
            maskedSid: this.maskedSid,
            roleLabel: this.roleLabel,
            quickIds: this.quickIds,
            epoch: this.homeEpoch,
            editing: this.editHome,
            onToggleEdit: () => {
              this.editHome = !this.editHome;
            },
            onRemoveQuick: (id: string) => {
              this.onSetHomeTools(HomeTools.remove(this.quickIds, id));
            },
            onAddQuick: () => {
              this.editHome = true;
              this.switchTab(1);
            },
            onEditQuick: () => {
              this.editHome = true;
              this.switchTab(1);
            },
            onOpenTool: (id: string) => {
              this.onOpenTool(id);
            },
            onOpenAll: () => {
              this.switchTab(1);
            }
          })
        }

        TabContent() {
          AllScreen({
            editing: this.editHome,
            quickIds: this.quickIds,
            onToggleQuick: (id: string) => {
              this.toggleQuick(id);
            },
            onToggleEdit: () => {
              this.editHome = !this.editHome;
            },
            onOpenTool: (id: string) => {
              this.onOpenTool(id);
            }
          })
        }

        TabContent() {
          MeScreen({
            userName: this.userName,
            maskedSid: this.maskedSid,
            roleLabel: this.roleLabel,
            isAdmin: this.isAdmin,
            syncState: this.syncState,
            onSyncNow: () => {
              this.onSyncNow();
            },
            onLogout: () => {
              this.onLogout();
            }
          })
        }
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .constraintSize({ maxWidth: 960 })
      .barHeight(0)
      .barBackgroundColor(Color.Transparent)
      .divider({ strokeWidth: 0 })
      .scrollable(false)
      .animationDuration(Motion.NORMAL)
      .animationMode(AnimationMode.CONTENT_FIRST)
      .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
      .onChange((index: number) => {
        if (index !== this.activeTab) {
          this.activeTab = index;
        }
      })

      this.bottomBar()
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .padding({ top: Tokens.BREATH_TOP })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
  }
}
/**
 * 响应式断点（手机 / 折叠屏 / 平板 / 2in1）纯逻辑，可单测。
 *
 * 口径（2026-11-15 视觉与平板适配要求）：
 * - 「全部工具」网格：宽 < 600vp → 2 列；600–899vp → 3 列；≥ 900vp → 4 列；
 * - 主内容最大宽度：手机/平板 ≤ 880vp，桌面/折叠屏展开 ≤ 960vp（居中留白，不横向拉满）；
 * - 顶部呼吸区：所有形态至少 [BREATH_TOP]，大屏再多一点，避免内容贴状态栏。
 *
 * 本文件不 import ArkUI，纯函数，hypium 可直接跑。
 */
export class Breakpoints {
  /** 手机竖屏上限（含普通折叠屏外屏）。 */
  static readonly PHONE_MAX: number = 600;
  /** 平板断点：≥ 该宽度用 3 列。 */
  static readonly TABLET_MIN: number = 600;
  /** 大屏断点（折叠屏展开 / 平板横屏 / 2in1）：≥ 该宽度用 4 列。 */
  static readonly WIDE_MIN: number = 900;

  /** 手机内容最大宽度。 */
  static readonly CONTENT_MAX_PHONE: number = 880;
  /** 大屏内容最大宽度。 */
  static readonly CONTENT_MAX_WIDE: number = 960;

  /** 顶部呼吸区（vp）：手机 8，宽屏 12。 */
  static readonly BREATH_TOP: number = 8;
  static readonly BREATH_TOP_WIDE: number = 12;

  /** 一列/两列/三列/四列断点判定。 */
  static isWide(width: number): boolean {
    return Breakpoints.normalize(width) >= Breakpoints.WIDE_MIN;
  }

  static isTablet(width: number): boolean {
    const w: number = Breakpoints.normalize(width);
    return w >= Breakpoints.TABLET_MIN && w < Breakpoints.WIDE_MIN;
  }

  /**
   * 「全部工具」网格列数：2 → 3 → 4。
   *
   * 非法/未知宽度（≤0）按手机 2 列处理，避免首帧 onAreaChange 前布局跳变。
   */
  static gridColumns(width: number): number {
    const w: number = Breakpoints.normalize(width);
    if (w >= Breakpoints.WIDE_MIN) {
      return 4;
    }
    if (w >= Breakpoints.TABLET_MIN) {
      return 3;
    }
    return 2;
  }

  /**
   * 网格项宽度百分比（给 `Flex` 的百分比宽度用）：
   * 2 列 → 48.5%（留 3% 间距），3 列 → 31.5%，4 列 → 23.5%。
   */
  static gridItemWidthPercent(width: number): string {
    const columns: number = Breakpoints.gridColumns(width);
    if (columns === 4) {
      return '23.5%';
    }
    if (columns === 3) {
      return '31.5%';
    }
    return '48.5%';
  }

  /** 主内容最大宽度（vp）：手机/平板 880，大屏 960。 */
  static contentMaxWidth(width: number): number {
    return Breakpoints.isWide(width) ? Breakpoints.CONTENT_MAX_WIDE : Breakpoints.CONTENT_MAX_PHONE;
  }

  /** 顶部呼吸区高度（vp）。 */
  static breathTop(width: number): number {
    return Breakpoints.isWide(width) ? Breakpoints.BREATH_TOP_WIDE : Breakpoints.BREATH_TOP;
  }

  /** 是否宽屏布局（平板横屏/折叠屏展开/2in1）：工具页可左右分栏。 */
  static useTwoPane(width: number): boolean {
    return Breakpoints.normalize(width) >= Breakpoints.WIDE_MIN;
  }

  private static normalize(width: number): number {
    if (typeof width !== 'number' || isNaN(width) || width <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return width;
  }
}
import curves from '@ohos.curves';

/**
 * 全局动效令牌（与网页/安卓同一套节奏）：
 * - 快 160ms（按压/勾选）、常规 260ms（弹层/切换）、慢 380ms（页面转场）；
 * - 使用 `getUIContext().animateTo` 驱动状态变化，配合 TransitionEffect 做进出场。
 */
export class Motion {
  static readonly FAST: number = 160;
  static readonly NORMAL: number = 260;
  static readonly SLOW: number = 380;

  /** 标准缓动（对应网页 cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) 近似）。 */
  static ease(): ICurve {
    return curves.cubicBezierCurve(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }

  /** 弹性缓动（tab 指示条、卡片回弹）。 */
  static spring(): ICurve {
    return curves.springCurve(0.72, 1, 220, 26);
  }

  /** 轻回弹（弹层）。 */
  static softSpring(): ICurve {
    return curves.springCurve(0.5, 1, 200, 28);
  }

  /** 页面进入：从右侧轻微滑入 + 淡入。 */
  static pageEnter(): TransitionEffect {
    return TransitionEffect.OPACITY
      .combine(TransitionEffect.translate({ x: 28 }))
      .combine(TransitionEffect.scale({ x: 0.985, y: 0.985 }));
  }

  /** 页面退出：向右滑出 + 淡出。 */
  static pageExit(): TransitionEffect {
    return TransitionEffect.OPACITY
      .combine(TransitionEffect.translate({ x: 24 }))
      .combine(TransitionEffect.scale({ x: 0.99, y: 0.99 }));
  }

  /** 底部弹层进入：自下而上滑入 + 淡入。 */
  static sheetEnter(): TransitionEffect {
    return TransitionEffect.OPACITY
      .combine(TransitionEffect.translate({ y: 72 }));
  }

  /** 底部弹层退出。 */
  static sheetExit(): TransitionEffect {
    return TransitionEffect.OPACITY
      .combine(TransitionEffect.translate({ y: 48 }));
  }

  /** 遮罩淡入淡出。 */
  static scrim(): TransitionEffect {
    return TransitionEffect.OPACITY;
  }

  /** 列表项进入：淡入 + 上移 10vp。 */
  static listItem(): TransitionEffect {
    return TransitionEffect.OPACITY
      .combine(TransitionEffect.translate({ y: 10 }));
  }

  /** 横向卡片/徽标出现。 */
  static popIn(): TransitionEffect {
    return TransitionEffect.OPACITY
      .combine(TransitionEffect.scale({ x: 0.9, y: 0.9 }));
  }
}
/** 设计令牌（与网页/安卓共用品牌色，HarmonyOS 端按原生排版落地）。 */
export class Tokens {
  // 品牌色
  static readonly MIST_TEAL: string = '#4E9082';
  static readonly SLATE_BLUE: string = '#6E8CA8';
  static readonly WARM_SAND: string = '#B98F63';

  // 中性色
  static readonly BG: string = '#F7F8F8';
  static readonly CARD: string = '#FFFFFF';
  /** 底部工具栏浅色底（无黑影：纯浅色 + 发丝线，不叠阴影）。 */
  static readonly BAR_LIGHT: string = '#FBFCFC';
  static readonly TEXT_PRIMARY: string = '#1C2629';
  static readonly TEXT_SECONDARY: string = '#66777D';
  static readonly TEXT_TERTIARY: string = '#93A2A7';
  static readonly DIVIDER: string = '#E8EDEE';
  static readonly TINT_TEAL: string = '#E7F0ED';
  static readonly TINT_BLUE: string = '#E9EFF4';
  static readonly TINT_SAND: string = '#F5EFE7';
  static readonly DANGER: string = '#B4553F';

  // 深色 hero（中性色：深板岩，不铺大面积品牌绿；品牌绿只做小面积点缀）
  static readonly HERO_DARK: string = '#26333A';
  static readonly HERO_DARK_SOFT: string = '#33424A';
  static readonly HERO_TEXT: string = '#F3F6F6';
  static readonly HERO_SUB: string = '#B9C7CB';

  // 顶部呼吸区（所有页面内容与状态栏之间的最小留白）
  static readonly BREATH_TOP: number = 8;

  // 形状 / 间距
  static readonly RADIUS_CARD: number = 18;
  static readonly RADIUS_INPUT: number = 14;
  static readonly RADIUS_PILL: number = 999;
  static readonly GAP: number = 12;
  static readonly PAGE_PADDING: number = 20;

  // 字号
  static readonly F_TITLE: number = 26;
  static readonly F_HEADING: number = 19;
  static readonly F_BODY: number = 15;
  static readonly F_LABEL: number = 13;
  static readonly F_CAPTION: number = 12;

  // 动效
  static readonly DUR_FAST: number = 160;
  static readonly DUR_NORMAL: number = 260;

  /** `#RRGGBB` + 透明度 → ArkUI 支持的 `#AARRGGBB`。 */
  static tint(hex: string, alpha: number): string {
    const a: number = Math.round(alpha * 255);
    const aa: string = (a < 16 ? '0' : '') + a.toString(16).toUpperCase();
    if (hex.length === 7) {
      return '#' + aa + hex.substring(1);
    }
    return hex;
  }
}
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import {
  DiagAnalysis,
  DiagCheck,
  DiagAnalysisResult,
  DiagHealthResult,
  DiagStatus,
  DiagSummary,
  RepairTask,
  ServiceHealthRow,
  diagStatusColor,
  diagStatusLabel
} from '../../data/diag/DiagModels';
import { DiagRepository, GatewayProbe } from '../../data/diag/DiagRepository';
import { DiagReport, DiagThrottle } from '../../data/diag/DiagReport';
import { DiagReportStore } from '../../data/diag/DiagReportStore';
import { Blob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { DeviceChecks } from '../../features/diag/DeviceChecks';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { PageHeader } from '../components/PageHeader';

/**
 * 诊断工具：本机设备检查 + 服务健康 + AI 分析/修复任务（只读）。
 *
 * - 设备检查全部本地计算（版本/型号/系统/存储/网关延迟/会话），不上报；
 * - 服务健康 `service_health`、分析 `diag_analysis`、修复 `repair_tasks` 均为只读；
 * - client_diag 上报（本机检查 + 服务健康，指纹 10 分钟限流）；修复仍由本机代理执行。
 */
@Component
export struct DiagScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private summary: DiagSummary = new DiagSummary();
  @State private health: ServiceHealthRow[] = [];
  @State private analyses: DiagAnalysis[] = [];
  @State private repairs: RepairTask[] = [];
  @State private loading: boolean = true;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private reportNotice: string = '';

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.refresh();
  }

  private async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = this.summary.checks.length === 0;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    const probe: GatewayProbe = await Services.diag.probe();
    this.summary = await DeviceChecks.run(probe.ok, probe.latencyMs);
    const healthResult: DiagHealthResult = await Services.diag.health();
    this.health = healthResult.rows;
    if (!healthResult.ok) {
      this.errorMsg = healthResult.message;
    }
    const analysisResult: DiagAnalysisResult = await Services.diag.analyses();
    this.analyses = analysisResult.analyses;
    this.repairs = analysisResult.repairs;
    this.loading = false;
  }

  private async reportAnomalies(): Promise<void> {
    const now: number = Date.now();
    const last: number = await DiagReportStore.lastReportAt();
    if (!DiagThrottle.canReport(last, now)) {
      this.reportNotice = '10 分钟内已上报过，请稍后再试';
      return;
    }
    const row: Blob | undefined = DiagReport.buildAll(this.summary.checks, this.health, now);
    if (row === undefined) {
      this.reportNotice = '当前没有需要上报的异常';
      return;
    }
    const ok: boolean = await Services.diag.report(row);
    if (ok) {
      await DiagReportStore.markReported(now);
      this.reportNotice = '已上报，本机代理会尽快处理';
    } else {
      this.reportNotice = '上报失败，请稍后重试';
    }
  }

  private checkedText(row: ServiceHealthRow): string {
    if (row.checkedAt.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const stamp: number = Date.parse(row.checkedAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(stamp)) {
      return row.checkedAt;
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(stamp);
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  private timeText(ts: number): string {
    if (ts <= 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(ts);
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  @Builder
  statusChip(status: DiagStatus, label: string) {
    Text(label)
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
      .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 1, bottom: 1 })
      .backgroundColor(diagStatusColor(status))
      .borderRadius(6)
  }

  @Builder
  checkRow(row: DiagAnalysis) {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text(row.title.length > 0 ? row.title : row.id)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .maxLines(2)
        Text(this.timeText(row.ts))
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .margin({ left: 8 })
      }
      .width('100%')
      if (row.cause.length > 0) {
        Text(row.cause)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
          .width('100%')
          .maxLines(2)
          .margin({ top: 2 })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding({ top: 6, bottom: 6 })
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      PageHeader({
        title: '诊断',
        actionText: this.loading ? '' : '重测',
        onBack: () => {
          this.onClose();
        },
        onAction: () => {
          this.refresh();
        }
      })

      if (this.loading) {
        Column() {
          LoadingProgress().width(32).height(32).color(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
      } else {
        Scroll() {
          Column() {
            Row() {
              Text('本机检查')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              Blank()
              if (this.summary.warnCount() + this.summary.failCount() + DiagReport.fromHealth(this.health).length > 0) {
                Text('上报异常')
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
                  .padding({ left: 8, right: 8 } )
                  .onClick(() => {
                    this.reportAnomalies();
                  })
              }
              Text('通过 ' + this.summary.passCount()
                + ' · 注意 ' + this.summary.warnCount()
                + ' · 异常 ' + this.summary.failCount())
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(this.summary.overall() === DiagStatus.PASS ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.WARM_SAND)
            }
            .width('100%')

            Column() {
              ForEach(this.summary.checks, (check: DiagCheck) => {
                Row() {
                  Text(check.label)
                    .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                    .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
                    .width(80)
                  Text(check.value)
                    .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                    .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                    .maxLines(1)
                  this.statusChip(check.status, diagStatusLabel(check.status))
                }
                .width('100%')
                .padding({ top: 7, bottom: 7 })
              }, (check: DiagCheck) => check.id)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ left: 14, right: 14 })
            .margin({ top: 8 })
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

            if (this.reportNotice.length > 0) {
              Text(this.reportNotice)
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 8 })
            }

            if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
              Text(this.errorMsg)
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 8 })
            }

            Row() {
              Text('服务健康')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              Blank()
              Text(this.health.length + ' 项')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 14 })

            Column() {
              ForEach(this.health, (row: ServiceHealthRow) => {
                Row() {
                  Column() {
                    Text(row.name.length > 0 ? row.name : row.id)
                      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                      .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                    if (row.detail.length > 0) {
                      Text(row.detail)
                        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                        .maxLines(1)
                    }
                  }
                  .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
                  .layoutWeight(1)
                  Text(this.checkedText(row))
                    .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                    .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                    .margin({ right: 8 })
                  this.statusChip(row.displayStatus(), diagStatusLabel(row.displayStatus()))
                }
                .width('100%')
                .padding({ top: 6, bottom: 6 })
              }, (row: ServiceHealthRow) => row.id + '_' + row.status)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ left: 14, right: 14 })
            .margin({ top: 8 })
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

            if (this.analyses.length > 0) {
              Text('AI 分析')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 14 })

              Column() {
                ForEach(this.analyses, (row: DiagAnalysis) => {
                  this.checkRow(row)
                }, (row: DiagAnalysis) => row.id + '_' + row.ts)
              }
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ left: 14, right: 14 })
              .margin({ top: 8 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
            }

            if (this.repairs.length > 0) {
              Text('修复任务')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 14 })

              Column() {
                ForEach(this.repairs, (task: RepairTask) => {
                  Row() {
                    Text(task.action.length > 0 ? task.action : task.id)
                      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                      .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                      .layoutWeight(1)
                      .maxLines(1)
                    Text(task.status)
                      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                      .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                  }
                  .width('100%')
                  .padding({ top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                }, (task: RepairTask) => task.id + '_' + task.status)
              }
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ left: 14, right: 14 })
              .margin({ top: 8, bottom: 16 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
            }
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 24 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .align(Alignment.Top)
        .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
  }
}

function pad2(value: number): string {
  return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value;
}
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { ClassMember } from '../../data/member/ClassMember';
import {
  DrawConfig,
  DrawEntry,
  DrawPoolSource,
  DrawResult,
  DrawSortMode,
  drawSortLabel
} from '../../features/draw/DrawModels';
import { defaultDrawRandom } from '../../features/draw/DrawRandom';
import { DrawConfigCodec } from '../../features/draw/DrawConfigCodec';
import { DrawStep, DrawTransition, DrawWorkflow, DrawWorkflowState } from '../../features/draw/DrawWorkflow';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Motion } from '../theme/Motion';
import { PageHeader } from '../components/PageHeader';
import { DrawExportFactory, ExportCardSpec, ExportNaming } from '../../features/export/ExportCard';
import { DrawSession } from '../../app/DrawSession';
import { ExportPreview } from './ExportPreview';

/**
 * 抽签工具：STEP1 配置 → STEP2 候选 → STEP3 结果。
 *
 * - 参数写回 `userdata.draw`（脏检测 + 防抖推送，跨端一致）；
 * - 候选来源支持「号码范围 / 班级名单」（名单来源显示姓名，不显示学号）；
 * - 结果支持剔除补抽、重抽、切换排序（排序写回 config.sort）。
 */
@Component
export struct DrawScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private step: DrawStep = DrawStep.CONFIG;
  @State private start: number = 1;
  @State private end: number = 70;
  @State private count: number = 10;
  @State private dup: boolean = false;
  @State private excl: string = '';
  @State private sort: DrawSortMode = DrawSortMode.DRAW_ORDER;
  @State private source: DrawPoolSource = DrawPoolSource.RANGE;
  @State private candidates: DrawEntry[] = [];
  @State private result: DrawResult | undefined = undefined;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private seatNames: string[] = [];
  @State private seats: number[] = [];
  @State private showExport: boolean = false;
  @State private exportSpec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.restoreConfig();
    this.loadRoster();
  }

  private restoreConfig(): void {
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const config: DrawConfig = DrawConfigCodec.fromJson(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'draw'));
    this.start = config.start;
    this.end = config.end;
    this.count = config.count;
    this.dup = config.allowDuplicates;
    this.excl = config.excludedText;
    this.sort = config.sort;
  }

  private async loadRoster(): Promise<void> {
    const loaded = await Services.members.load(false);
    const seats: number[] = [];
    const names: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < loaded.members.length; i++) {
      seats.push(loaded.members[i].seat);
      names.push(loaded.members[i].name);
    }
    this.seats = seats;
    this.seatNames = names;
  }

  private currentConfig(): DrawConfig {
    const config: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig();
    config.start = this.start;
    config.end = this.end;
    config.count = this.count;
    config.allowDuplicates = this.dup;
    config.excludedText = this.excl;
    config.sort = this.sort;
    config.poolSource = this.source;
    return config;
  }

  private nameOf(number: number): string {
    if (this.source !== DrawPoolSource.ROSTER) {
      return '';
    }
    const index: number = this.seats.indexOf(number);
    return index >= 0 && index < this.seatNames.length ? this.seatNames[index] : '';
  }

  /** 参数写回云端 `userdata.draw`（保留未知字段）。 */
  private async persistConfig(): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const existing: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(current, 'draw'));
    next['draw'] = DrawConfigCodec.toJson(this.currentConfig(), existing);
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
  }

  private toPreview(): void {
    this.persistConfig();
    let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
    state.config = this.currentConfig();
    const transition: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.toPreview(state, this.seats, (n: number) => this.nameOf(n));
    if (!transition.ok || transition.state === undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = transition.error !== undefined ? transition.error.message : '无法生成候选';
      return;
    }
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.candidates = transition.state.candidates;
    this.step = DrawStep.PREVIEW;
  }

  private swipeNext(): void {
    if (this.step === DrawStep.CONFIG) {
      this.toPreview();
    }
  }

  private startDraw(): void {
    let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
    state.step = DrawStep.PREVIEW;
    state.config = this.currentConfig();
    state.candidates = this.candidates;
    const transition: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.startDraw(state, defaultDrawRandom());
    if (!transition.ok || transition.state === undefined || transition.state.result === undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = transition.error !== undefined ? transition.error.message : '抽签失败';
      return;
    }
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.result = transition.state.result;
    DrawSession.set(this.result);
    this.step = DrawStep.RESULT;
  }

  private back(): void {
    if (this.step === DrawStep.RESULT) {
      this.step = DrawStep.PREVIEW;
      this.result = undefined;
      return;
    }
    if (this.step === DrawStep.PREVIEW) {
      this.step = DrawStep.CONFIG;
      this.candidates = [];
      return;
    }
    this.onClose();
  }

  private changeSort(mode: DrawSortMode): void {
    this.sort = mode;
    this.persistConfig();
    if (this.step !== DrawStep.RESULT || this.result === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
    state.step = DrawStep.RESULT;
    state.config = this.currentConfig();
    state.result = this.result;
    const transition: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.changeSort(state, mode, defaultDrawRandom());
    if (transition.ok && transition.state !== undefined) {
      this.result = transition.state.result;
      DrawSession.set(this.result);
    }
  }

  private reroll(): void {
    if (this.result === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
    state.step = DrawStep.RESULT;
    state.config = this.currentConfig();
    state.result = this.result;
    const transition: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.reroll(state, defaultDrawRandom());
    if (!transition.ok || transition.state === undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = transition.error !== undefined ? transition.error.message : '重抽失败';
      return;
    }
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.result = transition.state.result;
    DrawSession.set(this.result);
  }

  private removeAt(index: number): void {
    if (this.result === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
    state.step = DrawStep.RESULT;
    state.config = this.currentConfig();
    state.result = this.result;
    const transition: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.removeAndRedraw(state, index, true, defaultDrawRandom());
    if (!transition.ok || transition.state === undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = transition.error !== undefined ? transition.error.message : '剔除失败';
      return;
    }
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.result = transition.state.result;
    DrawSession.set(this.result);
  }

  private openExport(): void {
    if (this.result === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    this.exportSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(this.result, Date.now(), ExportNaming.randomSuffix());
    this.showExport = true;
  }

  @Builder
  sortChip(mode: DrawSortMode) {
    Text(drawSortLabel(mode))
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.sort === mode ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
      .backgroundColor(this.sort === mode ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.changeSort(mode);
      })
  }

  @Builder
  sourceChip(source: DrawPoolSource, label: string) {
    Text(label)
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.source === source ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
      .backgroundColor(this.source === source ? Tokens.SLATE_BLUE : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.source = source;
        this.persistConfig();
      })
  }

  @Builder
  numberField(label: string, value: number, onChange: (value: number) => void) {
    Column() {
      Text(label)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      TextInput({ text: '' + value })
        .type(InputType.Number)
        .height(44)
        .margin({ top: 4 })
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
        .borderRadius(10)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .onChange((text: string) => {
          const parsed: number = Number(text);
          if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0) {
            onChange(Math.round(parsed));
          }
        })
    }
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
    .layoutWeight(1)
  }

  @Builder
  configStep() {
    Scroll() {
      Column() {
        Column() {
          Row({ space: 12 }) {
            this.numberField('起始', this.start, (value: number) => {
              this.start = Math.min(value, 999);
            })
            this.numberField('结束', this.end, (value: number) => {
              this.end = Math.min(value, 999);
            })
          }
          .width('100%')

          Row({ space: 12 }) {
            this.numberField('抽取个数', this.count, (value: number) => {
              this.count = Math.min(value, 999);
            })
            Column() {
              Text('允许重复')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
              Toggle({ type: ToggleType.Switch, isOn: this.dup })
                .margin({ top: 6 })
                .selectedColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
                .onChange((isOn: boolean) => {
                  this.dup = isOn;
                })
            }
            .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
            .width(110)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 14 })

          Text('排除号')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 14 })
          TextInput({ placeholder: '如 3,7,10-12', text: this.excl })
            .height(44)
            .margin({ top: 4 })
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
            .borderRadius(10)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
            .onChange((text: string) => {
              this.excl = text;
            })

          Text('候选来源')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 16, bottom: 8 })
          Row() {
            this.sourceChip(DrawPoolSource.RANGE, '号码范围')
            this.sourceChip(DrawPoolSource.ROSTER, '班级名单' + (this.seats.length > 0 ? ' · ' + this.seats.length : ''))
          }

          Text('结果排序')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 16, bottom: 8 })
          Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.DRAW_ORDER)
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.ASCENDING)
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.DESCENDING)
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.RANDOM)
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding(16)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

        if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
          Text(this.errorMsg)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 12 })
        }

        Button('预览候选')
          .width('100%')
          .height(48)
          .margin({ top: 20 })
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.toPreview();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 24 })
    }
    .layoutWeight(1)
    .align(Alignment.Top)
    .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
  }

  @Builder
  previewStep() {
    Column() {
      Scroll() {
        Column() {
          Text('候选 ' + this.candidates.length + ' 个')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_HEADING)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
            .width('100%')

          Text('参数固化后开始抽签；候选与实际抽签池一致')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 12 })

          Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
            ForEach(this.candidates, (entry: DrawEntry) => {
              Text(entry.label())
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
                .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
                .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 6 })
            }, (entry: DrawEntry) => '' + entry.number)
          }
          .width('100%')
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding(16)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .align(Alignment.Top)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)

      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Button('返回')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.back();
          })
        Button('开始抽签')
          .layoutWeight(2)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.startDraw();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 16, top: 10 })
    }
    .layoutWeight(1)
  }

  @Builder
  resultStep() {
    Column() {
      Scroll() {
        Column() {
          Column() {
            Text('结果 ' + (this.result !== undefined ? this.result.entries.length : 0) + ' 个')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_HEADING)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              .width('100%')

            Text('范围 ' + this.start + '–' + this.end + ' · ' + this.count + ' 个 · '
              + (this.dup ? '可重复' : '不重复') + ' · ' + drawSortLabel(this.sort))
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 10 })

            ForEach(this.result !== undefined ? this.result.entries : [], (entry: DrawEntry, index: number) => {
              Row() {
                Text('' + (index + 1))
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                  .width(28)
                Text(entry.label())
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
                  .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                  .layoutWeight(1)
                Text('剔除')
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
                  .padding({ left: 8, right: 4, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                  .onClick(() => {
                    this.removeAt(index);
                  })
              }
              .width('100%')
              .height(44)
            }, (entry: DrawEntry, index: number) => '' + index + '_' + entry.number)

            if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
              Text(this.errorMsg)
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 8 })
            }
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding(16)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

          Text('排序')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 16, bottom: 8 })
          Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.DRAW_ORDER)
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.ASCENDING)
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.DESCENDING)
            this.sortChip(DrawSortMode.RANDOM)
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 20 })
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .align(Alignment.Top)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)

      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Button('调整参数')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.step = DrawStep.CONFIG;
            this.candidates = [];
            this.result = undefined;
          })
        Button('重新抽一次')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.reroll();
          })
        Button('导出图片')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.openExport();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 16, top: 10 })
    }
    .layoutWeight(1)
  }

  build() {
    Stack() {
      Column() {
        PageHeader({
          title: '抽签 · ' + (this.step === DrawStep.CONFIG ? '配置'
            : (this.step === DrawStep.PREVIEW ? '候选' : '结果')),
          onBack: () => {
            this.back();
          }
        })

        if (this.step === DrawStep.CONFIG) {
          Column() {
            this.configStep()
          }
          .width('100%')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .transition(TransitionEffect.asymmetric(Motion.pageEnter(), Motion.pageExit()))
        } else if (this.step === DrawStep.PREVIEW) {
          Column() {
            this.previewStep()
          }
          .width('100%')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .transition(TransitionEffect.asymmetric(Motion.pageEnter(), Motion.pageExit()))
        } else {
          Column() {
            this.resultStep()
          }
          .width('100%')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .transition(TransitionEffect.asymmetric(Motion.pageEnter(), Motion.pageExit()))
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)

      if (this.showExport) {
        ExportPreview({
          spec: this.exportSpec,
          onClose: () => {
            this.showExport = false;
          }
        })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .gesture(
      PanGesture({ direction: PanDirection.Horizontal, distance: 24 })
        .onActionEnd((event: GestureEvent) => {
          if (event.offsetX > 60) {
            this.back();
          } else if (event.offsetX < -60) {
            this.swipeNext();
          }
        })
    )
  }
}
import { image } from '@kit.ImageKit';
import { BusinessError } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';
import { ExportCardSpec } from '../../features/export/ExportCard';
import { ImageSaver, SaveResult } from '../../data/export/ImageSaver';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Motion } from '../theme/Motion';
import { ExportCardView } from '../components/ExportCardView';
import { Log } from '../../common/Log';

const TAG: string = 'ExportPreview';

/**
 * 导出预览：展示 760 宽导出卡（可滚动查看），截图为 PNG 后保存沙箱 + 相册。
 *
 * 截图：`UIContext.getComponentSnapshot().get('exportCard', {scale:2})`；
 * 相册：`photoAccessHelper.showAssetsCreationDialog`（系统确认框，无需写媒体权限）。
 */
@Component
export struct ExportPreview {
  spec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private status: string = '';
  @State private saving: boolean = false;
  @State private entered: boolean = false;

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
        this.entered = true;
      });
    }, 20);
  }

  private async capture(): Promise<ArrayBuffer | undefined> {
    try {
      const pixelMap: image.PixelMap = await this.getUIContext()
        .getComponentSnapshot()
        .get('exportCard', { scale: 2 });
      const packer: image.ImagePacker = image.createImagePacker();
      try {
        const data: ArrayBuffer = await packer.packToData(pixelMap, { format: 'image/png', quality: 100 });
        return data;
      } finally {
        await packer.release();
        await pixelMap.release();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      Log.e(TAG, '截图失败 code=' + err.code + ' msg=' + err.message);
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  /** 仅保存到应用沙箱（不弹相册确认；用于系统对话框无响应时兜底）。 */
  private async saveFileOnly(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.saving) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving = true;
    this.status = '正在生成图片…';
    try {
      const data: ArrayBuffer | undefined = await this.capture();
      if (data === undefined) {
        this.status = '生成图片失败，请重试';
        return;
      }
      const path: string = await ImageSaver.writeToAppFile(data, this.spec.fileName);
      this.status = path.length > 0 ? '已保存到应用文件：' + this.spec.fileName : '写入文件失败';
    } finally {
      this.saving = false;
    }
  }

  private async save(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.saving) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving = true;
    this.status = '正在生成图片…';
    try {
      const data: ArrayBuffer | undefined = await this.capture();
      if (data === undefined) {
        this.status = '生成图片失败，请重试';
        return;
      }
      const path: string = await ImageSaver.writeToAppFile(data, this.spec.fileName);
      if (path.length === 0) {
        this.status = '写入文件失败';
        return;
      }
      this.status = '已生成，正在打开相册确认…';
      const result: SaveResult | undefined = await ExportPreview.withTimeout(
        ImageSaver.saveToGallery(path, this.spec.fileName), 15000);
      if (result === undefined) {
        this.status = '相册确认超时：图片已保存到应用文件，可点「仅保存文件」重试';
        return;
      }
      this.status = result.message;
    } finally {
      this.saving = false;
    }
  }

  /** Promise 超时保护（相册确认框偶发不弹出时避免 UI 卡死）。 */
  private static async withTimeout<T>(task: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T | undefined> {
    let timer: number = -1;
    const timeout: Promise<undefined> = new Promise<undefined>((resolve: (value: undefined) => void) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        resolve(undefined);
      }, ms);
    });
    const result: T | undefined = await Promise.race<T | undefined>([task, timeout]);
    if (timer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    return result;
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('关闭')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
          .height(44)
          .padding({ left: 12, right: 12 })
          .onClick(() => {
            this.onClose();
          })
        Blank()
        Text('导出图片')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_HEADING)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text('')
          .width(56)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height(56)

      Scroll() {
        Scroll() {
          ExportCardView({ spec: this.spec })
        }
        .scrollable(ScrollDirection.Horizontal)
        .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
        .width('100%')
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .align(Alignment.Top)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)

      Column() {
        if (this.status.length > 0) {
          Text(this.status)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(this.saving ? Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            .margin({ bottom: 8 })
        }
        Button(this.saving ? '保存中…' : '保存到相册')
          .width('100%')
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(this.saving ? Tokens.tint(Tokens.MIST_TEAL, 0.5) : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .enabled(!this.saving)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.save();
          })
        Button('仅保存文件')
          .width('100%')
          .height(40)
          .margin({ top: 8 })
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .enabled(!this.saving)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.saveFileOnly();
          })
        Text('图片已同时保存到应用文件，可在无相册权限时兜底')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .margin({ top: 8 })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 18, top: 8 })
      .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
    .opacity(this.entered ? 1 : 0)
    .translate({ y: this.entered ? 0 : 26 })
  }
}
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { CloudSpaceFile, CloudSpaceSnapshot, CloudSpaceResult } from '../../data/cloudspace/CloudSpaceModels';
import { CloudSpaceLogic } from '../../data/cloudspace/CloudSpaceLogic';
import { CloudSpaceRepository, PickedFile } from '../../data/cloudspace/CloudSpaceRepository';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Breakpoints } from '../theme/Breakpoints';

/**
 * 文件传输 / 临时云空间（对齐网页 `#s-file`、安卓 CloudSpaceScreen）。
 *
 * - 同班级身份（同 sid）跨设备自动共享同一空间，不需要房间码/配对；
 * - ECS drop v2.2：8 MiB 分片上传任意大小文件、列表/下载/删除/清空；
 * - **每个文件自上传完成起保留 72 小时**（逐文件过期），下载链接每次读取重签（30 分钟有效）；
