 * - 文件选择用系统 `DocumentViewPicker`；下载落应用沙箱并用系统能力打开；
 * - 班级 token 只在请求头 `X-Device-Id` 中出现，不落盘/不打印。
 */
@Component
export struct FileTransferScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private loading: boolean = true;
  @State private connected: boolean = false;
  @State private files: CloudSpaceFile[] = [];
  @State private expiredCount: number = 0;
  @State private statusMsg: string = '';
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private uploading: boolean = false;
  @State private uploadName: string = '';
  @State private uploadPercent: number = 0;
  @State private uploadStateText: string = '';
  @State private downloadingId: string = '';
  @State private layoutWidth: number = 0;
  private pollTimer: number = -1;
  private repo(): CloudSpaceRepository {
    return Services.cloudspace;
  }

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.refresh(true);
    this.pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.uploading) {
        this.refresh(false);
      }
    }, 5000);
  }

  aboutToDisappear(): void {
    if (this.pollTimer >= 0) {
      clearInterval(this.pollTimer);
      this.pollTimer = -1;
    }
  }

  private applySnapshot(snapshot: CloudSpaceSnapshot): void {
    this.connected = snapshot.connected();
    this.files = snapshot.files;
    this.expiredCount = snapshot.expiredCount;
    this.loading = false;
  }

  private async refresh(force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    if (Services.currentToken.length === 0) {
      this.loading = false;
      this.errorMsg = '身份缺失，请重新登录';
      return;
    }
    const result: CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceSnapshot> = force
      ? await this.repo().ensureSpace() : await this.repo().refresh(false);
    if (result.ok && result.value !== undefined) {
      this.applySnapshot(result.value);
      if (force) {
        this.errorMsg = '';
      }
      return;
    }
    this.loading = false;
    this.errorMsg = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '云空间加载失败，请稍后重试';
  }

  private async pickAndUpload(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.uploading) {
      return;
    }
    this.errorMsg = '';
    const picked: PickedFile | undefined = await this.repo().pickFile();
    if (picked === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    if (picked.sizeBytes <= 0) {
      this.errorMsg = '空文件无法上传（0 字节）';
      return;
    }
    this.uploading = true;
    this.uploadName = picked.name;
    this.uploadPercent = 0;
    this.uploadStateText = '准备上传…';
    const result: CloudSpaceResult<CloudSpaceFile> = await this.repo().upload(picked,
      (progress) => {
        this.uploadPercent = CloudSpaceLogic.uploadPercent(progress.sentBytes, progress.totalBytes);
        this.uploadStateText = CloudSpaceLogic.uploadStateText(progress.state, progress.message);
      });
    this.uploading = false;
    if (result.ok) {
      this.uploadPercent = 100;
      this.uploadStateText = '已上传';
      this.statusMsg = '已上传「' + CloudSpaceLogic.safeName(picked.name) + '」· 保留 72 小时';
      await this.refresh(true);
    } else {
      this.errorMsg = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '上传失败，请重试';
    }
  }

  private async downloadFile(file: CloudSpaceFile): Promise<void> {
    if (this.downloadingId.length > 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.downloadingId = file.id;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.statusMsg = '正在下载「' + file.name + '」…';
    const result: CloudSpaceResult<string> = await this.repo().download(file,
      (received: number, total: number) => {
        this.uploadStateText = '下载中 ' + CloudSpaceLogic.uploadPercent(received, total) + '%';
      });
    if (!result.ok || result.value === undefined) {
      this.downloadingId = '';
      this.statusMsg = '';
      this.errorMsg = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '下载失败，请重试';
      return;
    }
    const path: string = result.value;
    const openError: string = await this.repo().openLocalFile(path, file.mimeType);
    this.downloadingId = '';
    this.statusMsg = openError.length > 0 ? openError : '已下载并打开「' + file.name + '」';
  }

  private confirmDelete(file: CloudSpaceFile): void {
    AlertDialog.show({
      title: '删除文件',
      message: '「' + file.name + '」将从同账号所有设备移除，删除后不可恢复。',
      primaryButton: {
        value: '取消',
        action: () => {
        }
      },
      secondaryButton: {
        value: '删除',
        fontColor: Tokens.DANGER,
        action: () => {
          this.deleteFile(file);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  private async deleteFile(file: CloudSpaceFile): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.repo().delete(file.id);
    if (result.ok && result.value !== undefined) {
      this.applySnapshot(result.value);
      this.statusMsg = '已删除「' + file.name + '」';
    } else {
      this.errorMsg = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '删除失败，请重试';
    }
  }

  private confirmClear(): void {
    AlertDialog.show({
      title: '清空云空间',
      message: '将删除本账号云空间内的全部文件（同账号所有设备）并重新开一个空空间。',
      primaryButton: {
        value: '取消',
        action: () => {
        }
      },
      secondaryButton: {
        value: '清空',
        fontColor: Tokens.DANGER,
        action: () => {
          this.clearSpace();
        }
      }
    });
  }

  private async clearSpace(): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = true;
    const result = await this.repo().clearSpace();
    this.loading = false;
    if (result.ok && result.value !== undefined) {
      this.applySnapshot(result.value);
      this.statusMsg = '已清空云空间';
    } else {
      this.errorMsg = result.error !== undefined ? result.error.displayMessage() : '清空失败，请重试';
    }
  }

  private fileMeta(file: CloudSpaceFile): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    parts.push(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtSize(file.sizeBytes));
    const time: string = CloudSpaceLogic.fmtTime(file.uploadedAt);
    if (time.length > 0) {
      parts.push(time);
    }
    parts.push(CloudSpaceLogic.ttlText(file.uploadedAt, Date.now()));
    return parts.join(' · ');
  }

  private contentMax(): number {
    return Breakpoints.contentMaxWidth(this.layoutWidth);
  }

  @Builder
  header() {
    Row() {
      Text('‹')
        .fontSize(28)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        .width(44)
        .height(44)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.onClose();
        })
        .accessibilityText('返回')

      Text('文件传输')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_HEADING)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        .layoutWeight(1)

      Text('刷新')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        .padding({ left: 8, right: 10 })
        .height(44)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.refresh(true);
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(56)
    .padding({ left: 4, right: 8 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
  }

  @Builder
  uploadBar() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('临时云空间')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .layoutWeight(1)
        Text('保留 72 小时 · 同账号跨设备')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Text('上传的文件自完成起 3 天后自动删除；不限制文件大小（8 MiB 分片）。')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 4 })

      Button(this.uploading ? '上传中…' : '选择文件上传')
        .width('100%')
        .height(44)
        .margin({ top: 10 })
        .backgroundColor(this.uploading ? Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
        .enabled(!this.uploading)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.pickAndUpload();
        })

      if (this.uploading) {
        Column() {
          Row() {
            Text(this.uploadName)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
              .layoutWeight(1)
              .maxLines(1)
              .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
            Text(this.uploadPercent + '%')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          }
          .width('100%')
          Progress({ value: this.uploadPercent, total: 100, type: ProgressType.Linear })
            .width('100%')
            .height(4)
            .margin({ top: 6 })
            .color(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.DIVIDER)
          Text(this.uploadStateText)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4 })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 10 })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  @Builder
  fileRow(file: CloudSpaceFile) {
    Row() {
      Text(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKindGlyph(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind(file.mimeType, file.name)))
        .fontSize(14)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
        .width(40)
        .height(40)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.TINT_BLUE)
        .borderRadius(12)

      Column() {
        Text(file.name)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .maxLines(2)
          .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
          .width('100%')
        Text(this.fileMeta(file))
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .margin({ top: 3 })
          .width('100%')
        if (this.downloadingId === file.id) {
          Text(this.uploadStateText.length > 0 ? this.uploadStateText : '下载中…')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            .margin({ top: 3 })
        }
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
      .margin({ left: 10 })

      Column() {
        Text('下载')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
          .onClick(() => {
            this.downloadFile(file);
          })
        Text('删除')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
          .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
          .onClick(() => {
            this.confirmDelete(file);
          })
      }
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.End)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding({ top: 10, bottom: 10 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
  }

  @Builder
  fileList() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('文件')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .layoutWeight(1)
        Text(this.files.length + ' 个')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ bottom: 4 })

      if (this.loading) {
        Text('正在连接云空间…')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ top: 12, bottom: 12 })
      } else if (this.files.length === 0) {
        Text(this.connected ? '还没有文件：上传后同账号设备立即可见' : '云空间未连接：点「刷新」重试')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ top: 12, bottom: 12 })
      } else {
        ForEach(this.files, (file: CloudSpaceFile) => {
          this.fileRow(file)
        }, (file: CloudSpaceFile) => file.id)
      }

      if (this.expiredCount > 0) {
        Text(CloudSpaceLogic.expiredHint(this.expiredCount))
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6 })
      }

      Button('清空云空间')
        .width('100%')
        .height(40)
        .margin({ top: 12 })
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
        .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.confirmClear();
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .margin({ top: 12 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      this.header()
      Scroll() {
        Column() {
          this.uploadBar()
          this.fileList()

          if (this.statusMsg.length > 0) {
            Text(this.statusMsg)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 10 })
          }
          if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
            Text(this.errorMsg)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 10 })
          }

          Text('班级 token 只在请求头中传输；文件只临时中转，不做持久化/病毒扫描，请勿存放重要资料。')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 12, bottom: 24 })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .constraintSize({ maxWidth: this.contentMax() })
        .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING })
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .align(Alignment.Top)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
    .padding({ top: Breakpoints.BREATH_TOP })
    .onAreaChange((oldArea: Area, newArea: Area) => {
      const next: number = Number(newArea.width);
      if (Math.abs(next - this.layoutWidth) > 1) {
        this.layoutWidth = next;
      }
    })
  }
}
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import {
  FIT_INPUT_FIELDS,
  FitCalc,
  FitFieldSpec,
  FitGrade,
  fitGradeLabel,
  FitHistory,
  FitInput,
  FitRecord,
  FitRow,
  FitSex,
  fitSexLabel,
  SavedHistory
} from '../../features/fit/FitModels';
import { FitScoring } from '../../features/fit/FitScoring';
import { FitCodec } from '../../features/fit/FitCodec';
import { ExportCardSpec, ExportNaming, FitExportFactory } from '../../features/export/ExportCard';
import { FitRecsResult, FitRecsWriteResult } from '../../data/fitrecs/FitRecsRepository';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { PageHeader } from '../components/PageHeader';
import { ExportPreview } from './ExportPreview';

/**
 * 体测工具：性别/年级 + 9 项成绩 → 实时国标评分 → 保存历史（fitrecs，最多 2 条）→ 导出。
 *
 * 参数写回 `userdata.fit`（11 键，保留未知字段）；history 走 `fitrecs` + arch 软删。
 */
@Component
export struct FitScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private input: FitInput = new FitInput();
  @State private calc: FitCalc = new FitCalc();
  @State private records: FitRecord[] = [];
  @State private historyMsg: string = '';
  @State private renameId: string = '';
  @State private renameText: string = '';
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private showExport: boolean = false;
  @State private exportSpec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();

  private persistTimer: number = -1;

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.restore();
    this.loadHistory();
  }

  aboutToDisappear(): void {
    if (this.persistTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.persistTimer);
      this.persistTimer = -1;
    }
    this.persist();
  }

  private restore(): void {
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    this.input = FitCodec.inputFromJson(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'fit'));
    this.calc = FitScoring.calc(this.input);
  }

  private async loadHistory(): Promise<void> {
    const result: FitRecsResult = await Services.fitRecs.refresh(false);
    this.records = result.records;
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.historyMsg = result.message;
    }
  }

  private fieldSpec(key: string): FitFieldSpec {
    for (let i = 0; i < FIT_INPUT_FIELDS.length; i++) {
      if (FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[i].key === key) {
        return FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[i];
      }
    }
    return new FitFieldSpec(key, key, '', 0);
  }

  private onFieldChange(key: string, text: string): void {
    const clean: string = FitScoring.sanitizeInput(text, this.fieldSpec(key));
    this.input = this.input.withValue(key, clean);
    this.calc = FitScoring.calc(this.input);
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.schedulePersist();
  }

  private onDurationChange(minutes: boolean, text: string): void {
    const clean: string = FitScoring.sanitizeInput(text, new FitFieldSpec('dur', '长跑', '', 0));
    this.input = this.input.withValue(minutes ? 'durM' : 'durS', clean);
    this.calc = FitScoring.calc(this.input);
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.schedulePersist();
  }

  private schedulePersist(): void {
    if (this.persistTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.persistTimer);
    }
    this.persistTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.persistTimer = -1;
      this.persist();
    }, 700);
  }

  private async persist(): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const existing: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(current, 'fit'));
    next['fit'] = FitCodec.toJson(this.input, existing);
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
  }

  private scoreOfKey(key: string): number | undefined {
    // 评分行顺序：0 体重指数 / 1 肺活量 / 2 50米 / 3 坐位体前屈 / 4 立定跳远 / 5 引体(仰卧) / 6 长跑
    let index: number = -1;
    if (key === 'h' || key === 'w') {
      index = 0;
    } else if (key === 'vc') {
      index = 1;
    } else if (key === 'r50') {
      index = 2;
    } else if (key === 'sit') {
      index = 3;
    } else if (key === 'jump') {
      index = 4;
    } else if (key === 'pull') {
      index = 5;
    } else if (key === 'dur') {
      index = 6;
    }
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.calc.rows.length) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return this.calc.rows[index].score;
  }

  /** 清空成绩（保留性别/年级）。 */
  private clearForm(): void {
    const next: FitInput = new FitInput();
    next.sex = this.input.sex;
    next.grade = this.input.grade;
    this.input = next;
    this.calc = FitScoring.calc(next);
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.persist();
  }

  private async saveRecord(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.input.hasAny()) {
      this.errorMsg = '请先填写至少一项成绩';
      return;
    }
    const now: number = Date.now();
    const id: string = 'fit_' + now + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000);
    const saved: SavedHistory = FitHistory.save(this.records, this.input, this.calc, id, now, '');
    if (saved.record === undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = '保存失败';
      return;
    }
    const write: FitRecsWriteResult = await Services.fitRecs.save(saved.record);
    for (let i = 0; i < saved.dropped.length; i++) {
      await Services.fitRecs.archive(saved.dropped[i].id);
    }
    this.records = saved.records;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.historyMsg = write.ok ? '已保存到历史（云端）' : '已保存到本机（云端同步失败，稍后重试）';
  }

  private async deleteRecord(index: number): Promise<void> {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.records.length) {
      return;
    }
    const id: string = this.records[index].id;
    this.records = FitHistory.deleteAt(this.records, index);
    await Services.fitRecs.archive(id);
    this.historyMsg = '已删除';
  }

  private async saveRename(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.renameId.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    const target = this.records.find((item: FitRecord) => item.id === this.renameId);
    if (target === undefined) {
      this.renameId = '';
      return;
    }
    const result = await Services.fitRecs.rename(target, this.renameText);
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.historyMsg = '改名失败，请稍后重试';
      return;
    }
    const next: FitRecord[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.records.length; i++) {
      const item: FitRecord = this.records[i];
      if (item.id === this.renameId) {
        const trimmed: string = this.renameText.trim();
        const copy: FitRecord = new FitRecord();
        copy.id = item.id;
        copy.ts = item.ts;
        copy.name = trimmed;
        copy.sex = item.sex;
        copy.gradeBucket = item.gradeBucket;
        copy.fields = item.fields;
        copy.total = item.total;
        copy.grade = item.grade;
        copy.syncPending = item.syncPending;
        next.push(copy);
      } else {
        next.push(item);
      }
    }
    this.records = next;
    this.renameId = '';
    this.historyMsg = '已改名';
  }

  private restoreRecord(index: number): void {
    const restored: FitInput | undefined = FitHistory.restoreAt(this.records, index);
    if (restored === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    this.input = restored;
    this.calc = FitScoring.calc(restored);
    this.historyMsg = '已回填该记录';
    this.persist();
  }

  private openExport(): void {
    if (!this.input.hasAny()) {
      this.errorMsg = '请先填写成绩再导出';
      return;
    }
    this.exportSpec = FitExportFactory.create(this.calc, this.input, Date.now(), ExportNaming.randomSuffix());
    this.showExport = true;
  }

  @Builder
  sexChip(value: FitSex) {
    Text(fitSexLabel(value))
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.input.sex === value ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 14, right: 14, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
      .backgroundColor(this.input.sex === value ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        const next: FitInput = this.input.copy();
        next.sex = value;
        this.input = next;
        this.calc = FitScoring.calc(this.input);
        this.persist();
      })
  }

  @Builder
  gradeChip(value: FitGrade) {
    Text(fitGradeLabel(value))
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.input.grade === value ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 14, right: 14, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
      .backgroundColor(this.input.grade === value ? Tokens.SLATE_BLUE : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        const next: FitInput = this.input.copy();
        next.grade = value;
        this.input = next;
        this.calc = FitScoring.calc(this.input);
        this.persist();
      })
  }

  @Builder
  fieldRow(spec: FitFieldSpec) {
    Row() {
      Text(spec.label)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
        .width(120)
      TextInput({ text: this.input.valueOf(spec.key), placeholder: spec.unit })
        .type(InputType.NUMBER_DECIMAL)
        .height(40)
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
        .borderRadius(8)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .onChange((text: string) => {
          this.onFieldChange(spec.key, text);
        })
      Text(this.scoreOfKey(spec.key) !== undefined ? this.scoreOfKey(spec.key) + ' 分' : '—')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width(56)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.End)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(48)
  }

  @Builder
  durationRow() {
    Row() {
      Text('长跑（分·秒）')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
        .width(120)
      TextInput({ text: this.input.durM, placeholder: '分' })
        .type(InputType.Number)
        .height(40)
        .width(64)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
        .borderRadius(8)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .onChange((text: string) => {
          this.onDurationChange(true, text);
        })
      Text('′')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .margin({ left: 4, right: 4 })
      TextInput({ text: this.input.durS, placeholder: '秒' })
        .type(InputType.Number)
        .height(40)
        .width(64)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
        .borderRadius(8)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .onChange((text: string) => {
          this.onDurationChange(false, text);
        })
      Blank()
      Text(this.scoreOfKey('dur') !== undefined ? this.scoreOfKey('dur') + ' 分' : '—')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width(56)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.End)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(48)
  }

  @Builder
  summaryCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text(this.calc.totalText)
          .fontSize(40)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Text(this.calc.grade)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontColor(this.calc.grade === '不及格' ? Tokens.DANGER : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 4, bottom: 4 })
          .backgroundColor(this.calc.grade === '不及格' ? Tokens.TINT_SAND : Tokens.TINT_TEAL)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .margin({ left: 10 })
        Blank()
      }
      .width('100%')

      Text('标准分 ' + this.calc.std.toFixed(1) + ' · 附加分 ' + this.calc.plus.toFixed(1)
        + ' · 已测权重 ' + this.calc.wtDone + ' / 100'
        + (this.calc.miss > 0 ? ' · 缺 ' + this.calc.miss + ' 项' : ''))
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 8 })

      ForEach(this.calc.rows, (row: FitRow) => {
        Row() {
          Text(row.name + ' · ' + row.value + ' ' + row.sub)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .layoutWeight(1)
          Text(row.weight + '%')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width(44)
            .textAlign(TextAlign.End)
          Text(row.score !== undefined ? row.score + ' 分' : '缺项')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(row.score !== undefined ? Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY : Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width(56)
            .textAlign(TextAlign.End)
          if (row.plus > 0) {
            Text('+' + row.plus)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
              .width(34)
              .textAlign(TextAlign.End)
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height(26)
      }, (row: FitRow, index: number) => row.name + '_' + row.value + '_' + (row.score !== undefined ? row.score : 'x'))
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
  }

  @Builder
  historyCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('历史记录')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        if (this.historyMsg.length > 0) {
          Text(this.historyMsg)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        }
      }
      .width('100%')

      if (this.renameId.length > 0) {
        Row({ space: 8 }) {
          TextInput({ text: this.renameText, placeholder: '记录名称' })
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .height(38)
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .borderRadius(8)
            .onChange((value: string) => {
              this.renameText = value;
            })
          Button('保存')
            .height(34)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.saveRename();
            })
          Button('取消')
            .height(34)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.renameId = '';
            })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 8 })
      }
      if (this.records.length === 0) {
        Text('暂无历史（保存后最多保留 2 条）')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 8 })
      } else {
        ForEach(this.records, (record: FitRecord, index: number) => {
          Column() {
            Row() {
              Text(record.displayName())
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                .layoutWeight(1)
              Text(record.totalText() + ' · ' + record.grade)
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            }
            .width('100%')
            Text(record.detailText())
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
              .width('100%')
              .maxLines(2)
              .margin({ top: 2 })
            Row() {
              Text('改名')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
                .padding({ right: 14, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.renameId = record.id;
                  this.renameText = record.displayName();
                })
              Text('回填')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
                .padding({ right: 14, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.restoreRecord(index);
                })
              Text('删除')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
                .padding({ top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.deleteRecord(index);
                })
            }
            .width('100%')
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ top: 6, bottom: 6 })
        }, (record: FitRecord, index: number) => record.id + '_' + index + '_' + record.name)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .margin({ top: 14 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  build() {
    Stack() {
      Column() {
        PageHeader({
          title: '体测',
          onBack: () => {
            this.onClose();
          }
        })

        Scroll() {
          Column() {
            Row() {
              this.sexChip(FitSex.MALE)
              this.sexChip(FitSex.FEMALE)
              Blank()
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ bottom: 8 })

            Row() {
              this.gradeChip(FitGrade.G12)
              this.gradeChip(FitGrade.G34)
              Blank()
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ bottom: 6 })

            Column() {
              this.fieldRow(FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[0])
              this.fieldRow(FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[1])
              this.fieldRow(FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[2])
              this.fieldRow(FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[3])
              this.fieldRow(FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[4])
              this.fieldRow(FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[5])
              this.fieldRow(FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[6])
              this.durationRow()
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ left: 16, right: 16 })
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

            if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
              Text(this.errorMsg)
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 10 })
            }

            Column() {
              this.summaryCard()
            }
            .margin({ top: 14 })

            Row({ space: 10 }) {
              Button('保存到历史')
                .layoutWeight(2)
                .height(46)
                .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
                .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
                .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.saveRecord();
                })
              Button('清空')
                .layoutWeight(1)
                .height(46)
                .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
                .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.clearForm();
                })
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 14 })

            Button('导出图片')
              .width('100%')
              .height(46)
              .margin({ top: 10 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
              .onClick(() => {
                this.openExport();
              })

            this.historyCard()
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 24 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .align(Alignment.Top)
        .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)

      if (this.showExport) {
        ExportPreview({
          spec: this.exportSpec,
          onClose: () => {
            this.showExport = false;
          }
        })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
  }
}

import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { DrawSession } from '../../app/DrawSession';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { DrawEntry, DrawResult } from '../../features/draw/DrawModels';
import {
  GroupConfig,
  GroupError,
  GroupErrorCode,
  GroupMember,
  GroupMode,
  groupModeLabel,
  GroupResult,
  GroupSource,
  groupSourceLabel,
  GroupStep,
  GroupValidation,
  MemberGroup
} from '../../features/group/GroupModels';
import { defaultGroupRandom, GroupEngine } from '../../features/group/GroupEngine';
import { GroupConfigCodec } from '../../features/group/GroupCodec';
import { GroupExportFactory, ExportCardSpec, ExportNaming } from '../../features/export/ExportCard';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { PageHeader } from '../components/PageHeader';
import { ExportPreview } from './ExportPreview';

/**
 * 分组工具：配置（来源/方式/打乱/名单选择）→ 结果（两列组卡）→ 导出。
 *
 * 来源「上一步抽签序号」使用本次会话的抽签结果（DrawSession，进程内）；
 * 参数写回 `userdata.group`（source/mode/n/shuffle/sel，保留未知字段）。
 */
@Component
export struct GroupScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private step: GroupStep = GroupStep.CONFIG;
  @State private source: GroupSource = GroupSource.PREV;
  @State private mode: GroupMode = GroupMode.GROUPS;
  @State private n: number = GroupConfig.DEFAULT_N;
  @State private shuffle: boolean = false;
  @State private seats: number[] = [];
  @State private names: string[] = [];
  @State private selected: number[] = [];
  @State private groups: GroupResult | undefined = undefined;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private showExport: boolean = false;
  @State private exportSpec: ExportCardSpec = new ExportCardSpec();

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.restoreConfig();
    this.loadRoster();
  }

  private restoreConfig(): void {
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const config: GroupConfig = GroupConfigCodec.fromJson(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'group'));
    this.source = config.source;
    this.mode = config.mode;
    this.n = config.n;
    this.shuffle = config.shuffle;
    this.selected = config.selectedSeats.slice(0);
  }

  private async loadRoster(): Promise<void> {
    const loaded = await Services.members.load(false);
    const seats: number[] = [];
    const names: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < loaded.members.length; i++) {
      seats.push(loaded.members[i].seat);
      names.push(loaded.members[i].name);
    }
    this.seats = seats;
    this.names = names;
    if (this.selected.length === 0 && seats.length > 0 && this.source === GroupSource.NAMES) {
      this.selected = seats.slice(0);
    }
  }

  private currentConfig(): GroupConfig {
    const config: GroupConfig = new GroupConfig();
    config.source = this.source;
    config.mode = this.mode;
    config.n = this.n;
    config.shuffle = this.shuffle;
    config.selectedSeats = this.selected.slice(0);
    return config;
  }

  private async persistConfig(): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const existing: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(current, 'group'));
    next['group'] = GroupConfigCodec.toJson(this.currentConfig(), existing);
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
  }

  private nameOf(seat: number): string {
    const index: number = this.seats.indexOf(seat);
    return index >= 0 && index < this.names.length ? this.names[index] : '';
  }

  /** 当前来源的成员。 */
  private members(): GroupMember[] {
    if (this.source === GroupSource.NAMES) {
      const out: GroupMember[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.selected.length; i++) {
        const seat: number = this.selected[i];
        out.push(new GroupMember(seat, this.nameOf(seat)));
      }
      return out;
    }
    const last: DrawResult | undefined = DrawSession.lastResult;
    if (last === undefined) {
      return [];
    }
    const out: GroupMember[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < last.entries.length; i++) {
      const entry: DrawEntry = last.entries[i];
      out.push(new GroupMember(entry.number, entry.name));
    }
    return out;
  }

  private plannedGroups(): number {
    return GroupEngine.groupCount(this.members().length, this.currentConfig());
  }

  private toggleSeat(seat: number): void {
    const index: number = this.selected.indexOf(seat);
    if (index >= 0) {
      this.selected.splice(index, 1);
    } else {
      this.selected.push(seat);
    }
    this.selected = this.selected.slice(0);
    this.persistConfig();
  }

  private startGroup(): void {
    const members: GroupMember[] = this.members();
    const config: GroupConfig = this.currentConfig();
    const validation: GroupValidation = GroupEngine.validate(members, config);
    if (!validation.ok) {
      const error: GroupError | undefined = validation.error;
      this.errorMsg = error !== undefined ? error.message : '无法分组';
      return;
    }
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.groups = GroupEngine.group(members, config, defaultGroupRandom());
    this.step = GroupStep.RESULT;
    this.persistConfig();
  }

  private regroup(): void {
    if (this.groups === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const config: GroupConfig = this.currentConfig();
    this.groups = GroupEngine.group(this.members(), config, defaultGroupRandom());
  }

  private openExport(): void {
    if (this.groups === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    this.exportSpec = GroupExportFactory.create(this.groups, Date.now(), ExportNaming.randomSuffix());
    this.showExport = true;
  }

  /** 来源 chip：active 在内部按 this.source 计算（@Builder 值参数不参与刷新）。 */
  @Builder
  sourceChip(source: GroupSource) {
    Text(groupSourceLabel(source))
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.source === source ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
      .backgroundColor(this.source === source ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.source = source;
        if (source === GroupSource.NAMES && this.selected.length === 0) {
          this.selected = this.seats.slice(0);
        }
        this.persistConfig();
      })
  }

  /** 分组方式 chip（同上，active 内部计算）。 */
  @Builder
  modeChip(mode: GroupMode) {
    Text(groupModeLabel(mode))
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.mode === mode ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
      .backgroundColor(this.mode === mode ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.mode = mode;
        this.persistConfig();
      })
  }

  @Builder
  seatChip(seat: number) {
    Text('' + seat)
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.selected.indexOf(seat) >= 0 ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .width(44)
      .height(34)
      .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
      .backgroundColor(this.selected.indexOf(seat) >= 0 ? Tokens.SLATE_BLUE : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(8)
      .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 6 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.toggleSeat(seat);
      })
  }

  @Builder
  memberText(member: GroupMember) {
    Text(member.label())
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
      .margin({ right: 10, top: 6 })
  }

  @Builder
  groupCard(group: MemberGroup) {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text(group.label())
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text(group.size() + ' 人')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
        ForEach(group.members, (member: GroupMember) => {
          this.memberText(member)
        }, (member: GroupMember) => '' + group.index + '_' + member.seat)
      }
      .width('100%')
    }
    .width('48.5%')
    .padding(12)
    .margin({ bottom: 10 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
  }

  @Builder
  configStep() {
    Scroll() {
      Column() {
        Column() {
          Text('成员来源')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ bottom: 8 })
          Row() {
            this.sourceChip(GroupSource.PREV)
            this.sourceChip(GroupSource.NAMES)
          }
          .width('100%')

          Text(this.source === GroupSource.PREV
            ? (DrawSession.lastResult !== undefined
              ? '本次抽签 ' + DrawSession.lastResult.entries.length + ' 个序号'
              : '还没有抽签结果，请先到「抽签」抽一次')
            : '已选 ' + this.selected.length + ' 人')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(this.source === GroupSource.PREV && DrawSession.lastResult === undefined
              ? Tokens.DANGER : Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')

          if (this.source === GroupSource.NAMES) {
            Row() {
              Text('全选')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
                .margin({ right: 14 })
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.selected = this.seats.slice(0);
                  this.persistConfig();
                })
              Text('清空')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.selected = [];
                  this.persistConfig();
                })
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 10, bottom: 6 })

            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
              ForEach(this.seats, (seat: number) => {
                this.seatChip(seat)
              }, (seat: number) => 'seat_' + seat)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4 })
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding(16)
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

        Column() {
          Text('分组方式')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ bottom: 8 })
          Row() {
            this.modeChip(GroupMode.GROUPS)
            this.modeChip(GroupMode.PER_GROUP)
          }
          .width('100%')

          Row() {
            Column() {
              Text(this.mode === GroupMode.GROUPS ? '组数' : '每组人数')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
              TextInput({ text: '' + this.n })
                .type(InputType.Number)
                .height(44)
                .margin({ top: 4 })
                .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
                .borderRadius(10)
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
                .onChange((text: string) => {
                  const parsed: number = Number(text);
                  if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0) {
                    this.n = Math.round(parsed);
                  }
                })
            }
            .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
            .layoutWeight(1)

            Column() {
              Text('打乱成员')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
              Toggle({ type: ToggleType.Switch, isOn: this.shuffle })
                .margin({ top: 6 })
                .selectedColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
                .onChange((isOn: boolean) => {
                  this.shuffle = isOn;
                  this.persistConfig();
                })
            }
            .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
            .width(120)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6 })

          Text('将分成 ' + this.plannedGroups() + ' 组 · ' + this.members().length + ' 人 · '
            + (this.shuffle ? '打乱后随机分配' : '按原顺序轮流分配'))
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 8 })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding(16)
        .margin({ top: 14 })
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

        if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
          Text(this.errorMsg)
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 12 })
        }

        Button('开始分组')
          .width('100%')
          .height(48)
          .margin({ top: 20 })
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.startGroup();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 24 })
    }
    .layoutWeight(1)
    .align(Alignment.Top)
    .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
  }

  @Builder
  resultStep() {
    Column() {
      Scroll() {
        Column() {
          Text(this.groups !== undefined
            ? '共 ' + this.groups.snapshot.total + ' 人 · ' + this.groups.snapshot.groupCount + ' 组'
            : '')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_HEADING)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
            .width('100%')

          Text(this.groups !== undefined
            ? this.groups.snapshot.sourceLabel + ' · ' + this.groups.snapshot.modeLabel + ' · ' + this.groups.snapshot.innerLabel
            : '')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 12 })

          Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap, justifyContent: FlexAlign.SpaceBetween }) {
            ForEach(this.groups !== undefined ? this.groups.groups : [], (group: MemberGroup) => {
              this.groupCard(group)
            }, (group: MemberGroup) => 'group_' + group.index + '_' + group.size())
          }
          .width('100%')
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 20 })
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .align(Alignment.Top)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)

      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Button('调整参数')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.step = GroupStep.CONFIG;
          })
        Button('重新分组')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.regroup();
          })
        Button('导出图片')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(48)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.openExport();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 16, top: 10 })
    }
    .layoutWeight(1)
  }

  build() {
    Stack() {
      Column() {
        PageHeader({
          title: this.step === GroupStep.CONFIG ? '分组 · 配置' : '分组 · 结果',
          onBack: () => {
            if (this.step === GroupStep.RESULT) {
              this.step = GroupStep.CONFIG;
            } else {
              this.onClose();
            }
          }
        })

        if (this.step === GroupStep.CONFIG) {
          this.configStep()
        } else {
          this.resultStep()
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)

      if (this.showExport) {
        ExportPreview({
          spec: this.exportSpec,
          onClose: () => {
            this.showExport = false;
          }
        })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
  }
}

  HomeworkAttachmentMeta,
  HomeworkDue,
  HomeworkDueCalculator,
  HomeworkDueTone,
  HomeworkAttachmentKind,

} from '../../data/homework/HomeworkModels';

/**
 * 作业工具：列表 + 截止倒计时 + 详情（全文/附件）+ 完成勾选 + 截止提醒。
 *
 * - 数据：`GET homework`（10 分钟 TTL）；完成状态 marks kind='hw'（乐观更新 + 补发）；
 * - 提醒：`reminderAgentManager` 系统日历提醒（失败降级为立即通知），本机按 homeworkId 记录提醒 id；
 * - 附件：图片内联预览、URL 文件可打开，data URI 文件只展示元信息。
 */
@Component
export struct HomeworkScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private rows: HomeworkRow[] = [];
  @State private doneIds: string[] = [];
  @State private filter: HomeworkFilter = HomeworkFilter.UNFINISHED;
  @State private loading: boolean = true;
  @State private refreshing: boolean = false;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private notice: string = '';
  @State private now: number = Date.now();

  @State private detailOpen: boolean = false;
  @State private detail: HomeworkItem | undefined = undefined;
  @State private advance: number = 30;
  @State private reminderIds: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
  @State private previewOpen: boolean = false;
  @State private previewSrc: string = '';
  @State private hiddenCount: number = 0;

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.reload(false);
    this.loadReminders();
  }

  private async loadReminders(): Promise<void> {
    const record: ReminderRecord = await ReminderStore.load(Services.currentSid);
    this.advance = ReminderPlanner.normalizeAdvance(record.advance);
    this.reminderIds = record.ids;
  }

  private async persistReminders(): Promise<void> {
    const record: ReminderRecord = new ReminderRecord();
    record.advance = this.advance;
    record.ids = this.reminderIds;
    await ReminderStore.save(Services.currentSid, record);
  }

  private async reload(force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = this.rows.length === 0;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    const result: HomeworkResult = await Services.homework.load(force);
    const marksResult: MarksRefreshResult = await Services.marks.refresh(false);
    this.now = Date.now();
    const rows: HomeworkRow[] = [];
    const hidden = HidePrefs.read(Services.userdata.currentSections());
    for (let i = 0; i < result.rows.length; i++) {
      const due: HomeworkDue | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(result.rows[i], this.now);
      if (due !== undefined && due.prunable) {
        continue;
      }
      if (hidden.hwHide.has(result.rows[i].id)) {
        continue;
      }
      rows.push(result.rows[i]);
    }
    this.rows = rows;
    this.hiddenCount = hidden.hwHide.size;
    const done: string[] = [];
    const snapshot = Services.marks.marks();
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.HW, rows[i].id)) {
        done.push(rows[i].id);
      }
    }
    this.doneIds = done;
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.errorMsg = result.message;
    } else if (marksResult.error !== undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = '完成状态同步失败：' + marksResult.error.displayMessage();
    }
    this.loading = false;
  }

  private items(): HomeworkItem[] {
    const list: HomeworkItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.rows.length; i++) {
      const row: HomeworkRow = this.rows[i];
      const item: HomeworkItem = new HomeworkItem();
      item.row = row;
      item.done = this.doneIds.indexOf(row.id) >= 0;
      item.due = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(row, this.now);
      item.attachments = HomeworkAttachments.parse(row.attachments);
      list.push(item);
    }
    list.sort((a: HomeworkItem, b: HomeworkItem) => {
      if (a.done !== b.done) {
        return a.done ? 1 : -1;
      }
      const aDue: number = a.due !== undefined ? a.due.atMillis : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
      const bDue: number = b.due !== undefined ? b.due.atMillis : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
      return aDue - bDue;
    });
    return list;
  }

  private visibleItems(): HomeworkItem[] {
    const all: HomeworkItem[] = this.items();
    if (this.filter === HomeworkFilter.ALL) {
      return all;
    }
    const out: HomeworkItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      if (this.filter === HomeworkFilter.DONE && all[i].done) {
        out.push(all[i]);
      } else if (this.filter === HomeworkFilter.UNFINISHED && !all[i].done) {
        out.push(all[i]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  private countOf(filter: HomeworkFilter): number {
    const all: HomeworkItem[] = this.items();
    if (filter === HomeworkFilter.ALL) {
      return all.length;
    }
    let count: number = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      const done: boolean = all[i].done;
      if ((filter === HomeworkFilter.DONE && done) || (filter === HomeworkFilter.UNFINISHED && !done)) {
        count += 1;
      }
    }
    return count;
  }

  private openDetail(item: HomeworkItem): void {
    this.detail = item;
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.detailOpen = true;
    });
  }

  private closeDetail(): void {
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.detailOpen = false;
    });
  }

  private async restoreHidden(): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const data = HidePrefs.read(current);
    if (data.hwHide.size === 0) {
      return;
    }
    data.hwHide.clear();
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(HidePrefs.write(current, data));
    const keys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    keys.add('hide');
    await Services.userdata.push(false, keys);
    this.hiddenCount = 0;
    this.notice = '已恢复隐藏的作业';
    await this.reload(true);
  }

  private async hideCurrent(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.detail === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const id: string = this.detail.row.id;
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const data = HidePrefs.read(current);
    data.hwHide.add(id);
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(HidePrefs.write(current, data));
    const keys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    keys.add('hide');
    await Services.userdata.push(false, keys);
    this.closeDetail();
    this.notice = '已隐藏（仅你不可见）';
    await this.reload(true);
  }

  private async toggle(item: HomeworkItem): Promise<void> {
    const id: string = item.row.id;
    const next: boolean = !item.done;
    if (next) {
      if (this.doneIds.indexOf(id) < 0) {
        this.doneIds.push(id);
      }
    } else {
      const index: number = this.doneIds.indexOf(id);
      if (index >= 0) {
        this.doneIds.splice(index, 1);
      }
    }
    this.doneIds = this.doneIds.slice(0);
    this.notice = '';
    const result: MarksUpdateResult = await Services.marks.setMark(MarkKind.HW, id, next);
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.notice = '网络不佳：已在本机标记，稍后自动补发';
    }
    if (this.detail !== undefined && this.detail.row.id === id) {
      const refreshed: HomeworkItem = new HomeworkItem();
      refreshed.row = item.row;
      refreshed.done = next;
      refreshed.due = item.due;
      refreshed.attachments = item.attachments;
      this.detail = refreshed;
    }
  }

  private hasReminder(id: string): boolean {
    const value: number | undefined = this.reminderIds.get(id);
    return value !== undefined && value >= 0;
  }

  private async setReminder(item: HomeworkItem): Promise<void> {
    const plan = ReminderPlanner.plan(item.row, Date.now(), this.advance);
    if (plan === undefined) {
      this.notice = '该作业没有可用的截止时间';
      return;
    }
    const result: ReminderPublishResult = await ReminderAgent.publish(plan);
    if (result.ok) {
      this.reminderIds.set(item.row.id, result.reminderId);
      this.reminderIds = new Map<string, number>(this.reminderIds);
      await this.persistReminders();
      this.notice = '已设置提醒：截止前 ' + this.advance + ' 分钟';
    } else {
      this.notice = result.message.length > 0 ? result.message : '提醒设置失败';
    }
  }

  private async cancelReminder(item: HomeworkItem): Promise<void> {
    const value: number | undefined = this.reminderIds.get(item.row.id);
    if (value !== undefined) {
      await ReminderAgent.cancel(value);
      this.reminderIds.delete(item.row.id);
      this.reminderIds = new Map<string, number>(this.reminderIds);
      await this.persistReminders();
    }
    this.notice = '已取消提醒';
  }

  private openPreview(src: string): void {
    this.previewSrc = src;
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.previewOpen = true;
    });
  }

  private closePreview(): void {
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.previewOpen = false;
    });
  }

  private openUrl(url: string): void {
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      this.notice = '无法打开链接';
      return;
    }
    try {
      context.startAbility({
        action: 'ohos.want.action.viewData',
        entities: ['entity.system.browsable'],
        uri: url
      }).catch(() => {
        this.notice = '无法打开该链接';
      });
    } catch (e) {
      this.notice = '无法打开该链接';
    }
  }

  private dueColor(tone: HomeworkDueTone): string {
    if (tone === HomeworkDueTone.OVERDUE) {
      return Tokens.DANGER;
    }
    if (tone === HomeworkDueTone.URGENT || tone === HomeworkDueTone.WARN) {
      return Tokens.WARM_SAND;
    }
    if (tone === HomeworkDueTone.SAFE) {
      return Tokens.MIST_TEAL;
    }
    return Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY;
  }

  @Builder
  filterChip(filter: HomeworkFilter) {
    Row({ space: 6 }) {
      Text(filter)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(this.filter === filter ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      Text('' + this.countOf(filter))
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(this.filter === filter ? '#E8F2EF' : Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
    }
    .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
    .backgroundColor(this.filter === filter ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
    .onClick(() => {
      this.filter = filter;
    })
  }

  @Builder
  advanceChip(value: number) {
    Text('提前 ' + (value >= 60 ? (value / 60) + ' 小时' : value + ' 分钟'))
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.advance === value ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 5, bottom: 5 })
      .backgroundColor(this.advance === value ? Tokens.SLATE_BLUE : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(8)
      .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 6 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.advance = value;
        this.persistReminders();
      })
  }

  @Builder
  itemCard(item: HomeworkItem) {
    Row() {
      Column() {
        Row() {
          if (ReminderPlanner.urgency(item.due !== undefined ? item.due.atMillis : undefined, this.now).length > 0) {
            Text(ReminderPlanner.urgency(item.due !== undefined ? item.due.atMillis : undefined, this.now))
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
              .padding({ left: 6, right: 6, top: 1, bottom: 1 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
              .borderRadius(6)
              .margin({ right: 6 })
          }
          Text(item.title())
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .fontColor(item.done ? Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY : Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .maxLines(1)
            .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
          if (item.due !== undefined) {
            Text(item.due.label)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(this.dueColor(item.due.tone))
              .margin({ left: 8 })
          }
        }
        .width('100%')

        if (item.bodyPreview().length > 0) {
          Text(item.bodyPreview())
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width('100%')
            .maxLines(2)
            .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
            .margin({ top: 4 })
        }

        Row({ space: 10 }) {
          if (item.due !== undefined) {
            Text('截止 ' + HomeworkDueCalculator.dueText(item.due.atMillis))
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          }
          if (item.attachments.length > 0) {
            Text('附件 ' + item.attachments.length)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
          }
          if (this.hasReminder(item.row.id)) {
            Text('已设提醒')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 6 })
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)

      Text(item.done ? '✓' : '')
        .fontSize(15)
        .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
        .width(28)
        .height(28)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .backgroundColor(item.done ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.BG)
        .border({ width: 1, color: item.done ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.DIVIDER })
        .borderRadius(14)
        .margin({ left: 12 })
        .onClick(() => {
          this.toggle(item);
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(14)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .stateStyles({
      pressed: {
        .scale({ x: 0.99, y: 0.99 })
      }
    })
    .animation({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() })
    .onClick(() => {
      this.openDetail(item);
    })
  }



  @Builder
  detailAttachment(meta: HomeworkAttachmentMeta) {
    Column() {
      if (this.detail !== undefined && meta.isImage()) {
        Image(HomeworkAttachments.dataOf(this.detail.row.attachments, meta.index))
          .width('100%')
          .height(150)
          .borderRadius(10)
          .objectFit(ImageFit.Cover)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.openPreview(HomeworkAttachments.dataOf((this.detail as HomeworkItem).row.attachments, meta.index));
          })
      }
      Row() {
        Text(meta.name)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .maxLines(2)
        Text(meta.sizeText())
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .margin({ left: 8 })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ top: 4, bottom: 4 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding({ top: 4, bottom: 4 })
  }

  @Builder
  detailPanel() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('作业详情')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text('关闭')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.closeDetail();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')

      if (this.detail !== undefined) {
        Scroll() {
          Column() {
            Text(this.detail.title())
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_TITLE)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              .width('100%')
            Row({ space: 10 }) {
              if (this.detail.due !== undefined) {
                Text(this.detail.due.label + ' · 截止 ' + HomeworkDueCalculator.dueText(this.detail.due.atMillis))
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(this.dueColor(this.detail.due.tone))
              }
              if (this.detail.row.author.length > 0) {
                Text(this.detail.row.author)
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
              }
              Blank()
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })

            Text(this.detail.row.content.length > 0 ? this.detail.row.content : '（无正文）')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 10 })

            if (this.detail.attachments.length > 0) {
              Text('附件')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 14 })
              Column() {
                ForEach(this.detail.attachments, (meta: HomeworkAttachmentMeta) => {
                  this.detailAttachment(meta)
                }, (meta: HomeworkAttachmentMeta) => 'att_' + meta.index + '_' + meta.name)
              }
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ left: 14, right: 14 })
              .margin({ top: 6 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
            }

            Text('截止提醒')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 14 })
            Row() {
              ForEach(ReminderPlanner.ADVANCE_OPTIONS, (value: number) => {
                this.advanceChip(value)
              }, (value: number) => 'adv_' + value)
              Blank()
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })

            Row({ space: 10 }) {
              Button(this.hasReminder(this.detail.row.id) ? '更新提醒' : '设置提醒')
                .layoutWeight(1)
                .height(42)
                .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
                .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
                .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.setReminder(this.detail as HomeworkItem);
                })
              if (this.hasReminder(this.detail.row.id)) {
                Button('取消提醒')
                  .layoutWeight(1)
                  .height(42)
                  .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
                  .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
                  .onClick(() => {
                    this.cancelReminder(this.detail as HomeworkItem);
                  })
              }
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 8 })

            if (this.notice.length > 0) {
              Text(this.notice)
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 8 })
            }

            Button(this.detail.done ? '标记为未完成' : '标记为已完成')
              .width('100%')
              .height(44)
              .margin({ top: 10 })
              .backgroundColor(this.detail.done ? Tokens.BG : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
              .fontColor(this.detail.done ? Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY : '#FFFFFF')
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
              .onClick(() => {
                this.toggle(this.detail as HomeworkItem);
              })
            Button('隐藏（仅自己不可见）')
              .width('100%')
              .height(40)
              .margin({ top: 8, bottom: 12 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
              .onClick(() => {
                this.hideCurrent();
              })
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ bottom: 8 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .align(Alignment.Top)
        .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('80%')
    .padding(16)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .transition(TransitionEffect.asymmetric(Motion.sheetEnter(), Motion.sheetExit()))
  }

  build() {
    Stack() {
      Column() {
        PageHeader({
          title: '作业',
          actionText: this.loading ? '' : '刷新',
          onBack: () => {
            this.onClose();
          },
          onAction: () => {
            this.reload(true);
          }
        })

        if (this.loading) {
          Column({ space: 10 }) {
            LoadingProgress().width(32).height(32).color(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            Text('加载作业…').fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION).fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
        } else if (this.rows.length === 0 && this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
          Column({ space: 12 }) {
            Text(this.errorMsg)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
              .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
            Button('重试')
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
              .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
              .height(40)
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
              .onClick(() => {
                this.reload(true);
              })
          }
          .width('100%')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
          .padding(Tokens.PAGE_PADDING)
        } else {
          Row({ space: 8 }) {
            this.filterChip(HomeworkFilter.ALL)
            this.filterChip(HomeworkFilter.UNFINISHED)
            this.filterChip(HomeworkFilter.DONE)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING })

          if (this.hiddenCount > 0) {
            Row() {
              Text('已隐藏 ' + this.hiddenCount + ' 条（仅自己不可见）')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                .layoutWeight(1)
              Text('恢复')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.restoreHidden();
                })
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, top: 6 })
          }
          if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
            Text(this.errorMsg)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, top: 8 })
          }

          if (this.visibleItems().length === 0) {
            Column() {
              Text('暂无作业')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
          } else {
            Refresh({ refreshing: $$this.refreshing }) {
              List({ space: 10 }) {
                ForEach(this.visibleItems(), (item: HomeworkItem) => {
                  ListItem() {
                    this.itemCard(item)
                  }
                }, (item: HomeworkItem) => item.row.id + '_' + (item.done ? '1' : '0'))
              }
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING })
              .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
              .transition(Motion.listItem())
            }
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .margin({ top: 10 })
            .onRefreshing(() => {
              this.reload(true).then(() => {
                this.refreshing = false;
              });
            })
          }
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)

      if (this.detailOpen) {
        Column() {
          this.detailPanel()
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#66000000')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.End)
        .transition(Motion.scrim())
        .animation({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() })
      }

      if (this.previewOpen) {
        Stack() {
          Column()
            .width('100%')
            .height('100%')
            .backgroundColor('#E6000000')
            .onClick(() => {
              this.closePreview();
            })
          Image(this.previewSrc)
            .width('100%')
            .height('100%')
            .objectFit(ImageFit.Contain)
            .hitTestBehavior(HitTestMode.None)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .transition(Motion.scrim())
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
  }
}
