import { JwCardDef, JwEntries, JwLogic } from '../../features/jw/JwModels';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Motion } from '../theme/Motion';
import { PageHeader } from '../components/PageHeader';

/**
 * 教务工具（链接型，与网页口径一致）：
 *
 * - 打开学校教务系统（`http://210.34.74.77/sso.jsp`，系统浏览器登录后自动填充）；
 * - 课表速览：当前周 / 今日课程 / 下一节（复用课表快照，不访问教务接口）；
 * - 个人课表同步：提交教务密码 → 云端 agent 登录 → 轮询结果写 `userdata.tt`（密码只随请求提交，不落盘/不打印；`p_platform='android'` 复用既有协议）；
 * - 成绩/考试/选课/公告仍不抓取。
 */
@Component
export struct JwScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined = undefined;
  @State private plan: TtPlan = new TtPlan();
  @State private loading: boolean = true;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private now: number = Date.now();
  @State private pwd: string = '';
  @State private loginBusy: boolean = false;
  @State private loginMsg: string = '';
  @State private loginOk: boolean = false;
  private pollTimer: number = -1;

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.load();
  }

  aboutToDisappear(): void {
    if (this.pollTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.pollTimer);
      this.pollTimer = -1;
    }
  }

  private async submitLogin(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.loginBusy) {
      return;
    }
    const password: string = this.pwd;
    this.pwd = '';
    if (password.length === 0) {
      this.loginMsg = '请输入教务密码';
      return;
    }
    this.loginBusy = true;
    this.loginOk = false;
    this.loginMsg = '正在提交登录任务…';
    const enqueue: TtLoginEnqueue = await Services.login.enqueue(password);
    if (!enqueue.ok || enqueue.jobId.length === 0) {
      this.loginBusy = false;
      this.loginMsg = enqueue.message.length > 0 ? enqueue.message : '登录任务提交失败';
      return;
    }
    this.loginMsg = enqueue.reused ? '已复用进行中的登录任务…' : '已提交，等待云端教务返回…';
    this.pollLogin(enqueue.jobId, Date.now());
  }

  private pollLogin(jobId: string, startedAt: number): void {
    if (this.pollTimer >= 0) {
      clearTimeout(this.pollTimer);
    }
    this.pollTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
      this.pollTimer = -1;
      const status: TtLoginStatus = await Services.login.status(jobId);
      if (!status.ok) {
        this.loginBusy = false;
        this.loginMsg = status.message.length > 0 ? status.message : '状态查询失败';
        return;
      }
      if (!status.finished) {
        if (Date.now() - startedAt > 120000) {
          this.loginBusy = false;
          this.loginMsg = '登录超时，请稍后重试';
          return;
        }
        this.loginMsg = '云端教务处理中（' + (status.status.length > 0 ? status.status : 'running') + '）…';
        this.pollLogin(jobId, startedAt);
        return;
      }
      if (status.snapshot === undefined || status.raw === undefined || status.snapshot.c.length === 0) {
        this.loginBusy = false;
        this.loginMsg = status.error.length > 0 ? ('登录失败：' + status.error) : '未获取到课程，请稍后重试';
        return;
      }
      await this.savePersonal(status.raw);
      await Services.timetable.load(true);
      await this.load();
      this.loginBusy = false;
      this.loginOk = true;
      this.loginMsg = '已同步 ' + status.snapshot.c.length + ' 节课到「我的课表」';
    }, 2000);
  }

  private async savePersonal(raw: Blob): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    const tt: Blob = {};
    const oldTt: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(current, 'tt'));
    if (oldTt !== undefined) {
      const oldKeys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(oldTt);
      for (let i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
        tt[oldKeys[i]] = oldTt[oldKeys[i]];
      }
    }
    tt['ttUseMine'] = true;
    tt['ttLocal'] = raw;
    next['tt'] = tt;
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
    const pushKeys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    pushKeys.add('tt');
    await Services.userdata.push(false, pushKeys);
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = this.snapshot === undefined;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    const result: TtResult = await Services.timetable.load(false);
    this.now = Date.now();
    this.snapshot = result.snapshot;
    this.plan = TtCalendar.plan(result.snapshot, this.now);
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.errorMsg = result.message;
    }
    this.loading = false;
  }

  private async openJw(): Promise<void> {
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = '应用上下文缺失，无法打开浏览器';
      return;
    }
    try {
      await context.startAbility({
        action: 'ohos.want.action.viewData',
        entities: ['entity.system.browsable'],
        uri: JwEntries.url()
      });
    } catch (e) {
      const err = e as BusinessError;
      this.errorMsg = '无法打开浏览器（' + err.code + '），请在浏览器访问 ' + JwEntries.url();
    }
  }

  private todaySessions(): SessionInfo[] {
    return this.plan.today;
  }

  private nextToday(): SessionInfo | undefined {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.plan.today.length; i++) {
      if (this.plan.today[i].state !== 'done') {
        return this.plan.today[i];
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  private todayText(): string {
    const next: SessionInfo | undefined = this.nextToday();
    return JwLogic.todayText(this.plan.today.length,
      next !== undefined ? next.startText : '', next !== undefined ? next.name : '');
  }

  @Builder
  loginCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('同步个人课表')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text('教务密码')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Text('使用当前身份学号登录教务，成功后课表切换为「我的课表」。密码只用于本次登录任务，不保存。')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 6 })

      Row({ space: 8 }) {
        TextInput({ text: this.pwd, placeholder: '教务密码' })
          .type(InputType.Password)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(42)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .borderRadius(10)
          .onChange((value: string) => {
            this.pwd = value;
          })
        Button(this.loginBusy ? '同步中…' : '登录并同步')
          .height(42)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .backgroundColor(this.loginBusy ? Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
          .enabled(!this.loginBusy)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.submitLogin();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 10 })

      if (this.loginMsg.length > 0) {
        Text(this.loginMsg)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(this.loginOk ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.WARM_SAND)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 8 })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  @Builder
  entryCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('教务系统')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text('系统浏览器')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Text(JwEntries.url())
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 6 })

      Text(JwLogic.loginHint())
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 4 })

      Button('打开教务系统')
        .width('100%')
        .height(44)
        .margin({ top: 10 })
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.openJw();
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  @Builder
  cardTile(card: JwCardDef) {
    Column() {
      Text(card.name)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
      Text(card.hint)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .maxLines(2)
        .margin({ top: 4 })
      Text('在教务系统查看')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
        .margin({ top: 6 })
    }
    .width('48%')
    .padding(12)
    .margin({ bottom: 8 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
    .onClick(() => {
      this.openJw();
    })
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      PageHeader({
        title: '教务',
        actionText: this.loading ? '' : '刷新',
        onBack: () => {
          this.onClose();
        },
        onAction: () => {
          this.load();
        }
      })

      Scroll() {
        Column() {
          this.loginCard()

          this.entryCard()

          Row() {
            Text('课表速览')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
            Blank()
            Text(JwLogic.weekText(this.plan.week, this.plan.hasData))
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 14 })

          Column() {
            Text(this.todayText())
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
              .width('100%')
            if (this.plan.next !== undefined) {
              Text('下一节：' + JwLogic.nextText(this.plan.next.dayText, this.plan.next.dateText,
                this.plan.next.startText, this.plan.next.name))
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                .width('100%')
                .margin({ top: 4 })
            }
            ForEach(this.todaySessions(), (session: SessionInfo) => {
              Row() {
                Text(session.startText + '–' + session.endText)
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                  .width(96)
                Text(session.name)
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
                  .layoutWeight(1)
                  .maxLines(1)
                if (session.room.length > 0) {
                  Text(session.room)
                    .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                    .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                }
              }
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ top: 5, bottom: 5 })
            }, (session: SessionInfo) => '' + session.startAt + '_' + session.name)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ left: 14, right: 14, top: 10, bottom: 10 })
          .margin({ top: 8 })
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)

          if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
            Text(this.errorMsg)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 8 })
          }

          Text('成绩 · 考试 · 选课 · 公告')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 14 })

          Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap, justifyContent: FlexAlign.SpaceBetween }) {
            ForEach(JwEntries.CARDS, (card: JwCardDef) => {
              Column() {
                this.cardTile(card)
              }
              .transition(Motion.listItem())
            }, (card: JwCardDef) => card.id)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 8 })

          Text('HarmonyOS 端不保存教务账号密码；数据请在教务系统内查看。')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4, bottom: 16 })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 24 })
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .align(Alignment.Top)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
  }
}
import { BusinessError } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';
import { webview } from '@kit.ArkWeb';
import { AppGlobal } from '../../app/AppGlobal';
import { MapLoadState, MapLogic } from '../../features/map/MapModels';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { Breakpoints } from '../theme/Breakpoints';

/**
 * 校内地图（ArkUI Web 加载 ECS H5，与网页/安卓同源方案）。
 *
 * - 数据源：`http://121.196.47.2/map/campus_final_25d.html?embed=1`（唯一数据源，不在原生侧重写 canvas）；
 * - 顶栏：返回 / 刷新 / 浏览器降级；
 * - 主文档加载失败：错误条提供「重试 / 浏览器打开」；
 * - Web 内部只允许 ECS 主机继续加载，其它链接交系统浏览器。
 */
@Component
export struct MapScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private state: MapLoadState = MapLoadState.LOADING;
  @State private progress: number = 0;
  @State private layoutWidth: number = 0;
  @State private wide: boolean = false;
  private controller: webview.WebviewController = new webview.WebviewController();

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.state = MapLoadState.LOADING;
  }

  private refresh(): void {
    try {
      this.state = MapLoadState.LOADING;
      this.progress = 0;
      this.controller.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      this.state = MapLoadState.FAILED;
    }
  }

  private async openBrowser(): Promise<void> {
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await context.startAbility({
        action: 'ohos.want.action.viewData',
        entities: ['entity.system.browsable'],
        uri: MapLogic.pageUrl()
      });
    } catch (e) {
      const err: BusinessError = e as BusinessError;
      this.getUIContext().getPromptAction().showToast({ message: '无法打开浏览器（' + err.code + '）' });
    }
  }

  @Builder
  header() {
    Row() {
      Text('‹')
        .fontSize(28)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        .width(44)
        .height(44)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.onClose();
        })
        .accessibilityText('返回')

      Text('地图')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_HEADING)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        .layoutWeight(1)

      Text('浏览器')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
        .padding({ left: 8, right: 8 })
        .height(44)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.openBrowser();
        })

      Text('刷新')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        .padding({ left: 8, right: 4 })
        .height(44)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.refresh();
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(56)
    .padding({ left: 4, right: 8 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
  }

  @Builder
  errorBar() {
    Row() {
      Text(MapLogic.stateText(MapLoadState.FAILED))
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.WARM_SAND)
        .layoutWeight(1)
      Text('重试')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
        .onClick(() => {
          this.refresh();
        })
      Text('浏览器')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
        .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
        .onClick(() => {
          this.openBrowser();
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding({ left: 14, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.TINT_SAND)
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      this.header()

      if (this.state === MapLoadState.LOADING) {
        Progress({ value: this.progress, total: 100, type: ProgressType.Linear })
          .width('100%')
          .height(2)
          .color(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.DIVIDER)
      }

      if (MapLogic.showErrorBar(this.state)) {
        this.errorBar()
      }

      Web({ src: MapLogic.pageUrl(), controller: this.controller })
        .javaScriptAccess(true)
        .domStorageAccess(true)
        .zoomAccess(true)
        .fileAccess(false)
        .imageAccess(true)
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .width('100%')
        .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
        .onPageBegin(() => {
          this.state = MapLoadState.LOADING;
        })
        .onProgressChange((event: OnProgressChangeEvent) => {
          this.progress = event.newProgress;
        })
        .onPageEnd(() => {
          this.state = MapLoadState.READY;
          this.progress = 100;
        })
        .onErrorReceive((event: OnErrorReceiveEvent) => {
          if (event.request.isMainFrame()) {
            this.state = MapLoadState.FAILED;
          }
        })
        .onLoadIntercept((event: OnLoadInterceptEvent) => {
          const url: string = event.data.getRequestUrl();
          if (MapLogic.isAllowedNavigation(url)) {
            return false;
          }
          // 非 ECS 主机（如站外链接）交给系统浏览器，Web 内不加载。
          this.openBrowser();
          return true;
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
    .padding({ top: Breakpoints.BREATH_TOP })
    .onAreaChange((oldArea: Area, newArea: Area) => {
      const next: number = Number(newArea.width);
      if (Math.abs(next - this.layoutWidth) > 1) {
        this.layoutWidth = next;
        this.wide = Breakpoints.isWide(next);
      }
    })
  }
}

/**
 * 通知工具：对齐「枫丹工具箱」微信小程序 pages/nt 的界面与口径。
 *
 * - 顶部简报：待处理 / 24h 截止 / 7 天内 / 长期通知 / 最新发布 五张可点数据卡；
 * - 两级筛选：状态 chips（全部 / 待处理 / 已截止 / 已隐藏）+ 分类 chips；
 * - 卡片：分类 / 长期安排 / OCR / 状态胶囊 / 来源 / AI 摘要 / 字段拆分 / 附件 / 图片 / 原文摘录 / 组成；
 * - 长期安排：24h 内期次卡（本次已处理）+ 长期清单；已结束归入已过期；
 * - 已处理写 `marks kind='ntdone'`；隐藏走 userdata.hide（可单条恢复 / 全部恢复）。
 */
@Component
export struct NoticeScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private cards: NoticeCard[] = [];
  @State private dataVersion: number = 0;
  @State private doneKeys: string[] = [];
  @State private hiddenIds: string[] = [];
  @State private stats: NoticeStats = new NoticeStats();
  @State private brief: NoticeCard[] = [];
  @State private categories: string[] = [];
  @State private cat: string = '全部';
  @State private filter: string = 'all';
  @State private cardKey: string = '';
  @State private showExpired: boolean = false;
  @State private showInfo: boolean = true;
  @State private expandedKeys: string[] = [];
  @State private loading: boolean = true;
  @State private syncing: boolean = false;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private notice: string = '';
  @State private now: number = Date.now();
  @State private entered: boolean = false;
  @State private previewOpen: boolean = false;
  @State private previewSrc: string = '';
  @State private rawOpen: boolean = false;
  @State private rawTitle: string = '';
  @State private rawBody: string = '';
  @State private rawBlocks: NoticeItemMeta[] = [];

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    HomeNtBadge.markOpened(Services.currentSid);
    this.reload(false);
  }

  private async reload(force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = this.cards.length === 0;
    this.syncing = true;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    const result: NoticesResult = await Services.notices.load(force);
    const marksResult: MarksRefreshResult = await Services.marks.refresh(false);
    this.now = Date.now();
    const hide = HidePrefs.read(Services.userdata.currentSections());
    const hidden: string[] = [];
    hide.ntHide.forEach((id: string) => {
      hidden.push(id);
    });
    this.hiddenIds = hidden;
    const built: NoticeCard[] = NoticeCards.build(result.entries, this.now);
    for (let i = 0; i < built.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = built[i];
      const entryId: string = card.entry !== undefined ? card.entry.row.id : '';
      const groupId: string = card.key.indexOf('@occ:') > 0
        ? card.key.substring(0, card.key.indexOf('@occ:')) : card.key;
      card.hiddenLocal = hidden.indexOf(entryId) >= 0 || hidden.indexOf(groupId) >= 0;
    }
    this.cards = built;
    this.dataVersion = this.dataVersion + 1;
    this.categories = NoticeCards.categories(built);
    if (this.cat !== '全部' && this.categories.indexOf(this.cat) < 0) {
      this.cat = '全部';
    }
    const done: string[] = [];
    const snapshot = Services.marks.marks();
    for (let i = 0; i < built.length; i++) {
      const key: string = built[i].key;
      if (snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.NT_DONE, key) || this.doneKeys.indexOf(key) >= 0) {
        done.push(key);
      }
    }
    this.doneKeys = done;
    this.refreshDigest();
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.errorMsg = result.message;
    } else if (marksResult.error !== undefined) {
      this.errorMsg = '已处理状态同步失败：' + marksResult.error.displayMessage();
    }
    this.loading = false;
    this.syncing = false;
    if (!this.entered) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.entered = true;
      }, 40);
    }
  }

  private refreshDigest(): void {
    const visible: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cards.length; i++) {
      if (!this.cards[i].hiddenLocal) {
        visible.push(this.cards[i]);
      }
    }
    this.stats = NoticeCards.statsOf(visible, this.doneKeys, this.now);
    this.brief = NoticeCards.briefNext(visible, this.doneKeys, this.now, 3);
  }

  private isDone(key: string): boolean {
    return this.doneKeys.indexOf(key) >= 0;
  }

  private isExpanded(key: string): boolean {
    return this.expandedKeys.indexOf(key) >= 0;
  }

  private mode(): string {
    return this.cardKey.length > 0 ? this.cardKey : this.filter;
  }

  private matchesCat(card: NoticeCard): boolean {
    return this.cat === '全部' || card.cat === this.cat;
  }

  private inWindow(card: NoticeCard, days: number): boolean {
    if (card.whenAt <= this.now) {
      return false;
    }
    return card.whenAt - this.now <= days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  }

  private currentCards(): NoticeCard[] {
    const mode: string = this.mode();
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cards.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = this.cards[i];
      if (mode === 'hidden') {
        if (card.hiddenLocal && this.matchesCat(card)) {
          out.push(card);
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (card.hiddenLocal || !this.matchesCat(card)) {
        continue;
      }
      if (mode === 'longterm') {
        continue;
      }
      if (mode === 'latest') {
        out.push(card);
      } else if (mode === 'expired') {
        if (card.section === NoticeSection.EXPIRED) {
          out.push(card);
        }
      } else if (mode === 'active' || mode === 'pending') {
        if (card.section === NoticeSection.PRIMARY && !card.definition && !this.isDone(card.key)) {
          out.push(card);
        }
      } else if (mode === 'urgent' || mode === 'week') {
        if (card.section === NoticeSection.PRIMARY && !card.definition && !this.isDone(card.key)
          && this.inWindow(card, mode === 'urgent' ? 1 : 7)) {
          out.push(card);
        }
      } else if (card.section === NoticeSection.PRIMARY) {
        out.push(card);
      }
    }
    if (mode === 'latest') {
      out.sort((a: NoticeCard, b: NoticeCard) => b.pubTs - a.pubTs);
    } else if (mode === 'urgent' || mode === 'week') {
      out.sort((a: NoticeCard, b: NoticeCard) => a.whenAt - b.whenAt);
    } else if (mode === 'expired') {
      out.sort((a: NoticeCard, b: NoticeCard) => b.sortAt - a.sortAt);
    }
    return out;
  }

  private infoCards(): NoticeCard[] {
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    if (this.mode() !== 'all') {
      return out;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cards.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = this.cards[i];
      if (!card.hiddenLocal && this.matchesCat(card) && card.section === NoticeSection.MATERIAL) {
        out.push(card);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  private expiredCards(): NoticeCard[] {
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    if (this.mode() !== 'all' && this.mode() !== 'active') {
      return out;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cards.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = this.cards[i];
      if (!card.hiddenLocal && this.matchesCat(card) && card.section === NoticeSection.EXPIRED
        && !card.definition) {
        out.push(card);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  private longtermList(): NoticeCard[] {
    const out: NoticeCard[] = [];
    if (this.mode() !== 'longterm') {
      return out;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cards.length; i++) {
      const card: NoticeCard = this.cards[i];
      if (!card.hiddenLocal && this.matchesCat(card) && card.definition && !card.expired) {
        out.push(card);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  private async toggleDone(card: NoticeCard): Promise<void> {
    const key: string = card.key;
    const next: boolean = !this.isDone(key);
    const copy: string[] = this.doneKeys.slice(0);
    if (next) {
      if (copy.indexOf(key) < 0) {
        copy.push(key);
      }
    } else {
      const index: number = copy.indexOf(key);
      if (index >= 0) {
        copy.splice(index, 1);
      }
    }
    this.doneKeys = copy;
    this.notice = '';
    this.refreshDigest();
    const result: MarksUpdateResult = await Services.marks.setMark(MarkKind.NT_DONE, key, next);
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.notice = '网络不佳：已在本机标记，稍后自动补发';
    }
  }

  private async hideCard(card: NoticeCard): Promise<void> {
    if (card.entry === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const id: string = card.entry.row.id;
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const data = HidePrefs.read(current);
    data.ntHide.add(id);
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(HidePrefs.write(current, data));
    const keys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    keys.add('hide');
    await Services.userdata.push(false, keys);
    this.notice = '已隐藏该通知（仅自己不可见，可在「已隐藏」恢复）';
    await this.reload(true);
  }

  private async restoreCard(card: NoticeCard): Promise<void> {
    if (card.entry === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const id: string = card.entry.row.id;
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const data = HidePrefs.read(current);
    data.ntHide.delete(id);
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(HidePrefs.write(current, data));
    const keys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    keys.add('hide');
    await Services.userdata.push(false, keys);
    this.notice = '已恢复该通知';
    await this.reload(true);
  }

  private async restoreAll(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.hiddenIds.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const data = HidePrefs.read(current);
    data.ntHide.clear();
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(HidePrefs.write(current, data));
    const keys: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
    keys.add('hide');
    await Services.userdata.push(false, keys);
    this.notice = '已恢复全部隐藏通知';
    await this.reload(true);
  }

  private toggleExpand(key: string): void {
    const copy: string[] = this.expandedKeys.slice(0);
    const index: number = copy.indexOf(key);
    if (index >= 0) {
      copy.splice(index, 1);
    } else {
      copy.push(key);
    }
    this.expandedKeys = copy;
  }

  private openPreview(src: string): void {
    if (src.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.previewSrc = src;
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.previewOpen = true;
    });
  }

  private closePreview(): void {
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.previewOpen = false;
    });
  }

  private openRaw(card: NoticeCard): void {
    this.rawTitle = card.rawTitle.length > 0 ? card.rawTitle : card.title;
    const blocks: NoticeItemMeta[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < card.quotes.length; i++) {
      blocks.push(card.quotes[i]);
    }
    if (blocks.length === 0 && card.entry !== undefined && card.entry.row.body.trim().length > 0) {
      this.rawBody = card.entry.row.body.trim();
    } else {
      this.rawBody = '';
    }
    this.rawBlocks = blocks;
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.rawOpen = true;
    });
  }

  private closeRaw(): void {
    this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
      this.rawOpen = false;
    });
  }

  private openUrl(url: string): void {
    if (url.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    if (url.indexOf('http') !== 0) {
      this.notice = '该附件仅有内嵌数据，当前设备无法直接打开';
      return;
    }
    const context = AppGlobal.context;
    if (context === undefined) {
      this.notice = '无法打开链接';
      return;
    }
    try {
      context.startAbility({
        action: 'ohos.want.action.viewData',
        entities: ['entity.system.browsable'],
        uri: url
      }).catch(() => {
        this.notice = '无法打开该链接';
      });
    } catch (e) {
      this.notice = '无法打开该链接';
    }
  }

  private pickCard(key: string): void {
    if (this.cardKey === key) {
      this.cardKey = '';
      this.filter = 'all';
    } else {
      this.cardKey = key;
      this.filter = key === 'pending' ? 'active' : key;
      if (key === 'longterm') {
        this.showExpired = false;
      }
    }
    this.cat = '全部';
  }

  private pickFilter(value: string): void {
    this.cardKey = '';
    this.filter = value;
    if (value === 'expired') {
      this.showExpired = true;
    }
  }

  private catBg(cls: string): string {
    if (cls === 'jw') {
      return NT_BL_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'tw') {
      return NT_CY_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'ks') {
      return NT_SD_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'jf') {
      return NT_ROSE_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'hd') {
      return NT_VIOLET_TINT;
    }
    return NT_GREY_TINT;
  }

  private catFg(cls: string): string {
    if (cls === 'jw') {
      return NT_BL_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'tw') {
      return NT_CY_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'ks') {
      return NT_SD_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'jf') {
      return NT_ROSE_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'hd') {
      return NT_VIOLET_INK;
    }
    return NT_GREY_INK;
  }

  private statusBg(cls: string): string {
    if (cls === 'urgent' || cls === 'alert') {
      return NT_ROSE_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'active') {
      return NT_CY_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'extended') {
      return NT_SD_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'recurring') {
      return NT_BL_TINT;
    }
    return NT_GREY_TINT;
  }

  private statusFg(cls: string): string {
    if (cls === 'urgent' || cls === 'alert') {
      return NT_ROSE_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'active') {
      return NT_CY_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'extended') {
      return NT_SD_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'recurring') {
      return NT_BL_INK;
    }
    return NT_INK_2;
  }

  private typeChipBg(cls: string): string {
    if (cls === 'time' || cls === 'due') {
      return NT_SD_TINT;
    }
    if (cls === 'rule') {
      return NT_ROSE_TINT;
    }
    return NT_GREY_TINT;
  }

  private typeChipFg(cls: string): string {
    if (cls === 'time' || cls === 'due') {
      return NT_SD_INK;
    }
    if (cls === 'rule') {
      return NT_ROSE_INK;
    }
    return NT_INK_2;
  }

  @Builder
  miniTag(text: string, bg: string, fg: string) {
    Text(text)
      .fontSize(10)
      .fontColor(fg)
      .backgroundColor(bg)
      .borderRadius(5)
      .padding({ left: 6, right: 6, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
      .maxLines(1)
      .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 2 })
  }

  @Builder
  filterChip(value: string, text: string) {
    Text(text)
      .fontSize(12)
      .fontColor((this.filter === value && this.cardKey.length === 0) ? '#FFFFFF' : NT_INK_2)
      .backgroundColor((this.filter === value && this.cardKey.length === 0) ? NT_CY_DEEP : NT_CARD)
      .border({ width: 1, color: (this.filter === value && this.cardKey.length === 0) ? NT_CY_DEEP : NT_LINE })
      .borderRadius(999)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
      .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.pickFilter(value);
      })
  }

  @Builder
  hiddenChip() {
    Text('已隐藏' + (this.hiddenIds.length > 0 ? ' ' + this.hiddenIds.length : ''))
      .fontSize(12)
      .fontColor((this.filter === 'hidden' && this.cardKey.length === 0) ? '#FFFFFF' : NT_INK_2)
      .backgroundColor((this.filter === 'hidden' && this.cardKey.length === 0) ? NT_CY_DEEP : NT_CARD)
      .border({ width: 1, color: (this.filter === 'hidden' && this.cardKey.length === 0) ? NT_CY_DEEP : NT_LINE })
      .borderRadius(999)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
      .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.pickFilter('hidden');
      })
  }

  private statValue(key: string): string {
    if (key === 'pending') {
      return '' + this.stats.pending;
    }
    if (key === 'urgent') {
      return '' + this.stats.urgent;
    }
    if (key === 'week') {
      return '' + this.stats.week;
    }
    if (key === 'longterm') {
      return '' + this.stats.longterm;
    }
    return this.stats.latestText;
  }

  private statLabel(key: string): string {
    if (key === 'pending') {
      return '待处理';
    }
    if (key === 'urgent') {
      return '24h 截止';
    }
    if (key === 'week') {
      return '7 天内';
    }
    if (key === 'longterm') {
      return '长期通知';
    }
    return '最新发布';
  }

  @Builder
  dataCard(key: string) {
    Column() {
      Text(this.statValue(key))
        .fontSize(key === 'latest' ? 17 : 16)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(this.cardKey === key ? '#FFFFFF' : NT_INK)
        .maxLines(1)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
      Text(this.statLabel(key))
        .fontSize(10)
        .fontColor(this.cardKey === key ? '#FFFFFF' : NT_INK_2)
        .margin({ top: 2 })
    }
    .width(key === 'longterm' || key === 'latest' ? '47%' : '30%')
    .height(56)
    .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
    .backgroundColor(this.cardKey === key ? NT_CY_DEEP : NT_CARD)
    .border({ width: 1, color: this.cardKey === key ? NT_CY_DEEP : NT_LINE })
    .borderRadius(10)
    .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
    .onClick(() => {
      this.pickCard(key);
    })
  }

  @Builder
  sectionHeader(title: string, count: number, foldable: boolean, open: boolean, onTap: () => void) {
    Row() {
      Text(title)
        .fontSize(13)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
      Text(' · ' + count)
        .fontSize(11)
        .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
      Blank()
      if (foldable) {
        Text(open ? '▴ 收起' : '▾ 展开')
          .fontSize(11)
          .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding({ left: 2, right: 2, top: 10, bottom: 6 })
    .onClick(() => {
      if (foldable) {
        onTap();
      }
    })
  }

  @Builder
  segmentRow(segment: NoticeSegment) {
    Row() {
      Text(segment.type)
        .fontSize(10)
        .fontColor(this.typeChipFg(NoticeCards.segClsOf(segment.type)))
        .backgroundColor(this.typeChipBg(NoticeCards.segClsOf(segment.type)))
        .borderRadius(5)
        .padding({ left: 6, right: 6, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
        .width(54)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
      Text(segment.text)
        .fontSize(12)
        .fontColor(NT_INK)
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .margin({ left: 8 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Top)
    .padding({ top: 6, bottom: 6 })
    .border({ width: { bottom: 1 }, color: NT_LINE })
  }

  @Builder
  itemRow(item: NoticeItemMeta, cardKey: string, index: number) {
    if (item.kind === 'file') {
      Row() {
        Text(item.extText.length > 0 ? item.extText : '文件')
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(NT_GREY_INK)
          .backgroundColor(NT_GREY_TINT)
          .borderRadius(6)
          .width(38)
          .height(38)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        Column() {
          Text(item.name)
            .fontSize(12)
            .fontColor(NT_INK)
            .maxLines(2)
            .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
          Text(item.sizeText.length > 0 ? item.sizeText : '附件')
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
            .margin({ top: 2 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
        .margin({ left: 8 })
        if (item.hasUrl) {
          Text('打开')
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
            .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
            .border({ width: 1, color: NT_LINE_STRONG })
            .borderRadius(999)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.openUrl(item.url);
            })
        } else if (item.archiveOk) {
          Text('已识别 ' + item.archiveCount)
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_BL_INK)
        } else {
          Text('待获取')
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ top: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .border({ width: { bottom: 1 }, color: NT_LINE })

      if (item.archiveOk) {
        Column() {
          if (item.archiveSummary.length > 0) {
            Text(item.archiveSummary)
              .fontSize(10)
              .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
              .width('100%')
              .maxLines(2)
              .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
          }
          ForEach(item.archiveFiles, (af: NoticeArchiveFile, afIndex: number) => {
            Row() {
              Text(af.extText)
                .fontSize(9)
                .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
                .width(30)
              Text(af.name)
                .fontSize(11)
                .fontColor(NT_INK)
                .layoutWeight(1)
                .maxLines(1)
                .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
              Text(af.sizeText)
                .fontSize(9)
                .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
              Text(af.hasUrl ? '可预览' : '仅清单')
                .fontSize(9)
                .fontColor(af.hasUrl ? NT_CY_INK : NT_INK_3)
                .margin({ left: 8 })
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ top: 3, bottom: 3 })
          }, (af: NoticeArchiveFile, afIndex: number) => cardKey + '_af' + index + '_' + afIndex + '_' + af.name)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: 46, bottom: 6 })
      }
    } else if (item.kind === 'form') {
      Row() {
        Text('表')
          .fontSize(11)
          .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
          .backgroundColor(NT_CY_TINT)
          .borderRadius(6)
          .width(30)
          .height(30)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        Column() {
          Text(item.name)
            .fontSize(12)
            .fontColor(NT_INK)
            .maxLines(1)
            .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
          Text(item.statusText + (item.note.length > 0 ? ' · ' + item.note : ''))
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
            .margin({ top: 2 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
        .margin({ left: 8 })
        if (item.hasUrl) {
          Text('打开')
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.openUrl(item.url);
            })
        } else {
          Text('QQ 表单')
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ top: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .border({ width: { bottom: 1 }, color: NT_LINE })
    } else if (item.kind === 'merged') {
      Column() {
        Row() {
          Text(item.name)
            .fontSize(12)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .fontColor(NT_INK)
            .layoutWeight(1)
          Text(item.count + ' 条')
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
        }
        .width('100%')
        ForEach(item.messages, (msg: NoticeMsgMeta, msgIndex: number) => {
          Column() {
            Row({ space: 6 }) {
              if (msg.fromBadge.length > 0) {
                Text(msg.fromBadge)
                  .fontSize(9)
                  .fontColor(NT_BL_INK)
              }
              if (msg.fromName.length > 0) {
                Text(msg.fromName)
                  .fontSize(10)
                  .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
              }
              if (msg.timeText.length > 0) {
                Text(msg.timeText)
                  .fontSize(9)
                  .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
              }
            }
            Text(msg.text)
              .fontSize(11)
              .fontColor(NT_INK)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 2 })
          }
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6 })
        }, (msg: NoticeMsgMeta, msgIndex: number) => cardKey + '_msg' + index + '_' + msgIndex)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(8)
      .backgroundColor(NT_CARD_SOFT)
      .borderRadius(8)
      .margin({ top: 6 })
    } else if (item.kind === 'link' || item.kind === 'mini' || item.kind === 'article') {
      Row() {
        Text(item.kind === 'article' ? '公' : (item.kind === 'mini' ? '程' : '链'))
          .fontSize(11)
          .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
          .backgroundColor(NT_GREY_TINT)
          .borderRadius(6)
          .width(30)
          .height(30)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        Column() {
          Text(item.name)
            .fontSize(12)
            .fontColor(NT_INK)
            .maxLines(1)
            .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
          Text(item.account.length > 0 ? item.account
            : (item.host.length > 0 ? item.host : (item.note.length > 0 ? item.note : '外部链接')))
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
            .margin({ top: 2 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
        .margin({ left: 8 })
        if (item.hasUrl) {
          Text('打开')
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.openUrl(item.url);
            })
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ top: 8, bottom: 8 })
      .border({ width: { bottom: 1 }, color: NT_LINE })
    } else if (item.kind === 'img') {
      Image(item.url)
        .width('48.5%')
        .height(110)
        .objectFit(ImageFit.Cover)
        .borderRadius(8)
        .backgroundColor(NT_GREY_TINT)
        .margin({ top: 6 })
        .onClick(() => {
          this.openPreview(item.url);
        })
    }
  }

  @Builder
  noticeCard(card: NoticeCard) {
    Column() {
      Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap, alignItems: ItemAlign.Center }) {
        this.miniTag(card.cat, this.catBg(card.catCls), this.catFg(card.catCls))
        if (card.occurrence || card.recurring) {
          this.miniTag('长期安排', NT_BL_TINT, NT_BL_INK)
        }
        if (card.ocr) {
          this.miniTag('OCR', NT_GREY_TINT, NT_INK_2)
        }
        Text(card.statusLabel)
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
          .fontColor(this.statusFg(card.statusCls))
          .backgroundColor(this.statusBg(card.statusCls))
          .borderRadius(999)
          .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 3, bottom: 3 })
          .maxLines(1)
          .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 2 })
        if (card.hiddenLocal) {
          this.miniTag('已隐藏', NT_GREY_TINT, NT_INK_2)
        }
        if (card.updated) {
          this.miniTag('已更新', NT_SD_TINT, NT_SD_INK)
        }
        if (card.hasRaw) {
          Text('原始消息')
            .fontSize(10)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
            .padding({ left: 4, right: 4, top: 4, bottom: 4 })
            .onClick(() => {
              this.openRaw(card);
            })
        }
      }
      .width('100%')

      Text(card.title)
        .fontSize(16)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(this.isDone(card.key) ? NT_INK_3 : NT_INK)
        .decoration({ type: this.isDone(card.key) ? TextDecorationType.LineThrough : TextDecorationType.None })
        .width('100%')
        .maxLines(3)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
        .margin({ top: 8 })

      if (card.source.length > 0 || card.senderName.length > 0 || card.senderBadge.length > 0) {
        Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap, alignItems: ItemAlign.Center }) {
          if (card.source.length > 0) {
            Row() {
              Circle()
                .width(5)
                .height(5)
                .fill(card.sourceKind === 'qq' ? NT_BL_INK : (card.sourceKind === 'wx' ? NT_CY : NT_INK_3))
              Text(card.source)
                .fontSize(10)
                .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
                .margin({ left: 5 })
            }
            .padding({ left: 7, right: 7, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
            .border({ width: 1, color: NT_LINE })
            .borderRadius(999)
            .margin({ right: 8, top: 3 })
          }
          if (card.senderBadge.length > 0) {
            Text(card.senderBadge)
              .fontSize(9)
              .fontColor(NT_BL_INK)
              .backgroundColor(NT_BL_TINT)
              .borderRadius(5)
              .padding({ left: 5, right: 5, top: 1, bottom: 1 })
              .margin({ right: 6, top: 3 })
          }
          if (card.senderName.length > 0) {
            Text(card.senderName)
              .fontSize(10)
              .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
              .margin({ top: 3 })
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 4 })
      }

      if (card.recurring && card.nextText.length > 0) {
        Row() {
          Text('下次 ' + card.nextText)
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_BL_INK)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 5, bottom: 5 })
        .backgroundColor(NT_BL_TINT)
        .borderRadius(7)
        .margin({ top: 8 })
      }

      if (card.aiSummary.length > 0) {
        Column() {
          Row() {
            Text('AI')
              .fontSize(9)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
              .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
              .backgroundColor(NT_CY_TINT)
              .borderRadius(4)
              .padding({ left: 4, right: 4, top: 1, bottom: 1 })
            Text('摘要')
              .fontSize(10)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
              .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
              .margin({ left: 4 })
          }
          Text(card.aiSummary)
            .fontSize(12)
            .fontColor(NT_INK)
            .width('100%')
            .maxLines(this.isExpanded(card.key) ? 30 : 4)
            .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
            .margin({ top: 4 })
          if (card.points.length > 0) {
            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
              ForEach(card.points, (point: string, pointIndex: number) => {
                Text(point)
                  .fontSize(10)
                  .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
                  .backgroundColor(NT_CY_TINT)
                  .borderRadius(5)
                  .padding({ left: 6, right: 6, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
                  .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 5 })
              }, (point: string, pointIndex: number) => card.key + '_pt' + pointIndex)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4 })
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding(8)
        .backgroundColor(NT_CARD_SOFT)
        .borderRadius(9)
        .margin({ top: 8 })
      }

      if (!this.isExpanded(card.key) && card.moreText.length > 0) {
        Text(card.moreText)
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 8 })
      }

      if (this.isExpanded(card.key)) {
        Column() {
          if (card.segments.length > 0) {
            Column() {
              ForEach(card.segments, (segment: NoticeSegment, segmentIndex: number) => {
                this.segmentRow(segment)
              }, (segment: NoticeSegment, segmentIndex: number) => card.key + '_seg' + segmentIndex + '_' + segment.type)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 8 })
            .border({ width: { top: 1 }, color: NT_LINE })
          }

          if (card.items.length > 0) {
            Column() {
              ForEach(card.items, (item: NoticeItemMeta, itemIndex: number) => {
                this.itemRow(item, card.key, itemIndex)
              }, (item: NoticeItemMeta, itemIndex: number) => card.key + '_it' + itemIndex + '_' + item.kind)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })
          }

          if (card.quotes.length > 0) {
            Column() {
              ForEach(card.quotes, (quote: NoticeItemMeta, quoteIndex: number) => {
                Column() {
                  Row({ space: 6 }) {
                    Text(quote.label)
                      .fontSize(9)
                      .fontColor(NT_SD_INK)
                      .backgroundColor(NT_SD_TINT)
                      .borderRadius(4)
                      .padding({ left: 4, right: 4, top: 1, bottom: 1 })
                    if (quote.fromName.length > 0) {
                      Text(quote.fromName)
                        .fontSize(9)
                        .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                    }
                    if (quote.timeText.length > 0) {
                      Text(quote.timeText)
                        .fontSize(9)
                        .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                    }
                  }
                  Text(quote.text)
                    .fontSize(11)
                    .fontColor(NT_INK)
                    .width('100%')
                    .maxLines(6)
                    .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
                    .margin({ top: 4 })
                }
                .width('100%')
                .padding(8)
                .backgroundColor(NT_CARD_SOFT)
                .borderRadius(8)
                .margin({ top: 6 })
              }, (quote: NoticeItemMeta, quoteIndex: number) => card.key + '_q' + quoteIndex)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4 })
          }

          if (card.compose.length > 0) {
            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
              ForEach(card.compose, (chip: NoticeComposeChip, chipIndex: number) => {
                Row() {
                  Text('' + chip.n)
                    .fontSize(9)
                    .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                    .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
                  Text(' ' + chip.label)
                    .fontSize(9)
                    .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
                }
                .padding({ left: 6, right: 6, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
                .border({ width: 1, color: NT_LINE })
                .borderRadius(999)
                .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 5 })
              }, (chip: NoticeComposeChip, chipIndex: number) => card.key + '_cp' + chipIndex)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 8 })
          }
        }
        .width('100%')
        .animation({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() })
      }

      Row({ space: 8 }) {
        if (!card.definition) {
          Text(this.isDone(card.key) ? (card.occurrence ? '本期已处理' : '已处理')
            : (card.occurrence ? '本次已处理' : '标记已处理'))
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(this.isDone(card.key) ? NT_CY_INK : NT_INK_2)
            .backgroundColor(this.isDone(card.key) ? NT_CY_TINT : NT_GREY_TINT)
            .borderRadius(999)
            .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
            .onClick(() => {
              this.toggleDone(card);
            })
        }
        if (card.hiddenLocal) {
          Text('恢复')
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
            .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
            .onClick(() => {
              this.restoreCard(card);
            })
        } else if (card.entry !== undefined) {
          Text('隐藏')
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
            .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
            .onClick(() => {
              this.hideCard(card);
            })
        }
        Blank()
        if (card.hasDetail) {
          Text(this.isExpanded(card.key) ? '收起' : '展开')
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
            .padding({ left: 8, right: 4, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
            .onClick(() => {
              this.toggleExpand(card.key);
            })
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 8 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(13)
    .backgroundColor(this.isDone(card.key) || card.expired ? NT_CARD_SOFT : NT_CARD)
    .borderRadius(14)
    .border({ width: 1, color: card.occurrence ? '#BFD3E3' : NT_LINE })
    .margin({ bottom: 10 })
    .opacity(this.entered ? 1 : 0)
    .translate({ y: this.entered ? 0 : 8 })
    .animation({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() })
  }

  @Builder
  emptyState(title: string, text: string) {
    Column({ space: 6 }) {
      Text('📣')
        .fontSize(26)
      Text(title)
        .fontSize(14)
        .fontColor(NT_INK)
      Text(text)
        .fontSize(11)
        .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding({ top: 28, bottom: 28 })
    .backgroundColor(NT_CARD)
    .borderRadius(14)
    .border({ width: 1, color: NT_LINE })
  }

  @Builder
  briefCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('待处理简报')
          .fontSize(11)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
        Text(this.stats.pending > 0 ? this.stats.pending + ' 项待处理' : '无待处理')
          .fontSize(9)
          .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
          .backgroundColor(NT_CARD)
          .borderRadius(999)
          .padding({ left: 7, right: 7, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
          .margin({ left: 8 })
        Blank()
        Text(NoticeStatus.pad2(new Date(this.now).getMonth() + 1) + '-' + NoticeStatus.pad2(new Date(this.now).getDate()))
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
        this.dataCard('pending')
        this.dataCard('urgent')
        this.dataCard('week')
        this.dataCard('longterm')
        this.dataCard('latest')
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 10 })

      if (this.brief.length > 0) {
        Column() {
          ForEach(this.brief, (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => {
            Row() {
              Text(card.title)
                .fontSize(11)
                .fontColor(NT_INK)
                .layoutWeight(1)
                .maxLines(1)
                .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
              Text(card.statusLabel)
                .fontSize(9)
                .fontColor(card.statusCls === 'urgent' ? NT_ROSE_INK : NT_INK_2)
                .margin({ left: 8 })
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ top: 7, bottom: 7 })
            .border({ width: { top: index === 0 ? 0 : 1 }, color: NT_LINE })
            .onClick(() => {
              this.filter = 'active';
              this.cardKey = '';
              this.cat = '全部';
            })
          }, (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => 'brief_' + card.key + '_' + this.dataVersion)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 4 })
      }

      Row() {
        Text(this.syncing ? '同步中…' : '已同步 · ' + new Date(this.now).getHours() + ':' + NoticeStatus.pad2(new Date(this.now).getMinutes()))
          .fontSize(9)
          .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
          .layoutWeight(1)
        Text(this.syncing ? '同步中…' : '刷新')
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
          .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 4, bottom: 4 })
          .onClick(() => {
            if (!this.syncing) {
              this.reload(true);
            }
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 6 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(12)
    .backgroundColor(NT_BRIEF)
    .borderRadius(14)
    .border({ width: 1, color: NT_LINE })
  }

  @Builder
  longtermRow(card: NoticeCard) {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        this.miniTag(card.cat, this.catBg(card.catCls), this.catFg(card.catCls))
        this.miniTag('长期安排', NT_BL_TINT, NT_BL_INK)
        Blank()
        Text('进行中')
          .fontSize(10)
          .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
      }
      .width('100%')
      Text(card.title)
        .fontSize(15)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(NT_INK)
        .width('100%')
        .maxLines(2)
        .margin({ top: 6 })
      Row() {
        Text(card.recurLabel)
          .fontSize(11)
          .fontColor(NT_BL_INK)
          .layoutWeight(1)
        if (card.nextCnText.length > 0) {
          Text(card.nextCnText)
            .fontSize(11)
            .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 4 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(13)
    .backgroundColor(NT_CARD)
    .borderRadius(14)
    .border({ width: 1, color: NT_LINE })
    .margin({ bottom: 10 })
  }

  build() {
    Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.Bottom }) {
      Column() {
        Row() {
          Text('‹')
            .fontSize(28)
            .fontColor(NT_INK)
            .width(42)
            .height(44)
            .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.onClose();
            })
          Text('通知')
            .fontSize(18)
            .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
            .fontColor(NT_INK)
            .layoutWeight(1)
          Text(this.syncing ? '同步中' : '刷新')
            .fontSize(12)
            .fontColor(this.syncing ? NT_INK_3 : NT_CY_INK)
            .padding({ left: 10, right: 12 })
            .height(44)
            .onClick(() => {
              if (!this.syncing) {
                this.reload(true);
              }
            })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height(56)
        .padding({ left: 2, right: 4 })
        .backgroundColor(NT_BG)

        if (this.loading) {
          Column({ space: 10 }) {
            LoadingProgress().width(30).height(30).color(NT_CY)
            Text('正在读取通知…')
              .fontSize(11)
              .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
        } else {
          Scroll() {
            Column() {
              this.briefCard()

              if (this.notice.length > 0) {
                Text(this.notice)
                  .fontSize(10)
                  .fontColor(NT_SD_INK)
                  .width('100%')
                  .margin({ top: 6 })
              }
              if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
                Text(this.errorMsg)
                  .fontSize(10)
                  .fontColor(NT_ROSE_INK)
                  .width('100%')
                  .margin({ top: 6 })
              }

              Column() {
                Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
                  this.filterChip('all', '全部')
                  this.filterChip('active', '待处理')
                  this.filterChip('expired', '已截止')
                  this.hiddenChip()
                }
                .width('100%')
                Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
                  Text('全部分类')
                    .fontSize(11)
                    .fontColor(this.cat === '全部' ? NT_CY_INK : NT_INK_2)
                    .backgroundColor(this.cat === '全部' ? NT_CY_TINT : NT_CARD)
                    .border({ width: 1, color: this.cat === '全部' ? NT_CY : NT_LINE })
                    .borderRadius(999)
                    .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                    .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
                    .onClick(() => {
                      this.cat = '全部';
                    })
                  ForEach(this.categories, (cat: string, index: number) => {
                    Text(cat)
                      .fontSize(11)
                      .fontColor(this.cat === cat ? NT_CY_INK : NT_INK_2)
                      .backgroundColor(this.cat === cat ? NT_CY_TINT : NT_CARD)
                      .border({ width: 1, color: this.cat === cat ? NT_CY : NT_LINE })
                      .borderRadius(999)
                      .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                      .margin({ right: 8, bottom: 8 })
                      .onClick(() => {
                        this.cat = cat;
                      })
                  }, (cat: string, index: number) => 'cat_' + cat)
                }
                .width('100%')
              }
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 4 })

              if (this.filter === 'hidden' && this.hiddenIds.length > 0) {
                Row() {
                  Text('已隐藏 ' + this.hiddenIds.length + ' 条（仅自己不可见）')
                    .fontSize(10)
                    .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                    .layoutWeight(1)
                  Text('全部恢复')
                    .fontSize(11)
                    .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
                    .onClick(() => {
                      this.restoreAll();
                    })
                }
                .width('100%')
                .padding({ left: 2, right: 2, top: 4, bottom: 4 })
              }

              if (this.mode() === 'longterm') {
                Row() {
                  Text(this.longtermList().length + ' 组')
                    .fontSize(11)
                    .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
                    .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
                  Blank()
                  Text('仅进行中的长期安排')
                    .fontSize(10)
                    .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                }
                .width('100%')
                .padding({ left: 2, right: 2, top: 8, bottom: 6 })
                if (this.longtermList().length === 0) {
                  this.emptyState('暂无长期安排', '长期安排到期后会自动归入已过期')
                } else {
                  ForEach(this.longtermList(), (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => {
                    this.longtermRow(card)
                  }, (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => 'lt_' + card.key + '_' + this.dataVersion)
                }
              } else {
                Row() {
                  Text(this.currentCards().length + ' 组')
                    .fontSize(11)
                    .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
                    .fontColor(NT_INK_2)
                  if (this.mode() === 'latest') {
                    Text('按发布时间倒序')
                      .fontSize(10)
                      .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                      .margin({ left: 8 })
                  } else if (this.mode() === 'active') {
                    Text('未过期默认展开')
                      .fontSize(10)
                      .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                      .margin({ left: 8 })
                  }
                  Blank()
                }
                .width('100%')
                .padding({ left: 2, right: 2, top: 8, bottom: 6 })

                if (this.currentCards().length > 0) {
                  ForEach(this.currentCards(), (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => {
                    this.noticeCard(card)
                  }, (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => card.key + '_' + (this.isDone(card.key) ? '1' : '0')
                    + '_' + (this.isExpanded(card.key) ? 'e' : 'c') + '_' + (card.hiddenLocal ? 'h' : 'v')
                    + '_' + this.dataVersion)
                }

                if (this.currentCards().length === 0 && this.filter === 'hidden') {
                  this.emptyState('没有已隐藏通知', '隐藏的通知会出现在这里，可恢复')
                } else if (this.currentCards().length === 0 && this.filter === 'expired') {
                  this.emptyState('没有已过期通知', '换个筛选看看')
                } else if (this.currentCards().length === 0 && this.mode() === 'latest') {
                  this.emptyState('暂无通知', '刷新试试')
                } else if (this.currentCards().length === 0 && this.mode() === 'urgent') {
                  this.emptyState('24 小时内没有待处理', '看看全部或 7 天内')
                } else if (this.currentCards().length === 0 && this.mode() === 'week') {
                  this.emptyState('7 天内没有待处理', '看看全部待处理')
                } else if (this.currentCards().length === 0 && this.filter === 'active') {
                  this.emptyState('没有待处理通知', '看看全部或已过期')
                } else if (this.currentCards().length === 0 && this.filter === 'all') {
                  this.emptyState('暂无通知', '刷新试试')
                }

                if (this.mode() === 'all' && this.infoCards().length > 0) {
                  this.sectionHeader('资料 / 无时间', this.infoCards().length, true, this.showInfo, () => {
                    this.showInfo = !this.showInfo;
                  })
                  if (this.showInfo) {
                    ForEach(this.infoCards(), (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => {
                      this.noticeCard(card)
                    }, (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => 'info_' + card.key + '_' + (this.isDone(card.key) ? '1' : '0')
                      + '_' + (this.isExpanded(card.key) ? 'e' : 'c') + '_' + this.dataVersion)
                  }
                }

                if (this.expiredCards().length > 0) {
                  this.sectionHeader('已过期', this.expiredCards().length, true, this.showExpired, () => {
                    this.showExpired = !this.showExpired;
                  })
                  if (this.showExpired) {
                    ForEach(this.expiredCards(), (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => {
                      this.noticeCard(card)
                    }, (card: NoticeCard, index: number) => 'exp_' + card.key + '_' + (this.isExpanded(card.key) ? 'e' : 'c')
                      + '_' + this.dataVersion)
                  }
                }
              }

              Blank().height(44)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ left: 14, right: 14, top: 4, bottom: 8 })
          }
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .align(Alignment.Top)
          .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
          .edgeEffect(EdgeEffect.Spring)
          .clip(true)
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .backgroundColor(NT_BG)

      if (this.rawOpen) {
        Column() {
          Column() {
            Row() {
              Text(this.rawTitle)
                .fontSize(14)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
                .fontColor(NT_INK)
                .layoutWeight(1)
                .maxLines(1)
                .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
              Text('关闭')
                .fontSize(11)
                .fontColor(NT_CY_INK)
                .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.closeRaw();
                })
            }
            .width('100%')
            .padding({ left: 16, right: 10, top: 12, bottom: 8 })
            Divider().color(NT_LINE)
            Scroll() {
              Column() {
                if (this.rawBody.length > 0) {
                  Text(this.rawBody)
                    .fontSize(12)
                    .fontColor(NT_INK)
                    .width('100%')
                }
                ForEach(this.rawBlocks, (block: NoticeItemMeta, index: number) => {
                  Column() {
                    Row({ space: 6 }) {
                      Text(block.label)
                        .fontSize(9)
                        .fontColor(NT_SD_INK)
                        .backgroundColor(NT_SD_TINT)
                        .borderRadius(4)
                        .padding({ left: 4, right: 4, top: 1, bottom: 1 })
                      if (block.fromName.length > 0) {
                        Text(block.fromName)
                          .fontSize(9)
                          .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                      }
                      if (block.timeText.length > 0) {
                        Text(block.timeText)
                          .fontSize(9)
                          .fontColor(NT_INK_3)
                      }
                    }
                    .width('100%')
                    Text(block.text)
                      .fontSize(12)
                      .fontColor(NT_INK)
                      .width('100%')
                      .margin({ top: 4 })
                  }
                  .width('100%')
                  .padding({ top: 10, bottom: 10 })
                  .border({ width: { bottom: 1 }, color: NT_LINE })
                }, (block: NoticeItemMeta, index: number) => 'raw_' + index)
                Blank().height(20)
              }
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ left: 16, right: 16, top: 6 })
            }
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .align(Alignment.Top)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .height('68%')
          .backgroundColor(NT_CARD)
          .borderRadius({ topLeft: 18, topRight: 18 })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#66000000')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.End)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.closeRaw();
        })
        .transition(Motion.scrim())
      }

      if (this.previewOpen) {
        Stack() {
          Column()
            .width('100%')
            .height('100%')
            .backgroundColor('#E6000000')
            .onClick(() => {
              this.closePreview();
            })
          Image(this.previewSrc)
            .width('100%')
            .height('100%')
            .objectFit(ImageFit.Contain)
            .hitTestBehavior(HitTestMode.None)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .transition(Motion.scrim())
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
  }
}
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { Blob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import {
  PowerPoint,
  PowerCompare,
  SlowEstimate,
  PowerEstimate,
  PowerRange,
  PowerRangeKey,
  PowerRooms,
  PowerRow,
  PowerStats,
  RangeStats,
  RoomInfo
} from '../../data/power/PowerModels';
import { PowerHistoryResult, PowerRepository, PowerRowResult } from '../../data/power/PowerRepository';
import { PowerPrefs, PowerPrefsData } from '../../data/power/PowerPrefs';
import { PowerNotifier } from '../../data/power/PowerNotifier';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { PageHeader } from '../components/PageHeader';

/**
 * 电费工具：宿舍选择（17 间，4 楼栋）+ 剩余电量 + 24h/7d/30d 趋势 + 区间统计 + 低电阈值。
 *
 * 口径：关注宿舍/阈值写 `userdata.power={sel,at,low}`（v6 整段 LWW）；
 * 13/16 号楼为网关日更，隐藏 24h 档并默认 7 天（与网页 §4b-34 一致）。
 */
@Component
export struct PowerScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private sel: string = '';
  @State private low: number = PowerStats.defaultLow();
  @State private row: PowerRow | undefined = undefined;
  @State private points: PowerPoint[] = [];
  @State private stats: RangeStats = new RangeStats();
  @State private rangeKey: string = PowerRangeKey.D7;
  @State private loading: boolean = false;
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private picking: boolean = true;
  @State private pickBuilding: string = '13号楼';
  @State private chartW: number = 0;
  @State private chartH: number = 170;
  @State private comparePoints: PowerPoint[] = [];
  @State private compare: PowerCompare = new PowerCompare();
  @State private slow: SlowEstimate = new SlowEstimate();
  @State private estimate: PowerEstimate = new PowerEstimate();
  @State private estimateDays: number = 0;
  @State private cursor: number = -1;
  @State private cursorText: string = '';
  @State private now: number = Date.now();

  private ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D = new CanvasRenderingContext2D(new RenderingContextSettings(true));

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    const prefs: PowerPrefsData = PowerPrefs.read(Services.userdata.currentSections());
    this.low = prefs.low;
    this.sel = prefs.sel;
    if (this.sel.length > 0) {
      this.picking = false;
      this.pickBuilding = PowerRooms.buildingOf(this.sel);
      this.rangeKey = PowerRooms.isSlowBuilding(this.pickBuilding) ? PowerRangeKey.D7 : PowerRangeKey.H24;
      this.load(false);
    }
  }

  private range(): PowerRange {
    return PowerRange.fromKey(this.rangeKey);
  }

  private async load(force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    if (this.sel.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.loading = true;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.now = Date.now();
    const rowResult: PowerRowResult = await Services.power.loadRow(this.sel, force);
    this.row = rowResult.row;
    if (!rowResult.ok) {
      this.errorMsg = rowResult.message;
    } else if (rowResult.message.length > 0) {
      this.errorMsg = rowResult.message;
    }
    const historyResult: PowerHistoryResult = await Services.power.loadHistory(this.sel, this.range(), force);
    this.points = historyResult.points;
    this.stats = PowerStats.deriveRange(this.points, this.range(), this.now);
    this.cursor = -1;
    this.cursorText = '';
    await this.refreshCompare(force);
    if (rowResult.row !== undefined && PowerPrefs.isLow(rowResult.row.q, rowResult.row.hasValue, this.low)) {
      PowerNotifier.notifyIfLow(PowerRooms.labelOf(this.sel), rowResult.row.q, this.low);
    }
    if (!historyResult.ok && this.errorMsg.length === 0) {
      this.errorMsg = historyResult.message;
    }
    this.loading = false;
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.drawChart();
    }, 60);
  }

  private async savePrefs(sel: string, low: number): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = PowerPrefs.write(current, sel, low, Date.now());
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
  }

  private pickRoom(rv: string): void {
    this.sel = rv;
    this.picking = false;
    this.pickBuilding = PowerRooms.buildingOf(rv);
    this.rangeKey = PowerRooms.isSlowBuilding(this.pickBuilding) ? PowerRangeKey.D7 : PowerRangeKey.H24;
    this.row = undefined;
    this.points = [];
    this.stats = new RangeStats();
    this.savePrefs(rv, this.low);
    this.load(false);
  }

  private rechargePoints(): PowerPoint[] {
    return PowerStats.recharges(PowerStats.windowPoints(this.points, this.range(), this.now));
  }

  private compareWindowMs(): number {
    if (this.rangeKey === PowerRangeKey.H24) {
      return 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    }
    if (this.rangeKey === PowerRangeKey.D7) {
      return 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    }
    return 70 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  }

  private async refreshCompare(force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const windowResult: PowerHistoryResult = await Services.power.loadHistoryWindow(this.sel,
      this.compareWindowMs(), force);
    this.comparePoints = windowResult.points;
    this.compare = PowerStats.compare(this.comparePoints, this.range(), this.now);
    this.slow = new SlowEstimate();
    if (PowerRooms.isSlowBuilding(PowerRooms.buildingOf(this.sel)) && this.rangeKey !== PowerRangeKey.H24) {
      this.slow = PowerStats.slowEstimate(this.comparePoints);
    }
    const estPoints: PowerPoint[] = this.comparePoints.length > 1 ? this.comparePoints : this.points;
    this.estimate = PowerStats.estimate(estPoints);
    this.estimateDays = this.hasValue() ? PowerStats.daysLeft(this.quantity(), this.estimate.ratePerDay) : 0;
  }

  private async onRange(key: string): Promise<void> {
    this.rangeKey = key;
    this.cursor = -1;
    this.cursorText = '';
    const result: PowerHistoryResult = await Services.power.loadHistory(this.sel, this.range(), false);
    this.points = result.points;
    this.now = Date.now();
    this.stats = PowerStats.deriveRange(this.points, this.range(), this.now);
    await this.refreshCompare(false);
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.drawChart();
    }, 40);
  }

  private onLow(value: number): void {
    this.low = PowerStats.normalizeLow(value);
    this.savePrefs(this.sel, this.low);
  }

  private updatedText(): string {
    if (this.row === undefined || this.row.updatedAt.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const stamp: number = Date.parse(this.row.updatedAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(stamp)) {
      return this.row.updatedAt;
    }
    const d: Date = new Date(stamp);
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate()) + ' ' + pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
  }

  private hasValue(): boolean {
    return this.row !== undefined && this.row.hasValue;
  }

  private quantity(): number {
    return this.row !== undefined ? this.row.q : 0;
  }

  private isLow(): boolean {
    return PowerPrefs.isLow(this.quantity(), this.hasValue(), this.low);
  }

  private rangeChips(): PowerRange[] {
    const slow: boolean = PowerRooms.isSlowBuilding(PowerRooms.buildingOf(this.sel));
    const out: PowerRange[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < PowerRange.ALL.length; i++) {
      const range: PowerRange = PowerRange.ALL[i];
      if (slow && range.key === PowerRangeKey.H24) {
        continue;
      }
      out.push(range);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** 趋势绘制（Canvas，单位 vp）。 */
  private drawChart(): void {
    const w: number = this.chartW > 0 ? this.chartW : 320;
    const h: number = this.chartH;
    this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const view: PowerPoint[] = PowerStats.windowPoints(this.points, this.range(), this.now);
    if (view.length < 2) {
      this.ctx.fillStyle = Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY;
      this.ctx.font = '12vp sans-serif';
      this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      this.ctx.fillText('暂无趋势数据', w / 2, h / 2);
      return;
    }
    let minQ: number = view[0].q;
    let maxQ: number = view[0].q;
    for (let i = 1; i < view.length; i++) {
      minQ = Math.min(minQ, view[i].q);
      maxQ = Math.max(maxQ, view[i].q);
    }
    if (maxQ - minQ < 0.01) {
      maxQ = minQ + 0.01;
    }
    const padLeft: number = 34;
    const padRight: number = 8;
    const padTop: number = 8;
    const padBottom: number = 18;
    const plotW: number = w - padLeft - padRight;
    const plotH: number = h - padTop - padBottom;
    const t0: number = view[0].t;
    const t1: number = view[view.length - 1].t;
    const span: number = Math.max(1, t1 - t0);
    const xOf = (t: number): number => padLeft + (t - t0) / span * plotW;
    const yOf = (q: number): number => padTop + (1 - (q - minQ) / (maxQ - minQ)) * plotH;

    // 坐标轴与网格
    this.ctx.strokeStyle = Tokens.DIVIDER;
    this.ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
    this.ctx.beginPath();
    this.ctx.moveTo(padLeft, padTop);
    this.ctx.lineTo(padLeft, padTop + plotH);
    this.ctx.lineTo(padLeft + plotW, padTop + plotH);
    this.ctx.stroke();

    // 折线
    this.ctx.strokeStyle = Tokens.MIST_TEAL;
    this.ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    this.ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < view.length; i++) {
      const px: number = xOf(view[i].t);
      const py: number = yOf(view[i].q);
      if (i === 0) {
        this.ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      } else {
        this.ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
    }
    this.ctx.stroke();

    // 最后一点
    const last: PowerPoint = view[view.length - 1];
    this.ctx.fillStyle = Tokens.MIST_TEAL;
    this.ctx.beginPath();
    this.ctx.arc(xOf(last.t), yOf(last.q), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    this.ctx.fill();

    // 充值/上调事件标记
    const rises: PowerPoint[] = PowerStats.recharges(view);
    this.ctx.fillStyle = Tokens.WARM_SAND;
