            this.selectChip('多选', this.fMulti, 'multi', '1')
            if (this.fMulti) {
              Text('最多选')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                .margin({ left: 6 })
              Text(this.fMax + ' 项')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
                .padding({ left: 8, right: 8 })
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.fMax = this.fMax >= 5 ? 2 : this.fMax + 1;
                })
            }
            Blank()
          }
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6 })

          Row({ space: 6 }) {
            this.selectChip('匿名', this.fAnonymous, 'anon', '1')
            this.selectChip('实名', !this.fAnonymous, 'anon', '0')
            this.selectChip(this.fAllowChange ? '可改票' : '不可改票', true, 'change', '1')
            Blank()
          }
          .width('100%')

          Text('结果可见性')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 10 })

          Row({ space: 6 }) {
            this.selectChip('始终', this.fVisibility === PollResultVisibility.ALWAYS, 'visibility', PollResultVisibility.ALWAYS)
            this.selectChip('投票后', this.fVisibility === PollResultVisibility.AFTER_VOTE, 'visibility', PollResultVisibility.AFTER_VOTE)
            this.selectChip('截止后', this.fVisibility === PollResultVisibility.AFTER_CLOSE, 'visibility', PollResultVisibility.AFTER_CLOSE)
            Blank()
          }
          .width('100%')

          Text('可见范围')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 10 })

          Row({ space: 6 }) {
            this.selectChip('全班', this.fAudience === PollAudience.ALL, 'audience', PollAudience.ALL)
            this.selectChip('班委', this.fAudience === PollAudience.COMMITTEE, 'audience', PollAudience.COMMITTEE)
            this.selectChip('团员', this.fAudience === PollAudience.LEAGUE, 'audience', PollAudience.LEAGUE)
            this.selectChip('指定成员', this.fAudience === PollAudience.CUSTOM, 'audience', PollAudience.CUSTOM)
            Blank()
          }
          .width('100%')

          if (this.fAudience === PollAudience.CUSTOM) {
            Row() {
              Text('已选 ' + this.fSeats.length + ' 人')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
              Blank()
              Text('清空')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.fSeats = [];
                })
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 6 })

            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap }) {
              ForEach(this.members, (member: ClassMember) => {
                Text(member.name)
                  .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                  .fontColor(this.fSeats.indexOf(member.seat) >= 0 ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
                  .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 4, bottom: 4 })
                  .margin({ right: 6, bottom: 6 })
                  .backgroundColor(this.fSeats.indexOf(member.seat) >= 0 ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.BG)
                  .borderRadius(8)
                  .onClick(() => {
                    this.toggleSeat(member.seat);
                  })
              }, (member: ClassMember) => 'seat_' + member.seat + (this.fSeats.indexOf(member.seat) >= 0 ? '_y' : '_n'))
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4 })
          }

          Text('时长')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 10 })

          Row({ space: 6 }) {
            this.selectChip('30 分钟', this.fMinutes === 30, 'minutes', '30')
            this.selectChip('2 小时', this.fMinutes === 120, 'minutes', '120')
            this.selectChip('1 天', this.fMinutes === 1440, 'minutes', '1440')
            this.selectChip('不限时', this.fMinutes === 0, 'minutes', '0')
            Blank()
          }
          .width('100%')

          if (this.fError.length > 0) {
            Text(this.fError)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 8 })
          }

          Button(this.busy ? '提交中…' : '发起')
            .width('100%')
            .height(44)
            .margin({ top: 12 })
            .enabled(!this.busy)
            .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
            .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
            .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.createPoll();
            })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ bottom: 12 })
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .align(Alignment.Top)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('92%')
    .padding(16)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .transition(TransitionEffect.asymmetric(Motion.sheetEnter(), Motion.sheetExit()))
  }

  build() {
    Stack() {
      Column() {
        PageHeader({
          title: '投票',
          actionText: '发起',
          onBack: () => {
            this.onClose();
          },
          onAction: () => {
            this.openCreate();
          }
        })

        Row({ space: 8 }) {
          this.selectChip('进行中', !this.showClosed, 'tab', '0')
          this.selectChip('已结束', this.showClosed, 'tab', '1')
          Blank()
          Text('刷新')
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
            .onClick(() => {
              this.reload();
            })
        }
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING })

        if (this.loading) {
          Column() {
            LoadingProgress().width(32).height(32).color(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          }
          .width('100%')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
        } else {
          if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
            Text(this.errorMsg)
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
              .width('100%')
              .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, top: 8 })
          }
          if (this.visiblePolls().length === 0) {
            Text(this.showClosed ? '暂无已结束投票' : '暂无进行中投票')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
              .width('100%')
              .layoutWeight(1)
              .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          } else {
            List({ space: 10 }) {
              ForEach(this.visiblePolls(), (poll: PollSummary) => {
                ListItem() {
                  this.pollCard(poll)
                }
              }, (poll: PollSummary) => poll.id + '_' + poll.total + '_' + (poll.hasVoted ? 'y' : 'n'))
            }
            .width('100%')
            .layoutWeight(1)
            .margin({ top: 10 })
            .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING })
            .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
          }
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)

      if (this.detailOpen) {
        Column() {
          this.detailPanel()
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#66000000')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.End)
        .padding({ left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0 })
        .transition(Motion.scrim())
        .animation({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() })
      }
      if (this.createOpen) {
        Column() {
          this.createPanel()
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#66000000')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.End)
        .transition(Motion.scrim())
        .animation({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() })
      }

      if (this.extendOpen) {
        Column() {
          Column() {
            Row() {
              Text('延长截止')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              Blank()
              Text('关闭')
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
                .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.getUIContext().animateTo({ duration: Motion.FAST, curve: Motion.ease() }, () => {
                    this.extendOpen = false;
                  });
                })
            }
            .width('100%')
            Row({ space: 6 }) {
              this.selectChip('30 分钟', this.extendMinutes === 30, 'extend', '30')
              this.selectChip('2 小时', this.extendMinutes === 120, 'extend', '120')
              this.selectChip('1 天', this.extendMinutes === 1440, 'extend', '1440')
              Blank()
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 10 })
            Text('新截止：' + VoteLogic.formatAt(Date.now() + this.extendMinutes * 60 * 1000))
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: 4 })
            Button('确认延长')
              .width('100%')
              .height(42)
              .margin({ top: 10 })
              .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
              .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
              .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
              .onClick(() => {
                this.confirmExtend();
              })
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding(18)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
          .borderRadius({ topLeft: Tokens.RADIUS_CARD, topRight: Tokens.RADIUS_CARD })
          .transition(TransitionEffect.asymmetric(Motion.sheetEnter(), Motion.sheetExit()))
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#66000000')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.End)
        .transition(Motion.scrim())
        .animation({ duration: Motion.NORMAL, curve: Motion.ease() })
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
  }
}
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../../data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { PowerRooms, RoomInfo } from '../../data/power/PowerModels';
import {
  WaterMonthStats,
  WaterRecord,
  WaterRecordReview,
  WaterRoomState,
  WaterRules,
  WaterState
} from '../../features/water/WaterModels';
import { WaterCalculator } from '../../features/water/WaterCalculator';
import { WaterCodec } from '../../features/water/WaterCodec';
import { WaterMonth } from '../../features/water/WaterMonth';
import { WaterMutator } from '../../features/water/WaterMutator';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';
import { PageHeader } from '../components/PageHeader';

/**
 * 水量工具：4/6 人间 + 按月抄表（读数 → 用量/水费/折合扣电）+ 记录列表 + 规则卡。
 *
 * 数据：`userdata.water = { rooms: { <roomverify>: { p, recs:[{m,r,ts}] } } }`（整段 LWW）。
 * 口径：水 3.03 元/吨、免费 2 吨/人/月、折合扣电 = 水费 ÷ 0.58；无上一条不伪造用量。
 */
@Component
export struct WaterScreen {
  onClose: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private sel: string = '';
  @State private state: WaterState = new WaterState();
  @State private persons: number = WaterRules.PERSONS_DEFAULT;
  @State private monthText: string = '';
  @State private readingText: string = '';
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private notice: string = '';
  @State private confirmReplace: boolean = false;
  @State private picking: boolean = true;
  @State private pickBuilding: string = '13号楼';
  @State private now: number = Date.now();

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.now = Date.now();
    this.monthText = WaterMonth.current(this.now);
    const sections: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    this.state = WaterCodec.fromJson(JsonBlob.get(sections, 'water'));
    const keys: string[] = [];
    this.state.rooms.forEach((room: WaterRoomState, key: string) => {
      keys.push(key);
    });
    if (keys.length > 0) {
      this.sel = keys[0];
      this.picking = false;
      this.pickBuilding = PowerRooms.buildingOf(this.sel);
      this.persons = this.state.roomOrDefault(this.sel).persons;
    }
  }

  private roomLabel(): string {
    return this.sel.length > 0 ? PowerRooms.labelOf(this.sel) : '';
  }

  private roomState(): WaterRoomState {
    return this.state.roomOrDefault(this.sel);
  }

  private stats(): WaterMonthStats {
    return WaterCalculator.stats(this.roomState(), this.monthText, this.now);
  }

  private async persist(): Promise<void> {
    const current: Blob = Services.userdata.currentSections();
    const next: Blob = {};
    const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
    }
    next['water'] = WaterCodec.toJson(this.state);
    await Services.userdata.updateCurrent(next);
  }

  private pickRoom(rv: string): void {
    this.sel = rv;
    this.picking = false;
    this.pickBuilding = PowerRooms.buildingOf(rv);
    this.persons = this.state.roomOrDefault(rv).persons;
    this.confirmReplace = false;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    this.notice = '';
    this.monthText = WaterMonth.current(this.now);
  }

  private async onPersons(value: number): Promise<void> {
    this.persons = WaterCodec.normalizePersons(value);
    this.state = WaterMutator.withPersons(this.state, this.sel, this.persons);
    await this.persist();
  }

  private async saveRecord(): Promise<void> {
    this.errorMsg = '';
    if (this.sel.length === 0) {
      this.errorMsg = '请先选择宿舍';
      return;
    }
    const room: WaterRoomState = this.roomState();
    const review: WaterRecordReview = WaterMutator.review(room, this.monthText, this.readingText, Date.now());
    if (!review.valid) {
      this.errorMsg = review.message;
      this.confirmReplace = false;
      return;
    }
    if (review.replaceExisting && !this.confirmReplace) {
      this.confirmReplace = true;
      this.notice = '该月已有记录，再点一次「保存」覆盖';
      return;
    }
    const record: WaterRecord = review.record as WaterRecord;
    this.state = WaterMutator.put(this.state, this.sel, WaterRecordCopy(record));
    await this.persist();
    this.confirmReplace = false;
    this.readingText = '';
    this.notice = record.month + ' 已保存（' + record.reading.toFixed(2) + ' 吨）';
  }

  private async deleteRecord(month: string): Promise<void> {
    this.state = WaterMutator.delete(this.state, this.sel, month);
    await this.persist();
    this.notice = month + ' 记录已删除';
    this.confirmReplace = false;
  }

  @Builder
  buildingChip(building: string) {
    Text(building)
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.pickBuilding === building ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 12, right: 12, top: 7, bottom: 7 })
      .backgroundColor(this.pickBuilding === building ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.CARD)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.pickBuilding = building;
      })
  }

  @Builder
  roomTile(info: RoomInfo) {
    Column() {
      Text(info.room)
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(this.sel === info.rv ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
      Text(this.state.rooms.has(info.rv) ? '已录入' : '未录入')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(this.sel === info.rv ? '#E8F2EF' : Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .margin({ top: 2 })
    }
    .width('31%')
    .padding({ top: 12, bottom: 12 })
    .margin({ bottom: 8 })
    .backgroundColor(this.sel === info.rv ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .onClick(() => {
      this.pickRoom(info.rv);
    })
  }

  @Builder
  personsChip(value: number) {
    Text(value + ' 人间')
      .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
      .fontColor(this.persons === value ? '#FFFFFF' : Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
      .padding({ left: 14, right: 14, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
      .backgroundColor(this.persons === value ? Tokens.SLATE_BLUE : Tokens.BG)
      .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
      .margin({ right: 8 })
      .onClick(() => {
        this.onPersons(value);
      })
  }

  @Builder
  statTile(kind: string) {
    Column() {
      Text(this.statValue(kind))
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_TITLE)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
      Text(this.statLabel(kind))
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .margin({ top: 2 })
    }
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
    .layoutWeight(1)
  }

  private statValue(kind: string): string {
    const stats: WaterMonthStats = this.stats();
    if (kind === 'usage') {
      return WaterCalculator.fmtReading(stats.charge.usage, stats.charge.hasUsage);
    }
    if (kind === 'fee') {
      return WaterCalculator.fmtMoney(stats.charge.fee, stats.charge.hasUsage);
    }
    return WaterCalculator.fmtDegree(stats.charge.degree, stats.charge.hasUsage);
  }

  private statLabel(kind: string): string {
    if (kind === 'usage') {
      return '用量（吨）';
    }
    if (kind === 'fee') {
      return '水费（元）';
    }
    return '折合扣电（度）';
  }

  @Builder
  recordRow(record: WaterRecord) {
    Row() {
      Column() {
        Text(record.month)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Text('读数 ' + record.reading.toFixed(2) + ' 吨')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .margin({ top: 2 })
      }
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
      .layoutWeight(1)

      Column() {
        Text(this.rowUsage(record))
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
        Text(this.rowFee(record))
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .margin({ top: 2 })
      }
      .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.End)

      Text('删除')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
        .padding({ left: 12, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
        .onClick(() => {
          this.deleteRecord(record.month);
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding({ top: 8, bottom: 8 })
  }

  private rowUsage(record: WaterRecord): string {
    const charge = WaterCalculator.charge(this.roomState(), record, this.persons);
    return charge.hasUsage ? '用量 ' + charge.usage.toFixed(2) + ' 吨' : '首条';
  }

  private rowFee(record: WaterRecord): string {
    const charge = WaterCalculator.charge(this.roomState(), record, this.persons);
    if (!charge.hasUsage) {
      return '—';
    }
    return '水费 ' + charge.fee.toFixed(2) + ' 元 · ' + charge.degree.toFixed(1) + ' 度';
  }

  @Builder
  entryCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('抄表录入')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text(this.roomLabel())
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Row({ space: 8 }) {
        Text('上月')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
          .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
          .onClick(() => {
            this.monthText = WaterMonth.shift(WaterMonth.current(Date.now()), -1);
            this.confirmReplace = false;
          })
        Text('本月')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
          .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
          .onClick(() => {
            this.monthText = WaterMonth.current(Date.now());
            this.confirmReplace = false;
          })
        Text('下月')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.SLATE_BLUE)
          .padding({ left: 8, right: 8, top: 6, bottom: 6 })
          .onClick(() => {
            this.monthText = WaterMonth.shift(WaterMonth.current(Date.now()), 1);
            this.confirmReplace = false;
          })
        Blank()
        Text('当前 ' + this.monthText)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 6 })

      Row({ space: 8 }) {
        TextInput({ text: this.monthText, placeholder: 'YYYY-MM' })
          .height(40)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
          .borderRadius(8)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
          .onChange((text: string) => {
            this.monthText = text;
            this.confirmReplace = false;
            this.errorMsg = '';
          })
        TextInput({ text: this.readingText, placeholder: '读数（吨）' })
          .type(InputType.NUMBER_DECIMAL)
          .height(40)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
          .borderRadius(8)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_BODY)
          .onChange((text: string) => {
            this.readingText = text;
            this.confirmReplace = false;
            this.errorMsg = '';
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 10 })

      if (this.errorMsg.length > 0) {
        Text(this.errorMsg)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.DANGER)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6 })
      }
      if (this.notice.length > 0) {
        Text(this.notice)
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(this.confirmReplace ? Tokens.WARM_SAND : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 6 })
      }

      Button(this.confirmReplace ? '确认覆盖' : '保存')
        .width('100%')
        .height(44)
        .margin({ top: 10 })
        .backgroundColor(this.confirmReplace ? Tokens.WARM_SAND : Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
        .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
        .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.saveRecord();
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  @Builder
  statsCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text(this.stats().month + ' 统计')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text('免费 ' + this.stats().charge.free.toFixed(1) + ' 吨')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')

      Row() {
        this.statTile('usage')
        this.statTile('fee')
        this.statTile('degree')
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: 10 })

      Text(this.statsSubText())
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 8 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .margin({ top: 12 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  private statsSubText(): string {
    const stats: WaterMonthStats = this.stats();
    if (!stats.charge.hasUsage) {
      return stats.record === undefined ? '本月还没有记录；录入首条后次月可算用量' : '首条记录：下一条起可算用量';
    }
    const parts: string[] = [];
    parts.push('日均 ' + (stats.hasDailyAverage ? stats.dailyAverage.toFixed(2) : '—') + ' 吨');
    if (stats.charge.within) {
      parts.push('定额内');
    } else {
      parts.push('超出 ' + stats.charge.excess.toFixed(2) + ' 吨');
    }
    if (stats.hasDelta) {
      parts.push((stats.deltaVsPreviousMonth >= 0 ? '较上月 +' : '较上月 ') + stats.deltaVsPreviousMonth.toFixed(2) + ' 吨');
    }
    return parts.join(' · ');
  }

  @Builder
  recordsCard() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text('记录')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        Blank()
        Text(this.roomState().records.length + ' 条')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
      }
      .width('100%')

      if (this.roomState().records.length === 0) {
        Text('暂无记录')
          .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
          .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
          .width('100%')
          .margin({ top: 8 })
      } else {
        ForEach(this.recentRecords(), (record: WaterRecord) => {
          this.recordRow(record)
        }, (record: WaterRecord) => record.month + '_' + record.reading)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .margin({ top: 12 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  private recentRecords(): WaterRecord[] {
    const all: WaterRecord[] = this.roomState().records;
    const out: WaterRecord[] = [];
    const start: number = all.length > 12 ? all.length - 12 : 0;
    for (let i = all.length - 1; i >= start; i--) {
      out.push(all[i]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  @Builder
  rulesCard() {
    Column() {
      Text('计费规则')
        .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
        .width('100%')

      ForEach(WaterCalculator.ruleLines(this.persons), (line: string[]) => {
        Row() {
          Text(line[0])
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_TERTIARY)
            .width(72)
          Text(line[1])
            .fontSize(Tokens.F_CAPTION)
            .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .layoutWeight(1)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .margin({ top: 4 })
      }, (line: string[]) => line[0] + line[1])
    }
    .width('100%')
    .padding(16)
    .margin({ top: 12 })
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
    .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_CARD)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      PageHeader({
        title: '水量',
        actionText: this.picking ? '' : '切换',
        onBack: () => {
          this.onClose();
        },
        onAction: () => {
          this.picking = true;
        }
      })

      if (this.picking) {
        Scroll() {
          Column() {
            Text('选择宿舍')
              .fontSize(Tokens.F_LABEL)
              .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
              .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              .width('100%')

            Row() {
              ForEach(PowerRooms.BUILDINGS, (building: string) => {
                this.buildingChip(building)
              }, (building: string) => building)
              Blank()
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 10 })

            Flex({ wrap: FlexWrap.Wrap, justifyContent: FlexAlign.SpaceBetween }) {
              ForEach(PowerRooms.roomsOfBuilding(this.pickBuilding), (info: RoomInfo) => {
                this.roomTile(info)
              }, (info: RoomInfo) => info.rv + '_' + (this.state.rooms.has(info.rv) ? 'y' : 'n'))
              if (PowerRooms.roomsOfBuilding(this.pickBuilding).length % 3 === 1) {
                Blank().width('31%')
                Blank().width('31%')
              } else if (PowerRooms.roomsOfBuilding(this.pickBuilding).length % 3 === 2) {
                Blank().width('31%')
              }
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 10 })

            if (this.sel.length > 0) {
              Button('返回水量')
                .width('100%')
                .height(44)
                .margin({ top: 12 })
                .backgroundColor(Tokens.CARD)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_SECONDARY)
                .borderRadius(Tokens.RADIUS_PILL)
                .onClick(() => {
                  this.picking = false;
                })
            }
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 24 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .align(Alignment.Top)
        .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
      } else {
        Scroll() {
          Column() {
            Row() {
              Text(this.roomLabel())
                .fontSize(Tokens.F_TITLE)
                .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
                .fontColor(Tokens.TEXT_PRIMARY)
              Blank()
              this.personsChip(4)
              this.personsChip(6)
            }
            .width('100%')
            .margin({ top: 4 })

            this.entryCard()
            this.statsCard()
            this.recordsCard()
            this.rulesCard()
          }
          .width('100%')
          .padding({ left: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, right: Tokens.PAGE_PADDING, bottom: 24 })
        }
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .align(Alignment.Top)
        .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor(Tokens.BG)
  }
}

/** 记录深拷贝（避免 Put 后状态引用共享）。 */
function WaterRecordCopy(record: WaterRecord): WaterRecord {
  const copy: WaterRecord = new WaterRecord();
  copy.month = record.month;
  copy.reading = record.reading;
  copy.ts = record.ts;
  return copy;
}
import { common } from '@kit.AbilityKit';
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { AccountBindingRepository, HwLoginResult } from '../../data/account/AccountBindingRepository';
import { HuaweiAccount } from '../../data/account/HuaweiAccount';
import { Session } from '../../data/session/Session';
import { VerifyResult } from '../../data/auth/AuthRepository';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';

/** 手表登录：优先华为账号（已绑定学号），保留学号+姓名兜底；圆屏按窗口尺寸自适应。 */
@Component
export struct WatchLogin {
  @Prop notice: string = '';
  onSignedIn: (session: Session) => void = () => {
  };

  @State private sid: string = '';
  @State private name: string = '';
  @State private errorMsg: string = '';
  @State private busy: boolean = false;
  @State private hwBusy: boolean = false;
  @State private screenH: number = 400;

  private px(base: number): number {
    const h: number = this.screenH > 0 ? this.screenH : 400;
    const factor: number = Math.max(0.82, Math.min(1.15, h / 400));
    return Math.round(base * factor);
  }

  private async huaweiLogin(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.hwBusy) {
      return;
    }
    this.hwBusy = true;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    try {
      const context = this.getUIContext().getHostContext() as common.Context;
      const openId: string = await HuaweiAccount.openId(context);
      const result: HwLoginResult = await AccountBindingRepository.login(openId);
      if (result.session !== undefined) {
        this.onSignedIn(result.session as Session);
      } else {
        this.errorMsg = result.reason.length > 0 ? result.reason : '该华为账号尚未绑定学号';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.errorMsg = HuaweiAccount.message(e as Object);
    }
    this.hwBusy = false;
  }

  private async submit(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.busy) {
      return;
    }
    this.busy = true;
    this.errorMsg = '';
    const result: VerifyResult = await Services.auth.verify(this.sid, this.name);
    this.busy = false;
    if (result.ok && result.session !== undefined) {
      this.onSignedIn(result.session as Session);
    } else {
      this.errorMsg = result.message;
    }
  }

  build() {
    Scroll() {
      Column({ space: this.px(4) }) {
        Text('枫丹工具箱')
          .fontSize(this.px(16))
          .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .maxLines(1)

        Button(this.hwBusy ? '华为账号验证中…' : '华为账号登录')
          .width('100%')
          .height(this.px(34))
          .fontSize(this.px(13))
          .backgroundColor(Tokens.MIST_TEAL)
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(this.px(17))
          .enabled(!this.hwBusy)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.huaweiLogin();
          })

        Text('或 学号 + 姓名')
          .fontSize(this.px(10))
          .fontColor('#6E747A')
          .margin({ top: this.px(1) })

        TextInput({ text: this.sid, placeholder: '10 位学号' })
          .type(InputType.Number)
          .maxLength(10)
          .height(this.px(38))
          .width('100%')
          .fontSize(this.px(12))
          .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 0, bottom: 0 })
          .backgroundColor('#1C1C1E')
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(this.px(8))
          .onChange((v: string) => {
            this.sid = v;
          })
        TextInput({ text: this.name, placeholder: '姓名' })
          .height(this.px(38))
          .width('100%')
          .fontSize(this.px(12))
          .padding({ left: 10, right: 10, top: 0, bottom: 0 })
          .backgroundColor('#1C1C1E')
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(this.px(8))
          .onChange((v: string) => {
            this.name = v;
          })

        if (this.errorMsg.length > 0 || this.notice.length > 0) {
          Text(this.errorMsg.length > 0 ? this.errorMsg : this.notice)
            .fontSize(this.px(10))
            .fontColor(this.errorMsg.length > 0 ? '#E8A87C' : '#9AA0A6')
            .maxLines(2)
            .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        }

        Button(this.busy ? '验证中…' : '用学号进入')
          .width('100%')
          .height(this.px(32))
          .fontSize(this.px(12))
          .backgroundColor('#2A2D31')
          .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
          .borderRadius(this.px(16))
          .enabled(!this.busy)
          .onClick(() => {
            this.submit();
          })

        Text('在手表上输入较慢，建议先用手机完成身份验证')
          .fontSize(this.px(8))
          .fontColor('#5A5F63')
          .maxLines(2)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .margin({ top: this.px(1) })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ left: this.px(24), right: this.px(24), top: this.px(14), bottom: this.px(14) })
      .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor('#000000')
    .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
    .expandSafeArea([SafeAreaType.SYSTEM], [SafeAreaEdge.TOP, SafeAreaEdge.BOTTOM])
    .onAreaChange((oldValue: Area, newValue: Area) => {
      const h: number = Number(newValue.height);
      if (h > 0 && Math.abs(h - this.screenH) > 1) {
        this.screenH = h;
      }
    })
  }
}
import { vibrator } from '@kit.SensorServiceKit';
import { Services } from '../../app/Services';
import { MarkKind } from '../../data/marks/Marks';
import { MarksUpdateResult } from '../../data/marks/MarksRepository';
import { HomeworkResult } from '../../data/homework/HomeworkRepository';
import {
  HomeworkDue,
  HomeworkDueCalculator,
  HomeworkDueTone,
  HomeworkRow
} from '../../data/homework/HomeworkModels';
import { NoticeCard, NoticeCards } from '../../features/notices/NoticeCards';
import { NoticesResult } from '../../data/notices/NoticesRepository';
import { PowerPrefs, PowerPrefsData } from '../../data/power/PowerPrefs';
import { PowerPoint, PowerEstimate, PowerRange, PowerRooms, PowerRow, PowerStats, RangeStats } from '../../data/power/PowerModels';
import { PowerHistoryResult, PowerRowResult } from '../../data/power/PowerRepository';
import { SessionInfo, SessionState, TtPlan } from '../../data/timetable/TimetableModels';
import { TtCalendar } from '../../data/timetable/TtCalendar';
import { TtResult } from '../../data/timetable/TimetableRepository';
import { HomeDigest } from '../../features/home/HomeDigest';
import { WatchLogic } from '../../features/watch/WatchLogic';
import { Tokens } from '../theme/Tokens';

/** 手表作业行（轻量展示模型）。 */
class WatchHwItem {
  id: string = '';
  title: string = '';
  sub: string = '';
  tone: string = 'neutral';
}

/** 手表通知行（轻量展示模型）。 */
class WatchNtItem {
  key: string = '';
  title: string = '';
  sub: string = '';
  urgent: boolean = false;
}

/**
 * 手表端：5 屏（今日 / 作业 / 通知 / 电费 / 更多）。
 *
 * 操作贴合手表：左右滑动或转动表冠翻页；列表内表冠滚动；
 * 作业点按即完成、通知点按看详情；长按任意处打开操作菜单（刷新 / 退出）。
 * UI：深色圆屏、大字号、环形进度、底部圆点与一句操作提示。
 */
@Component
export struct WatchShell {
  @Prop userName: string = '';
  onLogout: () => void = () => {
  };

  @State private page: number = 0;
  @State private plan: TtPlan = new TtPlan();
  @State private ttReady: boolean = false;
  @State private hwItems: WatchHwItem[] = [];
  @State private hwReady: boolean = false;
  @State private ntItems: WatchNtItem[] = [];
  @State private ntReady: boolean = false;
  @State private ntPending: number = 0;
  @State private ntUrgent: number = 0;
  @State private powerQ: string = '';
  @State private powerUnit: string = '度';
  @State private powerLabel: string = '';
  @State private powerState: string = 'idle';
  @State private powerUpd: string = '';
  @State private powerDrop: string = '';
  @State private powerDays: string = '';
  @State private powerBars: number[] = [];
  @State private powerReady: boolean = false;
  @State private offline: boolean = false;
  @State private syncing: boolean = false;
  @State private lastSync: number = 0;
  @State private dataVersion: number = 0;
  @State private screenW: number = 400;
  @State private screenH: number = 400;

  @State private menuOpen: boolean = false;
  @State private logoutOpen: boolean = false;
  @State private detailOpen: boolean = false;
  @State private detailTitle: string = '';
  @State private detailStatus: string = '';
  @State private detailSummary: string = '';
  @State private detailPoints: string[] = [];
  @State private detailKey: string = '';
  @State private toast: string = '';

  private controller: SwiperController = new SwiperController();
  private ntMap: Map<string, NoticeCard> = new Map<string, NoticeCard>();

  aboutToAppear(): void {
    this.load(false);
  }

  private px(base: number): number {
    const h: number = this.screenH > 0 ? this.screenH : 400;
    const factor: number = Math.max(0.8, Math.min(1.2, h / 400));
    return Math.round(base * factor);
  }

  private hPad(): number {
    const w: number = this.screenW > 0 ? this.screenW : 400;
    // 圆屏安全区：内容宽度约 70%，避开上下圆弧
    return Math.round(Math.max(22, Math.min(76, w * 0.15)));
  }

  private buzz(ms: number = 12): void {
    try {
      vibrator.startVibration({ type: 'time', duration: ms }, { id: 0, usage: 'notification' });
    } catch (e) {
      // 无振动权限/设备不支持时忽略
    }
  }

  private flash(text: string): void {
    this.toast = text;
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.toast = '';
    }, 1800);
  }

  /** 并发刷新：每个分页独立更新，网络慢也不会卡住整屏。 */
  private async load(force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const now: number = Date.now();
    this.syncing = true;
    this.offline = false;
    const prefs: PowerPrefsData = PowerPrefs.read(Services.userdata.currentSections());
    const tasks: Promise<void>[] = [
      this.loadTimetable(now, force),
      this.loadHomework(now, force),
      this.loadNotices(now, force),
      this.loadPower(now, force, prefs)
    ];
    await Promise.all(tasks);
    this.dataVersion = this.dataVersion + 1;
    this.syncing = false;
    this.lastSync = Date.now();
  }

  private async loadTimetable(now: number, force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const tt: TtResult = await Services.timetable.load(force);
      this.plan = TtCalendar.plan(tt.snapshot, now);
      this.ttReady = true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.ttReady = true;
    }
  }

  private async loadHomework(now: number, force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const hw: HomeworkResult = await Services.homework.load(force);
      this.applyHomework(hw.rows, now);
      this.hwReady = true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.hwReady = true;
    }
  }

  private applyHomework(rows: HomeworkRow[], now: number): void {
    let snapshot = Services.marks.marks();
    const open: HomeworkRow[] = HomeDigest.hwOpen(rows, (id: string) => snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.HW, id));
    const items: WatchHwItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < open.length; i++) {
      const row: HomeworkRow = open[i];
      const item: WatchHwItem = new WatchHwItem();
      item.id = row.id;
      item.title = WatchLogic.short(row.subject.length > 0 ? row.subject : row.content, 22);
      const due: HomeworkDue | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(row, now);
      if (due !== undefined) {
        item.sub = due.label;
        item.tone = toneOf(due.tone);
      } else {
        item.sub = row.date.length > 0 ? row.date : '无截止';
      }
      items.push(item);
    }
    this.hwItems = items;
  }

  private async loadNotices(now: number, force: boolean): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const nt: NoticesResult = await Services.notices.load(force);
      const cards: NoticeCard[] = NoticeCards.build(nt.entries, now);
      const snapshot = Services.marks.marks();
      const map: Map<string, NoticeCard> = new Map<string, NoticeCard>();
      const items: WatchNtItem[] = [];
      let pending: number = 0;
      let urgent: number = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
        const card: NoticeCard = cards[i];
        if (card.definition || card.section !== '待处理') {
          continue;
        }
        if (snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.NT_DONE, card.key)) {
          continue;
        }
        pending += 1;
        const isUrgent: boolean = card.whenAt > 0 && card.whenAt - now <= 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        if (isUrgent) {
          urgent += 1;
        }
        const item: WatchNtItem = new WatchNtItem();
        item.key = card.key;
        item.title = WatchLogic.short(card.title.length > 0 ? card.title : '班级通知', 22);
        item.sub = card.statusLabel.length > 0 ? card.statusLabel : card.cat;
        item.urgent = isUrgent;
        items.push(item);
        map.set(card.key, card);
      }
      items.sort((a: WatchNtItem, b: WatchNtItem) => {
        if (a.urgent !== b.urgent) {
          return a.urgent ? -1 : 1;
        }
        return 0;
      });
      this.ntPending = pending;
      this.ntUrgent = urgent;
      this.ntItems = items;
      this.ntMap = map;
      this.ntReady = true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.ntReady = true;
    }
  }

  private async loadPower(now: number, force: boolean, prefs: PowerPrefsData): Promise<void> {
    if (prefs.sel.length === 0) {
      this.powerReady = true;
      return;
    }
    try {
      this.powerLabel = PowerRooms.labelOf(prefs.sel);
      const rowResult: PowerRowResult = await Services.power.loadRow(prefs.sel, force);
      const row: PowerRow | undefined = rowResult.row;
      if (row !== undefined) {
        this.powerQ = HomeDigest.powerQText(row.q, row.hasValue);
        this.powerUnit = row.unit.length > 0 ? row.unit : '度';
        this.powerState = HomeDigest.powerState(row.q, row.hasValue, prefs.low);
        this.powerUpd = HomeDigest.updText(row.updatedAt);
      }
      const history: PowerHistoryResult = await Services.power.loadHistory(prefs.sel, PowerRange.H24, force);
      this.applyPowerHistory(history.points, row, now);
      this.powerReady = true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.powerReady = true;
    }
  }

  private applyPowerHistory(points: PowerPoint[], row: PowerRow | undefined, now: number): void {
    if (points.length === 0) {
      this.powerBars = [];
      return;
    }
    const stats: RangeStats = PowerStats.deriveRange(points, PowerRange.H24, now);
    this.powerDrop = stats.valid
      ? ('24h 下降 ' + PowerStats.fmtDrop(stats.drop, true) + (row !== undefined ? row.unit : '度')) : '';
    const est: PowerEstimate = PowerStats.estimate(points);
    if (est.valid && row !== undefined && row.hasValue && est.ratePerDay > 0) {
      const days: number = PowerStats.daysLeft(row.q, est.ratePerDay);
      this.powerDays = days > 0 && days < 999 ? ('约可用 ' + days + ' 天') : '';
    } else {
      this.powerDays = '';
    }
    const view: PowerPoint[] = PowerStats.downsample(points, 18);
    let min: number = view[0].q;
    let max: number = view[0].q;
    for (let i = 1; i < view.length; i++) {
      min = Math.min(min, view[i].q);
      max = Math.max(max, view[i].q);
    }
    const span: number = max - min;
    const bars: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < view.length; i++) {
      const ratio: number = span > 0.001 ? (view[i].q - min) / span : 0.5;
      bars.push(Math.round(5 + ratio * 23));
    }
    this.powerBars = bars;
  }

  private refresh(): void {
    this.buzz(18);
    this.load(true);
  }

  private async completeHomework(item: WatchHwItem): Promise<void> {
    this.buzz(15);
    const next: WatchHwItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.hwItems.length; i++) {
      if (this.hwItems[i].id !== item.id) {
        next.push(this.hwItems[i]);
      }
    }
    this.hwItems = next;
    this.flash('已完成 · ' + item.title);
    const result: MarksUpdateResult = await Services.marks.setMark(MarkKind.HW, item.id, true);
    if (!result.ok) {
      this.flash('网络不佳，已本机记录稍后补发');
    }
  }

  private async completeNotice(key: string): Promise<void> {
    this.buzz(15);
    const next: WatchNtItem[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.ntItems.length; i++) {
      if (this.ntItems[i].key !== key) {
        next.push(this.ntItems[i]);
      }
    }
    this.ntItems = next;
    this.ntPending = Math.max(0, this.ntPending - 1);
    this.detailOpen = false;
    this.flash('已标记处理');
    await Services.marks.setMark(MarkKind.NT_DONE, key, true);
  }

  private openDetail(key: string): void {
    const card: NoticeCard | undefined = this.ntMap.get(key);
    if (card === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    this.buzz(10);
    this.detailKey = key;
    this.detailTitle = card.title;
    this.detailStatus = card.statusLabel;
    this.detailSummary = card.aiSummary.length > 0 ? card.aiSummary : card.summary;
    this.detailPoints = card.points;
    this.detailOpen = true;
  }

  private closeDetail(): void {
    this.detailOpen = false;
  }

  private openMenu(): void {
    this.buzz(15);
    this.menuOpen = true;
  }

  private closeMenu(): void {
    this.menuOpen = false;
  }

  private askLogout(): void {
    this.menuOpen = false;
    this.logoutOpen = true;
  }

  private nextSession(): SessionInfo | undefined {
    return this.plan.hasData ? this.plan.next : undefined;
  }

  private nextLabel(): string {
    if (!this.plan.hasData) {
      return this.ttReady ? '课表未同步' : '正在同步';
    }
    if (this.plan.today.length === 0) {
      const next: SessionInfo | undefined = this.plan.next;
      return next !== undefined ? next.name : '今天没课';
    }
    const next: SessionInfo | undefined = this.plan.next;
    if (next === undefined) {
      return '今日课程已结束';
    }
    return next.name;
  }

  private nextMeta(): string {
    const next: SessionInfo | undefined = this.nextSession();
    if (next === undefined) {
      return this.plan.hasData ? '' : '在手机上打开课表';
    }
    const room: string = next.room.length > 0 ? ' · ' + next.room : '';
    return next.dayText + ' ' + next.startText + room;
  }

  private countdownMinutes(): number {
    const next: SessionInfo | undefined = this.nextSession();
    if (next === undefined || next.startAt <= 0) {
      return -1;
    }
    return WatchLogic.minutesUntil(next.startAt, Date.now());
  }

  private ringValue(): number {
    const min: number = this.countdownMinutes();
    if (min < 0) {
      return this.plan.hasData ? 100 : 0;
    }
    // 以 7 天为满环：越接近上课，环越满
    const ratio: number = Math.min(1, min / (7 * 24 * 60));
    return Math.round((1 - ratio) * 100);
  }

  private countdownMain(): string {
    const min: number = this.countdownMinutes();
    if (min < 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    if (min <= 0) {
      return '上课中';
    }
    if (min >= 24 * 60) {
      return Math.floor(min / (24 * 60)) + '天';
    }
    if (min >= 60) {
      return Math.floor(min / 60) + 'h' + (min % 60 > 0 ? (min % 60) + 'm' : '');
    }
    return '' + min;
  }

  private countdownUnit(): string {
    const min: number = this.countdownMinutes();
    if (min < 0) {
      return this.ttReady ? '无课程' : '同步中';
    }
    if (min <= 0) {
      return '进行中';
    }
    if (min >= 24 * 60) {
      return '后上课';
    }
    return min >= 60 ? '后上课' : '分钟后';
  }

  private sessionColor(state: string): string {
    if (state === SessionState.ONGOING) {
      return '#E8A87C';
    }
    if (state === SessionState.DONE) {
      return '#5A5F63';
    }
    return Tokens.MIST_TEAL;
  }

  private toneColor(tone: string): string {
    if (tone === 'urgent' || tone === 'overdue') {
      return '#E8A87C';
    }
    if (tone === 'warn') {
      return '#E0C080';
    }
    return '#9AA0A6';
  }

  private syncText(): string {
    if (this.syncing) {
      return '同步中…';
    }
    if (this.lastSync <= 0) {
      return '点按刷新';
    }
    return '更新 ' + WatchLogic.clock(this.lastSync);
  }

  private powerTone(): string {
    if (this.powerState === 'low') {
      return '#E8A87C';
    }
    if (this.powerState === 'warn') {
      return '#E0C080';
    }
    return '#FFFFFF';
  }

  private powerRing(): number {
    const value: number = Number(this.powerQ);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (this.powerState === 'low') {
      return Math.max(4, Math.round(Math.min(100, value)));
    }
    return Math.round(Math.min(100, Math.max(4, value)));
  }

  private powerStateText(): string {
    if (this.powerQ.length === 0) {
      return this.powerReady ? '未关注' : '同步中';
    }
    if (this.powerState === 'ok') {
      return '充足';
    }
    if (this.powerState === 'warn') {
      return '偏低';
    }
    if (this.powerState === 'low') {
      return '低电';
    }
    return '';
  }

  @Builder
  dots() {
    Row({ space: 5 }) {
      ForEach([0, 1, 2, 3, 4], (i: number) => {
        Circle()
          .width(this.page === i ? 7 : 5)
          .height(this.page === i ? 7 : 5)
          .fill(this.page === i ? Tokens.MIST_TEAL : '#4A4A4A')
      }, (i: number) => 'dot_' + i)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
    .margin({ bottom: 3 })
  }

  @Builder
  menuOverlay() {
    Column() {
      Text('操作')
        .fontSize(this.px(12))
        .fontColor('#9AA0A6')
        .margin({ bottom: this.px(4) })
      this.actionRow('刷', '刷新全部', this.syncText(), Tokens.MIST_TEAL, () => {
        this.closeMenu();
        this.refresh();
      })
      this.actionRow('取', '取消', '返回当前页面', '#9AA0A6', () => {
        this.closeMenu();
      })
    }
    .width('76%')
    .padding(this.px(8))
    .backgroundColor('#101418')
    .borderRadius(this.px(14))
    .border({ width: 1, color: '#2A3035' })
  }

  @Builder
  detailOverlay() {
    Column() {
      Row() {
        Text(this.detailStatus)
          .fontSize(this.px(9))
          .fontColor('#9BC9BB')
          .maxLines(1)
        Blank()
        Text('关闭')
          .fontSize(this.px(10))
          .fontColor('#6E747A')
      }
      .width('100%')
      Text(this.detailTitle)
        .fontSize(this.px(14))
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
        .maxLines(3)
        .margin({ top: this.px(3) })
      Scroll() {
        Column() {
          if (this.detailSummary.length > 0) {
            Text(this.detailSummary)
              .fontSize(this.px(10))
              .fontColor('#B9C7CB')
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: this.px(4) })
          }
          ForEach(this.detailPoints, (p: string, i: number) => {
            Text('· ' + p)
              .fontSize(this.px(9))
              .fontColor('#8FA3A8')
              .width('100%')
              .margin({ top: this.px(2) })
          }, (p: string, i: number) => 'dp_' + i)
          Blank().height(this.px(4))
        }
        .width('100%')
      }
      .layoutWeight(1)
      .scrollBar(BarState.Off)
        .clip(true)
      .focusable(true)
      .focusOnTouch(true)

      Row({ space: this.px(6) }) {
        Text('稍后')
          .fontSize(this.px(11))
          .fontColor('#9AA0A6')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(this.px(30))
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .backgroundColor('#1C2126')
          .borderRadius(this.px(15))
          .onClick(() => {
            this.closeDetail();
          })
        Text('标记已处理')
          .fontSize(this.px(11))
          .fontColor('#12332C')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(this.px(30))
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .backgroundColor('#9BC9BB')
          .borderRadius(this.px(15))
          .onClick(() => {
            this.completeNotice(this.detailKey);
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: this.px(4) })
    }
    .width('70%')
    .height('62%')
    .padding(this.px(9))
    .backgroundColor('#101418')
    .borderRadius(this.px(16))
    .border({ width: 1, color: '#2A3035' })
  }

  @Builder
  logoutOverlay() {
    Column() {
      Text('退出登录？')
        .fontSize(this.px(14))
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Medium)
        .fontColor('#FFFFFF')
      Text('退出后需要重新验证学号与姓名')
        .fontSize(this.px(9))
        .fontColor('#9AA0A6')
        .margin({ top: this.px(3) })
      Row({ space: this.px(6) }) {
        Text('取消')
          .fontSize(this.px(11))
          .fontColor('#9AA0A6')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(this.px(30))
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .backgroundColor('#1C2126')
          .borderRadius(this.px(15))
          .onClick(() => {
            this.logoutOpen = false;
          })
        Text('退出')
          .fontSize(this.px(11))
          .fontColor('#2A1A12')
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .height(this.px(30))
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .backgroundColor('#E8A87C')
          .borderRadius(this.px(15))
          .onClick(() => {
            this.logoutOpen = false;
            this.onLogout();
          })
      }
      .width('100%')
      .margin({ top: this.px(10) })
    }
    .width('72%')
    .padding(this.px(10))
    .backgroundColor('#101418')
    .borderRadius(this.px(16))
    .border({ width: 1, color: '#2A3035' })
  }

  build() {
    Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.Bottom }) {
      Swiper(this.controller) {
        Column() {
          this.pageToday()
        }
        Column() {
          this.pageHomework()
        }
        Column() {
          this.pageNotices()
        }
        Column() {
          this.pagePower()
        }
        Column() {
          this.pageMore()
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .height('100%')
      .index(this.page)
      .loop(false)
      .indicator(false)
      .focusable(true)
      .focusOnTouch(true)
      .defaultFocus(true)
      .onChange((index: number) => {
        this.page = index;
      })

      Column() {
        this.dots()
        Text('滑动翻页 · 长按操作')
          .fontSize(this.px(8))
          .fontColor('#5A5F63')
          .maxLines(1)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding({ bottom: this.px(14) })
      .hitTestBehavior(HitTestMode.None)

      if (this.toast.length > 0) {
        Text(this.toast)
          .fontSize(this.px(9))
          .fontColor('#EAE5D9')
          .backgroundColor('#2A3035')
          .borderRadius(this.px(10))
          .padding({ left: this.px(8), right: this.px(8), top: this.px(3), bottom: this.px(3) })
          .margin({ bottom: this.px(28) })
          .hitTestBehavior(HitTestMode.None)
      }

      if (this.offline && !this.menuOpen && !this.detailOpen && !this.logoutOpen) {
        Column() {
          Text('离线 · 显示缓存')
            .fontSize(this.px(9))
            .fontColor('#E8A87C')
            .padding({ left: 9, right: 9, top: 2, bottom: 2 })
            .backgroundColor('#1C1C1E')
            .borderRadius(9)
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Start)
        .padding({ top: this.px(6) })
        .hitTestBehavior(HitTestMode.None)
      }

      if (this.menuOpen) {
        Column() {
          this.menuOverlay()
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
        .backgroundColor('#99000000')
        .onClick(() => {
          this.closeMenu();
        })
        .transition(TransitionEffect.OPACITY)
      }

      if (this.detailOpen) {
        Column() {
          this.detailOverlay()
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
        .backgroundColor('#99000000')
        .transition(TransitionEffect.OPACITY)
      }

      if (this.logoutOpen) {
        Column() {
          this.logoutOverlay()
        }
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
        .backgroundColor('#B3000000')
        .onClick(() => {
          this.logoutOpen = false;
        })
        .transition(TransitionEffect.OPACITY)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor('#000000')
    .expandSafeArea([SafeAreaType.SYSTEM], [SafeAreaEdge.TOP, SafeAreaEdge.BOTTOM])
    .gesture(LongPressGesture().onAction(() => {
      if (!this.menuOpen && !this.detailOpen && !this.logoutOpen) {
        this.openMenu();
      }
    }))
    .onAreaChange((oldValue: Area, newValue: Area) => {
      const w: number = Number(newValue.width);
      const h: number = Number(newValue.height);
      if (w > 0 && h > 0 && (Math.abs(w - this.screenW) > 1 || Math.abs(h - this.screenH) > 1)) {
        this.screenW = w;
        this.screenH = h;
      }
    })
  }
}

function toneOf(tone: HomeworkDueTone): string {
  if (tone === HomeworkDueTone.URGENT) {
    return 'urgent';
  }
  if (tone === HomeworkDueTone.OVERDUE) {
    return 'overdue';
  }
  if (tone === HomeworkDueTone.WARN) {
    return 'warn';
  }
  if (tone === HomeworkDueTone.SAFE) {
    return 'safe';
  }
  return 'neutral';
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { AccountBindingRepository, BindItem } from '../main/ets/data/account/AccountBindingRepository';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';

export default function accountBindingTest() {
  describe('AccountBinding', () => {
    it('masked_and_empty', 0, () => {
      const item: BindItem = new BindItem();
      item.openId = 'abcdefghijklmnop';
      expect(item.masked()).assertEqual('abcd…mnop');
      const short: BindItem = new BindItem();
      short.openId = 'short';
      expect(short.masked()).assertEqual('已绑定账号');
    });

    it('bind_ok_and_reason', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const err: string = await AccountBindingRepository.bind('openid-12345678', 'phone', api);
      expect(err).assertEqual('');
      expect(api.postPaths[0]).assertEqual('rpc/hw_bind');
      expect(api.postBodies[0].indexOf('openid-12345678') > 0).assertTrue();

      const empty: string = await AccountBindingRepository.bind('', 'phone', api);
      expect(empty.length > 0).assertTrue();

      api.hwActionBody = '{"ok":false,"reason":"一个学号最多绑定 3 个华为账号"}';
      const limited: string = await AccountBindingRepository.bind('openid-99999999', 'phone', api);
      expect(limited).assertEqual('一个学号最多绑定 3 个华为账号');

      api.failPosts = true;
      const failed: string = await AccountBindingRepository.bind('openid-99999999', 'phone', api);
      expect(failed.length > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('list_parse', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.hwListBody = '[{"open_id":"abcdefgh12345678","device":"watch","created_at":"2026-11-15T20:00:00+08:00"}]';
      const list: BindItem[] = await AccountBindingRepository.list(api);
      expect(list.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(list[0].device).assertEqual('watch');
      expect(list[0].masked()).assertEqual('abcd…5678');

      api.hwListBody = 'not-json';
      const bad: BindItem[] = await AccountBindingRepository.list(api);
      expect(bad.length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('login_session_and_reason', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const ok = await AccountBindingRepository.login('openid-12345678', api);
      expect(ok.reason).assertEqual('');
      expect(ok.session !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (ok.session !== undefined) {
        expect(ok.session.sid).assertEqual('3260799999');
        expect(ok.session.token).assertEqual('t0');
      }

      api.hwLoginBody = '{"ok":false,"reason":"该华为账号尚未绑定学号"}';
      const unbound = await AccountBindingRepository.login('openid-12345678', api);
      expect(unbound.session === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(unbound.reason).assertEqual('该华为账号尚未绑定学号');

      const empty = await AccountBindingRepository.login('', api);
      expect(empty.session === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('unbind', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      expect(await AccountBindingRepository.unbind('abcdefgh12345678', api)).assertTrue();
      api.hwActionBody = '{"ok":false}';
      expect(await AccountBindingRepository.unbind('abcdefgh12345678', api)).assertFalse();
      api.failPosts = true;
      expect(await AccountBindingRepository.unbind('abcdefgh12345678', api)).assertFalse();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { Breakpoints } from '../main/ets/ui/theme/Breakpoints';
import { Tokens } from '../main/ets/ui/theme/Tokens';
import { ToolCatalog, ToolDef } from '../main/ets/data/tool/ToolCatalog';

export default function breakpointsTest() {
  describe('Breakpoints', () => {
    it('grid_columns_2_3_4', 0, () => {
      expect(Breakpoints.gridColumns(0)).assertEqual(2);
      expect(Breakpoints.gridColumns(360)).assertEqual(2);
      expect(Breakpoints.gridColumns(599)).assertEqual(2);
      expect(Breakpoints.gridColumns(600)).assertEqual(3);
      expect(Breakpoints.gridColumns(899)).assertEqual(3);
      expect(Breakpoints.gridColumns(900)).assertEqual(4);
      expect(Breakpoints.gridColumns(1200)).assertEqual(4);
    });

    it('grid_item_width_percent', 0, () => {
      expect(Breakpoints.gridItemWidthPercent(360)).assertEqual('48.5%');
      expect(Breakpoints.gridItemWidthPercent(700)).assertEqual('31.5%');
      expect(Breakpoints.gridItemWidthPercent(1000)).assertEqual('23.5%');
    });

    it('content_max_width_and_breath', 0, () => {
      expect(Breakpoints.contentMaxWidth(360)).assertEqual(880);
      expect(Breakpoints.contentMaxWidth(700)).assertEqual(880);
      expect(Breakpoints.contentMaxWidth(1200)).assertEqual(960);
      expect(Breakpoints.breathTop(360)).assertEqual(8);
      expect(Breakpoints.breathTop(1200)).assertEqual(12);
      expect(Tokens.BREATH_TOP).assertEqual(8);
    });

    it('wide_and_tablet_flags', 0, () => {
      expect(Breakpoints.isWide(899)).assertFalse();
      expect(Breakpoints.isWide(900)).assertTrue();
      expect(Breakpoints.isTablet(599)).assertFalse();
      expect(Breakpoints.isTablet(600)).assertTrue();
      expect(Breakpoints.isTablet(900)).assertFalse();
      expect(Breakpoints.useTwoPane(700)).assertFalse();
      expect(Breakpoints.useTwoPane(1000)).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('VisualTokens', () => {
    it('hero_is_neutral_dark_not_brand_green', 0, () => {
      // 深色 hero 是中性色：RGB 三通道接近（低饱和），且不是品牌绿 #4E9082。
      const hex: string = Tokens.HERO_DARK;
      expect(hex.startsWith('#') && hex.length === 7).assertTrue();
      const r: number = parseInt(hex.substring(1, 3), 16);
      const g: number = parseInt(hex.substring(3, 5), 16);
      const b: number = parseInt(hex.substring(5, 7), 16);
      expect(Math.abs(r - g) <= 20).assertTrue();
      expect(Math.abs(g - b) <= 20).assertTrue();
      expect((r + g + b) / 3 < 90).assertTrue();
      expect(hex.toUpperCase() === Tokens.MIST_TEAL.toUpperCase()).assertFalse();
      // 正文/副标与 hero 底色对比：浅色文字。
      expect(Tokens.HERO_TEXT.toUpperCase() === '#F3F6F6').assertTrue();
    });

    it('bottom_bar_is_light_no_dark_shadow', 0, () => {
      const bar: string = Tokens.BAR_LIGHT;
      const r: number = parseInt(bar.substring(1, 3), 16);
      const g: number = parseInt(bar.substring(3, 5), 16);
      const b: number = parseInt(bar.substring(5, 7), 16);
      expect((r + g + b) / 3 > 240).assertTrue();
      // 底栏用发丝线而不是黑影：分隔线是浅灰。
      const divider: string = Tokens.DIVIDER;
      const dr: number = parseInt(divider.substring(1, 3), 16);
      expect(dr > 200).assertTrue();
    });

    it('tool_description_two_lines_capacity', 0, () => {
      // 卡片副标最多两行：所有工具副标都非空，且 96vp 卡高可容纳 2 行（12vp * 17 行高）。
      expect(ToolCatalog.ALL.length >= 16).assertTrue();
      for (let i = 0; i < ToolCatalog.ALL.length; i++) {
        const tool: ToolDef = ToolCatalog.ALL[i];
        expect(tool.subtitle.length > 0).assertTrue();
        expect(tool.subtitle.length <= 40).assertTrue();
      }
    });
  });

  describe('ToolCatalogPorting', () => {
    it('new_tools_registered', 0, () => {
      const ids: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < ToolCatalog.ALL.length; i++) {
        ids.push(ToolCatalog.ALL[i].id);
      }
      expect(ids.indexOf('map') >= 0).assertTrue();
      expect(ids.indexOf('file') >= 0).assertTrue();
      expect(ids.length).assertEqual(16);
    });

    it('ids_unique_and_features_present', 0, () => {
      const seen: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < ToolCatalog.ALL.length; i++) {
        const tool: ToolDef = ToolCatalog.ALL[i];
        expect(seen.indexOf(tool.id)).assertEqual(-1);
        seen.push(tool.id);
        expect(tool.name.length > 0).assertTrue();
        expect(tool.glyph.length > 0).assertTrue();
        expect(tool.features.length > 0).assertTrue();
        expect(ToolCatalog.byId(tool.id) !== undefined).assertTrue();
      }
      expect(ToolCatalog.byId('not-exist') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}
