function fileOf(id: string, name: string, size: number, uploadedAt: number, url: string = 'u'): CloudSpaceFile {
  return new CloudSpaceFile(id, name, size, 'application/octet-stream', url, false, uploadedAt);
}

export default function cloudSpaceTest() {
  describe('CloudSpaceDefaults', () => {
    it('contract_constants', 0, () => {
      expect(CloudSpaceDefaults.BASE_URL).assertEqual('http://121.196.47.2/drop');
      expect(CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE).assertEqual(8 * 1024 * 1024);
      expect(CloudSpaceDefaults.FILE_TTL_MS).assertEqual(72 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      expect(CloudSpaceDefaults.MAX_FILES).assertEqual(300);
      expect(CloudSpaceDefaults.MAX_UPLOAD_CHUNKS).assertEqual(65536);
      expect(CloudSpaceDefaults.DOWNLOAD_URL_TTL_MINUTES).assertEqual(30);
    });
  });

  describe('CloudSpaceChunkPlan', () => {
    it('chunks_8mib', 0, () => {
      const zero: CloudSpaceChunkPlan = CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(0);
      expect(zero.totalChunks).assertEqual(1);
      expect(zero.chunks[0].size()).assertEqual(0);
      const one: CloudSpaceChunkPlan = CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(1);
      expect(one.totalChunks).assertEqual(1);
      expect(one.chunks[0].size()).assertEqual(1);
      const exact: CloudSpaceChunkPlan = CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE);
      expect(exact.totalChunks).assertEqual(1);
      const oneMore: CloudSpaceChunkPlan = CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE + 1);
      expect(oneMore.totalChunks).assertEqual(2);
      expect(oneMore.chunks[1].size()).assertEqual(1);
      expect(oneMore.chunks[1].start).assertEqual(CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE);
      const twentyMb: CloudSpaceChunkPlan = CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(20 * 1024 * 1024);
      expect(twentyMb.totalChunks).assertEqual(3);
      expect(twentyMb.chunks[2].size()).assertEqual(4 * 1024 * 1024);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(10, 4).chunks.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.chunkPlan(10, 4).chunks[0].index).assertEqual(0);
    });
  });

  describe('CloudSpaceFormat', () => {
    it('fmt_size', 0, () => {
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtSize(0)).assertEqual('0 B');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtSize(512)).assertEqual('512 B');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtSize(1024)).assertEqual('1.0 KB');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtSize(1536)).assertEqual('1.5 KB');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtSize(2 * 1024 * 1024)).assertEqual('2.0 MB');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtSize(20 * 1024 * 1024)).assertEqual('20 MB');
    });

    it('fmt_time_and_ttl', 0, () => {
      const millis: number = new Date(2026, 0, 2, 9, 5, 0).getTime();
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtTime(millis)).assertEqual('01-02 09:05');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fmtTime(0)).assertEqual('');
      const now: number = 1000000;
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.ttlText(now, now)).assertEqual('剩 3 天');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.ttlText(now, now + 24 * 3600000)).assertEqual('剩 2 天');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.ttlText(now, now + 47 * 3600000)).assertEqual('剩 1 天 1 小时');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.ttlText(now, now + 72 * 3600000)).assertEqual('已过期');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.ttlText(0, now)).assertEqual('已过期');
    });

    it('upload_percent_and_expired_hint', 0, () => {
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uploadPercent(0, 100)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uploadPercent(50, 100)).assertEqual(50);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uploadPercent(100, 100)).assertEqual(99);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uploadPercent(200, 100)).assertEqual(99);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uploadPercent(5, 0)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.expiredHint(2).indexOf('2 个文件已过期') >= 0).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uploadStateText('waiting', '')).assertEqual('准备上传…');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uploadStateText('failed', '磁盘不足')).assertEqual('磁盘不足');
    });
  });

  describe('CloudSpaceNaming', () => {
    it('safe_name', 0, () => {
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.safeName('a/b\\c:d*e?f"g<h>i|j.png')).assertEqual('a_b_c_d_e_f_g_h_i_j.png');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.safeName('')).assertEqual('file');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.safeName('../..')).assertEqual('_');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.safeName('.hidden.txt')).assertEqual('hidden.txt');
      let longName: string = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        longName += 'a';
      }
      longName += '.pdf';
      const safe: string = CloudSpaceLogic.safeName(longName);
      expect(safe.length <= 120).assertTrue();
      expect(safe.endsWith('.pdf')).assertTrue();
    });

    it('unique_name', 0, () => {
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uniqueName([], 'a.pdf')).assertEqual('a.pdf');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uniqueName(['a.pdf'], 'a.pdf')).assertEqual('a (1).pdf');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uniqueName(['a.pdf', 'a (1).pdf'], 'a.pdf')).assertEqual('a (2).pdf');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.uniqueName(['a'], 'a')).assertEqual('a (1)');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.sandboxFileName('f1', 'a.pdf')).assertEqual('f1_a.pdf');
    });

    it('mime_and_kind', 0, () => {
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.mimeOf('a.PDF')).assertEqual('application/pdf');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.mimeOf('a.png')).assertEqual('image/png');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.mimeOf('a.unknown')).assertEqual('application/octet-stream');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind('', 'a.jpg')).assertEqual(CloudSpaceFileKind.IMAGE);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind('video/mp4', 'a.bin')).assertEqual(CloudSpaceFileKind.VIDEO);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind('', 'a.mp3')).assertEqual(CloudSpaceFileKind.AUDIO);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind('', 'a.zip')).assertEqual(CloudSpaceFileKind.ARCHIVE);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind('', 'a.pdf')).assertEqual(CloudSpaceFileKind.PDF);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind('', 'a.docx')).assertEqual(CloudSpaceFileKind.DOCUMENT);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKind('', 'a.xyz')).assertEqual(CloudSpaceFileKind.OTHER);
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKindGlyph(CloudSpaceFileKind.IMAGE)).assertEqual('图');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKindGlyph(CloudSpaceFileKind.PDF)).assertEqual('PDF');
      expect(CloudSpaceLogic.fileKindGlyph(CloudSpaceFileKind.OTHER)).assertEqual('件');
    });
  });

  describe('CloudSpaceEventMerge', () => {
    it('adds_sorts_and_deletes', 0, () => {
      const oldFile: CloudSpaceFile = fileOf('a', 'a.pdf', 10, 100);
      const addedEvent: CloudSpaceEvent = new CloudSpaceEvent();
      addedEvent.kind = 'file';
      addedEvent.seq = 2;
      addedEvent.file = fileOf('b', 'b.png', 20, 200);
      const deletedEvent: CloudSpaceEvent = new CloudSpaceEvent();
      deletedEvent.kind = 'filedel';
      deletedEvent.seq = 3;
      deletedEvent.fileId = 'a';
      const events: CloudSpaceEvent[] = [];
      events.push(addedEvent);
      events.push(deletedEvent);
      const merged: CloudSpaceMergedFiles = CloudSpaceLogic.applyEvents([oldFile], [], events);
      expect(merged.files.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(merged.files[0].id).assertEqual('b');
      expect(merged.expiredCount()).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('refreshes_url_and_handles_expired', 0, () => {
      const oldFile: CloudSpaceFile = fileOf('a', 'a.pdf', 10, 100, 'old-url');
      const refresh: CloudSpaceEvent = new CloudSpaceEvent();
      refresh.kind = 'file';
      refresh.seq = 2;
      refresh.file = fileOf('a', 'a.pdf', 10, 100, 'new-url');
      const merged: CloudSpaceMergedFiles = CloudSpaceLogic.applyEvents([oldFile], [], [refresh]);
      expect(merged.files.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(merged.files[0].downloadUrl).assertEqual('new-url');

      const expired: CloudSpaceEvent = new CloudSpaceEvent();
      expired.kind = 'file';
      expired.seq = 3;
      expired.file = new CloudSpaceFile('a', 'a.pdf', 10, '', '', true, 100);
      const expiredMerged: CloudSpaceMergedFiles =
        CloudSpaceLogic.applyEvents(merged.files, merged.expiredIds, [expired]);
      expect(expiredMerged.files.length).assertEqual(0);
      expect(expiredMerged.expiredCount()).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('snapshot_totals', 0, () => {
      const snapshot: CloudSpaceSnapshot = new CloudSpaceSnapshot();
      expect(snapshot.connected()).assertFalse();
      snapshot.session = new CloudSpaceSession('s1');
      snapshot.files.push(fileOf('a', 'a', 10, 1));
      snapshot.files.push(fileOf('b', 'b', 20, 2));
      expect(snapshot.connected()).assertTrue();
      expect(snapshot.count()).assertEqual(2);
      expect(snapshot.totalBytes()).assertEqual(30);
    });
  });

  describe('CloudSpaceErrors', () => {
    it('status_mapping', 0, () => {
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.network().kind).assertEqual(CloudSpaceErrorKind.NETWORK);
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.network().displayMessage()).assertEqual('云空间服务不可达，请检查网络后重试');
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(401, '身份无效').kind).assertEqual(CloudSpaceErrorKind.TOKEN_INVALID);
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(401, '身份无效').displayMessage()).assertEqual('身份无效');
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(403).displayMessage().indexOf('过期') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(404).displayMessage().indexOf('不存在') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(413).displayMessage().indexOf('限制') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(507).displayMessage().indexOf('空间不足') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(500).displayMessage().indexOf('错误') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(418).displayMessage()).assertEqual('服务错误（HTTP 418）');
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.rejected('').displayMessage()).assertEqual('云空间操作失败，请稍后重试');
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.rejected('拒绝').displayMessage()).assertEqual('拒绝');
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.parse().displayMessage().indexOf('响应异常') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.local('本地错误').displayMessage()).assertEqual('本地错误');
      const error: CloudSpaceError = CloudSpaceErrors.network();
      expect(error.displayMessage().indexOf('121.196') < 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('reason_truncated_and_result_types', 0, () => {
      let longReason: string = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        longReason += 'x';
      }
      expect(CloudSpaceErrors.http(500, longReason).displayMessage().length <= 120).assertTrue();
      const ok: CloudSpaceResult<number> = CloudSpaceResult.success<number>(3);
      expect(ok.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(ok.value).assertEqual(3);
      const bad: CloudSpaceResult<number> = CloudSpaceResult.failure<number>(CloudSpaceErrors.parse());
      expect(bad.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(bad.error !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('CloudSpaceApi', () => {
    it('url_and_headers', 0, () => {
      const api: CloudSpaceApi = new CloudSpaceApi('http://121.196.47.2/drop/');
      expect(api.baseUrl).assertEqual('http://121.196.47.2/drop');
      expect(api.url('/mine')).assertEqual('http://121.196.47.2/drop/mine');
      expect(api.url('state')).assertEqual('http://121.196.47.2/drop/state');
      const noToken: Record<string, string> = api.headers('');
      expect(noToken['X-Device-Id'] === undefined).assertTrue();
      const withToken: Record<string, string> = api.headers('token-1', CloudSpaceApi.APPLICATION_JSON);
      expect(withToken['X-Device-Id']).assertEqual('token-1');
      expect(withToken['Content-Type']).assertEqual('application/json');
      expect(withToken['Accept']).assertEqual('application/json');
      expect(CloudSpaceApi.normalizeBase('  http://x/drop///  ')).assertEqual('http://x/drop');
    });

    it('request_specs', 0, () => {
      const api: CloudSpaceApi = new CloudSpaceApi();
      const mine: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.mineSpec();
      expect(mine.method).assertEqual('GET');
      expect(mine.path).assertEqual('/mine');
      const open: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.openSpec();
      expect(open.method).assertEqual('POST');
      expect(open.bodyText).assertEqual('{}');
      const state: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.stateSpec('s 1', 7);
      expect(state.path.indexOf('sessionId=s%201') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(state.path.indexOf('since=7') > 0).assertTrue();
      const init: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.initSpec('s1', 'a.pdf', 1024, 'application/pdf', 1);
      expect(init.bodyText.indexOf('"totalChunks":1') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(init.bodyText.indexOf('"sessionId":"s1"') > 0).assertTrue();
      const chunk: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.chunkSpec('u1', 2);
      expect(chunk.path).assertEqual('/upload/chunk?uploadId=u1&index=2');
      expect(chunk.contentType).assertEqual('application/octet-stream');
      const finish: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.finishSpec('s1', 'u1');
      expect(finish.path).assertEqual('/upload/finish');
      const del: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.deleteSpec('f/1', 's1');
      expect(del.method).assertEqual('DELETE');
      expect(del.path.indexOf('/file/f%2F1') >= 0).assertTrue();
      const close: CloudSpaceRequestSpec = api.closeSpec('s1');
      expect(close.bodyText.indexOf('"sessionId":"s1"') > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('interpret_status_and_ok_false', 0, () => {
      const ok: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> = CloudSpaceApi.interpret(200, '{"ok":true,"session":null}');
      expect(ok.ok).assertTrue();
      const rejected: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> = CloudSpaceApi.interpret(200, '{"ok":false,"reason":"文件数超限"}');
      expect(rejected.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(rejected.error!.displayMessage()).assertEqual('文件数超限');
      const unauthorized: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> = CloudSpaceApi.interpret(401, '{"ok":false,"reason":"身份无效"}');
      expect(unauthorized.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(unauthorized.error!.kind).assertEqual(CloudSpaceErrorKind.TOKEN_INVALID);
      const serverError: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> = CloudSpaceApi.interpret(507, '{"ok":false,"reason":"磁盘不足"}');
      expect(serverError.error!.displayMessage()).assertEqual('磁盘不足');
      const nonJson: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> = CloudSpaceApi.interpret(200, 'not-json');
      expect(nonJson.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(nonJson.error!.kind).assertEqual(CloudSpaceErrorKind.PARSE);
      const notFound: CloudSpaceResult<Blob> = CloudSpaceApi.interpret(404, '{"reason":"文件已过期"}');
      expect(notFound.error!.displayMessage()).assertEqual('文件已过期');
    });

    it('parse_session_state_init_file', 0, () => {
      const sessionBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse('{"id":"s1","code":"123456","createdAt":1,"expiresAt":2}');
      const session: CloudSpaceSession | undefined = CloudSpaceApi.parseSessionNode(sessionBlob);
      expect(session !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(session!.id).assertEqual('s1');
      expect(CloudSpaceApi.parseSessionNode(JsonBlob.parse('{"code":"x"}')) === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceApi.parseSessionNode(undefined) === undefined).assertTrue();

      const stateJson: string = '{"ok":true,"session":{"id":"s1"},"cursor":5,"events":['
        + '{"seq":4,"kind":"file","at":1000,"payload":{"fileId":"f1","name":"a.pdf","size":10,'
        + '"mime":"application/pdf","downloadUrl":"http://x/f/1?s=1"}},'
        + '{"seq":5,"kind":"filedel","payload":{"fileId":"f0"}},'
        + '{"seq":6,"kind":"text","payload":{"text":"hi"}}]}';
      const stateBlob: Blob = JsonBlob.parse(stateJson)!;
      const state: CloudSpaceState = CloudSpaceApi.parseState(stateBlob);
      expect(state.session !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(state.events.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(state.events[0].kind).assertEqual('file');
      expect(state.events[0].file!.name).assertEqual('a.pdf');
      expect(state.events[0].file!.uploadedAt).assertEqual(1000);
      expect(state.events[0].file!.expired).assertFalse();
      expect(state.events[1].kind).assertEqual('filedel');
      expect(state.events[1].fileId).assertEqual('f0');
      expect(state.cursor).assertEqual(5);

      const expiredState: CloudSpaceState = CloudSpaceApi.parseState(
        JsonBlob.parse('{"events":[{"seq":1,"kind":"file","at":1,"payload":{"fileId":"f","name":"n","size":1}}]}')!);
      expect(expiredState.events[0].file!.expired).assertTrue();
      expect(expiredState.events[0].file!.downloadUrl).assertEqual('');
      expect(expiredState.cursor).assertEqual(1);

      const init: CloudSpaceUploadInit | undefined =
        CloudSpaceApi.parseInit(JsonBlob.parse('{"uploadId":"u1"}')!);
      expect(init !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(init!.chunkSize).assertEqual(CloudSpaceDefaults.CHUNK_SIZE);
      expect(CloudSpaceApi.parseInit(JsonBlob.parse('{}')!) === undefined).assertTrue();

      const finished: CloudSpaceFile | undefined = CloudSpaceApi.parseFinishedFile(
        JsonBlob.parse('{"file":{"id":"f2","name":"b.png","size":20,"mime":"image/png","downloadUrl":"http://x"}}')!);
      expect(finished !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(finished!.id).assertEqual('f2');
      expect(finished!.downloadUrl).assertEqual('http://x');
      expect(CloudSpaceApi.parseDeleted(JsonBlob.parse('{"deleted":true}')!)).assertTrue();
      expect(CloudSpaceApi.parseDeleted(JsonBlob.parse('{"deleted":false}')!)).assertFalse();
      expect(CloudSpaceApi.parseReceived(JsonBlob.parse('{"received":42}')!)).assertEqual(42);
    });
  });
}

const HEALTH_JSON: string = '['
  + '{"id":"gateway","name":"云端网关","kind":"cloud","status":"ok","detail":"全部通过","checked_at":"2026-11-15T00:30:00+08:00"},'
  + '{"id":"site_static","name":"静态站","kind":"cloud","status":"warn","detail":"已按备案暂停","checked_at":"2026-11-15T00:30:00+08:00"},'

  + '{"id":"a1","severity":"warn","title":"静态站暂停","status":"done","cause":"备案暂停期","fix":"等待备案","ts":1794670000000,"related":"{\\"health_ids\\":[\\"site_static\\"]}"},'

  + '{"id":"r2","action":"restart_gateway","status":"failed","error":"timeout","created_at":1794660000000}]';

function check(id: string, status: DiagStatus): DiagCheck {
  const item: DiagCheck = new DiagCheck();
  item.id = id;
  item.label = id;
  item.status = status;
  return item;
}

export default function diagTest() {
  describe('DiagStatus', () => {
    it('labels_and_colors', 0, () => {
      expect(diagStatusLabel(DiagStatus.PASS)).assertEqual('正常');
      expect(diagStatusLabel(DiagStatus.WARN)).assertEqual('注意');
      expect(diagStatusLabel(DiagStatus.FAIL)).assertEqual('异常');
      expect(diagStatusLabel(DiagStatus.INFO)).assertEqual('信息');
      expect(diagStatusColor(DiagStatus.PASS)).assertEqual('#4E9082');
      expect(diagStatusColor(DiagStatus.FAIL)).assertEqual('#B4543F');
    });

    it('health_row_display_status', 0, () => {
      const row: ServiceHealthRow = new ServiceHealthRow();
      row.status = 'ok';
      expect(row.displayStatus()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.PASS);
      row.status = 'WARN';
      expect(row.displayStatus()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.WARN);
      row.status = 'down';
      expect(row.displayStatus()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.FAIL);
      row.status = 'unknown-x';
      expect(row.displayStatus()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.INFO);
    });

    it('summary_counts_and_overall', 0, () => {
      const summary: DiagSummary = new DiagSummary();
      summary.checks = [check('a', DiagStatus.PASS), check('b', DiagStatus.PASS)];
      expect(summary.passCount()).assertEqual(2);
      expect(summary.overall()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.PASS);
      summary.checks.push(check('c', DiagStatus.WARN));
      expect(summary.warnCount()).assertEqual(1);
      expect(summary.overall()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.WARN);
      summary.checks.push(check('d', DiagStatus.FAIL));
      expect(summary.failCount()).assertEqual(1);
      expect(summary.overall()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.FAIL);
      expect(summary.checks[2].shouldReport()).assertTrue();
      expect(summary.checks[0].shouldReport()).assertFalse();
    });
  });

  describe('DiagReport', () => {
    it('builds_anomaly_row', 0, () => {
      const warn: DiagCheck = check('gateway', DiagStatus.WARN);
      warn.value = '3200 ms';
      warn.hint = '延迟偏高';
      const row: Blob | undefined = DiagReport.build([check('app', DiagStatus.PASS), warn], 1234);
      expect(row !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (row !== undefined) {
        expect(row['kind']).assertEqual('diag');
        expect(row['level']).assertEqual('warn');
        expect(row['fingerprint']).assertEqual('gateway');
        const detail: Blob | undefined = row['detail'] as Blob;
        expect(detail['check']).assertEqual('gateway');
      }
    });

    it('includes_service_health', 0, () => {
      const warn: ServiceHealthRow = new ServiceHealthRow();
      warn.id = 'hw_sync';
      warn.name = '学工记云同步';
      warn.status = 'warn';
      warn.detail = '暂无作业';
      const pass: ServiceHealthRow = new ServiceHealthRow();
      pass.id = 'db';
      pass.status = 'pass';
      const checks: DiagCheck[] = DiagReport.fromHealth([warn, pass]);
      expect(checks.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(checks[0].id).assertEqual('svc:hw_sync');
      expect(checks[0].label).assertEqual('学工记云同步');
      const row: Blob | undefined = DiagReport.buildAll([check('app', DiagStatus.PASS)], [warn], 7);
      expect(row !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (row !== undefined) {
        const detail: Blob | undefined = row['detail'] as Blob;
        expect(detail['check']).assertEqual('svc:hw_sync');
      }
      expect(DiagReport.buildAll([], [pass], 8) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('error_level_and_multi', 0, () => {
      const a: DiagCheck = check('gateway', DiagStatus.FAIL);
      const b: DiagCheck = check('session', DiagStatus.WARN);
      const row: Blob | undefined = DiagReport.build([a, b], 99);
      if (row !== undefined) {
        expect(row['level']).assertEqual('error');
        expect(row['fingerprint']).assertEqual('gateway+session');
        const detail: Blob | undefined = row['detail'] as Blob;
        expect(detail['check']).assertEqual('multi');
      }
      expect(DiagReport.build([check('x', DiagStatus.PASS)], 1) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('throttle_window', 0, () => {
      expect(DiagThrottle.canReport(0, 1000)).assertTrue();
      expect(DiagThrottle.canReport(1000, 1000 + 5 * 60 * 1000)).assertFalse();
      expect(DiagThrottle.canReport(1000, 1000 + 11 * 60 * 1000)).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('DiagRepository', () => {
    it('parses_health_rows', 0, () => {
      const rows: ServiceHealthRow[] = DiagRepository.parseHealth(HEALTH_JSON);
      expect(rows.length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(rows[0].id).assertEqual('gateway');
      expect(rows[0].name).assertEqual('云端网关');
      expect(rows[0].displayStatus()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.PASS);
      expect(rows[1].displayStatus()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.WARN);
      expect(rows[2].displayStatus()).assertEqual(DiagStatus.FAIL);
      expect(DiagRepository.parseHealth('bad').length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('parses_analyses_and_repairs', 0, () => {
      const analyses: DiagAnalysis[] = DiagRepository.parseAnalyses(ANALYSIS_JSON);
      expect(analyses.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(analyses[0].title).assertEqual('静态站暂停');
      expect(analyses[0].severity).assertEqual('warn');
      expect(analyses[0].related.indexOf('site_static') > 0).assertTrue();
      const repairs: RepairTask[] = DiagRepository.parseRepairs(REPAIR_JSON);
      expect(repairs.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(repairs[0].action).assertEqual('recheck_health');
      expect(repairs[1].status).assertEqual('failed');
    });

    it('loads_health_and_analyses_via_api', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.diagHealthBody = HEALTH_JSON;
      api.diagAnalysisBody = ANALYSIS_JSON;
      api.diagRepairBody = REPAIR_JSON;
      const repo: DiagRepository = new DiagRepository(api);
      const health: DiagHealthResult = await repo.health();
      expect(health.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(health.rows.length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('service_health?select=id,name') === 0).assertTrue();
      const analyses: DiagAnalysisResult = await repo.analyses();
      expect(analyses.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(analyses.analyses.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(analyses.repairs.length).assertEqual(2);
    });

    it('probe_measures_latency_and_failure', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.diagHealthBody = '[]';
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: DiagRepository = new DiagRepository(api, () => now);
      const probe: GatewayProbe = await repo.probe();
      expect(probe.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(probe.latencyMs >= 1).assertTrue();
      api.failGets = true;
      const failed: GatewayProbe = await repo.probe();
      expect(failed.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(failed.message.length > 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}

function config(start: number, end: number, count: number): DrawConfig {
  const c: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig();
  c.start = start;
  c.end = end;
  c.count = count;
  return c;
}

function numbersOf(entries: DrawEntry[]): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
    out.push(entries[i].number);
  }
  return out;
}

function uniqueCount(numbers: number[]): number {
  const set: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
  for (let i = 0; i < numbers.length; i++) {
    set.add(numbers[i]);
  }
  return set.size;
}

export default function drawTest() {
  describe('DrawRandom', () => {
    it('same_seed_same_sequence', 0, () => {
      const a: DrawRandom = new SeededDrawRandom(42);
      const b: DrawRandom = new SeededDrawRandom(42);
      for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        expect(a.nextInt(100)).assertEqual(b.nextInt(100));
      }
    });

    it('next_int_stays_in_bound', 0, () => {
      const rng: DrawRandom = new SeededDrawRandom(7);
      for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        const value: number = rng.nextInt(10);
        expect(value >= 0 && value < 10).assertTrue();
      }
      expect(rng.nextInt(0)).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('shuffle_is_permutation', 0, () => {
      const order: number[] = shuffledInts(50, new SeededDrawRandom(9));
      expect(order.length).assertEqual(50);
      expect(uniqueCount(order)).assertEqual(50);
    });
  });

  describe('DrawValidator', () => {
    it('parses_exclusions_with_ranges', 0, () => {
      const parsed: ExcludedParse = DrawValidator.parseExcluded('3,7,10-12，15、20~22');
      expect(parsed.isValid()).assertTrue();
      expect(parsed.numbers.has(3)).assertTrue();
      expect(parsed.numbers.has(11)).assertTrue();
      expect(parsed.numbers.has(22)).assertTrue();
      expect(parsed.numbers.size).assertEqual(9);
    });

    it('rejects_bad_exclusions', 0, () => {
      const parsed: ExcludedParse = DrawValidator.parseExcluded('abc,5-2,1000');
      expect(parsed.isValid()).assertFalse();
      expect(parsed.invalidTokens.length).assertEqual(3);
    });

    it('rejects_start_greater_than_end', 0, () => {
      const result = DrawValidator.validate(config(50, 10, 5), []);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
    });

    it('rejects_count_out_of_range', 0, () => {
      const result = DrawValidator.validate(config(1, 10, 0), []);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
    });

    it('rejects_exclusion_format', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 10, 3);
      c.excludedText = 'x';
      const result = DrawValidator.validate(c, []);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
    });

    it('rejects_count_exceeding_pool', 0, () => {
      const result = DrawValidator.validate(config(1, 5, 6), []);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
    });

    it('allows_duplicates_exceeding_pool', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 5, 20);
      c.allowDuplicates = true;
      expect(DrawValidator.validate(c, []).ok).assertTrue();
    });

    it('pool_excludes_numbers', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 10, 5);
      c.excludedText = '2,4';
      const result = DrawValidator.validate(c, []);
      expect(result.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(result.numbers.length).assertEqual(8);
      expect(result.numbers.indexOf(2) < 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('roster_source_intersects_seats', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 10, 3);
      c.poolSource = DrawPoolSource.ROSTER;
      const result = DrawValidator.validate(c, [2, 4, 6, 99]);
      expect(result.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(result.numbers.join(',')).assertEqual('2,4,6');
    });

    it('roster_source_without_seats_is_error', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 10, 3);
      c.poolSource = DrawPoolSource.ROSTER;
      expect(DrawValidator.validate(c, []).ok).assertFalse();
    });
  });

  describe('DrawEngine', () => {
    it('unique_draw_has_no_duplicates_and_stays_in_range', 0, () => {
      const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(config(1, 70, 10), [], (n: number) => '', new SeededDrawRandom(1));
      expect(outcome.ok).assertTrue();
      const numbers: number[] = numbersOf(outcome.result!.entries);
      expect(numbers.length).assertEqual(10);
      expect(uniqueCount(numbers)).assertEqual(10);
      for (let i = 0; i < numbers.length; i++) {
        expect(numbers[i] >= 1 && numbers[i] <= 70).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('duplicates_allowed_can_repeat', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 3, 30);
      c.allowDuplicates = true;
      const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(c, [], (n: number) => '', new SeededDrawRandom(2));
      expect(outcome.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(outcome.result!.entries.length).assertEqual(30);
      expect(uniqueCount(numbersOf(outcome.result!.entries)) < 30).assertTrue();
    });

    it('name_mapping_is_used', 0, () => {
      const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(config(1, 3, 3), [], (n: number) => '名' + n,
        new SeededDrawRandom(3));
      expect(outcome.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(outcome.result!.entries[0].name.indexOf('名') === 0).assertTrue();
      expect(outcome.result!.entries[0].label().indexOf('名') > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('ascending_sort_orders_numbers', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 70, 8);
      c.sort = DrawSortMode.ASCENDING;
      const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(c, [], (n: number) => '', new SeededDrawRandom(4));
      const numbers: number[] = numbersOf(outcome.result!.entries);
      for (let i = 1; i < numbers.length; i++) {
        expect(numbers[i] >= numbers[i - 1]).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('descending_sort_orders_numbers', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 70, 8);
      c.sort = DrawSortMode.DESCENDING;
      const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(c, [], (n: number) => '', new SeededDrawRandom(5));
      const numbers: number[] = numbersOf(outcome.result!.entries);
      for (let i = 1; i < numbers.length; i++) {
        expect(numbers[i] <= numbers[i - 1]).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('remove_and_redraw_restores_size_and_keeps_unique', 0, () => {
      const rng: DrawRandom = new SeededDrawRandom(6);
      let outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(config(1, 10, 3), [], (n: number) => '', rng);
      const removedNumber: number = outcome.result!.entries[0].number;
      outcome = DrawEngine.removeAndRedraw(outcome.result!, 0, true, rng);
      expect(outcome.ok).assertTrue();
      const numbers: number[] = numbersOf(outcome.result!.entries);
      expect(numbers.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(uniqueCount(numbers)).assertEqual(3);
      expect(numbers.indexOf(removedNumber) < 0).assertTrue();
      expect(outcome.result!.log.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(outcome.result!.log[0].added !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('remove_without_redraw_shrinks', 0, () => {
      const rng: DrawRandom = new SeededDrawRandom(7);
      let outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(config(1, 10, 3), [], (n: number) => '', rng);
      outcome = DrawEngine.removeAndRedraw(outcome.result!, 0, false, rng);
      expect(outcome.result!.entries.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(outcome.result!.log[0].added === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('remove_invalid_index_fails', 0, () => {
      const rng: DrawRandom = new SeededDrawRandom(8);
      const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(config(1, 10, 2), [], (n: number) => '', rng);
      expect(DrawEngine.removeAndRedraw(outcome.result!, 5, true, rng).ok).assertFalse();
    });

    it('reroll_keeps_pool_and_count', 0, () => {
      const rng: DrawRandom = new SeededDrawRandom(9);
      const outcome: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.draw(config(1, 20, 5), [], (n: number) => '', rng);
      const again: DrawOutcome = DrawEngine.reroll(outcome.result!, rng);
      expect(again.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(again.result!.entries.length).assertEqual(5);
      expect(again.result!.pool.length).assertEqual(20);
    });
  });

  describe('DrawWorkflow', () => {
    it('config_to_preview_to_result', 0, () => {
      let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
      state = DrawWorkflow.updateConfig(state, config(1, 20, 3));
      const preview: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.toPreview(state, [], (n: number) => '');
      expect(preview.ok).assertTrue();
      state = preview.state!;
      expect(state.step).assertEqual(DrawStep.PREVIEW);
      expect(state.candidates.length).assertEqual(20);

      const drawn: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.startDraw(state, new SeededDrawRandom(10));
      expect(drawn.ok).assertTrue();
      state = drawn.state!;
      expect(state.step).assertEqual(DrawStep.RESULT);
      expect(state.result!.entries.length).assertEqual(3);
    });

    it('invalid_config_blocks_preview', 0, () => {
      let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
      state = DrawWorkflow.updateConfig(state, config(30, 10, 3));
      const preview: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.toPreview(state, [], (n: number) => '');
      expect(preview.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(preview.error !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('start_draw_requires_preview', 0, () => {
      const state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
      expect(DrawWorkflow.startDraw(state, new SeededDrawRandom(1)).ok).assertFalse();
    });

    it('back_walks_steps_and_clears', 0, () => {
      let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
      state = DrawWorkflow.updateConfig(state, config(1, 10, 2));
      state = DrawWorkflow.toPreview(state, [], (n: number) => '').state!;
      state = DrawWorkflow.startDraw(state, new SeededDrawRandom(2)).state!;
      state = DrawWorkflow.back(state);
      expect(state.step).assertEqual(DrawStep.PREVIEW);
      expect(state.result === undefined).assertTrue();
      state = DrawWorkflow.back(state);
      expect(state.step).assertEqual(DrawStep.CONFIG);
      expect(state.candidates.length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('change_sort_updates_config', 0, () => {
      let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
      state = DrawWorkflow.updateConfig(state, config(1, 30, 4));
      state = DrawWorkflow.toPreview(state, [], (n: number) => '').state!;
      state = DrawWorkflow.startDraw(state, new SeededDrawRandom(3)).state!;
      const changed: DrawTransition = DrawWorkflow.changeSort(state, DrawSortMode.ASCENDING, new SeededDrawRandom(4));
      expect(changed.ok).assertTrue();
      state = changed.state!;
      expect(state.config.sort).assertEqual(DrawSortMode.ASCENDING);
      expect(state.result!.config.sort).assertEqual(DrawSortMode.ASCENDING);
      const numbers: number[] = numbersOf(state.result!.entries);
      for (let i = 1; i < numbers.length; i++) {
        expect(numbers[i] >= numbers[i - 1]).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('config_is_locked_after_preview', 0, () => {
      let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
      state = DrawWorkflow.updateConfig(state, config(1, 10, 2));
      state = DrawWorkflow.toPreview(state, [], (n: number) => '').state!;
      const changed: DrawWorkflowState = DrawWorkflow.updateConfig(state, config(1, 99, 9));
      expect(changed.config.end).assertEqual(10);
    });

    it('reset_keeps_config_clears_data', 0, () => {
      let state: DrawWorkflowState = new DrawWorkflowState();
      state = DrawWorkflow.updateConfig(state, config(1, 10, 2));
      state = DrawWorkflow.toPreview(state, [], (n: number) => '').state!;
      state = DrawWorkflow.startDraw(state, new SeededDrawRandom(5)).state!;
      state = DrawWorkflow.reset(state);
      expect(state.step).assertEqual(DrawStep.CONFIG);
      expect(state.config.end).assertEqual(10);
      expect(state.result === undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('DrawConfigCodec', () => {
    it('roundtrip_keeps_contract_key_order', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(2, 50, 10);
      c.excludedText = '3,7';
      c.sort = DrawSortMode.ASCENDING;
      const blob: Blob = DrawConfigCodec.toJson(c);
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(blob).join(',')).assertEqual('start,end,count,dup,excl,sort');
      const back: DrawConfig = DrawConfigCodec.fromJson(blob);
      expect(back.start).assertEqual(2);
      expect(back.end).assertEqual(50);
      expect(back.count).assertEqual(10);
      expect(back.excludedText).assertEqual('3,7');
      expect(back.sort).assertEqual(DrawSortMode.ASCENDING);
    });

    it('missing_section_uses_defaults', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = DrawConfigCodec.fromJson(undefined);
      expect(c.start).assertEqual(DrawConfig.DEFAULT_START);
      expect(c.end).assertEqual(DrawConfig.DEFAULT_END);
      expect(c.count).assertEqual(DrawConfig.DEFAULT_COUNT);
      expect(c.sort).assertEqual(DrawSortMode.DRAW_ORDER);
    });

    it('dirty_values_are_clamped', 0, () => {
      const blob: Blob = {
        'start': 0,
        'end': 99999,
        'count': -3,
        'dup': 'yes',
        'excl': 5,
        'sort': 'unknown'
      };
      const c: DrawConfig = DrawConfigCodec.fromJson(blob);
      expect(c.start).assertEqual(DrawConfig.MIN_NUMBER);
      expect(c.end).assertEqual(DrawConfig.MAX_NUMBER);
      expect(c.count).assertEqual(DrawConfig.MIN_COUNT);
      expect(c.allowDuplicates).assertFalse();
      expect(c.excludedText).assertEqual('');
      expect(c.sort).assertEqual(DrawSortMode.DRAW_ORDER);
    });

    it('string_numbers_are_accepted', 0, () => {
      const blob: Blob = { 'start': '3', 'end': '12', 'count': '4' };
      const c: DrawConfig = DrawConfigCodec.fromJson(blob);
      expect(c.start).assertEqual(3);
      expect(c.end).assertEqual(12);
      expect(c.count).assertEqual(4);
    });

    it('pool_source_is_not_persisted', 0, () => {
      const c: DrawConfig = config(1, 10, 2);
      c.poolSource = DrawPoolSource.ROSTER;
      const back: DrawConfig = DrawConfigCodec.fromJson(DrawConfigCodec.toJson(c));
      expect(back.poolSource).assertEqual(DrawPoolSource.RANGE);
    });

    it('unknown_fields_are_preserved_on_write', 0, () => {
      const existing: Blob = {
        'start': 1,
        'end': 70,
        'count': 10,
        'dup': false,
        'excl': '',
        'sort': 'draw',
        'names': '1 甲\n2 乙'
      };
      const written: Blob = DrawConfigCodec.toJson(config(2, 20, 3), existing);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(written, 'names'), '')).assertEqual('1 甲\n2 乙');
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(written, 'end'))).assertEqual(20);
    });

    it('draw_section_syncs_through_userdata', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => '3260799999', () => 5000);
      await repo.pull(true);

      // 模拟 UI：读当前 draw section（含未知 names），写回新参数
      const current: Blob = repo.currentSections();
      const next: Blob = {};
      const keys: string[] = JsonBlob.keys(current);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        next[keys[i]] = current[keys[i]];
      }
      const existing: Blob = { 'names': '7 张三' };
      const edited: DrawConfig = config(3, 33, 6);
      edited.excludedText = '5';
      next['draw'] = DrawConfigCodec.toJson(edited, existing);
      await repo.updateCurrent(next);

      const pushed: UserdataPushResult = await repo.flush();
      expect(pushed.ok()).assertTrue();
      expect(pushed.pushed).assertTrue();

      const rows: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JSON.parse(api.lastPostBody()) as JsonValue);
      expect(rows !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (rows !== undefined) {
        const row: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(rows[0]);
        const blobText: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(row, 'blob'), '');
        const blob: Blob | undefined = UserdataV6.decode(blobText);
        expect(blob !== undefined).assertTrue();
        if (blob !== undefined) {
          const draw: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'draw'));
          expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(draw, 'start'))).assertEqual(3);
          expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(draw, 'end'))).assertEqual(33);
          expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(draw, 'names'), '')).assertEqual('7 张三');
          expect(UserdataV6.atValue(blob, 'draw')).assertEqual(5000);
        }
      }
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  DrawConfig,
  DrawEntry,
  DrawPoolSource,
  DrawRemoveLog,
  DrawResult,
  DrawSortMode
} from '../main/ets/features/draw/DrawModels';
import { DrawExportFactory, ExportCardSpec, ExportNaming, ExportParam } from '../main/ets/features/export/ExportCard';

const NOW: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 22, 30, 0).getTime();

function sampleConfig(): DrawConfig {
  const config: DrawConfig = new DrawConfig();
  config.start = 1;
  config.end = 50;
  config.count = 3;
  config.excludedText = '5';
  config.sort = DrawSortMode.ASCENDING;
  return config;
}

function sampleResult(): DrawResult {
  const result: DrawResult = new DrawResult();
  result.config = sampleConfig();
  result.entries = [new DrawEntry(7, '张三'), new DrawEntry(9, ''), new DrawEntry(12, '李四')];
  const pool: DrawEntry[] = [];
  for (let n = 1; n <= 50; n++) {
    if (n !== 5) {
      pool.push(new DrawEntry(n, ''));
    }
  }
  result.pool = pool;
  result.log = [new DrawRemoveLog(new DrawEntry(3, '王五'), new DrawEntry(8, '赵六'))];
  return result;
}

function paramValue(spec: ExportCardSpec, label: string): string {
  for (let i = 0; i < spec.params.length; i++) {
    if (spec.params[i].label === label) {
      return spec.params[i].value;
    }
  }
  return '';
}

export default function exportTest() {
  describe('ExportNaming', () => {
    it('stamp_and_time_use_local_format', 0, () => {
      expect(ExportNaming.stamp(NOW)).assertEqual('20261114-2230');
      expect(ExportNaming.timeText(NOW)).assertEqual('2026-11-14 22:30');
    });

    it('record_id_uppercases_suffix', 0, () => {
      expect(ExportNaming.recordId('DRAW', NOW, 'ab12c')).assertEqual('DRAW-20261114-2230-AB12C');
    });

    it('safe_name_replaces_illegal_chars', 0, () => {
      expect(ExportNaming.safeName('a/b:c*d?"e<f>g|h.png')).assertEqual('a_b_c_d__e_f_g_h.png');
    });

    it('random_suffix_is_5_chars', 0, () => {
      expect(ExportNaming.randomSuffix().length).assertEqual(5);
    });
  });

  describe('DrawExportFactory', () => {
    it('file_name_matches_spec', 0, () => {
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(sampleResult(), NOW, 'abc12');
      expect(spec.fileName).assertEqual('抽签结果_20261114-2230_范围1-50_抽3个_不重复_从小到大.png');
    });

    it('duplicates_and_random_sort_are_reflected', 0, () => {
      const result: DrawResult = sampleResult();
      result.config.allowDuplicates = true;
      result.config.sort = DrawSortMode.RANDOM;
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(result, NOW, 'AA111');
      expect(spec.fileName.indexOf('允许重复') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(spec.fileName.indexOf('随机') > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('record_id_and_footer', 0, () => {
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(sampleResult(), NOW, 'xyz99');
      expect(spec.recordId).assertEqual('DRAW-20261114-2230-XYZ99');
      expect(spec.footer).assertEqual('生成时间 2026-11-14 22:30');
      expect(spec.generatedAt).assertEqual(NOW);
    });

    it('params_cover_draw_fields', 0, () => {
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(sampleResult(), NOW, 'abc12');
      expect(spec.params.length).assertEqual(6);
      expect(paramValue(spec, '范围')).assertEqual('1 – 50');
      expect(paramValue(spec, '抽取个数')).assertEqual('3');
      expect(paramValue(spec, '允许重复')).assertEqual('否');
      expect(paramValue(spec, '排除序号')).assertEqual('5');
      expect(paramValue(spec, '结果排序')).assertEqual('从小到大');
      expect(paramValue(spec, '可用池')).assertEqual('共 49 个');
    });

    it('roster_source_adds_extra_param', 0, () => {
      const result: DrawResult = sampleResult();
      result.config.poolSource = DrawPoolSource.ROSTER;
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(result, NOW, 'abc12');
      expect(spec.params.length).assertEqual(7);
      expect(paramValue(spec, '候选来源')).assertEqual('班级名单');
    });

    it('chips_keep_numbers_and_names', 0, () => {
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(sampleResult(), NOW, 'abc12');
      expect(spec.chips.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(spec.chips[0].n).assertEqual(7);
      expect(spec.chips[0].nm).assertEqual('张三');
      expect(spec.chips[1].nm).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('remove_log_lines_render_labels', 0, () => {
      const result: DrawResult = sampleResult();
      result.log.push(new DrawRemoveLog(new DrawEntry(20, ''), undefined));
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(result, NOW, 'abc12');
      expect(spec.noteLines.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(spec.noteLines[0]).assertEqual('#1 剔除 3 王五 → 重抽 8 赵六');
      expect(spec.noteLines[1]).assertEqual('#2 剔除 20 → 重抽 （未补抽）');
    });

    it('title_and_subtitle', 0, () => {
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(sampleResult(), NOW, 'abc12');
      expect(spec.title).assertEqual('随机抽签结果');
      expect(spec.subtitle).assertEqual('共 3 个 · 范围 1–50');
      expect(spec.chipLabel).assertEqual('抽签结果');
    });

    it('no_remove_log_keeps_notes_empty', 0, () => {
      const result: DrawResult = sampleResult();
      result.log = [];
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = DrawExportFactory.create(result, NOW, 'abc12');
      expect(spec.noteLines.length).assertEqual(0);
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  FIT_INPUT_FIELDS,
  FitCalc,
  FitFieldSpec,
  FitFields,
  FitGrade,
  FitHistory,
  FitInput,
  FitRecord,
  FitSex,
  SavedHistory
} from '../main/ets/features/fit/FitModels';
import { FitTables } from '../main/ets/features/fit/FitTables';
import { FitScoring } from '../main/ets/features/fit/FitScoring';
import { FitCodec } from '../main/ets/features/fit/FitCodec';
import { ExportCardSpec, FitExportFactory } from '../main/ets/features/export/ExportCard';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

function fullInput(): FitInput {
  const input: FitInput = new FitInput();
  input.sex = FitSex.MALE;
  input.grade = FitGrade.G12;
  input.h = '178';
  input.w = '65';
  input.vc = '4200';
  input.r50 = '7.0';
  input.sit = '10';
  input.jump = '230';
  input.pull = '12';
  input.durM = '4';
  input.durS = '0';
  return input;
}

function rowScore(calc: FitCalc, index: number): number | undefined {
  return calc.rows[index].score;
}

export default function fitTest() {
  describe('FitHelpers', () => {
    it('num_parses_and_rejects', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.num(' 12.5 ')).assertEqual(12.5);
      expect(FitScoring.num('') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(FitScoring.num('abc') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('sec_combines_minutes_and_seconds', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.sec('4', '30')).assertEqual(270);
      expect(FitScoring.sec('', '45')).assertEqual(45);
      expect(FitScoring.sec('3', '')).assertEqual(180);
      expect(FitScoring.sec('', '') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('ms_formats', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.ms(270)).assertEqual('4\'30"');
      expect(FitScoring.ms(59.6)).assertEqual('1\'00"');
      expect(FitScoring.ms(undefined)).assertEqual('—');
    });

    it('round10_rounds_one_decimal', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.round10(78.65)).assertEqual(78.7);
      expect(FitScoring.round10(12.34)).assertEqual(12.3);
    });

    it('sanitize_keeps_digits_and_decimals', 0, () => {
      const h: FitFieldSpec = FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[0];
      expect(FitScoring.sanitizeInput('17a8.55', h)).assertEqual('178.5');
      const sit: FitFieldSpec = FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[4];
      expect(FitScoring.sanitizeInput('-12.5', sit)).assertEqual('-12.5');
      const vc: FitFieldSpec = FIT_INPUT_FIELDS[2];
      expect(FitScoring.sanitizeInput('4200.9', vc)).assertEqual('4200');
    });
  });

  describe('FitTablesScoring', () => {
    it('vc_top_score', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.VC, 5040, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(100);
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.VC, 4200, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(78);
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.VC, 100, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('r50_lower_is_better', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.R50, 6.7, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(100);
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.R50, 7.0, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(85);
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.R50, 11.0, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('sit_negative_values_score', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.SIT, -1.3, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(10);
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.SIT, 24.9, FitSex.MALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(100);
    });

    it('female_tables_differ', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.SUP, 56, FitSex.FEMALE, FitGrade.G12)).assertEqual(100);
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.SUP, 56, FitSex.FEMALE, FitGrade.G34)).assertEqual(95);
      expect(FitScoring.scoreOf(FitTables.PULL, 19, FitSex.FEMALE, FitGrade.G12) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('plus_tables', 0, () => {
      expect(FitScoring.plusOf(FitTables.PULL_PLUS, 6)).assertEqual(6);
      expect(FitScoring.plusOf(FitTables.PULL_PLUS, 20)).assertEqual(10);
      expect(FitScoring.plusOf(FitTables.PULL_PLUS, 0)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(FitScoring.plusOf(FitTables.DUR_MALE_PLUS, 37)).assertEqual(10);
    });
  });

  describe('FitCalc', () => {
    it('full_male_example', 0, () => {
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(fullInput());
      expect(calc.rows.length).assertEqual(7);
      expect(rowScore(calc, 0)).assertEqual(100); // BMI
      expect(rowScore(calc, 1)).assertEqual(78); // 肺活量
      expect(rowScore(calc, 2)).assertEqual(85); // 50m
      expect(rowScore(calc, 3)).assertEqual(68); // 坐位体前屈
      expect(rowScore(calc, 4)).assertEqual(70); // 立定跳远
      expect(rowScore(calc, 5)).assertEqual(68); // 引体
      expect(rowScore(calc, 6)).assertEqual(72); // 1000m
      expect(calc.std).assertEqual(78.7);
      expect(calc.plus).assertEqual(0);
      expect(calc.total).assertEqual(78.7);
      expect(calc.grade).assertEqual('及格');
      expect(calc.miss).assertEqual(0);
      expect(calc.wtDone).assertEqual(100);
      expect(calc.bmi !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(calc.bmiCategory).assertEqual('正常');
    });

    it('bmi_categories', 0, () => {
      const low: FitInput = fullInput();
      low.w = '50';
      expect(FitScoring.calc(low).bmiCategory).assertEqual('低体重');
      const over: FitInput = fullInput();
      over.w = '80';
      expect(FitScoring.calc(over).bmiCategory).assertEqual('超重');
      const obese: FitInput = fullInput();
      obese.w = '95';
      expect(FitScoring.calc(obese).bmiCategory).assertEqual('肥胖');
      expect(FitScoring.calc(obese).rows[0].score).assertEqual(60);
    });

    it('missing_fields_counted_and_weighted', 0, () => {
      const input: FitInput = new FitInput();
      input.sex = FitSex.MALE;
      input.grade = FitGrade.G12;
      input.h = '178';
      input.w = '65';
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(input);
      expect(calc.miss).assertEqual(6);
      expect(calc.wtDone).assertEqual(15);
      expect(calc.std).assertEqual(15);
      expect(calc.grade).assertEqual('不及格');
    });

    it('female_uses_situp_and_800m', 0, () => {
      const input: FitInput = fullInput();
      input.sex = FitSex.FEMALE;
      input.pull = '56';
      input.durM = '4';
      input.durS = '10';
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(input);
      expect(calc.rows[5].name).assertEqual('1 分钟仰卧起坐');
      expect(calc.rows[6].name).assertEqual('800 米跑');
      expect(calc.rows[5].score).assertEqual(100);
    });

    it('plus_points_added', 0, () => {
      const input: FitInput = fullInput();
      input.pull = '25';
      input.durM = '2';
      input.durS = '40';
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(input);
      expect(calc.rows[5].plus).assertEqual(6);
      expect(calc.rows[6].plus).assertEqual(10);
      expect(calc.plus).assertEqual(16);
      expect(calc.total).assertEqual(FitScoring.round10(calc.std + 16));
    });

    it('invalid_values_treated_as_missing', 0, () => {
      const input: FitInput = fullInput();
      input.r50 = '1.0'; // 小于 3 秒，非法
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(input);
      expect(calc.rows[2].score === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(calc.miss).assertEqual(1);
    });
  });

  describe('FitCodec', () => {
    it('userdata_fit_roundtrip', 0, () => {
      const input: FitInput = fullInput();
      const blob: Blob = FitCodec.toJson(input);
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(blob).join(',')).assertEqual('sex,grade,h,w,vc,r50,sit,jump,pull,durM,durS');
      const back: FitInput = FitCodec.inputFromJson(blob);
      expect(back.sex).assertEqual(FitSex.MALE);
      expect(back.grade).assertEqual(FitGrade.G12);
      expect(back.h).assertEqual('178');
      expect(back.durS).assertEqual('0');
    });

    it('missing_section_defaults', 0, () => {
      const input: FitInput = FitCodec.inputFromJson(undefined);
      expect(input.sex).assertEqual(FitSex.MALE);
      expect(input.grade).assertEqual(FitGrade.G12);
      expect(input.h).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('unknown_fields_preserved', 0, () => {
      const existing: Blob = { 'sex': 'm', 'grade': '12', 'future': 'x' };
      const written: Blob = FitCodec.toJson(fullInput(), existing);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(written, 'future'), '')).assertEqual('x');
    });

    it('record_roundtrip', 0, () => {
      const record: FitRecord = new FitRecord();
      record.id = 'fit_1';
      record.ts = 1762310000000;
      record.name = '期中';
      record.sex = 'f';
      record.gradeBucket = '34';
      record.fields = fullInput().toFields();
      record.total = 88.5;
      record.grade = '良好';
      const data: string = FitCodec.recordToData(record);
      const back: FitRecord | undefined = FitCodec.recordFromData(data);
      expect(back !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (back !== undefined) {
        expect(back.id).assertEqual('fit_1');
        expect(back.name).assertEqual('期中');
        expect(back.sexEnum()).assertEqual(FitSex.FEMALE);
        expect(back.gradeEnum()).assertEqual(FitGrade.G34);
        expect(back.fields.r50).assertEqual('7.0');
        expect(back.total).assertEqual(88.5);
        expect(back.grade).assertEqual('良好');
      }
      expect(FitCodec.recordFromData('not-json') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('FitHistory', () => {

    it('subset_detection', 0, () => {
      const input: FitInput = fullInput();
      const subset: FitFields = input.toFields();
      const partial: FitFields = new FitRecord().fields;
      partial.h = '178';
      partial.w = '65';
      expect(FitHistory.isSubset(partial, subset)).assertTrue();
      partial.vc = '9999';
      expect(FitHistory.isSubset(partial, subset)).assertFalse();
      const empty: FitFields = new FitRecord().fields;
      expect(FitHistory.isSubset(empty, subset)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('merge_updates_existing_record', 0, () => {
      // 先只记身高体重，再补填其它项 → 旧记录非空项与新记录一致，应合并到同一条
      const partial: FitInput = new FitInput();
      partial.h = '178';
      partial.w = '65';
      const first: SavedHistory = FitHistory.save([], partial, FitScoring.calc(partial), 'id1', 1000, '');
      expect(first.records.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(first.merged).assertFalse();

      const richer: FitInput = fullInput();
      const second: SavedHistory = FitHistory.save(first.records, richer, FitScoring.calc(richer), 'id2', 2000, '');
      expect(second.merged).assertTrue();
      expect(second.records.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(second.records[0].id).assertEqual('id1');
      expect(second.records[0].ts).assertEqual(2000);
      expect(second.records[0].fields.vc).assertEqual('4200');
    });

    it('keeps_two_and_reports_dropped', 0, () => {
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(fullInput());
      const a: SavedHistory = FitHistory.save([], fullInput(), calc, 'id1', 1000, '');
      const other: FitInput = fullInput();
      other.sex = FitSex.FEMALE;
      const b: SavedHistory = FitHistory.save(a.records, other, FitScoring.calc(other), 'id2', 2000, '');
      const third: FitInput = new FitInput();
      third.sex = FitSex.MALE;
      third.grade = FitGrade.G34;
      third.h = '180';
      const c: SavedHistory = FitHistory.save(b.records, third, FitScoring.calc(third), 'id3', 3000, '');
      expect(c.records.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(c.dropped.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(c.records[0].id).assertEqual('id3');
    });

    it('delete_rename_restore', 0, () => {
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(fullInput());
      const saved: SavedHistory = FitHistory.save([], fullInput(), calc, 'id1', 1000, '');
      const renamed: FitRecord[] = FitHistory.renameAt(saved.records, 0, '  期末体测  ');
      expect(renamed[0].name).assertEqual('期末体测');
      const restored: FitInput | undefined = FitHistory.restoreAt(renamed, 0);
      expect(restored !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (restored !== undefined) {
        expect(restored.h).assertEqual('178');
        expect(restored.grade).assertEqual(FitGrade.G12);
      }
      expect(FitHistory.deleteAt(renamed, 0).length).assertEqual(0);
    });
  });

  describe('FitExportFactory', () => {
    it('builds_export_spec', 0, () => {
      const calc: FitCalc = FitScoring.calc(fullInput());
      const spec: ExportCardSpec = FitExportFactory.create(calc, fullInput(), new Date(2026, 10, 14, 23, 40).getTime(), 'ab12c');
      expect(spec.title).assertEqual('体测评分结果');
      expect(spec.recordId).assertEqual('FIT-20261114-2340-AB12C');
      expect(spec.fileName).assertEqual('体测评分_20261114-2340_78.7分_及格.png');
      expect(spec.params.length).assertEqual(8);
      expect(spec.lines.length).assertEqual(8);
      expect(spec.lines[0].indexOf('体重指数') === 0).assertTrue();
      expect(spec.lines[7].indexOf('总分 78.7') === 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}

export default function fitRecsTest() {
  describe('FitRecsRepository', () => {
    it('renames_record', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const repo: FitRecsRepository = new FitRecsRepository(api, () => '3260799999');
      const record: FitRecord = new FitRecord();
      record.id = 'f1';
      record.ts = 1794670584149;
      record.name = '旧名字';
      const ok = await repo.rename(record, ' 新名字 ');
      expect(ok.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(api.patchPaths[0]).assertEqual('fitrecs?id=eq.f1');
      expect(api.patchBodies[0].indexOf('新名字') > 0).assertTrue();
      const empty = await repo.rename(new FitRecord(), 'x');
      expect(empty.ok).assertTrue();
      const noName = await repo.rename(record, '   ');
      expect(noName.ok).assertTrue();
      api.failPosts = true;
      const bad = await repo.rename(record, 'x');
      expect(bad.ok).assertFalse();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  GroupConfig,
  GroupErrorCode,
  GroupMember,
  GroupMode,
  GroupResult,
  GroupSource,
  GroupValidation,
  MemberGroup
} from '../main/ets/features/group/GroupModels';
import { GroupEngine, SeededGroupRandom } from '../main/ets/features/group/GroupEngine';
import { GroupConfigCodec } from '../main/ets/features/group/GroupCodec';
import { GroupExportFactory } from '../main/ets/features/export/ExportCard';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

function members(count: number): GroupMember[] {
  const out: GroupMember[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= count; i++) {
    out.push(new GroupMember(i, i % 2 === 0 ? '名' + i : ''));
  }
  return out;
}

function config(source: GroupSource, mode: GroupMode, n: number, shuffle: boolean): GroupConfig {
  const config: GroupConfig = new GroupConfig();
  config.source = source;
  config.mode = mode;
  config.n = n;
  config.shuffle = shuffle;
  return config;
}

function sizes(result: GroupResult): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < result.groups.length; i++) {
    out.push(result.groups[i].members.length);
  }
  return out;
}

function maxDiff(values: number[]): number {
  let min: number = values[0];
  let max: number = values[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
    if (values[i] < min) {
      min = values[i];
    }
    if (values[i] > max) {
      max = values[i];
    }
  }
  return max - min;
}

export default function groupTest() {
  describe('GroupEngineCount', () => {
    it('groups_mode_clamps_to_member_count', 0, () => {
      const list: GroupMember[] = members(10);
      expect(GroupEngine.groupCount(0, config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 4, false))).assertEqual(0);
      expect(GroupEngine.groupCount(10, config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 1, false))).assertEqual(2);
      expect(GroupEngine.groupCount(10, config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 99, false))).assertEqual(10);
      expect(list.length).assertEqual(10);
    });

    it('pergroup_mode_uses_ceil', 0, () => {
      expect(GroupEngine.groupCount(10, config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.PER_GROUP, 3, false))).assertEqual(4);
      expect(GroupEngine.groupCount(9, config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.PER_GROUP, 3, false))).assertEqual(3);
      expect(GroupEngine.groupCount(1, config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.PER_GROUP, 99, false))).assertEqual(1);
    });
  });

  describe('GroupEngineGroup', () => {
    it('splits_all_members_balanced', 0, () => {
      const result: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(members(10), config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 3, false),
        new SeededGroupRandom(1));
      expect(result.groups.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(result.totalMembers()).assertEqual(10);
      expect(maxDiff(sizes(result)) <= 1).assertTrue();
      expect(result.groups[0].index).assertEqual(1);
      expect(result.groups[0].label()).assertEqual('第 1 组');
    });

    it('pergroup_splits_by_size', 0, () => {
      const result: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(members(11), config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.PER_GROUP, 4, false),
        new SeededGroupRandom(2));
      expect(result.groups.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(result.totalMembers()).assertEqual(11);
    });

    it('no_shuffle_keeps_original_order', 0, () => {
      const list: GroupMember[] = members(6);
      const result: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(list, config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 3, false),
        new SeededGroupRandom(3));
      expect(result.groups[0].members[0].seat).assertEqual(1);
      expect(result.groups[1].members[0].seat).assertEqual(2);
      expect(result.groups[2].members[0].seat).assertEqual(3);
    });

    it('shuffle_is_deterministic_per_seed', 0, () => {
      const a: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(members(12), config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 3, true),
        new SeededGroupRandom(42));
      const b: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(members(12), config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 3, true),
        new SeededGroupRandom(42));
      const seatsA: string[] = [];
      const seatsB: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < a.groups.length; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < a.groups[i].members.length; j++) {
          seatsA.push('' + a.groups[i].members[j].seat);
          seatsB.push('' + b.groups[i].members[j].seat);
        }
      }
      expect(seatsA.join(',')).assertEqual(seatsB.join(','));
    });

    it('snapshot_labels_match_contract', 0, () => {
      const result: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(members(10), config(GroupSource.NAMES, GroupMode.PER_GROUP, 3, true),
        new SeededGroupRandom(4));
      expect(result.snapshot.total).assertEqual(10);
      expect(result.snapshot.groupCount).assertEqual(4);
      expect(result.snapshot.sourceLabel).assertEqual('班级名单（10 人）');
      expect(result.snapshot.modeLabel).assertEqual('按每组人数(3 人)');
      expect(result.snapshot.innerLabel).assertEqual('打乱后随机分配');
    });
  });

  describe('GroupEngineValidate', () => {
    it('rejects_empty_members', 0, () => {
      const validation: GroupValidation = GroupEngine.validate([], config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 4, false));
      expect(validation.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(validation.error!.code).assertEqual(GroupErrorCode.NO_MEMBERS);
    });

    it('rejects_empty_roster_selection', 0, () => {
      const validation: GroupValidation = GroupEngine.validate([], config(GroupSource.NAMES, GroupMode.GROUPS, 4, false));
      expect(validation.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(validation.error!.code).assertEqual(GroupErrorCode.ROSTER_EMPTY);
    });

    it('rejects_single_member', 0, () => {
      const validation: GroupValidation = GroupEngine.validate(members(1),
        config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 2, false));
      expect(validation.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(validation.error!.code).assertEqual(GroupErrorCode.MEMBERS_TOO_FEW);
    });

    it('accepts_valid_config', 0, () => {
      const validation: GroupValidation = GroupEngine.validate(members(10),
        config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.GROUPS, 4, false));
      expect(validation.ok).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('GroupConfigCodec', () => {
    it('roundtrip_keeps_contract_order', 0, () => {
      const c: GroupConfig = config(GroupSource.NAMES, GroupMode.PER_GROUP, 5, true);
      c.selectedSeats = [5, 3, 5, 1];
      const blob: Blob = GroupConfigCodec.toJson(c);
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(blob).join(',')).assertEqual('source,mode,n,shuffle,sel');
      const back: GroupConfig = GroupConfigCodec.fromJson(blob);
      expect(back.source).assertEqual(GroupSource.NAMES);
      expect(back.mode).assertEqual(GroupMode.PER_GROUP);
      expect(back.n).assertEqual(5);
      expect(back.shuffle).assertTrue();
      expect(back.selectedSeats.join(',')).assertEqual('1,3,5');
    });

    it('accepts_legacy_wire_values', 0, () => {
      const blob: Blob = { 'source': 'pick', 'mode': 'per', 'n': 3, 'shuffle': 'true', 'sel': [2, 1] };
      const c: GroupConfig = GroupConfigCodec.fromJson(blob);
      expect(c.source).assertEqual(GroupSource.NAMES);
      expect(c.mode).assertEqual(GroupMode.PER_GROUP);
      expect(c.n).assertEqual(3);
      expect(c.shuffle).assertTrue();
      expect(c.selectedSeats.join(',')).assertEqual('1,2');
    });

    it('missing_section_uses_defaults', 0, () => {
      const c: GroupConfig = GroupConfigCodec.fromJson(undefined);
      expect(c.source).assertEqual(GroupSource.PREV);
      expect(c.mode).assertEqual(GroupMode.GROUPS);
      expect(c.n).assertEqual(GroupConfig.DEFAULT_N);
      expect(c.shuffle).assertFalse();
      expect(c.selectedSeats.length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('seats_are_filtered_and_sorted', 0, () => {
      const blob: Blob = { 'sel': [0, 100, 7, '3', 7, -2] };
      const c: GroupConfig = GroupConfigCodec.fromJson(blob);
      expect(c.selectedSeats.join(',')).assertEqual('3,7');
    });

    it('unknown_fields_are_preserved_on_write', 0, () => {
      const existing: Blob = { 'source': 'prev', 'mode': 'groups', 'n': 4, 'shuffle': false, 'sel': [], 'future': 'x' };
      const written: Blob = GroupConfigCodec.toJson(config(GroupSource.NAMES, GroupMode.GROUPS, 6, false), existing);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(written, 'future'), '')).assertEqual('x');
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(written, 'source'), '')).assertEqual('names');
    });
  });

  describe('GroupExportFactory', () => {
    it('builds_groups_card_spec', 0, () => {
      const result: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(members(10), config(GroupSource.NAMES, GroupMode.GROUPS, 3, false),
        new SeededGroupRandom(5));
      const spec = GroupExportFactory.create(result, new Date(2026, 10, 14, 23, 30).getTime(), 'ab12c');
      expect(spec.title).assertEqual('随机分组结果');
      expect(spec.subtitle).assertEqual('共 10 人 · 3 组');
      expect(spec.recordId).assertEqual('GROUP-20261114-2330-AB12C');
      expect(spec.fileName).assertEqual('分组结果_20261114-2330_10人_3组_原顺序.png');
      expect(spec.params.length).assertEqual(5);
      expect(spec.groups.length).assertEqual(3);
      const firstGroup: number = spec.groups[0].length;
      expect(firstGroup >= 3 && firstGroup <= 4).assertTrue();
      const all: MemberGroup[] = result.groups;
      expect(all.length).assertEqual(3);
    });

    it('file_name_marks_shuffle', 0, () => {
      const result: GroupResult = GroupEngine.group(members(8), config(GroupSource.PREV, GroupMode.PER_GROUP, 4, true),
        new SeededGroupRandom(6));
      const spec = GroupExportFactory.create(result, new Date(2026, 0, 2, 9, 5).getTime(), 'zz999');
      expect(spec.fileName.indexOf('打乱') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(spec.fileName.indexOf('2组') > 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}

      expect(NickLogic.display('', '未命名')).assertEqual('未命名');

    });

  describe('HidePrefs', () => {
    it('reads_and_writes_hide', 0, () => {
      const sections: Blob = JSON.parse('{"v":6,"hide":{"hwHide":{"a":true,"b":false},"ntHide":{"x":true},"foo":1}}') as Blob;
      const data: HideData = HidePrefs.read(sections);
      expect(data.hwHide.has('a')).assertTrue();
      expect(data.hwHide.has('b')).assertFalse();
      expect(data.ntHide.has('x')).assertTrue();
      data.hwHide.add('c');
      const next: Blob = HidePrefs.write(sections, data);
      const hide: Blob | undefined = next['hide'] as Blob;
      expect(hide !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(HidePrefs.isHwHidden(next, 'c')).assertTrue();
      expect(HidePrefs.isHwHidden(next, 'a')).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(hide, 'foo'), 0)).assertEqual(1);
    });
  });

  describe('HomeDigest', () => {

      expect(HomeDigest.hello(21)).assertEqual('晚上好');

      expect(HomeDigest.powerState(0, false, 30)).assertEqual('idle');
      expect(HomeDigest.powerStateText('low')).assertEqual('低电');
      expect(HomeDigest.powerStateText('warn')).assertEqual('偏低');
      expect(HomeDigest.powerStateText('ok')).assertEqual('充足');
      expect(HomeDigest.powerStateText('idle')).assertEqual('未选择');
      expect(HomeDigest.rotate(3, 2)).assertEqual(0);

    it('homework_open_and_items', 0, () => {
      const a: HomeworkRow = new HomeworkRow();
      a.id = 'a';
      a.subject = '晚交的作业';
      a.date = '2026-11-20';
      a.time = '18:00';
      const b: HomeworkRow = new HomeworkRow();
      b.id = 'b';
      b.subject = '早交的作业';
      b.date = '2026-11-16';
      b.time = '18:00';

      c.subject = '已完成';
      const open: HomeworkRow[] = HomeDigest.hwOpen([a, b, c], (id: string) => id === 'c');
      expect(open.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(open[0].id).assertEqual('b');
