      expect(items.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(items[0].title).assertEqual('早交的作业');
      expect(items[0].sub.indexOf('截止') === 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('HomeTools', () => {
    it('toggle_adds_until_max', 0, () => {
      let ids: string[] = [];
      const first: HomeToolsToggleResult = HomeTools.toggle(ids, 'draw');
      expect(first.changed).assertTrue();
      ids = first.ids;
      ids = HomeTools.toggle(ids, 'group').ids;
      ids = HomeTools.toggle(ids, 'fit').ids;
      ids = HomeTools.toggle(ids, 'hw').ids;
      expect(ids.length).assertEqual(4);

      const fifth: HomeToolsToggleResult = HomeTools.toggle(ids, 'nt');
      expect(fifth.changed).assertFalse();
      expect(fifth.rejected).assertEqual('full');
      expect(fifth.ids.length).assertEqual(4);
    });

    it('toggle_removes_existing', 0, () => {
      const ids: string[] = ['draw', 'group', 'fit'];
      const result: HomeToolsToggleResult = HomeTools.toggle(ids, 'group');
      expect(result.changed).assertTrue();
      expect(result.rejected).assertEqual('');
      expect(result.ids.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(result.ids.indexOf('group') < 0).assertTrue();
      expect(HomeTools.contains(result.ids, 'draw')).assertTrue();
    });

    it('toggle_rejects_unknown_tool', 0, () => {
      const result: HomeToolsToggleResult = HomeTools.toggle([], 'not_a_tool');
      expect(result.changed).assertFalse();
      expect(result.rejected).assertEqual('unknown');
    });

    it('normalize_filters_unknown_and_dedupes', 0, () => {
      const ids: string[] = ['draw', 'draw', 'nope', '', 'group'];
      const normalized: string[] = HomeTools.normalize(ids);
      expect(normalized.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(normalized[0]).assertEqual('draw');
      expect(normalized[1]).assertEqual('group');
    });

    it('normalize_truncates_to_max', 0, () => {
      const ids: string[] = ['draw', 'group', 'fit', 'hw', 'nt', 'vote'];
      expect(HomeTools.normalize(ids).length).assertEqual(4);
    });

    it('remove_is_noop_for_absent', 0, () => {
      const ids: string[] = ['draw'];
      const next: string[] = HomeTools.remove(ids, 'group');
      expect(next.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(next[0]).assertEqual('draw');
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  HomeworkAttachments,
  HomeworkAttachmentKind,
  HomeworkDueCalculator,
  HomeworkDueTone,
  HomeworkFilter,
  HomeworkItem,
  HomeworkRow
} from '../main/ets/data/homework/HomeworkModels';
import { HomeworkRepository, HomeworkResult } from '../main/ets/data/homework/HomeworkRepository';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';

const HOUR: number = 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DAY: number = 24 * HOUR;

function rowWith(date: string, time: string): HomeworkRow {
  const row: HomeworkRow = new HomeworkRow();
  row.id = 'hw_' + date + '_' + time;
  row.date = date;
  row.time = time;
  return row;
}

function rowJson(id: string, subject: string, date: string, time: string): string {
  return '{"id":"' + id + '","subject":"' + subject + '","content":"' + subject + ' 内容",'
    + '"date":"' + date + '","time":"' + time + '","author":"老师","archived":false,"ts":1}';
}

export default function homeworkTest() {
  describe('HomeworkDue', () => {
    it('parse_date_and_optional_time', 0, () => {
      const withTime: number | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue('2026-11-20', '18:30');
      expect(withTime !== undefined).assertTrue();
      const midnight: number | undefined = HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue('2026-11-20', '');
      if (withTime !== undefined && midnight !== undefined) {
        expect(withTime - midnight).assertEqual(18 * HOUR + 30 * 60 * 1000);
      }
      expect(HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue('', '') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(HomeworkDueCalculator.parseDue('2026/11/20', '') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('hours_left_is_urgent', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 12, 0).getTime();
      const due = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(rowWith('2026-11-14', '15:00'), now);
      expect(due !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (due !== undefined) {
        expect(due.label).assertEqual('还剩 3 小时');
        expect(due.tone).assertEqual(HomeworkDueTone.URGENT);
        expect(due.expired).assertFalse();
        expect(due.prunable).assertFalse();
      }
    });

    it('days_left_tone_by_distance', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 12, 0).getTime();
      const near = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(rowWith('2026-11-17', '12:00'), now);
      const far = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(rowWith('2026-12-01', '12:00'), now);
      if (near !== undefined && far !== undefined) {
        expect(near.label).assertEqual('还剩 3 天');
        expect(near.tone).assertEqual(HomeworkDueTone.WARN);
        expect(far.tone).assertEqual(HomeworkDueTone.SAFE);
      }
    });

    it('overdue_hours_and_days', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 12, 0).getTime();
      const hours = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(rowWith('2026-11-14', '07:00'), now);
      const days = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(rowWith('2026-11-12', '12:00'), now);
      if (hours !== undefined && days !== undefined) {
        expect(hours.label).assertEqual('已过期 5 小时');
        expect(hours.tone).assertEqual(HomeworkDueTone.OVERDUE);
        expect(days.label).assertEqual('已过期 2 天');
        expect(days.expired).assertTrue();
        expect(days.prunable).assertFalse();
      }
    });

    it('prunable_after_three_days', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 20, 12, 0).getTime();
      const due = HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(rowWith('2026-11-15', '12:00'), now);
      expect(due !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (due !== undefined) {
        expect(due.prunable).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('due_text_formats', 0, () => {
      const at: number = new Date(2026, 10, 20, 18, 5).getTime();
      expect(HomeworkDueCalculator.dueText(at)).assertEqual('11-20 18:05');
      expect(HomeworkDueCalculator.dueText(0)).assertEqual('—');
    });

    it('no_date_means_no_due', 0, () => {
      expect(HomeworkDueCalculator.evaluate(rowWith('', ''), Date.now()) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('HomeworkAttachments', () => {
    it('parses_data_uri_and_url', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[{"n":"图.png","t":"image/png","d":"data:image/png;base64,AAAA","s":123},'
        + '{"n":"链接","t":"image/jpeg","d":"https://example.com/a.jpg"}]';
      const metas = HomeworkAttachments.parse(raw);
      expect(metas.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(metas[0].name).assertEqual('图.png');
      expect(metas[0].sizeBytes).assertEqual(123);
      expect(metas[0].kind).assertEqual(HomeworkAttachmentKind.DATA_URI);
      expect(metas[0].isImage()).assertTrue();
      expect(metas[1].kind).assertEqual(HomeworkAttachmentKind.URL);
      expect(metas[1].sizeBytes).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('estimates_size_without_explicit_size', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[{"n":"a","t":"image/png","d":"data:image/png;base64,AAAAAAAA"}]';
      const metas = HomeworkAttachments.parse(raw);
      expect(metas[0].sizeBytes).assertEqual(6);
    });

    it('bad_json_returns_empty', 0, () => {
      expect(HomeworkAttachments.parse('not-json').length).assertEqual(0);
      expect(HomeworkAttachments.parse('{"a":1}').length).assertEqual(0);
      expect(HomeworkAttachments.parse('').length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('data_of_returns_raw_payload', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[{"n":"a","d":"data:image/png;base64,AAAA"}]';
      expect(HomeworkAttachments.dataOf(raw, 0)).assertEqual('data:image/png;base64,AAAA');
      expect(HomeworkAttachments.dataOf(raw, 5)).assertEqual('');
    });
  });

  describe('HomeworkItem', () => {
    it('title_falls_back_to_first_line', 0, () => {
      const item: HomeworkItem = new HomeworkItem();
      item.row = new HomeworkRow();
      item.row.content = '第一行标题\n第二行';
      expect(item.title()).assertEqual('第一行标题');
      item.row.subject = '数学作业';
      expect(item.title()).assertEqual('数学作业');
      expect(item.bodyPreview().length > 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('HomeworkRepository', () => {
    it('parses_rows_and_caches', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.homeworkBody = '[' + rowJson('hw_1', '数学', '2026-11-20', '18:00') + ','
        + rowJson('hw_2', '英语', '2026-11-21', '12:00') + ']';
      const repo: HomeworkRepository = new HomeworkRepository(api, () => 1000, 600000);
      const first: HomeworkResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(first.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(first.rows.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(first.rows[0].subject).assertEqual('数学');
      expect(first.rows[0].date).assertEqual('2026-11-20');
      const second: HomeworkResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(second.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('archived=eq.false') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('order=ts.asc') > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('failure_falls_back_to_cache', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.homeworkBody = '[' + rowJson('hw_1', '数学', '2026-11-20', '18:00') + ']';
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: HomeworkRepository = new HomeworkRepository(api, () => now, 1000);
      await repo.load(false);
      now = 5000;
      api.failGets = true;
      const second: HomeworkResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(second.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(second.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(second.rows.length).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('skips_rows_without_id', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[{"subject":"无 id"},{"id":"hw_1","subject":"有 id"}]';
      const rows = HomeworkRepository.parseRows(raw);
      expect(rows.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(rows[0].subject).assertEqual('有 id');
      expect(HomeworkRepository.parseRows('bad').length).assertEqual(0);
    });
  });

  describe('HomeworkFilter', () => {
    it('labels', 0, () => {
      expect(HomeworkFilter.ALL).assertEqual('全部');
      expect(HomeworkFilter.UNFINISHED).assertEqual('未完成');
      expect(HomeworkFilter.DONE).assertEqual('已完成');
    });
  });
}

import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';
import { MarkKind, MarkRow, MarksSnapshot } from '../main/ets/data/marks/Marks';
import {
  InMemoryMarksLocalStore,
  MarksRefreshResult,
  MarksRepository,
  MarksUpdateResult,
  parseRows
} from '../main/ets/data/marks/MarksRepository';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

const SID: string = '3260799999';

function rowJson(ref: string, kind: string, value: boolean): Blob {
  const row: Blob = {
    'id': SID + '|' + kind + '|' + ref,
    'seat': SID,
    'kind': kind,
    'ref': ref,
    'val': value,
    'ts': 1
  };
  return row;
}

function marksBody(rows: Blob[]): string {
  const arr: Object[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    arr.push(rows[i]);
  }
  return JSON.stringify(arr);
}

export default function marksRepositoryTest() {
  describe('MarksSnapshot', () => {
    it('replace_rows_collects_only_true', 0, () => {
      const snapshot: MarksSnapshot = new MarksSnapshot();
      const rows: MarkRow[] = [
        new MarkRow('a', SID, 'hw', 'hw_1', true, 1),
        new MarkRow('b', SID, 'hw', 'hw_2', false, 2),
        new MarkRow('c', SID, 'nt', 'nt_1', true, 3),
        new MarkRow('d', SID, 'ntdone', 'nt_2', true, 4),
        new MarkRow('e', SID, 'unknown', 'x', true, 5)
      ];
      const next: MarksSnapshot = snapshot.replaceRows(rows);
      expect(next.hwDone.has('hw_1')).assertTrue();
      expect(next.hwDone.has('hw_2')).assertFalse();
      expect(next.ntPin.has('nt_1')).assertTrue();
      expect(next.ntDone.has('nt_2')).assertTrue();
      expect(next.isDone(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_1')).assertTrue();
      expect(next.isDone(MarkKind.NT_DONE, 'nt_2')).assertTrue();
      expect(next.counts()).assertEqual(3);
    });

    it('with_false_removes_and_keeps_immutability', 0, () => {
      const snapshot: MarksSnapshot = new MarksSnapshot().with(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_1', true);
      const next: MarksSnapshot = snapshot.with(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_1', false);
      expect(snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_1')).assertTrue();
      expect(next.isDone(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_1')).assertFalse();
    });

    it('apply_pending_overrides_remote', 0, () => {
      const remote: MarkRow[] = [new MarkRow('a', SID, 'hw', 'hw_1', false, 1)];
      const pending: MarkRow[] = [new MarkRow('a2', SID, 'hw', 'hw_1', true, 2)];
      const snapshot: MarksSnapshot = new MarksSnapshot().replaceRows(remote).applyPending(pending);
      expect(snapshot.isDone(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_1')).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('MarksRepository', () => {
    it('refresh_parses_rows_and_caches', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.marksBody = marksBody([rowJson('hw_1', 'hw', true), rowJson('nt_1', 'nt', true)]);
      const repo: MarksRepository = new MarksRepository(api, () => SID, new InMemoryMarksLocalStore(), () => 1000, 120000);
      const result: MarksRefreshResult = await repo.refresh(true);
      expect(result.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(result.snapshot.hwDone.has('hw_1')).assertTrue();
      expect(result.snapshot.ntPin.has('nt_1')).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('seat=eq.' + SID) >= 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('refresh_within_ttl_skips_network', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.marksBody = marksBody([]);
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: MarksRepository = new MarksRepository(api, () => SID, new InMemoryMarksLocalStore(), () => now, 120000);
      await repo.refresh(true);
      const count: number = api.getPaths.length;
      now = 2000;
      const second: MarksRefreshResult = await repo.refresh(false);
      expect(second.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(count);
    });

    it('set_mark_is_optimistic_and_posts_val', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const repo: MarksRepository = new MarksRepository(api, () => SID, new InMemoryMarksLocalStore(), () => 1000, 120000);
      const result: MarksUpdateResult = await repo.setMark(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_9', true);
      expect(result.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(repo.marks().isDone(MarkKind.HW, 'hw_9')).assertTrue();
      const body: string = api.lastPostBody();
      expect(body.indexOf('"val":true') >= 0).assertTrue();
      expect(body.indexOf('hw_9') >= 0).assertTrue();
      expect(await repo.pendingCount()).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('failed_mark_is_pending_and_flush_clears', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.failPosts = true;
      const repo: MarksRepository = new MarksRepository(api, () => SID, new InMemoryMarksLocalStore(), () => 1000, 120000);
      const result: MarksUpdateResult = await repo.setMark(MarkKind.NT_DONE, 'nt_5', true);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(repo.marks().isDone(MarkKind.NT_DONE, 'nt_5')).assertTrue();
      expect(await repo.pendingCount()).assertEqual(1);

      api.failPosts = false;
      const flushed: number = await repo.flushPending();
      expect(flushed).assertEqual(1);
      expect(await repo.pendingCount()).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('invalid_marks_response_is_parse_error', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.marksBody = '{"not":"array"}';
      const repo: MarksRepository = new MarksRepository(api, () => SID, new InMemoryMarksLocalStore(), () => 1000, 120000);
      const result: MarksRefreshResult = await repo.refresh(true);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(result.error !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('parse_rows_skips_bad_items', 0, () => {
      const good: Blob = rowJson('hw_1', 'hw', true);
      const noRef: Blob = { 'id': 'x', 'seat': SID, 'kind': 'hw', 'ref': '', 'val': true };
      const arr: Object[] = [good, noRef, 'junk'];
      const rows: MarkRow[] | undefined = parseRows(JSON.stringify(arr));
      expect(rows !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (rows !== undefined) {
        expect(rows.length).assertEqual(1);
        expect(rows[0].ref).assertEqual('hw_1');
      }
      expect(parseRows('not-json') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('model_roundtrip_preserves_fields', 0, () => {
      const row: MarkRow = new MarkRow('id1', SID, 'hw', 'hw_1', true, 123);
      const back: MarkRow | undefined = MarkRow.fromJson(row.toJson());
      expect(back !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (back !== undefined) {
        expect(back.value).assertTrue();
        expect(back.ts).assertEqual(123);
        expect(back.id).assertEqual('id1');
        expect(JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(row.toJson(), 'val'), false)).assertTrue();
      }
    });
  });
}
