const SID: string = '3260799999';

function memberJson(seat: number, name: string, role: string, badge: string): Blob {
  const out: Blob = {
    'seat': seat,
    'sid': 'sid_' + seat,
    'name': name,
    'role': role,
    'badge': badge,
    'is_admin': false
  };
  return out;
}

function membersBody(rows: Blob[]): string {
  const arr: Object[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    arr.push(rows[i]);
  }
  return JSON.stringify(arr);
}

function leagueBody(seats: Blob[]): string {
  const arr: Object[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < seats.length; i++) {
    arr.push(seats[i]);
  }
  const body: Blob = { 'ok': true, 'count': arr.length, 'seats': arr };
  return JSON.stringify(body);
}

function seatJson(seat: number, name: string): Blob {
  const out: Blob = { 'seat': seat, 'name': name };
  return out;
}

export default function membersTest() {
  describe('ClassMembersParsing', () => {
    it('parse_members_skips_bad_rows', 0, () => {
      const arr: Object[] = [memberJson(1, '张一', '班长', '班委'), memberJson(0, '无座号', '', ''), 'junk'];
      const members: ClassMember[] = parseMembers(JSON.stringify(arr));
      expect(members.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(members[0].name).assertEqual('张一');
      expect(members[0].isCommittee()).assertTrue();
      expect(parseMembers('not-json').length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('parse_league_reads_seats', 0, () => {
      const members: LeagueMember[] | undefined = parseLeague(leagueBody([seatJson(3, '李四'), seatJson(1, '王五')]));
      expect(members !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (members !== undefined) {
        expect(members.length).assertEqual(2);
        expect(members[0].seat).assertEqual(1);
      }
      expect(parseLeague('{"ok":false}') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(parseLeague('') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('MemberCategories', () => {
    const classMembers: ClassMember[] = [
      new ClassMember(5, 'sid5', '赵六', '团支书', '班委', false),
      new ClassMember(2, 'sid2', '钱七', '', '班委', false),
      new ClassMember(1, 'sid1', '孙八', '班长', '', false),
      new ClassMember(3, 'sid3', '李九', '', '', false),
      new ClassMember(0, 'sid0', '无效', '', '', false)
    ];
    const league: LeagueMember[] = [
      new LeagueMember(5, '赵六'),
      new LeagueMember(3, '李九'),
      new LeagueMember(3, '李九')
    ];

    it('committee_uses_role_or_badge_and_sorts_by_seat', 0, () => {
      const entries: MemberEntry[] = MemberCategoryBuilder.committee(classMembers);
      expect(entries.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(entries[0].seat).assertEqual(1);
      expect(entries[0].badge).assertEqual('班长');
      expect(entries[1].seat).assertEqual(2);
      expect(entries[1].badge).assertEqual('班委');
      expect(entries[2].seat).assertEqual(5);
      expect(entries[2].badge).assertEqual('团支书');
    });

    it('all_is_sorted_and_deduped', 0, () => {
      const entries: MemberEntry[] = MemberCategoryBuilder.all(classMembers);
      expect(entries.length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(entries[0].seat).assertEqual(1);
      expect(entries[3].seat).assertEqual(5);
    });

    it('league_dedupes_by_seat', 0, () => {
      const entries: MemberEntry[] = MemberCategoryBuilder.league(league);
      expect(entries.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(entries[0].seat).assertEqual(3);
      expect(entries[0].badge).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('counts_match_categories', 0, () => {
      const counts: MemberCategoryCounts = MemberCategoryBuilder.counts(classMembers, league);
      expect(counts.committee).assertEqual(3);
      expect(counts.league).assertEqual(2);
      expect(counts.all).assertEqual(4);
      expect(counts.of(MemberCategory.LEAGUE)).assertEqual(2);
    });

    it('search_filters_by_name', 0, () => {
      const entries: MemberEntry[] = MemberCategoryBuilder.all(classMembers);
      expect(MemberCategoryBuilder.search(entries, '李').length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(MemberCategoryBuilder.search(entries, '   ').length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(MemberCategoryBuilder.search(entries, '不存在').length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('visible_entries_combines_category_and_query', 0, () => {
      const entries: MemberEntry[] = MemberCategoryBuilder.visibleEntries(MemberCategory.ALL, classMembers, league, '孙');
      expect(entries.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(entries[0].name).assertEqual('孙八');
    });
  });

  describe('ClassMembersRepository', () => {
    it('load_fetches_and_caches', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.membersBody = membersBody([memberJson(1, '张一', '班长', '班委'), memberJson(2, '张二', '', '')]);
      const repo: ClassMembersRepository = new ClassMembersRepository(api, new InMemoryClassMemberCache(),
        () => SID, () => 1000, 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      const first: ClassMembersResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(first.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(first.fromCache).assertFalse();
      expect(first.members.length).assertEqual(2);
      const second: ClassMembersResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(second.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postPaths.length).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('failure_falls_back_to_cache', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.membersBody = membersBody([memberJson(1, '张一', '', '')]);
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: ClassMembersRepository = new ClassMembersRepository(api, new InMemoryClassMemberCache(),
        () => SID, () => now, 1000);
      await repo.load(false);
      now = 5000;
      api.failPosts = true;
      const second: ClassMembersResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(second.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(second.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(second.members.length).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('empty_response_is_failure_without_cache', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.membersBody = '[]';
      const repo: ClassMembersRepository = new ClassMembersRepository(api, new InMemoryClassMemberCache(),
        () => SID, () => 1000);
      const result: ClassMembersResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(result.message.length > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('cached_does_not_hit_network', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.membersBody = membersBody([memberJson(9, '张九', '', '')]);
      const repo: ClassMembersRepository = new ClassMembersRepository(api, new InMemoryClassMemberCache(),
        () => SID, () => 1000);
      await repo.load(true);
      const cached: ClassMember[] = await repo.cached();
      expect(cached.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(api.postPaths.length).assertEqual(1);
    });
  });

  describe('ClassLeagueRepository', () => {
    it('load_parses_and_caches', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.leagueBody = leagueBody([seatJson(2, '李四'), seatJson(1, '王五')]);
      const repo: ClassLeagueRepository = new ClassLeagueRepository(api, () => SID, () => 1000);
      const first: ClassLeagueResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(first.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(first.members.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(first.members[0].seat).assertEqual(1);
      const second: ClassLeagueResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(second.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postPaths.length).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('failure_without_cache_is_failure', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.failPosts = true;
      const repo: ClassLeagueRepository = new ClassLeagueRepository(api, () => SID, () => 1000);
      const result: ClassLeagueResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  NOTICE_BODY_PREFIX,
  NoticeFilter,
  NoticeGroup,
  NoticeRow,
  NoticeSegment,
  NoticeSigRow
} from '../main/ets/data/notices/NoticeModels';
import { NoticeBodyParser } from '../main/ets/data/notices/NoticeParser';
import { NoticeEntry, NoticesRepository, NoticesResult } from '../main/ets/data/notices/NoticesRepository';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';

const AUTO_BODY: string = NOTICE_BODY_PREFIX + '{"id":"g1","title":"关于班会","cat":"班会",'
  + '"summary":"本周五开班会","aiSummary":"周五 19:00 班会","aiPoints":["带笔记本","提前 10 分钟到"],'
  + '"aiSegments":[{"type":"时间","text":"周五 19:00"},{"type":"地点","text":"A101"}],'
  + '"deadline":"2026-11-20 18:00","timeLabel":"周五 19:00","items":['
  + '{"kind":"text","text":"原通知正文","fromName":"班长","time":"11-14 10:00"},'
  + '{"kind":"img","caption":"座位表","src":"data:image/png;base64,AAAAAAAA"},'
  + '{"kind":"file","name":"材料.zip","size":"2.0 MB"},'
  + '{"kind":"form","realTitle":"报名表","close":"11-19"},'
  + '{"kind":"link","name":"在线文档","url":"https://example.com/doc"}]}';

function rowJson(id: string, title: string, ts: number, pin: boolean, hidden: boolean, body: string): string {
  const escaped: string = body.replace(new RegExp('\\\\', 'g'), '\\\\')
    .replace(new RegExp('"', 'g'), '\\"');
  return '{"id":"' + id + '","title":"' + title + '","body":"' + escaped + '","pin":' + pin
    + ',"imp":false,"hidden":' + hidden + ',"ts":' + ts + ',"attachments":""}';
}

export default function noticeTest() {
  describe('NoticeBodyParser', () => {
    it('detects_auto_and_parses_group', 0, () => {
      expect(NoticeBodyParser.isAuto(AUTO_BODY)).assertTrue();
      expect(NoticeBodyParser.isAuto('普通人工通知')).assertFalse();
      const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(AUTO_BODY);
      expect(group !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (group !== undefined) {
        expect(group.id).assertEqual('g1');
        expect(group.title).assertEqual('关于班会');
        expect(group.aiPoints.length).assertEqual(2);
        expect(group.aiSegments.length).assertEqual(2);
        expect(group.aiSegments[0].type).assertEqual('时间');
        expect(group.deadline).assertEqual('2026-11-20 18:00');
        expect(group.items.length).assertEqual(5);
      }
    });

    it('bad_json_returns_undefined', 0, () => {
      expect(NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(NOTICE_BODY_PREFIX + '{bad') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup('普通人工通知') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(NOTICE_BODY_PREFIX + '') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('parses_items_meta', 0, () => {
      const items = NoticeBodyParser.parseItems([
        { 'kind': 'text', 'text': '正文一' },
        { 'kind': 'text', 'text': '正文二' },
        { 'kind': 'follow', 'text': '补充' },
        { 'kind': 'img', 'caption': '图', 'src': 'data:image/png;base64,AAAAAAAA' },
        { 'kind': 'file', 'name': 'a.zip', 'size': '1.5 MB' },
        { 'kind': 'form', 'realTitle': '报名', 'close': '11-19' },
        { 'kind': 'link', 'name': '文档', 'url': 'https://x' }
      ]);
      expect(items.length).assertEqual(7);
      expect(items[0].label).assertEqual('原始消息');
      expect(items[1].label).assertEqual('补充通知');
      expect(items[2].isFollow).assertTrue();
      expect(items[3].text).assertEqual('图片 · 图');
      expect(items[4].name).assertEqual('a.zip');
      expect(items[4].sizeText).assertEqual('1.5 MB');
      expect(items[5].statusText).assertEqual('11-19 截止');
      expect(items[6].name).assertEqual('文档');
    });

    it('applies_override_whitelist', 0, () => {
      const group: NoticeGroup = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(AUTO_BODY)!;
      const overridden: NoticeGroup = NoticeBodyParser.applyOverride(group,
        '{"title":"改过的标题","summary":"","unknown":"x"}');
      expect(overridden.title).assertEqual('改过的标题');
      expect(overridden.summary).assertEqual('');
      expect(overridden.aiSummary).assertEqual('周五 19:00 班会');
    });

    it('parses_sig_rows_and_signature', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[{"id":"a","ts":1,"hidden":false,"edited_at":0},{"id":"b","ts":2,"hidden":true,"edited_at":3}]';
      const rows: NoticeSigRow[] = NoticeBodyParser.parseSigRows(raw);
      expect(rows.length).assertEqual(2);
      const sig: string = NoticeSigRow.signatureOf(rows);
      expect(sig.indexOf('a|1|0|0') === 0).assertTrue();
      expect(NoticeSigRow.signatureOf(NoticeBodyParser.parseSigRows(raw))).assertEqual(sig);
      expect(NoticeSigRow.signatureOf(NoticeBodyParser.parseSigRows('[]')) !== sig).assertTrue();
    });

    it('parses_rows_and_skips_bad', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[' + rowJson('n1', '标题', 100, false, false, AUTO_BODY) + ',{"title":"无 id"}]';
      const rows: NoticeRow[] = NoticeBodyParser.parseRows(raw);
      expect(rows.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(rows[0].id).assertEqual('n1');
      expect(rows[0].ts).assertEqual(100);
      expect(NoticeBodyParser.isAuto(rows[0].body)).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('NoticesRepository', () => {
    it('builds_entries_hides_hidden_and_sorts', 0, () => {
      const rows: NoticeRow[] = NoticeBodyParser.parseRows('[' + rowJson('n1', '普通', 100, false, false, '人工通知')
        + ',' + rowJson('n2', '置顶', 50, true, false, '人工通知')
        + ',' + rowJson('n3', '隐藏', 200, false, true, '人工通知') + ']');
      const entries: NoticeEntry[] = NoticesRepository.buildEntries(rows);
      expect(entries.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(entries[0].id()).assertEqual('n2');
      expect(entries[1].id()).assertEqual('n1');
      expect(entries[0].row.pin).assertTrue();
    });

    it('entry_title_and_summary_prefer_group', 0, () => {
      const rows: NoticeRow[] = NoticeBodyParser.parseRows('[' + rowJson('n1', '行标题', 1, false, false, AUTO_BODY) + ']');
      const entry: NoticeEntry = NoticesRepository.buildEntries(rows)[0];
      expect(entry.title()).assertEqual('关于班会');
      expect(entry.summary()).assertEqual('周五 19:00 班会');
      expect(entry.items.length).assertEqual(5);
      expect(entry.timeLabel()).assertEqual('周五 19:00');
    });

    it('manual_notice_uses_row_fields', 0, () => {
      const rows: NoticeRow[] = NoticeBodyParser.parseRows('[' + rowJson('n2', '人工标题', 1700000000000, false, false,
        '第一行正文 第二行') + ']');
      const entry: NoticeEntry = NoticesRepository.buildEntries(rows)[0];
      expect(entry.title()).assertEqual('人工标题');
      expect(entry.summary()).assertEqual('第一行正文 第二行');
      expect(entry.group === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('dedupes_same_title_and_summary_keeps_newest', 0, () => {
      const rows: NoticeRow[] = NoticeBodyParser.parseRows('[' + rowJson('n1', '班会', 100, false, false, '同一内容')
        + ',' + rowJson('n2', '班会', 300, false, false, '同一内容')
        + ',' + rowJson('n3', '班会', 200, false, false, '不同内容') + ']');
      const entries: NoticeEntry[] = NoticesRepository.buildEntries(rows);
      expect(entries.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(entries[0].id()).assertEqual('n2');
    });

    it('filters_by_done_ids', 0, () => {
      const rows: NoticeRow[] = NoticeBodyParser.parseRows('[' + rowJson('n1', 'a', 2, false, false, 'x')
        + ',' + rowJson('n2', 'b', 1, false, false, 'y') + ']');
      const entries: NoticeEntry[] = NoticesRepository.buildEntries(rows);
      expect(NoticesRepository.filterEntries(entries, NoticeFilter.ALL, ['n1']).length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(NoticesRepository.filterEntries(entries, NoticeFilter.UNREAD, ['n1']).length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(NoticesRepository.filterEntries(entries, NoticeFilter.DONE, ['n1']).length).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('signature_short_circuits_full_fetch', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.noticesSigBody = '[{"id":"n1","ts":100,"hidden":false,"edited_at":0}]';
      api.noticesBody = '[' + rowJson('n1', '标题', 100, false, false, '正文') + ']';
      let now: number = 1000;
      // TTL = 0：强制每次都先拉签名，才能验证「签名未变就不再拉整表」
      const repo: NoticesRepository = new NoticesRepository(api, () => now, 0);
      const first: NoticesResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(first.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(first.entries.length).assertEqual(1);
      const getsAfterFirst: number = api.getPaths.length;
      expect(getsAfterFirst).assertEqual(2);
      now = 2000;
      const second: NoticesResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(second.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(getsAfterFirst + 1);
    });

    it('signature_change_refetches_full_table', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.noticesSigBody = '[{"id":"n1","ts":100,"hidden":false,"edited_at":0}]';
      api.noticesBody = '[' + rowJson('n1', '标题', 100, false, false, '正文') + ']';
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: NoticesRepository = new NoticesRepository(api, () => now, 0);
      await repo.load(false);
      const before: number = api.getPaths.length;
      api.noticesSigBody = '[{"id":"n1","ts":200,"hidden":false,"edited_at":0}]';
      now = 5000;
      const second: NoticesResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(second.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(before + 2);
    });

    it('failure_falls_back_to_cache', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.noticesSigBody = '[{"id":"n1","ts":100,"hidden":false,"edited_at":0}]';
      api.noticesBody = '[' + rowJson('n1', '标题', 100, false, false, '正文') + ']';
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: NoticesRepository = new NoticesRepository(api, () => now, 0);
      await repo.load(false);
      now = 5000;
      api.failGets = true;
      const second: NoticesResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(second.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(second.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(second.entries.length).assertEqual(1);
    });
  });

  describe('NoticeSegmentModel', () => {
    it('segment_fields', 0, () => {
      const seg: NoticeSegment = new NoticeSegment();
      seg.type = '地点';
      seg.text = 'A101';
      expect(seg.type + seg.text).assertEqual('地点A101');
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { NoticeBodyParser } from '../main/ets/data/notices/NoticeParser';
import { NOTICE_BODY_PREFIX, NoticeGroup, NoticeOccurrence } from '../main/ets/data/notices/NoticeModels';
import { NoticeEntry, NoticesRepository } from '../main/ets/data/notices/NoticesRepository';
import { NoticeCards, NoticeCard } from '../main/ets/features/notices/NoticeCards';
import { NoticeRecurrenceLogic, NoticeSection } from '../main/ets/features/notices/NoticeRecurrence';

const NOW: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 10, 0).getTime(); // 周日 10:00

function bodyWith(title: string, extra: string): string {
  return NOTICE_BODY_PREFIX + '{"id":"g1","title":"' + title + '","summary":"' + title
    + '","items":[],' + extra + '}';
}

function entryFromJson(id: string, body: string, ts: number): NoticeEntry {
  const escaped: string = body.replace(new RegExp('"', 'g'), '\\"');
  const json: string = '[{"id":"' + id + '","title":"行标题","ts":' + ts + ',"body":"' + escaped + '"}]';
  const rows = NoticeBodyParser.parseRows(json);
  return NoticesRepository.buildEntries(rows)[0];
}

export default function noticeParityTest() {
  describe('NoticeRecurrenceLogic', () => {
    it('parses_time_formats', 0, () => {
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs('2026-11-18T00:00:00+08:00'))
        .assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 18, 0, 0).getTime());
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs('2026-11-18 09:30'))
        .assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 18, 9, 30).getTime());
      const mdhm: number = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs('11-18 09:30');
      expect(new Date(mdhm).getMonth()).assertEqual(10);
      expect(new Date(mdhm).getDate()).assertEqual(18);
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs('')).assertEqual(0);
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.parseTs('not-a-date')).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('daily_next', 0, () => {
      const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(
        bodyWith('日常', '"recurrence":{"freq":"daily","time":"19:00"}'));
      expect(group !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (group !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(group, NOW))
          .assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 15, 19, 0).getTime());
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(group, new Date(2026, 10, 15, 20, 0).getTime()))
          .assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 16, 19, 0).getTime());
      }
    });

    it('weekly_next', 0, () => {
      const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(
        bodyWith('每周一', '"recurrence":{"freq":"weekly","weekday":1,"time":"19:00"}'));
      if (group !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(group, NOW))
          .assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 16, 19, 0).getTime());
      }
    });

    it('monthly_day_and_invalid', 0, () => {
      const monthly: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(
        bodyWith('每月', '"recurrence":{"freq":"monthly_day","day":20,"time":"08:00"}'));
      if (monthly !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurNext(monthly, NOW))
          .assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 20, 8, 0).getTime());
      }
      const badTime: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(
        bodyWith('坏时间', '"recurrence":{"freq":"daily","time":"7pm"}'));
      if (badTime !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.isLongterm(badTime)).assertFalse();
      }
      const badFreq: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(
        bodyWith('坏频率', '"recurrence":{"freq":"yearly","time":"09:00"}'));
      if (badFreq !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.isLongterm(badFreq)).assertFalse();
      }
    });

    it('occurrence_window_and_key', 0, () => {
      const entry: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('g1',
        bodyWith('每周一', '"recurrence":{"freq":"weekly","weekday":1,"time":"19:00"}'), 1);
      const next: number = new Date(2026, 10, 16, 19, 0).getTime();
      const inside: NoticeOccurrence | undefined = NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceOf(
        entry, next - 12 * 3600 * 1000);
      expect(inside !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (inside !== undefined) {
        expect(inside.key).assertEqual('g1@occ:20261116');
        expect(inside.nextMillis).assertEqual(next);
        expect(inside.windowStartMillis).assertEqual(next - 24 * 3600 * 1000);
      }
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceOf(entry, next - 30 * 3600 * 1000) === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceOf(entry, next) === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceKey('g2', next)).assertEqual('g2@occ:20261116');
    });

    it('until_and_ended', 0, () => {
      const entry: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('g1',
        bodyWith('已结束', '"recurrence":{"freq":"daily","time":"19:00","until":"2026-11-14"}'), 1);
      const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = entry.group;
      if (group !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.recurUntil(group))
          .assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 14, 23, 59, 59, 999).getTime());
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.sectionOf(entry, NOW)).assertEqual(NoticeSection.EXPIRED);
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.occurrenceOf(entry, NOW) === undefined).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('sections_primary_material_expired', 0, () => {
      const withDeadline: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('a1',
        bodyWith('交作业', '"deadline":"2026-11-20 18:00"'), 1);
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.sectionOf(withDeadline, NOW)).assertEqual(NoticeSection.PRIMARY);
      const expired: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('a2',
        bodyWith('过期通知', '"deadline":"2026-11-10 18:00"'), 2);
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.sectionOf(expired, NOW)).assertEqual(NoticeSection.EXPIRED);
      const material: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('a3', bodyWith('资料通知', ''), 3);
      expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.sectionOf(material, NOW)).assertEqual(NoticeSection.MATERIAL);
    });

    it('deadline_text_formats', 0, () => {
      const group: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(
        bodyWith('截止', '"deadline":"2026-11-20T18:00:00+08:00"'));
      if (group !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.deadlineText(group)).assertEqual('11-20 18:00');
      }
      const raw: NoticeGroup | undefined = NoticeBodyParser.parseGroup(
        bodyWith('文字截止', '"deadline":"另行通知"'));
      if (raw !== undefined) {
        expect(NoticeRecurrenceLogic.deadlineText(raw)).assertEqual('另行通知');
      }
    });
  });

  describe('NoticeCards', () => {
    it('builds_occurrence_and_sections', 0, () => {
      const longterm: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('g1',
        bodyWith('长期安排', '"recurrence":{"freq":"weekly","weekday":1,"time":"19:00"}'), 1);
      const expired: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('e1',
        bodyWith('过期通知', '"deadline":"2026-11-10 18:00"'), 2);
      const material: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('m1', bodyWith('资料通知', ''), 3);
      const next: number = new Date(2026, 10, 16, 19, 0).getTime();
      const now: number = next - 12 * 3600 * 1000;
      const cards: NoticeCard[] = NoticeCards.build([longterm, expired, material], now);
      expect(cards.length).assertEqual(3);
      const primary: NoticeCard[] = NoticeCards.ofSection(cards, NoticeSection.PRIMARY);
      expect(primary.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(primary[0].occurrence).assertTrue();
      expect(primary[0].key).assertEqual('g1@occ:20261116');
      expect(NoticeCards.ofSection(cards, NoticeSection.EXPIRED).length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(NoticeCards.ofSection(cards, NoticeSection.MATERIAL).length).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('definition_card_when_no_occurrence', 0, () => {
      const longterm: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('g1',
        bodyWith('长期安排', '"recurrence":{"freq":"monthly_day","day":0,"time":"09:00"}'), 1);
      const cards: NoticeCard[] = NoticeCards.build([longterm], NOW);
      expect(cards.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(cards[0].definition).assertTrue();
      expect(cards[0].occurrence).assertFalse();
      expect(cards[0].label.indexOf('长期安排') === 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('pending_count_excludes_definition', 0, () => {
      const normal: NoticeEntry = entryFromJson('n1', bodyWith('普通通知', ''), 2);
      const cards: NoticeCard[] = NoticeCards.build([normal], NOW);
      expect(NoticeCards.pendingCount(cards, [])).assertEqual(1);
      expect(NoticeCards.pendingCount(cards, [cards[0].key])).assertEqual(0);
      const definition: NoticeCard = new NoticeCard();
      definition.definition = true;
      expect(NoticeCards.pendingCount([definition], [])).assertEqual(0);
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  PowerPoint,
  PowerCompare,
  SlowEstimate,
  PowerEstimate,
  PowerRange,
  PowerRangeKey,
  PowerRooms,
  PowerStats,
  RoomInfo
} from '../main/ets/data/power/PowerModels';
import { PowerRepository, PowerHistoryResult, PowerRowResult } from '../main/ets/data/power/PowerRepository';
import { RangeStats } from '../main/ets/data/power/PowerModels';
import { PowerPrefs, PowerPrefsData } from '../main/ets/data/power/PowerPrefs';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';

function point(q: number, t: number): PowerPoint {
  const p: PowerPoint = new PowerPoint();
  p.q = q;
  p.t = t;
  return p;
}

const HOUR: number = 60 * 60 * 1000;

export default function powerTest() {
  describe('PowerRooms', () => {
    it('catalog_is_17_rooms', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerRooms.ROOMS.length).assertEqual(17);
      expect(PowerRooms.BUILDINGS.length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(PowerRooms.labelOf('4-23A---321')).assertEqual('23号楼A座321');
      expect(PowerRooms.buildingOf('4-23A---321')).assertEqual('23号楼A座');
    });

    it('normalize_rejects_unknown', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerRooms.normalizeSel(' 4-23A---321 ')).assertEqual('4-23A---321');
      expect(PowerRooms.normalizeSel('bogus')).assertEqual('');
      expect(PowerRooms.normalizeSel('')).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('rooms_by_building_and_rv', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerRooms.roomsOfBuilding('23号楼B座').length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(PowerRooms.rvOf('23号楼B座', '422')).assertEqual('4-23B---422');
      expect(PowerRooms.rvOf('23号楼B座', '999')).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('slow_buildings_13_16', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerRooms.isSlowBuilding('13号楼')).assertTrue();
      expect(PowerRooms.isSlowBuilding('16号楼')).assertTrue();
      expect(PowerRooms.isSlowBuilding('23号楼A座')).assertFalse();
    });
  });

  describe('PowerStats', () => {
    it('derive_range_with_baseline', 0, () => {
      const now: number = 100 * HOUR;
      const points: PowerPoint[] = [
        point(50, now - 30 * HOUR), // 窗口外基线
        point(48, now - 20 * HOUR),
        point(40, now - 2 * HOUR),
        point(38, now - 1 * HOUR)
      ];
      const stats = PowerStats.deriveRange(points, PowerRange.H24, now);
      expect(stats.n).assertEqual(3);
      expect(stats.start).assertEqual(50);
      expect(stats.end).assertEqual(38);
      expect(stats.drop).assertEqual(12);
      expect(stats.valid).assertTrue();
      expect(Math.round(stats.hours)).assertEqual(29);
      expect(PowerStats.round2(stats.perDay)).assertEqual(PowerStats.round2(12 / 29 * 24));
    });

    it('insufficient_samples_invalid', 0, () => {
      const now: number = 100 * HOUR;
      const one: PowerPoint[] = [point(30, now - HOUR)];
      const stats = PowerStats.deriveRange(one, PowerRange.H24, now);
      expect(stats.valid).assertFalse();
      expect(stats.drop).assertEqual(0);
      expect(PowerStats.deriveRange([], PowerRange.H24, now).n).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('recharge_jump_is_excluded_from_drop', 0, () => {
      const now: number = 100 * HOUR;
      const jump: PowerPoint[] = [point(5, now - 3 * HOUR), point(60, now - HOUR)];
      const stats = PowerStats.deriveRange(jump, PowerRange.H24, now);
      expect(stats.drop).assertEqual(0);
      expect(stats.end).assertEqual(60);
      // 充值前 20→10 用掉 10，充值到 80 后 80→70 再用 10 → 合计 20
      const mixed: PowerPoint[] = [point(20, now - 6 * HOUR), point(10, now - 5 * HOUR),
        point(80, now - 4 * HOUR), point(70, now - 2 * HOUR)];
      const mixedStats = PowerStats.deriveRange(mixed, PowerRange.H24, now);
      expect(mixedStats.drop).assertEqual(20);
      expect(mixedStats.end).assertEqual(70);
    });

    it('window_points_include_baseline', 0, () => {
      const now: number = 100 * HOUR;
      const points: PowerPoint[] = [point(50, now - 30 * HOUR), point(45, now - 2 * HOUR)];
      const view: PowerPoint[] = PowerStats.windowPoints(points, PowerRange.H24, now);
      expect(view.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(view[0].q).assertEqual(50);
    });

    it('downsample_keeps_ends', 0, () => {
      const points: PowerPoint[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        points.push(point(100 - i, i * HOUR));
      }
      const out: PowerPoint[] = PowerStats.downsample(points, 10);
      expect(out.length).assertEqual(10);
      expect(out[0].q).assertEqual(100);
      expect(out[9].q).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('derive_window_and_compare', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 12, 0).getTime();
      const todayStart: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 0, 0).getTime();
      const yStart: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 0, 0).getTime();
      const points: PowerPoint[] = [
        point(100, yStart), point(90, yStart + 6 * HOUR), point(80, yStart + 12 * HOUR),
        point(70, todayStart), point(65, todayStart + 6 * HOUR), point(60, todayStart + 12 * HOUR)
      ];
      const window: RangeStats = PowerStats.deriveWindow(points, todayStart, now);
      expect(window.drop).assertEqual(10);
      expect(window.valid).assertTrue();
      const compare: PowerCompare = PowerStats.compare(points, PowerRange.H24, now);
      expect(compare.label).assertEqual('较昨日同期');
      expect(compare.valid).assertTrue();
      expect(compare.currentDrop).assertEqual(10);
      expect(compare.previousDrop).assertEqual(20);
      expect(compare.deltaPct).assertEqual(-50);
    });

    it('compare_invalid_without_history', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 12, 0).getTime();
      const todayStart: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 0, 0).getTime();
      const points: PowerPoint[] = [point(70, todayStart), point(60, todayStart + 12 * HOUR)];
      const compare: PowerCompare = PowerStats.compare(points, PowerRange.H24, now);
      expect(compare.valid).assertFalse();
      expect(compare.label).assertEqual('较昨日同期');
    });

    it('cursor_hit_nearest', 0, () => {
      const points: PowerPoint[] = [point(10, 0), point(9, 1000), point(8, 2000)];
      expect(PowerStats.cursorIndex(points, 0)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(PowerStats.cursorIndex(points, 0.5)).assertEqual(1);
      expect(PowerStats.cursorIndex(points, 1)).assertEqual(2);
      expect(PowerStats.cursorIndex([], 0.3)).assertEqual(-1);
    });

    it('estimate_and_deducts', 0, () => {
      const t0: number = new Date(2026, 10, 1).getTime();
      const normal: PowerPoint[] = [point(10, t0), point(8, t0 + 24 * HOUR), point(6, t0 + 48 * HOUR)];
      const est: PowerEstimate = PowerStats.estimate(normal);
      expect(est.valid).assertTrue();
      expect(est.ratePerDay).assertEqual(2);
      expect(est.deductCount).assertEqual(0);
      expect(PowerStats.daysLeft(10, 2)).assertEqual(5);
      expect(PowerStats.daysLeft(10, 3)).assertEqual(3.3);
      expect(PowerStats.daysLeft(10, 0)).assertEqual(0);
      const withDeduct: PowerPoint[] = [point(30, t0), point(28, t0 + 24 * HOUR), point(12, t0 + 25 * HOUR)];
      const est2: PowerEstimate = PowerStats.estimate(withDeduct);
      expect(est2.deductCount).assertEqual(1);
      expect(est2.deductDeg).assertEqual(16);
    });

    it('detects_recharges', 0, () => {
      const pts: PowerPoint[] = [point(10, 0), point(20, 1000), point(19, 2000), point(30, 3000)];
      const last: PowerPoint | undefined = PowerStats.lastRecharge(pts);
      expect(last !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (last !== undefined) {
        expect(last.q).assertEqual(30);
        expect(last.t).assertEqual(3000);
      }
      expect(PowerStats.lastRecharge([point(10, 0), point(9, 1)]) === undefined).assertTrue();
      const points: PowerPoint[] = [point(10, 0), point(9, 1000), point(20, 2000), point(19, 3000)];
      const rises: PowerPoint[] = PowerStats.recharges(points);
      expect(rises.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(rises[0].q).assertEqual(20);
      expect(PowerStats.recharges([point(10, 0), point(10.01, 1)]).length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('slow_estimate_segments', 0, () => {
      const t0: number = new Date(2026, 10, 1).getTime();
      const two: PowerPoint[] = [point(10, t0), point(8, t0 + 24 * HOUR), point(6, t0 + 48 * HOUR)];
      const estimate: SlowEstimate = PowerStats.slowEstimate(two);
      expect(estimate.valid).assertTrue();
      expect(estimate.segments).assertEqual(2);
      expect(estimate.perDay).assertEqual(2);
      expect(estimate.ref).assertFalse();
      const one: PowerPoint[] = [point(10, t0), point(7, t0 + 24 * HOUR)];
      const single: SlowEstimate = PowerStats.slowEstimate(one);
      expect(single.valid).assertTrue();
      expect(single.segments).assertEqual(1);
      expect(single.perDay).assertEqual(3);
      expect(single.ref).assertTrue();
      expect(PowerStats.slowEstimate([]).valid).assertFalse();
    });

    it('formats', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerStats.fmtMain(12.345, true)).assertEqual('12.35');
      expect(PowerStats.fmtMain(0, false)).assertEqual('—');
      expect(PowerStats.fmtDrop(3.2, true)).assertEqual('3.20');
      expect(PowerStats.fmtDrop(3.2, false)).assertEqual('—');
      expect(PowerStats.fmtRate(1.234, true)).assertEqual('1.2');
    });

    it('low_normalization', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerStats.normalizeLow(40)).assertEqual(40);
      expect(PowerStats.normalizeLow(37)).assertEqual(30);
      expect(PowerStats.normalizeLow(0)).assertEqual(30);
      expect(PowerStats.defaultLow()).assertEqual(30);
    });

    it('range_from_key', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerRange.fromKey('24h').key).assertEqual(PowerRangeKey.H24);
      expect(PowerRange.fromKey('30d').windowMs).assertEqual(30 * 24 * HOUR);
      expect(PowerRange.fromKey('x').key).assertEqual(PowerRangeKey.H24);
    });
  });

  describe('PowerPrefs', () => {
    it('read_defaults_and_normalize', 0, () => {
      const empty: Blob = {};
      expect(PowerPrefs.read(empty).sel).assertEqual('');
      expect(PowerPrefs.read(empty).low).assertEqual(30);
      const section: Blob = { 'sel': '4-23A---321', 'at': 5, 'low': 50 };
      const sections: Blob = { 'power': section };
      const data: PowerPrefsData = PowerPrefs.read(sections);
      expect(data.sel).assertEqual('4-23A---321');
      expect(data.low).assertEqual(50);
      const bad: Blob = { 'sel': 'nope', 'low': 37 };
      const badSections: Blob = { 'power': bad };
      expect(PowerPrefs.read(badSections).sel).assertEqual('');
      expect(PowerPrefs.read(badSections).low).assertEqual(30);
    });

    it('write_preserves_other_keys', 0, () => {
      const draw: Blob = { 'count': 3 };
      const current: Blob = { 'v': 6, 'draw': draw };
      const next: Blob = PowerPrefs.write(current, '4-23B---422', 40, 1234);
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(next).join(',')).assertEqual('v,draw,power');
      const power: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(next, 'power'));
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(power, 'sel'), '')).assertEqual('4-23B---422');
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(power, 'low'), 0)).assertEqual(40);
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(power, 'at'), 0)).assertEqual(1234);
    });

    it('is_low_respects_value', 0, () => {
      expect(PowerPrefs.isLow(20, true, 30)).assertTrue();
      expect(PowerPrefs.isLow(40, true, 30)).assertFalse();
      expect(PowerPrefs.isLow(0, false, 30)).assertFalse();
    });
  });

  describe('PowerRepository', () => {
    it('parses_row', 0, () => {
      const row = PowerRepository.parseRow('[{"id":"4-23A---321","label":"23号楼A座321","building":"23号楼A座",'
        + '"room":"321","quantity":42.5,"unit":"度","low":false,"updated_at":"2026-11-14T12:00:00+08:00"}]');
      expect(row !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (row !== undefined) {
        expect(row.q).assertEqual(42.5);
        expect(row.hasValue).assertTrue();
        expect(row.unit).assertEqual('度');
        expect(row.updatedAt.indexOf('2026-11-14') === 0).assertTrue();
      }
      const textQty = PowerRepository.parseRow('[{"id":"x","quantity":"12.25"}]');
      expect(textQty !== undefined && textQty.q === 12.25).assertTrue();
      const bad = PowerRepository.parseRow('[{"id":"x","quantity":"n/a"}]');
      expect(bad !== undefined && !bad.hasValue).assertTrue();
      expect(PowerRepository.parseRow('[]') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(PowerRepository.parseRow('bad') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('parses_history_iso_and_epoch', 0, () => {
      const iso: string = '[{"ts":"2026-11-14T10:00:00+08:00","quantity":30.5},'
        + '{"ts":"2026-11-14T09:00:00+08:00","quantity":31}]';
      const points: PowerPoint[] = PowerRepository.parseHistory(iso);
      expect(points.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(points[0].q).assertEqual(31);
      expect(points[0].t < points[1].t).assertTrue();
      const epoch: string = '[{"ts":1763000000,"quantity":20}]';
      expect(PowerRepository.parseHistory(epoch)[0].t).assertEqual(1763000000000);
      expect(PowerRepository.parseHistory('[]').length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('loads_row_and_history_with_cache', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.powerBody = '[{"id":"4-23A---321","quantity":33.3,"unit":"度","updated_at":"2026-11-14T12:00:00+08:00"}]';
      api.powerHistoryBody = '[{"ts":"2026-11-14T11:00:00+08:00","quantity":34},'
        + '{"ts":"2026-11-14T12:00:00+08:00","quantity":33.3}]';
      let now: number = 1000000;
      const repo: PowerRepository = new PowerRepository(api, () => now);
      const row: PowerRowResult = await repo.loadRow('4-23A---321', false);
      expect(row.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(row.row !== undefined && row.row.q === 33.3).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('id=eq.4-23A---321') > 0).assertTrue();
      const history: PowerHistoryResult = await repo.loadHistory('4-23A---321', PowerRange.D7, false);
      expect(history.points.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(api.getPaths[1].indexOf('roomverify=eq.4-23A---321') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[1].indexOf('order=ts.asc') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[1].indexOf('limit=2000') > 0).assertTrue();
      const cachedRow: PowerRowResult = await repo.loadRow('4-23A---321', false);
      expect(cachedRow.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(2);
      now = 1000000 + 4 * 60 * 1000;
      const cachedHistory: PowerHistoryResult = await repo.loadHistory('4-23A---321', PowerRange.D7, false);
      expect(cachedHistory.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(2);
    });

    it('failure_falls_back_to_cache', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.powerBody = '[{"id":"4-23A---321","quantity":10}]';
      let now: number = 0;
      const repo: PowerRepository = new PowerRepository(api, () => now);
      await repo.loadRow('4-23A---321', false);
      now = 10 * 60 * 1000;
      api.failGets = true;
      const fallback: PowerRowResult = await repo.loadRow('4-23A---321', true);
      expect(fallback.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(fallback.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(fallback.row !== undefined && fallback.row.q === 10).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  PptDeck,
  PptDeckDetail,
  PptDetailResult,
  PptFileInfo,
  PptListResult,
  downloadName,
  fileUrl,
  formatBytes,
  resolveUrl,
  pptStatusColor,
  pptStatusLabel
} from '../main/ets/data/ppt/PptModels';
import { PptRepository } from '../main/ets/data/ppt/PptRepository';
import { PptUploadPlanner } from '../main/ets/features/ppt/PptUploadPlanner';
import { PptUploadRepository } from '../main/ets/data/ppt/PptUploadRepository';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';

const LIST_JSON: string = '['
  + '{"id":"deck_1","title":"开学第一课","owner_name":"班长","status":"ready","progress":100,'
  + '"slide_count":12,"step_count":24,"aspect":"16:9","cover_url":"https://x/cover.webp",'
  + '"source_name":"a.pptx","source_size":1048576,"created_at":1794600000000,'
  + '"converted_at":1794610000000,"files":{"compat":{"src":"https://x/compat.pptx","size":1100000},'
  + '"pdf":{"src":"https://x/preview.pdf","size":800000}}},'
  + '{"id":"deck_2","title":"未转换","status":"processing","progress":40,"slide_count":3,"created_at":1794500000000}'
  + ']';

const DETAIL_JSON: string = '[{"id":"deck_1","title":"开学第一课","status":"ready","owner_name":"班长","slide_count":12,'
  + '"manifest":{"files":{"compat":{"src":"https://x/compat.pptx","size":1100000,"ext":"pptx",'
  + '"name":"开学第一课_兼容版.pptx"},"pdf":{"src":"https://x/preview.pdf","size":800000,"ext":"pdf","pages":12},'
  + '"source":{"src":"https://x/source.pptx","size":1048576,"ext":"pptx"}},'
  + '"compat":{"warnings":["外链媒体无法随包","字体未嵌入"]},"media_files":[{"n":"v1.mp4"},{"n":"v2.mp4"}]}}]';

const AGENT_JSON: string = '[{"body":{"at":"' + '__RECENT__' + '"},"updated_at":"2026-11-15T00:00:00+08:00"}]';

export default function pptTest() {
  describe('PptRepository', () => {
    it('parses_list_rows', 0, () => {
      const decks: PptDeck[] = PptRepository.parseList(LIST_JSON);
      expect(decks.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(decks[0].id).assertEqual('deck_1');
      expect(decks[0].title).assertEqual('开学第一课');
      expect(decks[0].status).assertEqual('ready');
      expect(decks[0].slideCount).assertEqual(12);
      expect(decks[0].hasCompat).assertTrue();
      expect(decks[0].hasPdf).assertTrue();
      expect(decks[1].hasCompat).assertFalse();
      expect(PptRepository.parseList('bad').length).assertEqual(0);
      expect(PptRepository.parseList('[]').length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('parses_detail_manifest', 0, () => {
      const detail: PptDeckDetail | undefined = PptRepository.parseDetail(DETAIL_JSON);
      expect(detail !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (detail !== undefined) {
        expect(detail.deck.title).assertEqual('开学第一课');
        expect(detail.files.compat !== undefined).assertTrue();
        expect(detail.files.pdf !== undefined).assertTrue();
        expect(detail.files.source !== undefined).assertTrue();
        if (detail.files.pdf !== undefined) {
          expect(detail.files.pdf.pages).assertEqual(12);
        }
        expect(detail.warnings.length).assertEqual(2);
        expect(detail.mediaCount).assertEqual(2);
      }
      expect(PptRepository.parseDetail('[]') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('agent_online_window', 0, () => {
      const now: number = Date.now();
      const recent: string = '[{"body":{"at":' + (now - 60 * 1000) + '}}]';
      const stale: string = '[{"body":{"at":' + (now - 10 * 60 * 1000) + '}}]';
      expect(PptRepository.agentOnline(recent)).assertTrue();
      expect(PptRepository.agentOnline(stale)).assertFalse();
      expect(PptRepository.agentOnline('[]')).assertFalse();
      const seen: string = '[{"body":{"online":true,"seen_at":' + now
        + '},"updated_at":"2026-11-09T22:30:22+08:00"}]';
      expect(PptRepository.agentOnline(seen)).assertTrue();
      const off: string = '[{"body":{"online":false,"seen_at":' + now + '}}]';
      expect(PptRepository.agentOnline(off)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('list_and_detail_via_api', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.pptListBody = LIST_JSON;
      api.pptDetailBody = DETAIL_JSON;
      api.pptAgentBody = '[{"body":{"at":' + Date.now() + '}}]';
      const repo: PptRepository = new PptRepository(api);
      const list: PptListResult = await repo.list();
      expect(list.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(list.decks.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(list.agentOnline).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('ppt_decks?select=id,title') === 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('deleted=eq.false') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[0].indexOf('order=created_at.desc') > 0).assertTrue();
      const detail: PptDetailResult = await repo.detail('deck_1');
      expect(detail.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(detail.detail.files.compat !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths[2].indexOf('id=eq.deck_1') > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('list_failure_surfaces_message', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.failGets = true;
      const repo: PptRepository = new PptRepository(api);
      const list: PptListResult = await repo.list();
      expect(list.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(list.message.length > 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('PptHelpers', () => {
    it('formats_bytes', 0, () => {
      expect(formatBytes(0)).assertEqual('—');
      expect(formatBytes(512)).assertEqual('512 B');
      expect(formatBytes(2048)).assertEqual('2.0 KB');
      expect(formatBytes(1048576)).assertEqual('1.0 MB');
      expect(formatBytes(3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)).assertEqual('3.00 GB');
    });

    it('download_names', 0, () => {
      const deck: PptDeck = new PptDeck();
      deck.title = '开学/第一课';
      const compat: PptFileInfo = new PptFileInfo();
      compat.ext = 'pptx';
      expect(downloadName(deck, compat, 'compat')).assertEqual('开学_第一课_兼容版.pptx');
      compat.ext = 'pdf';
      expect(downloadName(deck, compat, 'pdf')).assertEqual('开学_第一课_预览.pdf');
      compat.ext = 'ppt';
      expect(downloadName(deck, compat, 'source')).assertEqual('开学_第一课_原始文件.ppt');
    });

    it('resolves_relative_urls', 0, () => {
      const base: string = 'https://x/ppt/a/deck/c0e5/';
      const rel: PptFileInfo = new PptFileInfo();
      rel.s = 'preview.pdf';
      expect(fileUrl(base, rel)).assertEqual('https://x/ppt/a/deck/c0e5/preview.pdf');
      expect(fileUrl('https://x/base', rel)).assertEqual('https://x/base/preview.pdf');
      const abs: PptFileInfo = new PptFileInfo();
      abs.s = 'compat.pptx';
      abs.src = 'https://cdn/compat.pptx';
      expect(fileUrl(base, abs)).assertEqual('https://cdn/compat.pptx');
      const empty: PptFileInfo = new PptFileInfo();
      expect(fileUrl(base, empty)).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('parses_relative_manifest_files', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[{"id":"deck_2","title":"t","manifest":{"base":"https://x/ppt/a/deck_2/abc/",'
        + '"files":{"pdf":{"s":"preview.pdf","size":1105861,"pages":16,"name":"preview_cn.pdf"},'
        + '"compat":{"s":"compat.pptx","ext":"pptx","size":39063744}}}}]';
      const detail: PptDeckDetail | undefined = PptRepository.parseDetail(raw);
      expect(detail !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (detail !== undefined) {
        expect(detail.base).assertEqual('https://x/ppt/a/deck_2/abc/');
        expect(detail.files.pdf !== undefined).assertTrue();
        if (detail.files.pdf !== undefined) {
          expect(detail.files.pdf.s).assertEqual('preview.pdf');
          expect(detail.files.pdf.name).assertEqual('preview_cn.pdf');
          expect(fileUrl(detail.base, detail.files.pdf))
            .assertEqual('https://x/ppt/a/deck_2/abc/preview.pdf');
        }
        expect(detail.files.source === undefined).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('soft_delete_and_owner_parse', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const repo: PptRepository = new PptRepository(api);
      const ok: boolean = await repo.softDelete('d1abc23def45', 1763200000000);
      expect(ok).assertTrue();
      expect(api.patchPaths[0].indexOf('ppt_decks?id=eq.d1abc23def45') === 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.patchBodies[0].indexOf('"deleted":true') > 0).assertTrue();
      const list: PptDeck[] = PptRepository.parseList('[{"id":"d1","title":"t","owner_sid":"sid123","owner_name":"n","status":"ready"}]');
      expect(list.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(list[0].ownerSid).assertEqual('sid123');
      api.failPosts = true;
      expect(await repo.softDelete('d1', 1)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('upload_repository_requests', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const repo: PptUploadRepository = new PptUploadRepository(api);
      const okCreate: boolean = await repo.createDeck('d1abc23def45', 'QA', 1024, 'pptx', 'QA.pptx', 'sid123', '测试账号', 1763200000000);
      expect(okCreate).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postPaths[0]).assertEqual('ppt_decks');
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"id":"d1abc23def45"') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"status":"uploading"') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"owner_sid":"sid123"') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"client":"harmony"') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"source_name":"QA.pptx"') > 0).assertTrue();
      const okChunk: boolean = await repo.putChunk('d1abc23def45', 'sid123', 1, 'QUJD', 1763200000001);
      expect(okChunk).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postPaths[1]).assertEqual('ppt_upload_chunks');
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"idx":1') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"data":"QUJD"') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.lastPostBody().indexOf('"owner_sid":"sid123"') > 0).assertTrue();
      const okQueue: boolean = await repo.queue('d1abc23def45', 2, 1024, 1763200000002);
      expect(okQueue).assertTrue();
      expect(api.patchPaths[0].indexOf('ppt_decks?id=eq.d1abc23def45') === 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.patchBodies[0].indexOf('"status":"queued"') > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(api.patchBodies[0].indexOf('"chunk_count":2') > 0).assertTrue();
      api.failPosts = true;
      expect(await repo.createDeck('d2', 'x', 1, 'pptx', 'x.pptx', 'sid123', 'n', 1)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('upload_planner_rules', 0, () => {
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.chunkCount(0)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.chunkCount(512 * 1024)).assertEqual(1);
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.chunkCount(512 * 1024 + 1)).assertEqual(2);
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.chunkRange(0, 512 * 1024 + 10)[1]).assertEqual(512 * 1024);
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.chunkRange(1, 512 * 1024 + 10)[0]).assertEqual(512 * 1024);
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.chunkRange(1, 512 * 1024 + 10)[1]).assertEqual(10);
      const id: string = PptUploadPlanner.deckId(1763200000000, 987654);
      expect(id.startsWith('d')).assertTrue();
      expect(id.length).assertEqual(13);
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.isSupported('a.pptx')).assertTrue();
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.isSupported('a.PPT')).assertTrue();
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.isSupported('a.pdf')).assertFalse();
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.titleOf('演示 文件.pptx')).assertEqual('演示 文件');
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.extOf('A.PPTX')).assertEqual('pptx');
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.validate('a.pdf', 1).length > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.validate('a.pptx', 0).length > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.validate('a.pptx', PptUploadPlanner.MAX_SIZE + 1).length > 0).assertTrue();
      expect(PptUploadPlanner.validate('a.pptx', 1024)).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('parses_slides_video_media', 0, () => {
      const raw: string = '[{"id":"d1","title":"t","manifest":{"base":"https://x/ppt/a/d1/b1/",'
        + '"slides":[{"steps":[{"img":"s1-1.webp"},{"img":"s1-2.webp","media":[{"src":"media1.mp4"}]}]},'
        + '{"steps":[{"img":"s2-1.webp"}]}],'
        + '"video":{"src":"deck.mp4","dur":303.6,"w":1280,"h":720,"chapters":[{"i":0,"t":0},{"i":1,"t":12}]},'
        + '"media_files":[{"s":"media/v1.mp4","name":"视频1.mp4","size":20158796,"kind":"video","slides":[7]}]}}]';
      const detail: PptDeckDetail | undefined = PptRepository.parseDetail(raw);
      expect(detail !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (detail !== undefined) {
        expect(detail.slides.length).assertEqual(2);
        expect(detail.slides[0].steps.length).assertEqual(2);
        expect(detail.slides[0].steps[0].img).assertEqual('s1-1.webp');
        expect(detail.slides[0].steps[1].hasMedia).assertTrue();
        expect(detail.video !== undefined).assertTrue();
        if (detail.video !== undefined) {
          expect(detail.video.src).assertEqual('deck.mp4');
          expect(detail.video.chapters).assertEqual(2);
          expect(detail.video.width).assertEqual(1280);
          expect(detail.video.chapterList.length).assertEqual(2);
          expect(detail.video.chapterList[1].startSec).assertEqual(12);
        }
        expect(detail.mediaFiles.length).assertEqual(1);
        expect(detail.mediaFiles[0].name).assertEqual('视频1.mp4');
        expect(detail.mediaFiles[0].slides[0]).assertEqual(7);
        expect(resolveUrl(detail.base, detail.slides[0].steps[0].img))
          .assertEqual('https://x/ppt/a/d1/b1/s1-1.webp');
      }
    });

    it('status_labels', 0, () => {
      expect(pptStatusLabel('ready')).assertEqual('就绪');
      expect(pptStatusLabel('processing')).assertEqual('转换中');
      expect(pptStatusLabel('failed')).assertEqual('转换失败');
      expect(pptStatusLabel('weird')).assertEqual('上传中');
      expect(pptStatusColor('ready')).assertEqual('#4E9082');
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { HomeworkRow } from '../main/ets/data/homework/HomeworkModels';
import { ReminderPlanner, ReminderPrefs } from '../main/ets/features/reminder/ReminderModels';
import { ReminderRecord, ReminderStore } from '../main/ets/data/reminder/ReminderStore';

function row(subject: string, date: string, time: string): HomeworkRow {
  const item: HomeworkRow = new HomeworkRow();
  item.id = 'hw1';
  item.subject = subject;
  item.content = subject + ' 的内容\n第二行';
  item.date = date;
  item.time = time;
  return item;
}

const NOW: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 10, 0).getTime();

export default function reminderTest() {
  describe('ReminderPlanner', () => {
    it('plans_before_deadline', 0, () => {
      const plan = ReminderPlanner.plan(row('数学', '2026-11-20', '18:00'), NOW, 30);
      expect(plan !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (plan !== undefined) {
        expect(plan.homeworkId).assertEqual('hw1');
        expect(plan.dueAt).assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 20, 18, 0).getTime());
        expect(plan.triggerAt).assertEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 20, 17, 30).getTime());
        expect(plan.title).assertEqual('数学 作业截止');
        expect(plan.content.indexOf('提前 30 分钟') > 0).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('clamps_trigger_after_now', 0, () => {
      // 截止 10 分钟后，提前 30 分钟 → 触发时间压到 now+1 分钟
      const plan = ReminderPlanner.plan(row('英语', '2026-11-15', '10:10'), NOW, 30);
      expect(plan !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (plan !== undefined) {
        expect(plan.triggerAt).assertEqual(NOW + 60 * 1000);
      }
    });

    it('skips_past_and_missing_due', 0, () => {
      expect(ReminderPlanner.plan(row('过期', '2026-11-10', '18:00'), NOW, 30) === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(ReminderPlanner.plan(row('无日期', '', ''), NOW, 30) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('title_fallback_and_advance', 0, () => {
      const plan = ReminderPlanner.plan(row('', '2026-11-20', '18:00'), NOW, 60);
      if (plan !== undefined) {
        expect(plan.title).assertEqual('的内容 截止');
        expect(plan.content.indexOf('提前 1 小时') > 0).assertTrue();
      }
      expect(ReminderPlanner.normalizeAdvance(10)).assertEqual(10);
      expect(ReminderPlanner.normalizeAdvance(45)).assertEqual(30);
      expect(ReminderPlanner.ADVANCE_OPTIONS.length).assertEqual(4);
    });

    it('urgency_labels', 0, () => {
      expect(ReminderPlanner.urgency(undefined, NOW)).assertEqual('');
      expect(ReminderPlanner.urgency(NOW - 1, NOW)).assertEqual('已过期');
      expect(ReminderPlanner.urgency(NOW + 60 * 60 * 1000, NOW)).assertEqual('今日到期');
      expect(ReminderPlanner.urgency(NOW + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, NOW)).assertEqual('');
    });

    it('prefs_default', 0, () => {
      const prefs: ReminderPrefs = new ReminderPrefs();
      expect(prefs.enabled).assertTrue();
      expect(prefs.advanceMinutes).assertEqual(30);
    });
  });

  describe('ReminderStoreCodec', () => {
    it('encodes_and_decodes_ids', 0, () => {
      const ids: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
      ids.set('hw1', 12);
      ids.set('hw2', 34);
      const raw: string = ReminderStore.encodeIds(ids);
      expect(raw).assertEqual('hw1:12;hw2:34');
      const decoded: Map<string, number> = ReminderStore.decodeIds(raw);
      expect(decoded.get('hw1')).assertEqual(12);
      expect(decoded.get('hw2')).assertEqual(34);
      expect(ReminderStore.decodeIds('').size).assertEqual(0);
      expect(ReminderStore.decodeIds('bad').size).assertEqual(0);
      expect(ReminderStore.decodeIds('hw3:-1').size).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('skips_invalid_keys_and_values', 0, () => {
      const ids: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>();
      ids.set('a;b', 1);
      ids.set('c:d', 2);
      ids.set('ok', 3);
      ids.set('neg', -5);
      expect(ReminderStore.encodeIds(ids)).assertEqual('ok:3');
    });

    it('record_defaults', 0, () => {
      const record: ReminderRecord = new ReminderRecord();
      expect(record.advance).assertEqual(30);
      expect(record.ids.size).assertEqual(0);
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { ClassMember } from '../main/ets/data/member/ClassMember';
import {
  RollCodec,
  RollCounts,
  RollLogic,
  RollRow,
  RollScope,
  RollState,
  RollStatus
} from '../main/ets/features/roll/RollModels';
import { Blob } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

function member(seat: number, name: string, role: string, badge: string): ClassMember {
  return new ClassMember(seat, 'sid' + seat, name, role, badge, false);
}

function members(): ClassMember[] {
  return [
    member(3, '丙', '班长', '班委'),
    member(1, '甲', '', ''),
    member(2, '乙', '', '班委'),
    member(4, '丁', '', '')
  ];
}

export default function rollTest() {
  describe('RollCodec', () => {
    it('reads_roll_fields_and_preserves_others', 0, () => {
      const sections: Blob = JSON.parse('{"roster":{"rosterSel":[1,2],"groupSel":[3],"rollSel":[2,3],'
        + '"rollNames":"名单","rollSt":{"1":"到","2":"假","3":"x","0":"到"}},'
        + '"power":{"sel":"4-23A---321","low":30},"draw":{"count":3}}') as Blob;
      const state: RollState = RollCodec.read(sections);
      expect(state.rollSel.join(',')).assertEqual('2,3');
      expect(state.rosterSel.join(',')).assertEqual('1,2');
      expect(state.groupSel.join(',')).assertEqual('3');
      expect(state.rollSt.size).assertEqual(2);
      expect(state.rollSt.get(1)).assertEqual('到');
      expect(state.rollSt.get(2)).assertEqual('假');
      expect(state.rollSt.get(3) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('writes_roll_fields_keeping_other_data', 0, () => {
      const sections: Blob = JSON.parse('{"roster":{"rosterSel":[5],"rollSel":[1],"rollSt":{}},'
        + '"power":{"sel":"x"},"v":6}') as Blob;
      const state: RollState = RollCodec.read(sections);
      state.rollSt.set(1, '到');
      state.rollSt.set(2, '假');
      const next: Blob = RollCodec.write(sections, state);
      const nextRoster: Blob | undefined = next['roster'] as Blob;
      expect(nextRoster !== undefined).assertTrue();
      const rollSt: Blob | undefined = nextRoster['rollSt'] as Blob;
      expect(rollSt !== undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(Object.keys(rollSt).sort().join(',')).assertEqual('1,2');
      expect((nextRoster['rosterSel'] as number[]).join(',')).assertEqual('5');
      expect((next['power'] as Blob)['sel']).assertEqual('x');
      expect(next['v']).assertEqual(6);
    });
  });

  describe('RollLogic', () => {
    it('scope_seats', 0, () => {
      expect(RollLogic.scopeSeats(members(), [1, 4], RollScope.ALL).size).assertEqual(0);
      const committee: Set<number> = RollLogic.scopeSeats(members(), [1, 4], RollScope.COMMITTEE);
      expect(committee.has(3)).assertTrue();
      expect(committee.has(2)).assertTrue();
      expect(committee.has(1)).assertFalse();
      const league: Set<number> = RollLogic.scopeSeats(members(), [1, 4], RollScope.LEAGUE);
      expect(league.has(4)).assertTrue();
      expect(league.has(3)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('rows_pending_first_then_processed', 0, () => {
      const statuses: Map<number, string> = new Map<number, string>();
      statuses.set(3, '到');
      statuses.set(1, '假');
      const rows: RollRow[] = RollLogic.rows(members(), statuses, new Set<number>());
      expect(rows.length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(rows[0].seat).assertEqual(2);
      expect(rows[1].seat).assertEqual(4);
      expect(rows[2].processed).assertTrue();
      expect(rows[3].processed).assertTrue();
      expect(rows[2].seat).assertEqual(1);
    });

    it('counts_and_progress', 0, () => {
      const rows: RollRow[] = [];
      const done: RollRow = new RollRow();
      done.seat = 1;
      done.status = RollStatus.DONE;
      rows.push(done);
      const absent: RollRow = new RollRow();
      absent.seat = 2;
      absent.status = RollStatus.ABSENT;
      rows.push(absent);
      const pending: RollRow = new RollRow();
      pending.seat = 3;
      rows.push(pending);
      const counts: RollCounts = RollLogic.counts(rows);
      expect(counts.done).assertEqual(1);
      expect(counts.absent).assertEqual(1);
      expect(counts.pending).assertEqual(1);
      expect(counts.total).assertEqual(3);
      expect(counts.progress()).assertEqual(67);
      expect(RollLogic.counts([]).progress()).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('toggle_and_clear', 0, () => {
      let statuses: Map<number, string> = new Map<number, string>();
      statuses = RollLogic.toggle(statuses, 1, '到');
      expect(statuses.get(1)).assertEqual('到');
      statuses = RollLogic.toggle(statuses, 1, '到');
      expect(statuses.get(1) === undefined).assertTrue();
      statuses = RollLogic.toggle(statuses, 1, '到');
      statuses = RollLogic.toggle(statuses, 2, '假');
      statuses = RollLogic.toggle(statuses, 3, '到');
      const scope: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
      scope.add(1);
      scope.add(2);
      const cleared: Map<number, string> = RollLogic.clear(statuses, scope);
      expect(cleared.size).assertEqual(1);
      expect(cleared.get(3)).assertEqual('到');
      expect(RollLogic.clear(statuses, new Set<number>()).size).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('intersect_custom_roster', 0, () => {
      const scope: Set<number> = new Set<number>();
      scope.add(1);
      scope.add(2);
      scope.add(3);
      expect(RollLogic.intersect(scope, []).size).assertEqual(3);
      expect(RollLogic.intersect(scope, [2]).size).assertEqual(1);
      expect(RollLogic.intersect(scope, [2, 9]).size).assertEqual(1);
      expect(RollLogic.intersect(new Set<number>(), [5, 6]).size).assertEqual(2);
    });

    it('writes_roll_sel', 0, () => {
      const sections: Blob = JSON.parse('{"roster":{"rollSel":[],"rollSt":{}},"v":6}') as Blob;
      const state: RollState = RollCodec.read(sections);
      state.rollSel = [3, 5];
      const next: Blob = RollCodec.write(sections, state);
      const roster: Blob | undefined = next['roster'] as Blob;
      const seats: Object[] | undefined = roster['rollSel'] as Object[];
      expect(seats !== undefined && seats.length === 2).assertTrue();
    });

    it('names_of_status', 0, () => {
      const rows: RollRow[] = RollLogic.rows(members(), new Map<number, string>(), new Set<number>());
      rows[0].status = '假';
      expect(RollLogic.namesOf(rows, '假').length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(RollLogic.namesOf(rows, '').length).assertEqual(3);
    });
  });
}

import {

const TERM_START: string = '2026-09-07'; // 周一
const SATURDAY: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 10, 0).getTime(); // 11-14 周六 10:00

function course(name: string, day: number, start: number, end: number, weeks: string, parity: string): Course {
  const c: Course = new Course();
  c.name = name;
  c.day = day;
  c.start = start;
  c.end = end;
  c.weeks = weeks;
  c.parity = parity;
  c.room = '自强楼(教室01105)';
  return c;
}

function snapshotWith(courses: Course[], termStart: string): TtSnapshot {
  const snapshot: TtSnapshot = new TtSnapshot();
  snapshot.c = courses;
  snapshot.t = termStart;
  return snapshot;
}

function bodyJson(courses: string, termStart: string): string {
  return '{"c":[' + courses + '],"t":"' + termStart + '"}';
}

export default function timetableTest() {
  describe('TtCalendarBasics', () => {
    it('parses_term_start', 0, () => {
      const date: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(TERM_START);
      expect(date !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (date !== undefined) {
        expect(date.getFullYear()).assertEqual(2026);
        expect(date.getMonth()).assertEqual(8);
        expect(date.getDate()).assertEqual(7);
      }
      expect(TtCalendar.parseTermStart('') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(TtCalendar.parseTermStart('2026/09/07') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('parses_weeks_expression', 0, () => {
      const weeks: Set<number> = TtCalendar.parseWeeks('1-3,5，7;9');
      expect(weeks.size).assertEqual(6);
      expect(weeks.has(2)).assertTrue();
      expect(weeks.has(4)).assertFalse();
      expect(weeks.has(9)).assertTrue();
      expect(TtCalendar.parseWeeks('').size).assertEqual(0);
      expect(TtCalendar.parseWeeks('abc').size).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('week_of_term', 0, () => {
      const term: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(TERM_START);
      expect(term !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (term !== undefined) {
        const sameWeek: Date = new Date(2026, 8, 12, 0, 0, 0); // 09-12 周六
        expect(TtCalendar.weekOf(term, sameWeek)).assertEqual(1);
        const nextWeek: Date = new Date(2026, 8, 14, 0, 0, 0); // 09-14 周一
        expect(TtCalendar.weekOf(term, nextWeek)).assertEqual(2);
        const before: Date = new Date(2026, 8, 1, 0, 0, 0);
        expect(TtCalendar.weekOf(term, before) === undefined).assertTrue();
        expect(TtCalendar.weekOf(undefined, sameWeek) === undefined).assertTrue();
      }
    });

    it('active_by_weeks_and_parity', 0, () => {
      const full: Course = course('全学期', 5, 1, 2, '', 'all');
      expect(TtCalendar.isActive(full, 10)).assertTrue();
      const odd: Course = course('单周', 5, 1, 2, '1-16', 'odd');
      expect(TtCalendar.isActive(odd, 9)).assertTrue();
      expect(TtCalendar.isActive(odd, 10)).assertFalse();
      const even: Course = course('双周', 5, 1, 2, '3-16', 'even');
      expect(TtCalendar.isActive(even, 10)).assertTrue();
      expect(TtCalendar.isActive(even, 1)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('room_short_and_span', 0, () => {
      expect(TtCalendar.roomShort('自强楼(教室01105)')).assertEqual('01105');
      expect(TtCalendar.roomShort('A101')).assertEqual('A101');
      expect(TtCalendar.roomShort('很长的教室名字没有数字'.substring(0, 12))).assertEqual('很长的教室名字…');
      expect(TtCalendar.spanText(1, 2)).assertEqual('1-2 节');
      expect(TtCalendar.spanText(3, 3)).assertEqual('3 节');
    });

    it('periods_table', 0, () => {
      expect(TtPeriods.PERIODS.length).assertEqual(12);
      expect(TtPeriods.startText(1)).assertEqual('08:10');
      expect(TtPeriods.endText(5)).assertEqual('12:10');
      expect(TtPeriods.startText(0)).assertEqual('');
    });
  });

  describe('TtCalendarSessions', () => {
    it('sessions_on_with_states', 0, () => {
      const term: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(TERM_START);
      const courses: Course[] = [course('高数', 5, 1, 2, '1-16', 'all'), course('英语', 5, 3, 4, '1-16', 'all')];
      const date: Date = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 0, 0, 0);
      // 09:30：高数（08:10-09:40）进行中，英语（09:50-11:25）未开始
      const at0930: SessionInfo[] = TtCalendar.sessionsOn(courses, term,
        date, new Date(2026, 10, 14, 9, 30).getTime());
      expect(at0930.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(at0930[0].state).assertEqual(SessionState.ONGOING);
      expect(at0930[1].state).assertEqual(SessionState.NEXT);
      expect(at0930[0].room).assertEqual('01105');
      // 13:00：都结束
      const at1300: SessionInfo[] = TtCalendar.sessionsOn(courses, term,
        date, new Date(2026, 10, 14, 13, 0).getTime());
      expect(at1300[0].state).assertEqual(SessionState.DONE);
      expect(at1300[1].state).assertEqual(SessionState.DONE);
    });

    it('next_session_today_or_tomorrow', 0, () => {
      const term: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(TERM_START);
      const courses: Course[] = [course('高数', 5, 1, 2, '1-16', 'all')];
      // 周六 06:00 → 今天 1-2 节
      const early: SessionInfo | undefined = TtCalendar.nextSession(courses, term,
        new Date(2026, 10, 14, 6, 0).getTime(), 14);
      expect(early !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (early !== undefined) {
        expect(early.dayOffset).assertEqual(0);
        expect(early.dayText).assertEqual('今天');
      }
      // 周六 13:00 → 今天已结束，下周同一课程（+7 天）
      const after: SessionInfo | undefined = TtCalendar.nextSession(courses, term,
        new Date(2026, 10, 14, 13, 0).getTime(), 14);
      expect(after !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (after !== undefined) {
        expect(after.dayOffset).assertEqual(7);
      }
    });

    it('courses_on_filters_and_sorts', 0, () => {
      const term: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(TERM_START);
      const courses: Course[] = [course('晚课', 5, 10, 12, '', 'all'), course('早课', 5, 1, 2, '', 'all'),
        course('单周课', 5, 3, 4, '1-16', 'odd'), course('别的天', 0, 1, 2, '', 'all')];
      const date: Date = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 0, 0, 0);
      const list: Course[] = TtCalendar.coursesOn(courses, term, date);
      expect(list.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(list[0].name).assertEqual('早课');
      expect(list[1].name).assertEqual('晚课');
      const oddWeek: Date = new Date(2026, 10, 21, 0, 0, 0);
      const oddOnly: Course[] = TtCalendar.coursesOn(courses, term, oddWeek);
      expect(oddOnly.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(oddOnly[1].name).assertEqual('单周课');
    });

    it('monday_of_week', 0, () => {
      const term: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(TERM_START);
      if (term !== undefined) {
        const monday: Date = TtCalendar.mondayOfWeek(term, 3);
        expect(monday.getMonth()).assertEqual(8);
        expect(monday.getDate()).assertEqual(21);
      }
    });

    it('plan_states', 0, () => {
      const term: Date | undefined = TtCalendar.parseTermStart(TERM_START);
      const date: Date = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 0, 0, 0);
      const empty: TtSnapshot = snapshotWith([], TERM_START);
      expect(TtCalendar.plan(empty, date.getTime()).todayState).assertEqual(TodayState.NODATA);
      expect(TtCalendar.plan(undefined, date.getTime()).hasData).assertFalse();

      const noToday: TtSnapshot = snapshotWith([course('高数', 0, 1, 2, '', 'all')], TERM_START);
      expect(TtCalendar.plan(noToday, date.getTime()).todayState).assertEqual(TodayState.NONE);

      const hasToday: TtSnapshot = snapshotWith([course('高数', 5, 1, 2, '', 'all')], TERM_START);
      const plan = TtCalendar.plan(hasToday, new Date(2026, 10, 14, 8, 30).getTime());
      expect(plan.todayState).assertEqual(TodayState.HAS);
      expect(plan.week).assertEqual(10);
      expect(plan.today.length).assertEqual(1);

      const doneToday = TtCalendar.plan(hasToday, new Date(2026, 10, 14, 20, 0).getTime());
      expect(doneToday.todayState).assertEqual(TodayState.DONE);
      expect(term !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('TtParser', () => {
    it('parses_snapshot', 0, () => {
      const body: string = bodyJson('{"name":"高数","day":5,"start":1,"end":2,"weeks":"1-16","parity":"all",'
        + '"room":"A101","teacher":"张老师"}', TERM_START);
      const snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined = TtParser.parseSnapshot(body);
      expect(snapshot !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (snapshot !== undefined) {
        expect(snapshot.c.length).assertEqual(1);
        expect(snapshot.c[0].name).assertEqual('高数');
        expect(snapshot.c[0].teacher).assertEqual('张老师');
        expect(snapshot.termStart()).assertEqual(TERM_START);
      }
      expect(TtParser.parseSnapshot('') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(TtParser.parseSnapshot('bad') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('drops_invalid_courses', 0, () => {
      const body: string = bodyJson('{"name":"坏课","day":9,"start":1,"end":2}'
        + ',{"name":"倒序","day":1,"start":5,"end":3}'
        + ',{"name":"好课","day":1,"start":1,"end":2}', TERM_START);
      const snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined = TtParser.parseSnapshot(body);
      expect(snapshot !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (snapshot !== undefined) {
        expect(snapshot.c.length).assertEqual(1);
        expect(snapshot.c[0].name).assertEqual('好课');
      }
    });

    it('meta_term_start_wins', 0, () => {
      const body: string = '{"c":[],"t":"2026-09-01","meta":{"termStart":"2026-09-07"}}';
      const snapshot: TtSnapshot | undefined = TtParser.parseSnapshot(body);
      expect(snapshot !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (snapshot !== undefined) {
        expect(snapshot.termStart()).assertEqual('2026-09-07');
      }
    });
  });

  describe('TimetableRepository', () => {
    it('parses_site_asset_object_body', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.siteAssetsBody = '[{"id":"tt","body":{"c":[{"name":"高数","day":5,"start":1,"end":2}],"t":"2026-09-07"}}]';
      const repo: TimetableRepository = new TimetableRepository(api, () => undefined, () => SATURDAY, 0);
      const result: TtResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(result.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(result.snapshot !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (result.snapshot !== undefined) {
        expect(result.snapshot.c.length).assertEqual(1);
      }
      expect(result.source).assertEqual(TtSource.PUBLIC);
      expect(result.fromCache).assertFalse();
    });

    it('personal_snapshot_has_priority', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const personal: Blob = JSON.parse('{"ttUseMine":true,"ttLocal":{"c":[{"name":"我的课","day":5,"start":1,"end":2}],'
        + '"t":"2026-09-07"}}') as Blob;
      const repo: TimetableRepository = new TimetableRepository(api, () => personal, () => SATURDAY, 0);
      const result: TtResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(result.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(result.source).assertEqual(TtSource.PERSONAL);
      if (result.snapshot !== undefined) {
        expect(result.snapshot.c[0].name).assertEqual('我的课');
      }
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('ttl_cache_and_fallback', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.siteAssetsBody = '[{"id":"tt","body":"{\\"c\\":[{\\"name\\":\\"高数\\",\\"day\\":5,\\"start\\":1,\\"end\\":2}],'
        + '\\"t\\":\\"2026-09-07\\"}"}]';
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: TimetableRepository = new TimetableRepository(api, () => undefined, () => now, 1000);
      await repo.load(false);
      const cached: TtResult = await repo.load(false);
      expect(cached.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(1);
      now = 5000;
      api.failGets = true;
      const fallback: TtResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(fallback.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(fallback.fromCache).assertTrue();
      expect(fallback.snapshot !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('empty_site_asset_is_failure', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.siteAssetsBody = '[]';
      const repo: TimetableRepository = new TimetableRepository(api, () => undefined, () => SATURDAY, 0);
      const result: TtResult = await repo.load(true);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(result.message.length > 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}

export default function timetableLoginTest() {
  describe('TimetableLoginRepository', () => {

      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const repo: TimetableLoginRepository = new TimetableLoginRepository(api);
      const empty = await repo.enqueue('');
      expect(empty.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(empty.message).assertEqual('请输入教务密码');

      const enqueue: TtLoginEnqueue = await repo.enqueue('secret');
      expect(enqueue.ok).assertTrue();

      const rejected = await repo.enqueue('x');
      expect(rejected.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(rejected.message).assertEqual('拒绝');

      api.ttLoginStatusBody = '{"ok":true,"status":"running","finished":false}';
      const running = await repo.status('job1');
      expect(running.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(running.finished).assertFalse();
      expect(running.snapshot === undefined).assertTrue();

      api.ttLoginStatusBody = '{"ok":true,"status":"done","finished":true,"result":{"t":"2026-09-01","c":[{"name":"高等数学","teacher":"张老师","room":"A101","day":0,"start":1,"end":2,"weeks":"1-16","parity":"all"}]}}';

      }

      api.failPosts = true;
      const failed = await repo.enqueue('x');
      expect(failed.ok).assertFalse();
    });
  });
