import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { UserdataV6 } from '../main/ets/data/sync/UserdataV6';
import { UserdataMerge } from '../main/ets/data/sync/UserdataMerge';
import {
  EXPECTED_MERGE_MP_WEB,
  EXPECTED_MERGE_WEB_MP,
  EXPECTED_V5_MIGRATE,
  LEGACY_V5,
  USERDATA_V6_MP,
  USERDATA_V6_WEB
} from './fixtures/SyncFixtures';

function blobOf(text: string): Blob {
  const parsed: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.parse(text);
  return parsed !== undefined ? parsed : {};
}

function allSections(): Set<string> {
  const set: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS.length; i++) {
    set.add(UserdataV6.SECTION_KEYS[i]);
  }
  return set;
}

function emptySet(): Set<string> {
  return new Set<string>();
}

export default function userdataMergeTest() {
  describe('UserdataMergeOracle', () => {
    it('merge_remote_mp_local_web_matches_oracle', 0, () => {
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(blobOf(USERDATA_V6_MP), blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB));
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(merged, blobOf(EXPECTED_MERGE_WEB_MP))).assertTrue();
    });

    it('merge_remote_web_local_mp_matches_oracle', 0, () => {
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB), blobOf(USERDATA_V6_MP));
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(merged, blobOf(EXPECTED_MERGE_MP_WEB))).assertTrue();
    });

    it('v5_migration_matches_oracle', 0, () => {
      const localAt: Blob = {};
      const localFit: Blob = { 'sex': 'm' };
      const local: Blob = { 'at': localAt, 'fit': localFit };
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(blobOf(LEGACY_V5), local);
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(merged, blobOf(EXPECTED_V5_MIGRATE))).assertTrue();
    });

    it('merge_output_has_contract_key_order', 0, () => {
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(blobOf(USERDATA_V6_MP), blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB));
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(merged).join(',')).assertEqual(UserdataV6.TOP_LEVEL_KEYS.join(','));
    });

    it('merge_is_idempotent', 0, () => {
      const once: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(blobOf(USERDATA_V6_MP), blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB));
      const twice: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(once, once);
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(once, twice)).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('UserdataMergeRules', () => {
    it('remote_wins_on_timestamp_tie', 0, () => {
      const remoteAt: Blob = { 'nick': 100 };
      const remote: Blob = { 'v': 6, 'at': remoteAt, 'nick': 'remote' };
      const localAt: Blob = { 'nick': 100 };
      const local: Blob = { 'at': localAt, 'nick': 'local' };
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(remote, local);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'nick'), '')).assertEqual('remote');
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(merged, 'nick')).assertEqual(100);
    });

    it('local_wins_when_newer', 0, () => {
      const remoteAt: Blob = { 'nick': 100 };
      const remote: Blob = { 'v': 6, 'at': remoteAt, 'nick': 'remote' };
      const localAt: Blob = { 'nick': 200 };
      const local: Blob = { 'at': localAt, 'nick': 'local' };
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(remote, local);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'nick'), '')).assertEqual('local');
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(merged, 'nick')).assertEqual(200);
    });

    it('null_value_does_not_count_as_present', 0, () => {
      const remoteAt: Blob = { 'tt': 500 };
      const remote: Blob = { 'v': 6, 'at': remoteAt, 'tt': null };
      const localAt: Blob = { 'tt': 100 };
      const localTt: Blob = { 'ttView': 'day' };
      const local: Blob = { 'at': localAt, 'tt': localTt };
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(remote, local);
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(merged, 'tt')).assertEqual(100);
      const tt: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'tt'));
      expect(tt !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('defaults_fill_when_both_sides_missing', 0, () => {
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(undefined, undefined);
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'draw'), UserdataV6.defaultSection('draw'))).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'roster'), UserdataV6.defaultSection('roster'))).assertTrue();
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(merged, 'draw')).assertEqual(0);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'homeToolsAt'))).assertEqual(0);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'v'))).assertEqual(6);
    });

    it('bad_json_is_treated_as_no_data', 0, () => {
      expect(JsonBlob.parse('not-json') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.parse('[1,2]') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.parse('') === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('homeToolsAt_mirrors_at_homeTools', 0, () => {
      const remoteAt: Blob = { 'homeTools': 1762310000000 };
      const homeTools: Object[] = ['hw'];
      const remote: Blob = { 'v': 6, 'at': remoteAt, 'homeTools': homeTools };
      const merged: Blob = UserdataMerge.merge(remote, undefined);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(merged, 'homeToolsAt'))).assertEqual(1762310000000);
    });
  });

  describe('UserdataLocalView', () => {
    it('dirty_section_gets_now_timestamp', 0, () => {
      const base: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      const current: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      current['nick'] = '改了昵称';
      const now: number = 1762400000000;
      const view: Blob = UserdataMerge.localView(base, current, base, emptySet(), now, allSections());
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(view, 'nick')).assertEqual(now);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(view, 'nick'), '')).assertEqual('改了昵称');
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(view, 'fit')).assertEqual(UserdataV6.atValue(base, 'fit'));
    });

    it('no_base_is_not_dirty', 0, () => {
      const current: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      const view: Blob = UserdataMerge.localView(undefined, current, undefined, emptySet(), 1762400000000, allSections());
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(view, 'nick')).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('force_keys_are_dirty_even_without_change', 0, () => {
      const base: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      const force: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
      force.add('power');
      const now: number = 1762400000000;
      const view: Blob = UserdataMerge.localView(base, base, base, force, now, allSections());
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(view, 'power')).assertEqual(now);
    });

    it('power_section_mirrors_at_power', 0, () => {
      const base: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      const force: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
      force.add('power');
      const now: number = 1762400000000;
      const view: Blob = UserdataMerge.localView(base, base, base, force, now, allSections());
      const power: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(view, 'power'));
      expect(power !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (power !== undefined) {
        expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(power, 'at'))).assertEqual(now);
        expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(power, 'sel'), '')).assertEqual(
          JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(base, 'power')), 'sel'), ''));
      }
    });

    it('local_view_output_has_contract_key_order', 0, () => {
      const base: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      const view: Blob = UserdataMerge.localView(base, base, base, emptySet(), 1762400000000, allSections());
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(view).join(',')).assertEqual(UserdataV6.TOP_LEVEL_KEYS.join(','));
    });

    it('dirty_sections_detects_change_only', 0, () => {
      const base: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      const current: Blob = blobOf(USERDATA_V6_WEB);
      current['nick'] = 'x';
      const dirty: Set<string> = UserdataMerge.dirtySections(base, current, allSections());
      expect(dirty.has('nick')).assertTrue();
      expect(dirty.has('fit')).assertFalse();
    });

    it('changed_keys_vs_defaults_skips_prefs', 0, () => {
      const current: Blob = UserdataV6.empty();
      current['nick'] = 'x';
      const changed: Set<string> = UserdataMerge.changedKeysVsDefaults(current, allSections());
      expect(changed.has('nick')).assertTrue();
      expect(changed.has('prefs')).assertFalse();
      expect(changed.has('fit')).assertFalse();
    });
  });

  describe('JsonBlobSemantics', () => {
    it('deep_equal_ignores_object_key_order', 0, () => {
      const aInner: Blob = { 'p': 1, 'q': 2 };
      const bInner: Blob = { 'q': 2, 'p': 1 };
      const a: Blob = { 'x': 1, 'y': aInner };
      const b: Blob = { 'y': bInner, 'x': 1 };
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(a, b)).assertTrue();
    });

    it('deep_equal_is_strict_about_arrays', 0, () => {
      const a: Object[] = [1, 2];
      const b: Object[] = [2, 1];
      expect(JsonBlob.deepEqual(a, b)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('num_ms_rejects_string_and_non_positive', 0, () => {
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs('1762310000000')).assertEqual(0);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(0)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(-5)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(1762310000000)).assertEqual(1762310000000);
    });

    it('json_value_helpers_have_defaults', 0, () => {
      const value: JsonValue = null;
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(value, 'd')).assertEqual('d');
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(value, 7)).assertEqual(7);
      expect(JsonBlob.asBoolean(value, true)).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.asBlob(value) === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.asArray(value) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';
import { InMemoryUserdataLocalStore } from '../main/ets/data/sync/UserdataLocalStore';
import { UserdataRepository, UserdataPullResult, UserdataPushResult } from '../main/ets/data/sync/UserdataRepository';
import { UserdataV6 } from '../main/ets/data/sync/UserdataV6';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';
import { USERDATA_V6_WEB } from './fixtures/SyncFixtures';

const SID: string = '3260799999';

function remoteV6(nick: string, at: number): string {
  const blob: Blob = UserdataV6.empty();
  blob['nick'] = nick;
  const atMap: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'at'));
  if (atMap !== undefined) {
    atMap['nick'] = at;
  }
  return JsonBlob.encode(blob);
}

function postedBlob(api: FakeApi): Blob {
  const body: string = api.lastPostBody();
  const rows: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JSON.parse(body) as JsonValue);
  if (rows === undefined || rows.length === 0) {
    return {};
  }
  const row: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(rows[0]);
  const blobText: string = JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(row, 'blob'), '');
  const decoded: Blob | undefined = UserdataV6.decode(blobText);
  return decoded !== undefined ? decoded : {};
}

export default function userdataRepositoryTest() {
  describe('UserdataRepository', () => {
    it('pull_empty_cloud_builds_baseline_without_push', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 1000);
      const result: UserdataPullResult = await repo.pull(true);
      expect(result.ok()).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postBodies.length).assertEqual(0);
      expect(await store.lastPullAt()).assertEqual(1000);
      const base: Blob | undefined = await store.readCache();
      expect(base !== undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('pull_applies_remote_sections', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.userdataBlob = remoteV6('云端昵称', 500);
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 1000);
      const result: UserdataPullResult = await repo.pull(true);
      expect(result.ok()).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(repo.currentSections(), 'nick'), '')).assertEqual('云端昵称');
    });

    it('flush_pushes_dirty_section_with_new_timestamp', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.userdataBlob = remoteV6('云端', 500);
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 2000);
      await repo.pull(true);
      const local: Blob = { 'nick': '本机' };
      await repo.updateCurrent(local);
      const flush: UserdataPushResult = await repo.flush();
      expect(flush.ok()).assertTrue();
      expect(flush.pushed).assertTrue();
      const blob: Blob = postedBlob(api);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'nick'), '')).assertEqual('本机');
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(blob, 'nick')).assertEqual(2000);
      expect(await store.pend()).assertFalse();
    });

    it('push_failure_marks_pending_and_retry_succeeds', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.userdataBlob = remoteV6('云端', 500);
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 2000);
      await repo.pull(true);
      await repo.updateCurrent({ 'nick': '本机' });
      api.failPosts = true;
      const failed: UserdataPushResult = await repo.flush();
      expect(failed.ok()).assertFalse();
      expect(await store.pend()).assertTrue();

      api.failPosts = false;
      const retried: UserdataPushResult = await repo.flush();
      expect(retried.ok()).assertTrue();
      expect(retried.pushed).assertTrue();
      expect(await store.pend()).assertFalse();
    });

    it('push_without_baseline_and_not_forced_is_skipped', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 2000);
      const result: UserdataPushResult = await repo.push(false, new Set<string>());
      expect(result.status).assertEqual('skipped');
      expect(api.postBodies.length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('hold_period_blocks_push', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      await store.setHoldUntil(999999);
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 2000);
      const result: UserdataPushResult = await repo.push(true, new Set<string>());
      expect(result.status).assertEqual('held');
    });

    it('disabled_sync_returns_disabled', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      await store.setSyncEnabled(false);
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 2000);
      const pull: UserdataPullResult = await repo.pull(true);
      expect(pull.status).assertEqual('disabled');
      const push: UserdataPushResult = await repo.push(true, new Set<string>());
      expect(push.status).assertEqual('disabled');
    });

    it('v5_cloud_is_migrated_and_pushed_back_as_v6', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const at: Blob = {};
      const homeTools: Object[] = ['hw', 'nt'];
      const fit: Blob = { 'sex': 'm' };
      const v5: Blob = { 'v': 5, 'homeToolsAt': 111, 'homeTools': homeTools, 'fit': fit, 'at': at };
      api.userdataBlob = JsonBlob.encode(v5);
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 2000);
      const result: UserdataPullResult = await repo.pull(true);
      expect(result.ok()).assertTrue();
      expect(result.migratedV5).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postBodies.length).assertEqual(1);
      const blob: Blob = postedBlob(api);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'v'))).assertEqual(6);
      expect(JsonBlob.numMs(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'homeToolsAt'))).assertEqual(111);
      expect(UserdataV6.atValue(blob, 'fit')).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('pull_within_ttl_skips_network', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      let now: number = 1000;
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => now);
      await repo.pull(true);
      const getsAfterFirst: number = api.getPaths.length;
      now = 2000;
      const second: UserdataPullResult = await repo.pull(false);
      expect(second.ok()).assertTrue();
      expect(second.fresh).assertTrue();
      expect(api.getPaths.length).assertEqual(getsAfterFirst);
    });

    it('water_section_is_normalized_before_push', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 3000);
      await repo.pull(true);
      const rooms: Blob = {};
      const recs: Object[] = [];
      const oct: Blob = { 'm': '2026-10', 'r': 93.555, 'ts': 2 };
      const sep: Blob = { 'm': '2026-09', 'r': 80, 'ts': 1 };
      recs.push(oct);
      recs.push(sep);
      const room: Blob = { 'p': 5, 'recs': recs };
      rooms['1-16---305'] = room;
      const waterSection: Blob = { 'rooms': rooms };
      const update: Blob = { 'water': waterSection };
      await repo.updateCurrent(update);
      const flush: UserdataPushResult = await repo.flush();
      expect(flush.ok()).assertTrue();
      const blob: Blob = postedBlob(api);
      const water: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'water'));
      const outRooms: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(water, 'rooms'));
      const kept: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(outRooms, '1-16---305'));
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(kept, 'p'), 0)).assertEqual(4);
      const outRecs: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(kept, 'recs'));
      if (outRecs !== undefined) {
        expect(outRecs.length).assertEqual(2);
        const first: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(outRecs[0]);
        expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(first, 'm'), '')).assertEqual('2026-09');
      }
    });

    it('pull_uses_full_fixture_blob_without_error', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.userdataBlob = USERDATA_V6_WEB;
      const store: InMemoryUserdataLocalStore = new InMemoryUserdataLocalStore();
      const repo: UserdataRepository = new UserdataRepository(api, store, () => SID, () => 4000);
      const result: UserdataPullResult = await repo.pull(true);
      expect(result.ok()).assertTrue();
      const base: Blob | undefined = await store.readCache();
      expect(base !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (base !== undefined) {
        expect(UserdataV6.atValue(base, 'homeTools')).assertEqual(1762300000000);
      }
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { FakeApi } from './support/FakeApi';
import { formatSlot, InMemoryVisitsStore, VisitsReporter } from '../main/ets/data/visits/VisitsReporter';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

const SID: string = '3260799999';

function payload(api: FakeApi): Blob {
  const rows: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JSON.parse(api.lastPostBody()) as JsonValue);
  if (rows === undefined || rows.length === 0) {
    return {};
  }
  const row: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(rows[0]);
  return row !== undefined ? row : {};
}

export default function visitsTest() {
  describe('VisitsReporter', () => {
    it('slot_format_is_yyyy_mm_dd_hh', 0, () => {
      const slot: string = formatSlot(new Date(2026, 10, 14, 9, 30, 0));
      expect(slot).assertEqual('2026-11-14-09');
    });

    it('reports_once_per_slot', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryVisitsStore = new InMemoryVisitsStore('aabbccddeeff0011');
      const reporter: VisitsReporter = new VisitsReporter(api, store, () => SID, () => '测试账号',
        () => new Date(2026, 10, 14, 9, 30, 0).getTime());
      const first: boolean = await reporter.reportOnce();
      expect(first).assertTrue();
      const second: boolean = await reporter.reportOnce();
      expect(second).assertFalse();
      expect(api.postPaths.length).assertEqual(1);
      expect(api.postPaths[0]).assertEqual('visits');
      const row: Blob = payload(api);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(row, 'slot'), '')).assertEqual('2026-11-14-09');
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(row, 'sid'), '')).assertEqual(SID);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(row, 'did'), '')).assertEqual('aabbccddeeff0011');
    });

    it('new_hour_reports_again', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryVisitsStore = new InMemoryVisitsStore('aabbccddeeff0011');
      let now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 9, 30, 0).getTime();
      const reporter: VisitsReporter = new VisitsReporter(api, store, () => SID, () => '测试账号', () => now);
      await reporter.reportOnce();
      now = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 10, 5, 0).getTime();
      const second: boolean = await reporter.reportOnce();
      expect(second).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postPaths.length).assertEqual(2);
    });

    it('failure_does_not_mark_slot', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.failPosts = true;
      const store: InMemoryVisitsStore = new InMemoryVisitsStore('aabbccddeeff0011');
      const reporter: VisitsReporter = new VisitsReporter(api, store, () => SID, () => '测试账号',
        () => new Date(2026, 10, 14, 9, 30, 0).getTime());
      const failed: boolean = await reporter.reportOnce();
      expect(failed).assertFalse();
      api.failPosts = false;
      const retried: boolean = await reporter.reportOnce();
      expect(retried).assertTrue();
    });

    it('no_sid_skips_report', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      const store: InMemoryVisitsStore = new InMemoryVisitsStore();
      const reporter: VisitsReporter = new VisitsReporter(api, store, () => '', () => '', () => 1000);
      expect(await reporter.reportOnce()).assertFalse();
      expect(api.postPaths.length).assertEqual(0);
    });
  });
}

const POLL_JSON: string = '{"ok":true,"polls":['
  + '{"id":"poll_1","title":"班会时间","description":"选一个","mode":"quick","owner_name":"班长",'
  + '"settings":{"multi":false,"maxChoices":1,"anonymous":true,"allowChange":true,"resultVisibility":"afterVote"},'
  + '"deadline":1794675000000,"status":"open","created_at":1794600000000,'
  + '"audience":"committee","audience_count":0,"closed":false,"total":3,"has_voted":true,'

const DETAIL_JSON: string = '{"ok":true,"poll":{"id":"poll_1","title":"班会时间","mode":"quick",'
  + '"settings":{"multi":true,"maxChoices":2,"anonymous":false,"allowChange":true,"resultVisibility":"always"},'
  + '"options":[{"id":"o1","text":"周五"},{"id":"o2","text":"周六"}],"deadline":0,"status":"open",'

  + '"voters":[{"name":"甲","choices":["o1"]},{"name":"乙","choices":["o1","o2"]}],"now":1794670000000}';

function settings(multi: boolean, max: number): PollSettings {
  const s: PollSettings = new PollSettings();
  s.multi = multi;
  s.maxChoices = max;
  s.anonymous = true;
  s.allowChange = true;
  s.resultVisibility = PollResultVisibility.AFTER_VOTE;
  return s;
}

function draftWith(title: string, options: string[]): PollDraft {
  const draft: PollDraft = new PollDraft();
  draft.id = 'pabc12345';
  draft.title = title;
  draft.mode = 'quick';
  draft.options = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
    const option: PollOption = new PollOption();
    option.id = 'o' + i;
    option.text = options[i];
    draft.options.push(option);
  }
  draft.settings = settings(false, 1);
  draft.deadline = 1794675000000;
  draft.audience = PollAudience.ALL;
  return draft;
}

export default function voteTest() {
  describe('VoteRpcBodies', () => {
    it('create_body_shape', 0, () => {
      const draft: PollDraft = draftWith('班会', ['周五', '周六']);
      const body: Blob = JSON.parse(VoteRpc.createBody(draft)) as Blob;
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_id'), '')).assertEqual('pabc12345');
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_title'), '')).assertEqual('班会');
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_mode'), '')).assertEqual('quick');
      const options: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_options'));
      expect(options !== undefined && options.length === 2).assertTrue();
      const settingsBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_settings'));
      expect(JsonBlob.asBoolean(JsonBlob.get(settingsBlob, 'multi'), true)).assertFalse();
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_audience'), '')).assertEqual('all');
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_deadline'), 0)).assertEqual(1794675000000);
    });

    it('submit_dedupes_choices', 0, () => {
      const body: Blob = JSON.parse(VoteRpc.submitBody('poll_1', ['o1', 'o1', 'o2'])) as Blob;
      const choices: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_choices'));
      expect(choices !== undefined && choices.length === 2).assertTrue();
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(body, 'p_id'), '')).assertEqual('poll_1');
    });

    it('manage_bodies', 0, () => {
      const close: Blob = JSON.parse(VoteRpc.manageBody('poll_1', 'close', 0, undefined)) as Blob;
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(close, 'p_action'), '')).assertEqual('close');
      const extend: Blob = JSON.parse(VoteRpc.manageBody('poll_1', 'extend', 1794680000000, undefined)) as Blob;
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(extend, 'p_deadline'), 0)).assertEqual(1794680000000);
    });
  });

  describe('VoteRpcParser', () => {
    it('parses_list', 0, () => {
      const list = VoteRpc.parseList(POLL_JSON);
      expect(list.polls.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(list.serverNow).assertEqual(1794670000000);
      expect(list.polls[0].id).assertEqual('poll_1');
      expect(list.polls[0].settings.anonymous).assertTrue();
      expect(list.polls[0].audience).assertEqual(PollAudience.COMMITTEE);
      expect(list.polls[0].hasVoted).assertTrue();
      expect(list.polls[0].counts.get('o1')).assertEqual(2);
      expect(VoteRpc.parseList('bad').polls.length).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('parses_detail', 0, () => {
      const detail = VoteRpc.parseDetail(DETAIL_JSON);
      expect(detail.poll.id).assertEqual('poll_1');
      expect(detail.poll.options.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(detail.poll.settings.multi).assertTrue();
      expect(detail.poll.settings.maxChoices).assertEqual(2);
      expect(detail.total).assertEqual(3);
      expect(detail.hasVoted).assertTrue();
      expect(detail.myChoices.join(',')).assertEqual('o1');
      expect(detail.canManage).assertTrue();
      expect(detail.voters.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(detail.voters[1].choices.length).assertEqual(2);
    });
  });

  describe('VoteLogic', () => {
    it('closed_and_results_visibility', 0, () => {
      const summary: PollSummary = new PollSummary();
      summary.status = 'open';
      summary.deadline = 1000;
      expect(VoteLogic.effectiveClosed(summary, 500)).assertFalse();
      expect(VoteLogic.effectiveClosed(summary, 1000)).assertTrue();
      summary.status = 'closed';
      expect(VoteLogic.effectiveClosed(summary, 1)).assertTrue();

      const always: PollSettings = settings(false, 1);
      always.resultVisibility = PollResultVisibility.ALWAYS;
      expect(VoteLogic.resultsVisible(always, false, false)).assertTrue();
      const afterVote: PollSettings = settings(false, 1);
      expect(VoteLogic.resultsVisible(afterVote, false, false)).assertFalse();
      expect(VoteLogic.resultsVisible(afterVote, false, true)).assertTrue();
      const afterClose: PollSettings = settings(false, 1);
      afterClose.resultVisibility = PollResultVisibility.AFTER_CLOSE;
      expect(VoteLogic.resultsVisible(afterClose, true, true)).assertTrue();
      expect(VoteLogic.resultsVisible(afterClose, false, true)).assertFalse();
    });

    it('validates_choices', 0, () => {
      const single: PollSettings = settings(false, 1);
      expect(VoteLogic.validateChoices(single, [], ['o1', 'o2'])).assertEqual('请至少选择 1 项');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateChoices(single, ['o1', 'o2'], ['o1', 'o2'])).assertEqual('单选投票只能选 1 项');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateChoices(single, ['o1'], ['o1', 'o2'])).assertEqual('');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateChoices(single, ['x'], ['o1', 'o2'])).assertEqual('选项无效');
      const multi: PollSettings = settings(true, 2);
      expect(VoteLogic.validateChoices(multi, ['o1', 'o2', 'o3'], ['o1', 'o2', 'o3'])).assertEqual('最多选 2 项');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateChoices(multi, ['o1', 'o2'], ['o1', 'o2'])).assertEqual('');

    it('countdown_and_format', 0, () => {
      expect(VoteLogic.formatRemaining(0)).assertEqual('已截止');

      expect(VoteLogic.formatRemaining(3 * 60 * 60 * 1000)).assertEqual('剩 3 小时');
      expect(VoteLogic.formatRemaining(2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)).assertEqual('剩 2 天');

    it('validates_draft', 0, () => {

      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(draftWith('标题', ['a']), now)).assertEqual('至少需要 2 个选项');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(draftWith('标题', ['a', 'a']), now)).assertEqual('选项不能重复');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(draftWith('标题', ['a', 'b']), now)).assertEqual('');
      const past: PollDraft = draftWith('标题', ['a', 'b']);
      past.deadline = now - 1;
      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(past, now)).assertEqual('截止时间需晚于现在');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(draftWith('x'.repeat(VoteLimits.MAX_TITLE + 1), ['a', 'b']), now).indexOf('标题不能超过') === 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('poll_id_format', 0, () => {
      expect(VoteLogic.isPollIdValid('pabc12345')).assertTrue();
      expect(VoteLogic.isPollIdValid('poll_1')).assertFalse();
      const fresh: string = VoteLogic.newPollId(1794670000000);
      expect(VoteLogic.isPollIdValid(fresh)).assertTrue();
      expect(fresh.length <= 33).assertTrue();
      expect(VoteLogic.newOptionId(1794670000000, 0).length <= 24).assertTrue();
    });

    it('validates_option_images', 0, () => {
      const draft: PollDraft = new PollDraft();
      draft.title = '配图投票';
      draft.deadline = 0;
      const a: PollOption = new PollOption();
      a.id = 'a1';
      a.text = '甲';
      a.img = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,AAAA';
      const b: PollOption = new PollOption();
      b.id = 'b1';
      b.text = '乙';
      draft.options = [a, b];
      draft.audience = 'all';
      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(draft, Date.now())).assertEqual('');
      a.img = 'http://x/y.jpg';
      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(draft, Date.now())).assertEqual('选项配图格式不支持');
      a.img = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + 'A'.repeat(150001);
      expect(VoteLogic.validateDraft(draft, Date.now()).indexOf('单张配图过大') === 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('normalizes_custom_seats', 0, () => {

      expect(VoteLogic.normalizeSeats([]).length).assertEqual(0);
      expect(VoteLogic.validateAudience('custom', [])).assertEqual('指定成员至少选 1 人');
      expect(VoteLogic.validateAudience('custom', [3])).assertEqual('');

    });

    it('percent_and_option_rows', 0, () => {
      expect(VoteLogic.percent(1, 3)).assertEqual(33.3);
      expect(VoteLogic.percent(1, 0)).assertEqual(0);
      expect(VoteLogic.formatPercent(33.3)).assertEqual('33.3%');
    });
  });

  describe('VoteRepository', () => {

      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.pollListBody = POLL_JSON;
      api.pollDetailBody = DETAIL_JSON;
      const repo: VoteRepository = new VoteRepository(api);
      const list: PollListResult = await repo.list();
      expect(list.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(list.list.polls.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(api.postPaths[0]).assertEqual('rpc/poll_list');
      const detail: PollDetailResult = await repo.detail('poll_1');
      expect(detail.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(detail.detail.poll.title).assertEqual('班会时间');
      expect(api.postPaths[1]).assertEqual('rpc/poll_detail');
    });

    it('submit_and_create', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.pollActionResult = '{"ok":true,"poll_id":"poll_1"}';
      const repo: VoteRepository = new VoteRepository(api);
      const submit: VoteResult = await repo.submit('poll_1', ['o1']);
      expect(submit.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(api.postPaths[0]).assertEqual('rpc/poll_submit');
      const create: VoteResult = await repo.create(draftWith('班会', ['a', 'b']));
      expect(create.ok).assertTrue();
      expect(create.pollId).assertEqual('poll_1');
      expect(api.postPaths[1]).assertEqual('rpc/poll_create');
    });

    it('error_message_surfaced', 0, async () => {
      const api: FakeApi = new FakeApi();
      api.pollActionResult = '{"ok":false,"error":"不在可见范围内"}';
      const repo: VoteRepository = new VoteRepository(api);
      const result: VoteResult = await repo.submit('poll_1', ['o1']);
      expect(result.ok).assertFalse();
      expect(result.message).assertEqual('不在可见范围内');
      api.failPosts = true;
      const failed: PollListResult = await repo.list();
      expect(failed.ok).assertFalse();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { WatchLogic } from '../main/ets/features/watch/WatchLogic';

export default function watchTest() {
  describe('WatchLogic', () => {
    it('countdown_and_clock', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 8, 0).getTime();
      const at: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 8, 10).getTime();
      expect(WatchLogic.minutesUntil(at, now)).assertEqual(10);
      expect(WatchLogic.countdownText(at, now)).assertEqual('还有 10 分钟');
      expect(WatchLogic.countdownText(now - 60000, now)).assertEqual('已开始');
      const far: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 10, 30).getTime();
      expect(WatchLogic.countdownText(far, now)).assertEqual('还有 2 小时 30 分');
      expect(WatchLogic.clock(new Date(2026, 10, 15, 9, 5).getTime())).assertEqual('09:05');
    });

    it('due_and_short', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 15, 12, 0).getTime();
      expect(WatchLogic.dueText('2026-11-15', '18:00', now)).assertEqual('今天 18:00 截止');
      expect(WatchLogic.dueText('2026-11-16', '09:00', now)).assertEqual('明天 09:00 截止');
      expect(WatchLogic.dueText('2026-11-20', '23:59', now)).assertEqual('2026-11-20 23:59 截止');
      expect(WatchLogic.dueText('', '18:00', now)).assertEqual('18:00 截止');
      expect(WatchLogic.short('一二三四五六七八九十', 5)).assertEqual('一二三四…');
      expect(WatchLogic.short('短', 5)).assertEqual('短');
      expect(WatchLogic.offline(false)).assertTrue();
      expect(WatchLogic.offline(true)).assertFalse();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import {
  WaterRecord,
  WaterRecordReview,
  WaterRoomState,
  WaterRules,
  WaterState
} from '../main/ets/features/water/WaterModels';
import { WaterCodec } from '../main/ets/features/water/WaterCodec';
import { WaterCalculator } from '../main/ets/features/water/WaterCalculator';
import { WaterMonth } from '../main/ets/features/water/WaterMonth';
import { WaterMutator } from '../main/ets/features/water/WaterMutator';
import { Blob, JsonBlob } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

const ROOM: string = '4-23A---321';

function record(month: string, reading: number): WaterRecord {
  const r: WaterRecord = new WaterRecord();
  r.month = month;
  r.reading = reading;
  r.ts = 1;
  return r;
}

function roomWith(persons: number, records: WaterRecord[]): WaterRoomState {
  const room: WaterRoomState = new WaterRoomState();
  room.persons = persons;
  room.records = records;
  return room;
}

function stateWith(room: WaterRoomState): WaterState {
  const state: WaterState = new WaterState();
  state.rooms.set(ROOM, room);
  return state;
}

function parseJson(text: string): Blob {
  return JSON.parse(text) as Blob;
}

export default function waterTest() {
  describe('WaterCodec', () => {
    it('parses_tolerant_section', 0, () => {
      const raw: Blob = parseJson('{"rooms":{"4-23A---321":{"p":7,"recs":['
        + '{"m":"2026-10","r":120.456,"ts":11},'
        + '{"m":"2026-09","r":100,"ts":10},'
        + '{"m":"2026-09","r":101,"ts":12},'
        + '{"m":"bad","r":5},'
        + '{"m":"2026-11","r":-3}]}}}');
      const state: WaterState = WaterCodec.fromJson(raw);
      const room: WaterRoomState = state.roomOrDefault(ROOM);
      expect(room.persons).assertEqual(WaterRules.PERSONS_DEFAULT);
      expect(room.records.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(room.records[0].month).assertEqual('2026-09');
      expect(room.records[0].reading).assertEqual(101);
      expect(room.records[1].reading).assertEqual(120.46);
    });

    it('empty_and_bad_sections', 0, () => {
      expect(WaterCodec.fromJson(undefined).rooms.size).assertEqual(0);
      const empty: Blob = {};
      expect(WaterCodec.fromJson(empty).rooms.size).assertEqual(0);
      const bad: Blob = parseJson('{"rooms":"x"}');
      expect(WaterCodec.fromJson(bad).rooms.size).assertEqual(0);
    });

    it('to_json_key_order_and_integer_reading', 0, () => {
      const state: WaterState = stateWith(roomWith(6, [record('2026-11', 130.1), record('2026-10', 120)]));
      const blob: Blob = WaterCodec.toJson(state);
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(blob).join(',')).assertEqual('rooms');
      const rooms: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(blob, 'rooms'));
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(rooms).join(',')).assertEqual(ROOM);
      const roomBlob: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(rooms, ROOM));
      expect(JsonBlob.keys(roomBlob).join(',')).assertEqual('p,recs');
      const recs: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(roomBlob, 'recs'));
      expect(recs !== undefined && recs.length === 2).assertTrue();
      if (recs !== undefined) {
        const first: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(recs[0]);
        expect(JsonBlob.keys(first).join(',')).assertEqual('m,r,ts');
        expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(first, 'r'), 0)).assertEqual(120);
      }
    });

    it('roundtrip_preserves_values', 0, () => {
      const state: WaterState = stateWith(roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100.5), record('2026-11', 112.25)]));
      const back: WaterState = WaterCodec.fromJson(WaterCodec.toJson(state));
      const room: WaterRoomState = back.roomOrDefault(ROOM);
      expect(room.persons).assertEqual(4);
      expect(room.records.length).assertEqual(2);
      expect(room.records[1].reading).assertEqual(112.25);
    });

    it('normalizes_helpers', 0, () => {
      expect(WaterCodec.normalizePersons(6)).assertEqual(6);
      expect(WaterCodec.normalizePersons(5)).assertEqual(4);
      expect(WaterCodec.normalizeMonth(' 2026-11 ')).assertEqual('2026-11');
      expect(WaterCodec.normalizeMonth('2026-13') === undefined).assertTrue();
      expect(WaterCodec.round2(12.345)).assertEqual(12.35);
      expect(WaterCodec.round1(23.45)).assertEqual(23.5);
    });
  });

  describe('WaterMonth', () => {
    it('current_and_shift', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 12, 0).getTime();
      expect(WaterMonth.current(now)).assertEqual('2026-11');
      expect(WaterMonth.shift('2026-11', -1)).assertEqual('2026-10');
      expect(WaterMonth.shift('2026-01', -1)).assertEqual('2025-12');
      expect(WaterMonth.shift('2026-12', 1)).assertEqual('2027-01');
    });

    it('elapsed_days', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 12, 0).getTime();
      expect(WaterMonth.elapsedDays('2026-11', now)).assertEqual(14);
      expect(WaterMonth.elapsedDays('2026-10', now)).assertEqual(31);
      expect(WaterMonth.elapsedDays('2026-12', now)).assertEqual(1);
      expect(WaterMonth.daysInMonth('2026-02')).assertEqual(28);
      expect(WaterMonth.daysInMonth('2024-02')).assertEqual(29);
    });
  });

  describe('WaterCalculator', () => {
    it('charge_uses_previous_month', 0, () => {
      const room: WaterRoomState = roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100), record('2026-11', 112.5)]);
      const charge = WaterCalculator.charge(room, room.records[1], 4);
      expect(charge.hasPrevious).assertTrue();
      expect(charge.usage).assertEqual(12.5);
      expect(charge.free).assertEqual(8);
      expect(charge.excess).assertEqual(4.5);
      expect(charge.fee).assertEqual(13.64);
      expect(charge.degree).assertEqual(23.5);
      expect(charge.within).assertFalse();
    });

    it('within_free_quota', 0, () => {
      const room: WaterRoomState = roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100), record('2026-11', 106)]);
      const charge = WaterCalculator.charge(room, room.records[1], 4);
      expect(charge.usage).assertEqual(6);
      expect(charge.excess).assertEqual(0);
      expect(charge.fee).assertEqual(0);
      expect(charge.within).assertTrue();
    });

    it('first_record_has_no_usage', 0, () => {
      const room: WaterRoomState = roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100)]);
      const charge = WaterCalculator.charge(room, room.records[0], 4);
      expect(charge.hasPrevious).assertFalse();
      expect(charge.hasUsage).assertFalse();
      expect(charge.free).assertEqual(8);
      expect(WaterCalculator.fmtReading(charge.usage, charge.hasUsage)).assertEqual('—');
      expect(WaterCalculator.fmtDegree(charge.degree, charge.hasUsage)).assertEqual('—');
    });

    it('stats_with_daily_and_delta', 0, () => {
      const now: number = new Date(2026, 10, 14, 12, 0).getTime();
      const room: WaterRoomState = roomWith(4, [
        record('2026-09', 80), record('2026-10', 100), record('2026-11', 112)
      ]);
      const stats = WaterCalculator.stats(room, '2026-11', now);
      expect(stats.charge.usage).assertEqual(12);
      expect(stats.hasDailyAverage).assertTrue();
      expect(stats.dailyAverage).assertEqual(WaterCodec.round2(12 / 14));
      expect(stats.hasPreviousMonthUsage).assertTrue();
      expect(stats.previousMonthUsage).assertEqual(20);
      expect(stats.hasDelta).assertTrue();
      expect(stats.deltaVsPreviousMonth).assertEqual(-8);
    });

    it('rule_lines', 0, () => {
      const lines: string[][] = WaterCalculator.ruleLines(6);
      expect(lines.length).assertEqual(4);
      expect(lines[0][1].indexOf('3.03') === 0).assertTrue();
      expect(lines[1][1].indexOf('2 吨/人/月 × 6 人 = 12.0 吨') >= 0).assertTrue();
    });
  });

  describe('WaterMutator', () => {
    it('review_rejects_bad_input', 0, () => {
      const room: WaterRoomState = roomWith(4, []);
      expect(WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-11', 'abc', 1).valid).assertFalse();
      expect(WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-13', '10', 1).valid).assertFalse();
      expect(WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-11', '-1', 1).valid).assertFalse();
      expect(WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-11', '', 1).message.length > 0).assertTrue();
    });

    it('review_enforces_monotonic_readings', 0, () => {
      const room: WaterRoomState = roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100), record('2026-12', 130)]);
      expect(WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-11', '99', 1).valid).assertFalse();
      expect(WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-11', '131', 1).valid).assertFalse();
      const ok: WaterRecordReview = WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-11', '110.555', 1);
      expect(ok.valid).assertTrue();
      if (ok.record !== undefined) {
        expect(ok.record.reading).assertEqual(110.56);
        expect(ok.record.month).assertEqual('2026-11');
      }
    });

    it('review_detects_replace_existing', 0, () => {
      const room: WaterRoomState = roomWith(4, [record('2026-11', 110)]);
      const review: WaterRecordReview = WaterMutator.review(room, '2026-11', '115', 1);
      expect(review.valid).assertTrue();
      expect(review.replaceExisting).assertTrue();
    });

    it('put_sorts_and_overwrites', 0, () => {
      let state: WaterState = stateWith(roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100)]));
      const rec: WaterRecord = record('2026-09', 90);
      state = WaterMutator.put(state, ROOM, rec);
      state = WaterMutator.put(state, ROOM, record('2026-11', 120));
      state = WaterMutator.put(state, ROOM, record('2026-10', 105));
      const room: WaterRoomState = state.roomOrDefault(ROOM);
      expect(room.records.length).assertEqual(3);
      expect(room.records[0].month).assertEqual('2026-09');
      expect(room.records[1].reading).assertEqual(105);
      expect(room.records[2].month).assertEqual('2026-11');
    });

    it('delete_and_persons_and_clear', 0, () => {
      let state: WaterState = stateWith(roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100), record('2026-11', 110)]));
      state = WaterMutator.delete(state, ROOM, '2026-10');
      expect(state.roomOrDefault(ROOM).records.length).assertEqual(1);
      state = WaterMutator.withPersons(state, ROOM, 6);
      expect(state.roomOrDefault(ROOM).persons).assertEqual(6);
      state = WaterMutator.clearRoom(state, ROOM);
      expect(state.rooms.size).assertEqual(0);
      expect(state.room(ROOM) === undefined).assertTrue();
    });

    it('unknown_room_delete_noop', 0, () => {
      const state: WaterState = stateWith(roomWith(4, [record('2026-10', 100)]));
      expect(WaterMutator.delete(state, 'nope', '2026-10') === state).assertTrue();
      expect(WaterMutator.clearRoom(state, 'nope') === state).assertTrue();
    });
  });
}
import { describe, it, expect } from '@ohos/hypium';
import { WaterNormalizer } from '../main/ets/data/sync/WaterNormalizer';
import { Blob, JsonBlob, JsonValue } from '../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

function sectionWithRooms(rooms: Blob): Blob {
  const section: Blob = { 'rooms': rooms };
  return section;
}

function room(persons: number, recs: Object[]): Blob {
  const value: Blob = { 'p': persons, 'recs': recs };
  return value;
}

function rec(month: string, reading: number, ts: number): Blob {
  const value: Blob = { 'm': month, 'r': reading, 'ts': ts };
  return value;
}

export default function waterNormalizerTest() {
  describe('WaterNormalizer', () => {
    it('keeps_valid_rooms_and_drops_bad_ones', 0, () => {
      const rooms: Blob = {};
      rooms['1-16---305'] = room(6, [rec('2026-09', 80, 1), rec('2026-10', 93.555, 2)]);
      rooms[''] = room(4, []);
      rooms['bad'] = 'not-an-object';
      const out: Blob = WaterNormalizer.normalize(sectionWithRooms(rooms));
      const outRooms: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(out, 'rooms'));
      expect(outRooms !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (outRooms !== undefined) {
        expect(JsonBlob.keys(outRooms).length).assertEqual(1);
        const kept: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(outRooms['1-16---305']);
        expect(kept !== undefined).assertTrue();
        if (kept !== undefined) {
          expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(kept, 'p'), 0)).assertEqual(6);
          const recs: Object[] | undefined = JsonBlob.asArray(JsonBlob.get(kept, 'recs'));
          expect(recs !== undefined).assertTrue();
          if (recs !== undefined) {
            expect(recs.length).assertEqual(2);
            const second: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(recs[1]);
            expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(second, 'r'), 0)).assertEqual(93.56);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    it('persons_defaults_to_4_unless_6', 0, () => {
      const rooms: Blob = {};
      rooms['a'] = room(5, []);
      rooms['b'] = room(6, []);
      const out: Blob = WaterNormalizer.normalize(sectionWithRooms(rooms));
      const outRooms: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(out, 'rooms'));
      if (outRooms !== undefined) {
        const a: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(outRooms['a']);
        const b: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(outRooms['b']);
        expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(a, 'p'), 0)).assertEqual(4);
        expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(b, 'p'), 0)).assertEqual(6);
      }
    });

    it('records_sorted_by_month_and_deduped', 0, () => {
      const recs: Object[] = [
        rec('2026-11', 100, 3),
        rec('2026-09', 80, 1),
        rec('2026-11', 101, 4),
        rec('2026-13', 5, 5),
        rec('bad-month', 5, 6),
        rec('2026-10', -1, 7)
      ];
      const normalized: Object[] = WaterNormalizer.normalizeRecords(recs);
      expect(normalized.length).assertEqual(2);
      const first: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(normalized[0]);
      const second: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(normalized[1]);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(first, 'm'), '')).assertEqual('2026-09');
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(second, 'm'), '')).assertEqual('2026-11');
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(JsonBlob.get(second, 'r'), 0)).assertEqual(101);
    });

    it('integer_readings_stay_integers', 0, () => {
      const normalized: Object[] = WaterNormalizer.normalizeRecords([rec('2026-09', 80, 1)]);
      const row: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(normalized[0]);
      const value: JsonValue | undefined = JsonBlob.get(row, 'r');
      expect(typeof value).assertEqual('number');
      expect(JsonBlob.asNumber(value, 0)).assertEqual(80);
      // 必须是整数形态（80 而非 80.0），保证跨端字节稳定
      expect(String(value)).assertEqual('80');
    });

    it('caps_records_to_120_keeping_latest_months', 0, () => {
      const recs: Object[] = [];
      for (let i = 1; i <= 130; i++) {
        const year: number = 2000 + Math.floor((i - 1) / 12);
        const month: number = ((i - 1) % 12) + 1;
        const mm: string = (month < 10 ? '0' : '') + month;
        recs.push(rec(year + '-' + mm, i, i));
      }
      const normalized: Object[] = WaterNormalizer.normalizeRecords(recs);
      expect(normalized.length).assertEqual(120);
      const last: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(normalized[normalized.length - 1]);
      expect(JsonBlob.asString(JsonBlob.get(last, 'm'), '')).assertEqual('2010-10');
    });

    it('empty_section_becomes_empty_rooms', 0, () => {
      const out: Blob = WaterNormalizer.normalize(undefined);
      const outRooms: Blob | undefined = JsonBlob.asBlob(JsonBlob.get(out, 'rooms'));
      expect(outRooms !== undefined).assertTrue();
      if (outRooms !== undefined) {
        expect(JsonBlob.keys(outRooms).length).assertEqual(0);
      }
    });
  });
}

import { Api } from '../../main/ets/data/net/Api';
import { ApiError, ApiErrorKind, ApiResult } from '../../main/ets/data/net/ApiResult';
import { Blob } from '../../main/ets/data/sync/JsonBlob';

/**
 * 假网络层：单测用（记录请求、可控失败、可控云端数据）。
 *
 * 路由：`userdata*` → userdataBlob（空串 = 云端无行）；`marks*` → marksBody；其它 → `[]`。
 */
export class FakeApi implements Api {
  /** 云端 userdata.blob 原文（'' = 无行）。 */
  userdataBlob: string = '';
  /** 云端 marks 响应数组原文。 */
  marksBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 class_members 响应原文。 */
  membersBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 class_league 响应原文。 */
  leagueBody: string = '{"ok":true,"count":0,"seats":[]}';
  /** 云端 homework 响应原文。 */
  homeworkBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 fitrecs 响应原文。 */
  fitrecsBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 notices 轻量签名响应原文。 */
  noticesSigBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 notices 整表响应原文。 */
  noticesBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 site_assets 响应原文。 */
  siteAssetsBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 power 当前值响应原文。 */
  powerBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 power_history 响应原文。 */
  powerHistoryBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 poll_list 响应原文。 */
  pollListBody: string = '{"ok":true,"polls":[]}';
  /** 云端 poll_detail 响应原文。 */
  pollDetailBody: string = '{"ok":true,"poll":{"id":""}}';
  /** 云端 poll_submit / poll_create / poll_manage 响应原文。 */
  pollActionResult: string = '{"ok":true}';
  /** 云端 ppt_decks 列表响应原文。 */
  pptListBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 ppt_decks 详情响应原文。 */
  pptDetailBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 site_assets id=ppt_agent 响应原文。 */
  pptAgentBody: string = '[]';
  /** 教务登录 enqueue/status 响应原文。 */
  ttLoginEnqueueBody: string = '{"ok":true,"job_id":"job1"}';
  ttLoginStatusBody: string = '{"ok":true,"status":"running","finished":false}';
  /** 云端 service_health 响应原文。 */
  diagHealthBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 diag_analysis 响应原文。 */
  diagAnalysisBody: string = '[]';
  /** 云端 repair_tasks 响应原文。 */
  diagRepairBody: string = '[]';
  failGets: boolean = false;
  failPosts: boolean = false;
  hwActionBody: string = '{"ok":true,"count":1}';
  hwLoginBody: string = '{"ok":true,"token":"t0","sid":"3260799999","name":"测试账号","role":"","badge":"","is_admin":false}';
  hwListBody: string = '[]';

  getPaths: string[] = [];
  postPaths: string[] = [];
  postBodies: string[] = [];
  patchPaths: string[] = [];
  patchBodies: string[] = [];
  deletePaths: string[] = [];

  async get(path: string, authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    this.getPaths.push(path);
    if (this.failGets) {
      return ApiResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', 'fake get failure'));
    }
    if (path.startsWith('userdata')) {
      if (this.userdataBlob.length === 0) {
        return ApiResult.success('[]');
      }
      const row: Blob = { 'id': 'test-sid', 'blob': this.userdataBlob, 'ts': 1 };
      const rows: Object[] = [row];
      return ApiResult.success(JSON.stringify(rows));
    }
    if (path.startsWith('marks')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.marksBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('homework')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.homeworkBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('fitrecs')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.fitrecsBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('power_history')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.powerHistoryBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('power')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.powerBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('site_assets')) {
      if (path.indexOf('id=eq.ppt_agent') >= 0) {
        return ApiResult.success(this.pptAgentBody);
      }
      return ApiResult.success(this.siteAssetsBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('notices')) {
      if (path.indexOf('select=id,ts,hidden,edited_at') >= 0) {
        return ApiResult.success(this.noticesSigBody);
      }
      return ApiResult.success(this.noticesBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('ppt_decks')) {
      if (path.indexOf('manifest') >= 0 && path.indexOf('id=eq.') >= 0) {
        return ApiResult.success(this.pptDetailBody);
      }
      return ApiResult.success(this.pptListBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('service_health')) {
      if (path.indexOf('select=id&limit=1') >= 0) {
        return ApiResult.success('[]');
      }
      return ApiResult.success(this.diagHealthBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('diag_analysis')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.diagAnalysisBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('repair_tasks')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.diagRepairBody);
    }
    return ApiResult.success('[]');
  }

  async post(path: string, body: string, prefer: string = '', authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    this.postPaths.push(path);
    this.postBodies.push(body);
    if (this.failPosts) {
      return ApiResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', 'fake post failure'));
    }
    if (path === 'rpc/tt_login_enqueue') {
      return ApiResult.success(this.ttLoginEnqueueBody);
    }
    if (path === 'rpc/tt_login_status') {
      return ApiResult.success(this.ttLoginStatusBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('rpc/class_members')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.membersBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('rpc/class_league')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.leagueBody);
    }
    if (path === 'rpc/poll_list') {
      return ApiResult.success(this.pollListBody);
    }
    if (path === 'rpc/poll_detail') {
      return ApiResult.success(this.pollDetailBody);
    }
    if (path.startsWith('rpc/poll_')) {
      return ApiResult.success(this.pollActionResult);
    }
    if (path === 'rpc/hw_bind' || path === 'rpc/hw_unbind') {
      return ApiResult.success(this.hwActionBody);
    }
    if (path === 'rpc/hw_login') {
      return ApiResult.success(this.hwLoginBody);
    }
    if (path === 'rpc/hw_bindings') {
      return ApiResult.success(this.hwListBody);
    }
    return ApiResult.success('[]');
  }

  async patch(path: string, body: string, prefer: string = '', authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    this.patchPaths.push(path);
    this.patchBodies.push(body);
    if (this.failPosts) {
      return ApiResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', 'fake patch failure'));
    }
    return ApiResult.success('[]');
  }

  async delete(path: string, authenticated: boolean = true): Promise<ApiResult> {
    this.deletePaths.push(path);
    if (this.failPosts) {
      return ApiResult.failure(new ApiError(ApiErrorKind.Network, 0, 'network', 'fake delete failure'));
    }
    return ApiResult.success('[]');
  }

  lastPostBody(): string {
    return this.postBodies.length > 0 ? this.postBodies[this.postBodies.length - 1] : '';
  }
}
